verses.textZh: 以色列的众子，各人带着家眷和雅各一同来到埃及。他们的名字是：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的众子，各人带着家眷和雅各一同来到埃及。他们的名字是：
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的众子，各带家眷，和雅各一同来到埃及。他们的名字记在下面。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob, each with his family:
verses.textEnEsv: These are the names of the sons of Israel who came to Egypt with Jacob, each with his household:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are the names of the children of Israel who came to Egypt; each man and his household came with Jacob:
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of the sons of Israel (that is, Jacob) who moved to Egypt with their father, each with his family:
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel who came to Egypt with Jacob; they came, each one with his household:
verses.textEn: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob, each with his family:

verses.textZh: 流本、西缅、利未、犹大、
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本、西缅、利未、犹大、
verses.textZhCuv: 有吕便、西缅、利未、犹大、
verses.textEnNiv: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah;
verses.textEnEsv: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;
verses.textEnNlt: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah,
verses.textEnNasb: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;
verses.textEn: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah;

verses.textZh: 以萨迦、西布伦、便雅悯、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以萨迦、西布伦、便雅悯、
verses.textZhCuv: 以萨迦、西布伦、便雅悯、
verses.textEnNiv: Issachar, Zebulun and Benjamin;
verses.textEnEsv: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
verses.textEnNkjv: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;
verses.textEnNlt: Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin,
verses.textEnNasb: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;
verses.textEn: Issachar, Zebulun and Benjamin;

verses.textZh: 但、拿弗他利、迦得、亚设。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但、拿弗他利、迦得、亚设。
verses.textZhCuv: 但、拿弗他利、迦得、亚设。
verses.textEnNiv: Dan and Naphtali; Gad and Asher.
verses.textEnEsv: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dan, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.textEnNlt: Dan, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.textEnNasb: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
verses.textEn: Dan and Naphtali; Gad and Asher.

verses.textZh: 他们全是雅各所生的，共有七十人；那时约瑟已经在埃及了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们全是雅各所生的，共有七十人；那时约瑟已经在埃及了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡从雅各而生的，共有七十人。约瑟已经在埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all; Joseph was already in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: All the descendants of Jacob were seventy persons; Joseph was already in Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: All those who were descendants of Jacob were seventy persons (for Joseph was in Egypt already).
verses.textEnNlt: In all, Jacob had seventy descendants in Egypt, including Joseph, who was already there.
verses.textEnNasb: All the people who descended from Jacob were seventy people, but Joseph was already in Egypt.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all; Joseph was already in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 后来，约瑟和他所有的兄弟，以及那一代的人都死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，约瑟和他所有的兄弟，以及那一代的人都死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟和他的弟兄，并那一代的人，都死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph died, and all his brothers and all that generation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph died, all his brothers, and all that generation.
verses.textEnNlt: In time, Joseph and all of his brothers died, ending that entire generation.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph died, and all his brothers and all that generation.
verses.textEn: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,

verses.textZh: 以色列人生养繁衍众多，人数增加，极其强盛，遍满了那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人生养繁衍众多，人数增加，极其强盛，遍满了那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人生养众多，并且繁茂，极其强盛，满了那地。
verses.textEnNiv: but the Israelites were exceedingly fruitful; they multiplied greatly, increased in numbers and became so numerous that the land was filled with them.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people of Israel were fruitful and increased greatly; they multiplied and grew exceedingly strong, so that the land was filled with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the children of Israel were fruitful and increased abundantly, multiplied and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
verses.textEnNlt: But their descendants, the Israelites, had many children and grandchildren. In fact, they multiplied so greatly that they became extremely powerful and filled the land.
verses.textEnNasb: But the sons of Israel were fruitful and increased greatly, and multiplied, and became exceedingly mighty, so that the land was filled with them.
verses.textEn: but the Israelites were exceedingly fruitful; they multiplied greatly, increased in numbers and became so numerous that the land was filled with them.

verses.textZh: 那时，有一位不认识约瑟的新王兴起来，统治埃及。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，有一位不认识约瑟的新王兴起来，统治埃及。
verses.textZhCuv: 有不认识约瑟的新王起来，治理埃及，
verses.textEnNiv: Then a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: Eventually, a new king came to power in Egypt who knew nothing about Joseph or what he had done.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a new king arose over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.
verses.textEn: Then a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 他对自己的人民说："看哪，以色列民比我们众多强盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对自己的人民说："看哪，以色列民比我们众多强盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他的百姓说：「看哪，这以色列民比我们还多，又比我们强盛。
verses.textEnNiv: "Look," he said to his people, "the Israelites have become far too numerous for us.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his people, "Behold, the people of Israel are too many and too mighty for us.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to his people, "Look, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we;
verses.textEnNlt: He said to his people, "Look, the people of Israel now outnumber us and are stronger than we are.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to his people, "Behold, the people of the sons of Israel are too many and too mighty for us.
verses.textEn: "Look," he said to his people, "the Israelites have become far too numerous for us.

verses.textZh: 来吧，我们要用巧计对付他们，恐怕他们增多起来，一旦发生战争，他们就与我们的仇敌联合，攻击我们，并且离开这地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 来吧，我们要用巧计对付他们，恐怕他们增多起来，一旦发生战争，他们就与我们的仇敌联合，攻击我们，并且离开这地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 来吧，我们不如用巧计待他们，恐怕他们多起来，日后若遇什么争战的事，就连合我们的仇敌攻击我们，离开这地去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Come, we must deal shrewdly with them or they will become even more numerous and, if war breaks out, will join our enemies, fight against us and leave the country."
verses.textEnEsv: Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, lest they multiply, and, if war breaks out, they join our enemies and fight against us and escape from the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: come, let us deal shrewdly with them, lest they multiply, and it happen, in the event of war, that they also join our enemies and fight against us, and so go up out of the land."
verses.textEnNlt: We must make a plan to keep them from growing even more. If we don’t, and if war breaks out, they will join our enemies and fight against us. Then they will escape from the country. "
verses.textEnNasb: Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, otherwise they will multiply, and in the event of war, they will also join those who hate us, and fight against us and depart from the land."
verses.textEn: Come, we must deal shrewdly with them or they will become even more numerous and, if war breaks out, will join our enemies, fight against us and leave the country."

verses.textZh: 于是，他们指派督工管辖他们，加重他们的重担苦害他们，他们为法老建造两座贮货城，就是比东和兰塞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，他们指派督工管辖他们，加重他们的重担苦害他们，他们为法老建造两座贮货城，就是比东和兰塞。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是埃及人派督工的辖制他们，加重担苦害他们。他们为法老建造两座积货城，就是比东和兰塞。
verses.textEnNiv: So they put slave masters over them to oppress them with forced labor, and they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with heavy burdens. They built for Pharaoh store cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh supply cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Egyptians made the Israelites their slaves. They appointed brutal slave drivers over them, hoping to wear them down with crushing labor. They forced them to build the cities of Pithom and Rameses as supply centers for the king.
verses.textEnNasb: So they appointed taskmasters over them to oppress them with hard labor. And they built for Pharaoh storage cities, Pithom and Raamses.
verses.textEn: So they put slave masters over them to oppress them with forced labor, and they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.

verses.textZh: 但是，埃及人越苦害他们，他们就越发增多，越发繁衍。埃及人就惧怕以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，埃及人越苦害他们，他们就越发增多，越发繁衍。埃及人就惧怕以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是越发苦害他们，他们越发多起来，越发蔓延；埃及人就因以色列人愁烦。
verses.textEnNiv: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and spread; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites
verses.textEnEsv: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and the more they spread abroad. And the Egyptians were in dread of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were in dread of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But the more the Egyptians oppressed them, the more the Israelites multiplied and spread, and the more alarmed the Egyptians became.
verses.textEnNasb: But the more they oppressed them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out, so that they dreaded the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and spread; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites

verses.textZh: 于是，埃及人严严地使以色列人作苦工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，埃及人严严地使以色列人作苦工。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人严严地使以色列人做工，
verses.textEnNiv: and worked them ruthlessly.
verses.textEnEsv: So they ruthlessly made the people of Israel work as slaves
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Egyptians made the children of Israel serve with rigor.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Egyptians worked the people of Israel without mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: The Egyptians used violence to compel the sons of Israel to labor;
verses.textEn: and worked them ruthlessly.

verses.textZh: 埃及人使他们因作苦工而觉得命苦，他们要和泥、做砖、作田间各样的工；这一切苦工，埃及人都严严地驱使以色列人去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及人使他们因作苦工而觉得命苦，他们要和泥、做砖、作田间各样的工；这一切苦工，埃及人都严严地驱使以色列人去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 使他们因做苦工觉得命苦；无论是和泥，是做砖，是做田间各样的工，在一切的工上都严严地待他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They made their lives bitter with harsh labor in brick and mortar and with all kinds of work in the fields; in all their harsh labor the Egyptians worked them ruthlessly.
verses.textEnEsv: and made their lives bitter with hard service, in mortar and brick, and in all kinds of work in the field. In all their work they ruthlessly made them work as slaves.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage— in mortar, in brick, and in all manner of service in the field. All their service in which they made them serve was with rigor.
verses.textEnNlt: They made their lives bitter, forcing them to mix mortar and make bricks and do all the work in the fields. They were ruthless in all their demands.
verses.textEnNasb: and they made their lives bitter with hard labor in mortar and bricks and at all kinds of labor in the field, all their labors which they violently had them perform as slaves.
verses.textEn: They made their lives bitter with harsh labor in brick and mortar and with all kinds of work in the fields; in all their harsh labor the Egyptians worked them ruthlessly.

verses.textZh: 埃及王吩咐两个希伯来接生妇，一个名叫施弗拉，一个名叫普阿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及王吩咐两个希伯来接生妇，一个名叫施弗拉，一个名叫普阿，
verses.textZhCuv: 有希伯来的两个收生婆，一名施弗拉，一名普阿；埃及王对她们说：
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, one of whom was named Shiphrah and the other Puah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of one was Shiphrah and the name of the other Puah;
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, gave this order to the Hebrew midwives, Shiphrah and Puah:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, one of whom was named Shiphrah, and the other was named Puah;
verses.textEn: The king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,

verses.textZh: 说："你们给希伯来妇人接生的时候，要看着她们临盆；若是男孩，你们要杀死他；若是女孩，她就可以活着。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："你们给希伯来妇人接生的时候，要看着她们临盆；若是男孩，你们要杀死他；若是女孩，她就可以活着。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们为希伯来妇人收生，看她们临盆的时候，若是男孩，就把他杀了；若是女孩，就留她存活。」
verses.textEnNiv: "When you are helping the Hebrew women during childbirth on the delivery stool, if you see that the baby is a boy, kill him; but if it is a girl, let her live."
verses.textEnEsv: "When you serve as midwife to the Hebrew women and see them on the birthstool, if it is a son, you shall kill him, but if it is a daughter, she shall live."
verses.textEnNkjv: and he said, "When you do the duties of a midwife for the Hebrew women, and see them on the birthstools, if it is a son, then you shall kill him; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live."
verses.textEnNlt: "When you help the Hebrew women as they give birth, watch as they deliver. If the baby is a boy, kill him; if it is a girl, let her live."
verses.textEnNasb: and he said, "When you are helping the Hebrew women to give birth and see them upon the birthstool, if it is a son, then you shall put him to death; but if it is a daughter, then she shall live."
verses.textEn: "When you are helping the Hebrew women during childbirth on the delivery stool, if you see that the baby is a boy, kill him; but if it is a girl, let her live."

verses.textZh: 但是，接生妇却敬畏神，不照着埃及王吩咐她们的去作，竟让男孩活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，接生妇却敬畏神，不照着埃及王吩咐她们的去作，竟让男孩活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 但是收生婆敬畏神，不照埃及王的吩咐行，竟存留男孩的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do what the king of Egypt had told them to do; they let the boys live.
verses.textEnEsv: But the midwives feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt commanded them, but let the male children live.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the midwives feared God, and did not do as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the male children alive.
verses.textEnNlt: But because the midwives feared God, they refused to obey the king’s orders. They allowed the boys to live, too.
verses.textEnNasb: But the midwives feared God, and did not do as the king of Egypt had commanded them, but let the boys live.
verses.textEn: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do what the king of Egypt had told them to do; they let the boys live.

verses.textZh: 于是，埃及王把接生妇叫了来，对她们说："你们为甚么作这事，让男孩活着呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，埃及王把接生妇叫了来，对她们说："你们为甚么作这事，让男孩活着呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及王召了收生婆来，说：「你们为什么做这事，存留男孩的性命呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, "Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?"
verses.textEnEsv: So the king of Egypt called the midwives and said to them, "Why have you done this, and let the male children live?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Egypt called for the midwives and said to them, "Why have you done this thing, and saved the male children alive?"
verses.textEnNlt: So the king of Egypt called for the midwives. "Why have you done this?" he demanded. "Why have you allowed the boys to live?"
verses.textEnNasb: So the king of Egypt called for the midwives and said to them, "Why have you done this thing, and let the boys live?"
verses.textEn: Then the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, "Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?"

verses.textZh: 接生妇回答法老："希伯来妇人与埃及妇人不同；她们很有活力，接生妇还没有来到，她们已经生产了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 接生妇回答法老："希伯来妇人与埃及妇人不同；她们很有活力，接生妇还没有来到，她们已经生产了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 收生婆对法老说：「因为希伯来妇人与埃及妇人不同；希伯来妇人本是健壮的 ，收生婆还没有到，她们已经生产了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The midwives answered Pharaoh, "Hebrew women are not like Egyptian women; they are vigorous and give birth before the midwives arrive."
verses.textEnEsv: The midwives said to Pharaoh, "Because the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife comes to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the midwives said to Pharaoh, "Because the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women; for they are lively and give birth before the midwives come to them."
verses.textEnNlt: "The Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women," the midwives replied. "They are more vigorous and have their babies so quickly that we cannot get there in time."
verses.textEnNasb: The midwives said to Pharaoh, "Because the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give birth before the midwife can get to them."
verses.textEn: The midwives answered Pharaoh, "Hebrew women are not like Egyptian women; they are vigorous and give birth before the midwives arrive."

verses.textZh: 神恩待接生妇；以色列民增多起来，而且非常强盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神恩待接生妇；以色列民增多起来，而且非常强盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 神厚待收生婆。以色列人多起来，极其强盛。
verses.textEnNiv: So God was kind to the midwives and the people increased and became even more numerous.
verses.textEnEsv: So God dealt well with the midwives. And the people multiplied and grew very strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives, and the people multiplied and grew very mighty.
verses.textEnNlt: So God was good to the midwives, and the Israelites continued to multiply, growing more and more powerful.
verses.textEnNasb: So God was good to the midwives, and the people multiplied, and became very mighty.
verses.textEn: So God was kind to the midwives and the people increased and became even more numerous.

verses.textZh: 接生妇因为敬畏神，神就为她们建立家室。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接生妇因为敬畏神，神就为她们建立家室。
verses.textZhCuv: 收生婆因为敬畏神，神便叫她们成立家室。
verses.textEnNiv: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families of their own.
verses.textEnEsv: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, because the midwives feared God, that He provided households for them.
verses.textEnNlt: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families of their own.
verses.textEnNasb: And because the midwives feared God, He established households for them.
verses.textEn: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families of their own.

verses.textZh: 法老吩咐他的众民说："凡是希伯来人 所生的男孩，你们都要把他投在河里；凡是女孩，就让她活着。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老吩咐他的众民说："凡是希伯来人 所生的男孩，你们都要把他投在河里；凡是女孩，就让她活着。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老吩咐他的众民说：「以色列人所生的男孩，你们都要丢在河里；一切的女孩，你们要存留她的性命。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh gave this order to all his people: "Every Hebrew boy that is born you must throw into the Nile, but let every girl live."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh commanded all his people, "Every son that is born to the Hebrews you shall cast into the Nile, but you shall let every daughter live."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, "Every son who is born you shall cast into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh gave this order to all his people: "Throw every newborn Hebrew boy into the Nile River. But you may let the girls live."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh commanded all his people, saying, "Every son who is born, you are to throw into the Nile, but every daughter, you are to keep alive."
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh gave this order to all his people: "Every Hebrew boy that is born you must throw into the Nile, but let every girl live."

verses.textZh: 有一个利未家的人去娶了一个利未女子为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个利未家的人去娶了一个利未女子为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个利未家的人娶了一个利未女子为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Now a man of the tribe of Levi married a Levite woman,
verses.textEnEsv: Now a man from the house of Levi went and took as his wife a Levite woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a man of the house of Levi went and took aswife a daughter of Levi.
verses.textEnNlt: About this time, a man and woman from the tribe of Levi got married.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a man from the house of Levi went and married a daughter of Levi.
verses.textEn: Now a man of the tribe of Levi married a Levite woman,

verses.textZh: 那女人怀孕，生了一个儿子；见他俊美，就把他藏了三个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人怀孕，生了一个儿子；见他俊美，就把他藏了三个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 那女人怀孕，生一个儿子，见他俊美，就藏了他三个月，
verses.textEnNiv: and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him for three months.
verses.textEnEsv: The woman conceived and bore a son, and when she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the woman conceived and bore a son. And when she saw that he was a beautiful child, she hid him three months.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She saw that he was a special baby and kept him hidden for three months.
verses.textEnNasb: And the woman conceived and gave birth to a son; and when she saw that he was beautiful, she hid him for three months.
verses.textEn: and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him for three months.

verses.textZh: 直到她不能把他再藏了，就拿一个蒲草箱来，涂上沥青和石漆；把孩子放在里面，把箱子放在河边的芦苇丛中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到她不能把他再藏了，就拿一个蒲草箱来，涂上沥青和石漆；把孩子放在里面，把箱子放在河边的芦苇丛中。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来不能再藏，就取了一个蒲草箱，抹上石漆和石油，将孩子放在里头，把箱子搁在河边的芦荻中。
verses.textEnNiv: But when she could hide him no longer, she got a papyrus basket for him and coated it with tar and pitch. Then she placed the child in it and put it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.
verses.textEnEsv: When she could hide him no longer, she took for him a basket made of bulrushes and daubed it with bitumen and pitch. She put the child in it and placed it among the reeds by the river bank.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when she could no longer hide him, she took an ark of bulrushes for him, daubed it with asphalt and pitch, put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.
verses.textEnNlt: But when she could no longer hide him, she got a basket made of papyrus reeds and waterproofed it with tar and pitch. She put the baby in the basket and laid it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile River.
verses.textEnNasb: But when she could no longer hide him, she got him a papyrus basket and covered it with tar and pitch. Then she put the child in it and set it among the reeds by the bank of the Nile.
verses.textEn: But when she could hide him no longer, she got a papyrus basket for him and coated it with tar and pitch. Then she placed the child in it and put it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.

verses.textZh: 孩子的姊姊远远地站着，要知道孩子究竟怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子的姊姊远远地站着，要知道孩子究竟怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子的姊姊远远站着，要知道他究竟怎么样。
verses.textEnNiv: His sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And his sister stood at a distance to know what would be done to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his sister stood afar off, to know what would be done to him.
verses.textEnNlt: The baby’s sister then stood at a distance, watching to see what would happen to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And his sister stood at a distance to find out what would happen to him.
verses.textEn: His sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him.

verses.textZh: 那时，法老的女儿下到河边去洗澡；她的使女们在河边行走；她看见了在芦苇中的箱子，就打发自己的使女去把箱子拿过来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，法老的女儿下到河边去洗澡；她的使女们在河边行走；她看见了在芦苇中的箱子，就打发自己的使女去把箱子拿过来。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的女儿来到河边洗澡，她的使女们在河边行走。她看见箱子在芦荻中，就打发一个婢女拿来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh’s daughter went down to the Nile to bathe, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. She saw the basket among the reeds and sent her female slave to get it.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the river, while her young women walked beside the river. She saw the basket among the reeds and sent her servant woman, and she took it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the river. And her maidens walked along the riverside; and when she saw the ark among the reeds, she sent her maid to get it.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe in the river, and her attendants walked along the riverbank. When the princess saw the basket among the reeds, she sent her maid to get it for her.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the Nile, with her female attendants walking alongside the Nile; and she saw the basket among the reeds and sent her slave woman, and she brought it to her.
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh’s daughter went down to the Nile to bathe, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. She saw the basket among the reeds and sent her female slave to get it.

verses.textZh: 她打开了，就看见那孩子；看哪，孩子哭了，她就怜悯他，说："这是希伯来人的一个孩子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她打开了，就看见那孩子；看哪，孩子哭了，她就怜悯他，说："这是希伯来人的一个孩子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她打开箱子，看见那孩子。孩子哭了，她就可怜他，说：「这是希伯来人的一个孩子。」
verses.textEnNiv: She opened it and saw the baby. He was crying, and she felt sorry for him. "This is one of the Hebrew babies," she said.
verses.textEnEsv: When she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the baby was crying. She took pity on him and said, "This is one of the Hebrews’ children."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the baby wept. So she had compassion on him, and said, "This is one of the Hebrews’ children."
verses.textEnNlt: When the princess opened it, she saw the baby. The little boy was crying, and she felt sorry for him. "This must be one of the Hebrew children," she said.
verses.textEnNasb: When she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the boy was crying. And she had pity on him and said, "This is one of the Hebrews’ children."
verses.textEn: She opened it and saw the baby. He was crying, and she felt sorry for him. "This is one of the Hebrew babies," she said.

verses.textZh: 孩子的姊姊对法老的女儿说："我去从希伯来妇人中给你请一个奶妈来，为你乳养这个孩子可以吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子的姊姊对法老的女儿说："我去从希伯来妇人中给你请一个奶妈来，为你乳养这个孩子可以吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子的姊姊对法老的女儿说：「我去在希伯来妇人中叫一个奶妈来，为你奶这孩子，可以不可以？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then his sister asked Pharaoh’s daughter, "Shall I go and get one of the Hebrew women to nurse the baby for you?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, "Shall I go and call you a nurse from the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, "Shall I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the baby’s sister approached the princess. "Should I go and find one of the Hebrew women to nurse the baby for you?" she asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, "Shall I go and call a woman for you who is nursing from the Hebrew women, so that she may nurse the child for you?"
verses.textEn: Then his sister asked Pharaoh’s daughter, "Shall I go and get one of the Hebrew women to nurse the baby for you?"

verses.textZh: 法老的女儿回答："你去吧。"童女就去把孩子的母亲请了来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老的女儿回答："你去吧。"童女就去把孩子的母亲请了来。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的女儿说：「可以。」童女就去叫了孩子的母亲来。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yes, go," she answered. So the girl went and got the baby’s mother.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Go." So the girl went and called the child’s mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Go." So the maiden went and called the child’s mother.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, do!" the princess replied. So the girl went and called the baby’s mother.
verses.textEnNasb: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Go ahead." So the girl went and called the child’s mother.
verses.textEn: "Yes, go," she answered. So the girl went and got the baby’s mother.

verses.textZh: 法老的女儿对她说："你把这孩子抱去，替我乳养他，我必给你工钱。"妇人就抱了孩子去乳养他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老的女儿对她说："你把这孩子抱去，替我乳养他，我必给你工钱。"妇人就抱了孩子去乳养他。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的女儿对她说：「你把这孩子抱去，为我奶他，我必给你工价。」妇人就抱了孩子去奶他。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Take this baby and nurse him for me, and I will pay you." So the woman took the baby and nursed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Take this child away and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages." So the woman took the child and nursed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Take this child away and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages." So the woman took the child and nursed him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take this baby and nurse him for me," the princess told the baby’s mother. "I will pay you for your help." So the woman took her baby home and nursed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Take this child away and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages." So the woman took the child and nursed him.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, "Take this baby and nurse him for me, and I will pay you." So the woman took the baby and nursed him.

verses.textZh: 孩子长大了，妇人把他带到法老的女儿那里，他就作了法老女儿的儿子。她给孩子起名叫摩西，说："因为我把他从水里拉出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子长大了，妇人把他带到法老的女儿那里，他就作了法老女儿的儿子。她给孩子起名叫摩西，说："因为我把他从水里拉出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子渐长，妇人把他带到法老的女儿那里，就作了她的儿子。她给孩子起名叫摩西，意思说：「因我把他从水里拉出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the child grew older, she took him to Pharaoh’s daughter and he became her son. She named him Moses, saying, "I drew him out of the water."
verses.textEnEsv: When the child grew older, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, "Because," she said, "I drew him out of the water."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. So she called his name Moses, saying, "Because I drew him out of the water."
verses.textEnNlt: Later, when the boy was older, his mother brought him back to Pharaoh’s daughter, who adopted him as her own son. The princess named him Moses, for she explained, "I lifted him out of the water."
verses.textEnNasb: And the child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter and he became her son. And she named him Moses, and said, "Because I drew him out of the water."
verses.textEn: When the child grew older, she took him to Pharaoh’s daughter and he became her son. She named him Moses, saying, "I drew him out of the water."

verses.textZh: 过了些日子，摩西长大了，有一次，他出去到他的同胞那里去，看见他们的重担，又看见一个埃及人打他的一个同胞希伯来人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了些日子，摩西长大了，有一次，他出去到他的同胞那里去，看见他们的重担，又看见一个埃及人打他的一个同胞希伯来人。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，摩西长大，他出去到他弟兄那里，看他们的重担，见一个埃及人打希伯来人的一个弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to where his own people were and watched them at their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.
verses.textEnEsv: One day, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his people and looked on their burdens, and he saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out to his brethren and looked at their burdens. And he saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Many years later, when Moses had grown up, he went out to visit his own people, the Hebrews, and he saw how hard they were forced to work. During his visit, he saw an Egyptian beating one of his fellow Hebrews.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in those days, when Moses had grown up, that he went out to his fellow Hebrews and looked at their hard labors; and he saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his fellow Hebrews.
verses.textEn: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to where his own people were and watched them at their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.

verses.textZh: 摩西左右观望，见没有人，就把那埃及人击杀了，埋藏在沙土里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西左右观望，见没有人，就把那埃及人击杀了，埋藏在沙土里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他左右观看，见没有人，就把埃及人打死了，藏在沙土里。
verses.textEnNiv: Looking this way and that and seeing no one, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
verses.textEnEsv: He looked this way and that, and seeing no one, he struck down the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he looked this way and that way, and when he saw no one, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
verses.textEnNlt: After looking in all directions to make sure no one was watching, Moses killed the Egyptian and hid the body in the sand.
verses.textEnNasb: So he looked this way and that, and when he saw that there was no one around, he struck and killed the Egyptian, and hid his body in the sand.
verses.textEn: Looking this way and that and seeing no one, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.

verses.textZh: 第二天他又出去，看见两个希伯来人彼此争斗着，就对那欺负人的说："你为甚么打你同族的人呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天他又出去，看见两个希伯来人彼此争斗着，就对那欺负人的说："你为甚么打你同族的人呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天他出去，见有两个希伯来人争斗，就对那欺负人的说：「你为什么打你同族的人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The next day he went out and saw two Hebrews fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, "Why are you hitting your fellow Hebrew?"
verses.textEnEsv: When he went out the next day, behold, two Hebrews were struggling together. And he said to the man in the wrong, "Why do you strike your companion?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he went out the second day, behold, two Hebrew men were fighting, and he said to the one who did the wrong, "Why are you striking your companion?"
verses.textEnNlt: The next day, when Moses went out to visit his people again, he saw two Hebrew men fighting. "Why are you beating up your friend?" Moses said to the one who had started the fight.
verses.textEnNasb: Now he went out the next day, and behold, two Hebrews were fighting with each other; and he said to the offender, "Why are you striking your companion?"
verses.textEn: The next day he went out and saw two Hebrews fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, "Why are you hitting your fellow Hebrew?"

verses.textZh: 那人回答："谁立了你作我们的领袖和审判官呢？难道你想杀我，好象杀那个埃及人一样吗？"摩西就惧怕起来，心里想："这事必定给人知道了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人回答："谁立了你作我们的领袖和审判官呢？难道你想杀我，好象杀那个埃及人一样吗？"摩西就惧怕起来，心里想："这事必定给人知道了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人说：「谁立你作我们的首领和审判官呢？难道你要杀我，像杀那埃及人吗？」摩西便惧怕，说：「这事必是被人知道了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man said, "Who made you ruler and judge over us? Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian?" Then Moses was afraid and thought, "What I did must have become known."
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you mean to kill me as you killed the Egyptian?" Then Moses was afraid, and thought, "Surely the thing is known."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you intend to kill me as you killed the Egyptian?" So Moses feared and said, "Surely this thing is known!"
verses.textEnNlt: The man replied, "Who appointed you to be our prince and judge? Are you going to kill me as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?" Then Moses was afraid, thinking, "Everyone knows what I did."
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "Who made you a ruler and a judge over us? Do you intend to kill me as you killed the Egyptian?" Then Moses was afraid and said, "Surely the matter has become known!"
verses.textEn: The man said, "Who made you ruler and judge over us? Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian?" Then Moses was afraid and thought, "What I did must have become known."

verses.textZh: 法老听见这事，就设法要杀摩西；摩西躲避法老，就往米甸地去居住；有一天他坐在井旁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老听见这事，就设法要杀摩西；摩西躲避法老，就往米甸地去居住；有一天他坐在井旁。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老听见这事，就想杀摩西，但摩西躲避法老，逃往米甸地居住。
verses.textEnNiv: When Pharaoh heard of this, he tried to kill Moses, but Moses fled from Pharaoh and went to live in Midian, where he sat down by a well.
verses.textEnEsv: When Pharaoh heard of it, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from Pharaoh and stayed in the land of Midian. And he sat down by a well.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Pharaoh heard of this matter, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh and dwelt in the land of Midian; and he sat down by a well.
verses.textEnNlt: And sure enough, Pharaoh heard what had happened, and he tried to kill Moses. But Moses fled from Pharaoh and went to live in the land of Midian. When Moses arrived in Midian, he sat down beside a well.
verses.textEnNasb: When Pharaoh heard about this matter, he tried to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the presence of Pharaoh and settled in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.
verses.textEn: When Pharaoh heard of this, he tried to kill Moses, but Moses fled from Pharaoh and went to live in Midian, where he sat down by a well.

verses.textZh: 米甸的祭司有七个女儿，她们来打水，打满了水槽，要给父亲的羊群喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米甸的祭司有七个女儿，她们来打水，打满了水槽，要给父亲的羊群喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，他在井旁坐下。米甸的祭司有七个女儿；她们来打水，打满了槽，要饮父亲的群羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Now a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came and drew water and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. And they came and drew water, and they filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters who came as usual to draw water and fill the water troughs for their father’s flocks.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters; and they came to draw water and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
verses.textEn: Now a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.

verses.textZh: 有些牧人来了，把她们赶走；摩西却起来，救了她们，也给她们的羊群喝水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些牧人来了，把她们赶走；摩西却起来，救了她们，也给她们的羊群喝水。
verses.textZhCuv: 有牧羊的人来，把她们赶走了，摩西却起来帮助她们，又饮了她们的群羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Some shepherds came along and drove them away, but Moses got up and came to their rescue and watered their flock.
verses.textEnEsv: The shepherds came and drove them away, but Moses stood up and saved them, and watered their flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
verses.textEnNlt: But some other shepherds came and chased them away. So Moses jumped up and rescued the girls from the shepherds. Then he drew water for their flocks.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the shepherds came and drove them away, but Moses stood up and helped them and watered their flock.
verses.textEn: Some shepherds came along and drove them away, but Moses got up and came to their rescue and watered their flock.

verses.textZh: 她们回到父亲流珥那里，父亲问："今天你们为甚么赶着回来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们回到父亲流珥那里，父亲问："今天你们为甚么赶着回来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 她们来到父亲流珥那里；他说：「今日你们为何来得这么快呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the girls returned to Reuel their father, he asked them, "Why have you returned so early today?"
verses.textEnEsv: When they came home to their father Reuel, he said, "How is it that you have come home so soon today?"
verses.textEnNkjv: When they came to Reuel their father, he said, "How isitthat you have come so soon today?"
verses.textEnNlt: When the girls returned to Reuel, their father, he asked, "Why are you back so soon today?"
verses.textEnNasb: When they came to their father Reuel, he said, "Why have you come back so soon today?"
verses.textEn: When the girls returned to Reuel their father, he asked them, "Why have you returned so early today?"

verses.textZh: 她们说："有一个埃及人救我们脱离了牧羊人的手，而且还为我们打水给羊群喝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们说："有一个埃及人救我们脱离了牧羊人的手，而且还为我们打水给羊群喝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她们说：「有一个埃及人救我们脱离牧羊人的手，并且为我们打水饮了群羊。」
verses.textEnNiv: They answered, "An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds. He even drew water for us and watered the flock."
verses.textEnEsv: They said, "An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds and even drew water for us and watered the flock."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "An Egyptian delivered us from the hand of the shepherds, and he also drew enough water for us and watered the flock."
verses.textEnNlt: "An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds," they answered. "And then he drew water for us and watered our flocks."
verses.textEnNasb: They said, "An Egyptian saved us from the shepherds, and what is more, he even drew water for us and watered the flock."
verses.textEn: They answered, "An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds. He even drew water for us and watered the flock."

verses.textZh: 父亲对众女儿说："他在哪里？你们为甚么撇下那人呢？去请他来吃饭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 父亲对众女儿说："他在哪里？你们为甚么撇下那人呢？去请他来吃饭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对女儿们说：「那个人在哪里？你们为什么撇下他呢？你们去请他来吃饭。」
verses.textEnNiv: "And where is he?" Reuel asked his daughters. "Why did you leave him? Invite him to have something to eat."
verses.textEnEsv: He said to his daughters, "Then where is he? Why have you left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to his daughters, "And where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread."
verses.textEnNlt: "Then where is he?" their father asked. "Why did you leave him there? Invite him to come and eat with us."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to his daughters, "Where is he then? Why is it that you have left the man behind? Invite him to have something to eat."
verses.textEn: "And where is he?" Reuel asked his daughters. "Why did you leave him? Invite him to have something to eat."

verses.textZh: 摩西乐意和那人同住；那人把自己的女儿西坡拉给了摩西作妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西乐意和那人同住；那人把自己的女儿西坡拉给了摩西作妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西甘心和那人同住；那人把他的女儿西坡拉给摩西为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses agreed to stay with the man, who gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses was content to dwell with the man, and he gave Moses his daughter Zipporah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses was content to live with the man, and he gave Zipporah his daughter to Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses accepted the invitation, and he settled there with him. In time, Reuel gave Moses his daughter Zipporah to be his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses was willing to live with the man. And he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses.
verses.textEn: Moses agreed to stay with the man, who gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.

verses.textZh: 西坡拉生了一个儿子，摩西给他起名叫革舜，因为他说："我在异地作了客旅。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西坡拉生了一个儿子，摩西给他起名叫革舜，因为他说："我在异地作了客旅。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西坡拉生了一个儿子，摩西给他起名叫革舜，意思说：「因我在外邦作了寄居的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Zipporah gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, "I have become a foreigner in a foreign land."
verses.textEnEsv: She gave birth to a son, and he called his name Gershom, for he said, "I have been a sojourner in a foreign land."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she bore him a son. He called his name Gershom, for he said, "I have been a stranger in a foreign land."
verses.textEnNlt: Later she gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, for he explained, "I have been a foreigner in a foreign land."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she gave birth to a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, "I have been a stranger in a foreign land."
verses.textEn: Zipporah gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, "I have become a foreigner in a foreign land."

verses.textZh: 过了很久，埃及王死了。以色列人在捆锁中叹息，他们就呼求，在捆锁中的呼求达到神那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了很久，埃及王死了。以色列人在捆锁中叹息，他们就呼求，在捆锁中的呼求达到神那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了多年，埃及王死了。以色列人因做苦工，就叹息哀求，他们的哀声达于神。
verses.textEnNiv: During that long period, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned in their slavery and cried out, and their cry for help because of their slavery went up to God.
verses.textEnEsv: During those many days the king of Egypt died, and the people of Israel groaned because of their slavery and cried out for help. Their cry for rescue from slavery came up to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened in the process of time that the king of Egypt died. Then the children of Israel groaned because of the bondage, and they cried out; and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: Years passed, and the king of Egypt died. But the Israelites continued to groan under their burden of slavery. They cried out for help, and their cry rose up to God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the course of those many days that the king of Egypt died. And the sons of Israel groaned because of the bondage, and they cried out; and their cry for help because of their bondage ascended to God.
verses.textEn: During that long period, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned in their slavery and cried out, and their cry for help because of their slavery went up to God.

verses.textZh: 神听见他们的呼声，就记念他与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神听见他们的呼声，就记念他与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 神听见他们的哀声，就记念他与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: God heard their groaning and he remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac and with Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: So God heard their groaning, and God remembered His covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: God heard their groaning, and he remembered his covenant promise to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: So God heard their groaning; and God remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEn: God heard their groaning and he remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac and with Jacob.

verses.textZh: 神看顾以色列人，也关注他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神看顾以色列人，也关注他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 神看顾以色列人，也知道他们的苦情。
verses.textEnNiv: So God looked on the Israelites and was concerned about them.
verses.textEnEsv: God saw the people of Israel—and God knew.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God acknowledged them.
verses.textEnNlt: He looked down on the people of Israel and knew it was time to act.
verses.textEnNasb: And God saw the sons of Israel, and God took notice of them.
verses.textEn: So God looked on the Israelites and was concerned about them.

verses.textZh: 那时，摩西正在牧放他岳父米甸祭司叶忒罗的羊群。有一次，他把羊群领到旷野的尽头去，到了神的山，就是何烈山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，摩西正在牧放他岳父米甸祭司叶忒罗的羊群。有一次，他把羊群领到旷野的尽头去，到了神的山，就是何烈山。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西牧养他岳父米甸祭司叶忒罗的羊群；一日领羊群往野外去，到了神的山，就是何烈山。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Moses was tending the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Moses was keeping the flock of his father-in-law, Jethro, the priest of Midian, and he led his flock to the west side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Moses was tending the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian. And he led the flock to the back of the desert, and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Moses was tending the flock of his father-in-law, Jethro, the priest of Midian. He led the flock far into the wilderness and came to Sinai, the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Moses was pasturing the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian; and he led the flock to the west side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
verses.textEn: Now Moses was tending the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者从荆棘丛里的火焰中向摩西显现。摩西观看，看见荆棘被火烧着，却没有烧毁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者从荆棘丛里的火焰中向摩西显现。摩西观看，看见荆棘被火烧着，却没有烧毁。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者从荆棘里火焰中向摩西显现。摩西观看，不料，荆棘被火烧着，却没有烧毁。
verses.textEnNiv: There the angel of the Lord appeared to him in flames of fire from within a bush. Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush was burning, yet it was not consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Angel of the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire from the midst of a bush. So he looked, and behold, the bush was burning with fire, but the bush was not consumed.
verses.textEnNlt: There the angel of the Lord appeared to him in a blazing fire from the middle of a bush. Moses stared in amazement. Though the bush was engulfed in flames, it didn’t burn up.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of the Lord appeared to him in a blazing fire from the midst of a bush; and he looked, and behold, the bush was burning with fire, yet the bush was not being consumed.
verses.textEn: There the angel of the Lord appeared to him in flames of fire from within a bush. Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up.

verses.textZh: 摩西说："我要到那边去，看看这大异象，这荆棘为甚么烧不掉？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："我要到那边去，看看这大异象，这荆棘为甚么烧不掉？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「我要过去看这大异象，这荆棘为何没有烧坏呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses thought, "I will go over and see this strange sight—why the bush does not burn up."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said, "I will turn aside to see this great sight, why the bush is not burned."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said, "I will now turn aside and see this great sight, why the bush does not burn."
verses.textEnNlt: "This is amazing," Moses said to himself. "Why isn’t that bush burning up? I must go see it."
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses said, "I must turn aside and see this marvelous sight, why the bush is not burning up!"
verses.textEn: So Moses thought, "I will go over and see this strange sight—why the bush does not burn up."

verses.textZh: 耶和华见摩西要到那边去观看，神就从荆棘丛里呼叫他，说："摩西，摩西。"摩西说："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华见摩西要到那边去观看，神就从荆棘丛里呼叫他，说："摩西，摩西。"摩西说："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神见他过去要看，就从荆棘里呼叫说：「摩西！摩西！」他说：「我在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord saw that he had gone over to look, God called to him from within the bush, "Moses! Moses!" And Moses said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnEsv: When the Lord saw that he turned aside to see, God called to him out of the bush, "Moses, Moses!" And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when the Lord saw that he turned aside to look, God called to him from the midst of the bush and said, "Moses, Moses!" And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord saw Moses coming to take a closer look, God called to him from the middle of the bush, "Moses! Moses!" "Here I am!" Moses replied.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lord saw that he turned aside to look, God called to him from the midst of the bush and said, "Moses, Moses!" And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEn: When the Lord saw that he had gone over to look, God called to him from within the bush, "Moses! Moses!" And Moses said, "Here I am."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："不可过到这里来；要把你脚上的鞋脱掉，因为你所站的地方是圣地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："不可过到这里来；要把你脚上的鞋脱掉，因为你所站的地方是圣地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「不要近前来。当把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站之地是圣地」；
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not come any closer," God said. "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "Do not come near; take your sandals off your feet, for the place on which you are standing is holy ground."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said, "Do not draw near this place. Take your sandals off your feet, for the place where you stand is holy ground."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not come any closer," the Lord warned. "Take off your sandals, for you are standing on holy ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said, "Do not come near here; remove your sandals from your feet, for the place on which you are standing is holy ground."
verses.textEn: "Do not come any closer," God said. "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground."

verses.textZh: 又说："我是你父亲的神、亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神。"摩西因为怕见神，就把自己的脸蒙住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："我是你父亲的神、亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神。"摩西因为怕见神，就把自己的脸蒙住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「我是你父亲的神，是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。」摩西蒙上脸，因为怕看神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said, "I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob." At this, Moses hid his face, because he was afraid to look at God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover He said, "I am the God of your father—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look upon God.
verses.textEnNlt: I am the God of your father —the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." When Moses heard this, he covered his face because he was afraid to look at God.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "I am the God of your father—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." Then Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.
verses.textEn: Then he said, "I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob." At this, Moses hid his face, because he was afraid to look at God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我的子民在埃及所受的痛苦，我实在看见了；他们因受督工的辖制所发的呼声，我也听见了；他们的痛苦，我是知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我的子民在埃及所受的痛苦，我实在看见了；他们因受督工的辖制所发的呼声，我也听见了；他们的痛苦，我是知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了；他们因受督工的辖制所发的哀声，我也听见了。我原知道他们的痛苦，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said, "I have indeed seen the misery of my people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their slave drivers, and I am concerned about their suffering.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said, "I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters. I know their sufferings,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said: "I have surely seen the oppression of My people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told him, "I have certainly seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their cries of distress because of their harsh slave drivers. Yes, I am aware of their suffering.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said, "I have certainly seen the oppression of My people who are in Egypt, and have heard their outcry because of their taskmasters, for I am aware of their sufferings.
verses.textEn: The Lord said, "I have indeed seen the misery of my people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their slave drivers, and I am concerned about their suffering.

verses.textZh: 所以我下来，要救他们脱离埃及人的手，领他们脱离那地，到美好宽阔之地，到流奶与蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人和耶布斯人的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我下来，要救他们脱离埃及人的手，领他们脱离那地，到美好宽阔之地，到流奶与蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人和耶布斯人的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 我下来是要救他们脱离埃及人的手，领他们出了那地，到美好、宽阔、流奶与蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人之地。
verses.textEnNiv: So I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land into a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
verses.textEnEsv: and I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and broad land, a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up from that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites.
verses.textEnNlt: So I have come down to rescue them from the power of the Egyptians and lead them out of Egypt into their own fertile and spacious land. It is a land flowing with milk and honey—the land where the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites now live.
verses.textEnNasb: So I have come down to rescue them from the power of the Egyptians, and to bring them up from that land to a good and spacious land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.textEn: So I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land into a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

verses.textZh: 现在以色列人的呼声已经达到我的面前，我也看见了埃及人对他们所施的压迫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在以色列人的呼声已经达到我的面前，我也看见了埃及人对他们所施的压迫。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在以色列人的哀声达到我耳中，我也看见埃及人怎样欺压他们。
verses.textEnNiv: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached me, and I have seen the way the Egyptians are oppressing them.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, behold, the cry of the people of Israel has come to me, and I have also seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to Me, and I have also seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! The cry of the people of Israel has reached me, and I have seen how harshly the Egyptians abuse them.
verses.textEnNasb: And now, behold, the cry of the sons of Israel has come to Me; furthermore, I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians are oppressing them.
verses.textEn: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached me, and I have seen the way the Egyptians are oppressing them.

verses.textZh: 所以现在你来，我要派你到法老那里去，使你可以把我的人民以色列人从埃及领出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以现在你来，我要派你到法老那里去，使你可以把我的人民以色列人从埃及领出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，我要打发你去见法老，使你可以将我的百姓以色列人从埃及领出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: So now, go. I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring my people the Israelites out of Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: Come, I will send you to Pharaoh that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: Come now, therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh that you may bring My people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: Now go, for I am sending you to Pharaoh. You must lead my people Israel out of Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: And now come, and I will send you to Pharaoh, so that you may bring My people, the sons of Israel, out of Egypt."
verses.textEn: So now, go. I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring my people the Israelites out of Egypt."

verses.textZh: 摩西对神说："我是谁，竟能到法老那里去，把以色列人从埃及领出来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对神说："我是谁，竟能到法老那里去，把以色列人从埃及领出来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对神说：「我是什么人，竟能去见法老，将以色列人从埃及领出来呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses said to God, "Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said to God, "Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Moses said to God, "Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses protested to God, "Who am I to appear before Pharaoh? Who am I to lead the people of Israel out of Egypt?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses said to God, "Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the sons of Israel out of Egypt?"
verses.textEn: But Moses said to God, "Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?"

verses.textZh: 神回答："我必与你同在；你把人民从埃及领出来的时候，你们要在这山上事奉神；这就是我派你去的凭据。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神回答："我必与你同在；你把人民从埃及领出来的时候，你们要在这山上事奉神；这就是我派你去的凭据。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「我必与你同在。你将百姓从埃及领出来之后，你们必在这山上事奉我；这就是我打发你去的证据。」
verses.textEnNiv: And God said, "I will be with you. And this will be the sign to you that it is I who have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, you will worship God on this mountain."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "But I will be with you, and this shall be the sign for you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain."
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said, "I will certainly be with you. And this shallbe a sign to you that I have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain."
verses.textEnNlt: God answered, "I will be with you. And this is your sign that I am the one who has sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, you will worship God at this very mountain."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "Assuredly I will be with you, and this shall be the sign to you that it is I who have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall worship God at this mountain."
verses.textEn: And God said, "I will be with you. And this will be the sign to you that it is I who have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, you will worship God on this mountain."

verses.textZh: 摩西对神说："我到以色列人那里，对他们说：‘你们祖宗的神差遣我到你们这里来’，他们必问我：‘他叫甚么名字？’我要对他们说甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对神说："我到以色列人那里，对他们说：‘你们祖宗的神差遣我到你们这里来’，他们必问我：‘他叫甚么名字？’我要对他们说甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对神说：「我到以色列人那里，对他们说：『你们祖宗的神打发我到你们这里来。』他们若问我说：『他叫什么名字？』我要对他们说什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to God, "Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ Then what shall I tell them?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses said to God, "If I come to the people of Israel and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what shall I say to them?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said to God, "Indeed, when I come to the children of Israel and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they say to me, ‘What is His name?’ what shall I say to them?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses protested, "If I go to the people of Israel and tell them, ‘The God of your ancestors has sent me to you,’ they will ask me, ‘What is his name?’ Then what should I tell them?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to God, "Behold, I am going to the sons of Israel, and I will say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you.’ Now they may say to me, ‘What is His name?’ What shall I say to them?"
verses.textEn: Moses said to God, "Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ Then what shall I tell them?"

verses.textZh: 神回答摩西："我是‘自有永有者’。"又说："你要对以色列人这样说：‘那自有者派我到你们这里来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神回答摩西："我是‘自有永有者’。"又说："你要对以色列人这样说：‘那自有者派我到你们这里来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 神对摩西说：「我是自有永有的」；又说：「你要对以色列人这样说：『那自有的打发我到你们这里来。』」
verses.textEnNiv: God said to Moses, " I am who I am . This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘ I am has sent me to you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: God said to Moses, "I am who I am." And he said, "Say this to the people of Israel: ‘I am has sent me to you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And God said to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM." And He said, "Thus you shall say to the children of Israel, ‘I AM has sent me to you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: God replied to Moses, " I Am Who I Am . Say this to the people of Israel: I Am has sent me to you."
verses.textEnNasb: And God said to Moses, " I AM WHO I AM"; and He said, "This is what you shall say to the sons of Israel: ‘ I AM has sent me to you.’ "
verses.textEn: God said to Moses, " I am who I am . This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘ I am has sent me to you.’ "

verses.textZh: 神又对摩西说："你要对以色列人这样说：‘耶和华你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神，差遣我到你们这里来；这就是我永久的名字，也是世世代代中我被记念的名字。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 神又对摩西说："你要对以色列人这样说：‘耶和华你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神，差遣我到你们这里来；这就是我永久的名字，也是世世代代中我被记念的名字。’
verses.textZhCuv: 神又对摩西说：「你要对以色列人这样说：『耶和华－你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，打发我到你们这里来。』耶和华是我的名，直到永远；这也是我的纪念，直到万代。
verses.textEnNiv: God also said to Moses, "Say to the Israelites, ‘The Lord , the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you.’ "This is my name forever, the name you shall call me from generation to generation.
verses.textEnEsv: God also said to Moses, "Say this to the people of Israel: ‘The Lord , the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and thus I am to be remembered throughout all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover God said to Moses, "Thus you shall say to the children of Israel: ‘The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you. This is My name forever, and this is My memorial to all generations.’
verses.textEnNlt: God also said to Moses, "Say this to the people of Israel: Yahweh, the God of your ancestors—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you. This is my eternal name, my name to remember for all generations.
verses.textEnNasb: God furthermore said to Moses, "This is what you shall say to the sons of Israel: ‘The Lord, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, and this is the name for all generations to use to call upon Me.
verses.textEn: God also said to Moses, "Say to the Israelites, ‘The Lord , the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you.’ "This is my name forever, the name you shall call me from generation to generation.

verses.textZh: 你去召集以色列的长老，对他们说：‘耶和华你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神，向我显现，说："我实在眷顾了你们，和鉴察了你们在埃及所遭遇的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你去召集以色列的长老，对他们说：‘耶和华你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神，向我显现，说："我实在眷顾了你们，和鉴察了你们在埃及所遭遇的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你去招聚以色列的长老，对他们说：『耶和华－你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，向我显现，说：我实在眷顾了你们，我也看见埃及人怎样待你们。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘The Lord , the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—appeared to me and said: I have watched over you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Go and gather the elders of Israel together and say to them, ‘The Lord , the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, "I have observed you and what has been done to you in Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and say to them, ‘The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared to me, saying, "I have surely visited you and seen what is done to you in Egypt;
verses.textEnNlt: "Now go and call together all the elders of Israel. Tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your ancestors—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—has appeared to me. He told me, "I have been watching closely, and I see how the Egyptians are treating you.
verses.textEnNasb: Go and gather the elders of Israel together and say to them, ‘The Lord, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob has appeared to me, saying, " I am indeed concerned about you and what has been done to you in Egypt.
verses.textEn: "Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘The Lord , the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob—appeared to me and said: I have watched over you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 我也曾说："我要把你们从埃及的痛苦中领出来，到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人之地去，就是到流奶与蜜之地去。"’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也曾说："我要把你们从埃及的痛苦中领出来，到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人之地去，就是到流奶与蜜之地去。"’
verses.textZhCuv: 我也说：要将你们从埃及的困苦中领出来，往迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地去，就是到流奶与蜜之地。』
verses.textEnNiv: And I have promised to bring you up out of your misery in Egypt into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’
verses.textEnEsv: and I promise that I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, a land flowing with milk and honey."’
verses.textEnNkjv: and I have said I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, to a land flowing with milk and honey." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I have promised to rescue you from your oppression in Egypt. I will lead you to a land flowing with milk and honey—the land where the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites now live."’
verses.textEnNasb: So I said, I will bring you up out of the oppression of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey." ’
verses.textEn: And I have promised to bring you up out of your misery in Egypt into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’

verses.textZh: 他们必听你的话；你和以色列的长老要到埃及王那里去，对他说：‘耶和华希伯来人的神遇见了我们。现在求你让我们走三天的路程到旷野去，好献祭给耶和华我们的神。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必听你的话；你和以色列的长老要到埃及王那里去，对他说：‘耶和华希伯来人的神遇见了我们。现在求你让我们走三天的路程到旷野去，好献祭给耶和华我们的神。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必听你的话。你和以色列的长老要去见埃及王，对他说：『耶和华－希伯来人的神遇见了我们，现在求你容我们往旷野去，走三天的路程，为要祭祀耶和华－我们的神。』
verses.textEnNiv: "The elders of Israel will listen to you. Then you and the elders are to go to the king of Egypt and say to him, ‘The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God.’
verses.textEnEsv: And they will listen to your voice, and you and the elders of Israel shall go to the king of Egypt and say to him, ‘The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, has met with us; and now, please let us go a three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will heed your voice; and you shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt; and you shall say to him, ‘The Lord God of the Hebrews has met with us; and now, please, let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.’
verses.textEnNlt: "The elders of Israel will accept your message. Then you and the elders must go to the king of Egypt and tell him, ‘The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. So please let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the Lord , our God.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will pay attention to what you say; and you with the elders of Israel will come to the king of Egypt, and you will say to him, ‘The Lord, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. So now, please let us go a three days’ journey into the wilderness, so that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.’
verses.textEn: "The elders of Israel will listen to you. Then you and the elders are to go to the king of Egypt and say to him, ‘The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God.’

verses.textZh: 我也知道，如果不施行大能的手 ，埃及王决不会让你们走的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也知道，如果不施行大能的手 ，埃及王决不会让你们走的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我知道虽用大能的手，埃及王也不容你们去。
verses.textEnNiv: But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless a mighty hand compels him.
verses.textEnEsv: But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless compelled by a mighty hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not even by a mighty hand.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless a mighty hand forces him.
verses.textEnNasb: But I know that the king of Egypt will not permit you to go, except under compulsion.
verses.textEn: But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless a mighty hand compels him.

verses.textZh: 因此，我要伸手，用我在埃及快要施行的一切异能，击打埃及；然后他才会让你们离去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我要伸手，用我在埃及快要施行的一切异能，击打埃及；然后他才会让你们离去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必伸手在埃及中间施行我一切的奇事，攻击那地，然后他才容你们去。
verses.textEnNiv: So I will stretch out my hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders that I will perform among them. After that, he will let you go.
verses.textEnEsv: So I will stretch out my hand and strike Egypt with all the wonders that I will do in it; after that he will let you go.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will stretch out My hand and strike Egypt with all My wonders which I will do in its midst; and after that he will let you go.
verses.textEnNlt: So I will raise my hand and strike the Egyptians, performing all kinds of miracles among them. Then at last he will let you go.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will reach out with My hand and strike Egypt with all My miracles which I shall do in the midst of it; and after that he will let you go.
verses.textEn: So I will stretch out my hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders that I will perform among them. After that, he will let you go.

verses.textZh: 我必叫这民在埃及人的眼前蒙恩。因此你们离去的时候，就不至于空手而去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必叫这民在埃及人的眼前蒙恩。因此你们离去的时候，就不至于空手而去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必叫你们在埃及人眼前蒙恩，你们去的时候就不至于空手而去。
verses.textEnNiv: "And I will make the Egyptians favorably disposed toward this people, so that when you leave you will not go empty-handed.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians; and when you go, you shall not go empty,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians; and it shall be, when you go, that you shall not go empty-handed.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will cause the Egyptians to look favorably on you. They will give you gifts when you go so you will not leave empty-handed.
verses.textEnNasb: I will grant this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians; and it shall be that when you go, you will not go empty-handed.
verses.textEn: "And I will make the Egyptians favorably disposed toward this people, so that when you leave you will not go empty-handed.

verses.textZh: 但每个妇女要向她邻居的妇女，和寄居在她家中的妇女索取银器、金器和衣服，要给你们的儿女穿戴；这样，你们就把埃及人的财物掠夺了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但每个妇女要向她邻居的妇女，和寄居在她家中的妇女索取银器、金器和衣服，要给你们的儿女穿戴；这样，你们就把埃及人的财物掠夺了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但各妇女必向她的邻舍，并居住在她家里的女人，要金器银器和衣裳，好给你们的儿女穿戴。这样你们就把埃及人的财物夺去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Every woman is to ask her neighbor and any woman living in her house for articles of silver and gold and for clothing, which you will put on your sons and daughters. And so you will plunder the Egyptians."
verses.textEnEsv: but each woman shall ask of her neighbor, and any woman who lives in her house, for silver and gold jewelry, and for clothing. You shall put them on your sons and on your daughters. So you shall plunder the Egyptians."
verses.textEnNkjv: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, namely, of her who dwells near her house, articles of silver, articles of gold, and clothing; and you shall put them on your sons and on your daughters. So you shall plunder the Egyptians."
verses.textEnNlt: Every Israelite woman will ask for articles of silver and gold and fine clothing from her Egyptian neighbors and from the foreign women in their houses. You will dress your sons and daughters with these, stripping the Egyptians of their wealth."
verses.textEnNasb: But every woman shall ask her neighbor and the woman who lives in her house for articles of silver and articles of gold, and clothing; and you will put them on your sons and daughters. So you will plunder the Egyptians."
verses.textEn: Every woman is to ask her neighbor and any woman living in her house for articles of silver and gold and for clothing, which you will put on your sons and daughters. And so you will plunder the Egyptians."

verses.textZh: 摩西回答："看哪，他们必不信我，也不听我的话；因为他们必说：‘耶和华并没有向你显现。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答："看哪，他们必不信我，也不听我的话；因为他们必说：‘耶和华并没有向你显现。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西回答说：「他们必不信我，也不听我的话，必说：『耶和华并没有向你显现。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses answered, "What if they do not believe me or listen to me and say, ‘The Lord did not appear to you’?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses answered, "But behold, they will not believe me or listen to my voice, for they will say, ‘The Lord did not appear to you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses answered and said, "But suppose they will not believe me or listen to my voice; suppose they say, ‘The Lord has not appeared to you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses protested again, "What if they won’t believe me or listen to me? What if they say, ‘The Lord never appeared to you’?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said, "What if they will not believe me or listen to what I say? For they may say, ‘The Lord has not appeared to you.’ "
verses.textEn: Moses answered, "What if they do not believe me or listen to me and say, ‘The Lord did not appear to you’?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华问摩西："那在你手里的是甚么？"他说："是手杖。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华问摩西："那在你手里的是甚么？"他说："是手杖。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你手里是什么？」他说：「是杖。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to him, "What is that in your hand?" "A staff," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to him, "What is that in your hand?" He said, "A staff."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to him, "What is that in your hand?" He said, "A rod."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord asked him, "What is that in your hand?" "A shepherd’s staff," Moses replied.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to him, "What is that in your hand?" And he said, "A staff."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to him, "What is that in your hand?" "A staff," he replied.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："把它丢在地上。"摩西把它一丢在地上，它就变了蛇；摩西就逃跑，离开了牠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："把它丢在地上。"摩西把它一丢在地上，它就变了蛇；摩西就逃跑，离开了牠。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「丢在地上。」他一丢下去，就变作蛇；摩西便跑开。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said, "Throw it on the ground." Moses threw it on the ground and it became a snake, and he ran from it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Throw it on the ground." So he threw it on the ground, and it became a serpent, and Moses ran from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Cast it on the ground." So he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Throw it down on the ground," the Lord told him. So Moses threw down the staff, and it turned into a snake! Moses jumped back.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said, "Throw it on the ground." So he threw it on the ground, and it turned into a serpent; and Moses fled from it.
verses.textEn: The Lord said, "Throw it on the ground." Moses threw it on the ground and it became a snake, and he ran from it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："伸出你的手来，捉住蛇的尾巴。"摩西就伸出手来，紧握着牠，牠在摩西的掌中又变回了手杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："伸出你的手来，捉住蛇的尾巴。"摩西就伸出手来，紧握着牠，牠在摩西的掌中又变回了手杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「伸出手来，拿住它的尾巴，它必在你手中仍变为杖；
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to him, "Reach out your hand and take it by the tail." So Moses reached out and took hold of the snake and it turned back into a staff in his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to Moses, "Put out your hand and catch it by the tail"—so he put out his hand and caught it, and it became a staff in his hand—
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Reach out your hand and take it by the tail" (and he reached out his hand and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand),
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told him, "Reach out and grab its tail." So Moses reached out and grabbed it, and it turned back into a shepherd’s staff in his hand.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to Moses, "Reach out with your hand and grasp it by its tail"—so he reached out with his hand and caught it, and it turned into a staff in his hand—
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to him, "Reach out your hand and take it by the tail." So Moses reached out and took hold of the snake and it turned back into a staff in his hand.

verses.textZh: "这样就使他们相信耶和华他们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神曾向你显现了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "这样就使他们相信耶和华他们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神曾向你显现了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如此好叫他们信耶和华－他们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，是向你显现了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "This," said the Lord , "is so that they may believe that the Lord , the God of their fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob—has appeared to you."
verses.textEnEsv: "that they may believe that the Lord , the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: "that they may believe that the Lord God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Perform this sign," the Lord told him. "Then they will believe that the Lord , the God of their ancestors—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—really has appeared to you."
verses.textEnNasb: "so that they may believe that the Lord, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you."
verses.textEn: "This," said the Lord , "is so that they may believe that the Lord , the God of their fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob—has appeared to you."

verses.textZh: 耶和华又再对摩西说："现在把你的手放进怀里。"摩西就把手放进怀里；等他把手抽出来的时候，手就长满了痲风，像雪那样白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又再对摩西说："现在把你的手放进怀里。"摩西就把手放进怀里；等他把手抽出来的时候，手就长满了痲风，像雪那样白。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又对他说：「把手放在怀里。」他就把手放在怀里，及至抽出来，不料，手长了大麻风，有雪那样白。
