verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said, "Put your hand inside your cloak." So Moses put his hand into his cloak, and when he took it out, the skin was leprous —it had become as white as snow.
verses.textEnEsv: Again, the Lord said to him, "Put your hand inside your cloak." And he put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous like snow.
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore the Lord said to him, "Now put your hand in your bosom." And he put his hand in his bosom, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, like snow.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Now put your hand inside your cloak." So Moses put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out again, his hand was white as snow with a severe skin disease.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord furthermore said to him, "Now put your hand inside the fold of your robe." So he put his hand inside the fold, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous like snow.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said, "Put your hand inside your cloak." So Moses put his hand into his cloak, and when he took it out, the skin was leprous —it had become as white as snow.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："把你的手再放进怀里。"摩西就把手再放进怀里；等他把手从怀里抽出来的时候，手就恢复过来，像身上别处的肉一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："把你的手再放进怀里。"摩西就把手再放进怀里；等他把手从怀里抽出来的时候，手就恢复过来，像身上别处的肉一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「再把手放在怀里。」他就再把手放在怀里，及至从怀里抽出来，不料，手已经复原，与周身的肉一样；
verses.textEnNiv: "Now put it back into your cloak," he said. So Moses put his hand back into his cloak, and when he took it out, it was restored, like the rest of his flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: Then God said, "Put your hand back inside your cloak." So he put his hand back inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, it was restored like the rest of his flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Put your hand in your bosom again." So he put his hand in his bosom again, and drew it out of his bosom, and behold, it was restored like his other flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now put your hand back into your cloak," the Lord said. So Moses put his hand back in, and when he took it out again, it was as healthy as the rest of his body.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said, "Put your hand inside the fold of your robe again." So he put his hand into the fold again, and when he took it out of the fold, behold, it was restored like the rest of his flesh.
verses.textEn: "Now put it back into your cloak," he said. So Moses put his hand back into his cloak, and when he took it out, it was restored, like the rest of his flesh.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又说："如果他们不信你，也不听从头一个神迹的话，他们必信随后来的神迹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又说："如果他们不信你，也不听从头一个神迹的话，他们必信随后来的神迹。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「倘或他们不听你的话，也不信头一个神迹，他们必信第二个神迹。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said, "If they do not believe you or pay attention to the first sign, they may believe the second.
verses.textEnEsv: "If they will not believe you," God said, "or listen to the first sign, they may believe the latter sign.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then it will be, if they do not believe you, nor heed the message of the first sign, that they may believe the message of the latter sign.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses, "If they do not believe you and are not convinced by the first miraculous sign, they will be convinced by the second sign.
verses.textEnNasb: "So if they will not believe you nor pay attention to the evidence of the first sign, they may believe the evidence of the last sign.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said, "If they do not believe you or pay attention to the first sign, they may believe the second.

verses.textZh: 如果连这两个神迹他们也不信，也不听你的话，你就从河里取些水，倒在旱地上；你从河里取来的水就必在旱地上变成血。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果连这两个神迹他们也不信，也不听你的话，你就从河里取些水，倒在旱地上；你从河里取来的水就必在旱地上变成血。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这两个神迹若都不信，也不听你的话，你就从河里取些水，倒在旱地上，你从河里取的水必在旱地上变作血。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if they do not believe these two signs or listen to you, take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground. The water you take from the river will become blood on the ground."
verses.textEnEsv: If they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, you shall take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground, and the water that you shall take from the Nile will become blood on the dry ground."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, if they do not believe even these two signs, or listen to your voice, that you shall take water from the river and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take from the river will become blood on the dry land."
verses.textEnNlt: And if they don’t believe you or listen to you even after these two signs, then take some water from the Nile River and pour it out on the dry ground. When you do, the water from the Nile will turn to blood on the ground."
verses.textEnNasb: But if they will not believe even these two signs nor pay attention to what you say, then you shall take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground; and the water which you take from the Nile will turn into blood on the dry ground."
verses.textEn: But if they do not believe these two signs or listen to you, take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground. The water you take from the river will become blood on the ground."

verses.textZh: 摩西对耶和华说："主啊，我不是个会说话的人；以前不是，自从你对仆人说话以后也不是；因为我本是拙口笨舌的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对耶和华说："主啊，我不是个会说话的人；以前不是，自从你对仆人说话以后也不是；因为我本是拙口笨舌的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对耶和华说：「主啊，我素日不是能言的人，就是从你对仆人说话以后，也是这样。我本是拙口笨舌的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to the Lord , "Pardon your servant, Lord. I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since you have spoken to your servant. I am slow of speech and tongue."
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said to the Lord , "Oh, my Lord, I am not eloquent, either in the past or since you have spoken to your servant, but I am slow of speech and of tongue."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said to the Lord, "O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before nor since You have spoken to Your servant; but I am slow of speech and slow of tongue."
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses pleaded with the Lord , "O Lord, I’m not very good with words. I never have been, and I’m not now, even though you have spoken to me. I get tongue-tied, and my words get tangled."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to the Lord, "Please, Lord, I have never been eloquent, neither recently nor in time past, nor since You have spoken to Your servant; for I am slow of speech and slow of tongue."
verses.textEn: Moses said to the Lord , "Pardon your servant, Lord. I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since you have spoken to your servant. I am slow of speech and tongue."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对他说："谁造人的口呢？谁使人口哑、耳聋、眼明、眼瞎呢？不是我耶和华吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对他说："谁造人的口呢？谁使人口哑、耳聋、眼明、眼瞎呢？不是我耶和华吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对他说：「谁造人的口呢？谁使人口哑、耳聋、目明、眼瞎呢？岂不是我－耶和华吗？
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to him, "Who gave human beings their mouths? Who makes them deaf or mute? Who gives them sight or makes them blind? Is it not I, the Lord ?
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to him, "Who has made man’s mouth? Who makes him mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Is it not I, the Lord ?
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to him, "Who has made man’s mouth? Or who makes the mute, the deaf, the seeing, or the blind? Have not I, the Lord?
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord asked Moses, "Who makes a person’s mouth? Who decides whether people speak or do not speak, hear or do not hear, see or do not see? Is it not I, the Lord ?
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to him, "Who has made the human mouth? Or who makes anyone unable to speak or deaf, or able to see or blind? Is it not I, the Lord?
verses.textEn: The Lord said to him, "Who gave human beings their mouths? Who makes them deaf or mute? Who gives them sight or makes them blind? Is it not I, the Lord ?

verses.textZh: 现在去吧，我必赐你口才，指教你当说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在去吧，我必赐你口才，指教你当说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在去吧，我必赐你口才，指教你所当说的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now go; I will help you speak and will teach you what to say."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth and teach you what you shall speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, go, and I will be with your mouth and teach you what you shall say."
verses.textEnNlt: Now go! I will be with you as you speak, and I will instruct you in what to say."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then go, and I Myself will be with your mouth, and instruct you in what you are to say."
verses.textEn: Now go; I will help you speak and will teach you what to say."

verses.textZh: 摩西说："主啊，请你差派你愿意差派的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："主啊，请你差派你愿意差派的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「主啊，你愿意打发谁，就打发谁去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses said, "Pardon your servant, Lord. Please send someone else."
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "Oh, my Lord, please send someone else."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said, "O my Lord, please send by the hand of whomever else You may send."
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses again pleaded, "Lord, please! Send anyone else."
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "Please, Lord, now send the message by whomever You will."
verses.textEn: But Moses said, "Pardon your servant, Lord. Please send someone else."

verses.textZh: 耶和华向摩西发怒，说："不是有你的哥哥利未人亚伦吗？我知道他是有口才的；他现在出来要迎接你。他看见了你，心里就快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华向摩西发怒，说："不是有你的哥哥利未人亚伦吗？我知道他是有口才的；他现在出来要迎接你。他看见了你，心里就快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向摩西发怒说：「不是有你的哥哥利未人亚伦吗？我知道他是能言的；现在他出来迎接你，他一见你，心里就欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord ’s anger burned against Moses and he said, "What about your brother, Aaron the Levite? I know he can speak well. He is already on his way to meet you, and he will be glad to see you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the anger of the Lord was kindled against Moses and he said, "Is there not Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Behold, he is coming out to meet you, and when he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the anger of the Lord was kindled against Moses, and He said: "Is not Aaron the Levite your brother? I know that he can speak well. And look, he is also coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord became angry with Moses. "All right," he said. "What about your brother, Aaron the Levite? I know he speaks well. And look! He is on his way to meet you now. He will be delighted to see you.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the anger of the Lord burned against Moses, and He said, "Is there not your brother Aaron the Levite? I know that he speaks fluently. And moreover, behold, he is coming out to meet you; when he sees you, he will be overjoyed.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord ’s anger burned against Moses and he said, "What about your brother, Aaron the Levite? I know he can speak well. He is already on his way to meet you, and he will be glad to see you.

verses.textZh: 你要对他说话，把你要说的话放在他的口里；我必与你的口同在，也与他的口同在；我必指教你们当行的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他说话，把你要说的话放在他的口里；我必与你的口同在，也与他的口同在；我必指教你们当行的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要将当说的话传给他；我也要赐你和他口才，又要指教你们所当行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: You shall speak to him and put words in his mouth; I will help both of you speak and will teach you what to do.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall speak to him and put the words in his mouth, and I will be with your mouth and with his mouth and will teach you both what to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now you shall speak to him and put the words in his mouth. And I will be with your mouth and with his mouth, and I will teach you what you shall do.
verses.textEnNlt: Talk to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with both of you as you speak, and I will instruct you both in what to do.
verses.textEnNasb: So you are to speak to him and put the words in his mouth; and I Myself will be with your mouth and his mouth, and I will instruct you in what you are to do.
verses.textEn: You shall speak to him and put words in his mouth; I will help both of you speak and will teach you what to do.

verses.textZh: 他要替你向人民说话，他要作你的口，你要作他的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要替你向人民说话，他要作你的口，你要作他的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要替你对百姓说话；你要以他当作口，他要以你当作神。
verses.textEnNiv: He will speak to the people for you, and it will be as if he were your mouth and as if you were God to him.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall speak for you to the people, and he shall be your mouth, and you shall be as God to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he shall be your spokesman to the people. And he himself shall be as a mouth for you, and you shall be to him as God.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron will be your spokesman to the people. He will be your mouthpiece, and you will stand in the place of God for him, telling him what to say.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall speak for you to the people; and he will be as a mouth for you and you will be as God to him.
verses.textEn: He will speak to the people for you, and it will be as if he were your mouth and as if you were God to him.

verses.textZh: 这手杖你要拿在手里，用来行神迹。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这手杖你要拿在手里，用来行神迹。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你手里要拿这杖，好行神迹。」
verses.textEnNiv: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform the signs with it."
verses.textEnEsv: And take in your hand this staff, with which you shall do the signs."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs."
verses.textEnNlt: And take your shepherd’s staff with you, and use it to perform the miraculous signs I have shown you."
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall take in your hand this staff, with which you shall perform the signs."
verses.textEn: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform the signs with it."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西起程回到他岳父叶忒罗那里，对他说："请你容我离开这里，回到我在埃及的同胞那里，看看他们是否还在。"叶忒罗对摩西说："你可以平平安安地去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西起程回到他岳父叶忒罗那里，对他说："请你容我离开这里，回到我在埃及的同胞那里，看看他们是否还在。"叶忒罗对摩西说："你可以平平安安地去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，摩西回到他岳父叶忒罗那里，对他说：「求你容我回去见我在埃及的弟兄，看他们还在不在。」叶忒罗对摩西说：「你可以平平安安地去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses went back to Jethro his father-in-law and said to him, "Let me return to my own people in Egypt to see if any of them are still alive." Jethro said, "Go, and I wish you well."
verses.textEnEsv: Moses went back to Jethro his father-in-law and said to him, "Please let me go back to my brothers in Egypt to see whether they are still alive." And Jethro said to Moses, "Go in peace."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, "Please let me go and return to my brethren who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive." And Jethro said to Moses, "Go in peace."
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses went back home to Jethro, his father-in-law. "Please let me return to my relatives in Egypt," Moses said. "I don’t even know if they are still alive." "Go in peace," Jethro replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses departed and returned to his father-in-law Jethro, and said to him, "Please, let me go, that I may return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see if they are still alive." And Jethro said to Moses, "Go in peace."
verses.textEn: Then Moses went back to Jethro his father-in-law and said to him, "Let me return to my own people in Egypt to see if any of them are still alive." Jethro said, "Go, and I wish you well."

verses.textZh: 耶和华在米甸对摩西说："你要起程，回到埃及去，因为那些寻索你命的人都死了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在米甸对摩西说："你要起程，回到埃及去，因为那些寻索你命的人都死了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在米甸对摩西说：「你要回埃及去，因为寻索你命的人都死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Lord had said to Moses in Midian, "Go back to Egypt, for all those who wanted to kill you are dead."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses in Midian, "Go back to Egypt, for all the men who were seeking your life are dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord said to Moses in Midian, "Go, return to Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead."
verses.textEnNlt: Before Moses left Midian, the Lord said to him, "Return to Egypt, for all those who wanted to kill you have died."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Moses in Midian, "Go back to Egypt, for all the men who were seeking your life are dead."
verses.textEn: Now the Lord had said to Moses in Midian, "Go back to Egypt, for all those who wanted to kill you are dead."

verses.textZh: 摩西就带着他的妻子和孩子，让他们骑在驴上，向着埃及地回去了；摩西手里拿着神的杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就带着他的妻子和孩子，让他们骑在驴上，向着埃及地回去了；摩西手里拿着神的杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就带着妻子和两个儿子，叫他们骑上驴，回埃及地去。摩西手里拿着神的杖。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses took his wife and sons, put them on a donkey and started back to Egypt. And he took the staff of God in his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses took his wife and his sons and had them ride on a donkey, and went back to the land of Egypt. And Moses took the staff of God in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses took his wife and his sons and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. And Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses took his wife and sons, put them on a donkey, and headed back to the land of Egypt. In his hand he carried the staff of God.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses took his wife and his sons and mounted them on a donkey, and returned to the land of Egypt. Moses also took the staff of God in his hand.
verses.textEn: So Moses took his wife and sons, put them on a donkey and started back to Egypt. And he took the staff of God in his hand.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你起程回到埃及去的时候，要留意我交在你手里的一切奇事，把它们行在法老面前；我却要使他的心刚硬，他就不让人民离开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你起程回到埃及去的时候，要留意我交在你手里的一切奇事，把它们行在法老面前；我却要使他的心刚硬，他就不让人民离开。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你回到埃及的时候，要留意将我指示你的一切奇事行在法老面前。但我要使 他的心刚硬，他必不容百姓去。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "When you return to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders I have given you the power to do. But I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "When you go back to Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the miracles that I have put in your power. But I will harden his heart, so that he will not let the people go.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "When you go back to Egypt, see that you do all those wonders before Pharaoh which I have put in your hand. But I will harden his heart, so that he will not let the people go.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord told Moses, "When you arrive back in Egypt, go to Pharaoh and perform all the miracles I have empowered you to do. But I will harden his heart so he will refuse to let the people go.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to Moses, "When you go back to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your power; but I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "When you return to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders I have given you the power to do. But I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.

verses.textZh: 你要对法老说：‘耶和华这样说：以色列是我的长子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对法老说：‘耶和华这样说：以色列是我的长子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对法老说：『耶和华这样说：以色列是我的儿子，我的长子。
verses.textEnNiv: Then say to Pharaoh, ‘This is what the Lord says: Israel is my firstborn son,
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall say to Pharaoh, ‘Thus says the Lord , Israel is my firstborn son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall say to Pharaoh, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Israel is My son, My firstborn.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will tell him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Israel is my firstborn son.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall say to Pharaoh, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Israel is My son, My firstborn.
verses.textEn: Then say to Pharaoh, ‘This is what the Lord says: Israel is my firstborn son,

verses.textZh: 我曾对你说，要让我的儿子离开这里，好叫他事奉我。你还是拒绝让他离开，看哪！我必杀你的长子。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾对你说，要让我的儿子离开这里，好叫他事奉我。你还是拒绝让他离开，看哪！我必杀你的长子。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我对你说过：容我的儿子去，好事奉我。你还是不肯容他去。看哪，我要杀你的长子。』」
verses.textEnNiv: and I told you, "Let my son go, so he may worship me." But you refused to let him go; so I will kill your firstborn son.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and I say to you, "Let my son go that he may serve me." If you refuse to let him go, behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So I say to you, let My son go that he may serve Me. But if you refuse to let him go, indeed I will kill your son, your firstborn." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I commanded you, "Let my son go, so he can worship me." But since you have refused, I will now kill your firstborn son!’"
verses.textEnNasb: So I said to you, ‘Let My son go so that he may serve Me’; but you have refused to let him go. Behold, I am going to kill your son, your firstborn." ’ "
verses.textEn: and I told you, "Let my son go, so he may worship me." But you refused to let him go; so I will kill your firstborn son.’ "

verses.textZh: 在路上住宿的地方，耶和华遇见了摩西，就想要杀他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在路上住宿的地方，耶和华遇见了摩西，就想要杀他。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西在路上住宿的地方，耶和华遇见他，想要杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: At a lodging place on the way, the Lord met Moses and was about to kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: At a lodging place on the way the Lord met him and sought to put him to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass on the way, at the encampment, that the Lord met him and sought to kill him.
verses.textEnNlt: On the way to Egypt, at a place where Moses and his family had stopped for the night, the Lord confronted him and was about to kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: But it came about at the overnight encampment on the way, that the Lord met Moses, and sought to put him to death.
verses.textEn: At a lodging place on the way, the Lord met Moses and was about to kill him.

verses.textZh: 西坡拉就拿了一把石刀，把她儿子的包皮割下来，把它丢到摩西的脚上，说："你真是我的血郎了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西坡拉就拿了一把石刀，把她儿子的包皮割下来，把它丢到摩西的脚上，说："你真是我的血郎了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 西坡拉就拿一块火石，割下他儿子的阳皮，丢在摩西脚前，说：「你真是我的血郎了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son’s foreskin and touched Moses’ feet with it. "Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me," she said.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Zipporah took a flint and cut off her son’s foreskin and touched Moses’ feet with it and said, "Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone and cut off the foreskin of her son and cast it at Moses’ feet, and said, "Surely you are a husband of blood to me!"
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses’ wife, Zipporah, took a flint knife and circumcised her son. She touched his feet with the foreskin and said, "Now you are a bridegroom of blood to me."
verses.textEnNasb: So Zipporah took a flint and cut off her son’s foreskin and threw it at Moses’ feet; and she said, "You are indeed a groom of blood to me!"
verses.textEn: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son’s foreskin and touched Moses’ feet with it. "Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me," she said.

verses.textZh: 这样，耶和华才放了他。那时西坡拉说："你是血郎，是因为割礼的缘故。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，耶和华才放了他。那时西坡拉说："你是血郎，是因为割礼的缘故。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，耶和华才放了他。西坡拉说：「你因割礼就是血郎了。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord let him alone. (At that time she said "bridegroom of blood," referring to circumcision.)
verses.textEnEsv: So he let him alone. It was then that she said, "A bridegroom of blood," because of the circumcision.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He let him go. Then she said, "Youare a husband of blood!"—because of the circumcision.
verses.textEnNlt: (When she said "a bridegroom of blood," she was referring to the circumcision.) After that, the Lord left him alone.
verses.textEnNasb: So He left him alone. At that time she said, "You are a groom of blood"— because of the circumcision.
verses.textEn: So the Lord let him alone. (At that time she said "bridegroom of blood," referring to circumcision.)

verses.textZh: 耶和华对亚伦说："你到旷野去迎接摩西。"他就去了；他在神的山遇见了摩西，就和他亲吻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对亚伦说："你到旷野去迎接摩西。"他就去了；他在神的山遇见了摩西，就和他亲吻。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对亚伦说：「你往旷野去迎接摩西。」他就去，在神的山遇见摩西，和他亲嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Aaron, "Go into the wilderness to meet Moses." So he met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Aaron, "Go into the wilderness to meet Moses." So he went and met him at the mountain of God and kissed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Aaron, "Go into the wilderness to meet Moses." So he went and met him on the mountain of God, and kissed him.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Lord had said to Aaron, "Go out into the wilderness to meet Moses." So Aaron went and met Moses at the mountain of God, and he embraced him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Aaron, "Go to meet Moses in the wilderness." So he went and met him at the mountain of God and kissed him.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Aaron, "Go into the wilderness to meet Moses." So he met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.

verses.textZh: 摩西把耶和华派他所说的一切话，和吩咐他所行的一切神迹都告诉了亚伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把耶和华派他所说的一切话，和吩咐他所行的一切神迹都告诉了亚伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将耶和华打发他所说的言语和嘱咐他所行的神迹都告诉了亚伦。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses told Aaron everything the Lord had sent him to say, and also about all the signs he had commanded him to perform.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord with which he had sent him to speak, and all the signs that he had commanded him to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord who had sent him, and all the signs which He had commanded him.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses then told Aaron everything the Lord had commanded him to say. And he told him about the miraculous signs the Lord had commanded him to perform.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord with which He had sent him, and all the signs that He had commanded him to do.
verses.textEn: Then Moses told Aaron everything the Lord had sent him to say, and also about all the signs he had commanded him to perform.

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦就去召集以色列人的众长老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦就去召集以色列人的众长老。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦就去招聚以色列的众长老。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and Aaron brought together all the elders of the Israelites,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses and Aaron returned to Egypt and called all the elders of Israel together.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses and Aaron went and assembled all the elders of the sons of Israel;
verses.textEn: Moses and Aaron brought together all the elders of the Israelites,

verses.textZh: 亚伦把耶和华对摩西所说的一切话都说了一遍，并且在人民的眼前行了这些神迹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦把耶和华对摩西所说的一切话都说了一遍，并且在人民的眼前行了这些神迹。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦将耶和华对摩西所说的一切话述说了一遍，又在百姓眼前行了那些神迹，
verses.textEnNiv: and Aaron told them everything the Lord had said to Moses. He also performed the signs before the people,
verses.textEnEsv: Aaron spoke all the words that the Lord had spoken to Moses and did the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Aaron spoke all the words which the Lord had spoken to Moses. Then he did the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron told them everything the Lord had told Moses, and Moses performed the miraculous signs as they watched.
verses.textEnNasb: and Aaron spoke all the words which the Lord had spoken to Moses. He then performed the signs in the sight of the people.
verses.textEn: and Aaron told them everything the Lord had said to Moses. He also performed the signs before the people,

verses.textZh: 人民就相信了；他们听见耶和华眷顾以色列人，也鉴察了他们的痛苦，就俯伏敬拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民就相信了；他们听见耶和华眷顾以色列人，也鉴察了他们的痛苦，就俯伏敬拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓就信了。以色列人听见耶和华眷顾他们，鉴察他们的困苦，就低头下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: and they believed. And when they heard that the Lord was concerned about them and had seen their misery, they bowed down and worshiped.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people believed; and when they heard that the Lord had visited the people of Israel and that he had seen their affliction, they bowed their heads and worshiped.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people believed; and when they heard that the Lord had visited the children of Israel and that He had looked on their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Israel were convinced that the Lord had sent Moses and Aaron. When they heard that the Lord was concerned about them and had seen their misery, they bowed down and worshiped.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people believed; and when they heard that the Lord was concerned about the sons of Israel and that He had seen their affliction, they bowed low and worshiped.
verses.textEn: and they believed. And when they heard that the Lord was concerned about them and had seen their misery, they bowed down and worshiped.

verses.textZh: 后来，摩西和亚伦去对法老说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：让我的人民离开这里，叫他们可以在旷野向我守节。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，摩西和亚伦去对法老说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：让我的人民离开这里，叫他们可以在旷野向我守节。"
verses.textZhCuv: 后来摩西、亚伦去对法老说：「耶和华－以色列的神这样说：『容我的百姓去，在旷野向我守节。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Let my people go, so that they may hold a festival to me in the wilderness.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward Moses and Aaron went and said to Pharaoh, "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward Moses and Aaron went in and told Pharaoh, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘Let My people go, that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: After this presentation to Israel’s leaders, Moses and Aaron went and spoke to Pharaoh. They told him, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Let my people go so they may hold a festival in my honor in the wilderness."
verses.textEnNasb: And afterward Moses and Aaron came and said to Pharaoh, "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Let My people go so that they may celebrate a feast to Me in the wilderness.’ "
verses.textEn: Afterward Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Let my people go, so that they may hold a festival to me in the wilderness.’ "

verses.textZh: 法老回答："耶和华是谁，我要听他的话，让以色列人离开呢？我不认识耶和华，也不让以色列人离开。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老回答："耶和华是谁，我要听他的话，让以色列人离开呢？我不认识耶和华，也不让以色列人离开。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老说：「耶和华是谁，使我听他的话，容以色列人去呢？我不认识耶和华，也不容以色列人去！」
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh said, "Who is the Lord , that I should obey him and let Israel go? I do not know the Lord and I will not let Israel go."
verses.textEnEsv: But Pharaoh said, "Who is the Lord , that I should obey his voice and let Israel go? I do not know the Lord , and moreover, I will not let Israel go."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh said, "Who is the Lord, that I should obey His voice to let Israel go? I do not know the Lord, nor will I let Israel go."
verses.textEnNlt: "Is that so?" retorted Pharaoh. "And who is the Lord ? Why should I listen to him and let Israel go? I don’t know the Lord , and I will not let Israel go."
verses.textEnNasb: But Pharaoh said, "Who is the Lord that I should obey His voice to let Israel go? I do not know the Lord, and besides, I will not let Israel go."
verses.textEn: Pharaoh said, "Who is the Lord , that I should obey him and let Israel go? I do not know the Lord and I will not let Israel go."

verses.textZh: 他们说："希伯来人的神遇见了我们；求你让我们走三天的路程到旷野去，献祭给耶和华我们的神，免得他用瘟疫或刀剑击杀我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："希伯来人的神遇见了我们；求你让我们走三天的路程到旷野去，献祭给耶和华我们的神，免得他用瘟疫或刀剑击杀我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「希伯来人的神遇见了我们。求你容我们往旷野去，走三天的路程，祭祀耶和华－我们的神，免得他用瘟疫、刀兵攻击我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they said, "The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Now let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God, or he may strike us with plagues or with the sword."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said, "The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go a three days’ journey into the wilderness that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God, lest he fall upon us with pestilence or with the sword."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said, "The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please, let us go three days’ journey into the desert and sacrifice to the Lord our God, lest He fall upon us with pestilence or with the sword."
verses.textEnNlt: But Aaron and Moses persisted. "The God of the Hebrews has met with us," they declared. "So let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness so we can offer sacrifices to the Lord our God. If we don’t, he will kill us with a plague or with the sword."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said, "The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please, let us go a three days’ journey into the wilderness so that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God, otherwise He will strike us with plague or with the sword."
verses.textEn: Then they said, "The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Now let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God, or he may strike us with plagues or with the sword."

verses.textZh: 埃及王对他们说："摩西、亚伦哪，你们为甚么使人民懒惰不作工呢？去挑你们的担子吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及王对他们说："摩西、亚伦哪，你们为甚么使人民懒惰不作工呢？去挑你们的担子吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及王对他们说：「摩西、亚伦！你们为什么叫百姓旷工呢？你们去担你们的担子吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: But the king of Egypt said, "Moses and Aaron, why are you taking the people away from their labor? Get back to your work!"
verses.textEnEsv: But the king of Egypt said to them, "Moses and Aaron, why do you take the people away from their work? Get back to your burdens."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Egypt said to them, "Moses and Aaron, why do you take the people from their work? Get back to your labor."
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh replied, "Moses and Aaron, why are you distracting the people from their tasks? Get back to work!
verses.textEnNasb: But the king of Egypt said to them, "Moses and Aaron, why do you let the people neglect their work? Get back to your labors!"
verses.textEn: But the king of Egypt said, "Moses and Aaron, why are you taking the people away from their labor? Get back to your work!"

verses.textZh: 法老又说："你看，现在这地的民很多，你们竟叫他们歇下担子？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老又说："你看，现在这地的民很多，你们竟叫他们歇下担子？"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「看哪，这地的以色列人如今众多，你们竟叫他们歇下担子！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh said, "Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you are stopping them from working."
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh said, "Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh said, "Look, the people of the land are many now, and you make them rest from their labor!"
verses.textEnNlt: Look, there are many of your people in the land, and you are stopping them from their work."
verses.textEnNasb: Again Pharaoh said, "Look, the people of the land are now many, and you would have them cease from their labors!"
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh said, "Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you are stopping them from working."

verses.textZh: 就在那天，法老吩咐众民的督工和首领说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那天，法老吩咐众民的督工和首领说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当天，法老吩咐督工的和官长说：
verses.textEnNiv: That same day Pharaoh gave this order to the slave drivers and overseers in charge of the people:
verses.textEnEsv: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their foremen,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: That same day Pharaoh sent this order to the Egyptian slave drivers and the Israelite foremen:
verses.textEnNasb: So the same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters over the people and their foremen, saying,
verses.textEn: That same day Pharaoh gave this order to the slave drivers and overseers in charge of the people:

verses.textZh: "你们不要像往日一样再把草给人民做砖，叫他们自己去捡草。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不要像往日一样再把草给人民做砖，叫他们自己去捡草。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们不可照常把草给百姓做砖，叫他们自己去捡草。
verses.textEnNiv: "You are no longer to supply the people with straw for making bricks; let them go and gather their own straw.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall no longer give the people straw to make bricks, as in the past; let them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not supply any more straw for making bricks. Make the people get it themselves!
verses.textEnNasb: "You are no longer to give the people straw to make bricks as previously; have them go and gather straw for themselves.
verses.textEn: "You are no longer to supply the people with straw for making bricks; let them go and gather their own straw.

verses.textZh: 他们往日做砖的数量，你们还是向他们要，一点也不可减少，因为他们是懒惰的，所以他们才呼喊说：‘让我们去献祭给我们的神。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们往日做砖的数量，你们还是向他们要，一点也不可减少，因为他们是懒惰的，所以他们才呼喊说：‘让我们去献祭给我们的神。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们素常做砖的数目，你们仍旧向他们要，一点不可减少；因为他们是懒惰的，所以呼求说：『容我们去祭祀我们的神。』
verses.textEnNiv: But require them to make the same number of bricks as before; don’t reduce the quota. They are lazy; that is why they are crying out, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
verses.textEnEsv: But the number of bricks that they made in the past you shall impose on them, you shall by no means reduce it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, ‘Let us go and offer sacrifice to our God.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall lay on them the quota of bricks which they made before. You shall not reduce it. For they are idle; therefore they cry out, saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
verses.textEnNlt: But still require them to make the same number of bricks as before. Don’t reduce the quota. They are lazy. That’s why they are crying out, ‘Let us go and offer sacrifices to our God.’
verses.textEnNasb: But you shall impose on them the quota of bricks which they were making before; you are not to reduce any of it. Because they are lazy, for that reason they cry out, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
verses.textEn: But require them to make the same number of bricks as before; don’t reduce the quota. They are lazy; that is why they are crying out, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’

verses.textZh: 你们要把更重的工作加在这些人的身上，好使他们专心作工，不听谎言。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把更重的工作加在这些人的身上，好使他们专心作工，不听谎言。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要把更重的工夫加在这些人身上，叫他们劳碌，不听虚谎的言语。」
verses.textEnNiv: Make the work harder for the people so that they keep working and pay no attention to lies."
verses.textEnEsv: Let heavier work be laid on the men that they may labor at it and pay no regard to lying words."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let more work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it, and let them not regard false words."
verses.textEnNlt: Load them down with more work. Make them sweat! That will teach them to listen to lies!"
verses.textEnNasb: Let the labor be heavier on the men, and have them work at it so that they will pay no attention to false words."
verses.textEn: Make the work harder for the people so that they keep working and pay no attention to lies."

verses.textZh: 众民的督工和首领出来，告诉人民说："法老这样说：‘我不再给你们草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民的督工和首领出来，告诉人民说："法老这样说：‘我不再给你们草。
verses.textZhCuv: 督工的和官长出来对百姓说：「法老这样说：『我不给你们草。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the slave drivers and the overseers went out and said to the people, "This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you any more straw.
verses.textEnEsv: So the taskmasters and the foremen of the people went out and said to the people, "Thus says Pharaoh, ‘I will not give you straw.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the taskmasters of the people and their officers went out and spoke to the people, saying, "Thus says Pharaoh: ‘I will not give you straw.
verses.textEnNlt: So the slave drivers and foremen went out and told the people: "This is what Pharaoh says: I will not provide any more straw for you.
verses.textEnNasb: So the taskmasters of the people and their foremen went out and spoke to the people, saying, "This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I am not going to give you any straw.
verses.textEn: Then the slave drivers and the overseers went out and said to the people, "This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you any more straw.

verses.textZh: 你们自己能在哪里找到草，就到哪里去捡吧，但你们的工作一点也不可减少。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们自己能在哪里找到草，就到哪里去捡吧，但你们的工作一点也不可减少。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们自己在哪里能找草，就往那里去找吧！但你们的工一点不可减少。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it, but your work will not be reduced at all.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Go and get your straw yourselves wherever you can find it, but your work will not be reduced in the least.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Go, get yourselves straw where you can find it; yet none of your work will be reduced.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Go and get it yourselves. Find it wherever you can. But you must produce just as many bricks as before!"
verses.textEnNasb: You go, get straw for yourselves wherever you can find it; but none of your labor will be reduced.’ "
verses.textEn: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it, but your work will not be reduced at all.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是，人民就分散到埃及全地，去拾禾秸作草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，人民就分散到埃及全地，去拾禾秸作草。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是百姓散在埃及遍地，捡碎秸当作草。
verses.textEnNiv: So the people scattered all over Egypt to gather stubble to use for straw.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people were scattered throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people scattered throughout the land of Egypt in search of stubble to use as straw.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people scattered through all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
verses.textEn: So the people scattered all over Egypt to gather stubble to use for straw.

verses.textZh: 督工们催着说："你们的工作，每天的本分，要在当天完成，像以前有草的时候一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 督工们催着说："你们的工作，每天的本分，要在当天完成，像以前有草的时候一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 督工的催着说：「你们一天当完一天的工，与先前有草一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: The slave drivers kept pressing them, saying, "Complete the work required of you for each day, just as when you had straw."
verses.textEnEsv: The taskmasters were urgent, saying, "Complete your work, your daily task each day, as when there was straw."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the taskmasters forced them to hurry, saying, "Fulfill your work, your daily quota, as when there was straw."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the Egyptian slave drivers continued to push hard. "Meet your daily quota of bricks, just as you did when we provided you with straw!" they demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: And the taskmasters pressed them, saying, "Complete your work quota, your daily amount, just as when you had straw."
verses.textEn: The slave drivers kept pressing them, saying, "Complete the work required of you for each day, just as when you had straw."

verses.textZh: 法老的督工责打他们派定的以色列人的首领，说："你们昨天今天为甚么没有做完指定要你们做的砖，像往日一样呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老的督工责打他们派定的以色列人的首领，说："你们昨天今天为甚么没有做完指定要你们做的砖，像往日一样呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老督工的，责打他所派以色列人的官长，说：「你们昨天今天为什么没有照向来的数目做砖、完你们的工作呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: And Pharaoh’s slave drivers beat the Israelite overseers they had appointed, demanding, "Why haven’t you met your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as before?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the foremen of the people of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten and were asked, "Why have you not done all your task of making bricks today and yesterday, as in the past?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten and were asked, "Why have you not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and today, as before?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then they whipped the Israelite foremen they had put in charge of the work crews. "Why haven’t you met your quotas either yesterday or today?" they demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the foremen of the sons of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten and asked, "Why have you not completed your required task of making bricks either yesterday or today, as before?"
verses.textEn: And Pharaoh’s slave drivers beat the Israelite overseers they had appointed, demanding, "Why haven’t you met your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as before?"

verses.textZh: 以色列人的首领就来，向法老呼求说："你为甚么这样待你的仆人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人的首领就来，向法老呼求说："你为甚么这样待你的仆人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人的官长就来哀求法老说：「为什么这样待你的仆人？
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Israelite overseers went and appealed to Pharaoh: "Why have you treated your servants this way?
verses.textEnEsv: Then the foremen of the people of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, "Why do you treat your servants like this?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried out to Pharaoh, saying, "Why are you dealing thus with your servants?
verses.textEnNlt: So the Israelite foremen went to Pharaoh and pleaded with him. "Please don’t treat your servants like this," they begged.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the foremen of the sons of Israel came and cried out to Pharaoh, saying, "Why do you deal this way with your servants?
verses.textEn: Then the Israelite overseers went and appealed to Pharaoh: "Why have you treated your servants this way?

verses.textZh: 没有草给你的仆人，但他们对我们说：‘你们做砖吧！’看哪，你的仆人受了责打，其实这是你自己人民的错。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有草给你的仆人，但他们对我们说：‘你们做砖吧！’看哪，你的仆人受了责打，其实这是你自己人民的错。"
verses.textZhCuv: 督工的不把草给仆人，并且对我们说：『做砖吧！』看哪，你仆人挨了打，其实是你百姓的错。」
verses.textEnNiv: Your servants are given no straw, yet we are told, ‘Make bricks!’ Your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people."
verses.textEnEsv: No straw is given to your servants, yet they say to us, ‘Make bricks!’ And behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people."
verses.textEnNkjv: There is no straw given to your servants, and they say to us, ‘Make brick!’ And indeed your servants are beaten, but the fault is in your own people."
verses.textEnNlt: "We are given no straw, but the slave drivers still demand, ‘Make bricks!’ We are being beaten, but it isn’t our fault! Your own people are to blame!"
verses.textEnNasb: There is no straw given to your servants, yet they keep saying to us, ‘Make bricks!’ And behold, your servants are being beaten; but it is the fault of your own people."
verses.textEn: Your servants are given no straw, yet we are told, ‘Make bricks!’ Your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people."

verses.textZh: 法老说："你们确实是懒惰的，所以你们才说：‘让我们去献祭给耶和华。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老说："你们确实是懒惰的，所以你们才说：‘让我们去献祭给耶和华。’
verses.textZhCuv: 但法老说：「你们是懒惰的！你们是懒惰的！所以说：『容我们去祭祀耶和华。』
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh said, "Lazy, that’s what you are—lazy! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "You are idle, you are idle; that is why you say, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said, "You are idle! Idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the Lord.’
verses.textEnNlt: But Pharaoh shouted, "You’re just lazy! Lazy! That’s why you’re saying, ‘Let us go and offer sacrifices to the Lord .’
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "You are lazy, very lazy; for that reason you say, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the Lord.’
verses.textEn: Pharaoh said, "Lazy, that’s what you are—lazy! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the Lord .’

verses.textZh: 现在你们去作工吧；草是不给你们的，砖却要如数交上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们去作工吧；草是不给你们的，砖却要如数交上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们去做工吧！草是不给你们的，砖却要如数交纳。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now get to work. You will not be given any straw, yet you must produce your full quota of bricks."
verses.textEnEsv: Go now and work. No straw will be given you, but you must still deliver the same number of bricks."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore go now and work; for no straw shall be given you, yet you shall deliver the quota of bricks."
verses.textEnNlt: Now get back to work! No straw will be given to you, but you must still produce the full quota of bricks."
verses.textEnNasb: So go now and work; for you will be given no straw, but you must deliver the quota of bricks."
verses.textEn: Now get to work. You will not be given any straw, yet you must produce your full quota of bricks."

verses.textZh: 以色列人的首领因有命令说："你们每天本分要做的砖数不可减少"，就知道自己有祸了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人的首领因有命令说："你们每天本分要做的砖数不可减少"，就知道自己有祸了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人的官长听说「你们每天做砖的工作一点不可减少」，就知道是遭遇祸患了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelite overseers realized they were in trouble when they were told, "You are not to reduce the number of bricks required of you for each day."
verses.textEnEsv: The foremen of the people of Israel saw that they were in trouble when they said, "You shall by no means reduce your number of bricks, your daily task each day."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble after it was said, "You shall not reduce any bricks from your daily quota."
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelite foremen could see that they were in serious trouble when they were told, "You must not reduce the number of bricks you make each day."
verses.textEnNasb: The foremen of the sons of Israel saw that they were in trouble, since they were told, "You must not reduce your daily amount of bricks."
verses.textEn: The Israelite overseers realized they were in trouble when they were told, "You are not to reduce the number of bricks required of you for each day."

verses.textZh: 他们从法老那里出来的时候，遇见摩西和亚伦，正在站着等候他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从法老那里出来的时候，遇见摩西和亚伦，正在站着等候他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们离了法老出来，正遇见摩西、亚伦站在对面，
verses.textEnNiv: When they left Pharaoh, they found Moses and Aaron waiting to meet them,
verses.textEnEsv: They met Moses and Aaron, who were waiting for them, as they came out from Pharaoh;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, as they came out from Pharaoh, they met Moses and Aaron who stood there to meet them.
verses.textEnNlt: As they left Pharaoh’s court, they confronted Moses and Aaron, who were waiting outside for them.
verses.textEnNasb: When they left Pharaoh’s presence, they met Moses and Aaron as they were waiting for them.
verses.textEn: When they left Pharaoh, they found Moses and Aaron waiting to meet them,

verses.textZh: 就对他们说："愿耶和华鉴察你们，审判你们，因为你们使我们的香气在法老眼前和他的臣仆眼前都发臭了，把刀放在他们的手里来杀我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对他们说："愿耶和华鉴察你们，审判你们，因为你们使我们的香气在法老眼前和他的臣仆眼前都发臭了，把刀放在他们的手里来杀我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就向他们说：「愿耶和华鉴察你们，施行判断；因你们使我们在法老和他臣仆面前有了臭名，把刀递在他们手中杀我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: and they said, "May the Lord look on you and judge you! You have made us obnoxious to Pharaoh and his officials and have put a sword in their hand to kill us."
verses.textEnEsv: and they said to them, "The Lord look on you and judge, because you have made us stink in the sight of Pharaoh and his servants, and have put a sword in their hand to kill us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to them, "Let the Lord look on you and judge, because you have made us abhorrent in the sight of Pharaoh and in the sight of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us."
verses.textEnNlt: The foremen said to them, "May the Lord judge and punish you for making us stink before Pharaoh and his officials. You have put a sword into their hands, an excuse to kill us!"
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to them, "May the Lord look upon you and judge you, because you have made us repulsive in Pharaoh’s sight and in the sight of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!"
verses.textEn: and they said, "May the Lord look on you and judge you! You have made us obnoxious to Pharaoh and his officials and have put a sword in their hand to kill us."

verses.textZh: 摩西回到耶和华那里，说："主啊！你为甚么苦待这人民呢？为甚么差派我呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回到耶和华那里，说："主啊！你为甚么苦待这人民呢？为甚么差派我呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西回到耶和华那里，说：「主啊，你为什么苦待这百姓呢？为什么打发我去呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Moses returned to the Lord and said, "Why, Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Is this why you sent me?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses turned to the Lord and said, "O Lord, why have you done evil to this people? Why did you ever send me?
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses returned to the Lord and said, "Lord, why have You brought trouble on this people? Why is it You have sent me?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses went back to the Lord and protested, "Why have you brought all this trouble on your own people, Lord? Why did you send me?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses returned to the Lord and said, "Lord, why have You brought harm to this people? Why did You ever send me?
verses.textEn: Moses returned to the Lord and said, "Why, Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Is this why you sent me?

verses.textZh: 自从我到法老那里，奉你的名说话以来，他就苦待这人民，你一点也没有拯救你自己的人民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 自从我到法老那里，奉你的名说话以来，他就苦待这人民，你一点也没有拯救你自己的人民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 自从我去见法老，奉你的名说话，他就苦待这百姓，你一点也没有拯救他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people, and you have not rescued your people at all."
verses.textEnEsv: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has done evil to this people, and you have not delivered your people at all."
verses.textEnNkjv: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has done evil to this people; neither have You delivered Your people at all."
verses.textEnNlt: Ever since I came to Pharaoh as your spokesman, he has been even more brutal to your people. And you have done nothing to rescue them!"
verses.textEnNasb: Ever since I came to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has done harm to this people, and You have not rescued Your people at all."
verses.textEn: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people, and you have not rescued your people at all."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你现在必看见我要向法老行的事；因为我施展大能的手，他必让他们离去；我施展大能的手，他必把他们从自己的地赶出去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你现在必看见我要向法老行的事；因为我施展大能的手，他必让他们离去；我施展大能的手，他必把他们从自己的地赶出去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「现在你必看见我向法老所行的事，使他因我大能的手容以色列人去，且把他们赶出他的地。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh: Because of my mighty hand he will let them go; because of my mighty hand he will drive them out of his country."
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to Moses, "Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh; for with a strong hand he will send them out, and with a strong hand he will drive them out of his land."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh. For with a strong hand he will let them go, and with a strong hand he will drive them out of his land."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told Moses, "Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh. When he feels the force of my strong hand, he will let the people go. In fact, he will force them to leave his land!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh; for under compulsion he will let them go, and under compulsion he will drive them out of his land."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh: Because of my mighty hand he will let them go; because of my mighty hand he will drive them out of his country."

verses.textZh: 神告诉摩西说："我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神告诉摩西说："我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 神晓谕摩西说：「我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: God also said to Moses, "I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: God spoke to Moses and said to him, "I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And God spoke to Moses and said to him: "I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And God said to Moses, "I am Yahweh—‘the Lord .’
verses.textEnNasb: God spoke further to Moses and said to him, "I am the Lord;
verses.textEn: God also said to Moses, "I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我曾向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各显现为全能的神，至于我的名字‘耶和华’，他们是不认识的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各显现为全能的神，至于我的名字‘耶和华’，他们是不认识的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从前向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各显现为全能的神；至于我名耶和华，他们未曾知道。
verses.textEnNiv: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by my name the Lord I did not make myself fully known to them.
verses.textEnEsv: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty, but by my name the Lord I did not make myself known to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty, but by My name Lord I was not known to them.
verses.textEnNlt: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as El-Shaddai—‘God Almighty’ —but I did not reveal my name, Yahweh, to them.
verses.textEnNasb: and I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name, Lord, I did not make Myself known to them.
verses.textEn: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by my name the Lord I did not make myself fully known to them.

verses.textZh: 我不但与他们确立了我的约，要把迦南地，就是他们作客寄居之地赐给他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不但与他们确立了我的约，要把迦南地，就是他们作客寄居之地赐给他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 我与他们坚定所立的约，要把他们寄居的迦南地赐给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: I also established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, where they resided as foreigners.
verses.textEnEsv: I also established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land in which they lived as sojourners.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have also established My covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, in which they were strangers.
verses.textEnNlt: And I reaffirmed my covenant with them. Under its terms, I promised to give them the land of Canaan, where they were living as foreigners.
verses.textEnNasb: I also established My covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land in which they lived as strangers.
verses.textEn: I also established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, where they resided as foreigners.

verses.textZh: 而且我也听见了以色列人因埃及人所加的奴役而发的哀声，就记念我的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且我也听见了以色列人因埃及人所加的奴役而发的哀声，就记念我的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也听见以色列人被埃及人苦待的哀声，我也记念我的约。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I have heard the groaning of the people of Israel whom the Egyptians hold as slaves, and I have remembered my covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered My covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: You can be sure that I have heard the groans of the people of Israel, who are now slaves to the Egyptians. And I am well aware of my covenant with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore I have heard the groaning of the sons of Israel, because the Egyptians are holding them in bondage, and I have remembered My covenant.
verses.textEn: Moreover, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered my covenant.

verses.textZh: 所以，你要对以色列人说：‘我是耶和华，我要把你们从埃及人的重担底下救出来；我要拯救你们脱离他们的奴役；我要用伸出来的膀臂，并借着严厉的刑罚来救赎你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你要对以色列人说：‘我是耶和华，我要把你们从埃及人的重担底下救出来；我要拯救你们脱离他们的奴役；我要用伸出来的膀臂，并借着严厉的刑罚来救赎你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要对以色列人说：『我是耶和华；我要用伸出来的膀臂重重地刑罚埃及人，救赎你们脱离他们的重担，不做他们的苦工。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore, say to the Israelites: ‘I am the Lord , and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians. I will free you from being slaves to them, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.
verses.textEnEsv: Say therefore to the people of Israel, ‘I am the Lord , and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will deliver you from slavery to them, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with great acts of judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore say to the children of Israel: ‘I am the Lord; I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, I will rescue you from their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with great judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, say to the people of Israel: ‘I am the Lord . I will free you from your oppression and will rescue you from your slavery in Egypt. I will redeem you with a powerful arm and great acts of judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: Say, therefore, to the sons of Israel, ‘I am the Lord, and I will bring you out from under the labors of the Egyptians, and I will rescue you from their bondage. I will also redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.
verses.textEn: "Therefore, say to the Israelites: ‘I am the Lord , and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians. I will free you from being slaves to them, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.

verses.textZh: 我要以你们作我的人民，我也要作你们的神；你们要知道我是耶和华你们的神，是把你们从埃及人的重担底下救出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要以你们作我的人民，我也要作你们的神；你们要知道我是耶和华你们的神，是把你们从埃及人的重担底下救出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要以你们为我的百姓，我也要作你们的神。你们要知道我是耶和华－你们的神，是救你们脱离埃及人之重担的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will take you as my own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnEsv: I will take you to be my people, and I will be your God, and you shall know that I am the Lord your God, who has brought you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will take you as My people, and I will be your God. Then you shall know that I am the Lord your God who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNlt: I will claim you as my own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God who has freed you from your oppression in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will take you as My people, and I will be your God; and you shall know that I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from under the labors of the Egyptians.
verses.textEn: I will take you as my own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.

verses.textZh: 我举手起誓要给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的地，我必领你们进去；我也必把那地赐给你们作产业；我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我举手起誓要给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的地，我必领你们进去；我也必把那地赐给你们作产业；我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我起誓应许给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的那地，我要把你们领进去，将那地赐给你们为业。我是耶和华。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And I will bring you to the land I swore with uplifted hand to give to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob. I will give it to you for a possession. I am the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; and I will give it to you as a heritage: I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring you into the land I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as your very own possession. I am the Lord !’"
verses.textEnNasb: I will bring you to the land which I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and I will give it to you as a possession; I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: And I will bring you to the land I swore with uplifted hand to give to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 摩西这样告诉以色列人，只是他们因为心里愁烦和苦工的缘故，就不肯听摩西的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西这样告诉以色列人，只是他们因为心里愁烦和苦工的缘故，就不肯听摩西的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将这话告诉以色列人，只是他们因苦工愁烦，不肯听他的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses reported this to the Israelites, but they did not listen to him because of their discouragement and harsh labor.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses spoke thus to the people of Israel, but they did not listen to Moses, because of their broken spirit and harsh slavery.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses spoke thus to the children of Israel; but they did not heed Moses, because of anguish of spirit and cruel bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses told the people of Israel what the Lord had said, but they refused to listen anymore. They had become too discouraged by the brutality of their slavery.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses said this to the sons of Israel, but they did not listen to Moses on account of their despondency and cruel bondage.
verses.textEn: Moses reported this to the Israelites, but they did not listen to him because of their discouragement and harsh labor.

verses.textZh: 耶和华告诉摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华告诉摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉埃及王法老，叫他让以色列人离开他的地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉埃及王法老，叫他让以色列人离开他的地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你进去对埃及王法老说，要容以色列人出他的地。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his country."
verses.textEnEsv: "Go in, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the people of Israel go out of his land."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go in, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the children of Israel go out of his land."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go back to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and tell him to let the people of Israel leave his country."
verses.textEnNasb: "Go, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the sons of Israel go out of his land."
verses.textEn: "Go, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his country."

verses.textZh: 摩西在耶和华面前说："看哪，以色列人尚且不肯听我的话，法老又怎会听我的话呢？因为我是个拙口笨舌的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西在耶和华面前说："看哪，以色列人尚且不肯听我的话，法老又怎会听我的话呢？因为我是个拙口笨舌的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西在耶和华面前说：「以色列人尚且不听我的话，法老怎肯听我这拙口笨舌的人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses said to the Lord , "If the Israelites will not listen to me, why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I speak with faltering lips ?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said to the Lord , "Behold, the people of Israel have not listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, for I am of uncircumcised lips?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses spoke before the Lord, saying, "The children of Israel have not heeded me. How then shall Pharaoh heed me, for I am of uncircumcised lips?"
verses.textEnNlt: "But Lord !" Moses objected. "My own people won’t listen to me anymore. How can I expect Pharaoh to listen? I’m such a clumsy speaker! "
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses spoke before the Lord, saying, "Behold, the sons of Israel have not listened to me; how then will Pharaoh listen to me, as I am unskilled in speech?"
verses.textEn: But Moses said to the Lord , "If the Israelites will not listen to me, why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I speak with faltering lips ?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华吩咐摩西和亚伦，命令他们到以色列人和埃及王法老那里去，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华吩咐摩西和亚伦，命令他们到以色列人和埃及王法老那里去，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西、亚伦往以色列人和埃及王法老那里去，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron about the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he commanded them to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge about the people of Israel and about Pharaoh king of Egypt: to bring the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, and gave them a command for the children of Israel and for Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them orders for the Israelites and for Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. The Lord commanded Moses and Aaron to lead the people of Israel out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron and gave them a command concerning the sons of Israel and Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron about the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he commanded them to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 他们各家族首领的名字记在下面：以色列的长子流本的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯伦、迦米；这些是流本的各家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各家族首领的名字记在下面：以色列的长子流本的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯伦、迦米；这些是流本的各家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人家长的名字记在下面。以色列长子吕便的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯伦、迦米；这是吕便的各家。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the heads of their families : The sons of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel were Hanok and Pallu, Hezron and Karmi. These were the clans of Reuben.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses: the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the clans of Reuben.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. These are the families of Reuben.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the ancestors of some of the clans of Israel: The sons of Reuben, Israel’s oldest son, were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. Their descendants became the clans of Reuben.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the heads of their fathers’ households. The sons of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.
verses.textEn: These were the heads of their families : The sons of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel were Hanok and Pallu, Hezron and Karmi. These were the clans of Reuben.

verses.textZh: 西缅的儿子是耶母利、雅悯、阿辖、雅斤、琐辖和迦南女子的儿子扫罗；这些是西缅的各家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西缅的儿子是耶母利、雅悯、阿辖、雅斤、琐辖和迦南女子的儿子扫罗；这些是西缅的各家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 西缅的儿子是耶母利、雅悯、阿辖、雅斤、琐辖，和迦南女子的儿子扫罗；这是西缅的各家。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the clans of Simeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman. These are the families of Simeon.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, and Shaul. (Shaul’s mother was a Canaanite woman.) Their descendants became the clans of Simeon.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.
verses.textEn: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.

verses.textZh: 利未众子的名字按着他们的世代记在下面，就是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。利未一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未众子的名字按着他们的世代记在下面，就是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。利未一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未众子的名字按着他们的后代记在下面：就是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。利未一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, the years of the life of Levi being 137 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. And the years of the life of Levi were one hundred and thirty-seven.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the descendants of Levi, as listed in their family records: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. (Levi lived to be 137 years old.)
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari; and the length of Levi’s life was 137 years.
verses.textEn: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.

verses.textZh: 革顺的儿子，按着他们的家族，是立尼、示每。
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺的儿子，按着他们的家族，是立尼、示每。
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺的儿子按着家室是立尼、示每。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Gershon, by clans, were Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, by their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Gershon were Libni and Shimi according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gershon included Libni and Shimei, each of whom became the ancestor of a clan.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
verses.textEn: The sons of Gershon, by clans, were Libni and Shimei.

verses.textZh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。哥辖一生的岁数是一百三十三岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。哥辖一生的岁数是一百三十三岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。哥辖一生的岁数是一百三十三岁。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, the years of the life of Kohath being 133 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. And the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred and thirty-three.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Kohath included Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. (Kohath lived to be 133 years old.)
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel; and the length of Kohath’s life was 133 years.
verses.textEn: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示。按着他们的世代，这些是利未的家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示。按着他们的世代，这些是利未的家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示；这是利未的家，都按着他们的后代。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of Levi according to their records.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites according to their generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of Levi according to their generations.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Merari included Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites, as listed in their family records.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.
verses.textEn: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of Levi according to their records.

verses.textZh: 暗兰娶了自己的姑母约基别为妻；约基别给他生了亚伦和摩西；暗兰一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗兰娶了自己的姑母约基别为妻；约基别给他生了亚伦和摩西；暗兰一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗兰娶了他父亲的妹妹约基别为妻，她给他生了亚伦和摩西。暗兰一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, who bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.
verses.textEnEsv: Amram took as his wife Jochebed his father’s sister, and she bore him Aaron and Moses, the years of the life of Amram being 137 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Amram took for himself Jochebed, his father’s sister, as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. And the years of the life of Amram were one hundred and thirty-seven.
verses.textEnNlt: Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she gave birth to his sons, Aaron and Moses. (Amram lived to be 137 years old.)
verses.textEnNasb: Now Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses; and the length of Amram’s life was 137 years.
verses.textEn: Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, who bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.

verses.textZh: 以斯哈的儿子是可拉、尼斐、细基利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯哈的儿子是可拉、尼斐、细基利。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯哈的儿子是可拉、尼斐、细基利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg and Zikri.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Izhar: Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg, and Zicri.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Izhar: Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
verses.textEn: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg and Zikri.

verses.textZh: 乌薛的儿子是米沙利、以利撒反、西提利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌薛的儿子是米沙利、以利撒反、西提利。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌薛的儿子是米沙利、以利撒反、西提利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan and Sithri.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Zithri.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
verses.textEn: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan and Sithri.

verses.textZh: 亚伦娶了亚米拿达的女儿拿顺的妹妹以利沙巴作妻子；她给亚伦生了拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦娶了亚米拿达的女儿拿顺的妹妹以利沙巴作妻子；她给亚伦生了拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦娶了亚米拿达的女儿，拿顺的妹妹，以利沙巴为妻，她给他生了拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEnEsv: Aaron took as his wife Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and the sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Aaron took to himself Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon, as wife; and she bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she gave birth to his sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNasb: Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEn: Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.textZh: 可拉的儿子是亚惜、以利加拿、亚比亚撒；这些是可拉的各家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉的儿子是亚惜、以利加拿、亚比亚撒；这些是可拉的各家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 可拉的儿子是亚惜、以利加拿、亚比亚撒；这是可拉的各家。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Korah were: Assir, Elkanah and Abiasaph. These were the Korahite clans.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the clans of the Korahites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These are the families of the Korahites.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. Their descendants became the clans of Korah.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
verses.textEn: The sons of Korah were: Assir, Elkanah and Abiasaph. These were the Korahite clans.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒娶了普铁的一个女儿为妻；她给以利亚撒生了非尼哈。按照他们的家族，这些就是利未人的各首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒娶了普铁的一个女儿为妻；她给以利亚撒生了非尼哈。按照他们的家族，这些就是利未人的各首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒娶了普铁的一个女儿为妻，她给他生了非尼哈。这是利未人的家长，都按着他们的家。
verses.textEnNiv: Eleazar son of Aaron married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families, clan by clan.
verses.textEnEsv: Eleazar, Aaron’s son, took as his wife one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites by their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: Eleazar, Aaron’s son, took for himself one of the daughters of Putiel as wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: Eleazar son of Aaron married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she gave birth to his son, Phinehas. These are the ancestors of the Levite families, listed according to their clans.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Aaron’s son Eleazar married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites according to their families.
verses.textEn: Eleazar son of Aaron married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families, clan by clan.

verses.textZh: 这亚伦和摩西，耶和华曾经对他们说过："你们要按着他们的军队，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这亚伦和摩西，耶和华曾经对他们说过："你们要按着他们的军队，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「将以色列人按着他们的军队从埃及地领出来。」这是对那亚伦、摩西说的。
verses.textEnNiv: It was this Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said, "Bring the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions."
verses.textEnEsv: These are the Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said: "Bring out the people of Israel from the land of Egypt by their hosts."
verses.textEnNkjv: These arethesame Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said, "Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies."
verses.textEnNlt: The Aaron and Moses named in this list are the same ones to whom the Lord said, "Lead the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt like an army."
verses.textEnNasb: It was the same Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said, "Bring out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their multitudes."
verses.textEn: It was this Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said, "Bring the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions."

verses.textZh: 那对埃及王法老说要把以色列人从埃及领出来的，就是这摩西和亚伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那对埃及王法老说要把以色列人从埃及领出来的，就是这摩西和亚伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 对埃及王法老说要将以色列人从埃及领出来的，就是这摩西、亚伦。
verses.textEnNiv: They were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt about bringing the Israelites out of Egypt—this same Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: It was they who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt about bringing out the people of Israel from Egypt, this Moses and this Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These arethesame Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: It was Moses and Aaron who spoke to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, about leading the people of Israel out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: They were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt about bringing out the sons of Israel from Egypt; it was the same Moses and Aaron.
