verses.textEn: They were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt about bringing the Israelites out of Egypt—this same Moses and Aaron.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在埃及地对摩西说话的日子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在埃及地对摩西说话的日子，
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华在埃及地对摩西说话的日子，
verses.textEnNiv: Now when the Lord spoke to Moses in Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: On the day when the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, on the day the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about on the day when the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,
verses.textEn: Now when the Lord spoke to Moses in Egypt,

verses.textZh: 耶和华告诉摩西说："我是耶和华，你要把我对你所说的一切话都告诉埃及王法老。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华告诉摩西说："我是耶和华，你要把我对你所说的一切话都告诉埃及王法老。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他向摩西说：「我是耶和华；我对你说的一切话，你都要告诉埃及王法老。」
verses.textEnNiv: he said to him, "I am the Lord . Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I tell you."
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord said to Moses, "I am the Lord ; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: that the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "I am the Lord. Speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say to you."
verses.textEnNlt: he said to him, "I am the Lord ! Tell Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, everything I am telling you."
verses.textEnNasb: that the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "I am the Lord; say to Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say to you."
verses.textEn: he said to him, "I am the Lord . Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I tell you."

verses.textZh: 摩西在耶和华面前说："你看，我是个拙口笨舌的人，法老怎肯听我呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西在耶和华面前说："你看，我是个拙口笨舌的人，法老怎肯听我呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西在耶和华面前说：「看哪，我是拙口笨舌的人，法老怎肯听我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses said to the Lord , "Since I speak with faltering lips, why would Pharaoh listen to me?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said to the Lord , "Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips. How will Pharaoh listen to me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Moses said before the Lord, "Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh heed me?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses argued with the Lord , saying, "I can’t do it! I’m such a clumsy speaker! Why should Pharaoh listen to me?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses said before the Lord, "Behold, I am unskilled in speech; how then will Pharaoh listen to me?"
verses.textEn: But Moses said to the Lord , "Since I speak with faltering lips, why would Pharaoh listen to me?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，我使你在法老面前好象神一样；你哥哥亚伦要作你的先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，我使你在法老面前好象神一样；你哥哥亚伦要作你的先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「我使你在法老面前代替神，你的哥哥亚伦是替你说话的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron shall be your prophet.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to Moses: "See, I have made you as God to Pharaoh, and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pay close attention to this. I will make you seem like God to Pharaoh, and your brother, Aaron, will be your prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "See, I have made you as God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron shall be your prophet.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.

verses.textZh: 我吩咐你的一切，你都要说；你哥哥亚伦要告诉法老，法老就让以色列人离开他的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我吩咐你的一切，你都要说；你哥哥亚伦要告诉法老，法老就让以色列人离开他的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡我所吩咐你的，你都要说。你的哥哥亚伦要对法老说，容以色列人出他的地。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to say everything I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his country.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall speak all that I command you, and your brother Aaron shall tell Pharaoh to let the people of Israel go out of his land.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall speak all that I command you. And Aaron your brother shall tell Pharaoh to send the children of Israel out of his land.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell Aaron everything I command you, and Aaron must command Pharaoh to let the people of Israel leave his country.
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, you shall speak all that I command you, and your brother Aaron shall speak to Pharaoh that he let the sons of Israel go out of his land.
verses.textEn: You are to say everything I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his country.

verses.textZh: 我要使法老心硬，我也要在埃及地加增我的神迹奇事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使法老心硬，我也要在埃及地加增我的神迹奇事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使法老的心刚硬，也要在埃及地多行神迹奇事。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and though I multiply my signs and wonders in Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: But I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and though I multiply my signs and wonders in the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply My signs and My wonders in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will make Pharaoh’s heart stubborn so I can multiply my miraculous signs and wonders in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, so that I may multiply My signs and My wonders in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: But I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and though I multiply my signs and wonders in Egypt,

verses.textZh: 可是法老不听你们的话，我必下手击打埃及；借着严厉的刑罚把我的军队，我的人民以色列人，从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是法老不听你们的话，我必下手击打埃及；借着严厉的刑罚把我的军队，我的人民以色列人，从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 但法老必不听你们；我要伸手重重地刑罚埃及，将我的军队以色列民从埃及地领出来。
verses.textEnNiv: he will not listen to you. Then I will lay my hand on Egypt and with mighty acts of judgment I will bring out my divisions, my people the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: Pharaoh will not listen to you. Then I will lay my hand on Egypt and bring my hosts, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great acts of judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Pharaoh will not heed you, so that I may lay My hand on Egypt and bring My armies and My people, the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: Even then Pharaoh will refuse to listen to you. So I will bring down my fist on Egypt. Then I will rescue my forces—my people, the Israelites—from the land of Egypt with great acts of judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: When Pharaoh does not listen to you, I will lay My hand on Egypt and bring out My armies, My people the sons of Israel, from the land of Egypt by great judgments.
verses.textEn: he will not listen to you. Then I will lay my hand on Egypt and with mighty acts of judgment I will bring out my divisions, my people the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 我向埃及伸手，把以色列人从他们中间领出来的时候，埃及人就必知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向埃及伸手，把以色列人从他们中间领出来的时候，埃及人就必知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我伸手攻击埃及，将以色列人从他们中间领出来的时候，埃及人就要知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord when I stretch out my hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites out of it."
verses.textEnEsv: The Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord , when I stretch out my hand against Egypt and bring out the people of Israel from among them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I stretch out My hand on Egypt and bring out the children of Israel from among them."
verses.textEnNlt: When I raise my powerful hand and bring out the Israelites, the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I extend My hand over Egypt and bring out the sons of Israel from their midst."
verses.textEn: And the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord when I stretch out my hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites out of it."

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦这样行了；耶和华怎样吩咐摩西和亚伦，他们就照样行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦这样行了；耶和华怎样吩咐摩西和亚伦，他们就照样行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦这样行；耶和华怎样吩咐他们，他们就照样行了。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord commanded them.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses and Aaron did so; they did just as the Lord commanded them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses and Aaron did so; just as the Lord commanded them, so they did.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord had commanded them.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses and Aaron did this; as the Lord commanded them, so they did.
verses.textEn: Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord commanded them.

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦与法老说话的时候，摩西八十岁，亚伦八十三岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦与法老说话的时候，摩西八十岁，亚伦八十三岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦与法老说话的时候，摩西八十岁，亚伦八十三岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses was eighty years old and Aaron eighty-three years old when they spoke to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron was eighty-three when they made their demands to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses was eighty years old and Aaron eighty-three, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh.

verses.textZh: 耶和华告诉摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华告诉摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.textZh: "如果法老告诉你们说：‘你们行件奇事吧’，你就要对亚伦说：‘拿你的手杖来，把它丢在法老面前，它就会变作蛇。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果法老告诉你们说：‘你们行件奇事吧’，你就要对亚伦说：‘拿你的手杖来，把它丢在法老面前，它就会变作蛇。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「法老若对你们说：『你们行件奇事吧！』你就吩咐亚伦说：『把杖丢在法老面前，使杖变作蛇。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "When Pharaoh says to you, ‘Perform a miracle,’ then say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh,’ and it will become a snake."
verses.textEnEsv: "When Pharaoh says to you, ‘Prove yourselves by working a miracle,’ then you shall say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and cast it down before Pharaoh, that it may become a serpent.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Show a miracle for yourselves,’ then you shall say to Aaron, ‘Take your rod and cast it before Pharaoh, and let it become a serpent.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Pharaoh will demand, ‘Show me a miracle.’ When he does this, say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it down in front of Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent. ’"
verses.textEnNasb: "When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘ Work a miracle,’ then you shall say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh, so that it may turn into a serpent.’ "
verses.textEn: "When Pharaoh says to you, ‘Perform a miracle,’ then say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh,’ and it will become a snake."

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦就进到法老那里，照着耶和华吩咐他们的行了；亚伦把手杖丢在法老和法老的臣仆面前，手杖就变了蛇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦就进到法老那里，照着耶和华吩咐他们的行了；亚伦把手杖丢在法老和法老的臣仆面前，手杖就变了蛇。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦进去见法老，就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦把杖丢在法老和臣仆面前，杖就变作蛇。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the Lord commanded. Aaron threw his staff down in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a snake.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the Lord commanded. Aaron cast down his staff before Pharaoh and his servants, and it became a serpent.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, just as the Lord commanded. And Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did what the Lord had commanded them. Aaron threw down his staff before Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a serpent!
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh, and so they did, just as the Lord had commanded; and Aaron threw his staff down before Pharaoh and his servants, and it turned into a serpent.
verses.textEn: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the Lord commanded. Aaron threw his staff down in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a snake.

verses.textZh: 于是，法老也把智慧人和行法术的人召了来；他们本是埃及的术士，也用他们的巫术照样行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，法老也把智慧人和行法术的人召了来；他们本是埃及的术士，也用他们的巫术照样行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是法老召了博士和术士来；他们是埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh then summoned wise men and sorcerers, and the Egyptian magicians also did the same things by their secret arts:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh summoned the wise men and the sorcerers, and they, the magicians of Egypt, also did the same by their secret arts.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers; so the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh called in his own wise men and sorcerers, and these Egyptian magicians did the same thing with their magic.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers, and they too, the soothsayer priests of Egypt, did the same with their secret arts.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh then summoned wise men and sorcerers, and the Egyptian magicians also did the same things by their secret arts:

verses.textZh: 他们各人都丢下自己的手杖，手杖就变了蛇；亚伦的手杖却吞了他们的手杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人都丢下自己的手杖，手杖就变了蛇；亚伦的手杖却吞了他们的手杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们各人丢下自己的杖，杖就变作蛇；但亚伦的杖吞了他们的杖。
verses.textEnNiv: Each one threw down his staff and it became a snake. But Aaron’s staff swallowed up their staffs.
verses.textEnEsv: For each man cast down his staff, and they became serpents. But Aaron’s staff swallowed up their staffs.
verses.textEnNkjv: For every man threw down his rod, and they became serpents. But Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
verses.textEnNlt: They threw down their staffs, which also became serpents! But then Aaron’s staff swallowed up their staffs.
verses.textEnNasb: For each one threw down his staff, and they turned into serpents. But Aaron’s staff swallowed their staffs.
verses.textEn: Each one threw down his staff and it became a snake. But Aaron’s staff swallowed up their staffs.

verses.textZh: 法老心里刚硬，不肯听他们的话，就像耶和华所说的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老心里刚硬，不肯听他们的话，就像耶和华所说的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老心里刚硬，不肯听从摩西、亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet Pharaoh’s heart became hard and he would not listen to them, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnEsv: Still Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh’s heart grew hard, and he did not heed them, as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh’s heart, however, remained hard. He still refused to listen, just as the Lord had predicted.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he did not listen to them, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEn: Yet Pharaoh’s heart became hard and he would not listen to them, just as the Lord had said.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："法老心里固执，拒绝让人民离去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："法老心里固执，拒绝让人民离去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「法老心里固执，不肯容百姓去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pharaoh’s heart is unyielding; he refuses to let the people go.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pharaoh’s heart is hardened; he refuses to let the people go.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to Moses: "Pharaoh’s heart is hard; he refuses to let the people go.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn, and he still refuses to let the people go.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn; he refuses to let the people go.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pharaoh’s heart is unyielding; he refuses to let the people go.

verses.textZh: 明天早晨你要到法老那里去。看哪，法老出来到水边去的时候，你要站在河边迎见他；那变过蛇的手杖，你要拿在手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 明天早晨你要到法老那里去。看哪，法老出来到水边去的时候，你要站在河边迎见他；那变过蛇的手杖，你要拿在手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 明日早晨，他出来往水边去，你要往河边迎接他，手里要拿着那变过蛇的杖，
verses.textEnNiv: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as he goes out to the river. Confront him on the bank of the Nile, and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake.
verses.textEnEsv: Go to Pharaoh in the morning, as he is going out to the water, and stand on the bank of the Nile to meet him. Take in your hand the staff that turned into a serpent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Go to Pharaoh in the morning, when he goes out to the water, and you shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him; and the rod which was turned to a serpent you shall take in your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: So go to Pharaoh in the morning as he goes down to the river. Stand on the bank of the Nile and meet him there. Be sure to take along the staff that turned into a snake.
verses.textEnNasb: Go to Pharaoh in the morning just as he is going out to the water, and position yourself to meet him on the bank of the Nile; and you shall take in your hand the staff that was turned into a serpent.
verses.textEn: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as he goes out to the river. Confront him on the bank of the Nile, and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake.

verses.textZh: 你要对法老说：‘耶和华希伯来人的神差我到你这里来，说："让我的人民离开这里，好使他们可以在旷野事奉我"，你看，直到现在你还是不听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对法老说：‘耶和华希伯来人的神差我到你这里来，说："让我的人民离开这里，好使他们可以在旷野事奉我"，你看，直到现在你还是不听。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：『耶和华－希伯来人的神打发我来见你，说：容我的百姓去，好在旷野事奉我。到如今你还是不听。
verses.textEnNiv: Then say to him, ‘The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to say to you: Let my people go, so that they may worship me in the wilderness. But until now you have not listened.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall say to him, ‘The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, sent me to you, saying, "Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness." But so far, you have not obeyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall say to him, ‘The Lord God of the Hebrews has sent me to you, saying, "Let My people go, that they may serve Me in the wilderness"; but indeed, until now you would not hear!
verses.textEnNlt: Then announce to him, ‘The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to tell you, "Let my people go, so they can worship me in the wilderness." Until now, you have refused to listen to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall say to him, ‘The Lord, the God of the Hebrews, sent me to you, saying, "Let My people go, so that they may serve Me in the wilderness. But behold, you have not listened up to now."
verses.textEn: Then say to him, ‘The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to say to you: Let my people go, so that they may worship me in the wilderness. But until now you have not listened.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说："看哪，我要用我手里的杖击打河中的水，水就必变成血；因此你就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说："看哪，我要用我手里的杖击打河中的水，水就必变成血；因此你就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华这样说：我要用我手里的杖击打河中的水，水就变作血；因此，你必知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: By this you will know that I am the Lord : With the staff that is in my hand I will strike the water of the Nile, and it will be changed into blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , "By this you shall know that I am the Lord : behold, with the staff that is in my hand I will strike the water that is in the Nile, and it shall turn into blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "By this you shall know that I am the Lord. Behold, I will strike the waters which are in the river with the rod that is in my hand, and they shall be turned to blood.
verses.textEnNlt: So this is what the Lord says: "I will show you that I am the Lord ." Look! I will strike the water of the Nile with this staff in my hand, and the river will turn to blood.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "By this you shall know that I am the Lord: behold, I am going to strike the water that is in the Nile with the staff that is in my hand, and it will be turned into blood.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: By this you will know that I am the Lord : With the staff that is in my hand I will strike the water of the Nile, and it will be changed into blood.

verses.textZh: 河中的鱼必死亡，河水也必发臭，埃及人就必厌恶喝这河里的水。"’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 河中的鱼必死亡，河水也必发臭，埃及人就必厌恶喝这河里的水。"’"
verses.textZhCuv: 河里的鱼必死，河也要腥臭，埃及人就要厌恶吃这河里的水。』」
verses.textEnNiv: The fish in the Nile will die, and the river will stink; the Egyptians will not be able to drink its water.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: The fish in the Nile shall die, and the Nile will stink, and the Egyptians will grow weary of drinking water from the Nile."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the fish that are in the river shall die, the river shall stink, and the Egyptians will loathe to drink the water of the river." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The fish in it will die, and the river will stink. The Egyptians will not be able to drink any water from the Nile.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the fish that are in the Nile will die, the Nile will stink, and the Egyptians will no longer be able to drink water from the Nile." ’ "
verses.textEn: The fish in the Nile will die, and the river will stink; the Egyptians will not be able to drink its water.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对亚伦说：‘拿你的手杖来，把你的手伸在埃及的众水之上，就是在他们的江、河、池和所有水塘之上，使水都变成血。因此，在埃及全地，连木器石器中都必有血。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对亚伦说：‘拿你的手杖来，把你的手伸在埃及的众水之上，就是在他们的江、河、池和所有水塘之上，使水都变成血。因此，在埃及全地，连木器石器中都必有血。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：「你对亚伦说：『把你的杖伸在埃及所有的水以上，就是在他们的江、河、池、塘以上，叫水都变作血。在埃及遍地，无论在木器中，石器中，都必有血。』」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, ‘Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt—over the streams and canals, over the ponds and all the reservoirs—and they will turn to blood.’ Blood will be everywhere in Egypt, even in vessels of wood and stone."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, their canals, and their ponds, and all their pools of water, so that they may become blood, and there shall be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, even in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, "Say to Aaron, ‘Take your rod and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their streams, over their rivers, over their ponds, and over all their pools of water, that they may become blood. And there shall be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in bucketsof wood and pitchersof stone.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses: "Tell Aaron, ‘Take your staff and raise your hand over the waters of Egypt—all its rivers, canals, ponds, and all the reservoirs. Turn all the water to blood. Everywhere in Egypt the water will turn to blood, even the water stored in wooden bowls and stone pots.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and extend your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, over their pools, and over all their reservoirs of water, so that they may become blood; and there will be blood through all the land of Egypt, both in containers of wood and in containers of stone.’ "
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, ‘Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt—over the streams and canals, over the ponds and all the reservoirs—and they will turn to blood.’ Blood will be everywhere in Egypt, even in vessels of wood and stone."

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦就这样行了，就像耶和华所吩咐的；亚伦在法老面前和法老的臣仆面前举起手杖，击打河里的水，河里的水就都变了血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦就这样行了，就像耶和华所吩咐的；亚伦在法老面前和法老的臣仆面前举起手杖，击打河里的水，河里的水就都变了血。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦在法老和臣仆眼前举杖击打河里的水，河里的水都变作血了。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord had commanded. He raised his staff in the presence of Pharaoh and his officials and struck the water of the Nile, and all the water was changed into blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded. In the sight of Pharaoh and in the sight of his servants he lifted up the staff and struck the water in the Nile, and all the water in the Nile turned into blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses and Aaron did so, just as the Lord commanded. So he lifted up the rod and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh and in the sight of his servants. And all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord commanded them. As Pharaoh and all of his officials watched, Aaron raised his staff and struck the water of the Nile. Suddenly, the whole river turned to blood!
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord had commanded. And he lifted up the staff and struck the water that was in the Nile in the sight of Pharaoh and in the sight of his servants; and all the water that was in the Nile was turned into blood.
verses.textEn: Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord had commanded. He raised his staff in the presence of Pharaoh and his officials and struck the water of the Nile, and all the water was changed into blood.

verses.textZh: 河里的鱼死了，河水发臭了，埃及人也不能喝这河里的水了；在埃及，全地都有血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 河里的鱼死了，河水发臭了，埃及人也不能喝这河里的水了；在埃及，全地都有血。
verses.textZhCuv: 河里的鱼死了，河也腥臭了，埃及人就不能吃这河里的水；埃及遍地都有了血。
verses.textEnNiv: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. Blood was everywhere in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And the fish in the Nile died, and the Nile stank, so that the Egyptians could not drink water from the Nile. There was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fish that were in the river died, the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink the water of the river. So there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: The fish in the river died, and the water became so foul that the Egyptians couldn’t drink it. There was blood everywhere throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the fish that were in the Nile died, and the Nile stank, so that the Egyptians could not drink water from the Nile. And the blood was through all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. Blood was everywhere in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 埃及的术士也用他们的巫术这样行了；可是法老却心里刚硬，不肯听摩西和亚伦，就像耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及的术士也用他们的巫术这样行了；可是法老却心里刚硬，不肯听摩西和亚伦，就像耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。法老心里刚硬，不肯听摩西、亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Egyptian magicians did the same things by their secret arts, and Pharaoh’s heart became hard; he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnEsv: But the magicians of Egypt did the same by their secret arts. So Pharaoh’s heart remained hardened, and he would not listen to them, as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments; and Pharaoh’s heart grew hard, and he did not heed them, as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNlt: But again the magicians of Egypt used their magic, and they, too, turned water into blood. So Pharaoh’s heart remained hard. He refused to listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had predicted.
verses.textEnNasb: But the soothsayer priests of Egypt did the same with their secret arts; and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he did not listen to them, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEn: But the Egyptian magicians did the same things by their secret arts, and Pharaoh’s heart became hard; he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said.

verses.textZh: 法老转身回到宫里去，也不把这事放在心上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老转身回到宫里去，也不把这事放在心上。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老转身进宫，也不把这事放在心上。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, he turned and went into his palace, and did not take even this to heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he did not take even this to heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house. Neither was his heart moved by this.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh returned to his palace and put the whole thing out of his mind.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh turned and went into his house with no concern even for this.
verses.textEn: Instead, he turned and went into his palace, and did not take even this to heart.

verses.textZh: 所有的埃及人都在河的周围掘地，要得水喝，因为他们不能喝这河里的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的埃及人都在河的周围掘地，要得水喝，因为他们不能喝这河里的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人都在河的两边挖地，要得水喝，因为他们不能喝这河里的水。
verses.textEnNiv: And all the Egyptians dug along the Nile to get drinking water, because they could not drink the water of the river.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the Egyptians dug along the Nile for water to drink, for they could not drink the water of the Nile.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the Egyptians dug all around the river for water to drink, because they could not drink the water of the river.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the Egyptians dug along the riverbank to find drinking water, for they couldn’t drink the water from the Nile.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water to drink, because they could not drink from the water of the Nile.
verses.textEn: And all the Egyptians dug along the Nile to get drinking water, because they could not drink the water of the river.

verses.textZh: 耶和华击打尼罗河以后，满了七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华击打尼罗河以后，满了七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华击打河以后满了七天。
verses.textEnNiv: Seven days passed after the Lord struck the Nile.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven full days passed after the Lord had struck the Nile.
verses.textEnNkjv: And seven days passed after the Lord had struck the river.
verses.textEnNlt: Seven days passed from the time the Lord struck the Nile.
verses.textEnNasb: Seven days passed after the Lord had struck the Nile.
verses.textEn: Seven days passed after the Lord struck the Nile.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你到法老那里去，对他说：‘耶和华这样说："让我的人民离开这里，使他们可以事奉我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你到法老那里去，对他说：‘耶和华这样说："让我的人民离开这里，使他们可以事奉我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你进去见法老，对他说：『耶和华这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go in to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord , "Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Let My people go, that they may serve Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go back to Pharaoh and announce to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Let my people go, so they can worship me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

verses.textZh: 如果你拒绝让他们离开这里，看哪，我必用青蛙击打你的全境。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你拒绝让他们离开这里，看哪，我必用青蛙击打你的全境。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若不肯容他们去，我必使青蛙糟蹋你的四境。
verses.textEnNiv: If you refuse to let them go, I will send a plague of frogs on your whole country.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your country with frogs.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all your territory with frogs.
verses.textEnNlt: If you refuse to let them go, I will send a plague of frogs across your entire land.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you refuse to let them go, behold, I am going to strike your entire territory with frogs.
verses.textEn: If you refuse to let them go, I will send a plague of frogs on your whole country.

verses.textZh: 河里必滋生青蛙；青蛙必上来，进到你的宫殿和卧房里去，跳上你的床，进你臣仆的房屋，跳上你人民的身上，进你的炉子和抟面盆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 河里必滋生青蛙；青蛙必上来，进到你的宫殿和卧房里去，跳上你的床，进你臣仆的房屋，跳上你人民的身上，进你的炉子和抟面盆。
verses.textZhCuv: 河里要滋生青蛙；这青蛙要上来进你的宫殿和你的卧房，上你的床榻，进你臣仆的房屋，上你百姓的身上，进你的炉灶和你的抟面盆，
verses.textEnNiv: The Nile will teem with frogs. They will come up into your palace and your bedroom and onto your bed, into the houses of your officials and on your people, and into your ovens and kneading troughs.
verses.textEnEsv: The Nile shall swarm with frogs that shall come up into your house and into your bedroom and on your bed and into the houses of your servants and your people, and into your ovens and your kneading bowls.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into your house, into your bedroom, on your bed, into the houses of your servants, on your people, into your ovens, and into your kneading bowls.
verses.textEnNlt: The Nile River will swarm with frogs. They will come up out of the river and into your palace, even into your bedroom and onto your bed! They will enter the houses of your officials and your people. They will even jump into your ovens and your kneading bowls.
verses.textEnNasb: The Nile will swarm with frogs, which will come up and go into your house, and into your bedroom and on your bed, and into the houses of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens and kneading bowls.
verses.textEn: The Nile will teem with frogs. They will come up into your palace and your bedroom and onto your bed, into the houses of your officials and on your people, and into your ovens and kneading troughs.

verses.textZh: 青蛙也必跳上你、你的人民和臣仆的身上。"’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 青蛙也必跳上你、你的人民和臣仆的身上。"’"
verses.textZhCuv: 又要上你和你百姓并你众臣仆的身上。』」
verses.textEnNiv: The frogs will come up on you and your people and all your officials.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: The frogs shall come up on you and on your people and on all your servants."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the frogs shall come up on you, on your people, and on all your servants." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Frogs will jump on you, your people, and all your officials.’"
verses.textEnNasb: So the frogs will come up on you, your people, and on all your servants." ’ "
verses.textEn: The frogs will come up on you and your people and all your officials.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对亚伦说把手中的杖伸在江、河、池之上，使青蛙上到埃及地来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对亚伦说把手中的杖伸在江、河、池之上，使青蛙上到埃及地来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：「你对亚伦说：『把你的杖伸在江、河、池以上，使青蛙到埃及地上来。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your staff over the streams and canals and ponds, and make frogs come up on the land of Egypt.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Say to Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your staff over the rivers, over the canals and over the pools, and make frogs come up on the land of Egypt!’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, "Say to Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, ‘Raise the staff in your hand over all the rivers, canals, and ponds of Egypt, and bring up frogs over all the land.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Say to Aaron, ‘Extend your hand with your staff over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and make frogs come up on the land of Egypt.’ "
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your staff over the streams and canals and ponds, and make frogs come up on the land of Egypt.’ "

verses.textZh: 亚伦把手一伸在埃及的众水之上，青蛙就上来了，并且遮盖了埃及地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦把手一伸在埃及的众水之上，青蛙就上来了，并且遮盖了埃及地。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦便伸杖在埃及的诸水以上，青蛙就上来，遮满了埃及地。
verses.textEnNiv: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land.
verses.textEnEsv: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So Aaron raised his hand over the waters of Egypt, and frogs came up and covered the whole land!
verses.textEnNasb: So Aaron extended his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land.

verses.textZh: 众术士也用他们的巫术照样行了，使青蛙上了埃及地来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众术士也用他们的巫术照样行了，使青蛙上了埃及地来。
verses.textZhCuv: 行法术的也用他们的邪术照样而行，叫青蛙上了埃及地。
verses.textEnNiv: But the magicians did the same things by their secret arts; they also made frogs come up on the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: But the magicians did the same by their secret arts and made frogs come up on the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: But the magicians were able to do the same thing with their magic. They, too, caused frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the soothsayer priests did the same with their secret arts, making frogs come up on the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: But the magicians did the same things by their secret arts; they also made frogs come up on the land of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 法老把摩西和亚伦召了来，说："请你们恳求耶和华，好叫他使青蛙离开我和我的人民，我就必让这人民离开这里，使他们可以向耶和华献祭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老把摩西和亚伦召了来，说："请你们恳求耶和华，好叫他使青蛙离开我和我的人民，我就必让这人民离开这里，使他们可以向耶和华献祭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老召了摩西、亚伦来，说：「请你们求耶和华使这青蛙离开我和我的民，我就容百姓去祭祀耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Pray to the Lord to take the frogs away from me and my people, and I will let your people go to offer sacrifices to the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, "Plead with the Lord to take away the frogs from me and from my people, and I will let the people go to sacrifice to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, "Entreat the Lord that He may take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and begged, "Plead with the Lord to take the frogs away from me and my people. I will let your people go, so they can offer sacrifices to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron and said, "Plead with the Lord to remove the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, so that they may sacrifice to the Lord."
verses.textEn: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Pray to the Lord to take the frogs away from me and my people, and I will let your people go to offer sacrifices to the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 摩西回答法老："请指示，我要在甚么时候为你和你的臣仆，以及你的人民，恳求耶和华除灭青蛙，使青蛙离开你和你的宫殿，只留在河里呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答法老："请指示，我要在甚么时候为你和你的臣仆，以及你的人民，恳求耶和华除灭青蛙，使青蛙离开你和你的宫殿，只留在河里呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对法老说：「任凭你吧，我要何时为你和你的臣仆并你的百姓祈求，除灭青蛙离开你和你的宫殿只留在河里呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to Pharaoh, "I leave to you the honor of setting the time for me to pray for you and your officials and your people that you and your houses may be rid of the frogs, except for those that remain in the Nile."
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said to Pharaoh, "Be pleased to command me when I am to plead for you and for your servants and for your people, that the frogs be cut off from you and your houses and be left only in the Nile."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to Pharaoh, "Accept the honor of saying when I shall intercede for you, for your servants, and for your people, to destroy the frogs from you and your houses, that they may remain in the river only."
verses.textEnNlt: "You set the time!" Moses replied. "Tell me when you want me to pray for you, your officials, and your people. Then you and your houses will be rid of the frogs. They will remain only in the Nile River."
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses said to Pharaoh, " The honor is yours to tell me: when shall I plead for you and your servants and your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, that they be left only in the Nile?"
verses.textEn: Moses said to Pharaoh, "I leave to you the honor of setting the time for me to pray for you and your officials and your people that you and your houses may be rid of the frogs, except for those that remain in the Nile."

verses.textZh: 法老说："明天。"摩西回答："就照着你的话行吧，好叫你知道没有神像耶和华我们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老说："明天。"摩西回答："就照着你的话行吧，好叫你知道没有神像耶和华我们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「明天。」摩西说：「可以照你的话吧，好叫你知道没有像耶和华－我们神的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tomorrow," Pharaoh said. Moses replied, "It will be as you say, so that you may know there is no one like the Lord our God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Tomorrow." Moses said, "Be it as you say, so that you may know that there is no one like the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "Tomorrow." And he said, "Letitbe according to your word, that you may know that thereis no one like the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do it tomorrow," Pharaoh said. "All right," Moses replied, "it will be as you have said. Then you will know that there is no one like the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Tomorrow." So he said, "May it be according to your word, so that you may know that there is no one like the Lord our God.
verses.textEn: "Tomorrow," Pharaoh said. Moses replied, "It will be as you say, so that you may know there is no one like the Lord our God.

verses.textZh: 青蛙必离开你和你的宫殿、你的臣仆和你的人民，只留在河里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 青蛙必离开你和你的宫殿、你的臣仆和你的人民，只留在河里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 青蛙要离开你和你的宫殿，并你的臣仆与你的百姓，只留在河里。」
verses.textEnNiv: The frogs will leave you and your houses, your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile."
verses.textEnEsv: The frogs shall go away from you and your houses and your servants and your people. They shall be left only in the Nile."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the frogs shall depart from you, from your houses, from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only."
verses.textEnNlt: The frogs will leave you and your houses, your officials, and your people. They will remain only in the Nile River."
verses.textEnNasb: The frogs will depart from you and your houses, and from your servants and your people; they will be left only in the Nile."
verses.textEn: The frogs will leave you and your houses, your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西和亚伦离开法老走了出来；摩西为了耶和华加在法老身上青蛙的灾害向耶和华呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西和亚伦离开法老走了出来；摩西为了耶和华加在法老身上青蛙的灾害向耶和华呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西、亚伦离开法老出去。摩西为扰害法老的青蛙呼求耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: After Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the Lord about the frogs he had brought on Pharaoh.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to the Lord about the frogs, as he had agreed with Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh. And Moses cried out to the Lord concerning the frogs which He had brought against Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh’s palace, and Moses cried out to the Lord about the frogs he had inflicted on Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried out to the Lord concerning the frogs which He had inflicted upon Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: After Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the Lord about the frogs he had brought on Pharaoh.

verses.textZh: 耶和华就照着摩西的话行了；在房屋里、院子里和田野中的青蛙都死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就照着摩西的话行了；在房屋里、院子里和田野中的青蛙都死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就照摩西的话行。凡在房里、院中、田间的青蛙都死了。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord did what Moses asked. The frogs died in the houses, in the courtyards and in the fields.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses. The frogs died out in the houses, the courtyards, and the fields.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord did according to the word of Moses. And the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courtyards, and out of the fields.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord did just what Moses had predicted. The frogs in the houses, the courtyards, and the fields all died.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, the courtyards, and the fields.
verses.textEn: And the Lord did what Moses asked. The frogs died in the houses, in the courtyards and in the fields.

verses.textZh: 有人把青蛙一堆一堆积聚起来，那地就发臭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人把青蛙一堆一堆积聚起来，那地就发臭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人把青蛙聚拢成堆，遍地就都腥臭。
verses.textEnNiv: They were piled into heaps, and the land reeked of them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.
verses.textEnNkjv: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.
verses.textEnNlt: The Egyptians piled them into great heaps, and a terrible stench filled the land.
verses.textEnNasb: So they piled them in heaps, and the land stank.
verses.textEn: They were piled into heaps, and the land reeked of them.

verses.textZh: 法老一见灾祸平息了，就心里刚硬，不肯听他们的话，就像耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老一见灾祸平息了，就心里刚硬，不肯听他们的话，就像耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但法老见灾祸松缓，就硬着心，不肯听他们，正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But when Pharaoh saw that there was relief, he hardened his heart and would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart and would not listen to them, as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Pharaoh saw that there was relief, he hardened his heart and did not heed them, as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Pharaoh saw that relief had come, he became stubborn. He refused to listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had predicted.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Pharaoh saw that there was relief, he hardened his heart and did not listen to them, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEn: But when Pharaoh saw that there was relief, he hardened his heart and would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对亚伦说：‘伸出你的手杖，击打地上的尘土，使尘土在埃及全地都变成虱子。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对亚伦说：‘伸出你的手杖，击打地上的尘土，使尘土在埃及全地都变成虱子。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你对亚伦说：『伸出你的杖击打地上的尘土，使尘土在埃及遍地变作虱子 。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the ground,’ and throughout the land of Egypt the dust will become gnats."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Say to Aaron, ‘Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the earth, so that it may become gnats in all the land of Egypt.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to Moses, "Say to Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the land, so that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, ‘Raise your staff and strike the ground. The dust will turn into swarms of gnats throughout the land of Egypt.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Say to Aaron, ‘Extend your staff and strike the dust of the earth, so that it may turn into gnats through all the land of Egypt.’ "
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the ground,’ and throughout the land of Egypt the dust will become gnats."

verses.textZh: 他们就这样行了；亚伦伸出手中的杖，击打地上的尘土，就在人身上和牲畜身上有了虱子；埃及全地所有地上的尘土都变成了虱子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就这样行了；亚伦伸出手中的杖，击打地上的尘土，就在人身上和牲畜身上有了虱子；埃及全地所有地上的尘土都变成了虱子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就这样行。亚伦伸杖击打地上的尘土，就在人身上和牲畜身上有了虱子；埃及遍地的尘土都变成虱子了。
verses.textEnNiv: They did this, and when Aaron stretched out his hand with the staff and struck the dust of the ground, gnats came on people and animals. All the dust throughout the land of Egypt became gnats.
verses.textEnEsv: And they did so. Aaron stretched out his hand with his staff and struck the dust of the earth, and there were gnats on man and beast. All the dust of the earth became gnats in all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they did so. For Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod and struck the dust of the earth, and it became lice on man and beast. All the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord had commanded them. When Aaron raised his hand and struck the ground with his staff, gnats infested the entire land, covering the Egyptians and their animals. All the dust in the land of Egypt turned into gnats.
verses.textEnNasb: They did so; and Aaron extended his hand with his staff and struck the dust of the earth, and there were gnats on every person and animal. All the dust of the earth turned into gnats through all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: They did this, and when Aaron stretched out his hand with the staff and struck the dust of the ground, gnats came on people and animals. All the dust throughout the land of Egypt became gnats.

verses.textZh: 众术士也用他们的巫术照样行，要生出虱子来，却不能办到；所以在人身上和牲畜身上都有虱子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众术士也用他们的巫术照样行，要生出虱子来，却不能办到；所以在人身上和牲畜身上都有虱子。
verses.textZhCuv: 行法术的也用邪术要生出虱子来，却是不能。于是在人身上和牲畜身上都有了虱子。
verses.textEnNiv: But when the magicians tried to produce gnats by their secret arts, they could not. Since the gnats were on people and animals everywhere,
verses.textEnEsv: The magicians tried by their secret arts to produce gnats, but they could not. So there were gnats on man and beast.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the magicians so worked with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not. So there were lice on man and beast.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh’s magicians tried to do the same thing with their secret arts, but this time they failed. And the gnats covered everyone, people and animals alike.
verses.textEnNasb: The soothsayer priests tried with their secret arts to produce gnats, but they could not; so there were gnats on every person and animal.
verses.textEn: But when the magicians tried to produce gnats by their secret arts, they could not. Since the gnats were on people and animals everywhere,

verses.textZh: 众术士就对法老说："这是神的手指头。"法老却心里刚硬，不肯听摩西和亚伦，就像耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众术士就对法老说："这是神的手指头。"法老却心里刚硬，不肯听摩西和亚伦，就像耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 行法术的就对法老说：「这是神的手段。」法老心里刚硬，不肯听摩西、亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: the magicians said to Pharaoh, "This is the finger of God." But Pharaoh’s heart was hard and he would not listen, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, "This is the finger of God." But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, "This is the finger of God." But Pharaoh’s heart grew hard, and he did not heed them, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is the finger of God!" the magicians exclaimed to Pharaoh. But Pharaoh’s heart remained hard. He wouldn’t listen to them, just as the Lord had predicted.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the soothsayer priests said to Pharaoh, "This is the finger of God." But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he did not listen to them, just as the Lord had said.
verses.textEn: the magicians said to Pharaoh, "This is the finger of God." But Pharaoh’s heart was hard and he would not listen, just as the Lord had said.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要清早起来，站在法老面前；看哪，法老到水边来的时候，你要对他说：‘耶和华这样说：你要让我的人民离开这里，使他们可以事奉我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要清早起来，站在法老面前；看哪，法老到水边来的时候，你要对他说：‘耶和华这样说：你要让我的人民离开这里，使他们可以事奉我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你清早起来，法老来到水边，你站在他面前，对他说：『耶和华这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning and confront Pharaoh as he goes to the river and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Rise up early in the morning and present yourself to Pharaoh, as he goes out to the water, and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord , "Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Rise early in the morning and stand before Pharaoh as he comes out to the water. Then say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Let My people go, that they may serve Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told Moses, "Get up early in the morning and stand in Pharaoh’s way as he goes down to the river. Say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Let my people go, so they can worship me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Rise early in the morning and present yourself before Pharaoh, as he comes out to the water; and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning and confront Pharaoh as he goes to the river and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

verses.textZh: 如果你不让我的人民离开这里，看哪，我必叫苍蝇落在你和你臣仆，以及人民的身上，进到你的宫殿；埃及人的房屋都必充满苍蝇，他们所在的地方也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你不让我的人民离开这里，看哪，我必叫苍蝇落在你和你臣仆，以及人民的身上，进到你的宫殿；埃及人的房屋都必充满苍蝇，他们所在的地方也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若不容我的百姓去，我要叫成群的苍蝇到你和你臣仆并你百姓的身上，进你的房屋，并且埃及人的房屋和他们所住的地都要满了成群的苍蝇。
verses.textEnNiv: If you do not let my people go, I will send swarms of flies on you and your officials, on your people and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians will be full of flies; even the ground will be covered with them.
verses.textEnEsv: Or else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you and your servants and your people, and into your houses. And the houses of the Egyptians shall be filled with swarms of flies, and also the ground on which they stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or else, if you will not let My people go, behold, I will send swarms offlies on you and your servants, on your people and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms offlies, and also the ground on which they stand.
verses.textEnNlt: If you refuse, then I will send swarms of flies on you, your officials, your people, and all the houses. The Egyptian homes will be filled with flies, and the ground will be covered with them.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you are not going to let My people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you and on your servants and on your people, and into your houses; and the houses of the Egyptians will be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground on which they live.
verses.textEn: If you do not let my people go, I will send swarms of flies on you and your officials, on your people and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians will be full of flies; even the ground will be covered with them.

verses.textZh: 那日，我必把我人民居住的地方歌珊分别出来，使那里没有苍蝇，为要使你知道在全地上只有我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那日，我必把我人民居住的地方歌珊分别出来，使那里没有苍蝇，为要使你知道在全地上只有我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，我必分别我百姓所住的歌珊地，使那里没有成群的苍蝇，好叫你知道我是天下的耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But on that day I will deal differently with the land of Goshen, where my people live; no swarms of flies will be there, so that you will know that I, the Lord , am in this land.
verses.textEnEsv: But on that day I will set apart the land of Goshen, where my people dwell, so that no swarms of flies shall be there, that you may know that I am the Lord in the midst of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in that day I will set apart the land of Goshen, in which My people dwell, that no swarms offlies shall be there, in order that you may know that I am the Lord in the midst of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: But this time I will spare the region of Goshen, where my people live. No flies will be found there. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that I am present even in the heart of your land.
verses.textEnNasb: But on that day I will set apart the land of Goshen, where My people are living, so that no swarms of flies will be there, in order that you may know that I, the Lord, am in the midst of the land.
verses.textEn: " ‘But on that day I will deal differently with the land of Goshen, where my people live; no swarms of flies will be there, so that you will know that I, the Lord , am in this land.

verses.textZh: 我必把我的人民和你的人民分别出来 ，明天必有这神迹。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把我的人民和你的人民分别出来 ，明天必有这神迹。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将我的百姓和你的百姓分别出来。明天必有这神迹。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I will make a distinction between my people and your people. This sign will occur tomorrow.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Thus I will put a division between my people and your people. Tomorrow this sign shall happen."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make a difference between My people and your people. Tomorrow this sign shall be." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will make a clear distinction between my people and your people. This miraculous sign will happen tomorrow.’"
verses.textEnNasb: I will put a division between My people and your people. Tomorrow this sign will occur." ’ "
verses.textEn: I will make a distinction between my people and your people. This sign will occur tomorrow.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华就这样行了；无数的苍蝇进了法老的宫殿和他臣仆的房屋，并且遍布埃及全地；那地就因为苍蝇的缘故毁坏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就这样行了；无数的苍蝇进了法老的宫殿和他臣仆的房屋，并且遍布埃及全地；那地就因为苍蝇的缘故毁坏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就这样行。苍蝇成了大群，进入法老的宫殿，和他臣仆的房屋；埃及遍地就因这成群的苍蝇败坏了。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord did this. Dense swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh’s palace and into the houses of his officials; throughout Egypt the land was ruined by the flies.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord did so. There came great swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh and into his servants’ houses. Throughout all the land of Egypt the land was ruined by the swarms of flies.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord did so. Thick swarms offlies came into the house of Pharaoh, into his servants’ houses, and into all the land of Egypt. The land was corrupted because of the swarms offlies.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord did just as he had said. A thick swarm of flies filled Pharaoh’s palace and the houses of his officials. The whole land of Egypt was thrown into chaos by the flies.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord did so. And thick swarms of flies entered the house of Pharaoh and the houses of his servants, and the land was laid waste because of the swarms of flies in all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: And the Lord did this. Dense swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh’s palace and into the houses of his officials; throughout Egypt the land was ruined by the flies.

verses.textZh: 法老把摩西和亚伦召了来，对他们说："你们去，在这地献祭给你们的神吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老把摩西和亚伦召了来，对他们说："你们去，在这地献祭给你们的神吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老召了摩西、亚伦来，说：「你们去，在这地祭祀你们的神吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Go, sacrifice to your God here in the land."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, "Go, sacrifice to your God within the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, "Go, sacrifice to your God in the land."
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron. "All right! Go ahead and offer sacrifices to your God," he said. "But do it here in this land."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron and said, "Go, sacrifice to your God within the land."
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Go, sacrifice to your God here in the land."

verses.textZh: 摩西回答："决不可以这样行，因为我们要把埃及人看为可憎的祭物献给耶和华我们的神；如果我们把埃及人看为可憎的祭物在他们眼前献上，难道他们不拿石头打死我们吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答："决不可以这样行，因为我们要把埃及人看为可憎的祭物献给耶和华我们的神；如果我们把埃及人看为可憎的祭物在他们眼前献上，难道他们不拿石头打死我们吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「这样行本不相宜，因为我们要把埃及人所厌恶的祭祀耶和华－我们的神；若把埃及人所厌恶的在他们眼前献为祭，他们岂不拿石头打死我们吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses said, "That would not be right. The sacrifices we offer the Lord our God would be detestable to the Egyptians. And if we offer sacrifices that are detestable in their eyes, will they not stone us?
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said, "It would not be right to do so, for the offerings we shall sacrifice to the Lord our God are an abomination to the Egyptians. If we sacrifice offerings abominable to the Egyptians before their eyes, will they not stone us?
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said, "It is not right to do so, for we would be sacrificing the abomination of the Egyptians to the Lord our God. If we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, then will they not stone us?
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses replied, "That wouldn’t be right. The Egyptians detest the sacrifices that we offer to the Lord our God. Look, if we offer our sacrifices here where the Egyptians can see us, they will stone us.
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses said, "It is not permissible for us to do so, because we will sacrifice to the Lord our God that which is an abomination to the Egyptians. If we sacrifice that which is an abomination to the Egyptians before their eyes, will they not stone us?
verses.textEn: But Moses said, "That would not be right. The sacrifices we offer the Lord our God would be detestable to the Egyptians. And if we offer sacrifices that are detestable in their eyes, will they not stone us?

verses.textZh: 我们要走三天的路程进到旷野，好照着耶和华吩咐我们的，向耶和华我们的神献祭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要走三天的路程进到旷野，好照着耶和华吩咐我们的，向耶和华我们的神献祭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要往旷野去，走三天的路程，照着耶和华－我们神所要吩咐我们的祭祀他。」
verses.textEnNiv: We must take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God, as he commands us."
verses.textEnEsv: We must go three days’ journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the Lord our God as he tells us."
verses.textEnNkjv: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the Lord our God as He will command us."
verses.textEnNlt: We must take a three-day trip into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God, just as he has commanded us."
verses.textEnNasb: We must go a three days’ journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the Lord our God, just as He commands us."
verses.textEn: We must take a three-day journey into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God, as he commands us."

verses.textZh: 法老回答："我必让你们离开这里，你们可以在旷野献祭给耶和华你们的神，只是你们不可走得太远；请你们为我祈祷。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老回答："我必让你们离开这里，你们可以在旷野献祭给耶和华你们的神，只是你们不可走得太远；请你们为我祈祷。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老说：「我容你们去，在旷野祭祀耶和华－你们的神；只是不要走得很远。求你们为我祈祷。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh said, "I will let you go to offer sacrifices to the Lord your God in the wilderness, but you must not go very far. Now pray for me."
verses.textEnEsv: So Pharaoh said, "I will let you go to sacrifice to the Lord your God in the wilderness; only you must not go very far away. Plead for me."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Pharaoh said, "I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to the Lord your God in the wilderness; only you shall not go very far away. Intercede for me."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right, go ahead," Pharaoh replied. "I will let you go into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don’t go too far away. Now hurry and pray for me."
verses.textEnNasb: Pharaoh said, "I will let you go, so that you may sacrifice to the Lord your God in the wilderness; only you shall not go very far away. Plead for me."
verses.textEn: Pharaoh said, "I will let you go to offer sacrifices to the Lord your God in the wilderness, but you must not go very far. Now pray for me."

verses.textZh: 摩西说："看哪，我要离开你出去，祈求耶和华，使苍蝇明天可以离开法老和法老的臣仆，以及法老的人民，只是不可再行欺骗，不让以色列人离开这里去献祭给耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："看哪，我要离开你出去，祈求耶和华，使苍蝇明天可以离开法老和法老的臣仆，以及法老的人民，只是不可再行欺骗，不让以色列人离开这里去献祭给耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「我要出去求耶和华，使成群的苍蝇明天离开法老和法老的臣仆并法老的百姓；法老却不可再行诡诈，不容百姓去祭祀耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses answered, "As soon as I leave you, I will pray to the Lord , and tomorrow the flies will leave Pharaoh and his officials and his people. Only let Pharaoh be sure that he does not act deceitfully again by not letting the people go to offer sacrifices to the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses said, "Behold, I am going out from you and I will plead with the Lord that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow. Only let not Pharaoh cheat again by not letting the people go to sacrifice to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said, "Indeed I am going out from you, and I will entreat the Lord, that the swarms offlies may depart tomorrow from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. But let Pharaoh not deal deceitfully anymore in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses answered, "As soon as I leave you, I will pray to the Lord , and tomorrow the swarms of flies will disappear from you and your officials and all your people. But I am warning you, Pharaoh, don’t lie to us again and refuse to let the people go to sacrifice to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said, "Behold, I am going to leave you, and I will plead with the Lord that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people tomorrow; only do not let Pharaoh deal deceitfully again in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the Lord."
verses.textEn: Moses answered, "As soon as I leave you, I will pray to the Lord , and tomorrow the flies will leave Pharaoh and his officials and his people. Only let Pharaoh be sure that he does not act deceitfully again by not letting the people go to offer sacrifices to the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西从法老那里出来，去祈求耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西从法老那里出来，去祈求耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西离开法老去求耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses went out from Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses went out from Pharaoh and entreated the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses left Pharaoh’s palace and pleaded with the Lord to remove all the flies.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses left Pharaoh and pleaded with the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord ,

verses.textZh: 耶和华就照着摩西的话行了，使苍蝇离开了法老和他的臣仆，以及他的人民，连一只也没有留下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就照着摩西的话行了，使苍蝇离开了法老和他的臣仆，以及他的人民，连一只也没有留下。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就照摩西的话行，叫成群的苍蝇离开法老和他的臣仆并他的百姓，一个也没有留下。
verses.textEnNiv: and the Lord did what Moses asked. The flies left Pharaoh and his officials and his people; not a fly remained.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord did as Moses asked, and removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; not one remained.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; He removed the swarms offlies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. Not one remained.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord did as Moses asked and caused the swarms of flies to disappear from Pharaoh, his officials, and his people. Not a single fly remained.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord did as Moses asked, and removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; not one remained.
verses.textEn: and the Lord did what Moses asked. The flies left Pharaoh and his officials and his people; not a fly remained.

verses.textZh: 可是，这一次法老还是心里刚硬，不肯让以色列人离开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，这一次法老还是心里刚硬，不肯让以色列人离开。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一次法老又硬着心，不容百姓去。
verses.textEnNiv: But this time also Pharaoh hardened his heart and would not let the people go.
verses.textEnEsv: But Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and did not let the people go.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also; neither would he let the people go.
verses.textEnNlt: But Pharaoh again became stubborn and refused to let the people go.
verses.textEnNasb: But Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he did not let the people go.
verses.textEn: But this time also Pharaoh hardened his heart and would not let the people go.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要到法老那里去，对他说：‘耶和华希伯来人的神这样说："让我的人民离开这里，使他们可以事奉我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要到法老那里去，对他说：‘耶和华希伯来人的神这样说："让我的人民离开这里，使他们可以事奉我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你进去见法老，对他说：『耶和华－希伯来人的神这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: "Let my people go, so that they may worship me."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go in to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, "Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go in to Pharaoh and tell him, ‘Thus says the Lord God of the Hebrews: "Let My people go, that they may serve Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go back to Pharaoh," the Lord commanded Moses. "Tell him, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go, so they can worship me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and speak to him, ‘This is what the Lord, the God of the Hebrews says: "Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: "Let my people go, so that they may worship me."

verses.textZh: 如果你拒绝他们离开这里，仍然强留他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你拒绝他们离开这里，仍然强留他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 你若不肯容他们去，仍旧强留他们，
verses.textEnNiv: If you refuse to let them go and continue to hold them back,
verses.textEnEsv: For if you refuse to let them go and still hold them,
verses.textEnNkjv: For if you refuse to let them go, and still hold them,
verses.textEnNlt: If you continue to hold them and refuse to let them go,
verses.textEnNasb: For if you refuse to let them go and continue to hold them,
verses.textEn: If you refuse to let them go and continue to hold them back,

verses.textZh: 看哪，耶和华的手必用严重的瘟疫加在你田间的牲畜身上，加在马、驴、骆驼、牛群、羊群身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，耶和华的手必用严重的瘟疫加在你田间的牲畜身上，加在马、驴、骆驼、牛群、羊群身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的手加在你田间的牲畜上，就是在马、驴、骆驼、牛群、羊群上，必有重重的瘟疫。
verses.textEnNiv: the hand of the Lord will bring a terrible plague on your livestock in the field—on your horses, donkeys and camels and on your cattle, sheep and goats.
verses.textEnEsv: behold, the hand of the Lord will fall with a very severe plague upon your livestock that are in the field, the horses, the donkeys, the camels, the herds, and the flocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: behold, the hand of the Lord will be on your cattle in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the oxen, and on the sheep—a very severe pestilence.
verses.textEnNlt: the hand of the Lord will strike all your livestock—your horses, donkeys, camels, cattle, sheep, and goats—with a deadly plague.
verses.textEnNasb: behold, the hand of the Lord will come with a very severe plague on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks.
verses.textEn: the hand of the Lord will bring a terrible plague on your livestock in the field—on your horses, donkeys and camels and on your cattle, sheep and goats.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必把以色列的牲畜和埃及人的牲畜分别出来；所有属于以色列人的，一只也不死去。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必把以色列的牲畜和埃及人的牲畜分别出来；所有属于以色列人的，一只也不死去。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华要分别以色列的牲畜和埃及的牲畜，凡属以色列人的，一样都不死。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and that of Egypt, so that no animal belonging to the Israelites will die.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt, so that nothing of all that belongs to the people of Israel shall die."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord will make a difference between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt. So nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord will again make a distinction between the livestock of the Israelites and that of the Egyptians. Not a single one of Israel’s animals will die!
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt, so that nothing will die of all that belongs to the sons of Israel." ’ "
verses.textEn: But the Lord will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and that of Egypt, so that no animal belonging to the Israelites will die.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华就定了时候，说："明天耶和华必在此地行这事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就定了时候，说："明天耶和华必在此地行这事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就定了时候，说：「明天耶和华必在此地行这事。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord set a time and said, "Tomorrow the Lord will do this in the land."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord set a time, saying, "Tomorrow the Lord will do this thing in the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord appointed a set time, saying, "Tomorrow the Lord will do this thing in the land."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has already set the time for the plague to begin. He has declared that he will strike the land tomorrow.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord set a definite time, saying, "Tomorrow the Lord will do this thing in the land."
verses.textEn: The Lord set a time and said, "Tomorrow the Lord will do this in the land."

verses.textZh: 第二天，耶和华就行了这事，埃及人全部的牲畜都死了；可是属于以色列人的牲畜，一只也没有死去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，耶和华就行了这事，埃及人全部的牲畜都死了；可是属于以色列人的牲畜，一只也没有死去。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，耶和华就行这事。埃及的牲畜几乎都死了，只是以色列人的牲畜，一个都没有死。
verses.textEnNiv: And the next day the Lord did it: All the livestock of the Egyptians died, but not one animal belonging to the Israelites died.
verses.textEnEsv: And the next day the Lord did this thing. All the livestock of the Egyptians died, but not one of the livestock of the people of Israel died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord did this thing on the next day, and all the livestock of Egypt died; but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord did just as he had said. The next morning all the livestock of the Egyptians died, but the Israelites didn’t lose a single animal.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord did this thing on the next day, and all the livestock of Egypt died; but not one of the livestock of the sons of Israel died.
verses.textEn: And the next day the Lord did it: All the livestock of the Egyptians died, but not one animal belonging to the Israelites died.

verses.textZh: 法老派人去看，果然看见属于以色列人的牲畜，连一只也没有死去。法老的心还是刚硬，不肯让以色列人离开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老派人去看，果然看见属于以色列人的牲畜，连一只也没有死去。法老的心还是刚硬，不肯让以色列人离开。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老打发人去看，谁知以色列人的牲畜连一个都没有死。法老的心却是固执，不容百姓去。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh investigated and found that not even one of the animals of the Israelites had died. Yet his heart was unyielding and he would not let the people go.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh sent, and behold, not one of the livestock of Israel was dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh sent, and indeed, not even one of the livestock of the Israelites was dead. But the heart of Pharaoh became hard, and he did not let the people go.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh sent his officials to investigate, and they discovered that the Israelites had not lost a single animal! But even so, Pharaoh’s heart remained stubborn, and he still refused to let the people go.
verses.textEnNasb: And Pharaoh sent men, and they learned that, behold, not even one of the livestock of Israel was dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh investigated and found that not even one of the animals of the Israelites had died. Yet his heart was unyielding and he would not let the people go.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说："你们要两手拿满炉灰，摩西要在法老眼前把炉灰向天上扬起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说："你们要两手拿满炉灰，摩西要在法老眼前把炉灰向天上扬起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西、亚伦说：「你们取几捧炉灰，摩西要在法老面前向天扬起来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Take handfuls of soot from a furnace and have Moses toss it into the air in the presence of Pharaoh.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Take handfuls of soot from the kiln, and let Moses throw them in the air in the sight of Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Take for yourselves handfuls of ashes from a furnace, and let Moses scatter it toward the heavens in the sight of Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Take handfuls of soot from a brick kiln, and have Moses toss it into the air while Pharaoh watches.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Take for yourselves handfuls of soot from a kiln, and Moses shall toss it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Take handfuls of soot from a furnace and have Moses toss it into the air in the presence of Pharaoh.

verses.textZh: 这炉灰必在埃及全地变为微尘，在埃及全地的人和牲畜身上就必生出疹病和脓疮。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这炉灰必在埃及全地变为微尘，在埃及全地的人和牲畜身上就必生出疹病和脓疮。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这灰要在埃及全地变作尘土，在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的疮。」
verses.textEnNiv: It will become fine dust over the whole land of Egypt, and festering boils will break out on people and animals throughout the land."
verses.textEnEsv: It shall become fine dust over all the land of Egypt, and become boils breaking out in sores on man and beast throughout all the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it will become fine dust in all the land of Egypt, and it will cause boils that break out in sores on man and beast throughout all the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: The ashes will spread like fine dust over the whole land of Egypt, causing festering boils to break out on people and animals throughout the land."
verses.textEnNasb: Then it will become fine dust over all the land of Egypt, and will turn into boils breaking out with sores on every person and animal through all the land of Egypt."
verses.textEn: It will become fine dust over the whole land of Egypt, and festering boils will break out on people and animals throughout the land."

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦取了炉灰，站在法老面前；摩西把炉灰向天上扬起来，人和牲畜身上就生出了疹病和脓疮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦取了炉灰，站在法老面前；摩西把炉灰向天上扬起来，人和牲畜身上就生出了疹病和脓疮。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦取了炉灰，站在法老面前。摩西向天扬起来，就在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的疮。
verses.textEnNiv: So they took soot from a furnace and stood before Pharaoh. Moses tossed it into the air, and festering boils broke out on people and animals.
verses.textEnEsv: So they took soot from the kiln and stood before Pharaoh. And Moses threw it in the air, and it became boils breaking out in sores on man and beast.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took ashes from the furnace and stood before Pharaoh, and Moses scattered them toward heaven. And they caused boils that break out in sores on man and beast.
verses.textEnNlt: So they took soot from a brick kiln and went and stood before Pharaoh. As Pharaoh watched, Moses threw the soot into the air, and boils broke out on people and animals alike.
verses.textEnNasb: So they took soot from a kiln, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses tossed it toward the sky, and it became boils breaking out with sores on every person and animal.
verses.textEn: So they took soot from a furnace and stood before Pharaoh. Moses tossed it into the air, and festering boils broke out on people and animals.

verses.textZh: 众术士因为生了疮的缘故，不能站在摩西的面前；因为众术士和所有埃及人身上都生了疮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众术士因为生了疮的缘故，不能站在摩西的面前；因为众术士和所有埃及人身上都生了疮。
verses.textZhCuv: 行法术的在摩西面前站立不住，因为在他们身上和一切埃及人身上都有这疮。
verses.textEnNiv: The magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils that were on them and on all the Egyptians.
verses.textEnEsv: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils, for the boils came upon the magicians and upon all the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils, for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the magicians were unable to stand before Moses, because the boils had broken out on them and all the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNasb: The soothsayer priests could not stand before Moses because of the boils, for the boils were on the soothsayer priests as well as on all the Egyptians.
verses.textEn: The magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils that were on them and on all the Egyptians.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使法老心里刚硬，他就不肯听摩西和亚伦的话，就像耶和华对摩西所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使法老心里刚硬，他就不肯听摩西和亚伦的话，就像耶和华对摩西所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使法老的心刚硬，不听他们，正如耶和华对摩西所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said to Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he did not listen to them, as the Lord had spoken to Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh; and he did not heed them, just as the Lord had spoken to Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and just as the Lord had predicted to Moses, Pharaoh refused to listen.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not listen to them, just as the Lord had spoken to Moses.
verses.textEn: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said to Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要清早起来，站在法老面前，对他说：‘耶和华希伯来人的神这样说："让我的人民离开这里，使他们可以事奉我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要清早起来，站在法老面前，对他说：‘耶和华希伯来人的神这样说："让我的人民离开这里，使他们可以事奉我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你清早起来，站在法老面前，对他说：『耶和华－希伯来人的神这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning, confront Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me,
