verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Rise up early in the morning and present yourself before Pharaoh and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, "Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Rise early in the morning and stand before Pharaoh, and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord God of the Hebrews: "Let My people go, that they may serve Me,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning and stand before Pharaoh. Tell him, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go, so they can worship me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Rise up early in the morning and stand before Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord, the God of the Hebrews says: "Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning, confront Pharaoh and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me,

verses.textZh: 因为这一次我要降下我的一切灾祸，打击你和你的臣仆及人民，为要使你知道在全地上没有神像我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这一次我要降下我的一切灾祸，打击你和你的臣仆及人民，为要使你知道在全地上没有神像我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这一次我要叫一切的灾殃临到你和你臣仆并你百姓的身上，叫你知道在普天下没有像我的。
verses.textEnNiv: or this time I will send the full force of my plagues against you and against your officials and your people, so you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: For this time I will send all my plagues on you yourself, and on your servants and your people, so that you may know that there is none like me in all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: for at this time I will send all My plagues to your very heart, and on your servants and on your people, that you may know that thereis none like Me in all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: If you don’t, I will send more plagues on you and your officials and your people. Then you will know that there is no one like me in all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: For this time I am going to send all My plagues on you and your servants and your people, so that you may know that there is no one like Me in all the earth.
verses.textEn: or this time I will send the full force of my plagues against you and against your officials and your people, so you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

verses.textZh: 如果我现在伸手用瘟疫击打你和你的人民，你就早已从地上消灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我现在伸手用瘟疫击打你和你的人民，你就早已从地上消灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若伸手用瘟疫攻击你和你的百姓，你早就从地上除灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: For by now I could have stretched out my hand and struck you and your people with a plague that would have wiped you off the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: For by now I could have put out my hand and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if I had stretched out My hand and struck you and your people with pestilence, then you would have been cut off from the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: By now I could have lifted my hand and struck you and your people with a plague to wipe you off the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: For had I now put out My hand and struck you and your people with plague, you would then have been eliminated from the earth.
verses.textEn: For by now I could have stretched out my hand and struck you and your people with a plague that would have wiped you off the earth.

verses.textZh: 然而我使你存留，是为了使你看见我的能力，并且在全地上传讲我的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我使你存留，是为了使你看见我的能力，并且在全地上传讲我的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 其实，我叫你存立，是特要向你显我的大能，并要使我的名传遍天下。
verses.textEnNiv: But I have raised you up for this very purpose, that I might show you my power and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: But for this purpose I have raised you up, to show you my power, so that my name may be proclaimed in all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: But indeed for this purpose I have raised you up, that I may show My power in you, and that My name may be declared in all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: But I have spared you for a purpose—to show you my power and to spread my fame throughout the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: But indeed, for this reason I have allowed you to remain, in order to show you My power and in order to proclaim My name throughout the earth.
verses.textEn: But I have raised you up for this very purpose, that I might show you my power and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.

verses.textZh: 你仍然向我的人民自高，不让他们离开吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你仍然向我的人民自高，不让他们离开吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你还向我的百姓自高，不容他们去吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You still set yourself against my people and will not let them go.
verses.textEnEsv: You are still exalting yourself against my people and will not let them go.
verses.textEnNkjv: As yet you exalt yourself against My people in that you will not let them go.
verses.textEnNlt: But you still lord it over my people and refuse to let them go.
verses.textEnNasb: Still you exalt yourself against My people by not letting them go.
verses.textEn: You still set yourself against my people and will not let them go.

verses.textZh: 看哪，明天大约这个时候，我必降下极重的冰雹，在埃及自建国以来，直到现在，未曾有过这样的冰雹的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，明天大约这个时候，我必降下极重的冰雹，在埃及自建国以来，直到现在，未曾有过这样的冰雹的。
verses.textZhCuv: 到明天约在这时候，我必叫重大的冰雹降下，自从埃及开国以来，没有这样的冰雹。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, at this time tomorrow I will send the worst hailstorm that has ever fallen on Egypt, from the day it was founded till now.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, about this time tomorrow I will cause very heavy hail to fall, such as never has been in Egypt from the day it was founded until now.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause very heavy hail to rain down, such as has not been in Egypt since its founding until now.
verses.textEnNlt: So tomorrow at this time I will send a hailstorm more devastating than any in all the history of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, about this time tomorrow, I will send a very heavy hail, such as has not been seen in Egypt from the day it was founded until now.
verses.textEn: Therefore, at this time tomorrow I will send the worst hailstorm that has ever fallen on Egypt, from the day it was founded till now.

verses.textZh: 所以，你现在要派人去，把你的牲畜和田间所有属于你的，都收聚到安全的地方；因为凡在田间发现的人和牲畜而不收回家里去的，冰雹必落在他们身上，他们就必死亡。"’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你现在要派人去，把你的牲畜和田间所有属于你的，都收聚到安全的地方；因为凡在田间发现的人和牲畜而不收回家里去的，冰雹必落在他们身上，他们就必死亡。"’"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要打发人把你的牲畜和你田间一切所有的催进来；凡在田间不收回家的，无论是人是牲畜，冰雹必降在他们身上，他们就必死。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Give an order now to bring your livestock and everything you have in the field to a place of shelter, because the hail will fall on every person and animal that has not been brought in and is still out in the field, and they will die.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore send, get your livestock and all that you have in the field into safe shelter, for every man and beast that is in the field and is not brought home will die when the hail falls on them."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore send now and gather your livestock and all that you have in the field, for the hail shall come down on every man and every animal which is found in the field and is not brought home; and they shall die." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Quick! Order your livestock and servants to come in from the fields to find shelter. Any person or animal left outside will die when the hail falls.’"
verses.textEnNasb: So now, send word, bring your livestock and whatever you have in the field to safety. Every person and animal that is found in the field and is not brought home, when the hail comes down on them, will die." ’ "
verses.textEn: Give an order now to bring your livestock and everything you have in the field to a place of shelter, because the hail will fall on every person and animal that has not been brought in and is still out in the field, and they will die.’ "

verses.textZh: 法老的臣仆中有惧怕耶和华这话的，就叫他的仆人和牲畜进屋里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老的臣仆中有惧怕耶和华这话的，就叫他的仆人和牲畜进屋里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的臣仆中，惧怕耶和华这话的，便叫他的奴仆和牲畜跑进家来。
verses.textEnNiv: Those officials of Pharaoh who feared the word of the Lord hurried to bring their slaves and their livestock inside.
verses.textEnEsv: Then whoever feared the word of the Lord among the servants of Pharaoh hurried his slaves and his livestock into the houses,
verses.textEnNkjv: He who feared the word of the Lord among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his livestock flee to the houses.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of Pharaoh’s officials were afraid because of what the Lord had said. They quickly brought their servants and livestock in from the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone among the servants of Pharaoh who feared the word of the Lord hurried to bring his servants and his livestock into the houses;
verses.textEn: Those officials of Pharaoh who feared the word of the Lord hurried to bring their slaves and their livestock inside.

verses.textZh: 但那不把耶和华这话放在心上的，却把他的仆人和牲畜留在田里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那不把耶和华这话放在心上的，却把他的仆人和牲畜留在田里。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那不把耶和华这话放在心上的，就将他的奴仆和牲畜留在田里。
verses.textEnNiv: But those who ignored the word of the Lord left their slaves and livestock in the field.
verses.textEnEsv: but whoever did not pay attention to the word of the Lord left his slaves and his livestock in the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who did not regard the word of the Lord left his servants and his livestock in the field.
verses.textEnNlt: But those who paid no attention to the word of the Lord left theirs out in the open.
verses.textEnNasb: but everyone who did not pay regard to the word of the Lord left his servants and his livestock in the field.
verses.textEn: But those who ignored the word of the Lord left their slaves and livestock in the field.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要向天伸杖，使埃及全地都有冰雹，落在人身上、在牲畜身上和埃及地田间所有的蔬菜上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要向天伸杖，使埃及全地都有冰雹，落在人身上、在牲畜身上和埃及地田间所有的蔬菜上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你向天伸杖，使埃及遍地的人身上和牲畜身上，并田间各样菜蔬上，都有冰雹。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward the sky so that hail will fall all over Egypt—on people and animals and on everything growing in the fields of Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward heaven, so that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man and beast and every plant of the field, in the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt—on man, on beast, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Lift your hand toward the sky so hail may fall on the people, the livestock, and all the plants throughout the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Moses, "Reach out with your hand toward the sky, so that hail may fall on all the land of Egypt, on every person and animal, and on every plant of the field, throughout the land of Egypt."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward the sky so that hail will fall all over Egypt—on people and animals and on everything growing in the fields of Egypt."

verses.textZh: 摩西把手杖向天一伸，耶和华就打雷 下雹，有火落在地上；耶和华使冰雹降在埃及地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把手杖向天一伸，耶和华就打雷 下雹，有火落在地上；耶和华使冰雹降在埃及地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西向天伸杖，耶和华就打雷下雹，有火闪到地上；耶和华下雹在埃及地上。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses stretched out his staff toward the sky, the Lord sent thunder and hail, and lightning flashed down to the ground. So the Lord rained hail on the land of Egypt;
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses stretched out his staff toward heaven, and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and fire ran down to the earth. And the Lord rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses stretched out his rod toward heaven; and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and fire darted to the ground. And the Lord rained hail on the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses lifted his staff toward the sky, and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and lightning flashed toward the earth. The Lord sent a tremendous hailstorm against all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses reached out with his staff toward the sky, and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and fire ran down to the earth. And the Lord rained hail on the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: When Moses stretched out his staff toward the sky, the Lord sent thunder and hail, and lightning flashed down to the ground. So the Lord rained hail on the land of Egypt;

verses.textZh: 那时有了冰雹，冰雹与火混杂在一起，十分严重；埃及全地自从建国以来，未曾有过这样的冰雹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时有了冰雹，冰雹与火混杂在一起，十分严重；埃及全地自从建国以来，未曾有过这样的冰雹。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，雹与火搀杂，甚是厉害，自从埃及成国以来，遍地没有这样的。
verses.textEnNiv: hail fell and lightning flashed back and forth. It was the worst storm in all the land of Egypt since it had become a nation.
verses.textEnEsv: There was hail and fire flashing continually in the midst of the hail, very heavy hail, such as had never been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
verses.textEnNkjv: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, so very heavy that there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
verses.textEnNlt: Never in all the history of Egypt had there been a storm like that, with such devastating hail and continuous lightning.
verses.textEnNasb: So there was hail, and fire flashing intermittently in the midst of the hail, which was very heavy, such as had not occurred in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
verses.textEn: hail fell and lightning flashed back and forth. It was the worst storm in all the land of Egypt since it had become a nation.

verses.textZh: 在埃及全地，冰雹把田间的一切，连人和牲畜都击打了；冰雹又把田间的一切蔬菜击打了，也把田间的一切树木打断了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在埃及全地，冰雹把田间的一切，连人和牲畜都击打了；冰雹又把田间的一切蔬菜击打了，也把田间的一切树木打断了。
verses.textZhCuv: 在埃及遍地，雹击打了田间所有的人和牲畜，并一切的菜蔬，又打坏田间一切的树木。
verses.textEnNiv: Throughout Egypt hail struck everything in the fields—both people and animals; it beat down everything growing in the fields and stripped every tree.
verses.textEnEsv: The hail struck down everything that was in the field in all the land of Egypt, both man and beast. And the hail struck down every plant of the field and broke every tree of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the hail struck throughout the whole land of Egypt, all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail struck every herb of the field and broke every tree of the field.
verses.textEnNlt: It left all of Egypt in ruins. The hail struck down everything in the open field—people, animals, and plants alike. Even the trees were destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: The hail struck everything that was in the field through all the land of Egypt, from people to animals; the hail also struck every plant of the field, and shattered every tree of the field.
verses.textEn: Throughout Egypt hail struck everything in the fields—both people and animals; it beat down everything growing in the fields and stripped every tree.

verses.textZh: 只有在以色列人所在的歌珊地，没有冰雹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有在以色列人所在的歌珊地，没有冰雹。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独以色列人所住的歌珊地没有冰雹。
verses.textEnNiv: The only place it did not hail was the land of Goshen, where the Israelites were.
verses.textEnEsv: Only in the land of Goshen, where the people of Israel were, was there no hail.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.
verses.textEnNlt: The only place without hail was the region of Goshen, where the people of Israel lived.
verses.textEnNasb: Only in the land of Goshen, where the sons of Israel were, was there no hail.
verses.textEn: The only place it did not hail was the land of Goshen, where the Israelites were.

verses.textZh: 于是，法老把摩西和亚伦召了来，对他们说："这一次我犯了罪了；耶和华是公义的，我和我的人民是有罪的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，法老把摩西和亚伦召了来，对他们说："这一次我犯了罪了；耶和华是公义的，我和我的人民是有罪的。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老打发人召摩西、亚伦来，对他们说：「这一次我犯了罪了。耶和华是公义的；我和我的百姓是邪恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron. "This time I have sinned," he said to them. "The Lord is in the right, and I and my people are in the wrong.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh sent and called Moses and Aaron and said to them, "This time I have sinned; the Lord is in the right, and I and my people are in the wrong.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, "I have sinned this time. The Lordis righteous, and my people and I are wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh quickly summoned Moses and Aaron. "This time I have sinned," he confessed. "The Lord is the righteous one, and my people and I are wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, "I have sinned this time; the Lord is the righteous one, and I and my people are the wicked ones.
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron. "This time I have sinned," he said to them. "The Lord is in the right, and I and my people are in the wrong.

verses.textZh: 请你们祈求耶和华吧，因为这雷声和冰雹已经够了；我决意让你们离开，你们不可再留在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你们祈求耶和华吧，因为这雷声和冰雹已经够了；我决意让你们离开，你们不可再留在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这雷轰和冰雹已经够了。请你们求耶和华，我就容你们去，不再留住你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pray to the Lord , for we have had enough thunder and hail. I will let you go; you don’t have to stay any longer."
verses.textEnEsv: Plead with the Lord , for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer."
verses.textEnNkjv: Entreat the Lord, that there may be no more mighty thundering and hail, for itis enough. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer."
verses.textEnNlt: Please beg the Lord to end this terrifying thunder and hail. We’ve had enough. I will let you go; you don’t need to stay any longer."
verses.textEnNasb: Plead with the Lord, for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail; and I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer."
verses.textEn: Pray to the Lord , for we have had enough thunder and hail. I will let you go; you don’t have to stay any longer."

verses.textZh: 摩西回答法老："我一出城，就必向耶和华伸手祷告，雷声就必止住，也不再有冰雹了，好使你知道大地是属于耶和华的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答法老："我一出城，就必向耶和华伸手祷告，雷声就必止住，也不再有冰雹了，好使你知道大地是属于耶和华的。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对他说：「我一出城，就要向耶和华举手祷告；雷必止住，也不再有冰雹，叫你知道全地都是属耶和华的。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses replied, "When I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands in prayer to the Lord . The thunder will stop and there will be no more hail, so you may know that the earth is the Lord ’s.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said to him, "As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will stretch out my hands to the Lord . The thunder will cease, and there will be no more hail, so that you may know that the earth is the Lord ’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses said to him, "As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to the Lord; the thunder will cease, and there will be no more hail, that you may know that the earth is the Lord’s.
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," Moses replied. "As soon as I leave the city, I will lift my hands and pray to the Lord . Then the thunder and hail will stop, and you will know that the earth belongs to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Moses said to him, "As soon as I go out of the city, I will spread out my hands to the Lord; the thunder will cease and there will no longer be hail, so that you may know that the earth is the Lord’s.
verses.textEn: Moses replied, "When I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands in prayer to the Lord . The thunder will stop and there will be no more hail, so you may know that the earth is the Lord ’s.

verses.textZh: 至于你和你的臣仆，我知道你们在耶和华神的面前还是没有惧怕的心。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你和你的臣仆，我知道你们在耶和华神的面前还是没有惧怕的心。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你和你的臣仆，我知道你们还是不惧怕耶和华神。」（
verses.textEnNiv: But I know that you and your officials still do not fear the Lord God."
verses.textEnEsv: But as for you and your servants, I know that you do not yet fear the Lord God."
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for you and your servants, I know that you will not yet fear the Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: But I know that you and your officials still do not fear the Lord God."
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you and your servants, I know that you do not yet fear the Lord God."
verses.textEn: But I know that you and your officials still do not fear the Lord God."

verses.textZh: 那时，麻和大麦被冰雹击打了，因为大麦已经吐穗，麻也开了花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，麻和大麦被冰雹击打了，因为大麦已经吐穗，麻也开了花。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，麻和大麦被雹击打；因为大麦已经吐穗，麻也开了花。
verses.textEnNiv: (The flax and barley were destroyed, since the barley had headed and the flax was in bloom.
verses.textEnEsv: (The flax and the barley were struck down, for the barley was in the ear and the flax was in bud.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the flax and the barley were struck, for the barley was in the head and the flax was in bud.
verses.textEnNlt: (All the flax and barley were ruined by the hail, because the barley had formed heads and the flax was budding.
verses.textEnNasb: (Now the flax and the barley were ruined, for the barley was in the ear and the flax was in bud.
verses.textEn: (The flax and barley were destroyed, since the barley had headed and the flax was in bloom.

verses.textZh: 只是小麦和粗麦却没有被击打，因为它们还没有长成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是小麦和粗麦却没有被击打，因为它们还没有长成。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是小麦和粗麦没有被击打，因为还没有长成。）
verses.textEnNiv: The wheat and spelt, however, were not destroyed, because they ripen later.)
verses.textEnEsv: But the wheat and the emmer were not struck down, for they are late in coming up.)
verses.textEnNkjv: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they are late crops.
verses.textEnNlt: But the wheat and the emmer wheat were spared, because they had not yet sprouted from the ground.)
verses.textEnNasb: But the wheat and the spelt were not ruined, for they ripen late.)
verses.textEn: The wheat and spelt, however, were not destroyed, because they ripen later.)

verses.textZh: 摩西离开法老出城去了，就向耶和华伸手祷告，雷声和冰雹就止住了，雨也不再倾倒在地上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西离开法老出城去了，就向耶和华伸手祷告，雷声和冰雹就止住了，雨也不再倾倒在地上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西离了法老出城，向耶和华举手祷告；雷和雹就止住，雨也不再浇在地上了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses left Pharaoh and went out of the city. He spread out his hands toward the Lord ; the thunder and hail stopped, and the rain no longer poured down on the land.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh and stretched out his hands to the Lord , and the thunder and the hail ceased, and the rain no longer poured upon the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh and spread out his hands to the Lord; then the thunder and the hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses left Pharaoh’s court and went out of the city. When he lifted his hands to the Lord , the thunder and hail stopped, and the downpour ceased.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses left the city from his meeting with Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to the Lord; and the thunder and the hail stopped, and rain no longer poured on the earth.
verses.textEn: Then Moses left Pharaoh and went out of the city. He spread out his hands toward the Lord ; the thunder and hail stopped, and the rain no longer poured down on the land.

verses.textZh: 法老看见雨水、冰雹和雷声都止住了，就更加犯罪，他和他的臣仆都心里刚硬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老看见雨水、冰雹和雷声都止住了，就更加犯罪，他和他的臣仆都心里刚硬。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老见雨和雹与雷止住，就越发犯罪；他和他的臣仆都硬着心。
verses.textEnNiv: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and hail and thunder had stopped, he sinned again: He and his officials hardened their hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunder had ceased, he sinned yet again and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain, the hail, and the thunder had ceased, he sinned yet more; and he hardened his heart, he and his servants.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Pharaoh saw that the rain, hail, and thunder had stopped, he and his officials sinned again, and Pharaoh again became stubborn.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunder had stopped, he sinned again and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
verses.textEn: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and hail and thunder had stopped, he sinned again: He and his officials hardened their hearts.

verses.textZh: 法老的心刚硬，不肯让以色列人离开，就像耶和华借着摩西所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老的心刚硬，不肯让以色列人离开，就像耶和华借着摩西所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的心刚硬，不容以色列人去，正如耶和华藉着摩西所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: So Pharaoh’s heart was hard and he would not let the Israelites go, just as the Lord had said through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: So the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people of Israel go, just as the Lord had spoken through Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the heart of Pharaoh was hard; neither would he let the children of Israel go, as the Lord had spoken by Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Because his heart was hard, Pharaoh refused to let the people leave, just as the Lord had predicted through Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he did not let the sons of Israel go, just as the Lord had spoken through Moses.
verses.textEn: So Pharaoh’s heart was hard and he would not let the Israelites go, just as the Lord had said through Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要到法老那里去，因为我已经使他的心和他臣仆的心刚硬，为要在他们中间显出我这些神迹；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要到法老那里去，因为我已经使他的心和他臣仆的心刚硬，为要在他们中间显出我这些神迹；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你进去见法老。我使他和他臣仆的心刚硬，为要在他们中间显我这些神迹，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the hearts of his officials so that I may perform these signs of mine among them
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, that I may show these signs of mine among them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord said to Moses, "Go in to Pharaoh; for I have hardened his heart and the hearts of his servants, that I may show these signs of Mine before him,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Return to Pharaoh and make your demands again. I have made him and his officials stubborn so I can display my miraculous signs among them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, so that I may perform these signs of Mine among them,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the hearts of his officials so that I may perform these signs of mine among them

verses.textZh: 并且要你把愚弄埃及人的事，和我在他们中间显出的神迹，都讲给你的子孙听；使你们知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且要你把愚弄埃及人的事，和我在他们中间显出的神迹，都讲给你的子孙听；使你们知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并要叫你将我向埃及人所做的事，和在他们中间所行的神迹，传于你儿子和你孙子的耳中，好叫你们知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: that you may tell your children and grandchildren how I dealt harshly with the Egyptians and how I performed my signs among them, and that you may know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son and of your grandson how I have dealt harshly with the Egyptians and what signs I have done among them, that you may know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son and your son’s son the mighty things I have done in Egypt, and My signs which I have done among them, that you may know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: I’ve also done it so you can tell your children and grandchildren about how I made a mockery of the Egyptians and about the signs I displayed among them—and so you will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: and that you may tell in the presence of your son, and of your grandson, how I made a mockery of the Egyptians and how I performed My signs among them, so that you may know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEn: that you may tell your children and grandchildren how I dealt harshly with the Egyptians and how I performed my signs among them, and that you may know that I am the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦就到法老那里去，对他说："耶和华希伯来人的神这样说：‘你拒绝在我面前谦卑要到几时呢？让我的人民离开吧，使他们可以事奉我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦就到法老那里去，对他说："耶和华希伯来人的神这样说：‘你拒绝在我面前谦卑要到几时呢？让我的人民离开吧，使他们可以事奉我。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦就进去见法老，对他说：「耶和华－希伯来人的神这样说：『你在我面前不肯自卑要到几时呢？容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said to him, "This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, so that they may worship me.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh and said to him, "Thus says the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, that they may serve me.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses and Aaron came in to Pharaoh and said to him, "Thus says the Lord God of the Hebrews: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before Me? Let My people go, that they may serve Me.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, "This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: How long will you refuse to submit to me? Let my people go, so they can worship me.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said to him, "This is what the Lord, the God of the Hebrews says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before Me? Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.
verses.textEn: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said to him, "This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

verses.textZh: 如果你拒绝让我的人民离开，看哪！明天我要使蝗虫进入你的境界；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你拒绝让我的人民离开，看哪！明天我要使蝗虫进入你的境界；
verses.textZhCuv: 你若不肯容我的百姓去，明天我要使蝗虫进入你的境内，
verses.textEnNiv: If you refuse to let them go, I will bring locusts into your country tomorrow.
verses.textEnEsv: For if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,
verses.textEnNkjv: Or else, if you refuse to let My people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your territory.
verses.textEnNlt: If you refuse, watch out! For tomorrow I will bring a swarm of locusts on your country.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you refuse to let My people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your territory.
verses.textEn: If you refuse to let them go, I will bring locusts into your country tomorrow.

verses.textZh: 蝗虫必遮盖地面，甚至人不能看见地；蝗虫必吃尽那避过灾难余剩的，那没有受冰雹击打，剩下留给你们的；牠们也必吃尽田间给你们生长起来的一切树木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蝗虫必遮盖地面，甚至人不能看见地；蝗虫必吃尽那避过灾难余剩的，那没有受冰雹击打，剩下留给你们的；牠们也必吃尽田间给你们生长起来的一切树木。
verses.textZhCuv: 遮满地面，甚至看不见地，并且吃那冰雹所剩的和田间所长的一切树木。
verses.textEnNiv: They will cover the face of the ground so that it cannot be seen. They will devour what little you have left after the hail, including every tree that is growing in your fields.
verses.textEnEsv: and they shall cover the face of the land, so that no one can see the land. And they shall eat what is left to you after the hail, and they shall eat every tree of yours that grows in the field,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall cover the face of the earth, so that no one will be able to see the earth; and they shall eat the residue of what is left, which remains to you from the hail, and they shall eat every tree which grows up for you out of the field.
verses.textEnNlt: They will cover the land so that you won’t be able to see the ground. They will devour what little is left of your crops after the hailstorm, including all the trees growing in the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will cover the surface of the land, so that no one will be able to see the land. They will also eat the rest of what has survived—what is left to you from the hail—and they will eat every tree of yours which grows in the field.
verses.textEn: They will cover the face of the ground so that it cannot be seen. They will devour what little you have left after the hail, including every tree that is growing in your fields.

verses.textZh: 蝗虫必充满了你的宫殿，你所有臣仆的房屋，和所有埃及人的房屋；这是你祖宗和你祖宗的祖宗自从在世以来，直到今日，所没有见过的。’"摩西就转身，离开法老出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蝗虫必充满了你的宫殿，你所有臣仆的房屋，和所有埃及人的房屋；这是你祖宗和你祖宗的祖宗自从在世以来，直到今日，所没有见过的。’"摩西就转身，离开法老出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的宫殿和你众臣仆的房屋，并一切埃及人的房屋，都要被蝗虫占满了；自从你祖宗和你祖宗的祖宗在世以来，直到今日，没有见过这样的灾。』」摩西就转身离开法老出去。
verses.textEnNiv: They will fill your houses and those of all your officials and all the Egyptians—something neither your parents nor your ancestors have ever seen from the day they settled in this land till now.’ " Then Moses turned and left Pharaoh.
verses.textEnEsv: and they shall fill your houses and the houses of all your servants and of all the Egyptians, as neither your fathers nor your grandfathers have seen, from the day they came on earth to this day.’" Then he turned and went out from Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall fill your houses, the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians—which neither your fathers nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were on the earth to this day.’ " And he turned and went out from Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: They will overrun your palaces and the homes of your officials and all the houses in Egypt. Never in the history of Egypt have your ancestors seen a plague like this one!" And with that, Moses turned and left Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: Then your houses will be filled with them, together with the houses of all your servants and the houses of all the Egyptians, something which neither your fathers nor your grandfathers have seen, from the day that they came upon the earth until this day.’ " And he turned and left Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: They will fill your houses and those of all your officials and all the Egyptians—something neither your parents nor your ancestors have ever seen from the day they settled in this land till now.’ " Then Moses turned and left Pharaoh.

verses.textZh: 法老的臣仆对法老说："这人成为我们的网罗要到几时呢？让这些人离开吧，使他们可以事奉耶和华他们的神；埃及已经毁灭了，你还不知道吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老的臣仆对法老说："这人成为我们的网罗要到几时呢？让这些人离开吧，使他们可以事奉耶和华他们的神；埃及已经毁灭了，你还不知道吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的臣仆对法老说：「这人为我们的网罗要到几时呢？容这些人去事奉耶和华－他们的神吧！埃及已经败坏了，你还不知道吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh’s officials said to him, "How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the people go, so that they may worship the Lord their God. Do you not yet realize that Egypt is ruined?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh’s servants said to him, "How long shall this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve the Lord their God. Do you not yet understand that Egypt is ruined?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh’s servants said to him, "How long shall this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve the Lord their God. Do you not yet know that Egypt is destroyed?"
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh’s officials now came to Pharaoh and appealed to him. "How long will you let this man hold us hostage? Let the men go to worship the Lord their God! Don’t you realize that Egypt lies in ruins?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh’s servants said to him, "How long shall this man be a snare to us? Let the people go, so that they may serve the Lord their God. Do you not yet realize that Egypt is destroyed?"
verses.textEn: Pharaoh’s officials said to him, "How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the people go, so that they may worship the Lord their God. Do you not yet realize that Egypt is ruined?"

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西和亚伦被召回来到法老那里。法老对他们说："你们去事奉耶和华你们的神吧，但那些要去的是谁呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西和亚伦被召回来到法老那里。法老对他们说："你们去事奉耶和华你们的神吧，但那些要去的是谁呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西、亚伦被召回来见法老；法老对他们说：「你们去事奉耶和华－你们的神；但那要去的是谁呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. "Go, worship the Lord your God," he said. "But tell me who will be going."
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. And he said to them, "Go, serve the Lord your God. But which ones are to go?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, "Go, serve the Lord your God. Who are the ones that are going?"
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. "All right," he told them, "go and worship the Lord your God. But who exactly will be going with you?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh, and he said to them, "Go, serve the Lord your God! Who specifically are the ones who are going?"
verses.textEn: Then Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. "Go, worship the Lord your God," he said. "But tell me who will be going."

verses.textZh: 摩西回答："我们要和我们年少的与年老的同去，要和我们的儿女同去，也要和我们的羊群与牛群同去，因为我们必须向耶和华守节。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答："我们要和我们年少的与年老的同去，要和我们的儿女同去，也要和我们的羊群与牛群同去，因为我们必须向耶和华守节。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「我们要和我们老的少的、儿子女儿同去，且把羊群牛群一同带去，因为我们务要向耶和华守节。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses answered, "We will go with our young and our old, with our sons and our daughters, and with our flocks and herds, because we are to celebrate a festival to the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said, "We will go with our young and our old. We will go with our sons and daughters and with our flocks and herds, for we must hold a feast to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said, "We will go with our young and our old; with our sons and our daughters, with our flocks and our herds we will go, for we must hold a feast to the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses replied, "We will all go—young and old, our sons and daughters, and our flocks and herds. We must all join together in celebrating a festival to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Moses said, "We shall go with our young and our old; with our sons and our daughters, with our flocks and our herds we shall go, for we must hold a feast to the Lord."
verses.textEn: Moses answered, "We will go with our young and our old, with our sons and our daughters, and with our flocks and herds, because we are to celebrate a festival to the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 法老对他们说："我让你们和你们的孩子离开的时候，愿耶和华与你们同在；你们要谨慎，因为有祸患在你们面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老对他们说："我让你们和你们的孩子离开的时候，愿耶和华与你们同在；你们要谨慎，因为有祸患在你们面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对他们说：「我容你们和你们妇人孩子去的时候，耶和华与你们同在吧！你们要谨慎；因为有祸在你们眼前 ，
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh said, "The Lord be with you—if I let you go, along with your women and children! Clearly you are bent on evil.
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to them, "The Lord be with you, if ever I let you and your little ones go! Look, you have some evil purpose in mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to them, "The Lord had better be with you when I let you and your little ones go! Beware, for evil is ahead of you.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh retorted, "The Lord will certainly need to be with you if I let you take your little ones! I can see through your evil plan.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to them, "So may the Lord be with you, when I let you and your little ones go! Watch out, for evil is on your mind!
verses.textEn: Pharaoh said, "The Lord be with you—if I let you go, along with your women and children! Clearly you are bent on evil.

verses.textZh: 不可以这样，只有你们的男子可以去事奉耶和华，因为这原是你们要求的。"于是把他们从法老面前赶出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可以这样，只有你们的男子可以去事奉耶和华，因为这原是你们要求的。"于是把他们从法老面前赶出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可都去！你们这壮年人去事奉耶和华吧，因为这是你们所求的。」于是把他们从法老面前撵出去。
verses.textEnNiv: No! Have only the men go and worship the Lord , since that’s what you have been asking for." Then Moses and Aaron were driven out of Pharaoh’s presence.
verses.textEnEsv: No! Go, the men among you, and serve the Lord , for that is what you are asking." And they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Not so! Go now, you whoare men, and serve the Lord, for that is what you desired." And they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.
verses.textEnNlt: Never! Only the men may go and worship the Lord , since that is what you requested." And Pharaoh threw them out of the palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Not so! Go now, but only the men among you, and serve the Lord, since that is what you desire." So they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.
verses.textEn: No! Have only the men go and worship the Lord , since that’s what you have been asking for." Then Moses and Aaron were driven out of Pharaoh’s presence.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要向埃及地伸手，使蝗虫上埃及地来，吃尽地上所有的蔬菜，就是受冰雹击打后留下的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要向埃及地伸手，使蝗虫上埃及地来，吃尽地上所有的蔬菜，就是受冰雹击打后留下的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你向埃及地伸杖，使蝗虫到埃及地上来，吃地上一切的菜蔬，就是冰雹所剩的。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over Egypt so that locusts swarm over the land and devour everything growing in the fields, everything left by the hail."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, so that they may come upon the land of Egypt and eat every plant in the land, all that the hail has left."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land—all that the hail has left."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Raise your hand over the land of Egypt to bring on the locusts. Let them cover the land and devour every plant that survived the hailstorm."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Reach out with your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, so that they may come up on the land of Egypt and eat every plant of the land, everything that the hail has left."
verses.textEn: And the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over Egypt so that locusts swarm over the land and devour everything growing in the fields, everything left by the hail."

verses.textZh: 摩西就向埃及地伸杖，整整的一日一夜，耶和华把东风吹在地上；到了早晨，东风把蝗虫吹来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就向埃及地伸杖，整整的一日一夜，耶和华把东风吹在地上；到了早晨，东风把蝗虫吹来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就向埃及地伸杖，那一昼一夜，耶和华使东风刮在埃及地上；到了早晨，东风把蝗虫刮了来。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses stretched out his staff over Egypt, and the Lord made an east wind blow across the land all that day and all that night. By morning the wind had brought the locusts;
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses stretched out his staff over the land of Egypt, and the Lord brought an east wind upon the land all that day and all that night. When it was morning, the east wind had brought the locusts.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and the Lord brought an east wind on the land all that day and all that night. When it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses raised his staff over Egypt, and the Lord caused an east wind to blow over the land all that day and through the night. When morning arrived, the east wind had brought the locusts.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses reached out with his staff over the land of Egypt, and the Lord directed an east wind on the land all that day and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
verses.textEn: So Moses stretched out his staff over Egypt, and the Lord made an east wind blow across the land all that day and all that night. By morning the wind had brought the locusts;

verses.textZh: 蝗虫上到埃及全地来，停留在埃及全境。牠们非常众多，以前没有像这样多的蝗虫，以后也没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蝗虫上到埃及全地来，停留在埃及全境。牠们非常众多，以前没有像这样多的蝗虫，以后也没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 蝗虫上来，落在埃及的四境，甚是厉害；以前没有这样的，以后也必没有。
verses.textEnNiv: they invaded all Egypt and settled down in every area of the country in great numbers. Never before had there been such a plague of locusts, nor will there ever be again.
verses.textEnEsv: The locusts came up over all the land of Egypt and settled on the whole country of Egypt, such a dense swarm of locusts as had never been before, nor ever will be again.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt and rested on all the territory of Egypt. Theywere very severe; previously there had been no such locusts as they, nor shall there be such after them.
verses.textEnNlt: And the locusts swarmed over the whole land of Egypt, settling in dense swarms from one end of the country to the other. It was the worst locust plague in Egyptian history, and there has never been another one like it.
verses.textEnNasb: The locusts came up over all the land of Egypt and settled in all the territory of Egypt; they were very numerous. There had never been so many locusts, nor would there be so many again.
verses.textEn: they invaded all Egypt and settled down in every area of the country in great numbers. Never before had there been such a plague of locusts, nor will there ever be again.

verses.textZh: 蝗虫遮盖了整个地面，以致大地都变黑了。牠们吃尽了地上一切蔬菜，和树上所有的果子，就是受冰雹击打后留下来的。这样，在埃及全地，无论是树木，或田间的蔬菜，连一点青的也没有留下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蝗虫遮盖了整个地面，以致大地都变黑了。牠们吃尽了地上一切蔬菜，和树上所有的果子，就是受冰雹击打后留下来的。这样，在埃及全地，无论是树木，或田间的蔬菜，连一点青的也没有留下。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这蝗虫遮满地面，甚至地都黑暗了，又吃地上一切的菜蔬和冰雹所剩树上的果子。埃及遍地，无论是树木，是田间的菜蔬，连一点青的也没有留下。
verses.textEnNiv: They covered all the ground until it was black. They devoured all that was left after the hail—everything growing in the fields and the fruit on the trees. Nothing green remained on tree or plant in all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: They covered the face of the whole land, so that the land was darkened, and they ate all the plants in the land and all the fruit of the trees that the hail had left. Not a green thing remained, neither tree nor plant of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they ate every herb of the land and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. So there remained nothing green on the trees or on the plants of the field throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: For the locusts covered the whole country and darkened the land. They devoured every plant in the fields and all the fruit on the trees that had survived the hailstorm. Not a single leaf was left on the trees and plants throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: For they covered the surface of the whole land, so that the land was darkened; and they ate every plant of the land and all the fruit of the trees that the hail had left. Therefore nothing green was left on tree or plant of the field throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: They covered all the ground until it was black. They devoured all that was left after the hail—everything growing in the fields and the fruit on the trees. Nothing green remained on tree or plant in all the land of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 于是，法老急忙把摩西和亚伦召了来，说："我得罪了耶和华你们的神，也得罪了你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，法老急忙把摩西和亚伦召了来，说："我得罪了耶和华你们的神，也得罪了你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是法老急忙召了摩西、亚伦来，说：「我得罪耶和华－你们的神，又得罪了你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh quickly summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh hastily called Moses and Aaron and said, "I have sinned against the Lord your God, and against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and said, "I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh quickly summoned Moses and Aaron. "I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you," he confessed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh hurriedly called for Moses and Aaron, and he said, "I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh quickly summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you.

verses.textZh: 现在求你只这一次赦免我的罪，也请你们求告耶和华你们的神，使这一次的死亡离开我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求你只这一次赦免我的罪，也请你们求告耶和华你们的神，使这一次的死亡离开我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在求你，只这一次，饶恕我的罪，求耶和华－你们的神使我脱离这一次的死亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now forgive my sin once more and pray to the Lord your God to take this deadly plague away from me."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, forgive my sin, please, only this once, and plead with the Lord your God only to remove this death from me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, please forgive my sin only this once, and entreat the Lord your God, that He may take away from me this death only."
verses.textEnNlt: "Forgive my sin, just this once, and plead with the Lord your God to take away this death from me."
verses.textEnNasb: So now, please forgive my sin only this once, and plead with the Lord your God, that He would only remove this death from me."
verses.textEn: Now forgive my sin once more and pray to the Lord your God to take this deadly plague away from me."

verses.textZh: 摩西就离开法老出来，祈求耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就离开法老出来，祈求耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就离开法老去求耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses then left Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So he went out from Pharaoh and pleaded with the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went out from Pharaoh and entreated the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses left Pharaoh’s court and pleaded with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then he left Pharaoh and pleaded with the Lord.
verses.textEn: Moses then left Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华转了非常强大的西风，把蝗虫吹起来了，投进红海里；在埃及全境，连一只蝗虫也没留下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华转了非常强大的西风，把蝗虫吹起来了，投进红海里；在埃及全境，连一只蝗虫也没留下。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华转了极大的西风，把蝗虫刮起，吹入红海；在埃及的四境连一个也没有留下。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord changed the wind to a very strong west wind, which caught up the locusts and carried them into the Red Sea. Not a locust was left anywhere in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord turned the wind into a very strong west wind, which lifted the locusts and drove them into the Red Sea. Not a single locust was left in all the country of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord turned a very strong west wind, which took the locusts away and blew them into the Red Sea. There remained not one locust in all the territory of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord responded by shifting the wind, and the strong west wind blew the locusts into the Red Sea. Not a single locust remained in all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord shifted the wind to a very strong west wind, which picked up the locusts and drove them into the Red Sea; not one locust was left in all the territory of Egypt.
verses.textEn: And the Lord changed the wind to a very strong west wind, which caught up the locusts and carried them into the Red Sea. Not a locust was left anywhere in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 但是耶和华使法老的心刚硬，以致法老不肯让以色列人离开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是耶和华使法老的心刚硬，以致法老不肯让以色列人离开。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华使法老的心刚硬，不容以色列人去。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let the Israelites go.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not let the people of Israel go.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not let the children of Israel go.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart again, so he refused to let the people go.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not let the sons of Israel go.
verses.textEn: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let the Israelites go.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要向天举手，使黑暗临到埃及地，这黑暗是可以触摸的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要向天举手，使黑暗临到埃及地，这黑暗是可以触摸的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你向天伸杖，使埃及地黑暗；这黑暗似乎摸得着。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward the sky so that darkness spreads over Egypt—darkness that can be felt."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, a darkness to be felt."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, darkness which may even be felt."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Lift your hand toward heaven, and the land of Egypt will be covered with a darkness so thick you can feel it."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Reach out with your hand toward the sky, so that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even a darkness which may be felt."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward the sky so that darkness spreads over Egypt—darkness that can be felt."

verses.textZh: 摩西向天伸手，幽暗就临到埃及全地三天之久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西向天伸手，幽暗就临到埃及全地三天之久。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西向天伸杖，埃及遍地就乌黑了三天。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and total darkness covered all Egypt for three days.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses stretched out his hand toward heaven, and there was pitch darkness in all the land of Egypt three days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses stretched out his hand toward heaven, and there was thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses lifted his hand to the sky, and a deep darkness covered the entire land of Egypt for three days.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses reached out with his hand toward the sky, and there was thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.
verses.textEn: So Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and total darkness covered all Egypt for three days.

verses.textZh: 三天之内，人彼此不能看见，谁也不能起来离开自己的地方；但是在所有以色列人居住的地方都有亮光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 三天之内，人彼此不能看见，谁也不能起来离开自己的地方；但是在所有以色列人居住的地方都有亮光。
verses.textZhCuv: 三天之久，人不能相见，谁也不敢起来离开本处；惟有以色列人家中都有亮光。
verses.textEnNiv: No one could see anyone else or move about for three days. Yet all the Israelites had light in the places where they lived.
verses.textEnEsv: They did not see one another, nor did anyone rise from his place for three days, but all the people of Israel had light where they lived.
verses.textEnNkjv: They did not see one another; nor did anyone rise from his place for three days. But all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
verses.textEnNlt: During all that time the people could not see each other, and no one moved. But there was light as usual where the people of Israel lived.
verses.textEnNasb: They did not see one another, nor did anyone rise from his place for three days, but all the sons of Israel had light in their dwellings.
verses.textEn: No one could see anyone else or move about for three days. Yet all the Israelites had light in the places where they lived.

verses.textZh: 法老就把摩西召了来，说："你们去事奉耶和华吧，你们的孩子也可以与你们同去；只是要把你们的羊群和牛群留下来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老就把摩西召了来，说："你们去事奉耶和华吧，你们的孩子也可以与你们同去；只是要把你们的羊群和牛群留下来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老就召摩西来，说：「你们去事奉耶和华；只是你们的羊群牛群要留下；你们的妇人孩子可以和你们同去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and said, "Go, worship the Lord . Even your women and children may go with you; only leave your flocks and herds behind."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh called Moses and said, "Go, serve the Lord ; your little ones also may go with you; only let your flocks and your herds remain behind."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh called to Moses and said, "Go, serve the Lord; only let your flocks and your herds be kept back. Let your little ones also go with you."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, Pharaoh called for Moses. "Go and worship the Lord ," he said. "But leave your flocks and herds here. You may even take your little ones with you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh called for Moses, and said, "Go, serve the Lord; only let your flocks and your herds be left behind. Even your little ones may go with you."
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and said, "Go, worship the Lord . Even your women and children may go with you; only leave your flocks and herds behind."

verses.textZh: 摩西回答："你也要把献祭用的祭物和燔祭交给我们，使我们可以献给耶和华我们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答："你也要把献祭用的祭物和燔祭交给我们，使我们可以献给耶和华我们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「你总要把祭物和燔祭牲交给我们，使我们可以祭祀耶和华－我们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses said, "You must allow us to have sacrifices and burnt offerings to present to the Lord our God.
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said, "You must also let us have sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Moses said, "You must also give us sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNlt: "No," Moses said, "you must provide us with animals for sacrifices and burnt offerings to the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses said, "You must also let us have sacrifices and burnt offerings, so that we may sacrifice them to the Lord our God.
verses.textEn: But Moses said, "You must allow us to have sacrifices and burnt offerings to present to the Lord our God.

verses.textZh: 我们的牲畜也要与我们同去，连一只也不留下；因为我们要从牠们当中取出一些来事奉耶和华我们的神；我们没有到达之前，还不知道要用甚么事奉耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的牲畜也要与我们同去，连一只也不留下；因为我们要从牠们当中取出一些来事奉耶和华我们的神；我们没有到达之前，还不知道要用甚么事奉耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的牲畜也要带去，连一蹄也不留下；因为我们要从其中取出来，事奉耶和华－我们的神。我们未到那里，还不知道用什么事奉耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Our livestock too must go with us; not a hoof is to be left behind. We have to use some of them in worshiping the Lord our God, and until we get there we will not know what we are to use to worship the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Our livestock also must go with us; not a hoof shall be left behind, for we must take of them to serve the Lord our God, and we do not know with what we must serve the Lord until we arrive there."
verses.textEnNkjv: Our livestock also shall go with us; not a hoof shall be left behind. For we must take some of them to serve the Lord our God, and even we do not know with what we must serve the Lord until we arrive there."
verses.textEnNlt: All our livestock must go with us, too; not a hoof can be left behind. We must choose our sacrifices for the Lord our God from among these animals. And we won’t know how we are to worship the Lord until we get there."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, our livestock too shall go with us; not a hoof shall be left behind, for we shall take some of them to serve the Lord our God. And until we arrive there, we ourselves do not know with what we shall serve the Lord."
verses.textEn: Our livestock too must go with us; not a hoof is to be left behind. We have to use some of them in worshiping the Lord our God, and until we get there we will not know what we are to use to worship the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 但耶和华使法老心里刚硬，因此他不愿意让他们离开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华使法老心里刚硬，因此他不愿意让他们离开。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华使法老的心刚硬，不肯容他们去。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he was not willing to let them go.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart once more, and he would not let them go.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he was not willing to let them go.
verses.textEn: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he was not willing to let them go.

verses.textZh: 法老对摩西说："你离开我去吧，你要小心，不要再见我的面；因为你再见我面的时候，你必定死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老对摩西说："你离开我去吧，你要小心，不要再见我的面；因为你再见我面的时候，你必定死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对摩西说：「你离开我去吧，你要小心，不要再见我的面！因为你见我面的那日你就必死！」
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh said to Moses, "Get out of my sight! Make sure you do not appear before me again! The day you see my face you will die."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh said to him, "Get away from me; take care never to see my face again, for on the day you see my face you shall die."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh said to him, "Get away from me! Take heed to yourself and see my face no more! For in the day you see my face you shall die!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Get out of here!" Pharaoh shouted at Moses. "I’m warning you. Never come back to see me again! The day you see my face, you will die!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh said to him, "Get away from me! Be careful, do not see my face again, for on the day you see my face, you shall die!"
verses.textEn: Pharaoh said to Moses, "Get out of my sight! Make sure you do not appear before me again! The day you see my face you will die."

verses.textZh: 摩西回答："你说对了，我不再见你的面了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答："你说对了，我不再见你的面了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「你说得好！我必不再见你的面了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Just as you say," Moses replied. "I will never appear before you again."
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said, "As you say! I will not see your face again."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses said, "You have spoken well. I will never see your face again."
verses.textEnNlt: "Very well," Moses replied. "I will never see your face again."
verses.textEnNasb: Moses said, "You have spoken correctly; I shall never see your face again!"
verses.textEn: "Just as you say," Moses replied. "I will never appear before you again."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："我再使一种灾祸临到法老和埃及，然后法老他必让你们离开这里。他让你们离开的时候，必全部赶逐你们离开这地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："我再使一种灾祸临到法老和埃及，然后法老他必让你们离开这里。他让你们离开的时候，必全部赶逐你们离开这地。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「我再使一样的灾殃临到法老和埃及，然后他必容你们离开这地。他容你们去的时候，总要催逼你们都从这地出去。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Lord had said to Moses, "I will bring one more plague on Pharaoh and on Egypt. After that, he will let you go from here, and when he does, he will drive you out completely.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses, "Yet one plague more I will bring upon Pharaoh and upon Egypt. Afterward he will let you go from here. When he lets you go, he will drive you away completely.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "I will bring one more plague on Pharaoh and on Egypt. Afterward he will let you go from here. When he lets you go, he will surely drive you out of here altogether.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "I will strike Pharaoh and the land of Egypt with one more blow. After that, Pharaoh will let you leave this country. In fact, he will be so eager to get rid of you that he will force you all to leave.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Moses, "One more plague I will bring on Pharaoh and on Egypt; after that he will let you go from here. When he lets you go, he will assuredly drive you out from here completely.
verses.textEn: Now the Lord had said to Moses, "I will bring one more plague on Pharaoh and on Egypt. After that, he will let you go from here, and when he does, he will drive you out completely.

verses.textZh: 现在你要告诉人民，叫他们男女各人向自己的邻舍索取银器金器。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要告诉人民，叫他们男女各人向自己的邻舍索取银器金器。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要传于百姓的耳中，叫他们男女各人向邻舍要金器银器。」
verses.textEnNiv: Tell the people that men and women alike are to ask their neighbors for articles of silver and gold."
verses.textEnEsv: Speak now in the hearing of the people, that they ask, every man of his neighbor and every woman of her neighbor, for silver and gold jewelry."
verses.textEnNkjv: Speak now in the hearing of the people, and let every man ask from his neighbor and every woman from her neighbor, articles of silver and articles of gold."
verses.textEnNlt: Tell all the Israelite men and women to ask their Egyptian neighbors for articles of silver and gold."
verses.textEnNasb: Speak now so that the people hear, that each man is to ask of his neighbor, and each woman of her neighbor, articles of silver and articles of gold."
verses.textEn: Tell the people that men and women alike are to ask their neighbors for articles of silver and gold."

verses.textZh: 耶和华使人民在埃及人眼前蒙恩，同时摩西在埃及地，在法老臣仆的眼前和人民的眼前都成了伟大的人物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使人民在埃及人眼前蒙恩，同时摩西在埃及地，在法老臣仆的眼前和人民的眼前都成了伟大的人物。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，并且摩西在埃及地、法老臣仆，和百姓的眼中看为极大。
verses.textEnNiv: (The Lord made the Egyptians favorably disposed toward the people, and Moses himself was highly regarded in Egypt by Pharaoh’s officials and by the people.)
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants and in the sight of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants and in the sight of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: (Now the Lord had caused the Egyptians to look favorably on the people of Israel. And Moses was considered a very great man in the land of Egypt, respected by Pharaoh’s officials and the Egyptian people alike.)
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Furthermore, the man Moses himself was greatly esteemed in the land of Egypt, both in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants and in the sight of the people.
verses.textEn: (The Lord made the Egyptians favorably disposed toward the people, and Moses himself was highly regarded in Egypt by Pharaoh’s officials and by the people.)

verses.textZh: 摩西说："耶和华这样说：‘大约半夜的时候，我要出去巡行埃及地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："耶和华这样说：‘大约半夜的时候，我要出去巡行埃及地。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「耶和华这样说：『约到半夜，我必出去巡行埃及遍地。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘About midnight I will go throughout Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses said, "Thus says the Lord : ‘About midnight I will go out in the midst of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said, "Thus says the Lord: ‘About midnight I will go out into the midst of Egypt;
verses.textEnNlt: Moses had announced to Pharaoh, "This is what the Lord says: At midnight tonight I will pass through the heart of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘About midnight I am going out into the midst of Egypt,
verses.textEn: So Moses said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘About midnight I will go throughout Egypt.

verses.textZh: 在埃及地所有头生的都必死亡，就是从坐王位的法老的长子，直到推磨的婢女的长子，以及一切头生的牲畜都必死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在埃及地所有头生的都必死亡，就是从坐王位的法老的长子，直到推磨的婢女的长子，以及一切头生的牲畜都必死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在埃及地，从坐宝座的法老直到磨子后的婢女所有的长子，以及一切头生的牲畜，都必死。
verses.textEnNiv: Every firstborn son in Egypt will die, from the firstborn son of Pharaoh, who sits on the throne, to the firstborn son of the female slave, who is at her hand mill, and all the firstborn of the cattle as well.
verses.textEnEsv: and every firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the slave girl who is behind the handmill, and all the firstborn of the cattle.
verses.textEnNkjv: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the handmill, and all the firstborn of the animals.
verses.textEnNlt: All the firstborn sons will die in every family in Egypt, from the oldest son of Pharaoh, who sits on his throne, to the oldest son of his lowliest servant girl who grinds the flour. Even the firstborn of all the livestock will die.
verses.textEnNasb: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of the Pharaoh who sits on his throne, to the firstborn of the slave girl who is behind the millstones; all the firstborn of the cattle as well.
verses.textEn: Every firstborn son in Egypt will die, from the firstborn son of Pharaoh, who sits on the throne, to the firstborn son of the female slave, who is at her hand mill, and all the firstborn of the cattle as well.

verses.textZh: 在埃及全地必有大哀号；这样的哀号从前未曾有过，以后也必再没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在埃及全地必有大哀号；这样的哀号从前未曾有过，以后也必再没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及遍地必有大哀号；从前没有这样的，后来也必没有。
verses.textEnNiv: There will be loud wailing throughout Egypt—worse than there has ever been or ever will be again.
verses.textEnEsv: There shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has never been, nor ever will be again.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as was not like it before, nor shall be like it again.
verses.textEnNlt: Then a loud wail will rise throughout the land of Egypt, a wail like no one has heard before or will ever hear again.
verses.textEnNasb: So there shall be a great cry in all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been before and such as shall never be again.
verses.textEn: There will be loud wailing throughout Egypt—worse than there has ever been or ever will be again.

verses.textZh: 但是对于所有的以色列人，无论是人或是牲畜，连狗也不敢向他们叫吠；为要使你们知道耶和华是把埃及人和以色列人分别出来的’。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是对于所有的以色列人，无论是人或是牲畜，连狗也不敢向他们叫吠；为要使你们知道耶和华是把埃及人和以色列人分别出来的’。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于以色列中，无论是人是牲畜，连狗也不敢向他们摇舌，好叫你们知道耶和华是将埃及人和以色列人分别出来。』
verses.textEnNiv: But among the Israelites not a dog will bark at any person or animal.’ Then you will know that the Lord makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But not a dog shall growl against any of the people of Israel, either man or beast, that you may know that the Lord makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But against none of the children of Israel shall a dog move its tongue, against man or beast, that you may know that the Lord does make a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.’
verses.textEnNlt: But among the Israelites it will be so peaceful that not even a dog will bark. Then you will know that the Lord makes a distinction between the Egyptians and the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: But not even a dog will threaten any of the sons of Israel, nor anything from person to animal, so that you may learn how the Lord distinguishes between Egypt and Israel.’
verses.textEn: But among the Israelites not a dog will bark at any person or animal.’ Then you will know that the Lord makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.

verses.textZh: 你所有的臣仆都必下到我这里来，向我下跪说：‘你和所有跟从你的人民都出去吧’，然后我才出去。"于是摩西气忿忿地离开法老出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所有的臣仆都必下到我这里来，向我下跪说：‘你和所有跟从你的人民都出去吧’，然后我才出去。"于是摩西气忿忿地离开法老出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这一切臣仆都要俯伏来见我，说：『求你和跟从你的百姓都出去』，然后我要出去。」于是，摩西气忿忿地离开法老，出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: All these officials of yours will come to me, bowing down before me and saying, ‘Go, you and all the people who follow you!’ After that I will leave." Then Moses, hot with anger, left Pharaoh.
verses.textEnEsv: And all these your servants shall come down to me and bow down to me, saying, ‘Get out, you and all the people who follow you.’ And after that I will go out." And he went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all these your servants shall come down to me and bow down to me, saying, ‘Get out, and all the people who follow you!’ After that I will go out." Then he went out from Pharaoh in great anger.
verses.textEnNlt: All the officials of Egypt will run to me and fall to the ground before me. ‘Please leave!’ they will beg. ‘Hurry! And take all your followers with you.’ Only then will I go!" Then, burning with anger, Moses left Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: And all these servants of yours will come down to me and bow themselves before me, saying, ‘Go out, you and all the people who follow you,’ and after that I will go out." And he left Pharaoh in the heat of anger.
verses.textEn: All these officials of yours will come to me, bowing down before me and saying, ‘Go, you and all the people who follow you!’ After that I will leave." Then Moses, hot with anger, left Pharaoh.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："法老必不听你们的话，好使我的神迹在埃及地加增起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："法老必不听你们的话，好使我的神迹在埃及地加增起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「法老必不听你 们，使我的奇事在埃及地多起来。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord had said to Moses, "Pharaoh will refuse to listen to you—so that my wonders may be multiplied in Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pharaoh will not listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord said to Moses, "Pharaoh will not heed you, so that My wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Lord had told Moses earlier, "Pharaoh will not listen to you, but then I will do even more mighty miracles in the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pharaoh will not listen to you, so that My wonders will be multiplied in the land of Egypt."
verses.textEn: The Lord had said to Moses, "Pharaoh will refuse to listen to you—so that my wonders may be multiplied in Egypt."

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦在法老面前行了这一切神迹；但耶和华使法老的心刚硬，所以他不肯让以色列人离开他的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦在法老面前行了这一切神迹；但耶和华使法老的心刚硬，所以他不肯让以色列人离开他的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦在法老面前行了这一切奇事；耶和华使法老的心刚硬，不容以色列人出离他的地。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and Aaron performed all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let the Israelites go out of his country.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, and the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not let the people of Israel go out of his land.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh; and the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses and Aaron performed these miracles in Pharaoh’s presence, but the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let the Israelites leave the country.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses and Aaron performed all these wonders before Pharaoh; yet the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he did not let the sons of Israel go out of his land.
verses.textEn: Moses and Aaron performed all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the Lord hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let the Israelites go out of his country.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在埃及地告诉摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在埃及地告诉摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在埃及地晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron in Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: While the Israelites were still in the land of Egypt, the Lord gave the following instructions to Moses and Aaron:
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron in Egypt,

verses.textZh: "你们要以本月为正月，为一年的第一个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要以本月为正月，为一年的第一个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要以本月为正月，为一年之首。
verses.textEnNiv: "This month is to be for you the first month, the first month of your year.
verses.textEnEsv: "This month shall be for you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This month shallbe your beginning of months; it shallbe the first month of the year to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "From now on, this month will be the first month of the year for you.
verses.textEnNasb: "This month shall be the beginning of months for you; it is to be the first month of the year for you.
verses.textEn: "This month is to be for you the first month, the first month of your year.

verses.textZh: 你们要告诉以色列全体会众说：本月初十，他们各人要按着父家取羊羔，一家一只。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要告诉以色列全体会众说：本月初十，他们各人要按着父家取羊羔，一家一只。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们吩咐以色列全会众说：本月初十日，各人要按着父家取羊羔，一家一只。
verses.textEnNiv: Tell the whole community of Israel that on the tenth day of this month each man is to take a lamb for his family, one for each household.
verses.textEnEsv: Tell all the congregation of Israel that on the tenth day of this month every man shall take a lamb according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household.
verses.textEnNkjv: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying: ‘On the tenth of this month every man shall take for himself a lamb, according to the house of his father, a lamb for a household.
verses.textEnNlt: Announce to the whole community of Israel that on the tenth day of this month each family must choose a lamb or a young goat for a sacrifice, one animal for each household.
verses.textEnNasb: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth of this month they are, each one, to take a lamb for themselves, according to the fathers’ households, a lamb for each household.
verses.textEn: Tell the whole community of Israel that on the tenth day of this month each man is to take a lamb for his family, one for each household.

verses.textZh: 如果一家的人太少，吃不了一只羊羔，家长就要和靠近他家的邻居按着人数共取一只。你们预备羊羔的时候，要按着各人的食量计算。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果一家的人太少，吃不了一只羊羔，家长就要和靠近他家的邻居按着人数共取一只。你们预备羊羔的时候，要按着各人的食量计算。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是一家的人太少，吃不了一只羊羔，本人就要和他隔壁的邻舍共取一只。你们预备羊羔，要按着人数和饭量计算。
verses.textEnNiv: If any household is too small for a whole lamb, they must share one with their nearest neighbor, having taken into account the number of people there are. You are to determine the amount of lamb needed in accordance with what each person will eat.
verses.textEnEsv: And if the household is too small for a lamb, then he and his nearest neighbor shall take according to the number of persons; according to what each can eat you shall make your count for the lamb.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if the household is too small for the lamb, let him and his neighbor next to his house take it according to the number of the persons; according to each man’s need you shall make your count for the lamb.
verses.textEnNlt: If a family is too small to eat a whole animal, let them share with another family in the neighborhood. Divide the animal according to the size of each family and how much they can eat.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if the household is too small for a lamb, then he and his neighbor nearest to his house are to take one according to the number of persons in them; in proportion to what each one should eat, you are to divide the lamb.
verses.textEn: If any household is too small for a whole lamb, they must share one with their nearest neighbor, having taken into account the number of people there are. You are to determine the amount of lamb needed in accordance with what each person will eat.

verses.textZh: 你们的羊羔要毫无残疾，一岁以内的公羊；你们可以从绵羊或山羊里取。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的羊羔要毫无残疾，一岁以内的公羊；你们可以从绵羊或山羊里取。
verses.textZhCuv: 要无残疾、一岁的公羊羔，你们或从绵羊里取，或从山羊里取，都可以。
verses.textEnNiv: The animals you choose must be year-old males without defect, and you may take them from the sheep or the goats.
verses.textEnEsv: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male a year old. You may take it from the sheep or from the goats,
verses.textEnNkjv: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year. You may take it from the sheep or from the goats.
verses.textEnNlt: The animal you select must be a one-year-old male, either a sheep or a goat, with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: Your lamb shall be an unblemished male a year old; you may take it from the sheep or from the goats.
verses.textEn: The animals you choose must be year-old males without defect, and you may take them from the sheep or the goats.

verses.textZh: 你们要把羊羔留到本月十四日，在黄昏的时候 ，以色列全体会众要把羊羔宰杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把羊羔留到本月十四日，在黄昏的时候 ，以色列全体会众要把羊羔宰杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 要留到本月十四日，在黄昏的时候，以色列全会众把羊羔宰了。
verses.textEnNiv: Take care of them until the fourteenth day of the month, when all the members of the community of Israel must slaughter them at twilight.
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall keep it until the fourteenth day of this month, when the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill their lambs at twilight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now you shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month. Then the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at twilight.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take special care of this chosen animal until the evening of the fourteenth day of this first month. Then the whole assembly of the community of Israel must slaughter their lamb or young goat at twilight.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month, then the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel is to slaughter it at twilight.
verses.textEn: Take care of them until the fourteenth day of the month, when all the members of the community of Israel must slaughter them at twilight.

verses.textZh: 他们要取点血，涂在吃羊羔的房屋两边的门柱和门楣上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要取点血，涂在吃羊羔的房屋两边的门柱和门楣上。
verses.textZhCuv: 各家要取点血，涂在吃羊羔的房屋左右的门框上和门楣上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then they shall take some of the blood and put it on the two doorposts and the lintel of the houses in which they eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall take some of the blood and put it on the two doorposts and on the lintel of the houses where they eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: They are to take some of the blood and smear it on the sides and top of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the animal.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, they shall take some of the blood and put it on the two doorposts and on the lintel of the houses in which they eat it.
verses.textEn: Then they are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs.

verses.textZh: 当那一夜，你们要吃羊羔的肉，肉要用火烤了，和无酵饼与苦菜一同吃，
verses.textZhCnvs: 当那一夜，你们要吃羊羔的肉，肉要用火烤了，和无酵饼与苦菜一同吃，
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜要吃羊羔的肉；用火烤了，与无酵饼和苦菜同吃。
verses.textEnNiv: That same night they are to eat the meat roasted over the fire, along with bitter herbs, and bread made without yeast.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall eat the flesh that night, roasted on the fire; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they shall eat the flesh on that night; roasted in fire, with unleavened bread and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: That same night they must roast the meat over a fire and eat it along with bitter salad greens and bread made without yeast.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall eat the flesh that same night, roasted with fire, and they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
