verses.textEn: That same night they are to eat the meat roasted over the fire, along with bitter herbs, and bread made without yeast.

verses.textZh: 不可吃生的，也不可用水煮；只可吃用火烤的。头、腿和内脏都一起吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可吃生的，也不可用水煮；只可吃用火烤的。头、腿和内脏都一起吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可吃生的，断不可吃水煮的，要带着头、腿、五脏，用火烤了吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not eat the meat raw or boiled in water, but roast it over a fire—with the head, legs and internal organs.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not eat any of it raw or boiled in water, but roasted, its head with its legs and its inner parts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted in fire—its head with its legs and its entrails.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not eat any of the meat raw or boiled in water. The whole animal—including the head, legs, and internal organs—must be roasted over a fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not eat any of it raw or boiled at all with water, but rather roasted with fire, both its head and its legs along with its entrails.
verses.textEn: Do not eat the meat raw or boiled in water, but roast it over a fire—with the head, legs and internal organs.

verses.textZh: 你们一点也不可留到早晨；如果有一点留到早晨，就要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们一点也不可留到早晨；如果有一点留到早晨，就要用火烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可剩下一点留到早晨；若留到早晨，要用火烧了。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not leave any of it till morning; if some is left till morning, you must burn it.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall let none of it remain until the morning; anything that remains until the morning you shall burn.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall let none of it remain until morning, and what remains of it until morning you shall burn with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not leave any of it until the next morning. Burn whatever is not eaten before morning.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not leave any of it over until morning, but whatever is left of it until morning, you shall completely burn with fire.
verses.textEn: Do not leave any of it till morning; if some is left till morning, you must burn it.

verses.textZh: 你们要这样吃羊羔：腰间束上带，脚上穿著鞋，手中拿着杖，快速地吃；这是耶和华的逾越节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要这样吃羊羔：腰间束上带，脚上穿著鞋，手中拿着杖，快速地吃；这是耶和华的逾越节。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们吃羊羔当腰间束带，脚上穿鞋，手中拿杖，赶紧地吃；这是耶和华的逾越节。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how you are to eat it: with your cloak tucked into your belt, your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand. Eat it in haste; it is the Lord ’s Passover.
verses.textEnEsv: In this manner you shall eat it: with your belt fastened, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand. And you shall eat it in haste. It is the Lord ’s Passover.
verses.textEnNkjv: And thus you shall eat it: with a belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand. So you shall eat it in haste. It is the Lord’s Passover.
verses.textEnNlt: "These are your instructions for eating this meal: Be fully dressed, wear your sandals, and carry your walking stick in your hand. Eat the meal with urgency, for this is the Lord ’s Passover.
verses.textEnNasb: Now you shall eat it in this way: with your garment belted around your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in a hurry—it is the Lord’s Passover.
verses.textEn: This is how you are to eat it: with your cloak tucked into your belt, your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand. Eat it in haste; it is the Lord ’s Passover.

verses.textZh: 因为在那一夜我要走遍埃及地，把埃及地所有头生的，无论是人或是牲畜，都要杀掉；我也要审判埃及的一切神祇，我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在那一夜我要走遍埃及地，把埃及地所有头生的，无论是人或是牲畜，都要杀掉；我也要审判埃及的一切神祇，我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那夜我要巡行埃及地，把埃及地一切头生的，无论是人是牲畜，都击杀了，又要败坏埃及一切的神。我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "On that same night I will pass through Egypt and strike down every firstborn of both people and animals, and I will bring judgment on all the gods of Egypt. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For I will pass through the land of Egypt that night, and I will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and on all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For I will pass through the land of Egypt on that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: On that night I will pass through the land of Egypt and strike down every firstborn son and firstborn male animal in the land of Egypt. I will execute judgment against all the gods of Egypt, for I am the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: For I will go through the land of Egypt on that night, and fatally strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the human firstborn to animals; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments—I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: "On that same night I will pass through Egypt and strike down every firstborn of both people and animals, and I will bring judgment on all the gods of Egypt. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 这血要在你们居住的房屋上作你们的记号；我击打埃及地的时候，一看见这血，就越过你们去，灾祸必不临到你们身上毁灭你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这血要在你们居住的房屋上作你们的记号；我击打埃及地的时候，一看见这血，就越过你们去，灾祸必不临到你们身上毁灭你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 这血要在你们所住的房屋上作记号；我一见这血，就越过你们去。我击杀埃及地头生的时候，灾殃必不临到你们身上灭你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: The blood will be a sign for you on the houses where you are, and when I see the blood, I will pass over you. No destructive plague will touch you when I strike Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: The blood shall be a sign for you, on the houses where you are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will befall you to destroy you, when I strike the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the blood shall be a sign for you on the houses where you are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you; and the plague shall not be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: But the blood on your doorposts will serve as a sign, marking the houses where you are staying. When I see the blood, I will pass over you. This plague of death will not touch you when I strike the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: The blood shall be a sign for you on the houses where you live; and when I see the blood I will pass over you, and no plague will come upon you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: The blood will be a sign for you on the houses where you are, and when I see the blood, I will pass over you. No destructive plague will touch you when I strike Egypt.

verses.textZh: 这一日必作你们的记念日；你们要守这日为耶和华的节；你们要世世代代守这节日作永远的定例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一日必作你们的记念日；你们要守这日为耶和华的节；你们要世世代代守这节日作永远的定例。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要记念这日，守为耶和华的节，作为你们世世代代永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is a day you are to commemorate; for the generations to come you shall celebrate it as a festival to the Lord —a lasting ordinance.
verses.textEnEsv: "This day shall be for you a memorial day, and you shall keep it as a feast to the Lord ; throughout your generations, as a statute forever, you shall keep it as a feast.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘So this day shall be to you a memorial; and you shall keep it as a feast to the Lord throughout your generations. You shall keep it as a feast by an everlasting ordinance.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is a day to remember. Each year, from generation to generation, you must celebrate it as a special festival to the Lord . This is a law for all time.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now this day shall be a memorial to you, and you shall celebrate it as a feast to the Lord; throughout your generations you are to celebrate it as a permanent ordinance.
verses.textEn: "This is a day you are to commemorate; for the generations to come you shall celebrate it as a festival to the Lord —a lasting ordinance.

verses.textZh: "你们要吃无酵饼七天；可是第一天就要把酵从你们的家中除去；因为从第一日起直到第七日，凡吃有酵之物的，那人必从以色列中被除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要吃无酵饼七天；可是第一天就要把酵从你们的家中除去；因为从第一日起直到第七日，凡吃有酵之物的，那人必从以色列中被除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要吃无酵饼七日。头一日要把酵从你们各家中除去；因为从头一日起，到第七日为止，凡吃有酵之饼的，必从以色列中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days you are to eat bread made without yeast. On the first day remove the yeast from your houses, for whoever eats anything with yeast in it from the first day through the seventh must be cut off from Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the first day you shall remove leaven out of your houses, for if anyone eats what is leavened, from the first day until the seventh day, that person shall be cut off from Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the first day you shall remove leaven from your houses. For whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that person shall be cut off from Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: For seven days the bread you eat must be made without yeast. On the first day of the festival, remove every trace of yeast from your homes. Anyone who eats bread made with yeast during the seven days of the festival will be cut off from the community of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, but on the first day you shall remove dough with yeast from your houses; for whoever eats anything with yeast from the first day until the seventh day, that person shall be cut off from Israel.
verses.textEn: For seven days you are to eat bread made without yeast. On the first day remove the yeast from your houses, for whoever eats anything with yeast in it from the first day through the seventh must be cut off from Israel.

verses.textZh: 第一日你们要有圣会，第七日你们也要有圣会；这两日之内，除了预备各人所要吃的以外，一切工作都不可作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一日你们要有圣会，第七日你们也要有圣会；这两日之内，除了预备各人所要吃的以外，一切工作都不可作。
verses.textZhCuv: 头一日你们当有圣会，第七日也当有圣会。这两日之内，除了预备各人所要吃的以外，无论何工都不可做。
verses.textEnNiv: On the first day hold a sacred assembly, and another one on the seventh day. Do no work at all on these days, except to prepare food for everyone to eat; that is all you may do.
verses.textEnEsv: On the first day you shall hold a holy assembly, and on the seventh day a holy assembly. No work shall be done on those days. But what everyone needs to eat, that alone may be prepared by you.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the first day thereshallbe a holy convocation, and on the seventh day there shall be a holy convocation for you. No manner of work shall be done on them; but that which everyone must eat—that only may be prepared by you.
verses.textEnNlt: On the first day of the festival and again on the seventh day, all the people must observe an official day for holy assembly. No work of any kind may be done on these days except in the preparation of food.
verses.textEnNasb: And on the first day you shall have a holy assembly, and another holy assembly on the seventh day; no work at all shall be done on them, except for what must be eaten by every person—that alone may be prepared by you.
verses.textEn: On the first day hold a sacred assembly, and another one on the seventh day. Do no work at all on these days, except to prepare food for everyone to eat; that is all you may do.

verses.textZh: 你们要守无酵节，因为就在这一天，我把你们的军队从埃及地领出来；所以你们要世世代代守这一日作为永远的定例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要守无酵节，因为就在这一天，我把你们的军队从埃及地领出来；所以你们要世世代代守这一日作为永远的定例。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要守无酵节，因为我正当这日把你们的军队从埃及地领出来。所以，你们要守这日，作为世世代代永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: "Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because it was on this very day that I brought your divisions out of Egypt. Celebrate this day as a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall observe the Feast of Unleavened Bread, for on this very day I brought your hosts out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day, throughout your generations, as a statute forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall observe theFeastof Unleavened Bread, for on this same day I will have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations as an everlasting ordinance.
verses.textEnNlt: "Celebrate this Festival of Unleavened Bread, for it will remind you that I brought your forces out of the land of Egypt on this very day. This festival will be a permanent law for you; celebrate this day from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread, for on this very day I brought your multitudes out of the land of Egypt; therefore you shall keep this day throughout your generations as a permanent ordinance.
verses.textEn: "Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because it was on this very day that I brought your divisions out of Egypt. Celebrate this day as a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

verses.textZh: 从正月十四日晚上起，直到本月二十一日晚上止，你们要吃无酵饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从正月十四日晚上起，直到本月二十一日晚上止，你们要吃无酵饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 从正月十四日晚上，直到二十一日晚上，你们要吃无酵饼。
verses.textEnNiv: In the first month you are to eat bread made without yeast, from the evening of the fourteenth day until the evening of the twenty-first day.
verses.textEnEsv: In the first month, from the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread until the twenty-first day of the month at evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty-first day of the month at evening.
verses.textEnNlt: The bread you eat must be made without yeast from the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month until the evening of the twenty-first day of that month.
verses.textEnNasb: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty-first day of the month at evening.
verses.textEn: In the first month you are to eat bread made without yeast, from the evening of the fourteenth day until the evening of the twenty-first day.

verses.textZh: 七日之内在你们的家中不可有酵；因为凡吃有酵之物的，无论是外国人或是本地人，那人必从以色列的会众中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 七日之内在你们的家中不可有酵；因为凡吃有酵之物的，无论是外国人或是本地人，那人必从以色列的会众中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你们各家中，七日之内不可有酵；因为凡吃有酵之物的，无论是寄居的，是本地的，必从以色列的会中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days no yeast is to be found in your houses. And anyone, whether foreigner or native-born, who eats anything with yeast in it must be cut off from the community of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For seven days no leaven is to be found in your houses. If anyone eats what is leavened, that person will be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a sojourner or a native of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: For seven days no leaven shall be found in your houses, since whoever eats what is leavened, that same person shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether heis a stranger or a native of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: During those seven days, there must be no trace of yeast in your homes. Anyone who eats anything made with yeast during this week will be cut off from the community of Israel. These regulations apply both to the foreigners living among you and to the native-born Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days there shall be no dough with yeast found in your houses; for whoever eats anything with yeast, that person shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a stranger or a native of the land.
verses.textEn: For seven days no yeast is to be found in your houses. And anyone, whether foreigner or native-born, who eats anything with yeast in it must be cut off from the community of Israel.

verses.textZh: 凡是有酵的，你们都不可吃；在你们一切居住的地方，你们都要吃无酵饼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是有酵的，你们都不可吃；在你们一切居住的地方，你们都要吃无酵饼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有酵的物，你们都不可吃；在你们一切住处要吃无酵饼。」
verses.textEnNiv: Eat nothing made with yeast. Wherever you live, you must eat unleavened bread."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat nothing leavened; in all your dwelling places you shall eat unleavened bread."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat nothing leavened; in all your dwellings you shall eat unleavened bread.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: During those days you must not eat anything made with yeast. Wherever you live, eat only bread made without yeast."
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not eat anything with yeast; in all your dwellings you shall eat unleavened bread.’ "
verses.textEn: Eat nothing made with yeast. Wherever you live, you must eat unleavened bread."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西把以色列的众长老召了来，对他们说："你们要按着家族自己选取羊羔，把这逾越节的羊羔宰杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西把以色列的众长老召了来，对他们说："你们要按着家族自己选取羊羔，把这逾越节的羊羔宰杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，摩西召了以色列的众长老来，对他们说：「你们要按着家口取出羊羔，把这逾越节的羊羔宰了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses summoned all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Go at once and select the animals for your families and slaughter the Passover lamb.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses called all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Go and select lambs for yourselves according to your clans, and kill the Passover lamb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Pick out and take lambs for yourselves according to your families, and kill the Passover lamb.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses called all the elders of Israel together and said to them, "Go, pick out a lamb or young goat for each of your families, and slaughter the Passover animal.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Go and take for yourselves lambs according to your families, and slaughter the Passover lamb.
verses.textEn: Then Moses summoned all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Go at once and select the animals for your families and slaughter the Passover lamb.

verses.textZh: 要拿一把牛膝草，蘸在盆中的血里，然后把盆里的血涂在门楣上和两边的门柱上；你们谁也不可出自己的房门，直到早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要拿一把牛膝草，蘸在盆中的血里，然后把盆里的血涂在门楣上和两边的门柱上；你们谁也不可出自己的房门，直到早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿一把牛膝草，蘸盆里的血，打在门楣上和左右的门框上。你们谁也不可出自己的房门，直到早晨。
verses.textEnNiv: Take a bunch of hyssop, dip it into the blood in the basin and put some of the blood on the top and on both sides of the doorframe. None of you shall go out of the door of your house until morning.
verses.textEnEsv: Take a bunch of hyssop and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and touch the lintel and the two doorposts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take a bunch of hyssop, dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two doorposts with the blood that is in the basin. And none of you shall go out of the door of his house until morning.
verses.textEnNlt: Drain the blood into a basin. Then take a bundle of hyssop branches and dip it into the blood. Brush the hyssop across the top and sides of the doorframes of your houses. And no one may go out through the door until morning.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall take a bunch of hyssop and dip it in the blood which is in the basin, and apply some of the blood that is in the basin to the lintel and the two doorposts; and none of you shall go outside the door of his house until morning.
verses.textEn: Take a bunch of hyssop, dip it into the blood in the basin and put some of the blood on the top and on both sides of the doorframe. None of you shall go out of the door of your house until morning.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华要走遍各处击打埃及人；他一看见门楣和两边的门柱上有血，就越过那门，不让那毁灭者进入你们的房屋来击杀你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华要走遍各处击打埃及人；他一看见门楣和两边的门柱上有血，就越过那门，不让那毁灭者进入你们的房屋来击杀你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华要巡行击杀埃及人，他看见血在门楣上和左右的门框上，就必越过那门，不容灭命的进你们的房屋，击杀你们。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord goes through the land to strike down the Egyptians, he will see the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe and will pass over that doorway, and he will not permit the destroyer to enter your houses and strike you down.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord will pass through to strike the Egyptians, and when he sees the blood on the lintel and on the two doorposts, the Lord will pass over the door and will not allow the destroyer to enter your houses to strike you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when He sees the blood on the lintel and on the two doorposts, the Lord will pass over the door and not allow the destroyer to come into your houses to strike you.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord will pass through the land to strike down the Egyptians. But when he sees the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe, the Lord will pass over your home. He will not permit his death angel to enter your house and strike you down.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord will pass through to strike the Egyptians; but when He sees the blood on the lintel and on the two doorposts, the Lord will pass over the door and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.
verses.textEn: When the Lord goes through the land to strike down the Egyptians, he will see the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe and will pass over that doorway, and he will not permit the destroyer to enter your houses and strike you down.

verses.textZh: 这教训你们必须遵守，作为你和你的子孙永远的定例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这教训你们必须遵守，作为你和你的子孙永远的定例。
verses.textZhCuv: 这例，你们要守着，作为你们和你们子孙永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: "Obey these instructions as a lasting ordinance for you and your descendants.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall observe this rite as a statute for you and for your sons forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall observe this thing as an ordinance for you and your sons forever.
verses.textEnNlt: "Remember, these instructions are a permanent law that you and your descendants must observe forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall keep this event as an ordinance for you and your children forever.
verses.textEn: "Obey these instructions as a lasting ordinance for you and your descendants.

verses.textZh: 日后，你们进了耶和华应许赐给你们的那地的时候，就必须守这敬拜之礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日后，你们进了耶和华应许赐给你们的那地的时候，就必须守这敬拜之礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 日后，你们到了耶和华按着所应许赐给你们的那地，就要守这礼。
verses.textEnNiv: When you enter the land that the Lord will give you as he promised, observe this ceremony.
verses.textEnEsv: And when you come to the land that the Lord will give you, as he has promised, you shall keep this service.
verses.textEnNkjv: It will come to pass when you come to the land which the Lord will give you, j ust as He promised, that you shall keep this service.
verses.textEnNlt: When you enter the land the Lord has promised to give you, you will continue to observe this ceremony.
verses.textEnNasb: When you enter the land which the Lord will give you, as He has promised, you shall keep this rite.
verses.textEn: When you enter the land that the Lord will give you as he promised, observe this ceremony.

verses.textZh: 日后，如果你们的子孙问你们：‘你们这敬拜之礼有甚么意思？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 日后，如果你们的子孙问你们：‘你们这敬拜之礼有甚么意思？’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的儿女问你们说：『行这礼是什么意思？』
verses.textEnNiv: And when your children ask you, ‘What does this ceremony mean to you?’
verses.textEnEsv: And when your children say to you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, when your children say to you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’
verses.textEnNlt: Then your children will ask, ‘What does this ceremony mean?’
verses.textEnNasb: And when your children say to you, ‘ What does this rite mean to you?’
verses.textEn: And when your children ask you, ‘What does this ceremony mean to you?’

verses.textZh: 你们就要回答：‘这是献给耶和华逾越节的祭。耶和华击杀埃及人的时候，越过了在埃及的以色列人的房屋，救了我们的家。’"于是人民低头敬拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就要回答：‘这是献给耶和华逾越节的祭。耶和华击杀埃及人的时候，越过了在埃及的以色列人的房屋，救了我们的家。’"于是人民低头敬拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就说：『这是献给耶和华逾越节的祭。当以色列人在埃及的时候，他击杀埃及人，越过以色列人的房屋，救了我们各家。』」于是百姓低头下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: then tell them, ‘It is the Passover sacrifice to the Lord , who passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt and spared our homes when he struck down the Egyptians.’ " Then the people bowed down and worshiped.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of the Lord ’s Passover, for he passed over the houses of the people of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians but spared our houses.’" And the people bowed their heads and worshiped.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you shall say, ‘It is the Passover sacrifice of the Lord, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt when He struck the Egyptians and delivered our households.’ " So the people bowed their heads and worshiped.
verses.textEnNlt: And you will reply, ‘It is the Passover sacrifice to the Lord , for he passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt. And though he struck the Egyptians, he spared our families.’" When Moses had finished speaking, all the people bowed down to the ground and worshiped.
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall say, ‘It is a Passover sacrifice to the Lord because He passed over the houses of the sons of Israel in Egypt when He struck the Egyptians, but spared our homes.’ " And the people bowed low and worshiped.
verses.textEn: then tell them, ‘It is the Passover sacrifice to the Lord , who passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt and spared our homes when he struck down the Egyptians.’ " Then the people bowed down and worshiped.

verses.textZh: 以色列人就去行了；耶和华怎样吩咐摩西和亚伦，以色列人就照样行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就去行了；耶和华怎样吩咐摩西和亚伦，以色列人就照样行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西、亚伦，以色列人就怎样行。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites did just what the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Israel went and did so; as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel went away and did so; just as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people of Israel did just as the Lord had commanded through Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel went and did so; just as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
verses.textEn: The Israelites did just what the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron.

verses.textZh: 到了半夜，耶和华把埃及地所有的长子，就是从坐王位的法老的长子，直到监牢里遭囚禁的人的长子，以及所有头生的牲畜，都击杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了半夜，耶和华把埃及地所有的长子，就是从坐王位的法老的长子，直到监牢里遭囚禁的人的长子，以及所有头生的牲畜，都击杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了半夜，耶和华把埃及地所有的长子，就是从坐宝座的法老，直到被掳囚在监里之人的长子，以及一切头生的牲畜，尽都杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: At midnight the Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on the throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner, who was in the dungeon, and the firstborn of all the livestock as well.
verses.textEnEsv: At midnight the Lord struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of the livestock.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass at midnight that the Lord struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.
verses.textEnNlt: And that night at midnight, the Lord struck down all the firstborn sons in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn son of Pharaoh, who sat on his throne, to the firstborn son of the prisoner in the dungeon. Even the firstborn of their livestock were killed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about at midnight that the Lord struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of cattle.
verses.textEn: At midnight the Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on the throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner, who was in the dungeon, and the firstborn of all the livestock as well.

verses.textZh: 在那一夜，法老本人和他所有的臣仆，以及全埃及的人都起来了；在埃及有极大的哀号，因为没有一家不死人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那一夜，法老本人和他所有的臣仆，以及全埃及的人都起来了；在埃及有极大的哀号，因为没有一家不死人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老和一切臣仆，并埃及众人，夜间都起来了。在埃及有大哀号，无一家不死一个人的。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh and all his officials and all the Egyptians got up during the night, and there was loud wailing in Egypt, for there was not a house without someone dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he and all his servants and all the Egyptians. And there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where someone was not dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Pharaoh rose in the night, he, all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for therewas not a house where therewas not one dead.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh and all his officials and all the people of Egypt woke up during the night, and loud wailing was heard throughout the land of Egypt. There was not a single house where someone had not died.
verses.textEnNasb: And Pharaoh got up in the night, he and all his servants and all the Egyptians, and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was no home where there was not someone dead.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh and all his officials and all the Egyptians got up during the night, and there was loud wailing in Egypt, for there was not a house without someone dead.

verses.textZh: 夜里，法老把摩西和亚伦召了来，说："你们和以色列人都起来，离开我的人民出去，照着你们所说的，去事奉耶和华吧；
verses.textZhCnvs: 夜里，法老把摩西和亚伦召了来，说："你们和以色列人都起来，离开我的人民出去，照着你们所说的，去事奉耶和华吧；
verses.textZhCuv: 夜间，法老召了摩西、亚伦来，说：「起来！连你们带以色列人，从我民中出去，依你们所说的，去事奉耶和华吧！
verses.textEnNiv: During the night Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Up! Leave my people, you and the Israelites! Go, worship the Lord as you have requested.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he summoned Moses and Aaron by night and said, "Up, go out from among my people, both you and the people of Israel; and go, serve the Lord , as you have said.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, "Rise, go out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel. And go, serve the Lord as you have said.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron during the night. "Get out!" he ordered. "Leave my people—and take the rest of the Israelites with you! Go and worship the Lord as you have requested.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he called for Moses and Aaron at night and said, "Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the sons of Israel; and go, worship the Lord, as you have said.
verses.textEn: During the night Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Up! Leave my people, you and the Israelites! Go, worship the Lord as you have requested.

verses.textZh: 也照着你们所说的，连羊群牛群都带着走吧，并且要为我祝福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也照着你们所说的，连羊群牛群都带着走吧，并且要为我祝福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 也依你们所说的，连羊群牛群带着走吧！并要为我祝福。」
verses.textEnNiv: Take your flocks and herds, as you have said, and go. And also bless me."
verses.textEnEsv: Take your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone, and bless me also!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Also take your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also."
verses.textEnNlt: Take your flocks and herds, as you said, and be gone. Go, but bless me as you leave."
verses.textEnNasb: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and go, and bless me also."
verses.textEn: Take your flocks and herds, as you have said, and go. And also bless me."

verses.textZh: 埃及人催促以色列人，要他们赶快离开此地，因为他们说："我们都要死了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及人催促以色列人，要他们赶快离开此地，因为他们说："我们都要死了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人催促百姓，打发他们快快出离那地，因为埃及人说：「我们都要死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Egyptians urged the people to hurry and leave the country. "For otherwise," they said, "we will all die!"
verses.textEnEsv: The Egyptians were urgent with the people to send them out of the land in haste. For they said, "We shall all be dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Egyptians urged the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste. For they said, "We shall all be dead."
verses.textEnNlt: All the Egyptians urged the people of Israel to get out of the land as quickly as possible, for they thought, "We will all die!"
verses.textEnNasb: The Egyptians urged the people, to send them out of the land in a hurry, for they said, "We will all be dead."
verses.textEn: The Egyptians urged the people to hurry and leave the country. "For otherwise," they said, "we will all die!"

verses.textZh: 以色列人就拿了没有发过酵的生面，用衣服把抟面盆绑好，扛在肩头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就拿了没有发过酵的生面，用衣服把抟面盆绑好，扛在肩头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓就拿着没有酵的生面，把抟面盆包在衣服中，扛在肩头上。
verses.textEnNiv: So the people took their dough before the yeast was added, and carried it on their shoulders in kneading troughs wrapped in clothing.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading bowls being bound up in their cloaks on their shoulders.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, having their kneading bowls bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites took their bread dough before yeast was added. They wrapped their kneading boards in their cloaks and carried them on their shoulders.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, with their kneading bowls bound up in the clothes on their shoulders.
verses.textEn: So the people took their dough before the yeast was added, and carried it on their shoulders in kneading troughs wrapped in clothing.

verses.textZh: 以色列人照着摩西的话行了，他们向埃及人索取银器金器和衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人照着摩西的话行了，他们向埃及人索取银器金器和衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人照着摩西的话行，向埃及人要金器、银器，和衣裳。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites did as Moses instructed and asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold and for clothing.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Israel had also done as Moses told them, for they had asked the Egyptians for silver and gold jewelry and for clothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the children of Israel had done according to the word of Moses, and they had asked from the Egyptians articles of silver, articles of gold, and clothing.
verses.textEnNlt: And the people of Israel did as Moses had instructed; they asked the Egyptians for clothing and articles of silver and gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Israel had done according to the word of Moses, for they had requested from the Egyptians articles of silver and articles of gold, and clothing;
verses.textEn: The Israelites did as Moses instructed and asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold and for clothing.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使以色列人在埃及人眼前蒙恩，埃及人就给了他们所要求的。这样，他们就夺去了埃及人的财物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使以色列人在埃及人眼前蒙恩，埃及人就给了他们所要求的。这样，他们就夺去了埃及人的财物。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，以致埃及人给他们所要的。他们就把埃及人的财物夺去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord had made the Egyptians favorably disposed toward the people, and they gave them what they asked for; so they plundered the Egyptians.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord had given the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. Thus they plundered the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord had given the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they granted them whattheyrequested. Thus they plundered the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord caused the Egyptians to look favorably on the Israelites, and they gave the Israelites whatever they asked for. So they stripped the Egyptians of their wealth!
verses.textEnNasb: and the Lord had given the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have their request. Therefore they plundered the Egyptians.
verses.textEn: The Lord had made the Egyptians favorably disposed toward the people, and they gave them what they asked for; so they plundered the Egyptians.

verses.textZh: 以色列人从兰塞起行到疏割去，除了小孩子以外，步行的男人约有六十万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人从兰塞起行到疏割去，除了小孩子以外，步行的男人约有六十万。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人从兰塞起行，往疏割去；除了妇人孩子，步行的男人约有六十万。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Sukkoth. There were about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides women and children.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides women and children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides children.
verses.textEnNlt: That night the people of Israel left Rameses and started for Succoth. There were about 600,000 men, plus all the women and children.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, aside from children.
verses.textEn: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Sukkoth. There were about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides women and children.

verses.textZh: 又有混杂多族的一群人和他们一同上去；他们还带着羊群牛群和无数的牲畜同去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有混杂多族的一群人和他们一同上去；他们还带着羊群牛群和无数的牲畜同去。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有许多闲杂人，并有羊群牛群，和他们一同上去。
verses.textEnNiv: Many other people went up with them, and also large droves of livestock, both flocks and herds.
verses.textEnEsv: A mixed multitude also went up with them, and very much livestock, both flocks and herds.
verses.textEnNkjv: A mixed multitude went up with them also, and flocks and herds—a great deal of livestock.
verses.textEnNlt: A rabble of non-Israelites went with them, along with great flocks and herds of livestock.
verses.textEnNasb: A mixed multitude also went up with them, along with flocks and herds, a very large number of livestock.
verses.textEn: Many other people went up with them, and also large droves of livestock, both flocks and herds.

verses.textZh: 他们把从埃及带出来的生面烘成了无酵的圆饼。这生面原是没有发过酵的，因为他们被驱逐离开埃及，所以不能停留，也没有为自己预备食粮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把从埃及带出来的生面烘成了无酵的圆饼。这生面原是没有发过酵的，因为他们被驱逐离开埃及，所以不能停留，也没有为自己预备食粮。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们用埃及带出来的生面烤成无酵饼。这生面原没有发起；因为他们被催逼离开埃及，不能耽延，也没有为自己预备什么食物。
verses.textEnNiv: With the dough the Israelites had brought from Egypt, they baked loaves of unleavened bread. The dough was without yeast because they had been driven out of Egypt and did not have time to prepare food for themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough that they had brought out of Egypt, for it was not leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt and could not wait, nor had they prepared any provisions for themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they had brought out of Egypt; for it was not leavened, because they were driven out of Egypt and could not wait, nor had they prepared provisions for themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: For bread they baked flat cakes from the dough without yeast they had brought from Egypt. It was made without yeast because the people were driven out of Egypt in such a hurry that they had no time to prepare the bread or other food.
verses.textEnNasb: And they baked the dough which they had brought out of Egypt into cakes of unleavened bread. For it had no yeast, since they were driven out of Egypt and could not delay, nor had they prepared any provisions for themselves.
verses.textEn: With the dough the Israelites had brought from Egypt, they baked loaves of unleavened bread. The dough was without yeast because they had been driven out of Egypt and did not have time to prepare food for themselves.

verses.textZh: 以色列人住在埃及的时间共有四百三十年之久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人住在埃及的时间共有四百三十年之久。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人住在埃及共有四百三十年。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the length of time the Israelite people lived in Egypt was 430 years.
verses.textEnEsv: The time that the people of Israel lived in Egypt was 430 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the sojourn of the children of Israel who lived in Egypt was four hundred and thirty years.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel had lived in Egypt for 430 years.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the time that the sons of Israel had lived in Egypt was 430 years.
verses.textEn: Now the length of time the Israelite people lived in Egypt was 430 years.

verses.textZh: 就在四百三十年届满的那一天，耶和华的全军都从埃及地出来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在四百三十年届满的那一天，耶和华的全军都从埃及地出来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 正满了四百三十年的那一天，耶和华的军队都从埃及地出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of the 430 years, to the very day, all the Lord ’s divisions left Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of 430 years, on that very day, all the hosts of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years—on that very same day—it came to pass that all the armies of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, it was on the last day of the 430th year that all the Lord ’s forces left the land.
verses.textEnNasb: And at the end of 430 years, on this very day, all the multitudes of the Lord departed from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: At the end of the 430 years, to the very day, all the Lord ’s divisions left Egypt.

verses.textZh: 这是向耶和华守的一夜，因为耶和华把他们从埃及地领出来，所以这一夜是所有以色列人世世代代向耶和华守的一夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是向耶和华守的一夜，因为耶和华把他们从埃及地领出来，所以这一夜是所有以色列人世世代代向耶和华守的一夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 这夜是耶和华的夜；因耶和华领他们出了埃及地，所以当向耶和华谨守，是以色列众人世世代代该谨守的。
verses.textEnNiv: Because the Lord kept vigil that night to bring them out of Egypt, on this night all the Israelites are to keep vigil to honor the Lord for the generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: It was a night of watching by the Lord , to bring them out of the land of Egypt; so this same night is a night of watching kept to the Lord by all the people of Israel throughout their generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is a night of solemn observance to the Lord for bringing them out of the land of Egypt. This is that night of the Lord, a solemn observance for all the children of Israel throughout their generations.
verses.textEnNlt: On this night the Lord kept his promise to bring his people out of the land of Egypt. So this night belongs to him, and it must be commemorated every year by all the Israelites, from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: It is a night to be observed for the Lord, for having brought them out of the land of Egypt; this night is for the Lord, to be observed by all the sons of Israel throughout their generations.
verses.textEn: Because the Lord kept vigil that night to bring them out of Egypt, on this night all the Israelites are to keep vigil to honor the Lord for the generations to come.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说："逾越节的定例是这样，凡是外族人都不可以吃羊羔的肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说："逾越节的定例是这样，凡是外族人都不可以吃羊羔的肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：「逾越节的例是这样：外邦人都不可吃这羊羔。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "These are the regulations for the Passover meal: "No foreigner may eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "This is the statute of the Passover: no foreigner shall eat of it,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "This is the ordinance of the Passover: No foreigner shall eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "These are the instructions for the festival of Passover. No outsiders are allowed to eat the Passover meal.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "This is the ordinance of the Passover: no foreigner is to eat it;
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "These are the regulations for the Passover meal: "No foreigner may eat it.

verses.textZh: 但是各人用银子买回来的奴仆，如果你给他行了割礼，他就可以吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是各人用银子买回来的奴仆，如果你给他行了割礼，他就可以吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但各人用银子买的奴仆，既受了割礼就可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Any slave you have bought may eat it after you have circumcised him,
verses.textEnEsv: but every slave that is bought for money may eat of it after you have circumcised him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then he may eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: But any slave who has been purchased may eat it if he has been circumcised.
verses.textEnNasb: but as for every slave that someone has purchased with money, after you have circumcised him, then he may eat it.
verses.textEn: Any slave you have bought may eat it after you have circumcised him,

verses.textZh: 寄居和受雇的都不可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 寄居和受雇的都不可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 寄居的和雇工人都不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: but a temporary resident or a hired worker may not eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: No foreigner or hired worker may eat of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: A sojourner and a hired servant shall not eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: Temporary residents and hired servants may not eat it.
verses.textEnNasb: A stranger or a hired worker shall not eat it.
verses.textEn: but a temporary resident or a hired worker may not eat it.

verses.textZh: 必须在同一间房子里吃，你不可把一点肉从房子里带到外面；羊羔的骨头，一根也不可折断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必须在同一间房子里吃，你不可把一点肉从房子里带到外面；羊羔的骨头，一根也不可折断。
verses.textZhCuv: 应当在一个房子里吃；不可把一点肉从房子里带到外头去。羊羔的骨头一根也不可折断。
verses.textEnNiv: "It must be eaten inside the house; take none of the meat outside the house. Do not break any of the bones.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be eaten in one house; you shall not take any of the flesh outside the house, and you shall not break any of its bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: In one house it shall be eaten; you shall not carry any of the flesh outside the house, nor shall you break one of its bones.
verses.textEnNlt: Each Passover lamb must be eaten in one house. Do not carry any of its meat outside, and do not break any of its bones.
verses.textEnNasb: It is to be eaten in a single house; you are not to bring any of the meat outside of the house, nor are you to break any bone of it.
verses.textEn: "It must be eaten inside the house; take none of the meat outside the house. Do not break any of the bones.

verses.textZh: 以色列全体会众都要守这逾越节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列全体会众都要守这逾越节。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列全会众都要守这礼。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole community of Israel must celebrate it.
verses.textEnEsv: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole community of Israel must celebrate this Passover festival.
verses.textEnNasb: All the congregation of Israel are to celebrate this.
verses.textEn: The whole community of Israel must celebrate it.

verses.textZh: 如果有外族人寄居在你们中间，也愿向耶和华守逾越节，他所有的男子都要受割礼，然后他才可以前来守逾越节；他就必像本地人一样，但所有未受割礼的人都不可以吃这羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有外族人寄居在你们中间，也愿向耶和华守逾越节，他所有的男子都要受割礼，然后他才可以前来守逾越节；他就必像本地人一样，但所有未受割礼的人都不可以吃这羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有外人寄居在你们中间，愿向耶和华守逾越节，他所有的男子务要受割礼，然后才容他前来遵守，他也就像本地人一样；但未受割礼的，都不可吃这羊羔。
verses.textEnNiv: "A foreigner residing among you who wants to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover must have all the males in his household circumcised; then he may take part like one born in the land. No uncircumcised male may eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: If a stranger shall sojourn with you and would keep the Passover to the Lord , let all his males be circumcised. Then he may come near and keep it; he shall be as a native of the land. But no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when a stranger dwells with you andwants to keep the Passover to the Lord, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as a native of the land. For no uncircumcised person shall eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: "If there are foreigners living among you who want to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover, let all their males be circumcised. Only then may they celebrate the Passover with you like any native-born Israelite. But no uncircumcised male may ever eat the Passover meal.
verses.textEnNasb: But if a stranger resides with you and celebrates the Passover to the Lord, all of his males are to be circumcised, and then he shall come near to celebrate it; and he shall be like a native of the land. But no uncircumcised male may eat it.
verses.textEn: "A foreigner residing among you who wants to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover must have all the males in his household circumcised; then he may take part like one born in the land. No uncircumcised male may eat it.

verses.textZh: 本地人和寄居在你们中间的外族人，都同属一例。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 本地人和寄居在你们中间的外族人，都同属一例。"
verses.textZhCuv: 本地人和寄居在你们中间的外人同归一例。」
verses.textEnNiv: The same law applies both to the native-born and to the foreigner residing among you."
verses.textEnEsv: There shall be one law for the native and for the stranger who sojourns among you."
verses.textEnNkjv: One law shall be for the native-born and for the stranger who dwells among you."
verses.textEnNlt: This instruction applies to everyone, whether a native-born Israelite or a foreigner living among you."
verses.textEnNasb: The same law shall apply to the native as to the stranger who resides among you."
verses.textEn: The same law applies both to the native-born and to the foreigner residing among you."

verses.textZh: 所有以色列人都奉行了；耶和华怎样吩咐摩西和亚伦，他们就怎样行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有以色列人都奉行了；耶和华怎样吩咐摩西和亚伦，他们就怎样行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西、亚伦，以色列众人就怎样行了。
verses.textEnNiv: All the Israelites did just what the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: All the people of Israel did just as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus all the children of Israel did; as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
verses.textEnNlt: So all the people of Israel followed all the Lord ’s commands to Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the sons of Israel did so; they did just as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEn: All the Israelites did just what the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron.

verses.textZh: 就在这一天，耶和华按着他们的军队，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在这一天，耶和华按着他们的军队，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 正当那日，耶和华将以色列人按着他们的军队，从埃及地领出来。
verses.textEnNiv: And on that very day the Lord brought the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions.
verses.textEnEsv: And on that very day the Lord brought the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, on that very same day, that the Lord brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt according to their armies.
verses.textEnNlt: On that very day the Lord brought the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt like an army.
verses.textEnNasb: And on that very day the Lord brought the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt according to their multitudes.
verses.textEn: And on that very day the Lord brought the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions.

verses.textZh: 耶和华告诉摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华告诉摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "在以色列人中，你要把所有头生的都分别为圣归我；无论是人或是牲畜，凡是头生的都是我的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "在以色列人中，你要把所有头生的都分别为圣归我；无论是人或是牲畜，凡是头生的都是我的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列中凡头生的，无论是人是牲畜，都是我的，要分别为圣归我。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Consecrate to me every firstborn male. The first offspring of every womb among the Israelites belongs to me, whether human or animal."
verses.textEnEsv: "Consecrate to me all the firstborn. Whatever is the first to open the womb among the people of Israel, both of man and of beast, is mine."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Consecrate to Me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and beast; it is Mine."
verses.textEnNlt: "Dedicate to me every firstborn among the Israelites. The first offspring to be born, of both humans and animals, belongs to me."
verses.textEnNasb: "Sanctify to Me every firstborn, the firstborn of every womb among the sons of Israel, among people and animals alike; it belongs to Me."
verses.textEn: "Consecrate to me every firstborn male. The first offspring of every womb among the Israelites belongs to me, whether human or animal."

verses.textZh: 摩西对人民说："你们要记念这一天，就是从埃及为奴之家出来的这一天，因为耶和华用大能的手把你们从这里领出来；所以有酵之物都不可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对人民说："你们要记念这一天，就是从埃及为奴之家出来的这一天，因为耶和华用大能的手把你们从这里领出来；所以有酵之物都不可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对百姓说：「你们要记念从埃及为奴之家出来的这日，因为耶和华用大能的手将你们从这地方领出来。有酵的饼都不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said to the people, "Commemorate this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery, because the Lord brought you out of it with a mighty hand. Eat nothing containing yeast.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses said to the people, "Remember this day in which you came out from Egypt, out of the house of slavery, for by a strong hand the Lord brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to the people: "Remember this day in which you went out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the Lord brought you out of this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses said to the people, "This is a day to remember forever—the day you left Egypt, the place of your slavery. Today the Lord has brought you out by the power of his mighty hand. (Remember, eat no food containing yeast.)
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses said to the people, "Remember this day in which you departed from Egypt, from the house of slavery; for by a powerful hand the Lord brought you out from this place. And nothing with yeast shall be eaten.
verses.textEn: Then Moses said to the people, "Commemorate this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery, because the Lord brought you out of it with a mighty hand. Eat nothing containing yeast.

verses.textZh: 你们是在亚笔月这一日出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们是在亚笔月这一日出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚笔月间的这日是你们出来的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: Today, in the month of Aviv, you are leaving.
verses.textEnEsv: Today, in the month of Abib, you are going out.
verses.textEnNkjv: On this day you are going out, in the month Abib.
verses.textEnNlt: On this day in early spring, in the month of Abib, you have been set free.
verses.textEnNasb: On this day in the month of Abib, you are about to go out from here.
verses.textEn: Today, in the month of Aviv, you are leaving.

verses.textZh: 日后耶和华领你进到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、希未人、耶布斯人之地，就是他向你的列祖起誓要赐给你的那流奶与蜜之地，那时你要在这月守这敬拜之礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日后耶和华领你进到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、希未人、耶布斯人之地，就是他向你的列祖起誓要赐给你的那流奶与蜜之地，那时你要在这月守这敬拜之礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 将来耶和华领你进迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、希未人、耶布斯人之地，就是他向你的祖宗起誓应许给你那流奶与蜜之地，那时你要在这月间守这礼。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites and Jebusites—the land he swore to your ancestors to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey—you are to observe this ceremony in this month:
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, you shall keep this service in this month.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, when the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Amorites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, which He swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.
verses.textEnNlt: You must celebrate this event in this month each year after the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites. (He swore to your ancestors that he would give you this land—a land flowing with milk and honey.)
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be when the Lord brings you to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which He swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall perform this rite in this month.
verses.textEn: When the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites and Jebusites—the land he swore to your ancestors to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey—you are to observe this ceremony in this month:

verses.textZh: 你要吃无酵饼七日，第七日要向耶和华守节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要吃无酵饼七日，第七日要向耶和华守节。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要吃无酵饼七日，到第七日要向耶和华守节。
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days eat bread made without yeast and on the seventh day hold a festival to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a feast to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day thereshallbe a feast to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: For seven days the bread you eat must be made without yeast. Then on the seventh day, celebrate a feast to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a feast to the Lord.
verses.textEn: For seven days eat bread made without yeast and on the seventh day hold a festival to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 七日之中你要吃无酵饼；在你四境之内，不可见有发过酵之物在你面前，也不可见有酵在你那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 七日之中你要吃无酵饼；在你四境之内，不可见有发过酵之物在你面前，也不可见有酵在你那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 这七日之久，要吃无酵饼；在你四境之内不可见有酵的饼，也不可见发酵的物。
verses.textEnNiv: Eat unleavened bread during those seven days; nothing with yeast in it is to be seen among you, nor shall any yeast be seen anywhere within your borders.
verses.textEnEsv: Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days; no leavened bread shall be seen with you, and no leaven shall be seen with you in all your territory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days. And no leavened bread shall be seen among you, nor shall leaven be seen among you in all your quarters.
verses.textEnNlt: Eat bread without yeast during those seven days. In fact, there must be no yeast bread or any yeast at all found within the borders of your land during this time.
verses.textEnNasb: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and nothing with yeast shall be seen among you, nor shall any dough with yeast be seen among you in all your borders.
verses.textEn: Eat unleavened bread during those seven days; nothing with yeast in it is to be seen among you, nor shall any yeast be seen anywhere within your borders.

verses.textZh: 在那日，你要告诉你的儿子说：‘这是因为耶和华在我从埃及出来的时候为我所行的事。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那日，你要告诉你的儿子说：‘这是因为耶和华在我从埃及出来的时候为我所行的事。’
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，你要告诉你的儿子说：『这是因耶和华在我出埃及的时候为我所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day tell your son, ‘I do this because of what the Lord did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
verses.textEnEsv: You shall tell your son on that day, ‘It is because of what the Lord did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘Thisisdone because of what the Lord did for me when I came up from Egypt.’
verses.textEnNlt: "On the seventh day you must explain to your children, ‘I am celebrating what the Lord did for me when I left Egypt.’
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall tell your son on that day, saying, ‘It is because of what the Lord did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
verses.textEn: On that day tell your son, ‘I do this because of what the Lord did for me when I came out of Egypt.’

verses.textZh: 这要在你的手上作记号，在你额上作记念，好使耶和华的律法常在你的口中，因为耶和华曾用大能的手把你从埃及领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这要在你的手上作记号，在你额上作记念，好使耶和华的律法常在你的口中，因为耶和华曾用大能的手把你从埃及领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这要在你手上作记号，在你额上作纪念，使耶和华的律法常在你口中，因为耶和华曾用大能的手将你从埃及领出来。
verses.textEnNiv: This observance will be for you like a sign on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that this law of the Lord is to be on your lips. For the Lord brought you out of Egypt with his mighty hand.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be to you as a sign on your hand and as a memorial between your eyes, that the law of the Lord may be in your mouth. For with a strong hand the Lord has brought you out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be as a sign to you on your hand and as a memorial between your eyes, that the Lord’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand the Lord has brought you out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: This annual festival will be a visible sign to you, like a mark branded on your hand or your forehead. Let it remind you always to recite this teaching of the Lord : ‘With a strong hand, the Lord rescued you from Egypt.’
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall serve as a sign to you on your hand, and as a reminder on your forehead, that the law of the Lord may be in your mouth; for with a powerful hand the Lord brought you out of Egypt.
verses.textEn: This observance will be for you like a sign on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that this law of the Lord is to be on your lips. For the Lord brought you out of Egypt with his mighty hand.

verses.textZh: 所以，你要年年按着定期遵守这定例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你要年年按着定期遵守这定例。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你每年要按着日期守这例。』」
verses.textEnNiv: You must keep this ordinance at the appointed time year after year.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall therefore keep this statute at its appointed time from year to year.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.
verses.textEnNlt: So observe the decree of this festival at the appointed time each year.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, you shall keep this ordinance at its appointed time from year to year.
verses.textEn: You must keep this ordinance at the appointed time year after year.

verses.textZh: "日后，耶和华照着他向你和你的列祖所起的誓，把你领进迦南人之地，把这地赐给你之后，
verses.textZhCnvs: "日后，耶和华照着他向你和你的列祖所起的誓，把你领进迦南人之地，把这地赐给你之后，
verses.textZhCuv: 「将来，耶和华照他向你和你祖宗所起的誓将你领进迦南人之地，把这地赐给你，
verses.textEnNiv: "After the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you, as he promised on oath to you and your ancestors,
verses.textEnEsv: "When the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, as he swore to you and your fathers, and shall give it to you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall be, when the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, as He swore to you and your fathers, and gives it to you,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what you must do when the Lord fulfills the promise he swore to you and to your ancestors. When he gives you the land where the Canaanites now live,
verses.textEnNasb: "Now when the Lord brings you to the land of the Canaanite, as He swore to you and to your fathers, and gives it to you,
verses.textEn: "After the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you, as he promised on oath to you and your ancestors,

verses.textZh: 你要把所有头生的奉献给耶和华，也要把你一切牲畜中所有头生的小牲口奉献给耶和华；公的都属耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把所有头生的奉献给耶和华，也要把你一切牲畜中所有头生的小牲口奉献给耶和华；公的都属耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时你要将一切头生的，并牲畜中头生的，归给耶和华；公的都要属耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: you are to give over to the Lord the first offspring of every womb. All the firstborn males of your livestock belong to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: you shall set apart to the Lord all that first opens the womb. All the firstborn of your animals that are males shall be the Lord ’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you shall set apart to the Lord all that open the womb, that is, every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have; the males shallbe the Lord’s.
verses.textEnNlt: you must present all firstborn sons and firstborn male animals to the Lord , for they belong to him.
verses.textEnNasb: you shall devote to the Lord every firstborn of a womb, and every firstborn offspring of an animal that you own; the males belong to the Lord.
verses.textEn: you are to give over to the Lord the first offspring of every womb. All the firstborn males of your livestock belong to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 凡是头生的驴，你要用羊羔代赎；如果你不代赎，就要打断牠的颈项；凡是你儿子中头生的人，你都要代赎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是头生的驴，你要用羊羔代赎；如果你不代赎，就要打断牠的颈项；凡是你儿子中头生的人，你都要代赎。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡头生的驴，你要用羊羔代赎；若不代赎，就要打折它的颈项。凡你儿子中头生的都要赎出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Redeem with a lamb every firstborn donkey, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem every firstborn among your sons.
verses.textEnEsv: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb, or if you will not redeem it you shall break its neck. Every firstborn of man among your sons you shall redeem.
verses.textEnNkjv: But every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. And all the firstborn of man among your sons you shall redeem.
verses.textEnNlt: A firstborn donkey may be bought back from the Lord by presenting a lamb or young goat in its place. But if you do not buy it back, you must break its neck. However, you must buy back every firstborn son.
verses.textEnNasb: But every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb, but if you do not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and every firstborn among your sons you shall redeem.
verses.textEn: Redeem with a lamb every firstborn donkey, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem every firstborn among your sons.

verses.textZh: 日后你的儿子若是问你们：‘这是甚么意思？’你就要回答他：‘耶和华曾经用大能的手把我们从埃及为奴之家领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日后你的儿子若是问你们：‘这是甚么意思？’你就要回答他：‘耶和华曾经用大能的手把我们从埃及为奴之家领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 日后，你的儿子问你说：『这是什么意思？』你就说：『耶和华用大能的手将我们从埃及为奴之家领出来。
verses.textEnNiv: "In days to come, when your son asks you, ‘What does this mean?’ say to him, ‘With a mighty hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
verses.textEnEsv: And when in time to come your son asks you, ‘What does this mean?’ you shall say to him, ‘By a strong hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall say to him, ‘By strength of hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: "And in the future, your children will ask you, ‘What does all this mean?’ Then you will tell them, ‘With the power of his mighty hand, the Lord brought us out of Egypt, the place of our slavery.
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ then you shall say to him, ‘With a powerful hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
verses.textEn: "In days to come, when your son asks you, ‘What does this mean?’ say to him, ‘With a mighty hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

verses.textZh: 那时法老心里刚硬，不让我们离开，耶和华就把埃及地所有头生的，无论是人或是牲畜都杀了；所以，我把所有头生的公牲口都献给耶和华为祭；但我所有头生的儿子，却都要代赎回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时法老心里刚硬，不让我们离开，耶和华就把埃及地所有头生的，无论是人或是牲畜都杀了；所以，我把所有头生的公牲口都献给耶和华为祭；但我所有头生的儿子，却都要代赎回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时法老几乎不容我们去，耶和华就把埃及地所有头生的，无论是人是牲畜，都杀了。因此，我把一切头生的公牲畜献给耶和华为祭，但将头生的儿子都赎出来。
verses.textEnNiv: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the Lord killed the firstborn of both people and animals in Egypt. This is why I sacrifice to the Lord the first male offspring of every womb and redeem each of my firstborn sons.’
verses.textEnEsv: For when Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the Lord killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man and the firstborn of animals. Therefore I sacrifice to the Lord all the males that first open the womb, but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh was stubborn about letting us go, that the Lord killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man and the firstborn of beast. Therefore I sacrifice to the Lord all males that open the womb, but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, so the Lord killed all the firstborn males throughout the land of Egypt, both people and animals. That is why I now sacrifice all the firstborn males to the Lord —except that the firstborn sons are always bought back.’
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when Pharaoh was stubborn about letting us go, that the Lord put to death every firstborn in the land of Egypt, from human firstborns to animal firstborns. Therefore, I sacrifice to the Lord the males, every firstborn of a womb, but every firstborn of my sons I redeem.’
verses.textEn: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the Lord killed the firstborn of both people and animals in Egypt. This is why I sacrifice to the Lord the first male offspring of every womb and redeem each of my firstborn sons.’

verses.textZh: 这要在你的手上作记号，在你的额上作头带；因为耶和华曾用大能的手把我们从埃及领出来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这要在你的手上作记号，在你的额上作头带；因为耶和华曾用大能的手把我们从埃及领出来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 这要在你手上作记号，在你额上作经文，因为耶和华用大能的手将我们从埃及领出来。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And it will be like a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead that the Lord brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand."
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be as a mark on your hand or frontlets between your eyes, for by a strong hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be as a sign on your hand and as frontlets between your eyes, for by strength of hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: This ceremony will be like a mark branded on your hand or your forehead. It is a reminder that the power of the Lord ’s mighty hand brought us out of Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: So it shall serve as a sign on your hand and as phylacteries on your forehead, for with a powerful hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt."
verses.textEn: And it will be like a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead that the Lord brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand."

verses.textZh: 法老让人民离开的时候，虽然非利士的路很近，神却不领他们从那里走，因为神说："恐怕百姓看见战争而后悔，就回埃及去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老让人民离开的时候，虽然非利士的路很近，神却不领他们从那里走，因为神说："恐怕百姓看见战争而后悔，就回埃及去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老容百姓去的时候，非利士地的道路虽近，神却不领他们从那里走；因为神说：「恐怕百姓遇见打仗后悔，就回埃及去。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them on the road through the Philistine country, though that was shorter. For God said, "If they face war, they might change their minds and return to Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them by way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near. For God said, "Lest the people change their minds when they see war and return to Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God did not lead them by way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, "Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and return to Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: When Pharaoh finally let the people go, God did not lead them along the main road that runs through Philistine territory, even though that was the shortest route to the Promised Land. God said, "If the people are faced with a battle, they might change their minds and return to Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Pharaoh had let the people go, God did not lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, even though it was near; for God said, "The people might change their minds when they see war, and return to Egypt."
verses.textEn: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them on the road through the Philistine country, though that was shorter. For God said, "If they face war, they might change their minds and return to Egypt."

verses.textZh: 所以神领人民绕道而行，走旷野的路到红海去；以色列人从埃及地上来的时候，都带着兵器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以神领人民绕道而行，走旷野的路到红海去；以色列人从埃及地上来的时候，都带着兵器。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以神领百姓绕道而行，走红海旷野的路。以色列人出埃及地，都带着兵器上去。
verses.textEnNiv: So God led the people around by the desert road toward the Red Sea. The Israelites went up out of Egypt ready for battle.
verses.textEnEsv: But God led the people around by the way of the wilderness toward the Red Sea. And the people of Israel went up out of the land of Egypt equipped for battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: So God led the people around by way of the wilderness of the Red Sea. And the children of Israel went up in orderly ranks out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So God led them in a roundabout way through the wilderness toward the Red Sea. Thus the Israelites left Egypt like an army ready for battle.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore God led the people around by way of the wilderness to the Red Sea; and the sons of Israel went up in battle formation from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: So God led the people around by the desert road toward the Red Sea. The Israelites went up out of Egypt ready for battle.

verses.textZh: 摩西带了约瑟的骸骨同去，因为约瑟曾经叫以色列人严肃地起誓，说："神必定眷顾你们；你们要把我的骸骨从这里也一同带去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西带了约瑟的骸骨同去，因为约瑟曾经叫以色列人严肃地起誓，说："神必定眷顾你们；你们要把我的骸骨从这里也一同带去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西把约瑟的骸骨一同带去；因为约瑟曾叫以色列人严严地起誓，对他们说：「神必眷顾你们，你们要把我的骸骨从这里一同带上去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him because Joseph had made the Israelites swear an oath. He had said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up with you from this place."
verses.textEnEsv: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for Joseph had made the sons of Israel solemnly swear, saying, "God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones with you from here."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had placed the children of Israel under solemn oath, saying, "God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here with you."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for Joseph had made the sons of Israel swear to do this. He said, "God will certainly come to help you. When he does, you must take my bones with you from this place."
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the sons of Israel solemnly swear, saying, "God will certainly take care of you, and you shall carry my bones from here with you."
verses.textEn: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him because Joseph had made the Israelites swear an oath. He had said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up with you from this place."

verses.textZh: 他们从疏割起程，在旷野边界的以倘安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从疏割起程，在旷野边界的以倘安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从疏割起行，在旷野边的以倘安营。
verses.textEnNiv: After leaving Sukkoth they camped at Etham on the edge of the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: And they moved on from Succoth and encamped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took their journey from Succoth and camped in Etham at the edge of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites left Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they set out from Succoth and camped in Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
verses.textEn: After leaving Sukkoth they camped at Etham on the edge of the desert.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在他们前面行，日间用云柱领他们的路，夜间用火柱光照他们，使他们日夜都可以行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在他们前面行，日间用云柱领他们的路，夜间用火柱光照他们，使他们日夜都可以行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 日间，耶和华在云柱中领他们的路；夜间，在火柱中光照他们，使他们日夜都可以行走。
verses.textEnNiv: By day the Lord went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them on their way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so that they could travel by day or night.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead them along the way, and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, that they might travel by day and by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of cloud to lead the way, and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so as to go by day and night.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord went ahead of them. He guided them during the day with a pillar of cloud, and he provided light at night with a pillar of fire. This allowed them to travel by day or by night.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord was going before them in a pillar of cloud by day to lead them on the way, and in a pillar of fire by night to give them light, so that they might travel by day and by night.
verses.textEn: By day the Lord went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them on their way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so that they could travel by day or night.

verses.textZh: 日间云柱，夜间火柱，都不离开众民的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日间云柱，夜间火柱，都不离开众民的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 日间云柱，夜间火柱，总不离开百姓的面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place in front of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: The pillar of cloud by day and the pillar of fire by night did not depart from before the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: He did not take away the pillar of cloud by day or the pillar of fire by night from before the people.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord did not remove the pillar of cloud or pillar of fire from its place in front of the people.
verses.textEnNasb: He did not take away the pillar of cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from the presence of the people.
verses.textEn: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place in front of the people.

verses.textZh: 耶和华告诉摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华告诉摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave these instructions to Moses:
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列人转回过来，在比．哈希录前，密夺和海之间安营；你们要在巴力．洗分前，对着巴力．洗分，靠近海边的地方安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列人转回过来，在比．哈希录前，密夺和海之间安营；你们要在巴力．洗分前，对着巴力．洗分，靠近海边的地方安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐以色列人转回，安营在比‧哈希录前，密夺和海的中间，对着巴力‧洗分，靠近海边安营。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell the Israelites to turn back and encamp near Pi Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. They are to encamp by the sea, directly opposite Baal Zephon.
verses.textEnEsv: "Tell the people of Israel to turn back and encamp in front of Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, in front of Baal-zephon; you shall encamp facing it, by the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn and camp before Pi Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, opposite Baal Zephon; you shall camp before it by the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: "Order the Israelites to turn back and camp by Pi-hahiroth between Migdol and the sea. Camp there along the shore, across from Baal-zephon.
verses.textEnNasb: "Tell the sons of Israel to turn back and camp in front of Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea; you shall camp in front of Baal-zephon, opposite it, by the sea.
verses.textEn: "Tell the Israelites to turn back and encamp near Pi Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. They are to encamp by the sea, directly opposite Baal Zephon.

verses.textZh: 法老必论到以色列人的事，说：‘他们在这地走迷了路，旷野把他们困住了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老必论到以色列人的事，说：‘他们在这地走迷了路，旷野把他们困住了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 法老必说：『以色列人在地中绕迷了，旷野把他们困住了。』
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh will think, ‘The Israelites are wandering around the land in confusion, hemmed in by the desert.’
verses.textEnEsv: For Pharaoh will say of the people of Israel, ‘They are wandering in the land; the wilderness has shut them in.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are bewildered by the land; the wilderness has closed them in.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh will think, ‘The Israelites are confused. They are trapped in the wilderness!’
verses.textEnNasb: For Pharaoh will say of the sons of Israel, ‘They are wandering aimlessly in the land; the wilderness has shut them in.’
verses.textEn: Pharaoh will think, ‘The Israelites are wandering around the land in confusion, hemmed in by the desert.’

verses.textZh: 我要使法老的心刚硬，他就必追赶他们；这样，我就可以在法老身上和他的全军身上得到荣耀，埃及人就必知道我是耶和华。"于是以色列人就这样行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使法老的心刚硬，他就必追赶他们；这样，我就可以在法老身上和他的全军身上得到荣耀，埃及人就必知道我是耶和华。"于是以色列人就这样行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使法老的心刚硬，他要追赶他们，我便在法老和他全军身上得荣耀；埃及人就知道我是耶和华。」于是以色列人这样行了。
verses.textEnNiv: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will pursue them. But I will gain glory for myself through Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord ." So the Israelites did this.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will pursue them, and I will get glory over Pharaoh and all his host, and the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord ." And they did so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, so that he will pursue them; and I will gain honor over Pharaoh and over all his army, that the Egyptians may know that I am the Lord." And they did so.
verses.textEnNlt: And once again I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will chase after you. I have planned this in order to display my glory through Pharaoh and his whole army. After this the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord !" So the Israelites camped there as they were told.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will chase after them; and I will be honored through Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord." And they did so.
verses.textEn: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will pursue them. But I will gain glory for myself through Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord ." So the Israelites did this.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉埃及王说："以色列人逃走了。"法老和他的臣仆对以色列人的心就改变了，他们说："我们让以色列人离开，不再服事我们，我们作了甚么事呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉埃及王说："以色列人逃走了。"法老和他的臣仆对以色列人的心就改变了，他们说："我们让以色列人离开，不再服事我们，我们作了甚么事呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉埃及王说：「百姓逃跑。」法老和他的臣仆就向百姓变心，说：「我们容以色列人去，不再服事我们，这做的是什么事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, "What have we done? We have let the Israelites go and have lost their services!"
verses.textEnEsv: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, the mind of Pharaoh and his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, "What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?"
