verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was told the king of Egypt that the people had fled, and the heart of Pharaoh and his servants was turned against the people; and they said, "Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?"
verses.textEnNlt: When word reached the king of Egypt that the Israelites had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds. "What have we done, letting all those Israelite slaves get away?" they asked.
verses.textEnNasb: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his servants had a change of heart toward the people, and they said, "What is this that we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?"
verses.textEn: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, "What have we done? We have let the Israelites go and have lost their services!"

verses.textZh: 法老就预备他的马车，带着他的人民一同去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老就预备他的马车，带着他的人民一同去，
verses.textZhCuv: 法老就预备他的车辆，带领军兵同去，
verses.textEnNiv: So he had his chariot made ready and took his army with him.
verses.textEnEsv: So he made ready his chariot and took his army with him,
verses.textEnNkjv: So he made ready his chariot and took his people with him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Pharaoh harnessed his chariot and called up his troops.
verses.textEnNasb: So he had horses harnessed to his chariot and took his people with him;
verses.textEn: So he had his chariot made ready and took his army with him.

verses.textZh: 并且带着六百辆特选的马车和埃及所有的马车，每辆马车上都有马车长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且带着六百辆特选的马车和埃及所有的马车，每辆马车上都有马车长。
verses.textZhCuv: 并带着六百辆特选的车和埃及所有的车，每辆都有车兵长。
verses.textEnNiv: He took six hundred of the best chariots, along with all the other chariots of Egypt, with officers over all of them.
verses.textEnEsv: and took six hundred chosen chariots and all the other chariots of Egypt with officers over all of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, he took six hundred choice chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt with captains over every one of them.
verses.textEnNlt: He took with him 600 of Egypt’s best chariots, along with the rest of the chariots of Egypt, each with its commander.
verses.textEnNasb: and he took six hundred select chariots, and all the other chariots of Egypt with officers over all of them.
verses.textEn: He took six hundred of the best chariots, along with all the other chariots of Egypt, with officers over all of them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使埃及王法老的心刚硬，法老就追赶以色列人；因为以色列人是靠着耶和华高举的手出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使埃及王法老的心刚硬，法老就追赶以色列人；因为以色列人是靠着耶和华高举的手出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使埃及王法老的心刚硬，他就追赶以色列人，因为以色列人是昂然无惧地出埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, so that he pursued the Israelites, who were marching out boldly.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the people of Israel while the people of Israel were going out defiantly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; and the children of Israel went out with boldness.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, so he chased after the people of Israel, who had left with fists raised in defiance.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and he chased after the sons of Israel as the sons of Israel were going out boldly.
verses.textEn: The Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, so that he pursued the Israelites, who were marching out boldly.

verses.textZh: 埃及人追赶他们，法老所有的马匹、战车和他的马兵与军队，就在海边，靠近比．哈希录，对着巴力．洗分他们安营的地方追上了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及人追赶他们，法老所有的马匹、战车和他的马兵与军队，就在海边，靠近比．哈希录，对着巴力．洗分他们安营的地方追上了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人追赶他们，法老一切的马匹、车辆、马兵，与军兵就在海边上，靠近比‧哈希录，对着巴力‧洗分，在他们安营的地方追上了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Egyptians—all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots, horsemen and troops—pursued the Israelites and overtook them as they camped by the sea near Pi Hahiroth, opposite Baal Zephon.
verses.textEnEsv: The Egyptians pursued them, all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots and his horsemen and his army, and overtook them encamped at the sea, by Pi-hahiroth, in front of Baal-zephon.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Egyptians pursued them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen and his army, and overtook them camping by the sea beside Pi Hahiroth, before Baal Zephon.
verses.textEnNlt: The Egyptians chased after them with all the forces in Pharaoh’s army—all his horses and chariots, his charioteers, and his troops. The Egyptians caught up with the people of Israel as they were camped beside the shore near Pi-hahiroth, across from Baal-zephon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Egyptians chased after them with all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen and his army, and they overtook them camping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, in front of Baal-zephon.
verses.textEn: The Egyptians—all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots, horsemen and troops—pursued the Israelites and overtook them as they camped by the sea near Pi Hahiroth, opposite Baal Zephon.

verses.textZh: 法老走近的时候，以色列人举目观看，看见埃及人正追赶过来，就非常惧怕，向耶和华呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老走近的时候，以色列人举目观看，看见埃及人正追赶过来，就非常惧怕，向耶和华呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老临近的时候，以色列人举目看见埃及人赶来，就甚惧怕，向耶和华哀求。
verses.textEnNiv: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up, and there were the Egyptians, marching after them. They were terrified and cried out to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: When Pharaoh drew near, the people of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them, and they feared greatly. And the people of Israel cried out to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Pharaoh drew near, the children of Israel lifted their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians marched after them. So they were very afraid, and the children of Israel cried out to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: As Pharaoh approached, the people of Israel looked up and panicked when they saw the Egyptians overtaking them. They cried out to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: As Pharaoh approached, the sons of Israel looked, and behold, the Egyptians were coming after them, and they became very frightened; so the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord.
verses.textEn: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up, and there were the Egyptians, marching after them. They were terrified and cried out to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们对摩西说："难道埃及没有坟墓，你要把我们带来死在旷野吗？你为甚么这样待我们，把我们从埃及领出来呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对摩西说："难道埃及没有坟墓，你要把我们带来死在旷野吗？你为甚么这样待我们，把我们从埃及领出来呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对摩西说：「难道在埃及没有坟地，你把我们带来死在旷野吗？你为什么这样待我们，将我们从埃及领出来呢？
verses.textEnNiv: They said to Moses, "Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us to the desert to die? What have you done to us by bringing us out of Egypt?
verses.textEnEsv: They said to Moses, "Is it because there are no graves in Egypt that you have taken us away to die in the wilderness? What have you done to us in bringing us out of Egypt?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to Moses, "Because therewere no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you so dealt with us, to bring us up out of Egypt?
verses.textEnNlt: and they said to Moses, "Why did you bring us out here to die in the wilderness? Weren’t there enough graves for us in Egypt? What have you done to us? Why did you make us leave Egypt?
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to Moses, "Is it because there were no graves in Egypt that you have taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you dealt with us in this way, bringing us out of Egypt?
verses.textEn: They said to Moses, "Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us to the desert to die? What have you done to us by bringing us out of Egypt?

verses.textZh: 我们在埃及的时候，不是对你说过：‘不要管我们，我们要服事埃及人’这话吗？因为服事埃及人比死在旷野还好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们在埃及的时候，不是对你说过：‘不要管我们，我们要服事埃及人’这话吗？因为服事埃及人比死在旷野还好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在埃及岂没有对你说过，不要搅扰我们，容我们服事埃及人吗？因为服事埃及人比死在旷野还好。」
verses.textEnNiv: Didn’t we say to you in Egypt, ‘Leave us alone; let us serve the Egyptians’? It would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the desert!"
verses.textEnEsv: Is not this what we said to you in Egypt: ‘Leave us alone that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness."
verses.textEnNkjv: Is this not the word that we told you in Egypt, saying, ‘Let us alone that we may serve the Egyptians’? For itwouldhavebeen better for us to serve the Egyptians than that we should die in the wilderness."
verses.textEnNlt: Didn’t we tell you this would happen while we were still in Egypt? We said, ‘Leave us alone! Let us be slaves to the Egyptians. It’s better to be a slave in Egypt than a corpse in the wilderness!’"
verses.textEnNasb: Is this not the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘ Leave us alone so that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness!"
verses.textEn: Didn’t we say to you in Egypt, ‘Leave us alone; let us serve the Egyptians’? It would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the desert!"

verses.textZh: 摩西对人民说："不要惧怕，要站着，观看耶和华今天为你们施行的拯救；因为你们今天看见的埃及人，必永远不再看见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对人民说："不要惧怕，要站着，观看耶和华今天为你们施行的拯救；因为你们今天看见的埃及人，必永远不再看见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对百姓说：「不要惧怕，只管站住！看耶和华今天向你们所要施行的救恩。因为，你们今天所看见的埃及人必永远不再看见了。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses answered the people, "Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the deliverance the Lord will bring you today. The Egyptians you see today you will never see again.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to the people, "Fear not, stand firm, and see the salvation of the Lord , which he will work for you today. For the Egyptians whom you see today, you shall never see again.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which He will accomplish for you today. For the Egyptians whom you see today, you shall see again no more forever.
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses told the people, "Don’t be afraid. Just stand still and watch the Lord rescue you today. The Egyptians you see today will never be seen again.
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses said to the people, "Do not fear! Stand by and see the salvation of the Lord, which He will perform for you today; for the Egyptians whom you have seen today, you will never see them again, ever.
verses.textEn: Moses answered the people, "Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the deliverance the Lord will bring you today. The Egyptians you see today you will never see again.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必为你们争战，你们必须安静，不要作声。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必为你们争战，你们必须安静，不要作声。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必为你们争战；你们只管静默，不要作声。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will fight for you, and you have only to be silent."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will fight for you, and you shall hold your peace."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord himself will fight for you. Just stay calm."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will fight for you, while you keep silent."
verses.textEn: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你为甚么向我呼求呢？吩咐以色列人往前走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你为甚么向我呼求呢？吩咐以色列人往前走。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你为什么向我哀求呢？你吩咐以色列人往前走。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Why are you crying out to me? Tell the Israelites to move on.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses, "Why do you cry to me? Tell the people of Israel to go forward.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Why do you cry to Me? Tell the children of Israel to go forward.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Why are you crying out to me? Tell the people to get moving!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Why are you crying out to Me? Tell the sons of Israel to go forward.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Why are you crying out to me? Tell the Israelites to move on.

verses.textZh: 你要把你的杖举起来，向海伸手，把海分开，叫以色列人下到海中走干地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把你的杖举起来，向海伸手，把海分开，叫以色列人下到海中走干地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你举手向海伸杖，把水分开。以色列人要下海中走干地。
verses.textEnNiv: Raise your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea to divide the water so that the Israelites can go through the sea on dry ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Lift up your staff, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it, that the people of Israel may go through the sea on dry ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: But lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. And the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Pick up your staff and raise your hand over the sea. Divide the water so the Israelites can walk through the middle of the sea on dry ground.
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, lift up your staff and reach out with your hand over the sea and divide it, and the sons of Israel shall go through the midst of the sea on dry land.
verses.textEn: Raise your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea to divide the water so that the Israelites can go through the sea on dry ground.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我要使埃及人的心刚硬，他们就必跟着以色列人下去；这样，我必在法老和他的全军身上，以及他的马车和马兵身上得到荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我要使埃及人的心刚硬，他们就必跟着以色列人下去；这样，我必在法老和他的全军身上，以及他的马车和马兵身上得到荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使埃及人的心刚硬，他们就跟着下去。我要在法老和他的全军、车辆、马兵上得荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they will go in after them. And I will gain glory through Pharaoh and all his army, through his chariots and his horsemen.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they shall go in after them, and I will get glory over Pharaoh and all his host, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I indeed will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them. So I will gain honor over Pharaoh and over all his army, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will charge in after the Israelites. My great glory will be displayed through Pharaoh and his troops, his chariots, and his charioteers.
verses.textEnNasb: And as for Me, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they will go in after them; and I will be honored through Pharaoh and all his army, through his chariots and his horsemen.
verses.textEn: I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they will go in after them. And I will gain glory through Pharaoh and all his army, through his chariots and his horsemen.

verses.textZh: 我在法老身上，以及他的马车和马兵身上得到荣耀的时候，埃及人就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在法老身上，以及他的马车和马兵身上得到荣耀的时候，埃及人就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我在法老和他的车辆、马兵上得荣耀的时候，埃及人就知道我是耶和华了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Egyptians will know that I am the Lord when I gain glory through Pharaoh, his chariots and his horsemen."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord , when I have gotten glory over Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I have gained honor for Myself over Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen."
verses.textEnNlt: When my glory is displayed through them, all Egypt will see my glory and know that I am the Lord !"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord, when I am honored through Pharaoh, through his chariots, and through his horsemen."
verses.textEn: The Egyptians will know that I am the Lord when I gain glory through Pharaoh, his chariots and his horsemen."

verses.textZh: 在以色列营前行走的神的使者，转到他们后面去；云柱也从他们前面转过去，立在他们后面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以色列营前行走的神的使者，转到他们后面去；云柱也从他们前面转过去，立在他们后面。
verses.textZhCuv: 在以色列营前行走神的使者，转到他们后边去；云柱也从他们前边转到他们后边立住。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel of God, who had been traveling in front of Israel’s army, withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from in front and stood behind them,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel of God who was going before the host of Israel moved and went behind them, and the pillar of cloud moved from before them and stood behind them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud went from before them and stood behind them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel of God, who had been leading the people of Israel, moved to the rear of the camp. The pillar of cloud also moved from the front and stood behind them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of God, who had been going before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them and stood behind them.
verses.textEn: Then the angel of God, who had been traveling in front of Israel’s army, withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from in front and stood behind them,

verses.textZh: 云柱来到埃及营和以色列营中间；云柱一边是黑暗的，一边却光照着黑夜。这样整夜彼此都不能接近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 云柱来到埃及营和以色列营中间；云柱一边是黑暗的，一边却光照着黑夜。这样整夜彼此都不能接近。
verses.textZhCuv: 在埃及营和以色列营中间有云柱，一边黑暗，一边发光，终夜两下不得相近。
verses.textEnNiv: coming between the armies of Egypt and Israel. Throughout the night the cloud brought darkness to the one side and light to the other side; so neither went near the other all night long.
verses.textEnEsv: coming between the host of Egypt and the host of Israel. And there was the cloud and the darkness. And it lit up the night without one coming near the other all night.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel. Thus it was a cloud and darkness totheone, and it gave light by night totheother, so that the one did not come near the other all that night.
verses.textEnNlt: The cloud settled between the Egyptian and Israelite camps. As darkness fell, the cloud turned to fire, lighting up the night. But the Egyptians and Israelites did not approach each other all night.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel; and there was the cloud along with the darkness, yet it gave light at night. Therefore the one did not approach the other all night.
verses.textEn: coming between the armies of Egypt and Israel. Throughout the night the cloud brought darkness to the one side and light to the other side; so neither went near the other all night long.

verses.textZh: 摩西向海伸手，耶和华就用极强的东风，一夜之间使海水退去；他使海变成干地，海水也分开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西向海伸手，耶和华就用极强的东风，一夜之间使海水退去；他使海变成干地，海水也分开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西向海伸杖，耶和华便用大东风，使海水一夜退去，水便分开，海就成了干地。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the Lord drove the sea back with a strong east wind and turned it into dry land. The waters were divided,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the Lord drove the sea back by a strong east wind all night and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea into dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses raised his hand over the sea, and the Lord opened up a path through the water with a strong east wind. The wind blew all that night, turning the seabed into dry land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses reached out with his hand over the sea; and the Lord swept the sea back by a strong east wind all night, and turned the sea into dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.textEn: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the Lord drove the sea back with a strong east wind and turned it into dry land. The waters were divided,

verses.textZh: 以色列人下到海中走干地，水在他们的左右作了墙垣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人下到海中走干地，水在他们的左右作了墙垣。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人下海中走干地，水在他们的左右作了墙垣。
verses.textEnNiv: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel went into the midst of the sea on dry ground, the waters being a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea on the dry ground, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people of Israel walked through the middle of the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on each side!
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel went through the midst of the sea on the dry land, and the waters were like a wall to them on their right and on their left.
verses.textEn: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.

verses.textZh: 埃及人追赶过来，法老所有的马匹、马车和马兵，都跟着以色列人下到海中去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及人追赶过来，法老所有的马匹、马车和马兵，都跟着以色列人下到海中去。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人追赶他们，法老一切的马匹、车辆，和马兵都跟着下到海中。
verses.textEnNiv: The Egyptians pursued them, and all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots and horsemen followed them into the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: The Egyptians pursued and went in after them into the midst of the sea, all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Egyptians pursued and went after them into the midst of the sea, all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Egyptians—all of Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and charioteers—chased them into the middle of the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Egyptians took up the pursuit, and all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen went in after them into the midst of the sea.
verses.textEn: The Egyptians pursued them, and all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots and horsemen followed them into the sea.

verses.textZh: 到了晨更的时候，耶和华透过云柱火柱向下观看埃及人的军兵，并且使埃及人的军兵大起混乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了晨更的时候，耶和华透过云柱火柱向下观看埃及人的军兵，并且使埃及人的军兵大起混乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晨更的时候，耶和华从云火柱中向埃及的军兵观看，使埃及的军兵混乱了；
verses.textEnNiv: During the last watch of the night the Lord looked down from the pillar of fire and cloud at the Egyptian army and threw it into confusion.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the morning watch the Lord in the pillar of fire and of cloud looked down on the Egyptian forces and threw the Egyptian forces into a panic,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, in the morning watch, that the Lord looked down upon the army of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and cloud, and He troubled the army of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNlt: But just before dawn the Lord looked down on the Egyptian army from the pillar of fire and cloud, and he threw their forces into total confusion.
verses.textEnNasb: But at the morning watch, the Lord looked down on the army of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and cloud, and brought the army of the Egyptians into confusion.
verses.textEn: During the last watch of the night the Lord looked down from the pillar of fire and cloud at the Egyptian army and threw it into confusion.

verses.textZh: 又使他们的车轮脱落，行驶困难，因此埃及人说："我们从以色列人面前逃跑吧，因为耶和华为他们争战，攻击埃及人了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又使他们的车轮脱落，行驶困难，因此埃及人说："我们从以色列人面前逃跑吧，因为耶和华为他们争战，攻击埃及人了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又使他们的车轮脱落，难以行走，以致埃及人说：「我们从以色列人面前逃跑吧！因耶和华为他们攻击我们了。」
verses.textEnNiv: He jammed the wheels of their chariots so that they had difficulty driving. And the Egyptians said, "Let’s get away from the Israelites! The Lord is fighting for them against Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: clogging their chariot wheels so that they drove heavily. And the Egyptians said, "Let us flee from before Israel, for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He took off their chariot wheels, so that they drove them with difficulty; and the Egyptians said, "Let us flee from the face of Israel, for the Lord fights for them against the Egyptians."
verses.textEnNlt: He twisted their chariot wheels, making their chariots difficult to drive. "Let’s get out of here—away from these Israelites!" the Egyptians shouted. "The Lord is fighting for them against Egypt!"
verses.textEnNasb: He caused their chariot wheels to swerve, and He made them drive with difficulty; so the Egyptians each said, "Let me flee from Israel, for the Lord is fighting for them against the Egyptians."
verses.textEn: He jammed the wheels of their chariots so that they had difficulty driving. And the Egyptians said, "Let’s get away from the Israelites! The Lord is fighting for them against Egypt."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要向海伸手，使水回流到埃及人身上，流到他们的战车和马兵身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要向海伸手，使水回流到埃及人身上，流到他们的战车和马兵身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你向海伸杖，叫水仍合在埃及人并他们的车辆、马兵身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the sea so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots and horsemen."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the water may come back upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come back upon the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen."
verses.textEnNlt: When all the Israelites had reached the other side, the Lord said to Moses, "Raise your hand over the sea again. Then the waters will rush back and cover the Egyptians and their chariots and charioteers."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Reach out with your hand over the sea so that the waters may come back over the Egyptians, over their chariots and their horsemen."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the sea so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots and horsemen."

verses.textZh: 摩西就向海伸手，到了天亮的时候，海水流回原处；埃及人逆流逃跑的时候，耶和华就把他们投在海中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就向海伸手，到了天亮的时候，海水流回原处；埃及人逆流逃跑的时候，耶和华就把他们投在海中。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就向海伸杖，到了天一亮，海水仍旧复原。埃及人避水逃跑的时候，耶和华把他们推翻在海中，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea went back to its place. The Egyptians were fleeing toward it, and the Lord swept them into the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its normal course when the morning appeared. And as the Egyptians fled into it, the Lord threw the Egyptians into the midst of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and when the morning appeared, the sea returned to its full depth, while the Egyptians were fleeing into it. So the Lord overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: So as the sun began to rise, Moses raised his hand over the sea, and the water rushed back into its usual place. The Egyptians tried to escape, but the Lord swept them into the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses reached out with his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its normal state at daybreak, while the Egyptians were fleeing right into it; then the Lord overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
verses.textEn: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea went back to its place. The Egyptians were fleeing toward it, and the Lord swept them into the sea.

verses.textZh: 海水一回流，就淹没了马车、马兵和那些跟着以色列人下海去的法老的全军，连一个也没有余下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 海水一回流，就淹没了马车、马兵和那些跟着以色列人下海去的法老的全军，连一个也没有余下。
verses.textZhCuv: 水就回流，淹没了车辆和马兵。那些跟着以色列人下海法老的全军，连一个也没有剩下。
verses.textEnNiv: The water flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen—the entire army of Pharaoh that had followed the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them survived.
verses.textEnEsv: The waters returned and covered the chariots and the horsemen; of all the host of Pharaoh that had followed them into the sea, not one of them remained.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the waters returned and covered the chariots, the horsemen, and all the army of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them. Not so much as one of them remained.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the waters returned and covered all the chariots and charioteers—the entire army of Pharaoh. Of all the Egyptians who had chased the Israelites into the sea, not a single one survived.
verses.textEnNasb: The waters returned and covered the chariots and the horsemen, Pharaoh’s entire army that had gone into the sea after them; not even one of them remained.
verses.textEn: The water flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen—the entire army of Pharaoh that had followed the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them survived.

verses.textZh: 以色列人却在海中走干地，水在他们的左右作了墙垣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人却在海中走干地，水在他们的左右作了墙垣。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人却在海中走干地；水在他们的左右作了墙垣。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people of Israel walked on dry ground through the sea, the waters being a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the children of Israel had walked on dry land in the midst of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of Israel had walked through the middle of the sea on dry ground, as the water stood up like a wall on both sides.
verses.textEnNasb: But the sons of Israel walked on dry land through the midst of the sea, and the waters were like a wall to them on their right and on their left.
verses.textEn: But the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.

verses.textZh: 这样，耶和华就在那一天把以色列人从埃及人的手里拯救了出来；以色列人看见埃及人都死在海边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，耶和华就在那一天把以色列人从埃及人的手里拯救了出来；以色列人看见埃及人都死在海边。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，耶和华这样拯救以色列人脱离埃及人的手，以色列人看见埃及人的死尸都在海边了。
verses.textEnNiv: That day the Lord saved Israel from the hands of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians lying dead on the shore.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the Lord saved Israel that day from the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
verses.textEnNlt: That is how the Lord rescued Israel from the hand of the Egyptians that day. And the Israelites saw the bodies of the Egyptians washed up on the seashore.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord saved Israel that day from the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
verses.textEn: That day the Lord saved Israel from the hands of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians lying dead on the shore.

verses.textZh: 以色列人看见耶和华向埃及人所显大能的手，就敬畏耶和华，又信服耶和华和他的仆人摩西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人看见耶和华向埃及人所显大能的手，就敬畏耶和华，又信服耶和华和他的仆人摩西。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人看见耶和华向埃及人所行的大事，就敬畏耶和华，又信服他和他的仆人摩西。
verses.textEnNiv: And when the Israelites saw the mighty hand of the Lord displayed against the Egyptians, the people feared the Lord and put their trust in him and in Moses his servant.
verses.textEnEsv: Israel saw the great power that the Lord used against the Egyptians, so the people feared the Lord , and they believed in the Lord and in his servant Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Israel saw the great work which the Lord had done in Egypt; so the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord and His servant Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people of Israel saw the mighty power that the Lord had unleashed against the Egyptians, they were filled with awe before him. They put their faith in the Lord and in his servant Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: When Israel saw the great power which the Lord had used against the Egyptians, the people feared the Lord, and they believed in the Lord and in His servant Moses.
verses.textEn: And when the Israelites saw the mighty hand of the Lord displayed against the Egyptians, the people feared the Lord and put their trust in him and in Moses his servant.

verses.textZh: 那时，摩西和以色列人向耶和华唱了以下这首歌，说： "我要向耶和华歌唱，因为他高高地被高举起来；他把马匹和骑马的投在海中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，摩西和以色列人向耶和华唱了以下这首歌，说： "我要向耶和华歌唱，因为他高高地被高举起来；他把马匹和骑马的投在海中。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，摩西和以色列人向耶和华唱歌说： 我要向耶和华歌唱，因他大大战胜， 将马和骑马的投在海中。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the Lord : "I will sing to the Lord , for he is highly exalted. Both horse and driver he has hurled into the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses and the people of Israel sang this song to the Lord , saying, "I will sing to the Lord , for he has triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider he has thrown into the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the Lord, and spoke, saying: "I will sing to the Lord, For He has triumphed gloriously! The horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea!
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses and the people of Israel sang this song to the Lord : "I will sing to the Lord , for he has triumphed gloriously; he has hurled both horse and rider into the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses and the sons of Israel sang this song to the Lord, saying: " I will sing to the Lord, for He is highly exalted; The horse and its rider He has hurled into the sea.
verses.textEn: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the Lord : "I will sing to the Lord , for he is highly exalted. Both horse and driver he has hurled into the sea.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是我的力量，我的诗歌，也成了我的拯救； 这是我的神，我要赞美他； 他是我父的神，我要尊崇他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是我的力量，我的诗歌，也成了我的拯救； 这是我的神，我要赞美他； 他是我父的神，我要尊崇他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是我的力量，我的诗歌， 也成了我的拯救。 这是我的神，我要赞美他， 是我父亲的神，我要尊崇他。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord is my strength and my defense ; he has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise him, my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is my strength and my song, and he has become my salvation; this is my God, and I will praise him, my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis my strength and song, And He has become my salvation; He is my God, and I will praise Him; My father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has given me victory. This is my God, and I will praise him— my father’s God, and I will exalt him!
verses.textEnNasb: " The Lord is my strength and song, And He has become my salvation; This is my God, and I will praise Him; My father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
verses.textEn: "The Lord is my strength and my defense ; he has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise him, my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是战士，他的名是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是战士，他的名是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是战士； 他的名是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is a warrior; the Lord is his name.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is a man of war; the Lord is his name.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis a man of war; The Lordis His name.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is a warrior; Yahweh is his name!
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord is a warrior; The Lord is His name.
verses.textEn: The Lord is a warrior; the Lord is his name.

verses.textZh: 他把法老的马车和军兵都投在海里，法老特选的官长都沉在红海中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把法老的马车和军兵都投在海里，法老特选的官长都沉在红海中。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的车辆、军兵，耶和华已抛在海中； 他特选的军长都沉于红海。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh’s chariots and his army he has hurled into the sea. The best of Pharaoh’s officers are drowned in the Red Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: "Pharaoh’s chariots and his host he cast into the sea, and his chosen officers were sunk in the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pharaoh’s chariots and his army He has cast into the sea; His chosen captains also are drowned in the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh’s chariots and army he has hurled into the sea. The finest of Pharaoh’s officers are drowned in the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: "Pharaoh’s chariots and his army He has thrown into the sea; And the choicest of his officers are drowned in the Red Sea.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh’s chariots and his army he has hurled into the sea. The best of Pharaoh’s officers are drowned in the Red Sea.

verses.textZh: 波涛淹没了他们，他们好象石头坠到深海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波涛淹没了他们，他们好象石头坠到深海。
verses.textZhCuv: 深水淹没他们； 他们如同石头坠到深处。
verses.textEnNiv: The deep waters have covered them; they sank to the depths like a stone.
verses.textEnEsv: The floods covered them; they went down into the depths like a stone.
verses.textEnNkjv: The depths have covered them; They sank to the bottom like a stone.
verses.textEnNlt: The deep waters gushed over them; they sank to the bottom like a stone.
verses.textEnNasb: "The waters cover them; They went down into the depths like a stone.
verses.textEn: The deep waters have covered them; they sank to the depths like a stone.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，你的右手满有荣耀和能力；耶和华啊，你的右手击碎了仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，你的右手满有荣耀和能力；耶和华啊，你的右手击碎了仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的右手施展能力，显出荣耀； 耶和华啊，你的右手摔碎仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: Your right hand, Lord , was majestic in power. Your right hand, Lord , shattered the enemy.
verses.textEnEsv: Your right hand, O Lord , glorious in power, your right hand, O Lord , shatters the enemy.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Your right hand, O Lord, has become glorious in power; Your right hand, O Lord, has dashed the enemy in pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: "Your right hand, O Lord , is glorious in power. Your right hand, O Lord , smashes the enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your right hand, Lord, is majestic in power; Your right hand, Lord, destroys the enemy.
verses.textEn: Your right hand, Lord , was majestic in power. Your right hand, Lord , shattered the enemy.

verses.textZh: 你以莫大的威荣，毁灭了那些起来攻击你的人；你发出烈怒，把他们烧灭像烧禾秸一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你以莫大的威荣，毁灭了那些起来攻击你的人；你发出烈怒，把他们烧灭像烧禾秸一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你大发威严，推翻那些起来攻击你的； 你发出烈怒如火，烧灭他们像烧碎秸一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "In the greatness of your majesty you threw down those who opposed you. You unleashed your burning anger; it consumed them like stubble.
verses.textEnEsv: In the greatness of your majesty you overthrow your adversaries; you send out your fury; it consumes them like stubble.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the greatness of Your excellence You have overthrown those who rose against You; You sent forth Your wrath; It consumed them like stubble.
verses.textEnNlt: In the greatness of your majesty, you overthrow those who rise against you. You unleash your blazing fury; it consumes them like straw.
verses.textEnNasb: "And in the greatness of Your excellence You overthrow those who rise up against You; You send out Your burning anger, and it consumes them like chaff.
verses.textEn: "In the greatness of your majesty you threw down those who opposed you. You unleashed your burning anger; it consumed them like stubble.

verses.textZh: 你鼻孔中的气一发，海水就堆聚起来；水流直立像堤坝，深渊凝结于海心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你鼻孔中的气一发，海水就堆聚起来；水流直立像堤坝，深渊凝结于海心。
verses.textZhCuv: 你发鼻中的气，水便聚起成堆， 大水直立如垒， 海中的深水凝结。
verses.textEnNiv: By the blast of your nostrils the waters piled up. The surging waters stood up like a wall; the deep waters congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: At the blast of your nostrils the waters piled up; the floods stood up in a heap; the deeps congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: And with the blast of Your nostrils The waters were gathered together; The floods stood upright like a heap; The depths congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: At the blast of your breath, the waters piled up! The surging waters stood straight like a wall; in the heart of the sea the deep waters became hard.
verses.textEnNasb: "At the blast of Your nostrils the waters were piled up, The flowing waters stood up like a heap; The depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.textEn: By the blast of your nostrils the waters piled up. The surging waters stood up like a wall; the deep waters congealed in the heart of the sea.

verses.textZh: 仇敌说：‘我要追赶，我要追上，我要均分掳物；我要在他们身上得到满足；我要拔出刀来，亲手赶绝他们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 仇敌说：‘我要追赶，我要追上，我要均分掳物；我要在他们身上得到满足；我要拔出刀来，亲手赶绝他们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 仇敌说：我要追赶，我要追上； 我要分掳物，我要在他们身上称我的心愿。 我要拔出刀来，亲手杀灭他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The enemy boasted, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake them. I will divide the spoils; I will gorge myself on them. I will draw my sword and my hand will destroy them.’
verses.textEnEsv: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil, my desire shall have its fill of them. I will draw my sword; my hand shall destroy them.’
verses.textEnNkjv: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; My desire shall be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword, My hand shall destroy them.’
verses.textEnNlt: "The enemy boasted, ‘I will chase them and catch up with them. I will plunder them and consume them. I will flash my sword; my powerful hand will destroy them.’
verses.textEnNasb: "The enemy said, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoils; I shall be satisfied against them; I will draw my sword, my hand will destroy them.’
verses.textEn: The enemy boasted, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake them. I will divide the spoils; I will gorge myself on them. I will draw my sword and my hand will destroy them.’

verses.textZh: 你用风一吹，海就把他们淹没，他们就像铅一样沉在大水之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你用风一吹，海就把他们淹没，他们就像铅一样沉在大水之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 你叫风一吹，海就把他们淹没； 他们如铅沉在大水之中。
verses.textEnNiv: But you blew with your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
verses.textEnEsv: You blew with your wind; the sea covered them; they sank like lead in the mighty waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: You blew with Your wind, The sea covered them; They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
verses.textEnNlt: But you blew with your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
verses.textEnNasb: "You blew with Your wind, the sea covered them; They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
verses.textEn: But you blew with your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，万神之中有谁像你呢？ 有谁像你荣耀圣洁，可颂可畏，施行奇事呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，万神之中有谁像你呢？ 有谁像你荣耀圣洁，可颂可畏，施行奇事呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，众神之中，谁能像你？ 谁能像你－至圣至荣， 可颂可畏，施行奇事？
verses.textEnNiv: Who among the gods is like you, Lord ? Who is like you— majestic in holiness, awesome in glory, working wonders?
verses.textEnEsv: "Who is like you, O Lord , among the gods? Who is like you, majestic in holiness, awesome in glorious deeds, doing wonders?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who is like You, O Lord, among the gods? Who is like You, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verses.textEnNlt: "Who is like you among the gods, O Lord — glorious in holiness, awesome in splendor, performing great wonders?
verses.textEnNasb: "Who is like You among the gods, Lord? Who is like You, majestic in holiness, Awesome in praises, working wonders?
verses.textEn: Who among the gods is like you, Lord ? Who is like you— majestic in holiness, awesome in glory, working wonders?

verses.textZh: 你伸出右手，地就吞没他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你伸出右手，地就吞没他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你伸出右手， 地便吞灭他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "You stretch out your right hand, and the earth swallows your enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: You stretched out your right hand; the earth swallowed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You stretched out Your right hand; The earth swallowed them.
verses.textEnNlt: You raised your right hand, and the earth swallowed our enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: "You reached out with Your right hand, The earth swallowed them.
verses.textEn: "You stretch out your right hand, and the earth swallows your enemies.

verses.textZh: 你凭着慈爱，带领了你买赎的人民；你凭着能力，引导了他们到你的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你凭着慈爱，带领了你买赎的人民；你凭着能力，引导了他们到你的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 你凭慈爱领了你所赎的百姓； 你凭能力引他们到了你的圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: In your unfailing love you will lead the people you have redeemed. In your strength you will guide them to your holy dwelling.
verses.textEnEsv: "You have led in your steadfast love the people whom you have redeemed; you have guided them by your strength to your holy abode.
verses.textEnNkjv: You in Your mercy have led forth The people whom You have redeemed; You have guided them in Your strength To Your holy habitation.
verses.textEnNlt: "With your unfailing love you lead the people you have redeemed. In your might, you guide them to your sacred home.
verses.textEnNasb: "In Your faithfulness You have led the people whom You have redeemed; In Your strength You have guided them to Your holy habitation.
verses.textEn: In your unfailing love you will lead the people you have redeemed. In your strength you will guide them to your holy dwelling.

verses.textZh: 万民听见，就必战抖；疼痛恐惧抓住了非利士的居民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万民听见，就必战抖；疼痛恐惧抓住了非利士的居民。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人听见就发颤； 疼痛抓住非利士的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: The nations will hear and tremble; anguish will grip the people of Philistia.
verses.textEnEsv: The peoples have heard; they tremble; pangs have seized the inhabitants of Philistia.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The people will hear and be afraid; Sorrow will take hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
verses.textEnNlt: The peoples hear and tremble; anguish grips those who live in Philistia.
verses.textEnNasb: "The peoples have heard, they tremble; Anguish has gripped the inhabitants of Philistia.
verses.textEn: The nations will hear and tremble; anguish will grip the people of Philistia.

verses.textZh: 那时，以东的族长惊惶，摩押的英雄被战兢抓住，所有迦南的居民都胆战心寒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以东的族长惊惶，摩押的英雄被战兢抓住，所有迦南的居民都胆战心寒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，以东的族长惊惶， 摩押的英雄被战兢抓住， 迦南的居民心都消化了。
verses.textEnNiv: The chiefs of Edom will be terrified, the leaders of Moab will be seized with trembling, the people of Canaan will melt away;
verses.textEnEsv: Now are the chiefs of Edom dismayed; trembling seizes the leaders of Moab; all the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed; The mighty men of Moab, Trembling will take hold of them; All the inhabitants of Canaan will melt away.
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders of Edom are terrified; the nobles of Moab tremble. All who live in Canaan melt away;
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the chiefs of Edom were terrified; The leaders of Moab, trembling grips them; All the inhabitants of Canaan have despaired.
verses.textEn: The chiefs of Edom will be terrified, the leaders of Moab will be seized with trembling, the people of Canaan will melt away;

verses.textZh: 恐惧战兢临到他们身上；因着你大能的手臂，他们像石头一样寂然不动；直到你的人民过去，耶和华啊，直到你买赎的人民过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐惧战兢临到他们身上；因着你大能的手臂，他们像石头一样寂然不动；直到你的人民过去，耶和华啊，直到你买赎的人民过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 惊骇恐惧临到他们。 耶和华啊，因你膀臂的大能， 他们如石头寂然不动， 等候你的百姓过去， 等候你所赎的百姓过去。
verses.textEnNiv: terror and dread will fall on them. By the power of your arm they will be as still as a stone— until your people pass by, Lord , until the people you bought pass by.
verses.textEnEsv: Terror and dread fall upon them; because of the greatness of your arm, they are still as a stone, till your people, O Lord , pass by, till the people pass by whom you have purchased.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fear and dread will fall on them; By the greatness of Your arm They will be as still as a stone, Till Your people pass over, O Lord, Till the people pass over Whom You have purchased.
verses.textEnNlt: terror and dread fall upon them. The power of your arm makes them lifeless as stone until your people pass by, O Lord , until the people you purchased pass by.
verses.textEnNasb: "Terror and dread fall upon them; By the greatness of Your arm they are motionless as stone, Until Your people pass over, Lord, Until the people pass over whom You have purchased.
verses.textEn: terror and dread will fall on them. By the power of your arm they will be as still as a stone— until your people pass by, Lord , until the people you bought pass by.

verses.textZh: 你要把他们领进去，栽种在你产业的山上，耶和华啊，就是在你为自己预备的住处；主啊，就是在你手建立的圣所上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把他们领进去，栽种在你产业的山上，耶和华啊，就是在你为自己预备的住处；主啊，就是在你手建立的圣所上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要将他们领进去，栽于你产业的山上－ 耶和华啊，就是你为自己所造的住处； 主啊，就是你手所建立的圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of your inheritance— the place, Lord , you made for your dwelling, the sanctuary, Lord, your hands established.
verses.textEnEsv: You will bring them in and plant them on your own mountain, the place, O Lord , which you have made for your abode, the sanctuary, O Lord, which your hands have established.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will bring them in and plant them In the mountain of Your inheritance, In the place, O Lord, which You have made For Your own dwelling, The sanctuary, O Lord, which Your hands have established.
verses.textEnNlt: You will bring them in and plant them on your own mountain— the place, O Lord , reserved for your own dwelling, the sanctuary, O Lord, that your hands have established.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will bring them and plant them in the mountain of Your inheritance, The place, Lord, which You have made as Your dwelling, The sanctuary, Lord, which Your hands have established.
verses.textEn: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of your inheritance— the place, Lord , you made for your dwelling, the sanctuary, Lord, your hands established.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必作王，直到永永远远。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必作王，直到永永远远。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必作王，直到永永远远！
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord reigns for ever and ever."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will reign forever and ever."
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord shall reign forever and ever."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will reign forever and ever!"
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord shall reign forever and ever."
verses.textEn: "The Lord reigns for ever and ever."

verses.textZh: 因为法老的马匹、战车和马兵进到海中去的时候，耶和华使海水回流到他们身上；以色列人却在海中走干地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为法老的马匹、战车和马兵进到海中去的时候，耶和华使海水回流到他们身上；以色列人却在海中走干地。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的马匹、车辆，和马兵下到海中，耶和华使海水回流，淹没他们；惟有以色列人在海中走干地。
verses.textEnNiv: When Pharaoh’s horses, chariots and horsemen went into the sea, the Lord brought the waters of the sea back over them, but the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.
verses.textEnEsv: For when the horses of Pharaoh with his chariots and his horsemen went into the sea, the Lord brought back the waters of the sea upon them, but the people of Israel walked on dry ground in the midst of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the horses of Pharaoh went with his chariots and his horsemen into the sea, and the Lord brought back the waters of the sea upon them. But the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: When Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and charioteers rushed into the sea, the Lord brought the water crashing down on them. But the people of Israel had walked through the middle of the sea on dry ground!
verses.textEnNasb: For the horses of Pharaoh with his chariots and his horsemen went into the sea, and the Lord brought back the waters of the sea on them, but the sons of Israel walked on dry land through the midst of the sea.
verses.textEn: When Pharaoh’s horses, chariots and horsemen went into the sea, the Lord brought the waters of the sea back over them, but the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的姊姊女先知米利暗，手里拿着鼓；所有的妇女都跟着她出来，击鼓跳舞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的姊姊女先知米利暗，手里拿着鼓；所有的妇女都跟着她出来，击鼓跳舞。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的姊姊，女先知米利暗，手里拿着鼓；众妇女也跟她出去拿鼓跳舞。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Miriam the prophet, Aaron’s sister, took a timbrel in her hand, and all the women followed her, with timbrels and dancing.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women went out after her with tambourines and dancing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took the timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Miriam the prophet, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine and led all the women as they played their tambourines and danced.
verses.textEnNasb: Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took the tambourine in her hand, and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dancing.
verses.textEn: Then Miriam the prophet, Aaron’s sister, took a timbrel in her hand, and all the women followed her, with timbrels and dancing.

verses.textZh: 米利暗应和着她们说："你们要向耶和华歌唱，因为他高高地被高举起来，他把马匹和骑马的投在海中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米利暗应和着她们说："你们要向耶和华歌唱，因为他高高地被高举起来，他把马匹和骑马的投在海中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米利暗应声说： 你们要歌颂耶和华，因他大大战胜， 将马和骑马的投在海中。
verses.textEnNiv: Miriam sang to them: "Sing to the Lord , for he is highly exalted. Both horse and driver he has hurled into the sea."
verses.textEnEsv: And Miriam sang to them: "Sing to the Lord , for he has triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider he has thrown into the sea."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Miriam answered them: "Sing to the Lord, For He has triumphed gloriously! The horse and its rider He has thrown into the sea!"
verses.textEnNlt: And Miriam sang this song: "Sing to the Lord , for he has triumphed gloriously; he has hurled both horse and rider into the sea."
verses.textEnNasb: And Miriam answered them, "Sing to the Lord, for He is highly exalted; The horse and its rider He has hurled into the sea."
verses.textEn: Miriam sang to them: "Sing to the Lord , for he is highly exalted. Both horse and driver he has hurled into the sea."

verses.textZh: 摩西命以色列人从红海起程，到书珥旷野去；他们在旷野走了三天，找不着水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西命以色列人从红海起程，到书珥旷野去；他们在旷野走了三天，找不着水。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西领以色列人从红海往前行，到了书珥的旷野，在旷野走了三天，找不着水。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea and they went into the Desert of Shur. For three days they traveled in the desert without finding water.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses made Israel set out from the Red Sea, and they went into the wilderness of Shur. They went three days in the wilderness and found no water.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses brought Israel from the Red Sea; then they went out into the Wilderness of Shur. And they went three days in the wilderness and found no water.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses led the people of Israel away from the Red Sea, and they moved out into the desert of Shur. They traveled in this desert for three days without finding any water.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness and found no water.
verses.textEn: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea and they went into the Desert of Shur. For three days they traveled in the desert without finding water.

verses.textZh: 后来到了玛拉，玛拉的水却不能喝，因为水苦。因此，那地名叫玛拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来到了玛拉，玛拉的水却不能喝，因为水苦。因此，那地名叫玛拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了玛拉，不能喝那里的水；因为水苦，所以那地名叫玛拉。
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to Marah, they could not drink its water because it was bitter. (That is why the place is called Marah. )
verses.textEnEsv: When they came to Marah, they could not drink the water of Marah because it was bitter; therefore it was named Marah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they came to Marah, they could not drink the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore the name of it was called Marah.
verses.textEnNlt: When they came to the oasis of Marah, the water was too bitter to drink. So they called the place Marah (which means "bitter").
verses.textEnNasb: When they came to Marah, they could not drink the waters of Marah, because they were bitter; for that reason it was named Marah.
verses.textEn: When they came to Marah, they could not drink its water because it was bitter. (That is why the place is called Marah. )

verses.textZh: 人民就向摩西发怨言，说："我们喝甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民就向摩西发怨言，说："我们喝甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓就向摩西发怨言，说：「我们喝什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So the people grumbled against Moses, saying, "What are we to drink?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the people grumbled against Moses, saying, "What shall we drink?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people complained against Moses, saying, "What shall we drink?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people complained and turned against Moses. "What are we going to drink?" they demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people grumbled at Moses, saying, "What are we to drink?"
verses.textEn: So the people grumbled against Moses, saying, "What are we to drink?"

verses.textZh: 摩西向耶和华呼叫，耶和华就向他指示一棵树；他把树丢进水里，水就变甜了。耶和华在那里为他们立了律例和典章，也在那里试验了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西向耶和华呼叫，耶和华就向他指示一棵树；他把树丢进水里，水就变甜了。耶和华在那里为他们立了律例和典章，也在那里试验了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西呼求耶和华，耶和华指示他一棵树。他把树丢在水里，水就变甜了。 耶和华在那里为他们定了律例、典章，在那里试验他们；
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses cried out to the Lord , and the Lord showed him a piece of wood. He threw it into the water, and the water became fit to drink. There the Lord issued a ruling and instruction for them and put them to the test.
verses.textEnEsv: And he cried to the Lord , and the Lord showed him a log, and he threw it into the water, and the water became sweet. There the Lord made for them a statute and a rule, and there he tested them,
verses.textEnNkjv: So he cried out to the Lord, and the Lord showed him a tree. When he cast it into the waters, the waters were made sweet. There He made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there He tested them,
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses cried out to the Lord for help, and the Lord showed him a piece of wood. Moses threw it into the water, and this made the water good to drink. It was there at Marah that the Lord set before them the following decree as a standard to test their faithfulness to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he cried out to the Lord, and the Lord showed him a tree; and he threw it into the waters, and the waters became sweet. There He made for them a statute and regulation, and there He tested them.
verses.textEn: Then Moses cried out to the Lord , and the Lord showed him a piece of wood. He threw it into the water, and the water became fit to drink. There the Lord issued a ruling and instruction for them and put them to the test.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又说："如果你留意听耶和华你神的声音，行他眼中看为正的事，侧耳听他的诫命，遵守他的一切律例；这样，我决不把加在埃及人身上的一切疾病加在你们身上，因为我是医治你的耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又说："如果你留意听耶和华你神的声音，行他眼中看为正的事，侧耳听他的诫命，遵守他的一切律例；这样，我决不把加在埃及人身上的一切疾病加在你们身上，因为我是医治你的耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「你若留意听耶和华－你神的话，又行我眼中看为正的事，留心听我的诫命，守我一切的律例，我就不将所加与埃及人的疾病加在你身上，因为我－耶和华是医治你的。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "If you listen carefully to the Lord your God and do what is right in his eyes, if you pay attention to his commands and keep all his decrees, I will not bring on you any of the diseases I brought on the Egyptians, for I am the Lord , who heals you."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "If you will diligently listen to the voice of the Lord your God, and do that which is right in his eyes, and give ear to his commandments and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you that I put on the Egyptians, for I am the Lord , your healer."
verses.textEnNkjv: and said, "If you diligently heed the voice of the Lord your God and do what is right in His sight, give ear to His commandments and keep all His statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have brought on the Egyptians. For I am the Lord who heals you."
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "If you will listen carefully to the voice of the Lord your God and do what is right in his sight, obeying his commands and keeping all his decrees, then I will not make you suffer any of the diseases I sent on the Egyptians; for I am the Lord who heals you."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "If you will listen carefully to the voice of the Lord your God, and do what is right in His sight, and listen to His commandments, and keep all His statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I, the Lord, am your healer."
verses.textEn: He said, "If you listen carefully to the Lord your God and do what is right in his eyes, if you pay attention to his commands and keep all his decrees, I will not bring on you any of the diseases I brought on the Egyptians, for I am the Lord , who heals you."

verses.textZh: 后来他们到了以琳，那里有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树。他们就在那里靠近水边的地方安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来他们到了以琳，那里有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树。他们就在那里靠近水边的地方安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了以琳，在那里有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树；他们就在那里的水边安营。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there near the water.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there by the water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve wells of water and seventy palm trees; so they camped there by the waters.
verses.textEnNlt: After leaving Marah, the Israelites traveled on to the oasis of Elim, where they found twelve springs and seventy palm trees. They camped there beside the water.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they came to Elim where there were twelve springs of water and seventy date palms, and they camped there beside the waters.
verses.textEn: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there near the water.

verses.textZh: 以色列全体会众从以琳起行，在出埃及以后第二个月十五日，来到以琳和西奈中间汛的旷野那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列全体会众从以琳起行，在出埃及以后第二个月十五日，来到以琳和西奈中间汛的旷野那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列全会众从以琳起行，在出埃及后第二个月十五日到了以琳和西奈中间、汛的旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole Israelite community set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had come out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: They set out from Elim, and all the congregation of the people of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had departed from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they journeyed from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the Wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they departed from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the whole community of Israel set out from Elim and journeyed into the wilderness of Sin, between Elim and Mount Sinai. They arrived there on the fifteenth day of the second month, one month after leaving the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they set out from Elim, and all the congregation of the sons of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departure from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: The whole Israelite community set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had come out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 以色列全体会众在旷野都向摩西和亚伦发怨言；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列全体会众在旷野都向摩西和亚伦发怨言；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列全会众在旷野向摩西、亚伦发怨言，
verses.textEnNiv: In the desert the whole community grumbled against Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: And the whole congregation of the people of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the whole congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: There, too, the whole community of Israel complained about Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: But the whole congregation of the sons of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: In the desert the whole community grumbled against Moses and Aaron.

verses.textZh: 以色列人对他们说："我们宁愿在埃及地坐在肉锅旁边，吃饭吃到饱的时候，死在耶和华的手里！你们倒把我们领出来，到这旷野，是要叫这全体会众饿死啊！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人对他们说："我们宁愿在埃及地坐在肉锅旁边，吃饭吃到饱的时候，死在耶和华的手里！你们倒把我们领出来，到这旷野，是要叫这全体会众饿死啊！"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「巴不得我们早死在埃及地、耶和华的手下；那时我们坐在肉锅旁边，吃得饱足。你们将我们领出来，到这旷野，是要叫这全会众都饿死啊！」
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites said to them, "If only we had died by the Lord ’s hand in Egypt! There we sat around pots of meat and ate all the food we wanted, but you have brought us out into this desert to starve this entire assembly to death."
verses.textEnEsv: and the people of Israel said to them, "Would that we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots and ate bread to the full, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel said to them, "Oh, that we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the pots of meat and when we ate bread to the full! For you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger."
verses.textEnNlt: "If only the Lord had killed us back in Egypt," they moaned. "There we sat around pots filled with meat and ate all the bread we wanted. But now you have brought us into this wilderness to starve us all to death."
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Israel said to them, "If only we had died by the Lord’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the pots of meat, when we ate bread until we were full; for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this entire assembly with hunger!"
verses.textEn: The Israelites said to them, "If only we had died by the Lord ’s hand in Egypt! There we sat around pots of meat and ate all the food we wanted, but you have brought us out into this desert to starve this entire assembly to death."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，我要把粮食从天上降给你们；人民可以出去，每天收取当天的分量，我好试验他们是否遵行我的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，我要把粮食从天上降给你们；人民可以出去，每天收取当天的分量，我好试验他们是否遵行我的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「我要将粮食从天降给你们。百姓可以出去，每天收每天的分，我好试验他们遵不遵我的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "I will rain down bread from heaven for you. The people are to go out each day and gather enough for that day. In this way I will test them and see whether they will follow my instructions.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I am about to rain bread from heaven for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you. And the people shall go out and gather a certain quota every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in My law or not.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Look, I’m going to rain down food from heaven for you. Each day the people can go out and pick up as much food as they need for that day. I will test them in this to see whether or not they will follow my instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, so that I may test them, whether or not they will walk in My instruction.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "I will rain down bread from heaven for you. The people are to go out each day and gather enough for that day. In this way I will test them and see whether they will follow my instructions.

verses.textZh: 到第六天，他们把收进来的预备好，比每天收取的多一倍。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到第六天，他们把收进来的预备好，比每天收取的多一倍。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到第六天，他们要把所收进来的预备好了，比每天所收的多一倍。」
verses.textEnNiv: On the sixth day they are to prepare what they bring in, and that is to be twice as much as they gather on the other days."
verses.textEnEsv: On the sixth day, when they prepare what they bring in, it will be twice as much as they gather daily."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be on the sixth day that they shall prepare what they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily."
verses.textEnNlt: On the sixth day they will gather food, and when they prepare it, there will be twice as much as usual."
verses.textEnNasb: On the sixth day, when they prepare what they bring in, it will be twice as much as they gather daily."
verses.textEn: On the sixth day they are to prepare what they bring in, and that is to be twice as much as they gather on the other days."

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦对以色列众人说："今晚你们必定知道是耶和华把你们从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦对以色列众人说："今晚你们必定知道是耶和华把你们从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦对以色列众人说：「到了晚上，你们要知道是耶和华将你们从埃及地领出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, "In the evening you will know that it was the Lord who brought you out of Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses and Aaron said to all the people of Israel, "At evening you shall know that it was the Lord who brought you out of the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, "At evening you shall know that the Lord has brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and Aaron said to all the people of Israel, "By evening you will realize it was the Lord who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses and Aaron said to all the sons of Israel, "At evening you will know that the Lord has brought you out of the land of Egypt;
verses.textEn: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, "In the evening you will know that it was the Lord who brought you out of Egypt,

verses.textZh: 明早你们必定看见耶和华的荣耀，因为耶和华听见了你们向他所发的怨言了。我们算甚么，你们竟向我们发怨言呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 明早你们必定看见耶和华的荣耀，因为耶和华听见了你们向他所发的怨言了。我们算甚么，你们竟向我们发怨言呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 早晨，你们要看见耶和华的荣耀，因为耶和华听见你们向他所发的怨言了。我们算什么，你们竟向我们发怨言呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: and in the morning you will see the glory of the Lord , because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we, that you should grumble against us?"
verses.textEnEsv: and in the morning you shall see the glory of the Lord , because he has heard your grumbling against the Lord . For what are we, that you grumble against us?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the morning you shall see the glory of the Lord; for He hears your complaints against the Lord. But what are we, that you complain against us?"
verses.textEnNlt: In the morning you will see the glory of the Lord , because he has heard your complaints, which are against him, not against us. What have we done that you should complain about us?"
verses.textEnNasb: and in the morning you will see the glory of the Lord, for He hears your grumblings against the Lord; and what are we, that you grumble against us?"
verses.textEn: and in the morning you will see the glory of the Lord , because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we, that you should grumble against us?"

verses.textZh: 摩西又说："耶和华晚上必给你们肉吃，早晨必给你们食物吃饱，因为耶和华听见了你们埋怨他所说的怨言了。我们算甚么？你们的怨言不是向我们发的，而是向耶和华发的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西又说："耶和华晚上必给你们肉吃，早晨必给你们食物吃饱，因为耶和华听见了你们埋怨他所说的怨言了。我们算甚么？你们的怨言不是向我们发的，而是向耶和华发的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西又说：「耶和华晚上必给你们肉吃，早晨必给你们食物得饱；因为你们向耶和华发的怨言，他都听见了。我们算什么，你们的怨言不是向我们发的，乃是向耶和华发的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses also said, "You will know that it was the Lord when he gives you meat to eat in the evening and all the bread you want in the morning, because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we? You are not grumbling against us, but against the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said, "When the Lord gives you in the evening meat to eat and in the morning bread to the full, because the Lord has heard your grumbling that you grumble against him— what are we? Your grumbling is not against us but against the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Moses said, "Thisshallbeseen when the Lord gives you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to the full; for the Lord hears your complaints which you make against Him. And what are we? Your complaints are not against us but against the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses added, "The Lord will give you meat to eat in the evening and bread to satisfy you in the morning, for he has heard all your complaints against him. What have we done? Yes, your complaints are against the Lord , not against us."
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses said, "This will happen when the Lord gives you meat to eat in the evening, and bread to the full in the morning; for the Lord hears your grumblings which you grumble against Him. And what are we? Your grumblings are not against us but against the Lord."
verses.textEn: Moses also said, "You will know that it was the Lord when he gives you meat to eat in the evening and all the bread you want in the morning, because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we? You are not grumbling against us, but against the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 摩西对亚伦说："你要对以色列全体会众说：‘你们走近耶和华面前，因为他已经听见了你们的怨言了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对亚伦说："你要对以色列全体会众说：‘你们走近耶和华面前，因为他已经听见了你们的怨言了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对亚伦说：「你告诉以色列全会众说：『你们就近耶和华面前，因为他已经听见你们的怨言了。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses told Aaron, "Say to the entire Israelite community, ‘Come before the Lord , for he has heard your grumbling.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Say to the whole congregation of the people of Israel, ‘Come near before the Lord , for he has heard your grumbling.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses spoke to Aaron, "Say to all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come near before the Lord, for He has heard your complaints.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Announce this to the entire community of Israel: ‘Present yourselves before the Lord , for he has heard your complaining.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Say to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, ‘Come forward before the Lord, for He has heard your grumblings.’ "
verses.textEn: Then Moses told Aaron, "Say to the entire Israelite community, ‘Come before the Lord , for he has heard your grumbling.’ "

verses.textZh: 亚伦对以色列全体会众说话的时候，他们向着旷野观望，看见耶和华的荣耀在云中显现出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦对以色列全体会众说话的时候，他们向着旷野观望，看见耶和华的荣耀在云中显现出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦正对以色列全会众说话的时候，他们向旷野观看，不料，耶和华的荣光在云中显现。
verses.textEnNiv: While Aaron was speaking to the whole Israelite community, they looked toward the desert, and there was the glory of the Lord appearing in the cloud.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the people of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, as Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.
verses.textEnNlt: And as Aaron spoke to the whole community of Israel, they looked out toward the wilderness. There they could see the awesome glory of the Lord in the cloud.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, as Aaron spoke to the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.
verses.textEn: While Aaron was speaking to the whole Israelite community, they looked toward the desert, and there was the glory of the Lord appearing in the cloud.

verses.textZh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "以色列人的怨言，我已经听见了。你告诉他们说：‘黄昏的时候你们必吃肉，早晨的时候必有食物吃饱；这样，你们就知道我耶和华是你们的神了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列人的怨言，我已经听见了。你告诉他们说：‘黄昏的时候你们必吃肉，早晨的时候必有食物吃饱；这样，你们就知道我耶和华是你们的神了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「我已经听见以色列人的怨言。你告诉他们说：『到黄昏的时候，你们要吃肉，早晨必有食物得饱，你们就知道我是耶和华－你们的神。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites. Tell them, ‘At twilight you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "I have heard the grumbling of the people of Israel. Say to them, ‘At twilight you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you shall know that I am the Lord your God.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At twilight you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. And you shall know that I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "I have heard the Israelites’ complaints. Now tell them, ‘In the evening you will have meat to eat, and in the morning you will have all the bread you want. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "I have heard the grumblings of the sons of Israel; speak to them, saying, ‘ At twilight you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread; and you shall know that I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEn: "I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites. Tell them, ‘At twilight you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God.’ "

verses.textZh: 到了晚上，有鹌鹑飞上来，把营都遮盖了；到了早晨，营的四周有一层露水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了晚上，有鹌鹑飞上来，把营都遮盖了；到了早晨，营的四周有一层露水。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晚上，有鹌鹑飞来，遮满了营；早晨在营四围的地上有露水。
verses.textEnNiv: That evening quail came and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: In the evening quail came up and covered the camp, and in the morning dew lay around the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was that quails came up at evening and covered the camp, and in the morning the dew lay all around the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: That evening vast numbers of quail flew in and covered the camp. And the next morning the area around the camp was wet with dew.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about at evening that the quails came up and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.
verses.textEn: That evening quail came and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.

verses.textZh: 露水上升以后，就见野地上有细小鳞状的东西，像小白霜一样细小的东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 露水上升以后，就见野地上有细小鳞状的东西，像小白霜一样细小的东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 露水上升之后，不料，野地面上有如白霜的小圆物。
verses.textEnNiv: When the dew was gone, thin flakes like frost on the ground appeared on the desert floor.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the dew had gone up, there was on the face of the wilderness a fine, flake-like thing, fine as frost on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the layer of dew lifted, there, on the surface of the wilderness, was a small round substance, as fine as frost on the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: When the dew evaporated, a flaky substance as fine as frost blanketed the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: When the layer of dew evaporated, behold, on the surface of the wilderness there was a fine flake-like thing, fine as the frost on the ground.
verses.textEn: When the dew was gone, thin flakes like frost on the ground appeared on the desert floor.

verses.textZh: 以色列人看见了，就彼此对问说："这是甚么？"原来他们不知道那是甚么。摩西对他们说："这就是耶和华赐给你们吃的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人看见了，就彼此对问说："这是甚么？"原来他们不知道那是甚么。摩西对他们说："这就是耶和华赐给你们吃的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人看见，不知道是什么，就彼此对问说：「这是什么呢？」摩西对他们说：「这就是耶和华给你们吃的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Israelites saw it, they said to each other, "What is it?" For they did not know what it was. Moses said to them, "It is the bread the Lord has given you to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: When the people of Israel saw it, they said to one another, "What is it?" For they did not know what it was. And Moses said to them, "It is the bread that the Lord has given you to eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, "What is it?" For they did not know what it was. And Moses said to them, "This is the bread which the Lord has given you to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites were puzzled when they saw it. "What is it?" they asked each other. They had no idea what it was. And Moses told them, "It is the food the Lord has given you to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sons of Israel saw it, they said to one another, " What is it?" For they did not know what it was. And Moses said to them, "It is the bread which the Lord has given you to eat.
verses.textEn: When the Israelites saw it, they said to each other, "What is it?" For they did not know what it was. Moses said to them, "It is the bread the Lord has given you to eat.

verses.textZh: 耶和华吩咐的话是这样的：‘你们要按着各人的食量收取，按着你们的人数为帐幕里的人收取，一人两公升。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华吩咐的话是这样的：‘你们要按着各人的食量收取，按着你们的人数为帐幕里的人收取，一人两公升。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华所吩咐的是这样：你们要按着各人的饭量，为帐棚里的人，按着人数收起来，各拿一俄梅珥。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Everyone is to gather as much as they need. Take an omer for each person you have in your tent.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Gather of it, each one of you, as much as he can eat. You shall each take an omer, according to the number of the persons that each of you has in his tent.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the thing which the Lord has commanded: ‘Let every man gather it according to each one’s need, one omer for each person, accordingtothe number of persons; let every man take for those who are in his tent.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: These are the Lord ’s instructions: Each household should gather as much as it needs. Pick up two quarts for each person in your tent."
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Everyone gather as much as he will eat; you shall take an omer apiece according to the number of people each of you has in his tent.’ "
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Everyone is to gather as much as they need. Take an omer for each person you have in your tent.’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列人就这样行了；有的多收、有的少收。
