verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就这样行了；有的多收、有的少收。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人就这样行；有多收的，有少收的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites did as they were told; some gathered much, some little.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel did so. They gathered, some more, some less.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel did so and gathered, some more, some less.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people of Israel did as they were told. Some gathered a lot, some only a little.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Israel did so, and some gathered much and some little.
verses.textEn: The Israelites did as they were told; some gathered much, some little.

verses.textZh: 他们用升斗衡量的时候，多收的没有剩余，少收的也不缺乏；各人按着自己的食量收取。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用升斗衡量的时候，多收的没有剩余，少收的也不缺乏；各人按着自己的食量收取。
verses.textZhCuv: 及至用俄梅珥量一量，多收的也没有余，少收的也没有缺；各人按着自己的饭量收取。
verses.textEnNiv: And when they measured it by the omer, the one who gathered much did not have too much, and the one who gathered little did not have too little. Everyone had gathered just as much as they needed.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they measured it with an omer, whoever gathered much had nothing left over, and whoever gathered little had no lack. Each of them gathered as much as he could eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they measured it by omers, he who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack. Every man had gathered according to each one’s need.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they measured it out, everyone had just enough. Those who gathered a lot had nothing left over, and those who gathered only a little had enough. Each family had just what it needed.
verses.textEnNasb: When they measured it by the omer, the one who had gathered much did not have too much, and the one who had gathered little did not have too little; everyone gathered as much as he would eat.
verses.textEn: And when they measured it by the omer, the one who gathered much did not have too much, and the one who gathered little did not have too little. Everyone had gathered just as much as they needed.

verses.textZh: 摩西对他们说："谁也不可把一些留到早晨。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对他们说："谁也不可把一些留到早晨。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对他们说：「所收的，不许什么人留到早晨。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said to them, "No one is to keep any of it until morning."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to them, "Let no one leave any of it over till the morning."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said, "Let no one leave any of it till morning."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses told them, "Do not keep any of it until morning."
verses.textEnNasb: Moses said to them, "No one is to leave any of it until morning."
verses.textEn: Then Moses said to them, "No one is to keep any of it until morning."

verses.textZh: 他们却不听摩西的话，有人把一些留到早晨，就生虫发臭了。摩西就向他们发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却不听摩西的话，有人把一些留到早晨，就生虫发臭了。摩西就向他们发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而他们不听摩西的话，内中有留到早晨的，就生虫变臭了；摩西便向他们发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: However, some of them paid no attention to Moses; they kept part of it until morning, but it was full of maggots and began to smell. So Moses was angry with them.
verses.textEnEsv: But they did not listen to Moses. Some left part of it till the morning, and it bred worms and stank. And Moses was angry with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Notwithstanding they did not heed Moses. But some of them left part of it until morning, and it bred worms and stank. And Moses was angry with them.
verses.textEnNlt: But some of them didn’t listen and kept some of it until morning. But by then it was full of maggots and had a terrible smell. Moses was very angry with them.
verses.textEnNasb: But they did not listen to Moses, and some left part of it until morning, and it bred worms and stank; and Moses was angry with them.
verses.textEn: However, some of them paid no attention to Moses; they kept part of it until morning, but it was full of maggots and began to smell. So Moses was angry with them.

verses.textZh: 他们每天早晨都按着各人的食量去收取；太阳一发热，就融化了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们每天早晨都按着各人的食量去收取；太阳一发热，就融化了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们每日早晨，按着各人的饭量收取，日头一发热，就消化了。
verses.textEnNiv: Each morning everyone gathered as much as they needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away.
verses.textEnEsv: Morning by morning they gathered it, each as much as he could eat; but when the sun grew hot, it melted.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they gathered it every morning, every man according to his need. And when the sun became hot, it melted.
verses.textEnNlt: After this the people gathered the food morning by morning, each family according to its need. And as the sun became hot, the flakes they had not picked up melted and disappeared.
verses.textEnNasb: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone as much as he would eat; but when the sun became hot, it would melt.
verses.textEn: Each morning everyone gathered as much as they needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away.

verses.textZh: 到第六日，他们收取了两倍的食物，每人四公升；会众的首领都来告诉摩西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到第六日，他们收取了两倍的食物，每人四公升；会众的首领都来告诉摩西。
verses.textZhCuv: 到第六天，他们收了双倍的食物，每人两俄梅珥。会众的官长来告诉摩西；
verses.textEnNiv: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much—two omers for each person—and the leaders of the community came and reported this to Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: On the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers each. And when all the leaders of the congregation came and told Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, on the sixth day, that they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one. And all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much as usual—four quarts for each person instead of two. Then all the leaders of the community came and asked Moses for an explanation.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one. When all the leaders of the congregation came and told Moses,
verses.textEn: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much—two omers for each person—and the leaders of the community came and reported this to Moses.

verses.textZh: 摩西对他们说："耶和华这样说：‘明天是安息日，是向耶和华守的圣安息日。你们要烤的，就烤吧；要煮的，就煮吧；所有余剩的要自己保存着，直留到早晨。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对他们说："耶和华这样说：‘明天是安息日，是向耶和华守的圣安息日。你们要烤的，就烤吧；要煮的，就煮吧；所有余剩的要自己保存着，直留到早晨。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对他们说：「耶和华这样说：『明天是圣安息日，是向耶和华守的圣安息日。你们要烤的就烤了，要煮的就煮了，所剩下的都留到早晨。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "This is what the Lord commanded: ‘Tomorrow is to be a day of sabbath rest, a holy sabbath to the Lord . So bake what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil. Save whatever is left and keep it until morning.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: he said to them, "This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Tomorrow is a day of solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the Lord ; bake what you will bake and boil what you will boil, and all that is left over lay aside to be kept till the morning.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to them, "This iswhat the Lord has said: ‘Tomorrow is a Sabbath rest, a holy Sabbath to the Lord. Bake what you will bake today, and boil what you will boil; and lay up for yourselves all that remains, to be kept until morning.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: He told them, "This is what the Lord commanded: Tomorrow will be a day of complete rest, a holy Sabbath day set apart for the Lord . So bake or boil as much as you want today, and set aside what is left for tomorrow."
verses.textEnNasb: then he said to them, "This is what the Lord meant: Tomorrow is a Sabbath observance, a holy Sabbath to the Lord. Bake what you will bake and boil what you will boil, and all that is left over put aside to be kept until morning."
verses.textEn: He said to them, "This is what the Lord commanded: ‘Tomorrow is to be a day of sabbath rest, a holy sabbath to the Lord . So bake what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil. Save whatever is left and keep it until morning.’ "

verses.textZh: 他们就照着摩西吩咐的，把余剩的留到早晨；竟然不发臭，里头也没有生虫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就照着摩西吩咐的，把余剩的留到早晨；竟然不发臭，里头也没有生虫。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就照摩西的吩咐留到早晨，也不臭，里头也没有虫子。
verses.textEnNiv: So they saved it until morning, as Moses commanded, and it did not stink or get maggots in it.
verses.textEnEsv: So they laid it aside till the morning, as Moses commanded them, and it did not stink, and there were no worms in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they laid it up till morning, as Moses commanded; and it did not stink, nor were there any worms in it.
verses.textEnNlt: So they put some aside until morning, just as Moses had commanded. And in the morning the leftover food was wholesome and good, without maggots or odor.
verses.textEnNasb: So they put it aside until morning, as Moses had ordered, and it did not stink nor was there a maggot in it.
verses.textEn: So they saved it until morning, as Moses commanded, and it did not stink or get maggots in it.

verses.textZh: 摩西说："今天吃这个吧，因为今天是向耶和华守的安息日，今日你们在田野里必找不着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："今天吃这个吧，因为今天是向耶和华守的安息日，今日你们在田野里必找不着。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「你们今天吃这个吧！因为今天是向耶和华守的安息日；你们在田野必找不着了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Eat it today," Moses said, "because today is a sabbath to the Lord . You will not find any of it on the ground today.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said, "Eat it today, for today is a Sabbath to the Lord ; today you will not find it in the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said, "Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to the Lord; today you will not find it in the field.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said, "Eat this food today, for today is a Sabbath day dedicated to the Lord . There will be no food on the ground today.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said, "Eat it today, for today is a Sabbath to the Lord; today you will not find it in the field.
verses.textEn: "Eat it today," Moses said, "because today is a sabbath to the Lord . You will not find any of it on the ground today.

verses.textZh: 六天你们可以收取，但第七天是安息日，在那一天甚么都没有了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 六天你们可以收取，但第七天是安息日，在那一天甚么都没有了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 六天可以收取，第七天乃是安息日，那一天必没有了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Six days you are to gather it, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, there will not be any."
verses.textEnEsv: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day, which is a Sabbath, there will be none."
verses.textEnNkjv: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, there will be none."
verses.textEnNlt: You may gather the food for six days, but the seventh day is the Sabbath. There will be no food on the ground that day."
verses.textEnNasb: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, there will be none."
verses.textEn: Six days you are to gather it, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, there will not be any."

verses.textZh: 第七天民间有人出去收取，可是甚么也找不着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第七天民间有人出去收取，可是甚么也找不着。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七天，百姓中有人出去收，什么也找不着。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, some of the people went out on the seventh day to gather it, but they found none.
verses.textEnEsv: On the seventh day some of the people went out to gather, but they found none.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened thatsome of the people went out on the seventh day to gather, but they found none.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the people went out anyway on the seventh day, but they found no food.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet it came about on the seventh day that some of the people went out to gather, but they found none.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, some of the people went out on the seventh day to gather it, but they found none.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你们拒绝遵守我的诫命和律法，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你们拒绝遵守我的诫命和律法，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你们不肯守我的诫命和律法，要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "How long will you refuse to keep my commands and my instructions?
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "How long will you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "How long do you refuse to keep My commandments and My laws?
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord asked Moses, "How long will these people refuse to obey my commands and instructions?
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "How long do you refuse to keep My commandments and My instructions?
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "How long will you refuse to keep my commands and my instructions?

verses.textZh: 你们看，耶和华把安息日赐给了你们，所以第六日他赐给你们两天的食物；第七天你们各人要住在家里，谁都不可离开自己的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们看，耶和华把安息日赐给了你们，所以第六日他赐给你们两天的食物；第七天你们各人要住在家里，谁都不可离开自己的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们看！耶和华既将安息日赐给你们，所以第六天他赐给你们两天的食物，第七天各人要住在自己的地方，不许什么人出去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Bear in mind that the Lord has given you the Sabbath; that is why on the sixth day he gives you bread for two days. Everyone is to stay where they are on the seventh day; no one is to go out."
verses.textEnEsv: See! The Lord has given you the Sabbath; therefore on the sixth day he gives you bread for two days. Remain each of you in his place; let no one go out of his place on the seventh day."
verses.textEnNkjv: See! For the Lord has given you the Sabbath; therefore He gives you on the sixth day bread for two days. Let every man remain in his place; let no man go out of his place on the seventh day."
verses.textEnNlt: They must realize that the Sabbath is the Lord ’s gift to you. That is why he gives you a two-day supply on the sixth day, so there will be enough for two days. On the Sabbath day you must each stay in your place. Do not go out to pick up food on the seventh day."
verses.textEnNasb: See, the Lord has given you the Sabbath; for that reason He gives you bread for two days on the sixth day. Remain, everyone, in his place; no one is to leave his place on the seventh day."
verses.textEn: Bear in mind that the Lord has given you the Sabbath; that is why on the sixth day he gives you bread for two days. Everyone is to stay where they are on the seventh day; no one is to go out."

verses.textZh: 于是人民在第七天都安息了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是人民在第七天都安息了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是百姓第七天安息了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people did not gather any food on the seventh day.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.textEn: So the people rested on the seventh day.

verses.textZh: 以色列家给这食物起名叫"吗哪"，它像芫荽的种子，色白，味道像搀蜜的薄饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家给这食物起名叫"吗哪"，它像芫荽的种子，色白，味道像搀蜜的薄饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 这食物，以色列家叫吗哪；样子像芫荽子，颜色是白的，滋味如同搀蜜的薄饼。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Israel called the bread manna. It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the house of Israel called its name manna. It was like coriander seed, white, and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the house of Israel called its name Manna. And it was like white coriander seed, and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites called the food manna. It was white like coriander seed, and it tasted like honey wafers.
verses.textEnNasb: And the house of Israel named the bread manna, and it was like coriander seed, white, and its taste was like wafers with honey.
verses.textEn: The people of Israel called the bread manna. It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.

verses.textZh: 摩西说："耶和华吩咐的话是这样：要把满两公升的吗哪保留起来给你们的后代，好让他们可以看见当日我把你们从埃及地领出来的时候，在旷野给你们吃的食物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："耶和华吩咐的话是这样：要把满两公升的吗哪保留起来给你们的后代，好让他们可以看见当日我把你们从埃及地领出来的时候，在旷野给你们吃的食物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「耶和华所吩咐的是这样：『要将一满俄梅珥吗哪留到世世代代，使后人可以看见我当日将你们领出埃及地，在旷野所给你们吃的食物。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Take an omer of manna and keep it for the generations to come, so they can see the bread I gave you to eat in the wilderness when I brought you out of Egypt.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Let an omer of it be kept throughout your generations, so that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said, "This is the thing which the Lord has commanded: ‘Fill an omer with it, to be kept for your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded: Fill a two-quart container with manna to preserve it for your descendants. Then later generations will be able to see the food I gave you in the wilderness when I set you free from Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘A full omer of it is to be kept safe throughout your generations, so that they may see the bread that I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’ "
verses.textEn: Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded: ‘Take an omer of manna and keep it for the generations to come, so they can see the bread I gave you to eat in the wilderness when I brought you out of Egypt.’ "

verses.textZh: 摩西对亚伦说："拿一个罐子来，装满两公升吗哪，存放在耶和华面前，保留起来给你们的后代。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对亚伦说："拿一个罐子来，装满两公升吗哪，存放在耶和华面前，保留起来给你们的后代。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对亚伦说：「你拿一个罐子，盛一满俄梅珥吗哪，存在耶和华面前，要留到世世代代。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses said to Aaron, "Take a jar and put an omer of manna in it. Then place it before the Lord to be kept for the generations to come."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to Aaron, "Take a jar, and put an omer of manna in it, and place it before the Lord to be kept throughout your generations."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to Aaron, "Take a pot and put an omer of manna in it, and lay it up before the Lord, to be kept for your generations."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said to Aaron, "Get a jar and fill it with two quarts of manna. Then put it in a sacred place before the Lord to preserve it for all future generations."
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses said to Aaron, "Take a jar and put a full omer of manna in it, and place it before the Lord to be kept safe throughout your generations."
verses.textEn: So Moses said to Aaron, "Take a jar and put an omer of manna in it. Then place it before the Lord to be kept for the generations to come."

verses.textZh: 亚伦就照着耶和华吩咐摩西的，把吗哪存留在法柜前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦就照着耶和华吩咐摩西的，把吗哪存留在法柜前。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华怎么吩咐摩西，亚伦就怎么行，把吗哪放在法柜前存留。
verses.textEnNiv: As the Lord commanded Moses, Aaron put the manna with the tablets of the covenant law, so that it might be preserved.
verses.textEnEsv: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron placed it before the testimony to be kept.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron did just as the Lord had commanded Moses. He eventually placed it in the Ark of the Covenant—in front of the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron placed it before the Testimony, to be kept.
verses.textEn: As the Lord commanded Moses, Aaron put the manna with the tablets of the covenant law, so that it might be preserved.

verses.textZh: 以色列人吃吗哪共四十年，直到进了有人居住的地方为止；他们吃吗哪，直到进入迦南地的边界为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人吃吗哪共四十年，直到进了有人居住的地方为止；他们吃吗哪，直到进入迦南地的边界为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人吃吗哪共四十年，直到进了有人居住之地，就是迦南的境界。（
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a land that was settled; they ate manna until they reached the border of Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Israel ate the manna forty years, till they came to a habitable land. They ate the manna till they came to the border of the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel ate manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land; they ate manna until they came to the border of the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people of Israel ate manna for forty years until they arrived at the land where they would settle. They ate manna until they came to the border of the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel ate the manna for forty years, until they came to an inhabited land; they ate the manna until they came to the border of the land of Canaan.
verses.textEn: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a land that was settled; they ate manna until they reached the border of Canaan.

verses.textZh: 两公升就是当时的标准量器的十分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两公升就是当时的标准量器的十分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一。）
verses.textEnNiv: (An omer is one-tenth of an ephah.)
verses.textEnEsv: (An omer is the tenth part of an ephah.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Now an omer is one-tenth of an ephah.
verses.textEnNlt: The container used to measure the manna was an omer, which was one-tenth of an ephah; it held about two quarts.
verses.textEnNasb: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)
verses.textEn: (An omer is one-tenth of an ephah.)

verses.textZh: 以色列全体会众都照着耶和华的吩咐，一站一站，从汛的旷野起程，在利非订安营。在那里人民没有水喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列全体会众都照着耶和华的吩咐，一站一站，从汛的旷野起程，在利非订安营。在那里人民没有水喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列全会众都遵耶和华的吩咐，按着站口从汛的旷野往前行，在利非订安营。百姓没有水喝，
verses.textEnNiv: The whole Israelite community set out from the Desert of Sin, traveling from place to place as the Lord commanded. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.textEnEsv: All the congregation of the people of Israel moved on from the wilderness of Sin by stages, according to the commandment of the Lord , and camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the congregation of the children of Israel set out on their journey from the Wilderness of Sin, according to the commandment of the Lord, and camped in Rephidim; but therewas no water for the people to drink.
verses.textEnNlt: At the Lord ’s command, the whole community of Israel left the wilderness of Sin and moved from place to place. Eventually they camped at Rephidim, but there was no water there for the people to drink.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the congregation of the sons of Israel journeyed by stages from the wilderness of Sin, according to the command of the Lord, and camped at Rephidim, and there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.textEn: The whole Israelite community set out from the Desert of Sin, traveling from place to place as the Lord commanded. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.

verses.textZh: 因此人民与摩西争吵，说："给我们水喝吧。"摩西对他们说："你们为甚么与我争吵呢？你们为甚么试探耶和华呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此人民与摩西争吵，说："给我们水喝吧。"摩西对他们说："你们为甚么与我争吵呢？你们为甚么试探耶和华呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以与摩西争闹，说：「给我们水喝吧！」摩西对他们说：「你们为什么与我争闹？为什么试探耶和华呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So they quarreled with Moses and said, "Give us water to drink." Moses replied, "Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you put the Lord to the test?"
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses and said, "Give us water to drink." And Moses said to them, "Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the people contended with Moses, and said, "Give us water, that we may drink." So Moses said to them, "Why do you contend with me? Why do you tempt the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: So once more the people complained against Moses. "Give us water to drink!" they demanded. "Quiet!" Moses replied. "Why are you complaining against me? And why are you testing the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNasb: So the people quarreled with Moses and said, "Give us water so that we may drink!" And Moses said to them, "Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the Lord?"
verses.textEn: So they quarreled with Moses and said, "Give us water to drink." Moses replied, "Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you put the Lord to the test?"

verses.textZh: 人民在那里渴望得水喝，就向摩西发怨言，说："你为甚么把我们从埃及领上来，使我们和我们的儿女，以及我们的牲畜都渴死呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民在那里渴望得水喝，就向摩西发怨言，说："你为甚么把我们从埃及领上来，使我们和我们的儿女，以及我们的牲畜都渴死呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓在那里甚渴，要喝水，就向摩西发怨言，说：「你为什么将我们从埃及领出来，使我们和我们的儿女并牲畜都渴死呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the people were thirsty for water there, and they grumbled against Moses. They said, "Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the people thirsted there for water, and the people grumbled against Moses and said, "Why did you bring us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our livestock with thirst?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people thirsted there for water, and the people complained against Moses, and said, "Why is it you have brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our livestock with thirst?"
verses.textEnNlt: But tormented by thirst, they continued to argue with Moses. "Why did you bring us out of Egypt? Are you trying to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?"
verses.textEnNasb: But the people were thirsty for water there; and they grumbled against Moses and said, "Why is it that you have brought us up from Egypt, to kill us and our children and our livestock with thirst?"
verses.textEn: But the people were thirsty for water there, and they grumbled against Moses. They said, "Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?"

verses.textZh: 摩西向耶和华呼求，说："我要怎样对待这人民呢？他们几乎要用石头打死我了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西向耶和华呼求，说："我要怎样对待这人民呢？他们几乎要用石头打死我了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就呼求耶和华说：「我向这百姓怎样行呢？他们几乎要拿石头打死我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses cried out to the Lord , "What am I to do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me."
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses cried to the Lord , "What shall I do with this people? They are almost ready to stone me."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses cried out to the Lord, saying, "What shall I do with this people? They are almost ready to stone me!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses cried out to the Lord , "What should I do with these people? They are ready to stone me!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses cried out to the Lord, saying, "What am I to do with this people? A little more and they will stone me!"
verses.textEn: Then Moses cried out to the Lord , "What am I to do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me."

verses.textZh: 耶和华回答摩西："你要到人民的面前，要带着以色列的几个长老和你一起，手里要拿着你先前击打河水的杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华回答摩西："你要到人民的面前，要带着以色列的几个长老和你一起，手里要拿着你先前击打河水的杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你手里拿着你先前击打河水的杖，带领以色列的几个长老，从百姓面前走过去。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord answered Moses, "Go out in front of the people. Take with you some of the elders of Israel and take in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Pass on before the people, taking with you some of the elders of Israel, and take in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go on before the people, and take with you some of the elders of Israel. Also take in your hand your rod with which you struck the river, and go.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses, "Walk out in front of the people. Take your staff, the one you used when you struck the water of the Nile, and call some of the elders of Israel to join you.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pass before the people and take with you some of the elders of Israel; and take in your hand your staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.
verses.textEn: The Lord answered Moses, "Go out in front of the people. Take with you some of the elders of Israel and take in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我必在何烈山那里的盘石上站在你面前；你要击打盘石，就必有水从盘石流出来，使人民可以喝。"摩西就在以色列的长老眼前这样行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我必在何烈山那里的盘石上站在你面前；你要击打盘石，就必有水从盘石流出来，使人民可以喝。"摩西就在以色列的长老眼前这样行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在何烈的磐石那里，站在你面前。你要击打磐石，从磐石里必有水流出来，使百姓可以喝。」摩西就在以色列的长老眼前这样行了。
verses.textEnNiv: I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink." So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock at Horeb, and you shall strike the rock, and water shall come out of it, and the people will drink." And Moses did so, in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb; and you shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink." And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: I will stand before you on the rock at Mount Sinai. Strike the rock, and water will come gushing out. Then the people will be able to drink." So Moses struck the rock as he was told, and water gushed out as the elders looked on.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock at Horeb; and you shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, so that the people may drink." And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
verses.textEn: I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink." So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他给那地方起名叫玛撒，又叫米利巴，因为以色列人在那里争吵，又因为他们试探耶和华，说："耶和华是不是在我们中间呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他给那地方起名叫玛撒，又叫米利巴，因为以色列人在那里争吵，又因为他们试探耶和华，说："耶和华是不是在我们中间呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他给那地方起名叫玛撒 ，又叫米利巴 ；因以色列人争闹，又因他们试探耶和华，说：「耶和华是在我们中间不是？」
verses.textEnNiv: And he called the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled and because they tested the Lord saying, "Is the Lord among us or not?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he called the name of the place Massah and Meribah, because of the quarreling of the people of Israel, and because they tested the Lord by saying, "Is the Lord among us or not?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So he called the name of the place Massah and Meribah, because of the contention of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the Lord, saying, "Is the Lord among us or not?"
verses.textEnNlt: Moses named the place Massah (which means "test") and Meribah (which means "arguing") because the people of Israel argued with Moses and tested the Lord by saying, "Is the Lord here with us or not?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he named the place Massah and Meribah because of the quarrel of the sons of Israel, and because they tested the Lord, saying, "Is the Lord among us, or not?"
verses.textEn: And he called the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled and because they tested the Lord saying, "Is the Lord among us or not?"

verses.textZh: 那时亚玛力人来了，在利非订和以色列人争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时亚玛力人来了，在利非订和以色列人争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，亚玛力人来在利非订，和以色列人争战。
verses.textEnNiv: The Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel at Rephidim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
verses.textEnNlt: While the people of Israel were still at Rephidim, the warriors of Amalek attacked them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Amalek came and fought against Israel at Rephidim.
verses.textEn: The Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.

verses.textZh: 摩西对约书亚说："你要为我们选出人来，出去和亚玛力人争战；明天我要站在山顶上，手里拿着神的杖。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对约书亚说："你要为我们选出人来，出去和亚玛力人争战；明天我要站在山顶上，手里拿着神的杖。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对约书亚说：「你为我们选出人来，出去和亚玛力人争战。明天我手里要拿着神的杖，站在山顶上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to Joshua, "Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on top of the hill with the staff of God in my hands."
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses said to Joshua, "Choose for us men, and go out and fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the staff of God in my hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to Joshua, "Choose us some men and go out, fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses commanded Joshua, "Choose some men to go out and fight the army of Amalek for us. Tomorrow, I will stand at the top of the hill, holding the staff of God in my hand."
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses said to Joshua, "Choose men for us and go out, fight against Amalek. Tomorrow I will station myself on the top of the hill with the staff of God in my hand."
verses.textEn: Moses said to Joshua, "Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on top of the hill with the staff of God in my hands."

verses.textZh: 于是，约书亚照着摩西吩咐他的行了，去和亚玛力人争战；摩西、亚伦和户珥都上了山顶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约书亚照着摩西吩咐他的行了，去和亚玛力人争战；摩西、亚伦和户珥都上了山顶。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约书亚照着摩西对他所说的话行，和亚玛力人争战。摩西、亚伦，与户珥都上了山顶。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua fought the Amalekites as Moses had ordered, and Moses, Aaron and Hur went to the top of the hill.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua did as Moses told him, and fought with Amalek, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua did as Moses said to him, and fought with Amalek. And Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua did what Moses had commanded and fought the army of Amalek. Meanwhile, Moses, Aaron, and Hur climbed to the top of a nearby hill.
verses.textEnNasb: Joshua did just as Moses told him, and fought against Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.textEn: So Joshua fought the Amalekites as Moses had ordered, and Moses, Aaron and Hur went to the top of the hill.

verses.textZh: 摩西举起手来的时候，以色列人就得胜；摩西把手放下来的时候，亚玛力人就得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西举起手来的时候，以色列人就得胜；摩西把手放下来的时候，亚玛力人就得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西何时举手，以色列人就得胜，何时垂手，亚玛力人就得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: As long as Moses held up his hands, the Israelites were winning, but whenever he lowered his hands, the Amalekites were winning.
verses.textEnEsv: Whenever Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed, and whenever he lowered his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed; and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.textEnNlt: As long as Moses held up the staff in his hand, the Israelites had the advantage. But whenever he dropped his hand, the Amalekites gained the advantage.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about, when Moses held his hand up, that Israel prevailed; but when he let his hand down, Amalek prevailed.
verses.textEn: As long as Moses held up his hands, the Israelites were winning, but whenever he lowered his hands, the Amalekites were winning.

verses.textZh: 可是摩西的两手疲乏了，他们就搬块石头来，放在摩西下面，他就坐在上面；亚伦和户珥，一边一个，扶着摩西的两手；这样，他的两手就稳住，直到日落的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是摩西的两手疲乏了，他们就搬块石头来，放在摩西下面，他就坐在上面；亚伦和户珥，一边一个，扶着摩西的两手；这样，他的两手就稳住，直到日落的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 但摩西的手发沉，他们就搬石头来，放在他以下，他就坐在上面。亚伦与户珥扶着他的手，一个在这边，一个在那边，他的手就稳住，直到日落的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses’ hands grew tired, they took a stone and put it under him and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held his hands up—one on one side, one on the other—so that his hands remained steady till sunset.
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses’ hands grew weary, so they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it, while Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on one side, and the other on the other side. So his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Moses’ hands became heavy; so they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. And Aaron and Hur supported his hands, one on one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses’ arms soon became so tired he could no longer hold them up. So Aaron and Hur found a stone for him to sit on. Then they stood on each side of Moses, holding up his hands. So his hands held steady until sunset.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses’ hands were heavy. So they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it; and Aaron and Hur supported his hands, one on one side and one on the other. So his hands were steady until the sun set.
verses.textEn: When Moses’ hands grew tired, they took a stone and put it under him and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held his hands up—one on one side, one on the other—so that his hands remained steady till sunset.

verses.textZh: 约书亚用刀打败了亚玛力王和他的人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚用刀打败了亚玛力王和他的人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚用刀杀了亚玛力王和他的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua overcame the Amalekite army with the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua overwhelmed Amalek and his people with the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, Joshua overwhelmed the army of Amalek in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEn: So Joshua overcame the Amalekite army with the sword.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："我要把亚玛力的名号从天下完全抹掉；你要把话写在书上作记念，也要告诉约书亚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："我要把亚玛力的名号从天下完全抹掉；你要把话写在书上作记念，也要告诉约书亚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「我要将亚玛力的名号从天下全然涂抹了；你要将这话写在书上作纪念，又念给约书亚听。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write this on a scroll as something to be remembered and make sure that Joshua hears it, because I will completely blot out the name of Amalek from under heaven."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write this as a memorial in a book and recite it in the ears of Joshua, that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write this for a memorial in the book and recount it in the hearing of Joshua, that I will utterly blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven."
verses.textEnNlt: After the victory, the Lord instructed Moses, "Write this down on a scroll as a permanent reminder, and read it aloud to Joshua: I will erase the memory of Amalek from under heaven."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write this in a book as a memorial and recite it to Joshua, that I will utterly wipe out the memory of Amalek from under heaven."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write this on a scroll as something to be remembered and make sure that Joshua hears it, because I will completely blot out the name of Amalek from under heaven."

verses.textZh: 摩西筑了一座祭坛，给它起名叫"耶和华尼西"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西筑了一座祭坛，给它起名叫"耶和华尼西"。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西筑了一座坛，起名叫「耶和华尼西」 ，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses built an altar and called it The Lord is my Banner.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses built an altar and called the name of it, The Lord Is My Banner,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses built an altar and called its name, The-Lord-Is-My-Banner;
verses.textEnNlt: Moses built an altar there and named it Yahweh-Nissi (which means "the Lord is my banner").
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses built an altar and named it The Lord is My Banner;
verses.textEn: Moses built an altar and called it The Lord is my Banner.

verses.textZh: 摩西又说："向耶和华的旌旗举手，耶和华必世世代代和亚玛力人争战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西又说："向耶和华的旌旗举手，耶和华必世世代代和亚玛力人争战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「耶和华已经起了誓，必世世代代和亚玛力人争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "Because hands were lifted up against the throne of the Lord , the Lord will be at war against the Amalekites from generation to generation."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "A hand upon the throne of the Lord ! The Lord will have war with Amalek from generation to generation."
verses.textEnNkjv: for he said, "Because the Lord has sworn: the Lordwillhave war with Amalek from generation to generation."
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "They have raised their fist against the Lord ’s throne, so now the Lord will be at war with Amalek generation after generation."
verses.textEnNasb: and he said, " Because the Lord has sworn, the Lord will have war against Amalek from generation to generation."
verses.textEn: He said, "Because hands were lifted up against the throne of the Lord , the Lord will be at war against the Amalekites from generation to generation."

verses.textZh: 摩西的岳父，米甸祭司叶忒罗，听见了神为摩西和他自己的人民以色列所行的一切，就是耶和华怎样把以色列人从埃及领出来的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西的岳父，米甸祭司叶忒罗，听见了神为摩西和他自己的人民以色列所行的一切，就是耶和华怎样把以色列人从埃及领出来的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西的岳父，米甸祭司叶忒罗，听见神为摩西和神的百姓以色列所行的一切事，就是耶和华将以色列从埃及领出来的事，
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian and father-in-law of Moses, heard of everything God had done for Moses and for his people Israel, and how the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel His people—that the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses’ father-in-law, Jethro, the priest of Midian, heard about everything God had done for Moses and his people, the Israelites. He heard especially about how the Lord had rescued them from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard about everything that God had done for Moses and for Israel His people, how the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian and father-in-law of Moses, heard of everything God had done for Moses and for his people Israel, and how the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 他就带着摩西的妻子西坡拉，摩西从前送了她回去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就带着摩西的妻子西坡拉，摩西从前送了她回去，
verses.textZhCuv: 便带着摩西的妻子西坡拉，就是摩西从前打发回去的，
verses.textEnNiv: After Moses had sent away his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro received her
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, had taken Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her home,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,
verses.textEnNlt: Earlier, Moses had sent his wife, Zipporah, and his two sons back to Jethro, who had taken them in.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took in Moses’ wife Zipporah, after he had sent her away,
verses.textEn: After Moses had sent away his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro received her

verses.textZh: 又带着西坡拉的两个儿子，一个名叫革舜，因为摩西说："我在异地作了客旅"；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又带着西坡拉的两个儿子，一个名叫革舜，因为摩西说："我在异地作了客旅"；
verses.textZhCuv: 又带着西坡拉的两个儿子，一个名叫革舜，因为摩西说：「我在外邦作了寄居的」；
verses.textEnNiv: and her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses said, "I have become a foreigner in a foreign land";
verses.textEnEsv: along with her two sons. The name of the one was Gershom ( for he said, "I have been a sojourner in a foreign land"),
verses.textEnNkjv: with her two sons, of whom the name of one was Gershom (for he said, "I have been a stranger in a foreign land")
verses.textEnNlt: (Moses’ first son was named Gershom, for Moses had said when the boy was born, "I have been a foreigner in a foreign land."
verses.textEnNasb: and her two sons, one of whom was named Gershom, for Moses said, "I have been a stranger in a foreign land."
verses.textEn: and her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses said, "I have become a foreigner in a foreign land";

verses.textZh: 一个名叫以利以谢，因为他说："我父亲的神是我的帮助，救我脱离了法老的刀。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 一个名叫以利以谢，因为他说："我父亲的神是我的帮助，救我脱离了法老的刀。"
verses.textZhCuv: 一个名叫以利以谢，因为他说：「我父亲的神帮助了我，救我脱离法老的刀。」
verses.textEnNiv: and the other was named Eliezer, for he said, "My father’s God was my helper; he saved me from the sword of Pharaoh."
verses.textEnEsv: and the name of the other, Eliezer (for he said, "The God of my father was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh").
verses.textEnNkjv: and the name of the other was Eliezer (for hesaid, "The God of my father was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh");
verses.textEnNlt: His second son was named Eliezer, for Moses had said, "The God of my ancestors was my helper; he rescued me from the sword of Pharaoh.")
verses.textEnNasb: And the other was named Eliezer, for he said, "The God of my father was my help, and saved me from the sword of Pharaoh."
verses.textEn: and the other was named Eliezer, for he said, "My father’s God was my helper; he saved me from the sword of Pharaoh."

verses.textZh: 摩西的岳父叶忒罗，和摩西的妻子与两个儿子，来到旷野摩西那里，就是到神的山，摩西安营的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西的岳父叶忒罗，和摩西的妻子与两个儿子，来到旷野摩西那里，就是到神的山，摩西安营的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西的岳父叶忒罗带着摩西的妻子和两个儿子来到神的山，就是摩西在旷野安营的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, together with Moses’ sons and wife, came to him in the wilderness, where he was camped near the mountain of God.
verses.textEnEsv: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses in the wilderness where he was encamped at the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses in the wilderness, where he was encamped at the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, now came to visit Moses in the wilderness. He brought Moses’ wife and two sons with him, and they arrived while Moses and the people were camped near the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses in the wilderness where he was camped, at the mountain of God.
verses.textEn: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, together with Moses’ sons and wife, came to him in the wilderness, where he was camped near the mountain of God.

verses.textZh: 叶忒罗叫人告诉摩西说："你的岳父叶忒罗来见你，你的妻子和两个儿子也一同来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 叶忒罗叫人告诉摩西说："你的岳父叶忒罗来见你，你的妻子和两个儿子也一同来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对摩西说：「我是你岳父叶忒罗，带着你的妻子和两个儿子来到你这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jethro had sent word to him, "I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons."
verses.textEnEsv: And when he sent word to Moses, "I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons with her,"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he had said to Moses, "I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons with her."
verses.textEnNlt: Jethro had sent a message to Moses, saying, "I, Jethro, your father-in-law, am coming to see you with your wife and your two sons."
verses.textEnNasb: And he sent word to Moses: "I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons with her."
verses.textEn: Jethro had sent word to him, "I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons."

verses.textZh: 摩西出来迎接他的岳父，向他下拜，与他亲吻，彼此问候，然后一起进了帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西出来迎接他的岳父，向他下拜，与他亲吻，彼此问候，然后一起进了帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西迎接他的岳父，向他下拜，与他亲嘴，彼此问安，都进了帐棚。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and then went into the tent.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. And they asked each other of their welfare and went into the tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, bowed down, and kissed him. And they asked each other about their well-being, and they went into the tent.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law. He bowed low and kissed him. They asked about each other’s welfare and then went into Moses’ tent.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and he bowed down and kissed him; and they asked each other about their welfare, and went into the tent.
verses.textEn: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and then went into the tent.

verses.textZh: 摩西把耶和华为以色列的缘故，向法老和埃及人所作的一切，以及路上遭遇的一切困难，并且耶和华怎样拯救他们，都向他的岳父述说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把耶和华为以色列的缘故，向法老和埃及人所作的一切，以及路上遭遇的一切困难，并且耶和华怎样拯救他们，都向他的岳父述说。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将耶和华为以色列的缘故向法老和埃及人所行的一切事，以及路上所遭遇的一切艰难，并耶和华怎样搭救他们，都述说与他岳父听。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses told his father-in-law about everything the Lord had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake and about all the hardships they had met along the way and how the Lord had saved them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses told his father-in-law all that the Lord had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardship that had come upon them in the way, and how the Lord had delivered them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses told his father-in-law all that the Lord had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardship that had come upon them on the way, and how the Lord had delivered them.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses told his father-in-law everything the Lord had done to Pharaoh and Egypt on behalf of Israel. He also told about all the hardships they had experienced along the way and how the Lord had rescued his people from all their troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses told his father-in-law everything that the Lord had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardship that had confronted them on the journey, and how the Lord had rescued them.
verses.textEn: Moses told his father-in-law about everything the Lord had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake and about all the hardships they had met along the way and how the Lord had saved them.

verses.textZh: 叶忒罗因为耶和华为以色列人所行的美事，就是拯救他们脱离埃及人的手，就非常喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 叶忒罗因为耶和华为以色列人所行的美事，就是拯救他们脱离埃及人的手，就非常喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 叶忒罗因耶和华待以色列的一切好处，就是拯救他们脱离埃及人的手，便甚欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: Jethro was delighted to hear about all the good things the Lord had done for Israel in rescuing them from the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jethro rejoiced for all the good that the Lord had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jethro rejoiced for all the good which the Lord had done for Israel, whom He had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNlt: Jethro was delighted when he heard about all the good things the Lord had done for Israel as he rescued them from the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jethro rejoiced over all the goodness which the Lord had done for Israel, in rescuing them from the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.textEn: Jethro was delighted to hear about all the good things the Lord had done for Israel in rescuing them from the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.textZh: 叶忒罗说："耶和华是应当称颂的，他拯救了你们脱离埃及人的手和法老的手；他也把这人民从埃及人的手下拯救出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 叶忒罗说："耶和华是应当称颂的，他拯救了你们脱离埃及人的手和法老的手；他也把这人民从埃及人的手下拯救出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 叶忒罗说：「耶和华是应当称颂的；他救了你们脱离埃及人和法老的手，将这百姓从埃及人的手下救出来。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "Praise be to the Lord , who rescued you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who rescued the people from the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnEsv: Jethro said, "Blessed be the Lord , who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharaoh and has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jethro said, "Blessed be the Lord, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharaoh, and who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNlt: "Praise the Lord ," Jethro said, "for he has rescued you from the Egyptians and from Pharaoh. Yes, he has rescued Israel from the powerful hand of Egypt!
verses.textEnNasb: So Jethro said, "Blessed be the Lord who rescued you from the hand of the Egyptians and from the hand of Pharaoh, and who rescued the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.textEn: He said, "Praise be to the Lord , who rescued you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who rescued the people from the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.textZh: 现在我知道耶和华为至大，超乎万神之上，因为这在埃及人以狂傲的态度对以色列人的事上已经证明了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我知道耶和华为至大，超乎万神之上，因为这在埃及人以狂傲的态度对以色列人的事上已经证明了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我现今在埃及人向这百姓发狂傲的事上得知，耶和华比万神都大。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all other gods, for he did this to those who had treated Israel arrogantly."
verses.textEnEsv: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods, because in this affair they dealt arrogantly with the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I know that the Lordis greater than all the gods; for in the very thing in which they behaved proudly, Hewas above them."
verses.textEnNlt: I know now that the Lord is greater than all other gods, because he rescued his people from the oppression of the proud Egyptians."
verses.textEnNasb: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all the gods; indeed, it was proven when they acted insolently against the people."
verses.textEn: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all other gods, for he did this to those who had treated Israel arrogantly."

verses.textZh: 摩西的岳父叶忒罗把燔祭和几样祭品拿来献给神；亚伦和所有以色列的长老都来到神面前，与摩西的岳父一同吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西的岳父叶忒罗把燔祭和几样祭品拿来献给神；亚伦和所有以色列的长老都来到神面前，与摩西的岳父一同吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西的岳父叶忒罗把燔祭和平安祭献给神。亚伦和以色列的众长老都来了，与摩西的岳父在神面前吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and other sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat a meal with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God; and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and other sacrifices tooffer to God. And Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God. Aaron and all the elders of Israel came out and joined him in a sacrificial meal in God’s presence.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat a meal with Moses’ father-in-law before God.
verses.textEn: Then Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and other sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat a meal with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God.

verses.textZh: 次日，摩西坐着审判人民的案件；人民从早到晚都站在摩西的身旁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次日，摩西坐着审判人民的案件；人民从早到晚都站在摩西的身旁。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，摩西坐着审判百姓，百姓从早到晚都站在摩西的左右。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day Moses took his seat to serve as judge for the people, and they stood around him from morning till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: The next day Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from morning till evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, on the next day, that Moses sat to judge the people; and the people stood before Moses from morning until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day, Moses took his seat to hear the people’s disputes against each other. They waited before him from morning till evening.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about the next day, that Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood before Moses from the morning until the evening.
verses.textEn: The next day Moses took his seat to serve as judge for the people, and they stood around him from morning till evening.

verses.textZh: 摩西的岳父看见了摩西向人民所行的一切，就说："你向人民作的是甚么呢？你为甚么独自坐着审判，所有的人民却从早到晚都站在你的身旁呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西的岳父看见了摩西向人民所行的一切，就说："你向人民作的是甚么呢？你为甚么独自坐着审判，所有的人民却从早到晚都站在你的身旁呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西的岳父看见他向百姓所做的一切事，就说：「你向百姓做的是什么事呢？你为什么独自坐着，众百姓从早到晚都站在你的左右呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he said, "What is this you are doing for the people? Why do you alone sit as judge, while all these people stand around you from morning till evening?"
verses.textEnEsv: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he was doing for the people, he said, "What is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning till evening?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did for the people, he said, "What is this thing that you are doing for the people? Why do you alone sit, and all the people stand before you from morning until evening?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he asked, "What are you really accomplishing here? Why are you trying to do all this alone while everyone stands around you from morning till evening?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he was doing for the people, he said, "What is this thing that you are doing for the people? Why do you alone sit as judge and all the people stand before you from morning until evening?"
verses.textEn: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he said, "What is this you are doing for the people? Why do you alone sit as judge, while all these people stand around you from morning till evening?"

verses.textZh: 摩西回答他岳父："因为人民到我这里来求问神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答他岳父："因为人民到我这里来求问神。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对岳父说：「这是因百姓到我这里来求问神。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses answered him, "Because the people come to me to seek God’s will.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to his father-in-law, "Because the people come to me to inquire of God;
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to his father-in-law, "Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses replied, "Because the people come to me to get a ruling from God.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses said to his father-in-law, "Because the people come to me to inquire of God.
verses.textEn: Moses answered him, "Because the people come to me to seek God’s will.

verses.textZh: 他们有事件的时候，就到我这里来，我就在双方之间施行审判，使他们认识神的条例和律法。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们有事件的时候，就到我这里来，我就在双方之间施行审判，使他们认识神的条例和律法。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们有事的时候就到我这里来，我便在两造之间施行审判；我又叫他们知道神的律例和法度。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me, and I decide between the parties and inform them of God’s decrees and instructions."
verses.textEnEsv: when they have a dispute, they come to me and I decide between one person and another, and I make them know the statutes of God and his laws."
verses.textEnNkjv: When they have a difficulty, they come to me, and I judge between one and another; and I make known the statutes of God and His laws."
verses.textEnNlt: When a dispute arises, they come to me, and I am the one who settles the case between the quarreling parties. I inform the people of God’s decrees and give them his instructions."
verses.textEnNasb: When they have a dispute, it comes to me, and I judge between someone and his neighbor and make known the statutes of God and His laws."
verses.textEn: Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me, and I decide between the parties and inform them of God’s decrees and instructions."

verses.textZh: 摩西的岳父对摩西说："你这样作不好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西的岳父对摩西说："你这样作不好。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西的岳父说：「你这做的不好。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses’ father-in-law replied, "What you are doing is not good.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, "What you are doing is not good.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses’ father-in-law said to him, "The thing that you do is not good.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is not good!" Moses’ father-in-law exclaimed.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses’ father-in-law then said to him, "The thing that you are doing is not good.
verses.textEn: Moses’ father-in-law replied, "What you are doing is not good.

verses.textZh: 你必疲乏不堪；不但你自己，连与你在一起的人民也必疲乏不堪，因为这事太重，你不能独自一人去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必疲乏不堪；不但你自己，连与你在一起的人民也必疲乏不堪，因为这事太重，你不能独自一人去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 你和这些百姓必都疲惫；因为这事太重，你独自一人办理不了。
verses.textEnNiv: You and these people who come to you will only wear yourselves out. The work is too heavy for you; you cannot handle it alone.
verses.textEnEsv: You and the people with you will certainly wear yourselves out, for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to do it alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: Both you and these people who are with you will surely wear yourselves out. For this thing is too much for you; you are not able to perform it by yourself.
verses.textEnNlt: "You’re going to wear yourself out—and the people, too. This job is too heavy a burden for you to handle all by yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: You will surely wear out, both yourself and these people who are with you, because the task is too heavy for you; you cannot do it alone.
verses.textEn: You and these people who come to you will only wear yourselves out. The work is too heavy for you; you cannot handle it alone.

verses.textZh: 现在你要听我的话，我要给你出个主意，愿神与你同在；你要代替人民到神面前，把他们的事件带到神那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要听我的话，我要给你出个主意，愿神与你同在；你要代替人民到神面前，把他们的事件带到神那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要听我的话。我为你出个主意，愿神与你同在。你要替百姓到神面前，将案件奏告神；
verses.textEnNiv: Listen now to me and I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their disputes to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now obey my voice; I will give you advice, and God be with you! You shall represent the people before God and bring their cases to God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Listen now to my voice; I will give you counsel, and God will be with you: Stand before God for the people, so that you may bring the difficulties to God.
verses.textEnNlt: Now listen to me, and let me give you a word of advice, and may God be with you. You should continue to be the people’s representative before God, bringing their disputes to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now listen to me: I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You be the people’s representative before God, and you bring the disputes to God,
verses.textEn: Listen now to me and I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their disputes to him.

verses.textZh: 又要把规例和律法教导他们，使他们知道他们当走的路，应作的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要把规例和律法教导他们，使他们知道他们当走的路，应作的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要将律例和法度教训他们，指示他们当行的道，当做的事；
verses.textEnNiv: Teach them his decrees and instructions, and show them the way they are to live and how they are to behave.
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall warn them about the statutes and the laws, and make them know the way in which they must walk and what they must do.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and show them the way in which they must walk and the work they must do.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach them God’s decrees, and give them his instructions. Show them how to conduct their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: then admonish them about the statutes and the laws, and make known to them the way in which they are to walk and the work they are to do.
verses.textEn: Teach them his decrees and instructions, and show them the way they are to live and how they are to behave.

verses.textZh: 你要从人民中间选出有才能的人，就是敬畏神、忠实可信、恨恶不义之财的人，设立他们作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长，去管理人民，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要从人民中间选出有才能的人，就是敬畏神、忠实可信、恨恶不义之财的人，设立他们作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长，去管理人民，
verses.textZhCuv: 并要从百姓中拣选有才能的人，就是敬畏神、诚实无妄、恨不义之财的人，派他们作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长，管理百姓，
verses.textEnNiv: But select capable men from all the people—men who fear God, trustworthy men who hate dishonest gain—and appoint them as officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, look for able men from all the people, men who fear God, who are trustworthy and hate a bribe, and place such men over the people as chiefs of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover you shall select from all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them tobe rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.textEnNlt: But select from all the people some capable, honest men who fear God and hate bribes. Appoint them as leaders over groups of one thousand, one hundred, fifty, and ten.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, you shall select out of all the people able men who fear God, men of truth, those who hate dishonest gain; and you shall place these over them as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
verses.textEn: But select capable men from all the people—men who fear God, trustworthy men who hate dishonest gain—and appoint them as officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.

verses.textZh: 使他们随时可以审判人民的案件；所有大事件，他们要带到你这里来；所有小事件，他们可以自己审判。这样，你就轻省些，他们也可以和你一同分担此事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他们随时可以审判人民的案件；所有大事件，他们要带到你这里来；所有小事件，他们可以自己审判。这样，你就轻省些，他们也可以和你一同分担此事。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫他们随时审判百姓，大事都要呈到你这里，小事他们自己可以审判。这样，你就轻省些，他们也可以同当此任。
verses.textEnNiv: Have them serve as judges for the people at all times, but have them bring every difficult case to you; the simple cases they can decide themselves. That will make your load lighter, because they will share it with you.
verses.textEnEsv: And let them judge the people at all times. Every great matter they shall bring to you, but any small matter they shall decide themselves. So it will be easier for you, and they will bear the burden with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And let them judge the people at all times. Then it will be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they themselves shall judge. So it will be easier for you, for they will bear theburden with you.
verses.textEnNlt: They should always be available to solve the people’s common disputes, but have them bring the major cases to you. Let the leaders decide the smaller matters themselves. They will help you carry the load, making the task easier for you.
verses.textEnNasb: Let them judge the people at all times; and let it be that they will bring to you every major matter, but they will judge every minor matter themselves. So it will be easier for you, and they will carry the burden with you.
verses.textEn: Have them serve as judges for the people at all times, but have them bring every difficult case to you; the simple cases they can decide themselves. That will make your load lighter, because they will share it with you.

verses.textZh: 你若是这样行，神也这样吩咐你，你就能站立得住，所有的人民也都能平平安安地归回自己的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若是这样行，神也这样吩咐你，你就能站立得住，所有的人民也都能平平安安地归回自己的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你若这样行，神也这样吩咐你，你就能受得住，这百姓也都平平安安归回他们的住处。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you do this and God so commands, you will be able to stand the strain, and all these people will go home satisfied."
verses.textEnEsv: If you do this, God will direct you, you will be able to endure, and all this people also will go to their place in peace."
verses.textEnNkjv: If you do this thing, and God so commands you, then you will be able to endure, and all this people will also go to their place in peace."
verses.textEnNlt: If you follow this advice, and if God commands you to do so, then you will be able to endure the pressures, and all these people will go home in peace."
verses.textEnNasb: If you do this thing and God so commands you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their places in peace."
verses.textEn: If you do this and God so commands, you will be able to stand the strain, and all these people will go home satisfied."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西听从他岳父的话，照着他所说的行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西听从他岳父的话，照着他所说的行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，摩西听从他岳父的话，按着他所说的去行。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law and did all that he had said.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses heeded the voice of his father-in-law and did all that he had said.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses listened to his father-in-law’s advice and followed his suggestions.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything that he had said.
verses.textEn: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.

verses.textZh: 摩西从全体以色列人中选出了有才能的人，立他们作人民的首领，作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西从全体以色列人中选出了有才能的人，立他们作人民的首领，作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西从以色列人中拣选了有才能的人，立他们为百姓的首领，作千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长。
verses.textEnNiv: He chose capable men from all Israel and made them leaders of the people, officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses chose able men out of all Israel and made them heads over the people, chiefs of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people: rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.textEnNlt: He chose capable men from all over Israel and appointed them as leaders over the people. He put them in charge of groups of one thousand, one hundred, fifty, and ten.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses chose able men out of all Israel and made them heads over the people, leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
verses.textEn: He chose capable men from all Israel and made them leaders of the people, officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.

verses.textZh: 他们随时审判人民的案件；有困难的事件，他们就带到摩西那里；所有小事件，由他们自己审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们随时审判人民的案件；有困难的事件，他们就带到摩西那里；所有小事件，由他们自己审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们随时审判百姓，有难断的案件就呈到摩西那里，但各样小事他们自己审判。
verses.textEnNiv: They served as judges for the people at all times. The difficult cases they brought to Moses, but the simple ones they decided themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: And they judged the people at all times. Any hard case they brought to Moses, but any small matter they decided themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they judged the people at all times; the hard cases they brought to Moses, but they judged every small case themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: These men were always available to solve the people’s common disputes. They brought the major cases to Moses, but they took care of the smaller matters themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they judged the people at all times; they would bring the difficult matter to Moses, but they would judge every minor matter themselves.
verses.textEn: They served as judges for the people at all times. The difficult cases they brought to Moses, but the simple ones they decided themselves.

verses.textZh: 后来，摩西给他的岳父送行，他就回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，摩西给他的岳父送行，他就回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，摩西让他的岳父去，他就往本地去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own country.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went away to his own country.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way to his own land.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon after this, Moses said good-bye to his father-in-law, who returned to his own land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said goodbye to his father-in-law, and Jethro went his way to his own land.
verses.textEn: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own country.

verses.textZh: 以色列人从埃及地出来以后，满了三个月的那一天，就来到西奈的旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人从埃及地出来以后，满了三个月的那一天，就来到西奈的旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人出埃及地以后，满了三个月的那一天，就来到西奈的旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: On the first day of the third month after the Israelites left Egypt—on that very day—they came to the Desert of Sinai.
verses.textEnEsv: On the third new moon after the people of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on the same day, they came to the Wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEnNlt: Exactly two months after the Israelites left Egypt, they arrived in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEnNasb: In the third month after the sons of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that very day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEn: On the first day of the third month after the Israelites left Egypt—on that very day—they came to the Desert of Sinai.

verses.textZh: 他们从利非订起行，来到西奈的旷野，就在旷野安营；以色列人在那座山前安了营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从利非订起行，来到西奈的旷野，就在旷野安营；以色列人在那座山前安了营。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们离了利非订，来到西奈的旷野，就在那里的山下安营。
verses.textEnNiv: After they set out from Rephidim, they entered the Desert of Sinai, and Israel camped there in the desert in front of the mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: They set out from Rephidim and came into the wilderness of Sinai, and they encamped in the wilderness. There Israel encamped before the mountain,
verses.textEnNkjv: For they had departed from Rephidim, had come to the Wilderness of Sinai, and camped in the wilderness. So Israel camped there before the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: After breaking camp at Rephidim, they came to the wilderness of Sinai and set up camp there at the base of Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNasb: When they set out from Rephidim, they came to the wilderness of Sinai and camped in the wilderness; and there Israel camped in front of the mountain.
verses.textEn: After they set out from Rephidim, they entered the Desert of Sinai, and Israel camped there in the desert in front of the mountain.

verses.textZh: 摩西上到神那里去，耶和华从山上呼唤他，说："你要这样告诉雅各家，吩咐以色列人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西上到神那里去，耶和华从山上呼唤他，说："你要这样告诉雅各家，吩咐以色列人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西到神那里，耶和华从山上呼唤他说：「你要这样告诉雅各家，晓谕以色列人说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses went up to God, and the Lord called to him from the mountain and said, "This is what you are to say to the descendants of Jacob and what you are to tell the people of Israel:
verses.textEnEsv: while Moses went up to God. The Lord called to him out of the mountain, saying, "Thus you shall say to the house of Jacob, and tell the people of Israel:
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses went up to God, and the Lord called to him from the mountain, saying, "Thus you shall say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses climbed the mountain to appear before God. The Lord called to him from the mountain and said, "Give these instructions to the family of Jacob; announce it to the descendants of Israel:
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses went up to God, and the Lord called to him from the mountain, saying, "This is what you shall say to the house of Jacob and tell the sons of Israel:
verses.textEn: Then Moses went up to God, and the Lord called to him from the mountain and said, "This is what you are to say to the descendants of Jacob and what you are to tell the people of Israel:

verses.textZh: ‘我向埃及人所行的，你们都看见了；也看见了我怎样像鹰一样把你们背在翅膀上，带领你们到我这里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘我向埃及人所行的，你们都看见了；也看见了我怎样像鹰一样把你们背在翅膀上，带领你们到我这里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 『我向埃及人所行的事，你们都看见了，且看见我如鹰将你们背在翅膀上，带来归我。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘You yourselves have seen what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to myself.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘You yourselves have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings and brought you to myself.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians. You know how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to myself.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You yourselves have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to Myself.
verses.textEn: ‘You yourselves have seen what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to myself.

verses.textZh: 现在你们若是实在听我的话，遵守我的约，你们就必在万民中作属我的产业，因为全地都是我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们若是实在听我的话，遵守我的约，你们就必在万民中作属我的产业，因为全地都是我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今你们若实在听从我的话，遵守我的约，就要在万民中作属我的子民，因为全地都是我的。
verses.textEnNiv: Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession. Although the whole earth is mine,
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, you shall be my treasured possession among all peoples, for all the earth is mine;
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, then you shall be a special treasure to Me above all people; for all the earth is Mine.
verses.textEnNlt: Now if you will obey me and keep my covenant, you will be my own special treasure from among all the peoples on earth; for all the earth belongs to me.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, then you shall be My own possession among all the peoples, for all the earth is Mine;
verses.textEn: Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession. Although the whole earth is mine,

verses.textZh: 你们要归我作君尊的祭司和圣洁的国民。’这些话你都要对以色列人说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要归我作君尊的祭司和圣洁的国民。’这些话你都要对以色列人说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要归我作祭司的国度，为圣洁的国民。』这些话你要告诉以色列人。」
verses.textEnNiv: you will be for me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words you are to speak to the Israelites."
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you shall speak to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall be to Me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: And you will be my kingdom of priests, my holy nation.’ This is the message you must give to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall be to Me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you shall speak to the sons of Israel."
verses.textEn: you will be for me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words you are to speak to the Israelites."

verses.textZh: 摩西去把人民的长老召了来，把耶和华吩咐他的这一切话都摆在他们面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西去把人民的长老召了来，把耶和华吩咐他的这一切话都摆在他们面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西去召了民间的长老来，将耶和华所吩咐他的话都在他们面前陈明。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all the words the Lord had commanded him to speak.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses came and called the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before them all these words which the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses returned from the mountain and called together the elders of the people and told them everything the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses came and called the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEn: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all the words the Lord had commanded him to speak.

verses.textZh: 人民都一致地回答，说："凡是耶和华吩咐的，我们都要遵行。"摩西就去把人民的话回复耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民都一致地回答，说："凡是耶和华吩咐的，我们都要遵行。"摩西就去把人民的话回复耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓都同声回答说：「凡耶和华所说的，我们都要遵行。」摩西就将百姓的话回复耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The people all responded together, "We will do everything the Lord has said." So Moses brought their answer back to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: All the people answered together and said, "All that the Lord has spoken we will do." And Moses reported the words of the people to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the people answered together and said, "All that the Lord has spoken we will do." So Moses brought back the words of the people to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And all the people responded together, "We will do everything the Lord has commanded." So Moses brought the people’s answer back to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the people answered together and said, "All that the Lord has spoken we will do!" And Moses brought back the words of the people to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The people all responded together, "We will do everything the Lord has said." So Moses brought their answer back to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，我要在密云中降临到你那里，为要使人民在我与你说话的时候可以听见，也可以永远信你。"于是，摩西把人民的话告诉了耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："看哪，我要在密云中降临到你那里，为要使人民在我与你说话的时候可以听见，也可以永远信你。"于是，摩西把人民的话告诉了耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「我要在密云中临到你那里，叫百姓在我与你说话的时候可以听见，也可以永远信你了。」于是，摩西将百姓的话奏告耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "I am going to come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear me speaking with you and will always put their trust in you." Then Moses told the Lord what the people had said.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I am coming to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever." When Moses told the words of the people to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I come to you in the thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and believe you forever." So Moses told the words of the people to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "I will come to you in a thick cloud, Moses, so the people themselves can hear me when I speak with you. Then they will always trust you." Moses told the Lord what the people had said.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Behold, I will come to you in a thick cloud, so that the people may hear when I speak with you and may also trust in you forever." Then Moses told the words of the people to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "I am going to come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear me speaking with you and will always put their trust in you." Then Moses told the Lord what the people had said.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你到人民那里去，要他们今天明天分别为圣，又要他们洗净自己的衣服；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你到人民那里去，要他们今天明天分别为圣，又要他们洗净自己的衣服；
