verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又对摩西说：「你往百姓那里去，叫他们今天明天自洁，又叫他们洗衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. Have them wash their clothes
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord said to Moses, "Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their clothes.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told Moses, "Go down and prepare the people for my arrival. Consecrate them today and tomorrow, and have them wash their clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord also said to Moses, "Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow, and have them wash their garments;
verses.textEn: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. Have them wash their clothes

verses.textZh: 第三天，他们要准备好了，因为第三天耶和华要在全体人民眼前降临在西奈山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三天，他们要准备好了，因为第三天耶和华要在全体人民眼前降临在西奈山。
verses.textZhCuv: 到第三天要预备好了，因为第三天耶和华要在众百姓眼前降临在西奈山上。
verses.textEnNiv: and be ready by the third day, because on that day the Lord will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
verses.textEnEsv: and be ready for the third day. For on the third day the Lord will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And let them be ready for the third day. For on the third day the Lord will come down upon Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Be sure they are ready on the third day, for on that day the Lord will come down on Mount Sinai as all the people watch.
verses.textEnNasb: and have them ready for the third day, for on the third day the Lord will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
verses.textEn: and be ready by the third day, because on that day the Lord will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.

verses.textZh: 你要在山的周围给人民定界限，说：‘你们要谨慎，不可上山来，也不可触摸山脚；凡是触摸着那山的，必要把他处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在山的周围给人民定界限，说：‘你们要谨慎，不可上山来，也不可触摸山脚；凡是触摸着那山的，必要把他处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要在山的四围给百姓定界限，说：『你们当谨慎，不可上山去，也不可摸山的边界；凡摸这山的，必要治死他。
verses.textEnNiv: Put limits for the people around the mountain and tell them, ‘Be careful that you do not approach the mountain or touch the foot of it. Whoever touches the mountain is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set limits for the people all around, saying, ‘Take care not to go up into the mountain or touch the edge of it. Whoever touches the mountain shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall set bounds for the people all around, saying, ‘Take heed to yourselves that you do not go up to the mountain or touch its base. Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: Mark off a boundary all around the mountain. Warn the people, ‘Be careful! Do not go up on the mountain or even touch its boundaries. Anyone who touches the mountain will certainly be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: But you shall set boundaries for the people all around, saying, ‘ Beware that you do not go up on the mountain or touch the border of it; whoever touches the mountain shall certainly be put to death.
verses.textEn: Put limits for the people around the mountain and tell them, ‘Be careful that you do not approach the mountain or touch the foot of it. Whoever touches the mountain is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 不可用手触摸他，必须用石头把他打死，或用箭射透；无论是牲畜，是人，都不得生存。’当号角声拖长的时候，你们才可以上到山上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可用手触摸他，必须用石头把他打死，或用箭射透；无论是牲畜，是人，都不得生存。’当号角声拖长的时候，你们才可以上到山上来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不可用手摸他，必用石头打死，或用箭射透；无论是人是牲畜，都不得活。到角声拖长的时候，他们才可到山根来。』」
verses.textEnNiv: They are to be stoned or shot with arrows; not a hand is to be laid on them. No person or animal shall be permitted to live.’ Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain."
verses.textEnEsv: No hand shall touch him, but he shall be stoned or shot; whether beast or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds a long blast, they shall come up to the mountain."
verses.textEnNkjv: Not a hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot withanarrow; whether man or beast, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come near the mountain."
verses.textEnNlt: No hand may touch the person or animal that crosses the boundary; instead, stone them or shoot them with arrows. They must be put to death.’ However, when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast, then the people may go up on the mountain. "
verses.textEnNasb: No hand shall touch him, but he shall certainly be stoned or shot through; whether animal or person, the violator shall not live.’ When the ram’s horn sounds a long blast, they shall come up to the mountain."
verses.textEn: They are to be stoned or shot with arrows; not a hand is to be laid on them. No person or animal shall be permitted to live.’ Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain."

verses.textZh: 摩西从山上下来到人民那里去，使人民分别为圣，他们就把自己的衣服洗净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西从山上下来到人民那里去，使人民分别为圣，他们就把自己的衣服洗净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西下山往百姓那里去，叫他们自洁，他们就洗衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: After Moses had gone down the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses went down from the mountain to the people and consecrated the people; and they washed their garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses went down from the mountain to the people and sanctified the people, and they washed their clothes.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses went down to the people. He consecrated them for worship, and they washed their clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses went down from the mountain to the people and consecrated the people, and they washed their garments.
verses.textEn: After Moses had gone down the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.

verses.textZh: 他对人民说："第三天，你们要预备好了；不可亲近女人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对人民说："第三天，你们要预备好了；不可亲近女人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对百姓说：「到第三天要预备好了。不可亲近女人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to the people, "Prepare yourselves for the third day. Abstain from sexual relations."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the people, "Be ready for the third day; do not go near a woman."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to the people, "Be ready for the third day; do not come near your wives."
verses.textEnNlt: He told them, "Get ready for the third day, and until then abstain from having sexual intercourse."
verses.textEnNasb: He also said to the people, "Be ready for the third day; do not go near a woman."
verses.textEn: Then he said to the people, "Prepare yourselves for the third day. Abstain from sexual relations."

verses.textZh: 到了第三天早晨的时候，山上有雷声、闪电和密云，并且角声非常强大，以致所有在营中的人民都颤抖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第三天早晨的时候，山上有雷声、闪电和密云，并且角声非常强大，以致所有在营中的人民都颤抖。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了第三天早晨，在山上有雷轰、闪电，和密云，并且角声甚大，营中的百姓尽都发颤。
verses.textEnNiv: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning, with a thick cloud over the mountain, and a very loud trumpet blast. Everyone in the camp trembled.
verses.textEnEsv: On the morning of the third day there were thunders and lightnings and a thick cloud on the mountain and a very loud trumpet blast, so that all the people in the camp trembled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it came to pass on the third day, in the morning, that there were thunderings and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain; and the sound of the trumpet was very loud, so that all the people who were in the camp trembled.
verses.textEnNlt: On the morning of the third day, thunder roared and lightning flashed, and a dense cloud came down on the mountain. There was a long, loud blast from a ram’s horn, and all the people trembled.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about on the third day, when it was morning, that there were thunder and lightning flashes and a thick cloud over the mountain and a very loud trumpet sound, so that all the people who were in the camp trembled.
verses.textEn: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning, with a thick cloud over the mountain, and a very loud trumpet blast. Everyone in the camp trembled.

verses.textZh: 摩西率领人民出营去迎接神，他们都站在山下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西率领人民出营去迎接神，他们都站在山下。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西率领百姓出营迎接神，都站在山下。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses led the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet God, and they took their stand at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses brought th e people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses led them out from the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEn: Then Moses led the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.

verses.textZh: 西奈全山冒烟，因为耶和华在火中降临到山上；山的烟向上升，好象火窑的烟一样。全山猛烈震动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西奈全山冒烟，因为耶和华在火中降临到山上；山的烟向上升，好象火窑的烟一样。全山猛烈震动。
verses.textZhCuv: 西奈全山冒烟，因为耶和华在火中降于山上。山的烟气上腾，如烧窑一般，遍山大大地震动。
verses.textEnNiv: Mount Sinai was covered with smoke, because the Lord descended on it in fire. The smoke billowed up from it like smoke from a furnace, and the whole mountain trembled violently.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Mount Sinai was wrapped in smoke because the Lord had descended on it in fire. The smoke of it went up like the smoke of a kiln, and the whole mountain trembled greatly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Mount Sinai was completely in smoke, because the Lord descended upon it in fire. Its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.
verses.textEnNlt: All of Mount Sinai was covered with smoke because the Lord had descended on it in the form of fire. The smoke billowed into the sky like smoke from a brick kiln, and the whole mountain shook violently.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Mount Sinai was all in smoke because the Lord descended upon it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the entire mountain quaked violently.
verses.textEn: Mount Sinai was covered with smoke, because the Lord descended on it in fire. The smoke billowed up from it like smoke from a furnace, and the whole mountain trembled violently.

verses.textZh: 角声越来越大，大到极点的时候，摩西就说话，神用雷声回答摩西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 角声越来越大，大到极点的时候，摩西就说话，神用雷声回答摩西。
verses.textZhCuv: 角声渐渐地高而又高，摩西就说话，神有声音答应他。
verses.textEnNiv: As the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and the voice of God answered him.
verses.textEnEsv: And as the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him in thunder.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the blast of the trumpet sounded long and became louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by voice.
verses.textEnNlt: As the blast of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God thundered his reply.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him with thunder.
verses.textEn: As the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and the voice of God answered him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华降临在西奈山上，就是降临到山顶上；耶和华呼召摩西上山顶，他就上去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华降临在西奈山上，就是降临到山顶上；耶和华呼召摩西上山顶，他就上去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华降临在西奈山顶上，耶和华召摩西上山顶，摩西就上去。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the top of the mountain. So Moses went up
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. And the Lord called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord came down upon Mount Sinai, on the top of the mountain. And the Lord called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord came down on the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the top of the mountain. So Moses climbed the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain; and the Lord called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
verses.textEn: The Lord descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the top of the mountain. So Moses went up

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你下去警告人民，不可闯过来，到我这里观看，免得他们中间有很多人灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你下去警告人民，不可闯过来，到我这里观看，免得他们中间有很多人灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你下去嘱咐百姓，不可闯过来到我面前观看，恐怕他们有多人死亡；
verses.textEnNiv: and the Lord said to him, "Go down and warn the people so they do not force their way through to see the Lord and many of them perish.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go down and warn the people, lest they break through to the Lord to look and many of them perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go down and warn the people, lest they break through to gaze at the Lord, and many of them perish.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told Moses, "Go back down and warn the people not to break through the boundaries to see the Lord , or they will die.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses: "Go down, warn the people, so that they do not break through to the Lord to stare, and many of them perish.
verses.textEn: and the Lord said to him, "Go down and warn the people so they do not force their way through to see the Lord and many of them perish.

verses.textZh: 又叫那些亲近耶和华的祭司分别为圣，恐怕耶和华忽然击杀他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又叫那些亲近耶和华的祭司分别为圣，恐怕耶和华忽然击杀他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又叫亲近我的祭司自洁，恐怕我忽然出来击杀他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Even the priests, who approach the Lord , must consecrate themselves, or the Lord will break out against them."
verses.textEnEsv: Also let the priests who come near to the Lord consecrate themselves, lest the Lord break out against them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also let the priests who come near the Lord consecrate themselves, lest the Lord break out against them."
verses.textEnNlt: Even the priests who regularly come near to the Lord must purify themselves so that the Lord does not break out and destroy them."
verses.textEnNasb: Also have the priests who approach the Lord consecrate themselves, or else the Lord will break out against them."
verses.textEn: Even the priests, who approach the Lord , must consecrate themselves, or the Lord will break out against them."

verses.textZh: 摩西对耶和华说："人民不能上西奈山，因为你曾经警告我们，说：‘要给山定界限，也要把山分别为圣。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对耶和华说："人民不能上西奈山，因为你曾经警告我们，说：‘要给山定界限，也要把山分别为圣。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对耶和华说：「百姓不能上西奈山，因为你已经嘱咐我们说：『要在山的四围定界限，叫山成圣。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to the Lord , "The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, because you yourself warned us, ‘Put limits around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to the Lord , "The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai, for you yourself warned us, saying, ‘Set limits around the mountain and consecrate it.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Moses said to the Lord, "The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai; for You warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain and consecrate it.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "But Lord ," Moses protested, "the people cannot come up to Mount Sinai. You already warned us. You told me, ‘Mark off a boundary all around the mountain to set it apart as holy.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses said to the Lord, "The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai, for You warned us, saying, ‘Set boundaries around the mountain and consecrate it.’ "
verses.textEn: Moses said to the Lord , "The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, because you yourself warned us, ‘Put limits around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对他说："下去吧，你要和亚伦一起再上来，只是祭司和人民都不可闯过来，上到我这里，恐怕我忽然击杀他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对他说："下去吧，你要和亚伦一起再上来，只是祭司和人民都不可闯过来，上到我这里，恐怕我忽然击杀他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对他说：「下去吧，你要和亚伦一同上来；只是祭司和百姓不可闯过来上到我面前，恐怕我忽然出来击杀他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord replied, "Go down and bring Aaron up with you. But the priests and the people must not force their way through to come up to the Lord , or he will break out against them."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to him, "Go down, and come up bringing Aaron with you. But do not let the priests and the people break through to come up to the Lord , lest he break out against them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to him, "Away! Get down and then come up, you and Aaron with you. But do not let the priests and the people break through to come up to the Lord, lest He break out against them."
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said, "Go down and bring Aaron back up with you. In the meantime, do not let the priests or the people break through to approach the Lord , or he will break out and destroy them."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to him, " Go down and come up again, you and Aaron with you; but do not let the priests and the people break through to come up to the Lord, or He will break out against them."
verses.textEn: The Lord replied, "Go down and bring Aaron up with you. But the priests and the people must not force their way through to come up to the Lord , or he will break out against them."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西下到人民那里告诉他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西下到人民那里告诉他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西下到百姓那里告诉他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses went down to the people and told them.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses went down to the people and told them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses went down to the people and told them what the Lord had said.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses went down to the people and told them.
verses.textEn: So Moses went down to the people and told them.

verses.textZh: 神吩咐以下这一切话，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 神吩咐以下这一切话，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 神吩咐这一切的话说：
verses.textEnNiv: And God spoke all these words:
verses.textEnEsv: And God spoke all these words, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And God spoke all these words, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then God gave the people all these instructions :
verses.textEnNasb: Then God spoke all these words, saying,
verses.textEn: And God spoke all these words:

verses.textZh: "我是耶和华你的神，曾经把你从埃及地，从为奴之家领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我是耶和华你的神，曾经把你从埃及地，从为奴之家领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我是耶和华－你的神，曾将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
verses.textEnEsv: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the Lord your God, who rescued you from the land of Egypt, the place of your slavery.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
verses.textEn: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

verses.textZh: "除我以外，你不可有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: "除我以外，你不可有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 「除了我以外，你不可有别的神。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall have no other gods before Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not have any other god but me.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall have no other gods before Me.
verses.textEn: "You shall have no other gods before me.

verses.textZh: "不可为自己做偶像，也不可做天上、地下和地底下水中各物的形象。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可为自己做偶像，也不可做天上、地下和地底下水中各物的形象。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可为自己雕刻偶像，也不可做什么形象仿佛上天、下地，和地底下、水中的百物。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not make for yourself an image in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not make for yourself a carved image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not make for yourself a carved image—any likeness ofanything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth;
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not make for yourself an idol of any kind or an image of anything in the heavens or on the earth or in the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not make for yourself an idol, or any likeness of what is in heaven above or on the earth beneath, or in the water under the earth.
verses.textEn: "You shall not make for yourself an image in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

verses.textZh: 不可跪拜它们，也不可事奉它们，因为我耶和华你们的神是忌邪的神；恨恶我的，我必追讨他们的罪，从父亲到儿子，直到三四代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可跪拜它们，也不可事奉它们，因为我耶和华你们的神是忌邪的神；恨恶我的，我必追讨他们的罪，从父亲到儿子，直到三四代。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因为我耶和华－你的神是忌邪的神。恨我的，我必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三四代；
verses.textEnNiv: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not bow down to them or serve them, for I the Lord your God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall not bow down to them nor serve them. For I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
verses.textEnNlt: You must not bow down to them or worship them, for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God who will not tolerate your affection for any other gods. I lay the sins of the parents upon their children; the entire family is affected—even children in the third and fourth generations of those who reject me.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not worship them nor serve them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, inflicting the punishment of the fathers on the children, on the third and the fourth generations of those who hate Me,
verses.textEn: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

verses.textZh: 爱我和遵守我诫命的，我必向他们施慈爱，直到千代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱我和遵守我诫命的，我必向他们施慈爱，直到千代。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱我、守我诫命的，我必向他们发慈爱，直到千代。
verses.textEnNiv: but showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.textEnEsv: but showing steadfast love to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: but showing mercy to thousands, to those who love Me and keep My commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: But I lavish unfailing love for a thousand generations on those who love me and obey my commands.
verses.textEnNasb: but showing favor to thousands, to those who love Me and keep My commandments.
verses.textEn: but showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments.

verses.textZh: "不可妄称耶和华你神的名，因为妄称耶和华的名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可妄称耶和华你神的名，因为妄称耶和华的名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可妄称耶和华－你神的名；因为妄称耶和华名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord will not hold him guiltless who takes His name in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not misuse the name of the Lord your God. The Lord will not let you go unpunished if you misuse his name.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord will not leave him unpunished who takes His name in vain.
verses.textEn: "You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.

verses.textZh: "要记念安息日，守为圣日。
verses.textZhCnvs: "要记念安息日，守为圣日。
verses.textZhCuv: 「当记念安息日，守为圣日。
verses.textEnNiv: "Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.
verses.textEnEsv: "Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.textEnNlt: "Remember to observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.textEn: "Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

verses.textZh: 六日要劳碌，作你一切工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六日要劳碌，作你一切工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 六日要劳碌做你一切的工，
verses.textEnNiv: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
verses.textEnEsv: Six days you shall labor, and do all your work,
verses.textEnNkjv: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
verses.textEnNlt: You have six days each week for your ordinary work,
verses.textEnNasb: For six days you shall labor and do all your work,
verses.textEn: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

verses.textZh: 但第七日是耶和华你的神的安息日；这一日，你和你的儿女，你的仆婢和牲畜，以及住在你城里的寄居者，不可作任何的工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但第七日是耶和华你的神的安息日；这一日，你和你的儿女，你的仆婢和牲畜，以及住在你城里的寄居者，不可作任何的工。
verses.textZhCuv: 但第七日是向耶和华－你神当守的安息日。这一日你和你的儿女、仆婢、牲畜，并你城里寄居的客旅，无论何工都不可做；
verses.textEnNiv: but the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your male or female servant, nor your animals, nor any foreigner residing in your towns.
verses.textEnEsv: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, you, or your son, or your daughter, your male servant, or your female servant, or your livestock, or the sojourner who is within your gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the seventh day is the Sabbath of the Lord your God. Init you shall do no work: you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your cattle, nor your stranger who is within your gates.
verses.textEnNlt: but the seventh day is a Sabbath day of rest dedicated to the Lord your God. On that day no one in your household may do any work. This includes you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, your livestock, and any foreigners living among you.
verses.textEnNasb: but the seventh day is a Sabbath of the Lord your God; on it you shall not do any work, you, or your son, or your daughter, your male slave or your female slave, or your cattle, or your resident who stays with you.
verses.textEn: but the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your male or female servant, nor your animals, nor any foreigner residing in your towns.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华在六日之内造天、地、海和其中的万物，第七日就歇息了；所以耶和华赐福安息日，定为圣日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华在六日之内造天、地、海和其中的万物，第七日就歇息了；所以耶和华赐福安息日，定为圣日。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为六日之内，耶和华造天、地、海，和其中的万物，第七日便安息，所以耶和华赐福与安息日，定为圣日。
verses.textEnNiv: For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, but he rested on the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.
verses.textEnEsv: For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested on the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and hallowed it.
verses.textEnNlt: For in six days the Lord made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and everything in them; but on the seventh day he rested. That is why the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
verses.textEnNasb: For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, the sea and everything that is in them, and He rested on the seventh day; for that reason the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.
verses.textEn: For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, but he rested on the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.

verses.textZh: "要孝敬父母，使你在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上得享长寿。
verses.textZhCnvs: "要孝敬父母，使你在耶和华你的神赐给你的地上得享长寿。
verses.textZhCuv: 「当孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和华－你神所赐你的地上得以长久。
verses.textEnNiv: "Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnEsv: "Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long upon the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Honor your father and mother. Then you will live a long, full life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Honor your father and your mother, so that your days may be prolonged on the land which the Lord your God gives you.
verses.textEn: "Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.textZh: "不可杀人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可杀人。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可杀人。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not murder.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not murder.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not murder.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not murder.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not murder.
verses.textEn: "You shall not murder.

verses.textZh: "不可奸淫。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可奸淫。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可奸淫。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not commit adultery.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not commit adultery.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not commit adultery.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not commit adultery.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not commit adultery.
verses.textEn: "You shall not commit adultery.

verses.textZh: "不可偷盗。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可偷盗。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可偷盗。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not steal.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not steal.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not steal.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not steal.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not steal.
verses.textEn: "You shall not steal.

verses.textZh: "不可作假证供陷害你的邻舍。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可作假证供陷害你的邻舍。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可作假见证陷害人。
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not testify falsely against your neighbor.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.textEn: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

verses.textZh: "不可贪爱你邻舍的房屋；不可贪爱你邻舍的妻子、仆婢、牛驴和他的任何东西。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可贪爱你邻舍的房屋；不可贪爱你邻舍的妻子、仆婢、牛驴和他的任何东西。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可贪恋人的房屋；也不可贪恋人的妻子、仆婢、牛驴，并他一切所有的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his male or female servant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not covet your neighbor’s house; you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his male servant, or his female servant, or his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s."
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not covet your neighbor’s house; you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s."
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not covet your neighbor’s house. You must not covet your neighbor’s wife, male or female servant, ox or donkey, or anything else that belongs to your neighbor."
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not covet your neighbor’s house; you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his male slave, or his female slave, or his ox, or his donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."
verses.textEn: "You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his male or female servant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."

verses.textZh: 全体人民都看见打雷、闪电、角声和冒着烟的山；人民看见了，就颤抖，远远地站着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体人民都看见打雷、闪电、角声和冒着烟的山；人民看见了，就颤抖，远远地站着。
verses.textZhCuv: 众百姓见雷轰、闪电、角声、山上冒烟，就都发颤，远远地站立，
verses.textEnNiv: When the people saw the thunder and lightning and heard the trumpet and saw the mountain in smoke, they trembled with fear. They stayed at a distance
verses.textEnEsv: Now when all the people saw the thunder and the flashes of lightning and the sound of the trumpet and the mountain smoking, the people were afraid and trembled, and they stood far off
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all the people witnessed the thunderings, the lightning flashes, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking; and when the people saw it, they trembled and stood afar off.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people heard the thunder and the loud blast of the ram’s horn, and when they saw the flashes of lightning and the smoke billowing from the mountain, they stood at a distance, trembling with fear.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people were watching and hearing the thunder and the lightning flashes, and the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking; and when the people saw it all, they trembled and stood at a distance.
verses.textEn: When the people saw the thunder and lightning and heard the trumpet and saw the mountain in smoke, they trembled with fear. They stayed at a distance

verses.textZh: 他们对摩西说："求你和我们说话吧，我们必定听你的话，不可让神和我们说话，恐怕我们死亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对摩西说："求你和我们说话吧，我们必定听你的话，不可让神和我们说话，恐怕我们死亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对摩西说：「求你和我们说话，我们必听；不要神和我们说话，恐怕我们死亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said to Moses, "Speak to us yourself and we will listen. But do not have God speak to us or we will die."
verses.textEnEsv: and said to Moses, "You speak to us, and we will listen; but do not let God speak to us, lest we die."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to Moses, "You speak with us, and we will hear; but let not God speak with us, lest we die."
verses.textEnNlt: And they said to Moses, "You speak to us, and we will listen. But don’t let God speak directly to us, or we will die!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to Moses, "Speak to us yourself and we will listen; but do not have God speak to us, or we will die!"
verses.textEn: and said to Moses, "Speak to us yourself and we will listen. But do not have God speak to us or we will die."

verses.textZh: 摩西回答人民："不要惧怕，因为神降临是要试验你们，叫你们常常敬畏他，不至犯罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答人民："不要惧怕，因为神降临是要试验你们，叫你们常常敬畏他，不至犯罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对百姓说：「不要惧怕；因为神降临是要试验你们，叫你们时常敬畏他，不致犯罪。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid. God has come to test you, so that the fear of God will be with you to keep you from sinning."
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said to the people, "Do not fear, for God has come to test you, that the fear of him may be before you, that you may not sin."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to the people, "Do not fear; for God has come to test you, and that His fear may be before you, so that you may not sin."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t be afraid," Moses answered them, "for God has come in this way to test you, and so that your fear of him will keep you from sinning!"
verses.textEnNasb: However, Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid; for God has come in order to test you, and in order that the fear of Him may remain with you, so that you will not sin."
verses.textEn: Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid. God has come to test you, so that the fear of God will be with you to keep you from sinning."

verses.textZh: 于是，人民远远地站着，摩西却走近神所在的幽暗之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，人民远远地站着，摩西却走近神所在的幽暗之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是百姓远远地站立；摩西就挨近神所在的幽暗之中。
verses.textEnNiv: The people remained at a distance, while Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.
verses.textEnEsv: The people stood far off, while Moses drew near to the thick darkness where God was.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people stood afar off, but Moses drew near the thick darkness where God was.
verses.textEnNlt: As the people stood in the distance, Moses approached the dark cloud where God was.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people stood at a distance, while Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.
verses.textEn: The people remained at a distance, while Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对以色列人这样说：‘你们亲自看见我从天上和你们说话了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对以色列人这样说：‘你们亲自看见我从天上和你们说话了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你要向以色列人这样说：『你们自己看见我从天上和你们说话了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites this: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven:
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Thus you shall say to the people of Israel: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Thus you shall say to the children of Israel: ‘You have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses, "Say this to the people of Israel: You saw for yourselves that I spoke to you from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "This is what you shall say to the sons of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have spoken to you from heaven.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites this: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven:

verses.textZh: 你们不可做银的神像和金的神像和我相比，你们决不可为自己做这些神像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可做银的神像和金的神像和我相比，你们决不可为自己做这些神像。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不可做什么神像与我相配，不可为自己做金银的神像。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not make any gods to be alongside me; do not make for yourselves gods of silver or gods of gold.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not make gods of silver to be with me, nor shall you make for yourselves gods of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not make anythingtobe with Me—gods of silver or gods of gold you shall not make for yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, you must not make any idols of silver or gold to rival me.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not make other gods besides Me; gods of silver or gods of gold, you shall not make for yourselves.
verses.textEn: Do not make any gods to be alongside me; do not make for yourselves gods of silver or gods of gold.

verses.textZh: 你要为我筑一座土坛，把你的燔祭、平安祭和牛羊献在坛上；在我使人记念我名的地方，我都必到你那里去赐福你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要为我筑一座土坛，把你的燔祭、平安祭和牛羊献在坛上；在我使人记念我名的地方，我都必到你那里去赐福你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要为我筑土坛，在上面以牛羊献为燔祭和平安祭。凡记下我名的地方，我必到那里赐福给你。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Make an altar of earth for me and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, your sheep and goats and your cattle. Wherever I cause my name to be honored, I will come to you and bless you.
verses.textEnEsv: An altar of earth you shall make for me and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your oxen. In every place where I cause my name to be remembered I will come to you and bless you.
verses.textEnNkjv: An altar of earth you shall make for Me, and you shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your oxen. In every place where I record My name I will come to you, and I will bless you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Build for me an altar made of earth, and offer your sacrifices to me—your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and goats, and your cattle. Build my altar wherever I cause my name to be remembered, and I will come to you and bless you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make an altar of earth for Me, and you shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your oxen; in every place where I cause My name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.
verses.textEn: " ‘Make an altar of earth for me and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, your sheep and goats and your cattle. Wherever I cause my name to be honored, I will come to you and bless you.

verses.textZh: 你若是为我筑一座石坛，不可用凿过的石头来建筑，因为你在石头上一动用工具，就把坛污秽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若是为我筑一座石坛，不可用凿过的石头来建筑，因为你在石头上一动用工具，就把坛污秽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若为我筑一座石坛，不可用凿成的石头，因你在上头一动家具，就把坛污秽了。
verses.textEnNiv: If you make an altar of stones for me, do not build it with dressed stones, for you will defile it if you use a tool on it.
verses.textEnEsv: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of hewn stones, for if you wield your tool on it you profane it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you make Me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of hewn stone; for if you use your tool on it, you have profaned it.
verses.textEnNlt: If you use stones to build my altar, use only natural, uncut stones. Do not shape the stones with a tool, for that would make the altar unfit for holy use.
verses.textEnNasb: And if you make an altar of stone for Me, you shall not build it of cut stones, for if you wield your chisel on it, you will profane it.
verses.textEn: If you make an altar of stones for me, do not build it with dressed stones, for you will defile it if you use a tool on it.

verses.textZh: 你上我的坛，不可用梯级，免得在坛上露出你的下体来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你上我的坛，不可用梯级，免得在坛上露出你的下体来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你上我的坛，不可用台阶，免得露出你的下体来。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And do not go up to my altar on steps, or your private parts may be exposed.’
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness be not exposed on it.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor shall you go up by steps to My altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed on it.’
verses.textEnNlt: And do not approach my altar by going up steps. If you do, someone might look up under your clothing and see your nakedness.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not go up by steps to My altar, so that your nakedness will not be exposed on it.’
verses.textEn: And do not go up to my altar on steps, or your private parts may be exposed.’

verses.textZh: "你要在众民面前订立的典章是这样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要在众民面前订立的典章是这样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你在百姓面前所要立的典章是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: "These are the laws you are to set before them:
verses.textEnEsv: "Now these are the rules that you shall set before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now these are the judgments which you shall set before them:
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the regulations you must present to Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now these are the ordinances which you are to set before them:
verses.textEn: "These are the laws you are to set before them:

verses.textZh: 如果你买希伯来人作奴仆，他要服事你六年；到第七年他可以自由出去，不必补偿甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你买希伯来人作奴仆，他要服事你六年；到第七年他可以自由出去，不必补偿甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若买希伯来人作奴仆，他必服事你六年；第七年他可以自由，白白地出去。
verses.textEnNiv: "If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free, without paying anything.
verses.textEnEsv: When you buy a Hebrew slave, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free, for nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years; and in the seventh he shall go out free and pay nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you buy a Hebrew slave, he may serve for no more than six years. Set him free in the seventh year, and he will owe you nothing for his freedom.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you buy a Hebrew slave, he shall serve for six years; but on the seventh he shall leave as a free man without a payment to you.
verses.textEn: "If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free, without paying anything.

verses.textZh: 他若是单身来，就可以单身出去；他若是有妇之夫，他的妻子就可以和他同去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他若是单身来，就可以单身出去；他若是有妇之夫，他的妻子就可以和他同去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若孤身来就可以孤身去；他若有妻，他的妻就可以同他出去。
verses.textEnNiv: If he comes alone, he is to go free alone; but if he has a wife when he comes, she is to go with him.
verses.textEnEsv: If he comes in single, he shall go out single; if he comes in married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself; if he comesin married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.textEnNlt: If he was single when he became your slave, he shall leave single. But if he was married before he became a slave, then his wife must be freed with him.
verses.textEnNasb: If he comes alone, he shall leave alone; if he is the husband of a wife, then his wife shall leave with him.
verses.textEn: If he comes alone, he is to go free alone; but if he has a wife when he comes, she is to go with him.

verses.textZh: 他的主人若是给他妻子，妻子又给他生了儿女，那么妻子和儿女都要归给主人，他自己要单独出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的主人若是给他妻子，妻子又给他生了儿女，那么妻子和儿女都要归给主人，他自己要单独出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他主人若给他妻子，妻子给他生了儿子或女儿，妻子和儿女要归主人，他要独自出去。
verses.textEnNiv: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.
verses.textEnEsv: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: If his master has given him a wife, and she has borne him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.textEnNlt: "If his master gave him a wife while he was a slave and they had sons or daughters, then only the man will be free in the seventh year, but his wife and children will still belong to his master.
verses.textEnNasb: If his master gives him a wife, and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall belong to her master, and he shall leave alone.
verses.textEn: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.

verses.textZh: 如果那奴仆明明说：‘我爱我的主人和我的妻子儿女，不愿意自由出去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那奴仆明明说：‘我爱我的主人和我的妻子儿女，不愿意自由出去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 倘或奴仆明说：『我爱我的主人和我的妻子儿女，不愿意自由出去。』
verses.textEnNiv: "But if the servant declares, ‘I love my master and my wife and children and do not want to go free,’
verses.textEnEsv: But if the slave plainly says, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free,’
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the servant plainly says, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free,’
verses.textEnNlt: But the slave may declare, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I don’t want to go free.’
verses.textEnNasb: But if the slave plainly says, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not leave as a free man,’
verses.textEn: "But if the servant declares, ‘I love my master and my wife and children and do not want to go free,’

verses.textZh: 他的主人就要把他带到审判官 那里，又要把他带到门前，或是门柱旁；他的主人要用锥子刺穿他的耳朵，他就要永远服事他的主人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的主人就要把他带到审判官 那里，又要把他带到门前，或是门柱旁；他的主人要用锥子刺穿他的耳朵，他就要永远服事他的主人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的主人就要带他到审判官 那里，又要带他到门前，靠近门框，用锥子穿他的耳朵，他就永远服事主人。
verses.textEnNiv: then his master must take him before the judges. He shall take him to the door or the doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he will be his servant for life.
verses.textEnEsv: then his master shall bring him to God, and he shall bring him to the door or the doorpost. And his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall be his slave forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: then his master shall bring him to the judges. He shall also bring him to the door, or to the doorpost, and his master shall pierce his ear with an awl; and he shall serve him forever.
verses.textEnNlt: If he does this, his master must present him before God. Then his master must take him to the door or doorpost and publicly pierce his ear with an awl. After that, the slave will serve his master for life.
verses.textEnNasb: then his master shall bring him to God, then he shall bring him to the door or the doorpost. And his master shall pierce his ear with an awl; and he shall serve him permanently.
verses.textEn: then his master must take him before the judges. He shall take him to the door or the doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he will be his servant for life.

verses.textZh: 如果有人把女儿卖作婢女，婢女不可像男仆那样出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人把女儿卖作婢女，婢女不可像男仆那样出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若卖女儿作婢女，婢女不可像男仆那样出去。
verses.textEnNiv: "If a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as male servants do.
verses.textEnEsv: "When a man sells his daughter as a slave, she shall not go out as the male slaves do.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And if a man sells his daughter to be a female slave, she shall not go out as the male slaves do.
verses.textEnNlt: "When a man sells his daughter as a slave, she will not be freed at the end of six years as the men are.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if a man sells his daughter as a female slave, she is not to go free as the male slaves do.
verses.textEn: "If a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as male servants do.

verses.textZh: 如果主人选定她归自己，以后又不喜欢她，就要准她赎身；主人没有权力可以把她卖给外族人，因为主人曾经欺骗了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果主人选定她归自己，以后又不喜欢她，就要准她赎身；主人没有权力可以把她卖给外族人，因为主人曾经欺骗了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 主人选定她归自己，若不喜欢她，就要许她赎身；主人既然用诡诈待她，就没有权柄卖给外邦人。
verses.textEnNiv: If she does not please the master who has selected her for himself, he must let her be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, because he has broken faith with her.
verses.textEnEsv: If she does not please her master, who has designated her for himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has broken faith with her.
verses.textEnNkjv: If she does not please her master, who has betrothed her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.textEnNlt: If she does not satisfy her owner, he must allow her to be bought back again. But he is not allowed to sell her to foreigners, since he is the one who broke the contract with her.
verses.textEnNasb: If she is displeasing in the eyes of her master who designated her for himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He does not have authority to sell her to a foreign people, because of his unfairness to her.
verses.textEn: If she does not please the master who has selected her for himself, he must let her be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, because he has broken faith with her.

verses.textZh: 如果主人选定她归自己的儿子，就必须照着待女儿的规矩待她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果主人选定她归自己的儿子，就必须照着待女儿的规矩待她。
verses.textZhCuv: 主人若选定她给自己的儿子，就当待她如同女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: If he selects her for his son, he must grant her the rights of a daughter.
verses.textEnEsv: If he designates her for his son, he shall deal with her as with a daughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if he has betrothed her to his son, he shall deal with her according to the custom of daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the slave’s owner arranges for her to marry his son, he may no longer treat her as a slave but as a daughter.
verses.textEnNasb: And if he designates her for his son, he shall deal with her according to the custom of daughters.
verses.textEn: If he selects her for his son, he must grant her the rights of a daughter.

verses.textZh: 如果他另娶一个妻子，那么，对她的饮食、衣着和性的需要，仍然不可减少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他另娶一个妻子，那么，对她的饮食、衣着和性的需要，仍然不可减少。
verses.textZhCuv: 若另娶一个，那女子的吃食、衣服，并好合的事，仍不可减少。
verses.textEnNiv: If he marries another woman, he must not deprive the first one of her food, clothing and marital rights.
verses.textEnEsv: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, or her marital rights.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he takes another wife, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marriage rights.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man who has married a slave wife takes another wife for himself, he must not neglect the rights of the first wife to food, clothing, and sexual intimacy.
verses.textEnNasb: If he takes to himself another woman, he may not reduce her food, her clothing, or her conjugal rights.
verses.textEn: If he marries another woman, he must not deprive the first one of her food, clothing and marital rights.

verses.textZh: 如果他不向她行这三样，她就可以自由出去，不必补偿甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他不向她行这三样，她就可以自由出去，不必补偿甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 若不向她行这三样，她就可以不用钱赎，白白地出去。」
verses.textEnNiv: If he does not provide her with these three things, she is to go free, without any payment of money.
verses.textEnEsv: And if he does not do these three things for her, she shall go out for nothing, without payment of money.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if he does not do these three for her, then she shall go out free, without paying money.
verses.textEnNlt: If he fails in any of these three obligations, she may leave as a free woman without making any payment.
verses.textEnNasb: But if he will not do these three things for her, then she shall go free for nothing, without payment of money.
verses.textEn: If he does not provide her with these three things, she is to go free, without any payment of money.

verses.textZh: "打人以致把人打死的，必要把那人处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: "打人以致把人打死的，必要把那人处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「打人以致打死的，必要把他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone who strikes a person with a fatal blow is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever strikes a man so that he dies shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who assaults and kills another person must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: "He who strikes someone so that he dies shall certainly be put to death.
verses.textEn: "Anyone who strikes a person with a fatal blow is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 人若不是蓄意杀人，而是神交在他手中的，我就给你设立一个地方，他可以逃到那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若不是蓄意杀人，而是神交在他手中的，我就给你设立一个地方，他可以逃到那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若不是埋伏着杀人，乃是神交在他手中，我就设下一个地方，他可以往那里逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: However, if it is not done intentionally, but God lets it happen, they are to flee to a place I will designate.
verses.textEnEsv: But if he did not lie in wait for him, but God let him fall into his hand, then I will appoint for you a place to which he may flee.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, if he did not lie in wait, but God delivered him into his hand, then I will appoint for you a place where he may flee.
verses.textEnNlt: But if it was simply an accident permitted by God, I will appoint a place of refuge where the slayer can run for safety.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet if he did not lie in wait for him, but God caused him to fall into his hand, then I will appoint you a place to which he may flee.
verses.textEn: However, if it is not done intentionally, but God lets it happen, they are to flee to a place I will designate.

verses.textZh: 若有人任意待他的邻舍，用诡计把他杀了，你要把他从我的祭坛那里拿去处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 若有人任意待他的邻舍，用诡计把他杀了，你要把他从我的祭坛那里拿去处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若任意用诡计杀了他的邻舍，就是逃到我的坛那里，也当捉去把他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: But if anyone schemes and kills someone deliberately, that person is to be taken from my altar and put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: But if a man willfully attacks another to kill him by cunning, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if a man acts with premeditation against his neighbor, to kill him by treachery, you shall take him from My altar, that he may die.
verses.textEnNlt: However, if someone deliberately kills another person, then the slayer must be dragged even from my altar and be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: If, however, someone is enraged against his neighbor, so as to kill him in a cunning way, you are to take him even from My altar, to be put to death.
verses.textEn: But if anyone schemes and kills someone deliberately, that person is to be taken from my altar and put to death.

verses.textZh: "打父母的，必要把那人处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: "打父母的，必要把那人处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「打父母的，必要把他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone who attacks their father or mother is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever strikes his father or his mother shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And he who strikes his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who strikes father or mother must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: "And one who strikes his father or his mother shall certainly be put to death.
verses.textEn: "Anyone who attacks their father or mother is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: "拐带人口的，无论是把人卖了，或是还留在他手中，必要把那人处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: "拐带人口的，无论是把人卖了，或是还留在他手中，必要把那人处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「拐带人口，或是把人卖了，或是留在他手下，必要把他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone who kidnaps someone is to be put to death, whether the victim has been sold or is still in the kidnapper’s possession.
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever steals a man and sells him, and anyone found in possession of him, shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who kidnaps a man and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "Kidnappers must be put to death, whether they are caught in possession of their victims or have already sold them as slaves.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now one who kidnaps someone, whether he sells him or he is found in his possession, shall certainly be put to death.
verses.textEn: "Anyone who kidnaps someone is to be put to death, whether the victim has been sold or is still in the kidnapper’s possession.

verses.textZh: 咒骂父母的，必要把那人处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 咒骂父母的，必要把那人处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「咒骂父母的，必要把他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever curses his father or his mother shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And he who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who dishonors father or mother must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: "And one who curses his father or his mother shall certainly be put to death.
verses.textEn: "Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: "如果人彼此争论，一个用石头或拳头打另一个，但他还没有死，不过要躺在床上，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人彼此争论，一个用石头或拳头打另一个，但他还没有死，不过要躺在床上，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若彼此相争，这个用石头或是拳头打那个，尚且不至于死，不过躺卧在床，
verses.textEnNiv: "If people quarrel and one person hits another with a stone or with their fist and the victim does not die but is confined to bed,
verses.textEnEsv: "When men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone or with his fist and the man does not die but takes to his bed,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If men contend with each other, and one strikes the other with a stone or with his fist, and he does not die but is confined to his bed,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now suppose two men quarrel, and one hits the other with a stone or fist, and the injured person does not die but is confined to bed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if people have a quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone or with a fist, and he does not die but is confined to bed,
verses.textEn: "If people quarrel and one person hits another with a stone or with their fist and the victim does not die but is confined to bed,

verses.textZh: 以后，他若是能起来，能扶杖出外行走，那打他的就可算无罪，但要赔偿他停工的损失，并且要把他完全医好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后，他若是能起来，能扶杖出外行走，那打他的就可算无罪，但要赔偿他停工的损失，并且要把他完全医好。
verses.textZhCuv: 若再能起来扶杖而出，那打他的可算无罪；但要将他耽误的工夫用钱赔补，并要将他全然医好。
verses.textEnNiv: the one who struck the blow will not be held liable if the other can get up and walk around outside with a staff; however, the guilty party must pay the injured person for any loss of time and see that the victim is completely healed.
verses.textEnEsv: then if the man rises again and walks outdoors with his staff, he who struck him shall be clear; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall have him thoroughly healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: if he rises again and walks about outside with his staff, then he who struck him shall be acquitted. He shall only pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide forhim to be thoroughly healed.
verses.textEnNlt: If he is later able to walk outside again, even with a crutch, the assailant will not be punished but must compensate his victim for lost wages and provide for his full recovery.
verses.textEnNasb: if he gets up and walks around outside on his staff, then he who struck him shall go unpunished; he shall only pay for his loss of time, and shall pay for his care until he is completely healed.
verses.textEn: the one who struck the blow will not be held liable if the other can get up and walk around outside with a staff; however, the guilty party must pay the injured person for any loss of time and see that the victim is completely healed.

verses.textZh: "如果有人用棍打他的奴仆或婢女，以致死在他的手下，他必须受刑罚；
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人用棍打他的奴仆或婢女，以致死在他的手下，他必须受刑罚；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若用棍子打奴仆或婢女，立时死在他的手下，他必要受刑。
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone who beats their male or female slave with a rod must be punished if the slave dies as a direct result,
verses.textEnEsv: "When a man strikes his slave, male or female, with a rod and the slave dies under his hand, he shall be avenged.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And if a man beats his male or female servant with a rod, so that he dies under his hand, he shall surely be punished.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man beats his male or female slave with a club and the slave dies as a result, the owner must be punished.
verses.textEnNasb: "And if someone strikes his male or female slave with a rod and the slave dies at his hand, he shall be punished.
verses.textEn: "Anyone who beats their male or female slave with a rod must be punished if the slave dies as a direct result,

verses.textZh: 但如果他还活一两天，那人就不必受刑罚，因为那奴仆是他的财产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果他还活一两天，那人就不必受刑罚，因为那奴仆是他的财产。
verses.textZhCuv: 若过一两天才死，就可以不受刑，因为是用钱买的。
verses.textEnNiv: but they are not to be punished if the slave recovers after a day or two, since the slave is their property.
verses.textEnEsv: But if the slave survives a day or two, he is not to be avenged, for the slave is his money.
verses.textEnNkjv: Notwithstanding, if he remains alive a day or two, he shall not be punished; for he is his property.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the slave recovers within a day or two, then the owner shall not be punished, since the slave is his property.
verses.textEnNasb: If, however, the slave survives a day or two, no vengeance shall be taken; for the slave is his property.
verses.textEn: but they are not to be punished if the slave recovers after a day or two, since the slave is their property.

verses.textZh: "如果人彼此争斗，击伤了怀孕的妇人，以致流产，但没有别的损害，那伤害她的必须按照妇人的丈夫要求的，和照着审判官断定的，缴纳罚款。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人彼此争斗，击伤了怀孕的妇人，以致流产，但没有别的损害，那伤害她的必须按照妇人的丈夫要求的，和照着审判官断定的，缴纳罚款。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若彼此争斗，伤害有孕的妇人，甚至坠胎，随后却无别害，那伤害她的，总要按妇人的丈夫所要的，照审判官所断的，受罚。
verses.textEnNiv: "If people are fighting and hit a pregnant woman and she gives birth prematurely but there is no serious injury, the offender must be fined whatever the woman’s husband demands and the court allows.
verses.textEnEsv: "When men strive together and hit a pregnant woman, so that her children come out, but there is no harm, the one who hit her shall surely be fined, as the woman’s husband shall impose on him, and he shall pay as the judges determine.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If men fight, and hurt a woman with child, so that she gives birth prematurely, yet no harm follows, he shall surely be punished accordingly as the woman’s husband imposes on him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now suppose two men are fighting, and in the process they accidentally strike a pregnant woman so she gives birth prematurely. If no further injury results, the man who struck the woman must pay the amount of compensation the woman’s husband demands and the judges approve.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if people struggle with each other and strike a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, but there is no injury, the guilty person shall certainly be fined as the woman’s husband may demand of him, and he shall pay as the judges decide.
verses.textEn: "If people are fighting and hit a pregnant woman and she gives birth prematurely but there is no serious injury, the offender must be fined whatever the woman’s husband demands and the court allows.

verses.textZh: 如果有别的损害，你就要以命偿命，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有别的损害，你就要以命偿命，
verses.textZhCuv: 若有别害，就要以命偿命，
verses.textEnNiv: But if there is serious injury, you are to take life for life,
verses.textEnEsv: But if there is harm, then you shall pay life for life,
verses.textEnNkjv: But if any harm follows, then you shall give life for life,
verses.textEnNlt: But if there is further injury, the punishment must match the injury: a life for a life,
verses.textEnNasb: But if there is any further injury, then you shall appoint as a penalty life for life,
verses.textEn: But if there is serious injury, you are to take life for life,

verses.textZh: 以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚，
verses.textZhCuv: 以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚，
verses.textEnNiv: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.textEnEsv: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.textEnNkjv: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.textEnNlt: an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand, a foot for a foot,
verses.textEnNasb: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.textEn: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

verses.textZh: 以烙还烙，以伤还伤，以打还打。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以烙还烙，以伤还伤，以打还打。
verses.textZhCuv: 以烙还烙，以伤还伤，以打还打。
verses.textEnNiv: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.
verses.textEnEsv: burn for burn, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.textEnNkjv: burn for burn, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.textEnNlt: a burn for a burn, a wound for a wound, a bruise for a bruise.
verses.textEnNasb: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.
verses.textEn: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.

verses.textZh: "如果有人击打他奴仆的一只眼，或婢女的一只眼，把眼打坏了，就要因他的眼的缘故让他自由离去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人击打他奴仆的一只眼，或婢女的一只眼，把眼打坏了，就要因他的眼的缘故让他自由离去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若打坏了他奴仆或是婢女的一只眼，就要因他的眼放他去得以自由。
verses.textEnNiv: "An owner who hits a male or female slave in the eye and destroys it must let the slave go free to compensate for the eye.
verses.textEnEsv: "When a man strikes the eye of his slave, male or female, and destroys it, he shall let the slave go free because of his eye.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man strikes the eye of his male or female servant, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for the sake of his eye.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man hits his male or female slave in the eye and the eye is blinded, he must let the slave go free to compensate for the eye.
verses.textEnNasb: "And if someone strikes the eye of his male or female slave and destroys it, he shall let the slave go free on account of the eye.
verses.textEn: "An owner who hits a male or female slave in the eye and destroys it must let the slave go free to compensate for the eye.

verses.textZh: 如果有人打落了他奴仆的一颗牙，或婢女的一颗牙，就要因他的牙的缘故让他自由离去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人打落了他奴仆的一颗牙，或婢女的一颗牙，就要因他的牙的缘故让他自由离去。
verses.textZhCuv: 若打掉了他奴仆或是婢女的一个牙，就要因他的牙放他去得以自由。」
verses.textEnNiv: And an owner who knocks out the tooth of a male or female slave must let the slave go free to compensate for the tooth.
verses.textEnEsv: If he knocks out the tooth of his slave, male or female, he shall let the slave go free because of his tooth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if he knocks out the tooth of his male or female servant, he shall let him go free for the sake of his tooth.
verses.textEnNlt: And if a man knocks out the tooth of his male or female slave, he must let the slave go free to compensate for the tooth.
verses.textEnNasb: And if he knocks out a tooth of his male or female slave, he shall let the slave go free on account of the tooth.
verses.textEn: And an owner who knocks out the tooth of a male or female slave must let the slave go free to compensate for the tooth.

verses.textZh: "如果牛触了男人或女人，以致死亡，那牛必须用石头打死，只是不可吃牛的肉；牛的主人却不必受刑罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果牛触了男人或女人，以致死亡，那牛必须用石头打死，只是不可吃牛的肉；牛的主人却不必受刑罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 「牛若触死男人或是女人，总要用石头打死那牛，却不可吃它的肉；牛的主人可算无罪。
verses.textEnNiv: "If a bull gores a man or woman to death, the bull is to be stoned to death, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the bull will not be held responsible.
verses.textEnEsv: "When an ox gores a man or a woman to death, the ox shall be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten, but the owner of the ox shall not be liable.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If an ox gores a man or a woman to death, then the ox shall surely be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shallbe acquitted.
verses.textEnNlt: "If an ox gores a man or woman to death, the ox must be stoned, and its flesh may not be eaten. In such a case, however, the owner will not be held liable.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if an ox gores a man or a woman to death, the ox shall certainly be stoned and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall go unpunished.
verses.textEn: "If a bull gores a man or woman to death, the bull is to be stoned to death, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the bull will not be held responsible.

verses.textZh: 如果那牛以前常常触人，牛主也曾经受过警告，他仍然不把牛拴好，以致触死了男人或是女人，就要用石头把那牛打死，牛主也必要处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那牛以前常常触人，牛主也曾经受过警告，他仍然不把牛拴好，以致触死了男人或是女人，就要用石头把那牛打死，牛主也必要处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若那牛素来是触人的，有人报告了牛主，他竟不把牛拴着，以致把男人或是女人触死，就要用石头打死那牛，牛主也必治死。
verses.textEnNiv: If, however, the bull has had the habit of goring and the owner has been warned but has not kept it penned up and it kills a man or woman, the bull is to be stoned and its owner also is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: But if the ox has been accustomed to gore in the past, and its owner has been warned but has not kept it in, and it kills a man or a woman, the ox shall be stoned, and its owner also shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the ox tended to thrust with its horn in times past, and it has been made known to his owner, and he has not kept it confined, so that it has killed a man or a woman, the ox shall be stoned and its owner also shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: But suppose the ox had a reputation for goring, and the owner had been informed but failed to keep it under control. If the ox then kills someone, it must be stoned, and the owner must also be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: If, however, an ox was previously in the habit of goring and its owner has been warned, yet he does not confine it and it kills a man or a woman, the ox shall be stoned and its owner also shall be put to death.
verses.textEn: If, however, the bull has had the habit of goring and the owner has been warned but has not kept it penned up and it kills a man or woman, the bull is to be stoned and its owner also is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 如果给他提出赎金，他就必须照着提出的数量全数缴付赎命金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果给他提出赎金，他就必须照着提出的数量全数缴付赎命金。
verses.textZhCuv: 若罚他赎命的价银，他必照所罚的赎他的命。
verses.textEnNiv: However, if payment is demanded, the owner may redeem his life by the payment of whatever is demanded.
verses.textEnEsv: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: If there is imposed on him a sum of money, then he shall pay to redeem his life, whatever is imposed on him.
verses.textEnNlt: However, the dead person’s relatives may accept payment to compensate for the loss of life. The owner of the ox may redeem his life by paying whatever is demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: If a ransom is demanded of him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is demanded of him.
verses.textEn: However, if payment is demanded, the owner may redeem his life by the payment of whatever is demanded.

verses.textZh: 牛无论触了人的儿子，或是触了人的女儿，都必须照着这定例办理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牛无论触了人的儿子，或是触了人的女儿，都必须照着这定例办理。
verses.textZhCuv: 牛无论触了人的儿子或是女儿，必照这例办理。
verses.textEnNiv: This law also applies if the bull gores a son or daughter.
verses.textEnEsv: If it gores a man’s son or daughter, he shall be dealt with according to this same rule.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whether it has gored a son or gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.
verses.textEnNlt: "The same regulation applies if the ox gores a boy or a girl.
verses.textEnNasb: Whether it gores a son or a daughter, it shall be done to him according to the same rule.
verses.textEn: This law also applies if the bull gores a son or daughter.

verses.textZh: 如果牛触了人的奴仆，或是婢女，必须把三百四十克银子给他的主人，那牛也必须用石头打死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果牛触了人的奴仆，或是婢女，必须把三百四十克银子给他的主人，那牛也必须用石头打死。
verses.textZhCuv: 牛若触了奴仆或是婢女，必将银子三十舍客勒给他们的主人，也要用石头把牛打死。
verses.textEnNiv: If the bull gores a male or female slave, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of the slave, and the bull is to be stoned to death.
verses.textEnEsv: If the ox gores a slave, male or female, the owner shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the ox gores a male or female servant, he shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the ox gores a slave, either male or female, the animal’s owner must pay the slave’s owner thirty silver coins, and the ox must be stoned.
verses.textEnNasb: If the ox gores a male or female slave, the owner shall give his or her master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.textEn: If the bull gores a male or female slave, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of the slave, and the bull is to be stoned to death.

verses.textZh: "如果有人把井敞开，或是有人挖了井，而不把井口遮盖，以致有牛或驴掉进里面，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人把井敞开，或是有人挖了井，而不把井口遮盖，以致有牛或驴掉进里面，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若敞着井口，或挖井不遮盖，有牛或驴掉在里头，
verses.textEnNiv: "If anyone uncovers a pit or digs one and fails to cover it and an ox or a donkey falls into it,
verses.textEnEsv: "When a man opens a pit, or when a man digs a pit and does not cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls into it,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And if a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and does not cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls in it,
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose someone digs or uncovers a pit and fails to cover it, and then an ox or a donkey falls into it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now if someone opens a pit, or digs a pit and does not cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls into it,
verses.textEn: "If anyone uncovers a pit or digs one and fails to cover it and an ox or a donkey falls into it,

verses.textZh: 井主要赔偿，要把银子还给牛主或驴主，死的牲畜可以归自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 井主要赔偿，要把银子还给牛主或驴主，死的牲畜可以归自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 井主要拿钱赔还本主人，死牲畜要归自己。
verses.textEnNiv: the one who opened the pit must pay the owner for the loss and take the dead animal in exchange.
verses.textEnEsv: the owner of the pit shall make restoration. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.textEnNkjv: the owner of the pit shall make it good; he shall give money to their owner, but the dead animal shall be his.
verses.textEnNlt: The owner of the pit must pay full compensation to the owner of the animal, but then he gets to keep the dead animal.
verses.textEnNasb: the owner of the pit shall make restitution; he shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall become his.
verses.textEn: the one who opened the pit must pay the owner for the loss and take the dead animal in exchange.

verses.textZh: "如果有人的牛伤了他邻舍的牛，以致死亡，他们要把活牛卖了，平分银子，也要平分死牛。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人的牛伤了他邻舍的牛，以致死亡，他们要把活牛卖了，平分银子，也要平分死牛。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这人的牛若伤了那人的牛，以至于死，他们要卖了活牛，平分价值，也要平分死牛。
verses.textEnNiv: "If anyone’s bull injures someone else’s bull and it dies, the two parties are to sell the live one and divide both the money and the dead animal equally.
verses.textEnEsv: "When one man’s ox butts another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live ox and share its price, and the dead beast also they shall share.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If one man’s ox hurts another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live ox and divide the money from it; and the dead ox they shall also divide.
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone’s ox injures a neighbor’s ox and the injured ox dies, then the two owners must sell the live ox and divide the price equally between them. They must also divide the dead animal.
verses.textEnNasb: "And if someone’s ox injures another’s ox so that it dies, then they shall sell the live ox and divide its proceeds equally; and they shall also divide the dead ox.
verses.textEn: "If anyone’s bull injures someone else’s bull and it dies, the two parties are to sell the live one and divide both the money and the dead animal equally.

verses.textZh: 如果人知道那牛以前常常触人，牛主竟不把牛拴好，他必须赔偿，以牛还牛，死的可以归自己。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人知道那牛以前常常触人，牛主竟不把牛拴好，他必须赔偿，以牛还牛，死的可以归自己。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人若知道这牛素来是触人的，主人竟不把牛拴着，他必要以牛还牛，死牛要归自己。」
verses.textEnNiv: However, if it was known that the bull had the habit of goring, yet the owner did not keep it penned up, the owner must pay, animal for animal, and take the dead animal in exchange.
verses.textEnEsv: Or if it is known that the ox has been accustomed to gore in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall repay ox for ox, and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or if it was known that the ox tended to thrust in time past, and its owner has not kept it confined, he shall surely pay ox for ox, and the dead animal shall be his own.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the ox had a reputation for goring, yet its owner failed to keep it under control, he must pay full compensation—a live ox for the dead one—but he may keep the dead ox.
verses.textEnNasb: Or if it is known that the ox was previously in the habit of goring, yet its owner has not confined it, he must make restitution of ox for ox, and the dead animal shall become his.
verses.textEn: However, if it was known that the bull had the habit of goring, yet the owner did not keep it penned up, the owner must pay, animal for animal, and take the dead animal in exchange.

verses.textZh: "如果人偷了牛或是羊，无论是宰了或是卖了，他必须赔偿，以五牛还一牛，以四羊还一羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人偷了牛或是羊，无论是宰了或是卖了，他必须赔偿，以五牛还一牛，以四羊还一羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若偷牛或羊，无论是宰了，是卖了，他就要以五牛赔一牛，四羊赔一羊。
verses.textEnNiv: "Whoever steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters it or sells it must pay back five head of cattle for the ox and four sheep for the sheep.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall repay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and slaughters it or sells it, he shall restore five oxen for an ox and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone steals an ox or sheep and then kills or sells it, the thief must pay back five oxen for each ox stolen, and four sheep for each sheep stolen.
verses.textEnNasb: " If someone steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for the ox and four sheep for the sheep—
verses.textEn: "Whoever steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters it or sells it must pay back five head of cattle for the ox and four sheep for the sheep.

verses.textZh: "窃贼挖窟窿入屋的时候，如果被人发现，把他打了，以致打死，打死人的就没有流人血的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "窃贼挖窟窿入屋的时候，如果被人发现，把他打了，以致打死，打死人的就没有流人血的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 人若遇见贼挖窟窿，把贼打了，以至于死，就不能为他有流血的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: "If a thief is caught breaking in at night and is struck a fatal blow, the defender is not guilty of bloodshed;
verses.textEnEsv: If a thief is found breaking in and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no bloodguilt for him,
verses.textEnNkjv: If the thief is found breaking in, and he is struck so that he dies, thereshallbe no guilt for his bloodshed.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a thief is caught in the act of breaking into a house and is struck and killed in the process, the person who killed the thief is not guilty of murder.
verses.textEnNasb: If the thief is caught while breaking in and is struck so that he dies, there will be no guilt for bloodshed on his account.
verses.textEn: "If a thief is caught breaking in at night and is struck a fatal blow, the defender is not guilty of bloodshed;

verses.textZh: 如果太阳出来了，他就有流人血的罪。窃贼必须赔偿，如果他一无所有，就要卖身，还他所偷之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果太阳出来了，他就有流人血的罪。窃贼必须赔偿，如果他一无所有，就要卖身，还他所偷之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 若太阳已经出来，就为他有流血的罪。贼若被拿，总要赔还。若他一无所有，就要被卖，顶他所偷的物。
verses.textEnNiv: but if it happens after sunrise, the defender is guilty of bloodshed. "Anyone who steals must certainly make restitution, but if they have nothing, they must be sold to pay for their theft.
verses.textEnEsv: but if the sun has risen on him, there shall be bloodguilt for him. He shall surely pay. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the sun has risen on him, thereshallbe guilt for his bloodshed. He should make full restitution; if he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.textEnNlt: But if it happens in daylight, the one who killed the thief is guilty of murder. "A thief who is caught must pay in full for everything he stole. If he cannot pay, he must be sold as a slave to pay for his theft.
