verses.textEnNasb: If the sun has risen on him, there will be guilt for bloodshed on his account—A thief shall certainly make restitution; if he owns nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.textEn: but if it happens after sunrise, the defender is guilty of bloodshed. "Anyone who steals must certainly make restitution, but if they have nothing, they must be sold to pay for their theft.

verses.textZh: 所偷之物，无论是牛、是驴，或是羊，如果发现在他手中仍然活着，他必须双倍偿还。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所偷之物，无论是牛、是驴，或是羊，如果发现在他手中仍然活着，他必须双倍偿还。
verses.textZhCuv: 若他所偷的，或牛，或驴，或羊，仍在他手下存活，他就要加倍赔还。
verses.textEnNiv: If the stolen animal is found alive in their possession—whether ox or donkey or sheep—they must pay back double.
verses.textEnEsv: If the stolen beast is found alive in his possession, whether it is an ox or a donkey or a sheep, he shall pay double.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the theft is certainly found alive in his hand, whether it is an ox or donkey or sheep, he shall restore double.
verses.textEnNlt: If someone steals an ox or a donkey or a sheep and it is found in the thief’s possession, then the thief must pay double the value of the stolen animal.
verses.textEnNasb: If what he stole is actually found alive in his possession, whether an ox or a donkey or a sheep, he shall pay double.
verses.textEn: If the stolen animal is found alive in their possession—whether ox or donkey or sheep—they must pay back double.

verses.textZh: 如果有人在田间或葡萄园里放牲畜吃草，任由牲畜到别人的田里去吃草，就必须拿自己田间最好的，或自己葡萄园中最好的赔偿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人在田间或葡萄园里放牲畜吃草，任由牲畜到别人的田里去吃草，就必须拿自己田间最好的，或自己葡萄园中最好的赔偿。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若在田间或在葡萄园里放牲畜，任凭牲畜上别人的田里去吃，就必拿自己田间上好的和葡萄园上好的赔还。
verses.textEnNiv: "If anyone grazes their livestock in a field or vineyard and lets them stray and they graze in someone else’s field, the offender must make restitution from the best of their own field or vineyard.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man causes a field or vineyard to be grazed over, or lets his beast loose and it feeds in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best in his own field and in his own vineyard.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man causes a field or vineyard to be grazed, and lets loose his animal, and it feeds in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field and the best of his own vineyard.
verses.textEnNlt: "If an animal is grazing in a field or vineyard and the owner lets it stray into someone else’s field to graze, then the animal’s owner must pay compensation from the best of his own grain or grapes.
verses.textEnNasb: "If someone lets a field or vineyard be grazed bare and lets his animal loose so that it grazes in another person’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field and the best of his own vineyard.
verses.textEn: "If anyone grazes their livestock in a field or vineyard and lets them stray and they graze in someone else’s field, the offender must make restitution from the best of their own field or vineyard.

verses.textZh: "如果火烧起来，烧着了荆棘，以致把别人堆积的禾捆、竖立的庄稼，或是田园都烧尽了，那点火的必须赔偿。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果火烧起来，烧着了荆棘，以致把别人堆积的禾捆、竖立的庄稼，或是田园都烧尽了，那点火的必须赔偿。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若点火焚烧荆棘，以致将别人堆积的禾捆，站着的禾稼，或是田园，都烧尽了，那点火的必要赔还。
verses.textEnNiv: "If a fire breaks out and spreads into thornbushes so that it burns shocks of grain or standing grain or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make restitution.
verses.textEnEsv: "If fire breaks out and catches in thorns so that the stacked grain or the standing grain or the field is consumed, he who started the fire shall make full restitution.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If fire breaks out and catches in thorns, so that stacked grain, standing grain, or the field is consumed, he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you are burning thornbushes and the fire gets out of control and spreads into another person’s field, destroying the sheaves or the uncut grain or the whole crop, the one who started the fire must pay for the lost crop.
verses.textEnNasb: "If a fire breaks out and spreads to thorn bushes, and stacked grain or the standing grain or the field itself is consumed, the one who started the fire must make restitution.
verses.textEn: "If a fire breaks out and spreads into thornbushes so that it burns shocks of grain or standing grain or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make restitution.

verses.textZh: "如果人把银子或家中物件交给邻舍看守，这些东西从那人的家被偷去；如果把窃贼抓到了，窃贼就要双倍偿还。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人把银子或家中物件交给邻舍看守，这些东西从那人的家被偷去；如果把窃贼抓到了，窃贼就要双倍偿还。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若将银钱或家具交付邻舍看守，这物从那人的家被偷去，若把贼找到了，贼要加倍赔还；
verses.textEnNiv: "If anyone gives a neighbor silver or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor’s house, the thief, if caught, must pay back double.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man gives to his neighbor money or goods to keep safe, and it is stolen from the man’s house, then, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man delivers to his neighbor money or articles to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose someone leaves money or goods with a neighbor for safekeeping, and they are stolen from the neighbor’s house. If the thief is caught, the compensation is double the value of what was stolen.
verses.textEnNasb: "If someone gives his neighbor money or goods to keep for him and it is stolen from the neighbor’s house, if the thief is caught, then the thief shall pay double.
verses.textEn: "If anyone gives a neighbor silver or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor’s house, the thief, if caught, must pay back double.

verses.textZh: 如果找不到窃贼，那家主必要到审判官 那里，查明他有没有下手拿去邻舍的财物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果找不到窃贼，那家主必要到审判官 那里，查明他有没有下手拿去邻舍的财物。
verses.textZhCuv: 若找不到贼，那家主必就近审判官，要看看他拿了原主的物件没有。
verses.textEnNiv: But if the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges, and they must determine whether the owner of the house has laid hands on the other person’s property.
verses.textEnEsv: If the thief is not found, the owner of the house shall come near to God to show whether or not he has put his hand to his neighbor’s property.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the thief is not found, then the master of the house shall be brought to the judges tosee whether he has put his hand into his neighbor’s goods.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the thief is not caught, the neighbor must appear before God, who will determine if he stole the property.
verses.textEnNasb: If the thief is not caught, then the owner of the house shall appear before the judges, to determine whether he laid his hands on his neighbor’s property.
verses.textEn: But if the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges, and they must determine whether the owner of the house has laid hands on the other person’s property.

verses.textZh: 任何争讼的案件，无论是为了牛、驴、羊、衣服，或是甚么遗失了的东西，如果一方说：‘这是我的’，这样，双方的案件就要带到审判官 面前，审判官定谁有罪，谁就要双倍偿还给他的邻舍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 任何争讼的案件，无论是为了牛、驴、羊、衣服，或是甚么遗失了的东西，如果一方说：‘这是我的’，这样，双方的案件就要带到审判官 面前，审判官定谁有罪，谁就要双倍偿还给他的邻舍。
verses.textZhCuv: 「两个人的案件，无论是为什么过犯，或是为牛，为驴，为羊，为衣裳，或是为什么失掉之物，有一人说：『这是我的』，两造就要将案件禀告审判官，审判官定谁有罪，谁就要加倍赔还。
verses.textEnNiv: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any other lost property about which somebody says, ‘This is mine,’ both parties are to bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges declare guilty must pay back double to the other.
verses.textEnEsv: For every breach of trust, whether it is for an ox, for a donkey, for a sheep, for a cloak, or for any kind of lost thing, of which one says, ‘This is it,’ the case of both parties shall come before God. The one whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For any kind of trespass, whetheritconcerns an ox, a donkey, a sheep, or clothing, or for any kind of lost thing which another claims to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whomever the judges condemn shall pay double to his neighbor.
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose there is a dispute between two people who both claim to own a particular ox, donkey, sheep, article of clothing, or any lost property. Both parties must come before God, and the person whom God declares guilty must pay double compensation to the other.
verses.textEnNasb: For every breach of trust, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any lost thing about which one says, ‘This is it,’ the case of both parties shall come before the judges; he whom the judges condemn shall pay double to his neighbor.
verses.textEn: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any other lost property about which somebody says, ‘This is mine,’ both parties are to bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges declare guilty must pay back double to the other.

verses.textZh: "如果人把驴、牛、羊，或是任何牲畜交给邻舍看守，牲畜死亡、受伤，或是被赶去，又没有人看见，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人把驴、牛、羊，或是任何牲畜交给邻舍看守，牲畜死亡、受伤，或是被赶去，又没有人看见，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若将驴，或牛，或羊，或别的牲畜，交付邻舍看守，牲畜或死，或受伤，或被赶去，无人看见，
verses.textEnNiv: "If anyone gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep or any other animal to their neighbor for safekeeping and it dies or is injured or is taken away while no one is looking,
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man gives to his neighbor a donkey or an ox or a sheep or any beast to keep safe, and it dies or is injured or is driven away, without anyone seeing it,
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies, is hurt, or driven away, no one seeing it,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now suppose someone leaves a donkey, ox, sheep, or any other animal with a neighbor for safekeeping, but it dies or is injured or is taken away, and no one sees what happened.
verses.textEnNasb: "If someone gives his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep for him, and it dies or is injured or is driven away while no one is looking,
verses.textEn: "If anyone gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep or any other animal to their neighbor for safekeeping and it dies or is injured or is taken away while no one is looking,

verses.textZh: 两人必须在耶和华面前起誓，表明他没有下手拿去邻舍的财物；如果物主接受那誓言，看守的人就不必赔偿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两人必须在耶和华面前起誓，表明他没有下手拿去邻舍的财物；如果物主接受那誓言，看守的人就不必赔偿。
verses.textZhCuv: 那看守的人要凭着耶和华起誓，手里未曾拿邻舍的物，本主就要罢休，看守的人不必赔还。
verses.textEnNiv: the issue between them will be settled by the taking of an oath before the Lord that the neighbor did not lay hands on the other person’s property. The owner is to accept this, and no restitution is required.
verses.textEnEsv: an oath by the Lord shall be between them both to see whether or not he has put his hand to his neighbor’s property. The owner shall accept the oath, and he shall not make restitution.
verses.textEnNkjv: then an oath of the Lord shall be between them both, that he has not put his hand into his neighbor’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept that, and he shall not make it good.
verses.textEnNlt: The neighbor must then take an oath in the presence of the Lord . If the Lord confirms that the neighbor did not steal the property, the owner must accept the verdict, and no payment will be required.
verses.textEnNasb: an oath before the Lord shall be taken by the two of them that he has not laid a hand on his neighbor’s property; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not be compelled to make restitution.
verses.textEn: the issue between them will be settled by the taking of an oath before the Lord that the neighbor did not lay hands on the other person’s property. The owner is to accept this, and no restitution is required.

verses.textZh: 如果牲畜真的从看守的人那里被偷去，他就要赔偿给物主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果牲畜真的从看守的人那里被偷去，他就要赔偿给物主。
verses.textZhCuv: 牲畜若从看守的那里被偷去，他就要赔还本主；
verses.textEnNiv: But if the animal was stolen from the neighbor, restitution must be made to the owner.
verses.textEnEsv: But if it is stolen from him, he shall make restitution to its owner.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if, in fact, it is stolen from him, he shall make restitution to the owner of it.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the animal was indeed stolen, the guilty person must pay compensation to the owner.
verses.textEnNasb: But if it is actually stolen from him, he shall make restitution to its owner.
verses.textEn: But if the animal was stolen from the neighbor, restitution must be made to the owner.

verses.textZh: 如果真的被野兽撕碎了，看守的人就要把被撕碎的带来作证据，这样，他就不必赔偿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果真的被野兽撕碎了，看守的人就要把被撕碎的带来作证据，这样，他就不必赔偿。
verses.textZhCuv: 若被野兽撕碎，看守的要带来当作证据，所撕的不必赔还。
verses.textEnNiv: If it was torn to pieces by a wild animal, the neighbor shall bring in the remains as evidence and shall not be required to pay for the torn animal.
verses.textEnEsv: If it is torn by beasts, let him bring it as evidence. He shall not make restitution for what has been torn.
verses.textEnNkjv: If it is torn to pieces byabeast, then he shall bring it as evidence, and he shall not make good what was torn.
verses.textEnNlt: If it was torn to pieces by a wild animal, the remains of the carcass must be shown as evidence, and no compensation will be required.
verses.textEnNasb: If it is all torn to pieces, have him bring it as evidence; he shall not be compelled to make restitution for what has been torn to pieces.
verses.textEn: If it was torn to pieces by a wild animal, the neighbor shall bring in the remains as evidence and shall not be required to pay for the torn animal.

verses.textZh: "如果人向邻舍借甚么，所借的无论是受了伤，或是死了，物主不在场，借的人就必须偿还。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人向邻舍借甚么，所借的无论是受了伤，或是死了，物主不在场，借的人就必须偿还。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若向邻舍借什么，所借的或受伤，或死，本主没有同在一处，借的人总要赔还；
verses.textEnNiv: "If anyone borrows an animal from their neighbor and it is injured or dies while the owner is not present, they must make restitution.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man borrows anything of his neighbor, and it is injured or dies, the owner not being with it, he shall make full restitution.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And if a man borrows anything from his neighbor, and it becomes injured or dies, the owner of it not being with it, he shall surely make it good.
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone borrows an animal from a neighbor and it is injured or dies when the owner is absent, the person who borrowed it must pay full compensation.
verses.textEnNasb: "And if someone borrows an animal from his neighbor, and it is injured or dies while its owner is not with it, he shall make full restitution.
verses.textEn: "If anyone borrows an animal from their neighbor and it is injured or dies while the owner is not present, they must make restitution.

verses.textZh: 如果物主在场，他就不必偿还；若是雇来的，也不必偿还，因为他为雇价来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果物主在场，他就不必偿还；若是雇来的，也不必偿还，因为他为雇价来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 若本主同在一处，他就不必赔还；若是雇的，也不必赔还，本是为雇价来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if the owner is with the animal, the borrower will not have to pay. If the animal was hired, the money paid for the hire covers the loss.
verses.textEnEsv: If the owner was with it, he shall not make restitution; if it was hired, it came for its hiring fee.
verses.textEnNkjv: If its owner was with it, he shall not make it good; if it was hired, it came for its hire.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the owner was present, no compensation is required. And no compensation is required if the animal was rented, for this loss is covered by the rental fee.
verses.textEnNasb: If its owner is with it, the borrower shall not be compelled to make restitution. If it is hired, it came by its hire.
verses.textEn: But if the owner is with the animal, the borrower will not have to pay. If the animal was hired, the money paid for the hire covers the loss.

verses.textZh: "如果人引诱还没有许配人的处女，与她同寝，他必须交出聘礼，娶她为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人引诱还没有许配人的处女，与她同寝，他必须交出聘礼，娶她为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若引诱没有受聘的处女，与她行淫，他总要交出聘礼，娶她为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: "If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged to be married and sleeps with her, he must pay the bride-price, and she shall be his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man seduces a virgin who is not betrothed and lies with her, he shall give the bride-price for her and make her his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If a man entices a virgin who is not betrothed, and lies with her, he shall surely pay the bride-price for her tobe his wife.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man seduces a virgin who is not engaged to anyone and has sex with her, he must pay the customary bride price and marry her.
verses.textEnNasb: "If a man seduces a virgin who is not betrothed and sleeps with her, he must pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
verses.textEn: "If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged to be married and sleeps with her, he must pay the bride-price, and she shall be his wife.

verses.textZh: 如果处女的父亲坚决不肯把女儿嫁给他，他就要按照处女的聘礼，交出聘银来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果处女的父亲坚决不肯把女儿嫁给他，他就要按照处女的聘礼，交出聘银来。
verses.textZhCuv: 若女子的父亲决不肯将女子给他，他就要按处女的聘礼，交出钱来。
verses.textEnNiv: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, he must still pay the bride-price for virgins.
verses.textEnEsv: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money equal to the bride-price for virgins.
verses.textEnNkjv: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the bride-price of virgins.
verses.textEnNlt: But if her father refuses to let him marry her, the man must still pay him an amount equal to the bride price of a virgin.
verses.textEnNasb: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money equal to the dowry for virgins.
verses.textEn: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, he must still pay the bride-price for virgins.

verses.textZh: "不可让行巫术的女人活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可让行巫术的女人活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 「行邪术的女人，不可容她存活。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not allow a sorceress to live.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not permit a sorceress to live.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not permit a sorceress to live.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not allow a sorceress to live.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not allow a sorceress to live.
verses.textEn: "Do not allow a sorceress to live.

verses.textZh: "凡与牲畜同寝的，那人必须处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: "凡与牲畜同寝的，那人必须处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡与兽淫合的，总要把他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone who has sexual relations with an animal is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever lies with an animal shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whoever lies with an animal shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who has sexual relations with an animal must certainly be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: "Whoever has sexual intercourse with an animal must be put to death.
verses.textEn: "Anyone who has sexual relations with an animal is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: "除了独一的耶和华以外，还献祭给别神的，那人必须灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: "除了独一的耶和华以外，还献祭给别神的，那人必须灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 「祭祀别神，不单单祭祀耶和华的，那人必要灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: "Whoever sacrifices to any god other than the Lord must be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever sacrifices to any god, other than the Lord alone, shall be devoted to destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who sacrifices to any god, except to the Lord only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who sacrifices to any god other than the Lord must be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: "He who sacrifices to any god, other than to the Lord alone, shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.textEn: "Whoever sacrifices to any god other than the Lord must be destroyed.

verses.textZh: 不可欺负寄居的，也不可压迫他，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可欺负寄居的，也不可压迫他，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可亏负寄居的，也不可欺压他，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not mistreat or oppress a foreigner, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not wrong a sojourner or oppress him, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall neither mistreat a stranger nor oppress him, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not mistreat or oppress foreigners in any way. Remember, you yourselves were once foreigners in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not oppress a stranger nor torment him, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: "Do not mistreat or oppress a foreigner, for you were foreigners in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 不可苦待任何孤儿寡妇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可苦待任何孤儿寡妇。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可苦待寡妇和孤儿；
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not take advantage of the widow or the fatherless.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not mistreat any widow or fatherless child.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not afflict any widow or fatherless child.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not exploit a widow or an orphan.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not oppress any widow or orphan.
verses.textEn: "Do not take advantage of the widow or the fatherless.

verses.textZh: 如果你们真的苦待他们，他们一向我呼求，我必定听他们的呼求，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们真的苦待他们，他们一向我呼求，我必定听他们的呼求，
verses.textZhCuv: 若是苦待他们一点，他们向我一哀求，我总要听他们的哀声，
verses.textEnNiv: If you do and they cry out to me, I will certainly hear their cry.
verses.textEnEsv: If you do mistreat them, and they cry out to me, I will surely hear their cry,
verses.textEnNkjv: If you afflict them in any way, and they cry at all to Me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.textEnNlt: If you exploit them in any way and they cry out to me, then I will certainly hear their cry.
verses.textEnNasb: If you oppress him at all, and if he does cry out to Me, I will assuredly hear his cry;
verses.textEn: If you do and they cry out to me, I will certainly hear their cry.

verses.textZh: 并且我要发怒，用刀杀死你们，使你们的妻子成为寡妇，你们的儿女成为孤儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且我要发怒，用刀杀死你们，使你们的妻子成为寡妇，你们的儿女成为孤儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 并要发烈怒，用刀杀你们，使你们的妻子为寡妇，儿女为孤儿。
verses.textEnNiv: My anger will be aroused, and I will kill you with the sword; your wives will become widows and your children fatherless.
verses.textEnEsv: and my wrath will burn, and I will kill you with the sword, and your wives shall become widows and your children fatherless.
verses.textEnNkjv: and My wrath will become hot, and I will kill you with the sword; your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.textEnNlt: My anger will blaze against you, and I will kill you with the sword. Then your wives will be widows and your children fatherless.
verses.textEnNasb: and My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword, and your wives shall become widows and your children fatherless.
verses.textEn: My anger will be aroused, and I will kill you with the sword; your wives will become widows and your children fatherless.

verses.textZh: "如果你借钱给我的人民，就是与你们在一起的穷人，你对待他们不可像放债的人一样，不可在他们身上取利。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你借钱给我的人民，就是与你们在一起的穷人，你对待他们不可像放债的人一样，不可在他们身上取利。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我民中有贫穷人与你同住，你若借钱给他，不可如放债的向他取利。
verses.textEnNiv: "If you lend money to one of my people among you who is needy, do not treat it like a business deal; charge no interest.
verses.textEnEsv: "If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be like a moneylender to him, and you shall not exact interest from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you lend money to anyof My people whoare poor among you, you shall not be like a moneylender to him; you shall not charge him interest.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you lend money to any of my people who are in need, do not charge interest as a money lender would.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you lend money to My people, to the poor among you, you are not to act as a creditor to him; you shall not charge him interest.
verses.textEn: "If you lend money to one of my people among you who is needy, do not treat it like a business deal; charge no interest.

verses.textZh: 如果你拿了邻居的衣服作抵押，必须在日落之前归还给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你拿了邻居的衣服作抵押，必须在日落之前归还给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你即或拿邻舍的衣服作当头，必在日落以先归还他；
verses.textEnNiv: If you take your neighbor’s cloak as a pledge, return it by sunset,
verses.textEnEsv: If ever you take your neighbor’s cloak in pledge, you shall return it to him before the sun goes down,
verses.textEnNkjv: If you ever take your neighbor’s garment as a pledge, you shall return it to him before the sun goes down.
verses.textEnNlt: If you take your neighbor’s cloak as security for a loan, you must return it before sunset.
verses.textEnNasb: If you ever seize your neighbor’s cloak as a pledge, you are to return it to him before the sun sets,
verses.textEn: If you take your neighbor’s cloak as a pledge, return it by sunset,

verses.textZh: 因为这是他唯一的铺盖，是他蔽体的衣服；如果没有了它，他拿甚么睡觉呢？如果他向我呼求，我必应允，因为我是满有恩惠的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这是他唯一的铺盖，是他蔽体的衣服；如果没有了它，他拿甚么睡觉呢？如果他向我呼求，我必应允，因为我是满有恩惠的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他只有这一件当盖头，是他盖身的衣服，若是没有，他拿什么睡觉呢？他哀求我，我就应允，因为我是有恩惠的。
verses.textEnNiv: because that cloak is the only covering your neighbor has. What else can they sleep in? When they cry out to me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.
verses.textEnEsv: for that is his only covering, and it is his cloak for his body; in what else shall he sleep? And if he cries to me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.
verses.textEnNkjv: For that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What will he sleep in? And it will be that when he cries to Me, I will hear, for I am gracious.
verses.textEnNlt: This coat may be the only blanket your neighbor has. How can a person sleep without it? If you do not return it and your neighbor cries out to me for help, then I will hear, for I am merciful.
verses.textEnNasb: for that is his only covering; it is his cloak for his body. What else is he to sleep in? And it will come about that when he cries out to Me, I will listen to him, for I am gracious.
verses.textEn: because that cloak is the only covering your neighbor has. What else can they sleep in? When they cry out to me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.

verses.textZh: "不可咒骂神，也不可咒诅你人民的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可咒骂神，也不可咒诅你人民的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可毁谤神；也不可毁谤你百姓的官长。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not revile God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not revile God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not dishonor God or curse any of your rulers.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not curse God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
verses.textEn: "Do not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.

verses.textZh: 要把你丰收的五谷和初榨的新酒献上，不可迟延；要把你头生的儿子献给我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把你丰收的五谷和初榨的新酒献上，不可迟延；要把你头生的儿子献给我。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要从你庄稼中的谷和酒榨中滴出来的酒拿来献上，不可迟延。 「你要将头生的儿子归给我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not hold back offerings from your granaries or your vats. "You must give me the firstborn of your sons.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not delay to offer from the fullness of your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. The firstborn of your sons you shall give to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not delay tooffer the first of your ripe produce and your juices. The firstborn of your sons you shall give to Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not hold anything back when you give me offerings from your crops and your wine. "You must give me your firstborn sons.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not hold back the offering from your entire harvest and your wine. The firstborn of your sons you shall give to Me.
verses.textEn: "Do not hold back offerings from your granaries or your vats. "You must give me the firstborn of your sons.

verses.textZh: 对于牛羊头生的，你也要这样作；七天之内，可以和母的在一起，第八天就要把牠献给我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对于牛羊头生的，你也要这样作；七天之内，可以和母的在一起，第八天就要把牠献给我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你牛羊头生的，也要这样；七天当跟着母，第八天要归给我。
verses.textEnNiv: Do the same with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but give them to me on the eighth day.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall do the same with your oxen and with your sheep: seven days it shall be with its mother; on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise you shall do with your oxen and your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days; on the eighth day you shall give it to Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must also give me the firstborn of your cattle, sheep, and goats. But leave the newborn animal with its mother for seven days; then give it to me on the eighth day.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall do the same with your oxen and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother for seven days; on the eighth day you shall give it to Me.
verses.textEn: Do the same with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but give them to me on the eighth day.

verses.textZh: 你们要归我作圣洁的人；因此田间被野兽撕碎的肉，你们不可以吃，要把它丢给狗吃。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要归我作圣洁的人；因此田间被野兽撕碎的肉，你们不可以吃，要把它丢给狗吃。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要在我面前为圣洁的人。因此，田间被野兽撕裂牲畜的肉，你们不可吃，要丢给狗吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: "You are to be my holy people. So do not eat the meat of an animal torn by wild beasts; throw it to the dogs.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall be consecrated to me. Therefore you shall not eat any flesh that is torn by beasts in the field; you shall throw it to the dogs.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall be holy men to Me: you shall not eat meat torn bybeasts in the field; you shall throw it to the dogs.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must be my holy people. Therefore, do not eat any animal that has been torn up and killed by wild animals. Throw it to the dogs.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall be holy people to Me, therefore you shall not eat any flesh torn to pieces in the field; you shall throw it to the dogs.
verses.textEn: "You are to be my holy people. So do not eat the meat of an animal torn by wild beasts; throw it to the dogs.

verses.textZh: "不可传播谣言，也不可与恶人携手作假见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可传播谣言，也不可与恶人携手作假见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可随伙布散谣言；不可与恶人连手妄作见证。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not spread false reports. Do not help a guilty person by being a malicious witness.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not spread a false report. You shall not join hands with a wicked man to be a malicious witness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not circulate a false report. Do not put your hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not pass along false rumors. You must not cooperate with evil people by lying on the witness stand.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not give a false report; do not join your hand with a wicked person to be a malicious witness.
verses.textEn: "Do not spread false reports. Do not help a guilty person by being a malicious witness.

verses.textZh: 不可随众行恶，不可在诉讼的事上随众说歪曲正义的话；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可随众行恶，不可在诉讼的事上随众说歪曲正义的话；
verses.textZhCuv: 不可随众行恶；不可在争讼的事上随众偏行，作见证屈枉正直；
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you give testimony in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd,
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not fall in with the many to do evil, nor shall you bear witness in a lawsuit, siding with the many, so as to pervert justice,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not follow a crowd to do evil; nor shall you testify in a dispute so as to turn aside after many to pervert justice.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you are called to testify in a dispute, do not be swayed by the crowd to twist justice.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not follow the crowd in doing evil, nor shall you testify in a dispute so as to join together with a crowd in order to pervert justice;
verses.textEn: "Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you give testimony in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd,

verses.textZh: 也不可在诉讼的事上偏护穷人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不可在诉讼的事上偏护穷人。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不可在争讼的事上偏护穷人。
verses.textEnNiv: and do not show favoritism to a poor person in a lawsuit.
verses.textEnEsv: nor shall you be partial to a poor man in his lawsuit.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not show partiality to a poor man in his dispute.
verses.textEnNlt: And do not slant your testimony in favor of a person just because that person is poor.
verses.textEnNasb: nor shall you show favor to a poor person in his dispute.
verses.textEn: and do not show favoritism to a poor person in a lawsuit.

verses.textZh: "如果你遇见你仇敌的牛或是驴走迷了路，就应该把牠牵回来给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你遇见你仇敌的牛或是驴走迷了路，就应该把牠牵回来给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若遇见你仇敌的牛或驴失迷了路，总要牵回来交给他。
verses.textEnNiv: "If you come across your enemy’s ox or donkey wandering off, be sure to return it.
verses.textEnEsv: "If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall bring it back to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you come upon your enemy’s ox or donkey that has strayed away, take it back to its owner.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you encounter your enemy’s ox or his donkey wandering away, you must return it to him.
verses.textEn: "If you come across your enemy’s ox or donkey wandering off, be sure to return it.

verses.textZh: 如果你看见恨你的人的驴伏在重担之下，不可走开不理牠，你应该与驴主一同卸下重担。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你看见恨你的人的驴伏在重担之下，不可走开不理牠，你应该与驴主一同卸下重担。
verses.textZhCuv: 若看见恨你人的驴压卧在重驮之下，不可走开，务要和驴主一同抬开重驮。
verses.textEnNiv: If you see the donkey of someone who hates you fallen down under its load, do not leave it there; be sure you help them with it.
verses.textEnEsv: If you see the donkey of one who hates you lying down under its burden, you shall refrain from leaving him with it; you shall rescue it with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you see the donkey of one who hates you lying under its burden, and you would refrain from helping it, you shall surely help him with it.
verses.textEnNlt: If you see that the donkey of someone who hates you has collapsed under its load, do not walk by. Instead, stop and help.
verses.textEnNasb: If you see the donkey of one who hates you lying helpless under its load, you shall not leave it helpless for its owner; you must arrange the load with him.
verses.textEn: If you see the donkey of someone who hates you fallen down under its load, do not leave it there; be sure you help them with it.

verses.textZh: 不可在穷人诉讼的事上歪曲正义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可在穷人诉讼的事上歪曲正义。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可在穷人争讼的事上屈枉正直。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not pervert the justice due to your poor in his lawsuit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not pervert the judgment of your poor in his dispute.
verses.textEnNlt: "In a lawsuit, you must not deny justice to the poor.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not pervert the justice due to your needy brother in his dispute.
verses.textEn: "Do not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

verses.textZh: 要远离虚假的事；不可杀无辜和正义的人，因为我决不以恶人为义人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要远离虚假的事；不可杀无辜和正义的人，因为我决不以恶人为义人。
verses.textZhCuv: 当远离虚假的事。不可杀无辜和有义的人，因我必不以恶人为义。
verses.textEnNiv: Have nothing to do with a false charge and do not put an innocent or honest person to death, for I will not acquit the guilty.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep far from a false charge, and do not kill the innocent and righteous, for I will not acquit the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Keep yourself far from a false matter; do not kill the innocent and righteous. For I will not justify the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: "Be sure never to charge anyone falsely with evil. Never sentence an innocent or blameless person to death, for I never declare a guilty person to be innocent.
verses.textEnNasb: Keep far from a false charge, and do not kill the innocent or the righteous, for I will not acquit the guilty.
verses.textEn: Have nothing to do with a false charge and do not put an innocent or honest person to death, for I will not acquit the guilty.

verses.textZh: 不可受贿赂，因为贿赂能使明眼人变瞎，又能歪曲义人的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可受贿赂，因为贿赂能使明眼人变瞎，又能歪曲义人的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可受贿赂；因为贿赂能叫明眼人变瞎了，又能颠倒义人的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the innocent.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds the clear-sighted and subverts the cause of those who are in the right.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds the discerning and perverts the words of the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take no bribes, for a bribe makes you ignore something that you clearly see. A bribe makes even a righteous person twist the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the clear-sighted and subverts the cause of the just.
verses.textEn: "Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the innocent.

verses.textZh: 不可压迫寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的，知道寄居者的心情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可压迫寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的，知道寄居者的心情。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可欺压寄居的；因为你们在埃及地作过寄居的，知道寄居的心。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not oppress a foreigner; you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not oppress a sojourner. You know the heart of a sojourner, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also you shall not oppress a stranger, for you know the heart of a stranger, because you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not oppress foreigners. You know what it’s like to be a foreigner, for you yourselves were once foreigners in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not oppress a stranger, since you yourselves know the feelings of a stranger, for you also were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: "Do not oppress a foreigner; you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners, because you were foreigners in Egypt.

verses.textZh: "六年之内你要耕种田地，收取地的出产；
verses.textZhCnvs: "六年之内你要耕种田地，收取地的出产；
verses.textZhCuv: 「六年你要耕种田地，收藏土产，
verses.textEnNiv: "For six years you are to sow your fields and harvest the crops,
verses.textEnEsv: "For six years you shall sow your land and gather in its yield,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Six years you shall sow your land and gather in its produce,
verses.textEnNlt: "Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you shall sow your land for six years and gather in its yield,
verses.textEn: "For six years you are to sow your fields and harvest the crops,

verses.textZh: 但是第七年，你要让地歇息，不耕不种，使你民间的穷人可以有吃的；他们吃剩的，田间的野兽可以吃；你的葡萄园和橄榄园，也要这样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是第七年，你要让地歇息，不耕不种，使你民间的穷人可以有吃的；他们吃剩的，田间的野兽可以吃；你的葡萄园和橄榄园，也要这样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是第七年要叫地歇息，不耕不种，使你民中的穷人有吃的；他们所剩下的，野兽可以吃。你的葡萄园和橄榄园也要照样办理。
verses.textEnNiv: but during the seventh year let the land lie unplowed and unused. Then the poor among your people may get food from it, and the wild animals may eat what is left. Do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.
verses.textEnEsv: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the beasts of the field may eat. You shall do likewise with your vineyard, and with your olive orchard.
verses.textEnNkjv: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave, the beasts of the field may eat. In like manner you shall do with your vineyard and your olive grove.
verses.textEnNlt: but let the land be renewed and lie uncultivated during the seventh year. Then let the poor among you harvest whatever grows on its own. Leave the rest for wild animals to eat. The same applies to your vineyards and olive groves.
verses.textEnNasb: but in the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie uncultivated, so that the needy of your people may eat; and whatever they leave the animal of the field may eat. You are to do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.
verses.textEn: but during the seventh year let the land lie unplowed and unused. Then the poor among your people may get food from it, and the wild animals may eat what is left. Do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.

verses.textZh: 六日之内，你要作你的工；但第七日你要安息，好使你的牛和驴可以歇息，并且使你婢女的儿子和寄居的也可以有时间喘息一下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六日之内，你要作你的工；但第七日你要安息，好使你的牛和驴可以歇息，并且使你婢女的儿子和寄居的也可以有时间喘息一下。
verses.textZhCuv: 「六日你要做工，第七日要安息，使牛、驴可以歇息，并使你婢女的儿子和寄居的都可以舒畅。
verses.textEnNiv: "Six days do your work, but on the seventh day do not work, so that your ox and your donkey may rest, and so that the slave born in your household and the foreigner living among you may be refreshed.
verses.textEnEsv: "Six days you shall do your work, but on the seventh day you shall rest; that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant woman, and the alien, may be refreshed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may rest, and the son of your female servant and the stranger may be refreshed.
verses.textEnNlt: "You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but on the seventh day you must stop working. This gives your ox and your donkey a chance to rest. It also allows your slaves and the foreigners living among you to be refreshed.
verses.textEnNasb: "For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you shall cease from labor so that your ox and your donkey may rest, and the son of your female slave, as well as the stranger residing with you, may refresh themselves.
verses.textEn: "Six days do your work, but on the seventh day do not work, so that your ox and your donkey may rest, and so that the slave born in your household and the foreigner living among you may be refreshed.

verses.textZh: 我对你们所说的一切，你们都要小心谨守，你们不可提别神的名，也不可让人从你的口中听到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对你们所说的一切，你们都要小心谨守，你们不可提别神的名，也不可让人从你的口中听到。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡我对你们说的话，你们要谨守。别神的名，你不可提，也不可从你口中传说。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Be careful to do everything I have said to you. Do not invoke the names of other gods; do not let them be heard on your lips.
verses.textEnEsv: "Pay attention to all that I have said to you, and make no mention of the names of other gods, nor let it be heard on your lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And in all that I have said to you, be circumspect and make no mention of the name of other gods, nor let it be heard from your mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: "Pay close attention to all my instructions. You must not call on the name of any other gods. Do not even speak their names.
verses.textEnNasb: Now concerning everything which I have said to you, be careful; and do not mention the name of other gods, nor let them be heard from your mouth.
verses.textEn: "Be careful to do everything I have said to you. Do not invoke the names of other gods; do not let them be heard on your lips.

verses.textZh: "每年三次，你要为我守节。
verses.textZhCnvs: "每年三次，你要为我守节。
verses.textZhCuv: 「一年三次，你要向我守节。
verses.textEnNiv: "Three times a year you are to celebrate a festival to me.
verses.textEnEsv: "Three times in the year you shall keep a feast to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Three times you shall keep a feast to Me in the year:
verses.textEnNlt: "Each year you must celebrate three festivals in my honor.
verses.textEnNasb: "Three times a year you shall celebrate a feast to Me.
verses.textEn: "Three times a year you are to celebrate a festival to me.

verses.textZh: 你要守无酵节，要照我吩咐的，在亚笔月内所定的日期，吃无酵饼七天，因为你是在这个月从埃及出来的。你们不可空手朝见我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要守无酵节，要照我吩咐的，在亚笔月内所定的日期，吃无酵饼七天，因为你是在这个月从埃及出来的。你们不可空手朝见我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期，吃无酵饼七天。谁也不可空手朝见我，因为你是这月出了埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: "Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread; for seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Aviv, for in that month you came out of Egypt. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. As I commanded you, you shall eat unleavened bread for seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in it you came out of Egypt. None shall appear before me empty-handed.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread (you shall eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month of Abib, for in it you came out of Egypt; none shall appear before Me empty);
verses.textEnNlt: First, celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days the bread you eat must be made without yeast, just as I commanded you. Celebrate this festival annually at the appointed time in early spring, in the month of Abib, for that is the anniversary of your departure from Egypt. No one may appear before me without an offering.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread; for seven days you are to eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in that month you came out of Egypt. And no one is to appear before Me empty-handed.
verses.textEn: "Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread; for seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Aviv, for in that month you came out of Egypt. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

verses.textZh: 又要守收割节，就是收在田间你劳碌耕种所得初熟之物的节；也要在年底守收藏节，就是在田间收集你劳碌所得之物的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要守收割节，就是收在田间你劳碌耕种所得初熟之物的节；也要在年底守收藏节，就是在田间收集你劳碌所得之物的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要守收割节，所收的是你田间所种、劳碌得来初熟之物。并在年底收藏，要守收藏节。
verses.textEnNiv: "Celebrate the Festival of Harvest with the firstfruits of the crops you sow in your field. "Celebrate the Festival of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in your crops from the field.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall keep the Feast of Harvest, of the firstfruits of your labor, of what you sow in the field. You shall keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in from the field the fruit of your labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the Feast of Harvest, the firstfruits of your labors which you have sown in the field; and the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you have gathered in thefruitof your labors from the field.
verses.textEnNlt: "Second, celebrate the Festival of Harvest, when you bring me the first crops of your harvest. "Finally, celebrate the Festival of the Final Harvest at the end of the harvest season, when you have harvested all the crops from your fields.
verses.textEnNasb: Also you shall keep the Feast of the Harvest of the first fruits of your labors from what you sow in the field; also the Feast of the Ingathering at the end of the year when you gather in the fruit of your labors from the field.
verses.textEn: "Celebrate the Festival of Harvest with the firstfruits of the crops you sow in your field. "Celebrate the Festival of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in your crops from the field.

verses.textZh: 一年三次，你所有的男丁都要朝见主耶和华的面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一年三次，你所有的男丁都要朝见主耶和华的面。
verses.textZhCuv: 一切的男丁要一年三次朝见主耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Three times a year all the men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Three times in the year shall all your males appear before the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: At these three times each year, every man in Israel must appear before the Sovereign, the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord God.
verses.textEn: "Three times a year all the men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "你不可把我祭牲的血和有酵的饼一同献上；也不可把我节日祭牲的脂油留过夜到早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你不可把我祭牲的血和有酵的饼一同献上；也不可把我节日祭牲的脂油留过夜到早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可将我祭牲的血和有酵的饼一同献上；也不可将我节上祭牲的脂油留到早晨。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast. "The fat of my festival offerings must not be kept until morning.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with anything leavened, or let the fat of my feast remain until the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; nor shall the fat of My sacrifice remain until morning.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not offer the blood of my sacrificial offerings together with any baked goods containing yeast. And do not leave the fat from the festival offerings until the next morning.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; nor is the fat of My feast to remain overnight until morning.
verses.textEn: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast. "The fat of my festival offerings must not be kept until morning.

verses.textZh: 要把你地上最上好的初熟之物带到耶和华你神的殿中。不可用山羊羔母的奶去煮山羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把你地上最上好的初熟之物带到耶和华你神的殿中。不可用山羊羔母的奶去煮山羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 「地里首先初熟之物要送到耶和华－你神的殿。 「不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the Lord your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.textEnEsv: "The best of the firstfruits of your ground you shall bring into the house of the Lord your God. "You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.textEnNkjv: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring into the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.textEnNlt: "As you harvest your crops, bring the very best of the first harvest to the house of the Lord your God. "You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall bring the choice first fruits of your soil into the house of the Lord your God. "You are not to boil a young goat in the milk of its mother.
verses.textEn: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the Lord your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.

verses.textZh: "看哪，我在你面前差派使者，好在路上保护你，领你到我预备的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪，我在你面前差派使者，好在路上保护你，领你到我预备的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「看哪，我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保护你，领你到我所预备的地方去。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I send an angel before you to guard you on the way and to bring you to the place that I have prepared.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I send an Angel before you to keep you in the way and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
verses.textEnNlt: "See, I am sending an angel before you to protect you on your journey and lead you safely to the place I have prepared for you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am going to send an angel before you to guard you along the way and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
verses.textEn: "See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

verses.textZh: 你们在他面前要谨慎，要听他的话，不可违背他；不然，他必不赦免你们的过犯，因为他是奉我的名来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在他面前要谨慎，要听他的话，不可违背他；不然，他必不赦免你们的过犯，因为他是奉我的名来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是奉我名来的；你们要在他面前谨慎，听从他的话，不可惹 他，因为他必不赦免你们的过犯。
verses.textEnNiv: Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him; he will not forgive your rebellion, since my Name is in him.
verses.textEnEsv: Pay careful attention to him and obey his voice; do not rebel against him, for he will not pardon your transgression, for my name is in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beware of Him and obey His voice; do not provoke Him, for He will not pardon your transgressions; for My name is in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Pay close attention to him, and obey his instructions. Do not rebel against him, for he is my representative, and he will not forgive your rebellion.
verses.textEnNasb: Be attentive to him and obey his voice; do not be rebellious toward him, for he will not pardon your rebellion, since My name is in him.
verses.textEn: Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him; he will not forgive your rebellion, since my Name is in him.

verses.textZh: 如果你实在听他的话，遵行我吩咐的一切，我就要作你仇敌的仇敌，作你敌人的敌人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你实在听他的话，遵行我吩咐的一切，我就要作你仇敌的仇敌，作你敌人的敌人。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你若实在听从他的话，照着我一切所说的去行，我就向你的仇敌作仇敌，向你的敌人作敌人。
verses.textEnNiv: If you listen carefully to what he says and do all that I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and will oppose those who oppose you.
verses.textEnEsv: "But if you carefully obey his voice and do all that I say, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you indeed obey His voice and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you are careful to obey him, following all my instructions, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and I will oppose those who oppose you.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you truly obey his voice and do all that I say, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.
verses.textEn: If you listen carefully to what he says and do all that I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and will oppose those who oppose you.

verses.textZh: 我的使者必在你前面走，领你到亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、迦南人、希未人、耶布斯人那里去；我要把他们除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的使者必在你前面走，领你到亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、迦南人、希未人、耶布斯人那里去；我要把他们除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我的使者要在你前面行，领你到亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、迦南人、希未人、耶布斯人那里去，我必将他们剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: My angel will go ahead of you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
verses.textEnEsv: "When my angel goes before you and brings you to the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites, the Hivites and the Jebusites, and I blot them out,
verses.textEnNkjv: For My Angel will go before you and bring you in to the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites and the Hivites and the Jebusites; and I will cut them off.
verses.textEnNlt: For my angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, so you may live there. And I will destroy them completely.
verses.textEnNasb: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I will completely destroy them.
verses.textEn: My angel will go ahead of you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.

verses.textZh: 你不可跪拜他们的神像，也不可事奉它们，不可作他们所作的，不可模仿他们的行为，却要把神像完全拆毁，打碎他们的柱像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可跪拜他们的神像，也不可事奉它们，不可作他们所作的，不可模仿他们的行为，却要把神像完全拆毁，打碎他们的柱像。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不可跪拜他们的神，不可事奉他，也不可效法他们的行为，却要把神像尽行拆毁，打碎他们的柱像。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not bow down before their gods or worship them or follow their practices. You must demolish them and break their sacred stones to pieces.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall not bow down to their gods nor serve them, nor do as they do, but you shall utterly overthrow them and break their pillars in pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do according to their works; but you shall utterly overthrow them and completely break down their sacred pillars.
verses.textEnNlt: You must not worship the gods of these nations or serve them in any way or imitate their evil practices. Instead, you must utterly destroy them and smash their sacred pillars.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not worship their gods, nor serve them, nor do according to their deeds; but you shall utterly overthrow them and break their memorial stones in pieces.
verses.textEn: Do not bow down before their gods or worship them or follow their practices. You must demolish them and break their sacred stones to pieces.

verses.textZh: 你们要事奉耶和华你们的神，他就必赐福你的粮和你的水，我也必从你们中间除去疾病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要事奉耶和华你们的神，他就必赐福你的粮和你的水，我也必从你们中间除去疾病。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要事奉耶和华－你们的神，他必赐福与你的粮与你的水，也必从你们中间除去疾病。
verses.textEnNiv: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you,
verses.textEnEsv: You shall serve the Lord your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So you shall serve the Lord your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take sickness away from the midst of you.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must serve only the Lord your God. If you do, I will bless you with food and water, and I will protect you from illness.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall serve the Lord your God, and He will bless your bread and your water; and I will remove sickness from your midst.
verses.textEn: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you,

verses.textZh: 在你的境内，必没有流产和不育的妇女；我必使你一生的寿数满足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你的境内，必没有流产和不育的妇女；我必使你一生的寿数满足。
verses.textZhCuv: 你境内必没有坠胎的，不生产的。我要使你满了你年日的数目。
verses.textEnNiv: and none will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will give you a full life span.
verses.textEnEsv: None shall miscarry or be barren in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
verses.textEnNkjv: No one shall suffer miscarriage or be barren in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
verses.textEnNlt: There will be no miscarriages or infertility in your land, and I will give you long, full lives.
verses.textEnNasb: There will be no one miscarrying or unable to have children in your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
verses.textEn: and none will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will give you a full life span.

verses.textZh: 我必在你面前展露我的威严；凡你所到的地方，我必使那里的人民慌乱，又使你所有的仇敌都转背而逃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必在你面前展露我的威严；凡你所到的地方，我必使那里的人民慌乱，又使你所有的仇敌都转背而逃。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡你所到的地方，我要使那里的众民在你面前惊骇，扰乱，又要使你一切仇敌转背逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run.
verses.textEnEsv: I will send my terror before you and will throw into confusion all the people against whom you shall come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will send My fear before you, I will cause confusion among all the people to whom you come, and will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will send my terror ahead of you and create panic among all the people whose lands you invade. I will make all your enemies turn and run.
verses.textEnNasb: I will send My terror ahead of you, and throw into confusion all the people among whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
verses.textEn: "I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run.

verses.textZh: 我必在你面前打发大黄蜂，把希未人、迦南人、赫人，都从你面前驱逐出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必在你面前打发大黄蜂，把希未人、迦南人、赫人，都从你面前驱逐出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要打发黄蜂飞在你前面，把希未人、迦南人、赫人撵出去。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send the hornet ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites from before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite from before you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will send terror ahead of you to drive out the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will send hornets ahead of you so that they will drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites from you.
verses.textEn: I will send the hornet ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.

verses.textZh: 我不在一年之内把他们从你面前驱逐出去，恐怕这地变为荒凉，又恐怕田野间的走兽多起来害你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不在一年之内把他们从你面前驱逐出去，恐怕这地变为荒凉，又恐怕田野间的走兽多起来害你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我不在一年之内将他们从你面前撵出去，恐怕地成为荒凉，野地的兽多起来害你。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals too numerous for you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate and the wild beasts multiply against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate and the beasts of the field become too numerous for you.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals would multiply and threaten you.
verses.textEnNasb: I will not drive them out from you in a single year, so that the land will not become desolate and the animals of the field become too numerous for you.
verses.textEn: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals too numerous for you.

verses.textZh: 我要渐渐地把他们从你面前驱逐出去，等到你的人数增多起来，承受那地为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要渐渐地把他们从你面前驱逐出去，等到你的人数增多起来，承受那地为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要渐渐地将他们从你面前撵出去，等到你的人数加多，承受那地为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Little by little I will drive them out before you, until you have increased enough to take possession of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and possess the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased, and you inherit the land.
verses.textEnNlt: I will drive them out a little at a time until your population has increased enough to take possession of the land.
verses.textEnNasb: I will drive them out from you little by little, until you become fruitful and take possession of the land.
verses.textEn: Little by little I will drive them out before you, until you have increased enough to take possession of the land.

verses.textZh: 我要限定你的境界，从红海直到非利士海，从旷野直到大河。我要把那地的居民交在你手中，你要把他们从你面前驱逐出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要限定你的境界，从红海直到非利士海，从旷野直到大河。我要把那地的居民交在你手中，你要把他们从你面前驱逐出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要定你的境界，从红海直到非利士海，又从旷野直到大河。我要将那地的居民交在你手中，你要将他们从你面前撵出去。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean Sea, and from the desert to the Euphrates River. I will give into your hands the people who live in the land, and you will drive them out before you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will set your border from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates, for I will give the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will set your bounds from the Red Sea to the sea, Philistia, and from the desert to the River. For I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will fix your boundaries from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean Sea, and from the eastern wilderness to the Euphrates River. I will hand over to you the people now living in the land, and you will drive them out ahead of you.
verses.textEnNasb: I will set your boundary from the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates River; for I will hand over the inhabitants of the land to you, and you will drive them out from you.
verses.textEn: "I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean Sea, and from the desert to the Euphrates River. I will give into your hands the people who live in the land, and you will drive them out before you.

verses.textZh: 不可与他们和他们的神立约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可与他们和他们的神立约。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可和他们并他们的神立约。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not make a covenant with them or with their gods.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make no covenant with them and their gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.textEnNlt: "Make no treaties with them or their gods.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.
verses.textEn: Do not make a covenant with them or with their gods.

verses.textZh: 不可让他们住在你的境内，恐怕他们使你得罪我；如果你事奉他们的神，这必成为你的网罗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可让他们住在你的境内，恐怕他们使你得罪我；如果你事奉他们的神，这必成为你的网罗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不可住在你的地上，恐怕他们使你得罪我。你若事奉他们的神，这必成为你的网罗。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let them live in your land or they will cause you to sin against me, because the worship of their gods will certainly be a snare to you."
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me; for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against Me. For if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you."
verses.textEnNlt: They must not live in your land, or they will cause you to sin against me. If you serve their gods, you will be caught in the trap of idolatry."
verses.textEnNasb: They shall not live in your land, otherwise they will make you sin against Me; for if you serve their gods, it is certain to be a snare to you."
verses.textEn: Do not let them live in your land or they will cause you to sin against me, because the worship of their gods will certainly be a snare to you."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要上到耶和华这里来。你自己、亚伦、拿答、亚比户和以色列长老中的七十人都要上来，你们要远远下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要上到耶和华这里来。你自己、亚伦、拿答、亚比户和以色列长老中的七十人都要上来，你们要远远下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你和亚伦、拿答、亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都要上到我这里来，远远地下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Come up to the Lord , you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. You are to worship at a distance,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to Moses, "Come up to the Lord , you and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and worship from afar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now He said to Moses, "Come up to the Lord, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and worship from afar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord instructed Moses: "Come up here to me, and bring along Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders. All of you must worship from a distance.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to Moses, "Come up to the Lord, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and you shall worship at a distance.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Come up to the Lord , you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. You are to worship at a distance,

verses.textZh: 只有摩西一人可以走近耶和华，他们却不可以亲近；人民也不可和摩西一同上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有摩西一人可以走近耶和华，他们却不可以亲近；人民也不可和摩西一同上来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独你可以亲近耶和华；他们却不可亲近；百姓也不可和你一同上来。」
verses.textEnNiv: but Moses alone is to approach the Lord ; the others must not come near. And the people may not come up with him."
verses.textEnEsv: Moses alone shall come near to the Lord , but the others shall not come near, and the people shall not come up with him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord, but they shall not come near; nor shall the people go up with him."
verses.textEnNlt: Only Moses is allowed to come near to the Lord . The others must not come near, and none of the other people are allowed to climb up the mountain with him."
verses.textEnNasb: Moses alone, however, shall approach the Lord, but they shall not approach, nor shall the people come up with him."
verses.textEn: but Moses alone is to approach the Lord ; the others must not come near. And the people may not come up with him."

verses.textZh: 摩西下来，把耶和华的一切话和一切典章都向人民讲述；人民都同声回答，说："耶和华吩咐的一切话，我们都必遵行。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西下来，把耶和华的一切话和一切典章都向人民讲述；人民都同声回答，说："耶和华吩咐的一切话，我们都必遵行。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西下山，将耶和华的命令典章都述说与百姓听。众百姓齐声说：「耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses went and told the people all the Lord ’s words and laws, they responded with one voice, "Everything the Lord has said we will do."
verses.textEnEsv: Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord and all the rules. And all the people answered with one voice and said, "All the words that the Lord has spoken we will do."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord and all the judgments. And all the people answered with one voice and said, "All the words which the Lord has said we will do."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses went down to the people and repeated all the instructions and regulations the Lord had given him. All the people answered with one voice, "We will do everything the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses came and reported to the people all the words of the Lord and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice and said, "All the words which the Lord has spoken we will do!"
verses.textEn: When Moses went and told the people all the Lord ’s words and laws, they responded with one voice, "Everything the Lord has said we will do."

verses.textZh: 摩西把耶和华的一切话都记下了；清早起来，在山下筑了一座祭坛，按着以色列十二支派立了十二根柱子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把耶和华的一切话都记下了；清早起来，在山下筑了一座祭坛，按着以色列十二支派立了十二根柱子。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将耶和华的命令都写上。清早起来，在山下筑一座坛，按以色列十二支派立十二根柱子，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses then wrote down everything the Lord had said. He got up early the next morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up twelve stone pillars representing the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses wrote down all the words of the Lord . He rose early in the morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord. And he rose early in the morning, and built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and twelve pillars according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses carefully wrote down all the Lord ’s instructions. Early the next morning Moses got up and built an altar at the foot of the mountain. He also set up twelve pillars, one for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses wrote down all the words of the Lord. Then he got up early in the morning, and built an altar at the foot of the mountain with twelve memorial stones for the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEn: Moses then wrote down everything the Lord had said. He got up early the next morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up twelve stone pillars representing the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 又派了以色列人中的青年人去献燔祭，又向耶和华杀牛献为平安祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又派了以色列人中的青年人去献燔祭，又向耶和华杀牛献为平安祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 又打发以色列人中的少年人去献燔祭，又向耶和华献牛为平安祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he sent young Israelite men, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as fellowship offerings to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent young men of the people of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he sent some of the young Israelite men to present burnt offerings and to sacrifice bulls as peace offerings to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And he sent young men of the sons of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed bulls as peace offerings to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then he sent young Israelite men, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as fellowship offerings to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 摩西取了一半的血，盛在盆中；又取了另一半的血，洒在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西取了一半的血，盛在盆中；又取了另一半的血，洒在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将血一半盛在盆中，一半洒在坛上；
verses.textEnNiv: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he splashed against the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he threw against the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses took half the blood and put it in basins, and half the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses drained half the blood from these animals into basins. The other half he splattered against the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and the other half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.textEn: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he splashed against the altar.

verses.textZh: 他又把约书拿过来，念给人民听；他们说："耶和华吩咐的一切话，我们都必遵行和听从。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把约书拿过来，念给人民听；他们说："耶和华吩咐的一切话，我们都必遵行和听从。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又将约书念给百姓听。他们说：「耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people. They responded, "We will do everything the Lord has said; we will obey."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it in the hearing of the people. And they said, "All that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read in the hearing of the people. And they said, "All that the Lord has said we will do, and be obedient."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it aloud to the people. Again they all responded, "We will do everything the Lord has commanded. We will obey."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it as the people listened; and they said, "All that the Lord has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient!"
verses.textEn: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people. They responded, "We will do everything the Lord has said; we will obey."

verses.textZh: 摩西就取了血来，洒在人民的身上，说："看哪，这是立约的血，这约是耶和华按着这一切话与你们立的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就取了血来，洒在人民的身上，说："看哪，这是立约的血，这约是耶和华按着这一切话与你们立的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将血洒在百姓身上，说：「你看！这是立约的血，是耶和华按这一切话与你们立约的凭据。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses then took the blood, sprinkled it on the people and said, "This is the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses took the blood and threw it on the people and said, "Behold the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses took the blood, sprinkled it on the people, and said, "This is the blood of the covenant which the Lord has made with you according to all these words."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses took the blood from the basins and splattered it over the people, declaring, "Look, this blood confirms the covenant the Lord has made with you in giving you these instructions."
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses took the blood and sprinkled it on the people, and said, "Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words."
verses.textEn: Moses then took the blood, sprinkled it on the people and said, "This is the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words."

verses.textZh: 随后，摩西、亚伦、拿答、亚比户和以色列长老中的七十人都上了山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 随后，摩西、亚伦、拿答、亚比户和以色列长老中的七十人都上了山。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦、拿答、亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都上了山。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel went up
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses went up, also Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel climbed up the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
verses.textEn: Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel went up

verses.textZh: 他们看见了以色列的神；在神的脚下有好象蓝宝石一样晶莹的铺路，好象天色一般明亮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们看见了以色列的神；在神的脚下有好象蓝宝石一样晶莹的铺路，好象天色一般明亮。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们看见以色列的神，他脚下仿佛有平铺的蓝宝石，如同天色明净。
verses.textEnNiv: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something like a pavement made of lapis lazuli, as bright blue as the sky.
verses.textEnEsv: and they saw the God of Israel. There was under his feet as it were a pavement of sapphire stone, like the very heaven for clearness.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they saw the God of Israel. And therewas under His feet as it were a paved work of sapphire stone, and it was like the very heavens in its clarity.
verses.textEnNlt: There they saw the God of Israel. Under his feet there seemed to be a surface of brilliant blue lapis lazuli, as clear as the sky itself.
verses.textEnNasb: and they saw the God of Israel; and under His feet there appeared to be a pavement of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
verses.textEn: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something like a pavement made of lapis lazuli, as bright blue as the sky.

verses.textZh: 他不伸手攻击以色列人中的显贵；他们看见神，并且又吃又喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不伸手攻击以色列人中的显贵；他们看见神，并且又吃又喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的手不加害在以色列的尊者身上。他们观看神；他们又吃又喝。
verses.textEnNiv: But God did not raise his hand against these leaders of the Israelites; they saw God, and they ate and drank.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did not lay his hand on the chief men of the people of Israel; they beheld God, and ate and drank.
verses.textEnNkjv: But on the nobles of the children of Israel He did not lay His hand. So they saw God, and they ate and drank.
verses.textEnNlt: And though these nobles of Israel gazed upon God, he did not destroy them. In fact, they ate a covenant meal, eating and drinking in his presence!
verses.textEnNasb: Yet He did not reach out with His hand against the nobles of the sons of Israel; and they saw God, and they ate and drank.
verses.textEn: But God did not raise his hand against these leaders of the Israelites; they saw God, and they ate and drank.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要上山到我这里来，要住在这里；我要把石版，就是我所写的律法和诫命赐给你，使你可以教导人民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要上山到我这里来，要住在这里；我要把石版，就是我所写的律法和诫命赐给你，使你可以教导人民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你上山到我这里来，住在这里，我要将石版并我所写的律法和诫命赐给你，使你可以教训百姓。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain and stay here, and I will give you the tablets of stone with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain and wait there, that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and the commandment, which I have written for their instruction."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Come up to Me on the mountain and be there; and I will give you tablets of stone, and the law and commandments which I have written, that you may teach them."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain. Stay there, and I will give you the tablets of stone on which I have inscribed the instructions and commands so you can teach the people."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Moses, "Come up to Me on the mountain and stay there, and I will give you the stone tablets with the Law and the commandments which I have written for their instruction."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain and stay here, and I will give you the tablets of stone with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西和他的侍从约书亚起来；摩西就上到神的山那里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西和他的侍从约书亚起来；摩西就上到神的山那里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西和他的帮手约书亚起来，上了神的山。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses set out with Joshua his aide, and Moses went up on the mountain of God.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses rose with his assistant Joshua, and Moses went up into the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses arose with his assistant Joshua, and Moses went up to the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and his assistant Joshua set out, and Moses climbed up the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses got up along with Joshua his servant, and Moses went up to the mountain of God.
verses.textEn: Then Moses set out with Joshua his aide, and Moses went up on the mountain of God.

verses.textZh: 但摩西对长老说："你们要在这里等候我们，直到我们再回到你们那里来。看哪！这里有亚伦和户珥与你们在一起，谁有诉讼的案件，都可以到他们那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但摩西对长老说："你们要在这里等候我们，直到我们再回到你们那里来。看哪！这里有亚伦和户珥与你们在一起，谁有诉讼的案件，都可以到他们那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对长老说：「你们在这里等着，等到我们再回来，有亚伦、户珥与你们同在。凡有争讼的，都可以就近他们去。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to the elders, "Wait here for us until we come back to you. Aaron and Hur are with you, and anyone involved in a dispute can go to them."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the elders, "Wait here for us until we return to you. And behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever has a dispute, let him go to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to the elders, "Wait here for us until we come back to you. Indeed, Aaron and Hur are with you. If any man has a difficulty, let him go to them."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses told the elders, "Stay here and wait for us until we come back. Aaron and Hur are here with you. If anyone has a dispute while I am gone, consult with them."
verses.textEnNasb: But to the elders he said, "Wait here for us until we return to you. And behold, Aaron and Hur are with you; whoever has a legal matter, have him approach them."
verses.textEn: He said to the elders, "Wait here for us until we come back to you. Aaron and Hur are with you, and anyone involved in a dispute can go to them."

verses.textZh: 摩西上到山上，有云彩把山遮盖着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西上到山上，有云彩把山遮盖着。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西上山，有云彩把山遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,
