verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses went up into the mountain, and a cloud covered the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses climbed up the mountain, and the cloud covered it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses went up to the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
verses.textEn: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,

verses.textZh: 耶和华的荣耀停在西奈山上，云彩把山遮盖了六天；第七天，耶和华从云彩中呼唤摩西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的荣耀停在西奈山上，云彩把山遮盖了六天；第七天，耶和华从云彩中呼唤摩西。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的荣耀停于西奈山；云彩遮盖山六天，第七天他从云中召摩西。
verses.textEnNiv: and the glory of the Lord settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered the mountain, and on the seventh day the Lord called to Moses from within the cloud.
verses.textEnEsv: The glory of the Lord dwelt on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And on the seventh day he called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the glory of the Lord rested on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And on the seventh day He called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.textEnNlt: And the glory of the Lord settled down on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day the Lord called to Moses from inside the cloud.
verses.textEnNasb: The glory of the Lord settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days; and on the seventh day He called to Moses from the midst of the cloud.
verses.textEn: and the glory of the Lord settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered the mountain, and on the seventh day the Lord called to Moses from within the cloud.

verses.textZh: 耶和华荣耀的景象，在以色列人眼前，好象在山顶上出现烈火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华荣耀的景象，在以色列人眼前，好象在山顶上出现烈火。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的荣耀在山顶上，在以色列人眼前，形状如烈火。
verses.textEnNiv: To the Israelites the glory of the Lord looked like a consuming fire on top of the mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the sight of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sight of the glory of the Lordwas like a consuming fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: To the Israelites at the foot of the mountain, the glory of the Lord appeared at the summit like a consuming fire.
verses.textEnNasb: And to the eyes of the sons of Israel, the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a consuming fire on the mountain top.
verses.textEn: To the Israelites the glory of the Lord looked like a consuming fire on top of the mountain.

verses.textZh: 摩西进入云彩中，上到山上去；摩西在山上四十昼夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西进入云彩中，上到山上去；摩西在山上四十昼夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西进入云中上山，在山上四十昼夜。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses entered the cloud as he went on up the mountain. And he stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses entered the cloud and went up on the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses went into the midst of the cloud and went up into the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses disappeared into the cloud as he climbed higher up the mountain. He remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses entered the midst of the cloud as he went up to the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEn: Then Moses entered the cloud as he went on up the mountain. And he stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列民，叫他们给我送礼物来，所有心里乐意奉献的人，你们就可以收下他们给我的礼物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列民，叫他们给我送礼物来，所有心里乐意奉献的人，你们就可以收下他们给我的礼物。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你告诉以色列人当为我送礼物来；凡甘心乐意的，你们就可以收下归我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell the Israelites to bring me an offering. You are to receive the offering for me from everyone whose heart prompts them to give.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, that they take for me a contribution. From every man whose heart moves him you shall receive the contribution for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring Me an offering. From everyone who gives it willingly with his heart you shall take My offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell the people of Israel to bring me their sacred offerings. Accept the contributions from all whose hearts are moved to offer them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Tell the sons of Israel to take a contribution for Me; from everyone whose heart moves him you shall take My contribution.
verses.textEn: "Tell the Israelites to bring me an offering. You are to receive the offering for me from everyone whose heart prompts them to give.

verses.textZh: 以下是你们要从他们收取的礼物：金、银、铜、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是你们要从他们收取的礼物：金、银、铜、
verses.textZhCuv: 所要收的礼物：就是金、银、铜，
verses.textEnNiv: These are the offerings you are to receive from them: gold, silver and bronze;
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the contribution that you shall receive from them: gold, silver, and bronze,
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
verses.textEnNlt: Here is a list of sacred offerings you may accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
verses.textEnNasb: This is the contribution which you are to take from them: gold, silver, and bronze,
verses.textEn: These are the offerings you are to receive from them: gold, silver and bronze;

verses.textZh: 蓝色紫色朱红色线、细麻、山羊毛、
verses.textZhCnvs: 蓝色紫色朱红色线、细麻、山羊毛、
verses.textZhCuv: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，
verses.textEnNiv: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;
verses.textEnEsv: blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, goats’ hair,
verses.textEnNkjv: blue, purple, and scarlet thread, fine linen, and goats’ hair;
verses.textEnNlt: blue, purple, and scarlet thread; fine linen and goat hair for cloth;
verses.textEnNasb: violet, purple, and scarlet material, fine linen, goat hair,
verses.textEn: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

verses.textZh: 染红的公羊皮、海狗皮、皂荚木、
verses.textZhCnvs: 染红的公羊皮、海狗皮、皂荚木、
verses.textZhCuv: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，
verses.textEnNiv: ram skins dyed red and another type of durable leather ; acacia wood;
verses.textEnEsv: tanned rams’ skins, goatskins, acacia wood,
verses.textEnNkjv: ram skins dyed red, badger skins, and acacia wood;
verses.textEnNlt: tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather; acacia wood;
verses.textEnNasb: rams’ skins dyed red, fine leather, acacia wood,
verses.textEn: ram skins dyed red and another type of durable leather ; acacia wood;

verses.textZh: 灯油、膏油的香料和焚香用的香料，
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯油、膏油的香料和焚香用的香料，
verses.textZhCuv: 点灯的油并做膏油和香的香料，
verses.textEnNiv: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
verses.textEnEsv: oil for the lamps, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
verses.textEnNkjv: oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense;
verses.textEnNlt: olive oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and the fragrant incense;
verses.textEnNasb: oil for lighting, balsam oil for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
verses.textEn: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

verses.textZh: 红玛瑙和镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的宝石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 红玛瑙和镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的宝石。
verses.textZhCuv: 红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。
verses.textEnNiv: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
verses.textEnEsv: onyx stones, and stones for setting, for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
verses.textEnNkjv: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate.
verses.textEnNlt: onyx stones, and other gemstones to be set in the ephod and the priest’s chestpiece.
verses.textEnNasb: onyx stones and setting stones for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
verses.textEn: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

verses.textZh: 他们要为我建造圣所，使我可以在他们中间居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要为我建造圣所，使我可以在他们中间居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 又当为我造圣所，使我可以住在他们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.
verses.textEnEsv: And let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell in their midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Have the people of Israel build me a holy sanctuary so I can live among them.
verses.textEnNasb: Have them construct a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.
verses.textEn: "Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.

verses.textZh: 按着我指示你建造会幕和一切器具的样式，你们要照样建造。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按着我指示你建造会幕和一切器具的样式，你们要照样建造。
verses.textZhCuv: 制造帐幕和其中的一切器具都要照我所指示你的样式。」
verses.textEnNiv: Make this tabernacle and all its furnishings exactly like the pattern I will show you.
verses.textEnEsv: Exactly as I show you concerning the pattern of the tabernacle, and of all its furniture, so you shall make it.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to all that I show you, thatis, the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its furnishings, just so you shall make it.
verses.textEnNlt: You must build this Tabernacle and its furnishings exactly according to the pattern I will show you.
verses.textEnNasb: According to all that I am going to show you as the pattern of the tabernacle and the pattern of all its furniture, so you shall construct it.
verses.textEn: Make this tabernacle and all its furnishings exactly like the pattern I will show you.

verses.textZh: "他们要用皂荚木做一个柜，长一百一十公分，宽六十六公分，高六十六公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们要用皂荚木做一个柜，长一百一十公分，宽六十六公分，高六十六公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 「要用皂荚木做一柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。
verses.textEnNiv: "Have them make an ark of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
verses.textEnEsv: "They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Two cubits and a half shall be its length, a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And they shall make an ark of acacia wood; two and a half cubits shallbe its length, a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.textEnNlt: "Have the people make an Ark of acacia wood—a sacred chest 45 inches long, 27 inches wide, and 27 inches high.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now they shall construct an ark of acacia wood two and a half cubits long, one and a half cubits wide, and one and a half cubits high.
verses.textEn: "Have them make an ark of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

verses.textZh: 你要用纯金包柜，内外都要包上；柜上的四围要做金边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用纯金包柜，内外都要包上；柜上的四围要做金边。
verses.textZhCuv: 要里外包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。
verses.textEnNiv: Overlay it with pure gold, both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside shall you overlay it, and you shall make on it a molding of gold around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and out you shall overlay it, and shall make on it a molding of gold all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Overlay it inside and outside with pure gold, and run a molding of gold all around it.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and out you shall overlay it, and you shall make a gold molding around it.
verses.textEn: Overlay it with pure gold, both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.

verses.textZh: 你要铸造四个金环，安放在柜的四脚上，两个环在这边，两个环在那边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要铸造四个金环，安放在柜的四脚上，两个环在这边，两个环在那边。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上；这边两环，那边两环。
verses.textEnNiv: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall cast four rings of gold for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four corners; two rings shallbe on one side, and two rings on the other side.
verses.textEnNlt: Cast four gold rings and attach them to its four feet, two rings on each side.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also cast four gold rings for it and fasten them on its four feet; two rings shall be on one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.textEn: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

verses.textZh: 你要用皂荚木做几根柜杠，并要用金包裹起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用皂荚木做几根柜杠，并要用金包裹起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: Then make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Make poles from acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEn: Then make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

verses.textZh: 你要把柜杠穿在柜旁的环中，以便用杠抬柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把柜杠穿在柜旁的环中，以便用杠抬柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把杠穿在柜旁的环内，以便抬柜。
verses.textEnNiv: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark by them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, that the ark may be carried by them.
verses.textEnNlt: Insert the poles into the rings at the sides of the Ark to carry it.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark with them.
verses.textEn: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.

verses.textZh: 柜杠要常留在柜的环中，不可抽出环外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 柜杠要常留在柜的环中，不可抽出环外。
verses.textZhCuv: 这杠要常在柜的环内，不可抽出来。
verses.textEnNiv: The poles are to remain in the rings of this ark; they are not to be removed.
verses.textEnEsv: The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.
verses.textEnNlt: These carrying poles must stay inside the rings; never remove them.
verses.textEnNasb: The poles shall remain in the rings of the ark; they shall not be removed from it.
verses.textEn: The poles are to remain in the rings of this ark; they are not to be removed.

verses.textZh: 你要把我赐给你的法版放在柜里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把我赐给你的法版放在柜里。
verses.textZhCuv: 必将我所要赐给你的法版放在柜里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then put in the ark the tablets of the covenant law, which I will give you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put into the ark the testimony that I shall give you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall put into the ark the Testimony which I will give you.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Ark is finished, place inside it the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, which I will give to you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall put into the ark the testimony which I shall give you.
verses.textEn: Then put in the ark the tablets of the covenant law, which I will give you.

verses.textZh: 你要用纯金做施恩座，长一百一十公分，宽六十六公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用纯金做施恩座，长一百一十公分，宽六十六公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用精金做施恩座 ，长二肘半，宽一肘半。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make an atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two cubits and a half shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold; two and a half cubits shallbe its length and a cubit and a half its width.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then make the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement—from pure gold. It must be 45 inches long and 27 inches wide.
verses.textEnNasb: "And you shall make an atoning cover of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and one and a half cubits wide.
verses.textEn: "Make an atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

verses.textZh: 你要用黄金锤成两个基路伯，放在施恩座的两端。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用黄金锤成两个基路伯，放在施恩座的两端。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用金子锤出两个基路伯来，安在施恩座的两头。
verses.textEnNiv: And make two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make two cherubim of gold; of hammered work shall you make them, on the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make two cherubim of gold; of hammered work you shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNlt: Then make two cherubim from hammered gold, and place them on the two ends of the atonement cover.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make two cherubim of gold; make them of hammered work at the two ends of the atoning cover.
verses.textEn: And make two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.

verses.textZh: 这端做个基路伯，那端做个基路伯，二基路伯要与施恩座连在一起制造，在施恩座的两端。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这端做个基路伯，那端做个基路伯，二基路伯要与施恩座连在一起制造，在施恩座的两端。
verses.textZhCuv: 这头做一个基路伯，那头做一个基路伯，二基路伯要接连一块，在施恩座的两头。
verses.textEnNiv: Make one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; make the cherubim of one piece with the cover, at the two ends.
verses.textEnEsv: Make one cherub on the one end, and one cherub on the other end. Of one piece with the mercy seat shall you make the cherubim on its two ends.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make one cherub at one end, and the other cherub at the other end; you shall make the cherubim at the two ends of it ofonepiece with the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNlt: Mold the cherubim on each end of the atonement cover, making it all of one piece of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Make one cherub at one end and one cherub at the other end; you shall make the cherubim of one piece with the atoning cover at its two ends.
verses.textEn: Make one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; make the cherubim of one piece with the cover, at the two ends.

verses.textZh: 二基路伯要在上面展开双翼，遮掩施恩座，基路伯的脸要彼此相对，他们的脸要朝着施恩座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 二基路伯要在上面展开双翼，遮掩施恩座，基路伯的脸要彼此相对，他们的脸要朝着施恩座。
verses.textZhCuv: 二基路伯要高张翅膀，遮掩施恩座。基路伯要脸对脸，朝着施恩座。
verses.textEnNiv: The cherubim are to have their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the cover.
verses.textEnEsv: The cherubim shall spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings, their faces one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubim be.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the cherubim shall stretch out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and they shall face one another; the faces of the cherubim shallbe toward the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNlt: The cherubim will face each other and look down on the atonement cover. With their wings spread above it, they will protect it.
verses.textEnNasb: And the cherubim shall have their wings spread upward, covering the atoning cover with their wings and facing one another; the faces of the cherubim are to be turned toward the atoning cover.
verses.textEn: The cherubim are to have their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the cover.

verses.textZh: 你要把施恩座安放在柜顶，又要把我赐给你的法版放在柜里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把施恩座安放在柜顶，又要把我赐给你的法版放在柜里。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将施恩座安在柜的上边，又将我所要赐给你的法版放在柜里。
verses.textEnNiv: Place the cover on top of the ark and put in the ark the tablets of the covenant law that I will give you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put the mercy seat on the top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I shall give you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the Testimony that I will give you.
verses.textEnNlt: Place inside the Ark the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, which I will give to you. Then put the atonement cover on top of the Ark.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall put the atoning cover on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the testimony which I will give to you.
verses.textEn: Place the cover on top of the ark and put in the ark the tablets of the covenant law that I will give you.

verses.textZh: 我要在那里和你相会，也要从施恩座上面，从二基路伯之间，告诉你一切我命令你传给以色列人的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在那里和你相会，也要从施恩座上面，从二基路伯之间，告诉你一切我命令你传给以色列人的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在那里与你相会，又要从法柜施恩座上二基路伯中间，和你说我所要吩咐你传给以色列人的一切事。」
verses.textEnNiv: There, above the cover between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the covenant law, I will meet with you and give you all my commands for the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: There I will meet with you, and from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim that are on the ark of the testimony, I will speak with you about all that I will give you in commandment for the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there I will meet with you, and I will speak with you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the Testimony, about everything which I will give you in commandment to the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: I will meet with you there and talk to you from above the atonement cover between the gold cherubim that hover over the Ark of the Covenant. From there I will give you my commands for the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: There I will meet with you; and from above the atoning cover, from between the two cherubim which are upon the ark of the testimony, I will speak to you about every commandment that I will give you for the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: There, above the cover between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the covenant law, I will meet with you and give you all my commands for the Israelites.

verses.textZh: "你要用皂荚木做一张桌子，长八十八公分，宽四十四公分，高六十六公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用皂荚木做一张桌子，长八十八公分，宽四十四公分，高六十六公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 「要用皂荚木做一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make a table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make a table of acacia wood. Two cubits shall be its length, a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also make a table of acacia wood; two cubits shallbe its length, a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then make a table of acacia wood, 36 inches long, 18 inches wide, and 27 inches high.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long and one cubit wide, and one and a half cubits high.
verses.textEn: "Make a table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.

verses.textZh: 你要用纯金包桌子，桌子的四围要做金边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用纯金包桌子，桌子的四围要做金边。
verses.textZhCuv: 要包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。
verses.textEnNiv: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall overlay it with pure gold and make a molding of gold around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a molding of gold all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Overlay it with pure gold and run a gold molding around the edge.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall overlay it with pure gold and make a gold border around it.
verses.textEn: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.

verses.textZh: 你要给桌子的四围做七十五公厘宽的框边，框边上的四围要做金边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要给桌子的四围做七十五公厘宽的框边，框边上的四围要做金边。
verses.textZhCuv: 桌子的四围各做一掌宽的横梁，横梁上镶着金牙边。
verses.textEnNiv: Also make around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make a rim around it a handbreadth wide, and a molding of gold around the rim.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make for it a frame of a handbreadth all around, and you shall make a gold molding for the frame all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Decorate it with a 3-inch border all around, and run a gold molding along the border.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make for it a rim of a hand width around it; and you shall make a gold border for the rim around it.
verses.textEn: Also make around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

verses.textZh: 你要做四个金环，把金环安放在桌子的四角上，就是在桌子的四脚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要做四个金环，把金环安放在桌子的四角上，就是在桌子的四脚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 要做四个金环，安在桌子的四角上，就是桌子四脚上的四角。
verses.textEnNiv: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners, where the four legs are.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and fasten the rings to the four corners at its four legs.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that are at its four legs.
verses.textEnNlt: Make four gold rings for the table and attach them at the four corners next to the four legs.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also make four gold rings for it and put rings on the four corners which are on its four legs.
verses.textEn: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners, where the four legs are.

verses.textZh: 环子要靠近框边，用来穿桌杠，以便抬桌子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 环子要靠近框边，用来穿桌杠，以便抬桌子。
verses.textZhCuv: 安环子的地方要挨近横梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。
verses.textEnNiv: The rings are to be close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.
verses.textEnEsv: Close to the frame the rings shall lie, as holders for the poles to carry the table.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rings shall be close to the frame, as holders for the poles to bear the table.
verses.textEnNlt: Attach the rings near the border to hold the poles that are used to carry the table.
verses.textEnNasb: The rings shall be close to the rim, as holders for the poles to carry the table.
verses.textEn: The rings are to be close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.

verses.textZh: 你要用皂荚木做几根桌杠，又要用金包裹起来，桌子要用桌杠来抬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用皂荚木做几根桌杠，又要用金包裹起来，桌子要用桌杠来抬。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。
verses.textEnNiv: Make the poles of acacia wood, overlay them with gold and carry the table with them.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be carried with these.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
verses.textEnNlt: Make these poles from acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that with them the table may be carried.
verses.textEn: Make the poles of acacia wood, overlay them with gold and carry the table with them.

verses.textZh: 你要做桌子上的盘子、碟子、酒杯和奠酒用的瓶，这些你要用纯金制造。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要做桌子上的盘子、碟子、酒杯和奠酒用的瓶，这些你要用纯金制造。
verses.textZhCuv: 要做桌子上的盘子、调羹，并奠酒的爵和瓶；这都要用精金制作。
verses.textEnNiv: And make its plates and dishes of pure gold, as well as its pitchers and bowls for the pouring out of offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make its plates and dishes for incense, and its flagons and bowls with which to pour drink offerings; you shall make them of pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make its dishes, its pans, its pitchers, and its bowls for pouring. You shall make them of pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Make special containers of pure gold for the table—bowls, ladles, pitchers, and jars—to be used in pouring out liquid offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also make its dishes, its pans, its jars, and its libation bowls with which to pour drink offerings; you shall make them of pure gold.
verses.textEn: And make its plates and dishes of pure gold, as well as its pitchers and bowls for the pouring out of offerings.

verses.textZh: 你又要在桌子上，在我面前，常常摆放陈设饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要在桌子上，在我面前，常常摆放陈设饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常摆陈设饼。」
verses.textEnNiv: Put the bread of the Presence on this table to be before me at all times.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before me regularly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall set the showbread on the table before Me always.
verses.textEnNlt: Place the Bread of the Presence on the table to remain before me at all times.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall set the bread of the Presence on the table before Me continually.
verses.textEn: Put the bread of the Presence on this table to be before me at all times.

verses.textZh: "你要用纯金做一个灯台，那灯台你要用锤锤成；灯台的座、干、杯、球、花，都要与灯台连在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用纯金做一个灯台，那灯台你要用锤锤成；灯台的座、干、杯、球、花，都要与灯台连在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 「要用精金做一个灯台。灯台的座和干与杯、球、花，都要接连一块锤出来。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make a lampstand of pure gold. Hammer out its base and shaft, and make its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms of one piece with them.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand shall be made of hammered work: its base, its stem, its cups, its calyxes, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also make a lampstand of pure gold; the lampstand shall be of hammered work. Its shaft, its branches, its bowls, its ornamental knobs, and flowers shall be ofonepiece.
verses.textEnNlt: "Make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. Make the entire lampstand and its decorations of one piece—the base, center stem, lamp cups, buds, and petals.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you shall make a lampstand of pure gold. The lampstand, its base and its shaft, are to be made of hammered work; its cups, its bulbs, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.
verses.textEn: "Make a lampstand of pure gold. Hammer out its base and shaft, and make its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms of one piece with them.

verses.textZh: 灯台的两边伸出六个枝子；一边有三个灯台枝子，另一边也有三个灯台枝子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯台的两边伸出六个枝子；一边有三个灯台枝子，另一边也有三个灯台枝子。
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台两旁要杈出六个枝子：这旁三个，那旁三个。
verses.textEnNiv: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
verses.textEnEsv: And there shall be six branches going out of its sides, three branches of the lampstand out of one side of it and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it;
verses.textEnNkjv: And six branches shall come out of its sides: three branches of the lampstand out of one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.
verses.textEnNlt: Make it with six branches going out from the center stem, three on each side.
verses.textEnNasb: Six branches shall go out from its sides; three branches of the lampstand from its one side and three branches of the lampstand from its other side.
verses.textEn: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.

verses.textZh: 在第一个枝子上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球、有花；在另外一个枝子也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球、有花。从灯台伸出的六个枝子，都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在第一个枝子上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球、有花；在另外一个枝子也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球、有花。从灯台伸出的六个枝子，都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 这旁每枝上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花；那旁每枝上也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。从灯台杈出来的六个枝子都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on one branch, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.
verses.textEnEsv: three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on one branch, and three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on the other branch—so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Three bowls shallbe made like almond blossoms on one branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower, and three bowls made like almond blossoms on the other branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower—and so for the six branches that come out of the lampstand.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of the six branches will have three lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.
verses.textEnNasb: Three cups shall be shaped like almond blossoms on the one branch, a bulb and a flower, and three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the other branch, a bulb and a flower—the same for six branches going out from the lampstand;
verses.textEn: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on one branch, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

verses.textZh: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球、有花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球、有花。
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。
verses.textEnNiv: And on the lampstand there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the lampstand itself there shall be four cups made like almond blossoms, with their calyxes and flowers,
verses.textEnNkjv: On the lampstand itself four bowls shallbe made like almond blossoms, each with its ornamental knob and flower.
verses.textEnNlt: Craft the center stem of the lampstand with four lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.
verses.textEnNasb: and on the lampstand four cups shaped like almond blossoms, its bulbs and its flowers.
verses.textEn: And on the lampstand there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.

verses.textZh: 每两个枝子的下面有球和灯台相连，从灯台伸出来的六个枝子，都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每两个枝子的下面有球和灯台相连，从灯台伸出来的六个枝子，都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台每两个枝子以下有球与枝子接连一块。灯台出的六个枝子都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: One bud shall be under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair—six branches in all.
verses.textEnEsv: and a calyx of one piece with it under each pair of the six branches going out from the lampstand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And thereshallbe a knob under the first two branches of the same, a knob under the second two branches of the same, and a knob under the third two branches of the same, according to the six branches that extend from the lampstand.
verses.textEnNlt: There will also be an almond bud beneath each pair of branches where the six branches extend from the center stem.
verses.textEnNasb: A bulb shall be under the first pair of branches coming out of it, and a bulb under the second pair of branches coming out of it, and a bulb under the third pair of branches coming out of it, for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.
verses.textEn: One bud shall be under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair—six branches in all.

verses.textZh: 球和枝子都要与灯台连在一起，都是从一块纯金锤成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 球和枝子都要与灯台连在一起，都是从一块纯金锤成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 球和枝子要接连一块，都是一块精金锤出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: The buds and branches shall all be of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
verses.textEnEsv: Their calyxes and their branches shall be of one piece with it, the whole of it a single piece of hammered work of pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their knobs and their branches shallbeofonepiece; all of it shallbe one hammered piece of pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: The almond buds and branches must all be of one piece with the center stem, and they must be hammered from pure gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Their bulbs and their branches shall be of one piece with it; all of it shall be one piece of hammered work of pure gold.
verses.textEn: The buds and branches shall all be of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

verses.textZh: 你要做灯台上的七个灯盏，这些灯盏要放在灯台之上，使灯光照亮对面的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要做灯台上的七个灯盏，这些灯盏要放在灯台之上，使灯光照亮对面的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 要做灯台的七个灯盏。祭司要点这灯，使灯光对照。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then make its seven lamps and set them up on it so that they light the space in front of it.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make seven lamps for it. And the lamps shall be set up so as to give light on the space in front of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make seven lamps for it, and they shall arrange its lamps so that they give light in front of it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then make the seven lamps for the lampstand, and set them so they reflect their light forward.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall make its lamps seven in number; and they shall mount its lamps so as to shed light on the space in front of it.
verses.textEn: "Then make its seven lamps and set them up on it so that they light the space in front of it.

verses.textZh: 灯台上的灯剪和灯花盆，也是要纯金做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯台上的灯剪和灯花盆，也是要纯金做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台的蜡剪和蜡花盘也是要精金的。
verses.textEnNiv: Its wick trimmers and trays are to be of pure gold.
verses.textEnEsv: Its tongs and their trays shall be of pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And its wick-trimmers and their trays shallbe of pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: The lamp snuffers and trays must also be made of pure gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Its tongs and its trays shall be of pure gold.
verses.textEn: Its wick trimmers and trays are to be of pure gold.

verses.textZh: 要用三十五公斤纯金做灯台和一切器具。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要用三十五公斤纯金做灯台和一切器具。
verses.textZhCuv: 做灯台和这一切的器具要用精金一他连得。
verses.textEnNiv: A talent of pure gold is to be used for the lampstand and all these accessories.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be made, with all these utensils, out of a talent of pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these utensils.
verses.textEnNlt: You will need 75 pounds of pure gold for the lampstand and its accessories.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be made from a talent of pure gold, with all these utensils.
verses.textEn: A talent of pure gold is to be used for the lampstand and all these accessories.

verses.textZh: 你要留心照着在山上指示你的样式去做。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要留心照着在山上指示你的样式去做。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要谨慎做这些物件，都要照着在山上指示你的样式。」
verses.textEnNiv: See that you make them according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: And see that you make them after the pattern for them, which is being shown you on the mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And see to it that you make them according to the pattern which was shown you on the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: "Be sure that you make everything according to the pattern I have shown you here on the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: See that you make them by the pattern for them, which was shown to you on the mountain.
verses.textEn: See that you make them according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

verses.textZh: "你要用十幅幔子来做会幕；幔子要用捻的细麻、蓝色紫色朱红色线做成，并要用巧工绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用十幅幔子来做会幕；幔子要用捻的细麻、蓝色紫色朱红色线做成，并要用巧工绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用十幅幔子做帐幕。这些幔子要用捻的细麻和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线制造，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim woven into them by a skilled worker.
verses.textEnEsv: "Moreover, you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet yarns; you shall make them with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine woven linen and blue, purple, and scarlet thread; with artistic designs of cherubim you shall weave them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Make the Tabernacle from ten curtains of finely woven linen. Decorate the curtains with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: "Moreover, you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twisted linen and violet, purple, and scarlet material; you shall make them with cherubim, the work of a skilled embroiderer.
verses.textEn: "Make the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim woven into them by a skilled worker.

verses.textZh: 每幅幔子要长十二公尺，宽两公尺，每幅幔子都要一样的尺寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每幅幔子要长十二公尺，宽两公尺，每幅幔子都要一样的尺寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 每幅幔子要长二十八肘，宽四肘，幔子都要一样的尺寸。
verses.textEnNiv: All the curtains are to be the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains shall be the same size.
verses.textEnNkjv: The length of each curtain shallbe twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. And every one of the curtains shall have the same measurements.
verses.textEnNlt: These ten curtains must all be exactly the same size—42 feet long and 6 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains shall have the same measurements.
verses.textEn: All the curtains are to be the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 其中五幅幔子要彼此相连，另外五幅幔子也要彼此相连。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中五幅幔子要彼此相连，另外五幅幔子也要彼此相连。
verses.textZhCuv: 这五幅幔子要幅幅相连；那五幅幔子也要幅幅相连。
verses.textEnNiv: Join five of the curtains together, and do the same with the other five.
verses.textEnEsv: Five curtains shall be coupled to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Five curtains shall be coupled to one another, and theother five curtains shallbe coupled to one another.
verses.textEnNlt: Join five of these curtains together to make one long curtain, then join the other five into a second long curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: Five curtains shall be joined to one another, and the other five curtains shall be joined to one another.
verses.textEn: Join five of the curtains together, and do the same with the other five.

verses.textZh: 其中一组相连的幔子最后一幅的边上，你要做蓝色的钮扣；在另一组相连的幔子最后一幅的边上，你也要这样做。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中一组相连的幔子最后一幅的边上，你要做蓝色的钮扣；在另一组相连的幔子最后一幅的边上，你也要这样做。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要做蓝色的钮扣；在那相连的幔子末幅边上也要照样做。
verses.textEnNiv: Make loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and do the same with the end curtain in the other set.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of the outermost curtain in the first set. Likewise you shall make loops on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make loops of blue yarn on the edge of the curtain on the selvedge of one set, and likewise you shall do on the outer edge of theother curtain of the second set.
verses.textEnNlt: Put loops of blue yarn along the edge of the last curtain in each set.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make loops of violet on the edge of the outermost curtain in the first set, and likewise you shall make them on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set.
verses.textEn: Make loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and do the same with the end curtain in the other set.

verses.textZh: 在这幅幔子上，你要做五十个钮扣；在另一组幔子最后一幅的边上，你也要做五十个钮扣，这些钮扣要彼此相对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这幅幔子上，你要做五十个钮扣；在另一组幔子最后一幅的边上，你也要做五十个钮扣，这些钮扣要彼此相对。
verses.textZhCuv: 要在这相连的幔子上做五十个钮扣；在那相连的幔子上也做五十个钮扣，都要两两相对。
verses.textEnNiv: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.
verses.textEnEsv: Fifty loops you shall make on the one curtain, and fifty loops you shall make on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set; the loops shall be opposite one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fifty loops you shall make in the one curtain, and fifty loops you shall make on the edge of the curtain that is on the end of the second set, that the loops may be clasped to one another.
verses.textEnNlt: The fifty loops along the edge of one curtain are to match the fifty loops along the edge of the other curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set; the loops shall be opposite each other.
verses.textEn: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.

verses.textZh: 你要做五十个金钩，又要用钩使幔子相连起来，成为一整个会幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要做五十个金钩，又要用钩使幔子相连起来，成为一整个会幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要做五十个金钩，用钩使幔子相连，这才成了一个帐幕。
verses.textEnNiv: Then make fifty gold clasps and use them to fasten the curtains together so that the tabernacle is a unit.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains one to the other with the clasps, so that the tabernacle may be a single whole.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains together with the clasps, so that it may be one tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Then make fifty gold clasps and fasten the long curtains together with the clasps. In this way, the Tabernacle will be made of one continuous piece.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also make fifty clasps of gold, and join the curtains to one another with the clasps so that the tabernacle will be a unit.
verses.textEn: Then make fifty gold clasps and use them to fasten the curtains together so that the tabernacle is a unit.

verses.textZh: "你要用山羊毛做幔子，作会幕上面的帐棚，你要做十一幅幔子。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用山羊毛做幔子，作会幕上面的帐棚，你要做十一幅幔子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用山羊毛织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall also make curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains shall you make.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also make curtains of goats’ hair, to be a tent over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
verses.textEnNlt: "Make eleven curtains of goat-hair cloth to serve as a tent covering for the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you shall make curtains of goats’ hair as a tent over the tabernacle; you shall make eleven curtains in all.
verses.textEn: "Make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.

verses.textZh: 每幅幔子要长十三公尺，宽两公尺，十一幅幔子都要一样的尺寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每幅幔子要长十三公尺，宽两公尺，十一幅幔子都要一样的尺寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 每幅幔子要长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幔子都要一样的尺寸。
verses.textEnNiv: All eleven curtains are to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits. The eleven curtains shall be the same size.
verses.textEnNkjv: The length of each curtain shallbe thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; and the eleven curtains shall all have the same measurements.
verses.textEnNlt: These eleven curtains must all be exactly the same size—45 feet long and 6 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; the eleven curtains shall have the same measurements.
verses.textEn: All eleven curtains are to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 你要把五幅幔子连在一起，又把另外六幅幔子连在一起，你要在帐棚前面把第六幅幔子折叠起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把五幅幔子连在一起，又把另外六幅幔子连在一起，你要在帐棚前面把第六幅幔子折叠起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅，这第六幅幔子要在罩棚的前面折上去。
verses.textEnNiv: Join five of the curtains together into one set and the other six into another set. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and the sixth curtain you shall double over at the front of the tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall couple five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves, and you shall double over the sixth curtain at the forefront of the tent.
verses.textEnNlt: Join five of these curtains together to make one long curtain, and join the other six into a second long curtain. Allow 3 feet of material from the second set of curtains to hang over the front of the sacred tent.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall join five curtains by themselves and the other six curtains by themselves, and you shall double over the sixth curtain at the front of the tent.
verses.textEn: Join five of the curtains together into one set and the other six into another set. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.

verses.textZh: 在这一组相连的幔子最后一幅的边上，你要做五十个钮扣；在另一组相连的幔子最后一幅的边上，也要做五十个钮扣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一组相连的幔子最后一幅的边上，你要做五十个钮扣；在另一组相连的幔子最后一幅的边上，也要做五十个钮扣。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要做五十个钮扣；在那相连的幔子末幅边上也做五十个钮扣。
verses.textEnNiv: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain of the second set.
verses.textEnNlt: Make fifty loops for one edge of each large curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the first set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second set.
verses.textEn: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.

verses.textZh: 你又要做五十个铜钩，把钩穿进钮扣中，使帐棚连起来，成为一整个帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要做五十个铜钩，把钩穿进钮扣中，使帐棚连起来，成为一整个帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要做五十个铜钩，钩在钮扣中，使罩棚连成一个。
verses.textEnNiv: Then make fifty bronze clasps and put them in the loops to fasten the tent together as a unit.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together that it may be a single whole.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make fifty bronze clasps, put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.textEnNlt: Then make fifty bronze clasps, and fasten the loops of the long curtains with the clasps. In this way, the tent covering will be made of one continuous piece.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also make fifty clasps of bronze, and you shall put the clasps into the loops and join the tent together so that it will be a unit.
verses.textEn: Then make fifty bronze clasps and put them in the loops to fasten the tent together as a unit.

verses.textZh: 帐棚的幔子多出的那部分，即垂下来的半幅幔子，要垂在会幕的后面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 帐棚的幔子多出的那部分，即垂下来的半幅幔子，要垂在会幕的后面。
verses.textZhCuv: 罩棚的幔子所余那垂下来的半幅幔子，要垂在帐幕的后头。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the additional length of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the rear of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: And the part that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: The remnant that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: The remaining 3 feet of this tent covering will be left to hang over the back of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: The overhanging part that is left over in the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that is left over, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: As for the additional length of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the rear of the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 帐棚幔子多出的长度，要这边五十公分，那边五十公分，并且要在会幕的两边，遮盖会幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 帐棚幔子多出的长度，要这边五十公分，那边五十公分，并且要在会幕的两边，遮盖会幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 罩棚的幔子所余长的，这边一肘，那边一肘，要垂在帐幕的两旁，遮盖帐幕。
verses.textEnNiv: The tent curtains will be a cubit longer on both sides; what is left will hang over the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the extra that remains in the length of the curtains, the cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle, on this side and that side, to cover it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a cubit on one side and a cubit on the other side, of what remains of the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle, on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.textEnNlt: Allow 18 inches of remaining material to hang down over each side, so the Tabernacle is completely covered.
verses.textEnNasb: The cubit on one side and the cubit on the other, of what is left over in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on one side and on the other, to cover it.
verses.textEn: The tent curtains will be a cubit longer on both sides; what is left will hang over the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it.

verses.textZh: 你又要用染红的公羊皮做帐棚的顶盖，在上面再盖上海狗皮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要用染红的公羊皮做帐棚的顶盖，在上面再盖上海狗皮。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要用染红的公羊皮做罩棚的盖；再用海狗皮做一层罩棚上的顶盖。
verses.textEnNiv: Make for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of the other durable leather.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make for the tent a covering of tanned rams’ skins and a covering of goatskins on top.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also make a covering of ram skins dyed red for the tent, and a covering of badger skins above that.
verses.textEnNlt: Complete the tent covering with a protective layer of tanned ram skins and a layer of fine goatskin leather.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red and a covering of fine leather above.
verses.textEn: Make for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of the other durable leather.

verses.textZh: "你要用皂荚木做会幕的竖板，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用皂荚木做会幕的竖板，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用皂荚木做帐幕的竖板。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make upright frames for the tabernacle of acacia wood.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And for the tabernacle you shall make the boards of acacia wood, standing upright.
verses.textEnNlt: "For the framework of the Tabernacle, construct frames of acacia wood.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
verses.textEn: "Make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 每块板要长四公尺，宽六十六公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每块板要长四公尺，宽六十六公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 每块要长十肘，宽一肘半；
verses.textEnNiv: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,
verses.textEnEsv: Ten cubits shall be the length of a frame, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each frame.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ten cubits shallbe the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shallbe the width of each board.
verses.textEnNlt: Each frame must be 15 feet high and 27 inches wide,
verses.textEnNasb: Ten cubits shall be the length of each board and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
verses.textEn: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

verses.textZh: 每块木板要有两个榫头，彼此连接，会幕的一切木板你都要这样做。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每块木板要有两个榫头，彼此连接，会幕的一切木板你都要这样做。
verses.textZhCuv: 每块必有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都要这样做。
verses.textEnNiv: with two projections set parallel to each other. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
verses.textEnEsv: There shall be two tenons in each frame, for fitting together. So shall you do for all the frames of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Two tenons shallbe in each board for binding one to another. Thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: with two pegs under each frame. Make all the frames identical.
verses.textEnNasb: There shall be two tenons for each board, fitted to one another; that is what you shall do for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: with two projections set parallel to each other. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

verses.textZh: 你要给会幕做木板；给南边，就是向南的一面，做二十块木板，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要给会幕做木板；给南边，就是向南的一面，做二十块木板，
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕的南面要做板二十块。
verses.textEnNiv: Make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make the frames for the tabernacle: twenty frames for the south side;
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side.
verses.textEnNlt: Make twenty of these frames to support the curtains on the south side of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side.
verses.textEn: Make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle

verses.textZh: 在这二十块板底下，你要做四十个银插座；每块木板底下有两个插座连接它的两个榫头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这二十块板底下，你要做四十个银插座；每块木板底下有两个插座连接它的两个榫头。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这二十块板底下要做四十个带卯的银座，两卯接这块板上的两榫，两卯接那块板上的两榫。
verses.textEnNiv: and make forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.
verses.textEnEsv: and forty bases of silver you shall make under the twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons, and two bases under the next frame for its two tenons;
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under each of the boards for its two tenons.
verses.textEnNlt: Also make forty silver bases—two bases under each frame, with the pegs fitting securely into the bases.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make forty bases of silver under the twenty boards, two bases under one board for its two tenons and two bases under another board for its two tenons;
verses.textEn: and make forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.

verses.textZh: 你也要给会幕的另一边，就是北面，做二十块木板，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要给会幕的另一边，就是北面，做二十块木板，
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕第二面，就是北面，也要做板二十块
verses.textEnNiv: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, make twenty frames
verses.textEnEsv: and for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side twenty frames,
verses.textEnNkjv: And for the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, thereshallbe twenty boards
verses.textEnNlt: For the north side of the Tabernacle, make another twenty frames,
verses.textEnNasb: and for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
verses.textEn: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, make twenty frames

verses.textZh: 和四十个银插座。这块木板底下有两个插座，那块木板底下也有两个插座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和四十个银插座。这块木板底下有两个插座，那块木板底下也有两个插座。
verses.textZhCuv: 和带卯的银座四十个；这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。
verses.textEnNiv: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.
verses.textEnEsv: and their forty bases of silver, two bases under one frame, and two bases under the next frame.
verses.textEnNkjv: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under each of the boards.
verses.textEnNlt: with their forty silver bases, two bases under each frame.
verses.textEnNasb: and their forty bases of silver; two bases under one board and two bases under another board.
verses.textEn: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.

verses.textZh: 给会幕的后面，就是西面，你要做六块木板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 给会幕的后面，就是西面，你要做六块木板。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，要做板六块。
verses.textEnNiv: Make six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnEsv: And for the rear of the tabernacle westward you shall make six frames.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the far side of the tabernacle, westward, you shall make six boards.
verses.textEnNlt: Make six frames for the rear—the west side of the Tabernacle—
verses.textEnNasb: For the back of the tabernacle, to the west, you shall make six boards.
verses.textEn: Make six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,

verses.textZh: 在会幕后面的两角上，你要做两块木板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在会幕后面的两角上，你要做两块木板。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕后面的拐角要做板两块。
verses.textEnNiv: and make two frames for the corners at the far end.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make two frames for corners of the tabernacle in the rear;
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall also make two boards for the two back corners of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: along with two additional frames to reinforce the rear corners of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle at the back.
verses.textEn: and make two frames for the corners at the far end.

verses.textZh: 木板的下截是要双的，一直连到上面的第一环那里，都是要双的。两块都要这样做，要成为两只角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 木板的下截是要双的，一直连到上面的第一环那里，都是要双的。两块都要这样做，要成为两只角。
verses.textZhCuv: 板的下半截要双的，上半截要整的，直顶到第一个环子；两块都要这样做两个拐角。
verses.textEnNiv: At these two corners they must be double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both shall be like that.
verses.textEnEsv: they shall be separate beneath, but joined at the top, at the first ring. Thus shall it be with both of them; they shall form the two corners.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be coupled together at the bottom and they shall be coupled together at the top by one ring. Thus it shall be for both of them. They shall be for the two corners.
verses.textEnNlt: These corner frames will be matched at the bottom and firmly attached at the top with a single ring, forming a single corner unit. Make both of these corner units the same way.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall be double beneath, and together they shall be complete to its top to the first ring; this is how it shall be with both of them: they shall form the two corners.
verses.textEn: At these two corners they must be double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both shall be like that.

verses.textZh: 所以要有八块木板，和十六个银插座，这块木板底下有两个插座，那块木板底下也有两个插座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以要有八块木板，和十六个银插座，这块木板底下有两个插座，那块木板底下也有两个插座。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有八块板和十六个带卯的银座；这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。
verses.textEnNiv: So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
verses.textEnEsv: And there shall be eight frames, with their bases of silver, sixteen bases; two bases under one frame, and two bases under another frame.
verses.textEnNkjv: So there shall be eight boards with their sockets of silver—sixteen sockets—two sockets under each of the boards.
verses.textEnNlt: So there will be eight frames at the rear of the Tabernacle, set in sixteen silver bases—two bases under each frame.
verses.textEnNasb: And there shall be eight boards with their bases of silver, sixteen bases; two bases under one board and two bases under another board.
verses.textEn: So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.

verses.textZh: "你要用皂荚木做横闩，为会幕这边的木板做五个横闩，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用皂荚木做横闩，为会幕这边的木板做五个横闩，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用皂荚木作闩：为帐幕这面的板作五闩，
verses.textEnNiv: "Also make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards on one side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnNlt: "Make crossbars of acacia wood to link the frames, five crossbars for the north side of the Tabernacle
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the boards of one side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEn: "Also make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

verses.textZh: 为会幕那边的木板也做五个横闩，又为会幕的后边，即西边的木板，也做五个横闩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为会幕那边的木板也做五个横闩，又为会幕的后边，即西边的木板，也做五个横闩。
verses.textZhCuv: 为帐幕那面的板做五闩，又为帐幕后面的板做五闩。
verses.textEnNiv: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: and five bars for the frames of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the side of the tabernacle at the rear westward.
verses.textEnNkjv: five bars for the boards on the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.
verses.textEnNlt: and five for the south side. Also make five crossbars for the rear of the Tabernacle, which will face west.
verses.textEnNasb: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle for the back side to the west.
verses.textEn: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 木板中部的中闩，要从这一端通到那一端，
verses.textZhCnvs: 木板中部的中闩，要从这一端通到那一端，
verses.textZhCuv: 板腰间的中闩要从这一头通到那一头。
verses.textEnNiv: The center crossbar is to extend from end to end at the middle of the frames.
verses.textEnEsv: The middle bar, halfway up the frames, shall run from end to end.
verses.textEnNkjv: The middle bar shall pass through the midst of the boards from end to end.
verses.textEnNlt: The middle crossbar, attached halfway up the frames, will run all the way from one end of the Tabernacle to the other.
verses.textEnNasb: The middle bar in the center of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
verses.textEn: The center crossbar is to extend from end to end at the middle of the frames.

verses.textZh: 木板要包金，你也要做板上的金环，用来穿上横闩，横闩也要包金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 木板要包金，你也要做板上的金环，用来穿上横闩，横闩也要包金。
verses.textZhCuv: 板要用金子包裹，又要做板上的金环套闩；闩也要用金子包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall overlay the frames with gold and shall make their rings of gold for holders for the bars, and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall overlay the boards with gold, make their rings of gold as holders for the bars, and overlay the bars with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Overlay the frames with gold, and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Overlay the crossbars with gold as well.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold as holders for the bars; and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
verses.textEn: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.

verses.textZh: 你要照着在山上指示你的样式立起会幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要照着在山上指示你的样式立起会幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 要照着在山上指示你的样式立起帐幕。
verses.textEnNiv: "Set up the tabernacle according to the plan shown you on the mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall erect the tabernacle according to the plan for it that you were shown on the mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall raise up the tabernacle according to its pattern which you were shown on the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: "Set up this Tabernacle according to the pattern you were shown on the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall erect the tabernacle according to its plan which you have been shown on the mountain.
verses.textEn: "Set up the tabernacle according to the plan shown you on the mountain.

verses.textZh: "你要用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做幔幕，并且要用巧工绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做幔幕，并且要用巧工绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim woven into it by a skilled worker.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you shall make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen. It shall be made with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make a veil woven of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen. It shall be woven with an artistic design of cherubim.
verses.textEnNlt: "For the inside of the Tabernacle, make a special curtain of finely woven linen. Decorate it with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also make a veil of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen; it shall be made with cherubim, the work of a skilled embroiderer.
verses.textEn: "Make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim woven into it by a skilled worker.

verses.textZh: 你要把幔幕挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上，柱上有金钩，柱脚安在四个银插座上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把幔幕挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上，柱上有金钩，柱脚安在四个银插座上。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把幔子挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上，柱子上当有金钩，柱子安在四个带卯的银座上。
verses.textEnNiv: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, with hooks of gold, on four bases of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall hang it upon the four pillars of acacia wood overlaid with gold. Their hooks shallbe gold, upon four sockets of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: Hang this curtain on gold hooks attached to four posts of acacia wood. Overlay the posts with gold, and set them in four silver bases.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, their hooks also of gold, on four bases of silver.
verses.textEn: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.

verses.textZh: 你要把幔幕挂在钩子上，把法柜抬进幔幕里面，这幔幕要给你们把圣所和至圣所分开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把幔幕挂在钩子上，把法柜抬进幔幕里面，这幔幕要给你们把圣所和至圣所分开。
verses.textZhCuv: 要使幔子垂在钩子下，把法柜抬进幔子内；这幔子要将圣所和至圣所隔开。
verses.textEnNiv: Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the covenant law behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall hang the veil from the clasps, and bring the ark of the testimony in there within the veil. And the veil shall separate for you the Holy Place from the Most Holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall hang the veil from the clasps. Then you shall bring the ark of the Testimony in there, behind the veil. The veil shall be a divider for you between the holy place and the Most Holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Hang the inner curtain from clasps, and put the Ark of the Covenant in the room behind it. This curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and bring in the ark of the testimony there within the veil; and the veil shall serve as a partition for you between the Holy Place and the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEn: Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the covenant law behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

verses.textZh: 你要把施恩座安在至圣所内的法柜上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把施恩座安在至圣所内的法柜上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把施恩座安在至圣所内的法柜上，
verses.textEnNiv: Put the atonement cover on the ark of the covenant law in the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall put the mercy seat upon the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then put the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement—on top of the Ark of the Covenant inside the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall put the atoning cover on the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEn: Put the atonement cover on the ark of the covenant law in the Most Holy Place.

verses.textZh: 你要把桌子放在幔幕外，把灯台放在会幕的南边，与桌子相对；把桌子安在北面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把桌子放在幔幕外，把灯台放在会幕的南边，与桌子相对；把桌子安在北面。
verses.textZhCuv: 把桌子安在幔子外帐幕的北面；把灯台安在帐幕的南面，彼此相对。
verses.textEnNiv: Place the table outside the curtain on the north side of the tabernacle and put the lampstand opposite it on the south side.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand on the south side of the tabernacle opposite the table, and you shall put the table on the north side.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand across from the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and you shall put the table on the north side.
verses.textEnNlt: Place the table outside the inner curtain on the north side of the Tabernacle, and place the lampstand across the room on the south side.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and you shall put the table on the north side.
verses.textEn: Place the table outside the curtain on the north side of the tabernacle and put the lampstand opposite it on the south side.

verses.textZh: "你要给帐幕的门口做块帘子，要用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻编织而成。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要给帐幕的门口做块帘子，要用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻编织而成。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘。
verses.textEnNiv: "For the entrance to the tent make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, embroidered with needlework.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make a screen for the door of the tabernacle, wovenof blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver.
verses.textEnNlt: "Make another curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent. Make it of finely woven linen and embroider it with exquisite designs, using blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also make a curtain for the doorway of the tent of violet, purple, and scarlet material and fine twisted linen, the work of a weaver.
verses.textEn: "For the entrance to the tent make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer.

verses.textZh: 你又要用皂荚木为帘子做五根柱子，柱子要包金，柱上有金钩，你也要为柱脚铸造五个铜插座。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要用皂荚木为帘子做五根柱子，柱子要包金，柱上有金钩，你也要为柱脚铸造五个铜插座。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要用皂荚木为帘子做五根柱子，用金子包裹。柱子上当有金钩；又要为柱子用铜铸造五个带卯的座。」
verses.textEnNiv: Make gold hooks for this curtain and five posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold. And cast five bronze bases for them.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold, and you shall cast five bases of bronze for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold; their hooks shallbe gold, and you shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Craft five posts from acacia wood. Overlay them with gold, and hang the curtain from them with gold hooks. Cast five bronze bases for the posts.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make five pillars of acacia for the curtain and overlay them with gold, their hooks also of gold; and you shall cast five bases of bronze for them.
verses.textEn: Make gold hooks for this curtain and five posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold. And cast five bronze bases for them.

verses.textZh: "你要用皂荚木做祭坛，这坛要四方的：长两公尺两公寸，宽两公尺两公寸，高一公尺三公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用皂荚木做祭坛，这坛要四方的：长两公尺两公寸，宽两公尺两公寸，高一公尺三公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用皂荚木做坛。这坛要四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘。
verses.textEnNiv: "Build an altar of acacia wood, three cubits high; it is to be square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits broad. The altar shall be square, and its height shall be three cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make an altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide—the altar shall be square—and its height shallbe three cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: "Using acacia wood, construct a square altar 7-1/2 feet wide, 7-1/2 feet long, and 4-1/2 feet high.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide; the altar shall be square, and its height shall be three cubits.
verses.textEn: "Build an altar of acacia wood, three cubits high; it is to be square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 要在祭坛的四拐角做四个角，角要与祭坛连在一块，祭坛要包上铜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要在祭坛的四拐角做四个角，角要与祭坛连在一块，祭坛要包上铜。
verses.textZhCuv: 要在坛的四拐角上做四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: Make a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar are of one piece, and overlay the altar with bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make horns for it on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it, and you shall overlay it with bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it. And you shall overlay it with bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: Make horns for each of its four corners so that the horns and altar are all one piece. Overlay the altar with bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it, and you shall overlay it with bronze.
verses.textEn: Make a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar are of one piece, and overlay the altar with bronze.

verses.textZh: 要做盆，用来收去祭坛上的灰，又要做铲、盘、肉叉和火鼎；祭坛上的一切器具，你都要用铜来做。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要做盆，用来收去祭坛上的灰，又要做铲、盘、肉叉和火鼎；祭坛上的一切器具，你都要用铜来做。
verses.textZhCuv: 要做盆，收去坛上的灰，又做铲子、盘子、肉锸子、火鼎；坛上一切的器具都用铜做。
verses.textEnNiv: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots to remove the ashes, and its shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make pots for it to receive its ashes, and shovels and basins and forks and fire pans. You shall make all its utensils of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also you shall make its pans to receive its ashes, and its shovels and its basins and its forks and its firepans; you shall make all its utensils of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: Make ash buckets, shovels, basins, meat forks, and firepans, all of bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make its pails for removing its ashes, and its shovels, its basins, its forks, and its firepans; you shall make all its utensils of bronze.
verses.textEn: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots to remove the ashes, and its shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.

verses.textZh: 要为坛做一个铜网，网的四拐角上要做四个铜环。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要为坛做一个铜网，网的四拐角上要做四个铜环。
verses.textZhCuv: 要为坛做一个铜网，在网的四角上做四个铜环，
verses.textEnNiv: Make a grating for it, a bronze network, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the network.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall also make for it a grating, a network of bronze, and on the net you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make a grate for it, a network of bronze; and on the network you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.
verses.textEnNlt: Make a bronze grating for it, and attach four bronze rings at its four corners.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also make for it a grating, a netting of bronze, and on the netting you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.
verses.textEn: Make a grating for it, a bronze network, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the network.

verses.textZh: 要把网安在祭坛下面的围腰板之下，使网从下面直达到祭坛的半腰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把网安在祭坛下面的围腰板之下，使网从下面直达到祭坛的半腰。
verses.textZhCuv: 把网安在坛四面的围腰板以下，使网从下达到坛的半腰。
verses.textEnNiv: Put it under the ledge of the altar so that it is halfway up the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set it under the ledge of the altar so that the net extends halfway down the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall put it under the rim of the altar beneath, that the network may be midway up the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Install the grating halfway down the side of the altar, under the ledge.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall put it under the ledge of the altar, so that the netting will reach halfway up the altar.
verses.textEn: Put it under the ledge of the altar so that it is halfway up the altar.

verses.textZh: 又要为祭坛做杠，就是皂荚木的杠，要包上铜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要为祭坛做杠，就是皂荚木的杠，要包上铜。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要用皂荚木为坛做杠，用铜包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: Make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: For carrying the altar, make poles from acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also make carrying poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood and overlay them with bronze.
verses.textEn: Make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.

verses.textZh: 杠要穿在祭坛的环子里，抬祭坛的时候，杠就在祭坛的两边；
verses.textZhCnvs: 杠要穿在祭坛的环子里，抬祭坛的时候，杠就在祭坛的两边；
verses.textZhCuv: 这杠要穿在坛两旁的环子内，用以抬坛。
verses.textEnNiv: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so they will be on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
verses.textEnEsv: And the poles shall be put through the rings, so that the poles are on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.
verses.textEnNkjv: The poles shall be put in the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar to bear it.
verses.textEnNlt: Insert the poles through the rings on the two sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Its poles shall be inserted into the rings, so that the poles will be on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.
verses.textEn: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so they will be on two sides of the altar when it is carried.

verses.textZh: 你要用木板做祭坛，祭坛是空心的。你要照着在山上指示你的去做。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用木板做祭坛，祭坛是空心的。你要照着在山上指示你的去做。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用板做坛，坛是空的，都照着在山上指示你的样式做。」
verses.textEnNiv: Make the altar hollow, out of boards. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.
