verses.textEnEsv: You shall make it hollow, with boards. As it has been shown you on the mountain, so shall it be made.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make it hollow with boards; as it was shown you on the mountain, so shall they make it.
verses.textEnNlt: The altar must be hollow, made from planks. Build it just as you were shown on the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make it hollow with planks; as it was shown to you on the mountain, so they shall make it.
verses.textEn: Make the altar hollow, out of boards. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.

verses.textZh: "你要做会幕的院子。在南面，即向南的一面，要用捻的细麻为院子做帷幔，每边长四十四公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要做会幕的院子。在南面，即向南的一面，要用捻的细麻为院子做帷幔，每边长四十四公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要做帐幕的院子。院子的南面要用捻的细麻做帷子，长一百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make a courtyard for the tabernacle. The south side shall be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains of finely twisted linen,
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make the court of the tabernacle. On the south side the court shall have hangings of fine twined linen a hundred cubits long for one side.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also make the court of the tabernacle. For the south side thereshallbe hangings for the court madeof fine woven linen, one hundred cubits long for one side.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then make the courtyard for the Tabernacle, enclosed with curtains made of finely woven linen. On the south side, make the curtains 150 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you shall make the courtyard of the tabernacle. On the south side there shall be hangings for the courtyard of fine twisted linen, a hundred cubits long for one side;
verses.textEn: "Make a courtyard for the tabernacle. The south side shall be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains of finely twisted linen,

verses.textZh: 帷幔的柱子要二十根，铜插座二十个。柱子上的钩子和桁子都是银的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 帷幔的柱子要二十根，铜插座二十个。柱子上的钩子和桁子都是银的。
verses.textZhCuv: 帷子的柱子要二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。
verses.textEnNiv: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
verses.textEnEsv: Its twenty pillars and their twenty bases shall be of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: And its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets shallbe bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their bands shallbe silver.
verses.textEnNlt: They will be held up by twenty posts set securely in twenty bronze bases. Hang the curtains with silver hooks and rings.
verses.textEnNasb: and its pillars shall be twenty, with their twenty bases of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be of silver.
verses.textEn: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

verses.textZh: 北面也是一样，要有四十四公尺长的帷幔，帷幔的柱子二十根，铜插座二十个，柱子上的钩子和桁子都是银的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 北面也是一样，要有四十四公尺长的帷幔，帷幔的柱子二十根，铜插座二十个，柱子上的钩子和桁子都是银的。
verses.textZhCuv: 北面也当有帷子，长一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。
verses.textEnNiv: The north side shall also be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
verses.textEnEsv: And likewise for its length on the north side there shall be hangings a hundred cubits long, its pillars twenty and their bases twenty, of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise along the length of the north side thereshallbe hangings one hundred cubits long, with its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of bronze, and the hooks of the pillars and their bands of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: Make the curtains the same on the north side—150 feet of curtains held up by twenty posts set securely in bronze bases. Hang the curtains with silver hooks and rings.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings a hundred cubits long, and its twenty pillars with their twenty bases of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be of silver.
verses.textEn: The north side shall also be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

verses.textZh: 院子的西面，也要有帷幔，宽二十二公尺。帷幔的柱子十根，插座十个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子的西面，也要有帷幔，宽二十二公尺。帷幔的柱子十根，插座十个。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的西面当有帷子，宽五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，带卯的座十个。
verses.textEnNiv: "The west end of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide and have curtains, with ten posts and ten bases.
verses.textEnEsv: And for the breadth of the court on the west side there shall be hangings for fifty cubits, with ten pillars and ten bases.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And along the width of the court on the west side shallbe hangings of fifty cubits, with their ten pillars and their ten sockets.
verses.textEnNlt: The curtains on the west end of the courtyard will be 75 feet long, supported by ten posts set into ten bases.
verses.textEnNasb: For the width of the courtyard on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits, with their ten pillars and their ten bases.
verses.textEn: "The west end of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide and have curtains, with ten posts and ten bases.

verses.textZh: 院子的东面，要有二十二公尺宽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子的东面，要有二十二公尺宽。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的东面要宽五十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: On the east end, toward the sunrise, the courtyard shall also be fifty cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: The breadth of the court on the front to the east shall be fifty cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: The width of the court on the east side shallbe fifty cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: The east end of the courtyard, the front, will also be 75 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: The width of the courtyard on the east side shall be fifty cubits.
verses.textEn: On the east end, toward the sunrise, the courtyard shall also be fifty cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 门一面的帷幔要六公尺六公寸，帷幔的柱子三根，插座三个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门一面的帷幔要六公尺六公寸，帷幔的柱子三根，插座三个。
verses.textZhCuv: 门这边的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。
verses.textEnNiv: Curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,
verses.textEnEsv: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and three bases.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hangings on one side ofthegateshallbe fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three sockets.
verses.textEnNlt: The courtyard entrance will be on the east end, flanked by two curtains. The curtain on the right side will be 22-1/2 feet long, supported by three posts set into three bases.
verses.textEnNasb: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three bases.
verses.textEn: Curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

verses.textZh: 门另一面的帷幔也要六公尺六公寸，帷幔的柱子三根，插座三个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门另一面的帷幔也要六公尺六公寸，帷幔的柱子三根，插座三个。
verses.textZhCuv: 门那边的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。
verses.textEnNiv: and curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on the other side, with three posts and three bases.
verses.textEnEsv: On the other side the hangings shall be fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and three bases.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the other side shallbe hangings of fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three sockets.
verses.textEnNlt: The curtain on the left side will also be 22-1/2 feet long, supported by three posts set into three bases.
verses.textEnNasb: And for the other side there shall be hangings of fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three bases.
verses.textEn: and curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on the other side, with three posts and three bases.

verses.textZh: 院子的大门要有门帘，长九公尺，是用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻，用刺绣的手工织成，柱子四根，插座四个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子的大门要有门帘，长九公尺，是用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻，用刺绣的手工织成，柱子四根，插座四个。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的门当有帘子，长二十肘，要拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织成，柱子四根，带卯的座四个。
verses.textEnNiv: "For the entrance to the courtyard, provide a curtain twenty cubits long, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer—with four posts and four bases.
verses.textEnEsv: For the gate of the court there shall be a screen twenty cubits long, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, embroidered with needlework. It shall have four pillars and with them four bases.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For the gate of the court thereshallbe a screen twenty cubits long, wovenof blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver. It shallhave four pillars and four sockets.
verses.textEnNlt: "For the entrance to the courtyard, make a curtain that is 30 feet long. Make it from finely woven linen, and decorate it with beautiful embroidery in blue, purple, and scarlet thread. Support it with four posts, each securely set in its own base.
verses.textEnNasb: And for the gate of the courtyard there shall be a curtain of twenty cubits, of violet, purple, and scarlet material and fine twisted linen, the work of a weaver, with their four pillars and their four bases.
verses.textEn: "For the entrance to the courtyard, provide a curtain twenty cubits long, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer—with four posts and four bases.

verses.textZh: 院子周围一切柱子，都要用银桁子相连起来。柱子上的钩子是银的，插座是铜的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子周围一切柱子，都要用银桁子相连起来。柱子上的钩子是银的，插座是铜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子四围一切的柱子都要用银杆连络，柱子上的钩子要用银做，带卯的座要用铜做。
verses.textEnNiv: All the posts around the courtyard are to have silver bands and hooks, and bronze bases.
verses.textEnEsv: All the pillars around the court shall be filleted with silver. Their hooks shall be of silver, and their bases of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the pillars around the court shall have bands of silver; their hooks shallbe of silver and their sockets of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: All the posts around the courtyard must have silver rings and hooks and bronze bases.
verses.textEnNasb: All the pillars around the courtyard shall be joined together with silver, with their hooks of silver and their bases of bronze.
verses.textEn: All the posts around the courtyard are to have silver bands and hooks, and bronze bases.

verses.textZh: 院子要长四十四公尺，宽二十二公尺，高两公尺两公寸；帷幔是细麻捻的，插座是铜的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子要长四十四公尺，宽二十二公尺，高两公尺两公寸；帷幔是细麻捻的，插座是铜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子要长一百肘，宽五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用捻的细麻做，带卯的座要用铜做。
verses.textEnNiv: The courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely twisted linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.
verses.textEnEsv: The length of the court shall be a hundred cubits, the breadth fifty, and the height five cubits, with hangings of fine twined linen and bases of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: The length of the court shallbe one hundred cubits, the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, madeof fine woven linen, and its sockets of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: So the entire courtyard will be 150 feet long and 75 feet wide, with curtain walls 7-1/2 feet high, made from finely woven linen. The bases for the posts will be made of bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: The length of the courtyard shall be a hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits of fine twisted linen, and their bases of bronze.
verses.textEn: The courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely twisted linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.

verses.textZh: 会幕中为礼拜用的一切器具和钉子，以及院子里的一切钉子，都是铜的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 会幕中为礼拜用的一切器具和钉子，以及院子里的一切钉子，都是铜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕各样用处的器具，并帐幕一切的橛子，和院子里一切的橛子，都要用铜做。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the other articles used in the service of the tabernacle, whatever their function, including all the tent pegs for it and those for the courtyard, are to be of bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, and all its pegs and all the pegs of the court, shall be of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the utensils of the tabernacle for all its service, all its pegs, and all the pegs of the court, shallbe of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: "All the articles used in the rituals of the Tabernacle, including all the tent pegs used to support the Tabernacle and the courtyard curtains, must be made of bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: All the utensils of the tabernacle used in all its service, and all its pegs, and all the pegs of the courtyard, shall be of bronze.
verses.textEn: All the other articles used in the service of the tabernacle, whatever their function, including all the tent pegs for it and those for the courtyard, are to be of bronze.

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列民把打成的纯橄榄油拿来给你，是为点灯用的，使灯常常点着。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列民把打成的纯橄榄油拿来给你，是为点灯用的，使灯常常点着。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要吩咐以色列人，把那为点灯捣成的清橄榄油拿来给你，使灯常常点着。
verses.textEnNiv: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall command the people of Israel that they bring to you pure beaten olive oil for the light, that a lamp may regularly be set up to burn.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall command the children of Israel that they bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to cause the lamp to burn continually.
verses.textEnNlt: "Command the people of Israel to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
verses.textEnNasb: "And you shall command the sons of Israel that they bring you clear oil of beaten olives for the light, to make a lamp burn continually.
verses.textEn: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning.

verses.textZh: 在会幕中法柜前的幔子外，亚伦和他的子孙，从晚上到早晨，要常在耶和华面前料理这灯。这要作以色列人世世代代的定例。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在会幕中法柜前的幔子外，亚伦和他的子孙，从晚上到早晨，要常在耶和华面前料理这灯。这要作以色列人世世代代的定例。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在会幕中法柜前的幔外，亚伦和他的儿子，从晚上到早晨，要在耶和华面前经理这灯。这要作以色列人世世代代永远的定例。」
verses.textEnNiv: In the tent of meeting, outside the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law, Aaron and his sons are to keep the lamps burning before the Lord from evening till morning. This is to be a lasting ordinance among the Israelites for the generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil that is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall tend it from evening to morning before the Lord . It shall be a statute forever to be observed throughout their generations by the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the tabernacle of meeting, outside the veil which is before the Testimony, Aaron and his sons shall tend it from evening until morning before the Lord. Itshallbe a statute forever to their generations on behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The lampstand will stand in the Tabernacle, in front of the inner curtain that shields the Ark of the Covenant. Aaron and his sons must keep the lamps burning in the Lord ’s presence all night. This is a permanent law for the people of Israel, and it must be observed from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the Lord; it shall be a permanent statute throughout their generations for the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: In the tent of meeting, outside the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law, Aaron and his sons are to keep the lamps burning before the Lord from evening till morning. This is to be a lasting ordinance among the Israelites for the generations to come.

verses.textZh: "你要从以色列人中使你的哥哥亚伦和他的众子，就是亚伦和他的众子：拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛，都一同来到你面前，作事奉我的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要从以色列人中使你的哥哥亚伦和他的众子，就是亚伦和他的众子：拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛，都一同来到你面前，作事奉我的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要从以色列人中，使你的哥哥亚伦和他的儿子拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛一同就近你，给我供祭司的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Have Aaron your brother brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, so they may serve me as priests.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then bring near to you Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, from among the people of Israel, to serve me as priests—Aaron and Aaron’s sons, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now take Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to Me as priest, Aaron and Aaron’s sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNlt: "Call for your brother, Aaron, and his sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. Set them apart from the rest of the people of Israel so they may minister to me and be my priests.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then bring forward to yourself your brother Aaron, and his sons with him, from among the sons of Israel, to serve as priest to Me—Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
verses.textEn: "Have Aaron your brother brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, so they may serve me as priests.

verses.textZh: 你要为你哥哥亚伦做圣衣，使他有荣耀，有华美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要为你哥哥亚伦做圣衣，使他有荣耀，有华美。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要给你哥哥亚伦做圣衣为荣耀，为华美。
verses.textEnNiv: Make sacred garments for your brother Aaron to give him dignity and honor.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
verses.textEnNlt: Make sacred garments for Aaron that are glorious and beautiful.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
verses.textEn: Make sacred garments for your brother Aaron to give him dignity and honor.

verses.textZh: 你又要吩咐所有心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵充满的，给亚伦做衣服，使他成圣，作事奉我的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要吩咐所有心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵充满的，给亚伦做衣服，使他成圣，作事奉我的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦做衣服，使他分别为圣，可以给我供祭司的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: Tell all the skilled workers to whom I have given wisdom in such matters that they are to make garments for Aaron, for his consecration, so he may serve me as priest.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall speak to all the skillful, whom I have filled with a spirit of skill, that they make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him for my priesthood.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall speak to all whoare gifted artisans, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments, to consecrate him, that he may minister to Me as priest.
verses.textEnNlt: Instruct all the skilled craftsmen whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom. Have them make garments for Aaron that will distinguish him as a priest set apart for my service.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall speak to all the skillful people whom I have endowed with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may serve as priest to Me.
verses.textEn: Tell all the skilled workers to whom I have given wisdom in such matters that they are to make garments for Aaron, for his consecration, so he may serve me as priest.

verses.textZh: 这些就是他们要做的衣服：胸牌、以弗得、长外袍、杂色内袍、礼冠、腰带。他们要为你哥哥亚伦和他的众子做圣衣，使他们作事奉我的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些就是他们要做的衣服：胸牌、以弗得、长外袍、杂色内袍、礼冠、腰带。他们要为你哥哥亚伦和他的众子做圣衣，使他们作事奉我的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 所要做的就是胸牌、以弗得、外袍、杂色的内袍、冠冕、腰带，使你哥哥亚伦和他儿子穿这圣服，可以给我供祭司的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the garments they are to make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash. They are to make these sacred garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so they may serve me as priests.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a coat of checker work, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons to serve me as priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a skillfully woven tunic, a turban, and a sash. So they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to Me as priest.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the garments they are to make: a chestpiece, an ephod, a robe, a patterned tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to make these sacred garments for your brother, Aaron, and his sons to wear when they serve me as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a tunic of checkered work, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that he may serve as priest to Me.
verses.textEn: These are the garments they are to make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash. They are to make these sacred garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so they may serve me as priests.

verses.textZh: 他们要拿金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻去做。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要拿金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻去做。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并细麻去做。
verses.textEnNiv: Have them use gold, and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall receive gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall take the gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and the fine linen,
verses.textEnNlt: So give them fine linen cloth, gold thread, and blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall take the gold, the violet, the purple, the scarlet material, and the fine linen.
verses.textEn: Have them use gold, and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.

verses.textZh: "他们要拿金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻，用巧工来做以弗得。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们要拿金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻，用巧工来做以弗得。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他们要拿金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻，用巧匠的手工做以弗得。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen—the work of skilled hands.
verses.textEnEsv: "And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and of fine twined linen, skillfully worked.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen, artistically worked.
verses.textEnNlt: "The craftsmen must make the ephod of finely woven linen and skillfully embroider it with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
verses.textEnNasb: "They shall also make the ephod of gold, of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen, the work of the skilled embroiderer.
verses.textEn: "Make the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen—the work of skilled hands.

verses.textZh: 以弗得要有两条肩带，连接着两端，好使它相连在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以弗得要有两条肩带，连接着两端，好使它相连在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 以弗得当有两条肩带，接上两头，使它相连。
verses.textEnNiv: It is to have two shoulder pieces attached to two of its corners, so it can be fastened.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached to its two edges, so that it may be joined together.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall have two shoulder straps joined at its two edges, and so it shall be joined together.
verses.textEnNlt: It will consist of two pieces, front and back, joined at the shoulders with two shoulder-pieces.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall have two shoulder pieces joined to its two ends, so that it may be joined.
verses.textEn: It is to have two shoulder pieces attached to two of its corners, so it can be fastened.

verses.textZh: 以弗得上面的带子，它的巧工要和以弗得一样，用来束上以弗得，要用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以弗得上面的带子，它的巧工要和以弗得一样，用来束上以弗得，要用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做成。
verses.textZhCuv: 其上巧工织的带子，要和以弗得一样的做法，用以束上，与以弗得接连一块，要用金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做成。
verses.textEnNiv: Its skillfully woven waistband is to be like it—of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen.
verses.textEnEsv: And the skillfully woven band on it shall be made like it and be of one piece with it, of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the intricately woven band of the ephod, which is on it, shall be of the same workmanship, madeof gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen.
verses.textEnNlt: The decorative sash will be made of the same materials: finely woven linen embroidered with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
verses.textEnNasb: The skillfully woven band of its overlay, which is on it, shall be like its workmanship, of the same material: of gold, of violet and purple and scarlet material and fine twisted linen.
verses.textEn: Its skillfully woven waistband is to be like it—of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen.

verses.textZh: 你要取两块红宝石，把以色列众子的名字刻在上面，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要取两块红宝石，把以色列众子的名字刻在上面，
verses.textZhCuv: 要取两块红玛瑙，在上面刻以色列儿子的名字：
verses.textEnNiv: "Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel
verses.textEnEsv: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then you shall take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: "Take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel,
verses.textEn: "Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel

verses.textZh: 六个名字在一块宝石上，其余六个名字在另一块宝石上，都是照着他们出生的次序。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六个名字在一块宝石上，其余六个名字在另一块宝石上，都是照着他们出生的次序。
verses.textZhCuv: 六个名字在这块宝石上，六个名字在那块宝石上，都照他们生来的次序。
verses.textEnNiv: in the order of their birth—six names on one stone and the remaining six on the other.
verses.textEnEsv: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the remaining six on the other stone, in the order of their birth.
verses.textEnNkjv: six of their names on one stone and six names on the other stone, in order of their birth.
verses.textEnNlt: Six names will be on each stone, arranged in the order of the births of the original sons of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: six of their names on the one stone and the names of the remaining six on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.textEn: in the order of their birth—six names on one stone and the remaining six on the other.

verses.textZh: 好象宝石雕刻匠刻印章一样，你要把以色列众子的名字刻在这两块宝石上，要把它们镶嵌在金槽中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好象宝石雕刻匠刻印章一样，你要把以色列众子的名字刻在这两块宝石上，要把它们镶嵌在金槽中。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用刻宝石的手工，仿佛刻图书，按着以色列儿子的名字，刻这两块宝石，要镶在金槽上。
verses.textEnNiv: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings
verses.textEnEsv: As a jeweler engraves signets, so shall you engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel. You shall enclose them in settings of gold filigree.
verses.textEnNkjv: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel. You shall set them in settings of gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Engrave these names on the two stones in the same way a jeweler engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in settings of gold filigree.
verses.textEnNasb: As a jeweler engraves a signet, you shall engrave the two stones according to the names of the sons of Israel; you shall set them in filigree settings of gold.
verses.textEn: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings

verses.textZh: 你要把这两块宝石安放在以弗得的肩带上，作以色列民的记念石。亚伦在耶和华面前，用两肩担当他们的名字，作为记念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这两块宝石安放在以弗得的肩带上，作以色列民的记念石。亚伦在耶和华面前，用两肩担当他们的名字，作为记念。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人做纪念石。亚伦要在两肩上担他们的名字，在耶和华面前作为纪念。
verses.textEnNiv: and fasten them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear the names on his shoulders as a memorial before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, as stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel. And Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord on his two shoulders for remembrance.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall put the two stones on the shoulders of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. So Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord on his two shoulders as a memorial.
verses.textEnNlt: Fasten the two stones on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod as a reminder that Aaron represents the people of Israel. Aaron will carry these names on his shoulders as a constant reminder whenever he goes before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall put the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, as stones of memorial for the sons of Israel, and Aaron shall carry their names before the Lord on his two shoulders as a memorial.
verses.textEn: and fasten them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear the names on his shoulders as a memorial before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你要做金槽，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要做金槽，
verses.textZhCuv: 要用金子做二槽，
verses.textEnNiv: Make gold filigree settings
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make settings of gold filigree,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall also make settings of gold,
verses.textEnNlt: Make the settings of gold filigree,
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make filigree settings of gold,
verses.textEn: Make gold filigree settings

verses.textZh: 和两条纯金的链子，像做绳子一样拧成，把这像绳子一样的链子放置在二槽上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和两条纯金的链子，像做绳子一样拧成，把这像绳子一样的链子放置在二槽上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又拿精金，用拧工仿佛拧绳子，做两条链子，把这拧成的链子搭在二槽上。」
verses.textEnNiv: and two braided chains of pure gold, like a rope, and attach the chains to the settings.
verses.textEnEsv: and two chains of pure gold, twisted like cords; and you shall attach the corded chains to the settings.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you shall make two chains of pure gold like braided cords, and fasten the braided chains to the settings.
verses.textEnNlt: then braid two cords of pure gold and attach them to the filigree settings on the shoulders of the ephod.
verses.textEnNasb: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them of twisted cord work, and you shall put the corded chains on the filigree settings.
verses.textEn: and two braided chains of pure gold, like a rope, and attach the chains to the settings.

verses.textZh: "你要用巧工做一个作判断用的胸牌，像以弗得的做法一样，要用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做成。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用巧工做一个作判断用的胸牌，像以弗得的做法一样，要用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做成。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用巧匠的手工做一个决断的胸牌。要和以弗得一样的做法：用金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做成。
verses.textEnNiv: "Fashion a breastpiece for making decisions—the work of skilled hands. Make it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make a breastpiece of judgment, in skilled work. In the style of the ephod you shall make it—of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen shall you make it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make the breastplate of judgment. Artistically woven according to the workmanship of the ephod you shall make it: of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen, you shall make it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then, with great skill and care, make a chestpiece to be worn for seeking a decision from God. Make it to match the ephod, using finely woven linen embroidered with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall make a breastpiece of judgment, the work of a skilled embroiderer; like the work of the ephod you shall make it: of gold, of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen you shall make it.
verses.textEn: "Fashion a breastpiece for making decisions—the work of skilled hands. Make it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

verses.textZh: 胸牌要四方的，双层的，长二十二公分，宽二十二公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 胸牌要四方的，双层的，长二十二公分，宽二十二公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 这胸牌要四方的，叠为两层，长一虎口，宽一虎口。
verses.textEnNiv: It is to be square—a span long and a span wide—and folded double.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be square and doubled, a span its length and a span its breadth.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be doubled into a square: a span shallbe its length, and a span shallbe its width.
verses.textEnNlt: Make the chestpiece of a single piece of cloth folded to form a pouch nine inches square.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be square and folded double, a span in length and a span in width.
verses.textEn: It is to be square—a span long and a span wide—and folded double.

verses.textZh: 你要在胸牌上面镶上四行宝石：第一行是红宝石、黄玉、翡翠；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在胸牌上面镶上四行宝石：第一行是红宝石、黄玉、翡翠；
verses.textZhCuv: 要在上面镶宝石四行：第一行是红宝石、红璧玺、红玉；
verses.textEnNiv: Then mount four rows of precious stones on it. The first row shall be carnelian, chrysolite and beryl;
verses.textEnEsv: You shall set in it four rows of stones. A row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle shall be the first row;
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall put settings of stones in it, four rows of stones: Thefirst row shallbe a sardius, a topaz, and an emerald; thisshallbe the first row;
verses.textEnNlt: Mount four rows of gemstones on it. The first row will contain a red carnelian, a pale-green peridot, and an emerald.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall mount on it four rows of stones; the first row shall be a row of ruby, topaz, and emerald;
verses.textEn: Then mount four rows of precious stones on it. The first row shall be carnelian, chrysolite and beryl;

verses.textZh: 第二行是绿宝石、蓝宝石、金钢石；
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二行是绿宝石、蓝宝石、金钢石；
verses.textZhCuv: 第二行是绿宝石、蓝宝石、金钢石；
verses.textEnNiv: the second row shall be turquoise, lapis lazuli and emerald;
verses.textEnEsv: and the second row an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;
verses.textEnNkjv: the second row shallbe a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
verses.textEnNlt: The second row will contain a turquoise, a blue lapis lazuli, and a white moonstone.
verses.textEnNasb: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
verses.textEn: the second row shall be turquoise, lapis lazuli and emerald;

verses.textZh: 第三行是黄玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶；
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三行是黄玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶；
verses.textZhCuv: 第三行是紫玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶；
verses.textEnNiv: the third row shall be jacinth, agate and amethyst;
verses.textEnEsv: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.textEnNkjv: the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.textEnNlt: The third row will contain an orange jacinth, an agate, and a purple amethyst.
verses.textEnNasb: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.textEn: the third row shall be jacinth, agate and amethyst;

verses.textZh: 第四行是水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉。这些宝石都是镶在金槽里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第四行是水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉。这些宝石都是镶在金槽里。
verses.textZhCuv: 第四行是水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉。这都要镶在金槽中。
verses.textEnNiv: the fourth row shall be topaz, onyx and jasper. Mount them in gold filigree settings.
verses.textEnEsv: and the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be set in gold filigree.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be set in gold settings.
verses.textEnNlt: The fourth row will contain a blue-green beryl, an onyx, and a green jasper. All these stones will be set in gold filigree.
verses.textEnNasb: and the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper; they shall be set in gold filigree.
verses.textEn: the fourth row shall be topaz, onyx and jasper. Mount them in gold filigree settings.

verses.textZh: 按着以色列众子的名字，这些宝石要有十二块；按着他们的名字刻印章，按他们的名字各代表十二个支派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按着以色列众子的名字，这些宝石要有十二块；按着他们的名字刻印章，按他们的名字各代表十二个支派。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些宝石都要按着以色列十二个儿子的名字，仿佛刻图书，刻十二个支派的名字。
verses.textEnNiv: There are to be twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
verses.textEnEsv: There shall be twelve stones with their names according to the names of the sons of Israel. They shall be like signets, each engraved with its name, for the twelve tribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the stones shall have the names of the sons of Israel, twelve according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, each one with its own name; they shall be according to the twelve tribes.
verses.textEnNlt: Each stone will represent one of the twelve sons of Israel, and the name of that tribe will be engraved on it like a seal.
verses.textEnNasb: The stones shall be engraved according to the names of the sons of Israel: twelve, according to their names; they shall be like the engravings of a signet, each according to his name for the twelve tribes.
verses.textEn: There are to be twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

verses.textZh: 你要在胸牌上做纯金的链子，像做绳子一样拧成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在胸牌上做纯金的链子，像做绳子一样拧成。
verses.textZhCuv: 要在胸牌上用精金拧成如绳的链子。
verses.textEnNiv: "For the breastpiece make braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make for the breastpiece twisted chains like cords, of pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make chains for the breastplate at the end, like braided cords of pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: "To attach the chestpiece to the ephod, make braided cords of pure gold thread.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also make on the breastpiece twisted chains of cord work in pure gold.
verses.textEn: "For the breastpiece make braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

verses.textZh: 你要在胸牌上做两个金环，把这两个金环安在胸牌的两端之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在胸牌上做两个金环，把这两个金环安在胸牌的两端之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 在胸牌上也要做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头。
verses.textEnNiv: Make two gold rings for it and fasten them to two corners of the breastpiece.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make for the breastpiece two rings of gold, and put the two rings on the two edges of the breastpiece.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make two rings of gold for the breastplate, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.textEnNlt: Then make two gold rings and attach them to the top corners of the chestpiece.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make on the breastpiece two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.
verses.textEn: Make two gold rings for it and fasten them to two corners of the breastpiece.

verses.textZh: 你要把那两条金链子穿在胸牌两端的两个环子里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把那两条金链子穿在胸牌两端的两个环子里。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把那两条拧成的金链子，穿过胸牌两头的环子。
verses.textEnNiv: Fasten the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the edges of the breastpiece.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate;
verses.textEnNlt: Tie the two gold cords to the two rings on the chestpiece.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall put the two cords of gold on the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.
verses.textEn: Fasten the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

verses.textZh: 你又要把那两条链子的另两端接在两槽上，连在以弗得前面的肩带上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要把那两条链子的另两端接在两槽上，连在以弗得前面的肩带上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把链子的那两头接在两槽上，安在以弗得前面肩带上。
verses.textEnNiv: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
verses.textEnEsv: The two ends of the two cords you shall attach to the two settings of filigree, and so attach it in front to the shoulder pieces of the ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the other two ends of the two braided chains you shall fasten to the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in the front.
verses.textEnNlt: Tie the other ends of the cords to the gold settings on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall put the other two ends of the two cords on the two filigree settings, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, at the front of it.
verses.textEn: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

verses.textZh: 你又要做两个金环，安在胸牌下边的两端，就是靠近以弗得里面的边缘上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要做两个金环，安在胸牌下边的两端，就是靠近以弗得里面的边缘上。
verses.textZhCuv: 要做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头，在以弗得里面的边上。
verses.textEnNiv: Make two gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make two rings of gold, and put them at the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inside edge next to the ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on the edge of it, which is on the inner side of the ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: Then make two more gold rings and attach them to the inside edges of the chestpiece next to the ephod.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make two rings of gold and place them on the two ends of the breastpiece, on the edge of it, which is toward the inner side of the ephod.
verses.textEn: Make two gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

verses.textZh: 你又要做两个金环，把它们安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下面，靠近相接的地方，在以弗得巧工织成的带子上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要做两个金环，把它们安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下面，靠近相接的地方，在以弗得巧工织成的带子上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要做两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，挨近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。
verses.textEnNiv: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make two rings of gold, and attach them in front to the lower part of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, at its seam above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: And two other rings of gold you shall make, and put them on the two shoulder straps, underneath the ephod toward its front, right at the seam above the intricately woven band of the ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: And make two more gold rings and attach them to the front of the ephod, below the shoulder-pieces, just above the knot where the decorative sash is fastened to the ephod.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make two rings of gold and put them on the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on the front of it close to the place where it is joined, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.textEn: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

verses.textZh: 你要用紫蓝色细线把胸牌的环子系在以弗得的环子上，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织成的带子上，免得胸牌从以弗得上脱下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用紫蓝色细线把胸牌的环子系在以弗得的环子上，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织成的带子上，免得胸牌从以弗得上脱下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用蓝细带子把胸牌的环子与以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不可与以弗得离缝。
verses.textEnNiv: The rings of the breastpiece are to be tied to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband, so that the breastpiece will not swing out from the ephod.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall bind the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, so that it may lie on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, so that the breastpiece shall not come loose from the ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall bind the breastplate by means of its rings to the rings of the ephod, using a blue cord, so that it is above the intricately woven band of the ephod, and so that the breastplate does not come loose from the ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: Then attach the bottom rings of the chestpiece to the rings on the ephod with blue cords. This will hold the chestpiece securely to the ephod above the decorative sash.
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall bind the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a violet cord, so that it will be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastpiece will not come loose from the ephod.
verses.textEn: The rings of the breastpiece are to be tied to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband, so that the breastpiece will not swing out from the ephod.

verses.textZh: 亚伦进入圣所的时候，要把作决断用的胸牌，上面有以色列众子的名字，带在胸前，在耶和华面前常作记念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦进入圣所的时候，要把作决断用的胸牌，上面有以色列众子的名字，带在胸前，在耶和华面前常作记念。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦进圣所的时候，要将决断胸牌，就是刻着以色列儿子名字的，带在胸前，在耶和华面前常作纪念。
verses.textEnNiv: "Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he will bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of decision as a continuing memorial before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of judgment on his heart, when he goes into the Holy Place, to bring them to regular remembrance before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "So Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel on the breastplate of judgment over his heart, when he goes into the holy place, as a memorial before the Lord continually.
verses.textEnNlt: "In this way, Aaron will carry the names of the tribes of Israel on the sacred chestpiece over his heart when he goes into the Holy Place. This will be a continual reminder that he represents the people when he comes before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So Aaron shall carry the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of judgment over his heart when he enters the Holy Place, as a memorial before the Lord continually.
verses.textEn: "Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he will bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of decision as a continuing memorial before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你要把乌陵和土明放在作决断用的胸牌里。亚伦进入耶和华面前的时候，它们要带在胸前；这样，亚伦就在耶和华面前常常把以色列众子的决断带在胸前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把乌陵和土明放在作决断用的胸牌里。亚伦进入耶和华面前的时候，它们要带在胸前；这样，亚伦就在耶和华面前常常把以色列众子的决断带在胸前。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要将乌陵和土明放在决断的胸牌里；亚伦进到耶和华面前的时候，要带在胸前，在耶和华面前常将以色列人的决断牌带在胸前。」
verses.textEnNiv: Also put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastpiece, so they may be over Aaron’s heart whenever he enters the presence of the Lord . Thus Aaron will always bear the means of making decisions for the Israelites over his heart before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And in the breastpiece of judgment you shall put the Urim and the Thummim, and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the Lord . Thus Aaron shall bear the judgment of the people of Israel on his heart before the Lord regularly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim, and they shall be over Aaron’s heart when he goes in before the Lord. So Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel over his heart before the Lord continually.
verses.textEnNlt: Insert the Urim and Thummim into the sacred chestpiece so they will be carried over Aaron’s heart when he goes into the Lord ’s presence. In this way, Aaron will always carry over his heart the objects used to determine the Lord ’s will for his people whenever he goes in before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall put in the breastpiece of judgment the Urim and the Thummim, and they shall be over Aaron’s heart when he goes in before the Lord; and Aaron shall carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the Lord continually.
verses.textEn: Also put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastpiece, so they may be over Aaron’s heart whenever he enters the presence of the Lord . Thus Aaron will always bear the means of making decisions for the Israelites over his heart before the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你要做以弗得的长外袍，全件要紫蓝色。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要做以弗得的长外袍，全件要紫蓝色。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要做以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.textEnNlt: "Make the robe that is worn with the ephod from a single piece of blue cloth,
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall make the robe of the ephod all of violet.
verses.textEn: "Make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,

verses.textZh: 在长外袍的正中，头部的地方，要有一个领口，领口的周围要有领边，是用纺织的细工织成，如同战袍的领口一样，免得长外袍破裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在长外袍的正中，头部的地方，要有一个领口，领口的周围要有领边，是用纺织的细工织成，如同战袍的领口一样，免得长外袍破裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 袍上要为头留一领口，口的周围织出领边来，仿佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。
verses.textEnNiv: with an opening for the head in its center. There shall be a woven edge like a collar around this opening, so that it will not tear.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall have an opening for the head in the middle of it, with a woven binding around the opening, like the opening in a garment, so that it may not tear.
verses.textEnNkjv: There shall be an opening for his head in the middle of it; it shall have a woven binding all around its opening, like the opening in a coat of mail, so that it does not tear.
verses.textEnNlt: with an opening for Aaron’s head in the middle of it. Reinforce the opening with a woven collar so it will not tear.
verses.textEnNasb: There shall be an opening at its top in the middle of it; around its opening there shall be a binding of woven work, like the opening of a coat of mail, so that it will not be torn.
verses.textEn: with an opening for the head in its center. There shall be a woven edge like a collar around this opening, so that it will not tear.

verses.textZh: 在长外袍下襬的周围，你要用蓝色紫色朱红色线做石榴，在长外袍下襬周围的石榴中间，要缀上金铃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在长外袍下襬的周围，你要用蓝色紫色朱红色线做石榴，在长外袍下襬周围的石榴中间，要缀上金铃。
verses.textZhCuv: 袍子周围底边上要用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线做石榴。在袍子周围的石榴中间要有金铃铛：
verses.textEnNiv: Make pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn around the hem of the robe, with gold bells between them.
verses.textEnEsv: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet yarns, around its hem, with bells of gold between them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And upon its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet, all around its hem, and bells of gold between them all around:
verses.textEnNlt: Make pomegranates out of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and attach them to the hem of the robe, with gold bells between them.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make on its hem pomegranates of violet, purple, and scarlet material all around on its hem, and bells of gold between them all around:
verses.textEn: Make pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn around the hem of the robe, with gold bells between them.

verses.textZh: 在长外袍下襬的周围缀上一个金铃、一个石榴、一个金铃、一个石榴，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在长外袍下襬的周围缀上一个金铃、一个石榴、一个金铃、一个石榴，
verses.textZhCuv: 一个金铃铛一个石榴，一个金铃铛一个石榴，在袍子周围的底边上。
verses.textEnNiv: The gold bells and the pomegranates are to alternate around the hem of the robe.
verses.textEnEsv: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
verses.textEnNkjv: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe all around.
verses.textEnNlt: The gold bells and pomegranates are to alternate all around the hem.
verses.textEnNasb: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, all around on the hem of the robe.
verses.textEn: The gold bells and the pomegranates are to alternate around the hem of the robe.

verses.textZh: 长外袍要穿在亚伦的身上，好作事奉。他进入圣所到耶和华面前，以及出来的时候，他的声音必被听见，免得他死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 长外袍要穿在亚伦的身上，好作事奉。他进入圣所到耶和华面前，以及出来的时候，他的声音必被听见，免得他死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦供职的时候要穿这袍子。他进圣所到耶和华面前，以及出来的时候，袍上的响声必被听见，使他不至于死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron must wear it when he ministers. The sound of the bells will be heard when he enters the Holy Place before the Lord and when he comes out, so that he will not die.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be on Aaron when he ministers, and its sound shall be heard when he goes into the Holy Place before the Lord , and when he comes out, so that he does not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be upon Aaron when he ministers, and its sound will be heard when he goes into the holy place before the Lord and when he comes out, that he may not die.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron will wear this robe whenever he ministers before the Lord , and the bells will tinkle as he goes in and out of the Lord ’s presence in the Holy Place. If he wears it, he will not die.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be on Aaron when he ministers; and its sound shall be heard when he enters and leaves the Holy Place before the Lord, so that he will not die.
verses.textEn: Aaron must wear it when he ministers. The sound of the bells will be heard when he enters the Holy Place before the Lord and when he comes out, so that he will not die.

verses.textZh: "你要用精金做一面牌子，在牌上像刻印章般刻着：‘归耶和华为圣’。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用精金做一面牌子，在牌上像刻印章般刻着：‘归耶和华为圣’。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用精金做一面牌，在上面按刻图书之法刻着『归耶和华为圣』。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: holy to the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet, ‘Holy to the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet: HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.textEnNlt: "Next make a medallion of pure gold, and engrave it like a seal with these words: Holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘Holy to the Lord.’
verses.textEn: "Make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: holy to the Lord.

verses.textZh: 你要用一条紫蓝色细线把牌子系住，好使它安在礼冠上，就是在礼冠的前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用一条紫蓝色细线把牌子系住，好使它安在礼冠上，就是在礼冠的前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用一条蓝细带子将牌系在冠冕的前面。
verses.textEnNiv: Fasten a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban; it is to be on the front of the turban.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall fasten it on the turban by a cord of blue. It shall be on the front of the turban.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall put it on a blue cord, that it may be on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
verses.textEnNlt: Attach the medallion with a blue cord to the front of Aaron’s turban, where it must remain.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall fasten it on a violet cord, and it shall be on the turban; it shall be at the front of the turban.
verses.textEn: Fasten a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban; it is to be on the front of the turban.

verses.textZh: 这牌要在亚伦的额上，亚伦要担当干犯圣物的罪过，这些圣物是以色列人在一切圣礼物上分别为圣的；这牌要常在亚伦的额上，好使他们在耶和华面前可以得蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这牌要在亚伦的额上，亚伦要担当干犯圣物的罪过，这些圣物是以色列人在一切圣礼物上分别为圣的；这牌要常在亚伦的额上，好使他们在耶和华面前可以得蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 这牌必在亚伦的额上，亚伦要担当干犯圣物条例的罪孽；这圣物是以色列人在一切的圣礼物上所分别为圣的。这牌要常在他的额上，使他们可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be on Aaron’s forehead, and he will bear the guilt involved in the sacred gifts the Israelites consecrate, whatever their gifts may be. It will be on Aaron’s forehead continually so that they will be acceptable to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear any guilt from the holy things that the people of Israel consecrate as their holy gifts. It shall regularly be on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So it shall be on Aaron’s forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things which the children of Israel hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall always be on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron must wear it on his forehead so he may take on himself any guilt of the people of Israel when they consecrate their sacred offerings. He must always wear it on his forehead so the Lord will accept the people.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall take away the guilt of the holy things which the sons of Israel consecrate, regarding all their holy gifts; and it shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be accepted before the Lord.
verses.textEn: It will be on Aaron’s forehead, and he will bear the guilt involved in the sacred gifts the Israelites consecrate, whatever their gifts may be. It will be on Aaron’s forehead continually so that they will be acceptable to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你要用细麻线编织杂色内袍，用细麻布做礼冠，又用刺绣的手工做腰带。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用细麻线编织杂色内袍，用细麻布做礼冠，又用刺绣的手工做腰带。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用杂色细麻线织内袍，用细麻布做冠冕，又用绣花的手工做腰带。
verses.textEnNiv: "Weave the tunic of fine linen and make the turban of fine linen. The sash is to be the work of an embroiderer.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall weave the coat in checker work of fine linen, and you shall make a turban of fine linen, and you shall make a sash embroidered with needlework.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall skillfully weave the tunic of fine linen thread, you shall make the turban of fine linen, and you shall make the sash of woven work.
verses.textEnNlt: "Weave Aaron’s patterned tunic from fine linen cloth. Fashion the turban from this linen as well. Also make a sash, and decorate it with colorful embroidery.
verses.textEnNasb: "And you shall weave the tunic of checkered work of fine linen, and shall make a turban of fine linen, and you shall make a sash, the work of a weaver.
verses.textEn: "Weave the tunic of fine linen and make the turban of fine linen. The sash is to be the work of an embroiderer.

verses.textZh: "你也要为亚伦的儿子做内袍，为他们做腰带，又为他们做头巾，使他们有荣耀，有华美。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你也要为亚伦的儿子做内袍，为他们做腰带，又为他们做头巾，使他们有荣耀，有华美。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要为亚伦的儿子做内袍、腰带、裹头巾，为荣耀，为华美。
verses.textEnNiv: Make tunics, sashes and caps for Aaron’s sons to give them dignity and honor.
verses.textEnEsv: "For Aaron’s sons you shall make coats and sashes and caps. You shall make them for glory and beauty.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For Aaron’s sons you shall make tunics, and you shall make sashes for them. And you shall make hats for them, for glory and beauty.
verses.textEnNlt: "For Aaron’s sons, make tunics, sashes, and special head coverings that are glorious and beautiful.
verses.textEnNasb: "For Aaron’s sons you shall also make tunics; you shall also make sashes for them, and you shall make caps for them, for glory and for beauty.
verses.textEn: Make tunics, sashes and caps for Aaron’s sons to give them dignity and honor.

verses.textZh: 你要把这些给你哥哥亚伦和他的儿子们穿上，又要膏抹他们，按立他们，把他们分别为圣，好使他们可以作我的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这些给你哥哥亚伦和他的儿子们穿上，又要膏抹他们，按立他们，把他们分别为圣，好使他们可以作我的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把这些给你的哥哥亚伦和他的儿子穿戴，又要膏他们，将他们分别为圣，好给我供祭司的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: After you put these clothes on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint and ordain them. Consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them and ordain them and consecrate them, that they may serve me as priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall put them on Aaron your brother and on his sons with him. You shall anoint them, consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to Me as priests.
verses.textEnNlt: Clothe your brother, Aaron, and his sons with these garments, and then anoint and ordain them. Consecrate them so they can serve as my priests.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall put them on Aaron your brother and on his sons with him; and you shall anoint them and ordain them and consecrate them, so that they may serve Me as priests.
verses.textEn: After you put these clothes on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint and ordain them. Consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

verses.textZh: 你要给他们做白麻布裤子，遮盖裸体，裤子遮盖腰间，直到大腿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要给他们做白麻布裤子，遮盖裸体，裤子遮盖腰间，直到大腿。
verses.textZhCuv: 要给他们做细麻布裤子，遮掩下体；裤子当从腰达到大腿。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make linen undergarments as a covering for the body, reaching from the waist to the thigh.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make for them linen undergarments to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the hips to the thighs;
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make for them linen trousers to cover their nakedness; they shall reach from the waist to the thighs.
verses.textEnNlt: Also make linen undergarments for them, to be worn next to their bodies, reaching from their hips to their thighs.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make for them linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh; they shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.
verses.textEn: "Make linen undergarments as a covering for the body, reaching from the waist to the thigh.

verses.textZh: 亚伦和他儿子进入会幕，或走近祭坛，在圣所里事奉的时候，都必须穿上裤子，免得他们担当罪过而死。这要给亚伦和他的后裔作永远的条例。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦和他儿子进入会幕，或走近祭坛，在圣所里事奉的时候，都必须穿上裤子，免得他们担当罪过而死。这要给亚伦和他的后裔作永远的条例。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦和他儿子进入会幕，或就近坛，在圣所供职的时候必穿上，免得担罪而死。这要为亚伦和他的后裔作永远的定例。」
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the tent of meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. "This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants.
verses.textEnEsv: and they shall be on Aaron and on his sons when they go into the tent of meeting or when they come near the altar to minister in the Holy Place, lest they bear guilt and die. This shall be a statute forever for him and for his offspring after him.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons when they come into the tabernacle of meeting, or when they come near the altar to minister in the holy place, that they do not incur iniquity and die. Itshallbe a statute forever to him and his descendants after him.
verses.textEnNlt: These must be worn whenever Aaron and his sons enter the Tabernacle or approach the altar in the Holy Place to perform their priestly duties. Then they will not incur guilt and die. This is a permanent law for Aaron and all his descendants after him.
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall be on Aaron and on his sons when they enter the tent of meeting, or when they approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they do not incur guilt and die. It shall be a statute forever to him and to his descendants after him.
verses.textEn: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the tent of meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. "This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants.

verses.textZh: "你要把他们分别为圣，使他们作我的祭司，就必须这样作：取一头小公牛和两只没有残疾的公绵羊，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把他们分别为圣，使他们作我的祭司，就必须这样作：取一头小公牛和两只没有残疾的公绵羊，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你使亚伦和他儿子成圣，给我供祭司的职分，要如此行：取一只公牛犊，两只无残疾的公绵羊，
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what you are to do to consecrate them, so they may serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now this is what you shall do to them to consecrate them, that they may serve me as priests. Take one bull of the herd and two rams without blemish,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And this is what you shall do to them to hallow them for ministering to Me as priests: Take one young bull and two rams without blemish,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is the ceremony you must follow when you consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now this is what you shall do to them to consecrate them to serve as priests to Me: take one bull and two rams without blemish,
verses.textEn: "This is what you are to do to consecrate them, so they may serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without defect.

verses.textZh: 以及无酵饼、调油的无酵饼和抹油的无酵薄饼。这些你都要用细麦面来做。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及无酵饼、调油的无酵饼和抹油的无酵薄饼。这些你都要用细麦面来做。
verses.textZhCuv: 无酵饼和调油的无酵饼，与抹油的无酵薄饼；这都要用细麦面做成。
verses.textEnNiv: And from the finest wheat flour make round loaves without yeast, thick loaves without yeast and with olive oil mixed in, and thin loaves without yeast and brushed with olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: and unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers smeared with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.
verses.textEnNkjv: and unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil (you shall make them of wheat flour).
verses.textEnNlt: Then, using choice wheat flour and no yeast, make loaves of bread, thin cakes mixed with olive oil, and wafers spread with oil.
verses.textEnNasb: and unleavened bread and unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil; you shall make them of fine wheat flour.
verses.textEn: And from the finest wheat flour make round loaves without yeast, thick loaves without yeast and with olive oil mixed in, and thin loaves without yeast and brushed with olive oil.

verses.textZh: 你要把这些饼放在篮子里，用篮子把饼带来献上，又把小公牛和两只绵羊牵来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这些饼放在篮子里，用篮子把饼带来献上，又把小公牛和两只绵羊牵来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这饼要装在一个筐子里，连筐子带来，又把公牛和两只公绵羊牵来。
verses.textEnNiv: Put them in a basket and present them along with the bull and the two rams.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall put them in one basket and bring them in the basket, and bring the bull and the two rams.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall put them in one basket and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.
verses.textEnNlt: Place them all in a single basket, and present them at the entrance of the Tabernacle, along with the young bull and the two rams.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall put them in one basket, and present them in the basket along with the bull and the two rams.
verses.textEn: Put them in a basket and present them along with the bull and the two rams.

verses.textZh: 你要把亚伦和他儿子们带到会幕门口，用水给他们洗身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把亚伦和他儿子们带到会幕门口，用水给他们洗身。
verses.textZhCuv: 要使亚伦和他儿子到会幕门口来，用水洗身。
verses.textEnNiv: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And Aaron and his sons you shall bring to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and you shall wash them with water.
verses.textEnNlt: "Present Aaron and his sons at the entrance of the Tabernacle, and wash them with water.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doorway of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
verses.textEn: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

verses.textZh: 你要拿衣服来，给亚伦穿上杂色内袍、以弗得的长外袍、以弗得和胸牌，又束上巧工织成的以弗得的带子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要拿衣服来，给亚伦穿上杂色内袍、以弗得的长外袍、以弗得和胸牌，又束上巧工织成的以弗得的带子。
verses.textZhCuv: 要给亚伦穿上内袍和以弗得的外袍，并以弗得，又带上胸牌，束上以弗得巧工织的带子。
verses.textEnNiv: Take the garments and dress Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself and the breastpiece. Fasten the ephod on him by its skillfully woven waistband.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the coat and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastpiece, and gird him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall take the garments, put the tunic on Aaron, and the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the intricately woven band of the ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: Dress Aaron in his priestly garments—the tunic, the robe worn with the ephod, the ephod itself, and the chestpiece. Then wrap the decorative sash of the ephod around him.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod and the breastpiece, and wrap his waist with the skillfully woven band of the ephod;
verses.textEn: Take the garments and dress Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself and the breastpiece. Fasten the ephod on him by its skillfully woven waistband.

verses.textZh: 你要把礼冠戴在他头上，又把圣冠放在礼冠上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把礼冠戴在他头上，又把圣冠放在礼冠上。
verses.textZhCuv: 把冠冕戴在他头上，将圣冠加在冠冕上，
verses.textEnNiv: Put the turban on his head and attach the sacred emblem to the turban.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set the turban on his head and put the holy crown on the turban.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall put the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.
verses.textEnNlt: Place the turban on his head, and fasten the sacred medallion to the turban.
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall set the turban on his head and put the holy crown on the turban.
verses.textEn: Put the turban on his head and attach the sacred emblem to the turban.

verses.textZh: 你要把膏油拿来，倒在他头上，膏立他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把膏油拿来，倒在他头上，膏立他。
verses.textZhCuv: 就把膏油倒在他头上膏他。
verses.textEnNiv: Take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall take the anointing oil and pour it on his head and anoint him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take the anointing oil, pour it on his head, and anoint him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then anoint him by pouring the anointing oil over his head.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall take the anointing oil and pour it on his head, and anoint him.
verses.textEn: Take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.

verses.textZh: 你也要把他的儿子带来，给他们穿上杂色内袍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要把他的儿子带来，给他们穿上杂色内袍。
verses.textZhCuv: 要叫他的儿子来，给他们穿上内袍。
verses.textEnNiv: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall bring his sons and put coats on them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall bring his sons and put tunics on them.
verses.textEnNlt: Next present his sons, and dress them in their tunics.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also bring his sons and put tunics on them.
verses.textEn: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics

verses.textZh: 要给亚伦和他儿子束上腰带，包上头巾；这样，他们就按永远的定例，得了祭司的职分。你又要把亚伦和他儿子们分别为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要给亚伦和他儿子束上腰带，包上头巾；这样，他们就按永远的定例，得了祭司的职分。你又要把亚伦和他儿子们分别为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 给亚伦和他儿子束上腰带，包上裹头巾，他们就凭永远的定例得了祭司的职任。又要将亚伦和他儿子分别为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: and fasten caps on them. Then tie sashes on Aaron and his sons. The priesthood is theirs by a lasting ordinance. "Then you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall gird Aaron and his sons with sashes and bind caps on them. And the priesthood shall be theirs by a statute forever. Thus you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall gird them with sashes, Aaron and his sons, and put the hats on them. The priesthood shall be theirs for a perpetual statute. So you shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.
verses.textEnNlt: Wrap the sashes around the waists of Aaron and his sons, and put their special head coverings on them. Then the right to the priesthood will be theirs by law forever. In this way, you will ordain Aaron and his sons.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall wrap their waists with sashes, Aaron and his sons, and fit caps on them, and they shall have the priesthood by a permanent statute. So you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.
verses.textEn: and fasten caps on them. Then tie sashes on Aaron and his sons. The priesthood is theirs by a lasting ordinance. "Then you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.

verses.textZh: "你要把公牛带到会幕来献上，亚伦和他儿子们要按手在公牛的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把公牛带到会幕来献上，亚伦和他儿子们要按手在公牛的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要把公牛牵到会幕前，亚伦和他儿子要按手在公牛的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Bring the bull to the front of the tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then you shall bring the bull before the tent of meeting. Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also have the bull brought before the tabernacle of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands on the head of the bull.
verses.textEnNlt: "Bring the young bull to the entrance of the Tabernacle, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you shall bring the bull in front of the tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.
verses.textEn: "Bring the bull to the front of the tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

verses.textZh: 你要在耶和华面前，在会幕门口，宰杀那公牛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在耶和华面前，在会幕门口，宰杀那公牛。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要在耶和华面前，在会幕门口，宰这公牛。
verses.textEnNiv: Slaughter it in the Lord ’s presence at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall kill the bull before the Lord at the entrance of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall kill the bull before the Lord, by the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Then slaughter the bull in the Lord ’s presence at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall slaughter the bull before the Lord at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: Slaughter it in the Lord ’s presence at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 你要取些公牛的血，用你的指头抹在祭坛的角上，把其余的血都倒在祭坛脚前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要取些公牛的血，用你的指头抹在祭坛的角上，把其余的血都倒在祭坛脚前。
verses.textZhCuv: 要取些公牛的血，用指头抹在坛的四角上，把血都倒在坛脚那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Take some of the bull’s blood and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: and shall take part of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and the rest of the blood you shall pour out at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour all the blood beside the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Put some of its blood on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour out the rest at the base of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.textEn: Take some of the bull’s blood and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.

verses.textZh: 你要把一切遮盖内脏的脂油、肝叶、两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，都取出来，把它们焚烧在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把一切遮盖内脏的脂油、肝叶、两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，都取出来，把它们焚烧在祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把一切盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then take all the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall take all the fat that covers the entrails, and the long lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take all the fat that covers the entrails, the fatty lobe attached to the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Take all the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat around them, and burn it all on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall take all the fat that covers the entrails, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, and offer them up in smoke on the altar.
verses.textEn: Then take all the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.

verses.textZh: 至于公牛的肉、皮和粪，你都要在营外用火焚化。因为这是赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于公牛的肉、皮和粪，你都要在营外用火焚化。因为这是赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是公牛的皮、肉、粪都要用火烧在营外。这牛是赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: But burn the bull’s flesh and its hide and its intestines outside the camp. It is a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: But the flesh of the bull and its skin and its dung you shall burn with fire outside the camp; it is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the flesh of the bull, with its skin and its offal, you shall burn with fire outside the camp. It is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Then take the rest of the bull, including its hide, meat, and dung, and burn it outside the camp as a sin offering.
verses.textEnNasb: But the flesh of the bull and its hide and its refuse, you shall burn with fire outside the camp; it is a sin offering.
verses.textEn: But burn the bull’s flesh and its hide and its intestines outside the camp. It is a sin offering.

verses.textZh: "你要把一只公绵羊牵来，亚伦和他儿子们要按手在这公绵羊的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把一只公绵羊牵来，亚伦和他儿子们要按手在这公绵羊的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要牵一只公绵羊来，亚伦和他儿子要按手在这羊的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then you shall take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also take one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands on the head of the ram;
verses.textEnNlt: "Next Aaron and his sons must lay their hands on the head of one of the rams.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram;
verses.textEn: "Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

verses.textZh: 你要宰杀这公绵羊，取些羊血，洒在祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要宰杀这公绵羊，取些羊血，洒在祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 要宰这羊，把血洒在坛的周围。
verses.textEnNiv: Slaughter it and take the blood and splash it against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall kill the ram and shall take its blood and throw it against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood and sprinkle it all around on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then slaughter the ram, and splatter its blood against all sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall slaughter the ram and take its blood and sprinkle it around on the altar.
verses.textEn: Slaughter it and take the blood and splash it against the sides of the altar.

verses.textZh: 你要把公绵羊切成块子，再把内脏和羊腿洗净，放在肉块和羊头上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把公绵羊切成块子，再把内脏和羊腿洗净，放在肉块和羊头上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把羊切成块子，洗净五脏和腿，连块子带头，都放在一处。
verses.textEnNiv: Cut the ram into pieces and wash the internal organs and the legs, putting them with the head and the other pieces.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall cut the ram into pieces, and wash its entrails and its legs, and put them with its pieces and its head,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall cut the ram in pieces, wash its entrails and its legs, and put them with its pieces and with its head.
verses.textEnNlt: Cut the ram into pieces, and wash off the internal organs and the legs. Set them alongside the head and the other pieces of the body,
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its entrails and its legs, and put them with its pieces and its head.
verses.textEn: Cut the ram into pieces and wash the internal organs and the legs, putting them with the head and the other pieces.

verses.textZh: 你要把整只公绵羊焚烧在祭坛上；这是献给耶和华的燔祭，是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把整只公绵羊焚烧在祭坛上；这是献给耶和华的燔祭，是献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把全羊烧在坛上，是给耶和华献的燔祭，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then burn the entire ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the Lord , a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and burn the whole ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the Lord . It is a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall burn the whole ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the Lord; it is a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: then burn the entire animal on the altar. This is a burnt offering to the Lord ; it is a pleasing aroma, a special gift presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall offer up in smoke the whole ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the Lord: it is a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then burn the entire ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the Lord , a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你要把另一只公绵羊也牵来，亚伦和他儿子们要按手在这公绵羊的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把另一只公绵羊也牵来，亚伦和他儿子们要按手在这公绵羊的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要将那一只公绵羊牵来，亚伦和他儿子要按手在羊的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram,
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now take the other ram, and have Aaron and his sons lay their hands on its head.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.textEn: "Take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

verses.textZh: 你要宰杀这公绵羊，取些血，抹在亚伦的右耳垂上，以及他儿子们的右耳垂上，又抹在他们右手的大拇指上，和他们右脚的大拇趾上；并且要把血洒在祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要宰杀这公绵羊，取些血，抹在亚伦的右耳垂上，以及他儿子们的右耳垂上，又抹在他们右手的大拇指上，和他们右脚的大拇趾上；并且要把血洒在祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要宰这羊，取点血抹在亚伦的右耳垂上和他儿子的右耳垂上，又抹在他们右手的大拇指上和右脚的大拇指上；并要把血洒在坛的四围。
verses.textEnNiv: Slaughter it, take some of its blood and put it on the lobes of the right ears of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then splash blood against the sides of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall kill the ram and take part of its blood and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron and on the tips of the right ears of his sons, and on the thumbs of their right hands and on the great toes of their right feet, and throw the rest of the blood against the sides of the altar.
