verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood all around on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then slaughter it, and apply some of its blood to the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons. Also put it on the thumbs of their right hands and the big toes of their right feet. Splatter the rest of the blood against all sides of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall slaughter the ram, and take some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear and on the lobes of his sons’ right ears, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet, and sprinkle the rest of the blood around on the altar.
verses.textEn: Slaughter it, take some of its blood and put it on the lobes of the right ears of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then splash blood against the sides of the altar.

verses.textZh: 你要从坛上取一点血，也取一点膏油，弹在亚伦身上和他的衣服上，并且要弹在他儿子的身上和他们的衣服上。这样，他和他的衣服，他儿子和他们的衣服就都一同成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要从坛上取一点血，也取一点膏油，弹在亚伦身上和他的衣服上，并且要弹在他儿子的身上和他们的衣服上。这样，他和他的衣服，他儿子和他们的衣服就都一同成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要取点膏油和坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子和他儿子的衣服上，他们和他们的衣服就一同成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: And take some blood from the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. Then he and his sons and their garments will be consecrated.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall take part of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, and on his sons and his sons’ garments with him. He and his garments shall be holy, and his sons and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take some of the blood that is on the altar, and some of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and on his garments, on his sons and on the garments of his sons with him; and he and his garments shall be hallowed, and his sons and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then take some of the blood from the altar and some of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his sons and on their garments. In this way, they and their garments will be set apart as holy.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall take some of the blood that is on the altar and some of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and on his garments, and on his sons and on his sons’ garments with him; so he and his garments shall be consecrated, as well as his sons and his sons’ garments with him.
verses.textEn: And take some blood from the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. Then he and his sons and their garments will be consecrated.

verses.textZh: 你要从这公绵羊身上取出脂油和肥尾巴，遮盖内脏的脂油和肝叶、两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，以及右腿，因为这是授圣职的时候，所要献的公绵羊，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要从这公绵羊身上取出脂油和肥尾巴，遮盖内脏的脂油和肝叶、两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，以及右腿，因为这是授圣职的时候，所要献的公绵羊，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要取这羊的脂油和肥尾巴，并盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油并右腿（这是承接圣职所献的羊）。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take from this ram the fat, the fat tail, the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh. (This is the ram for the ordination.)
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall also take the fat from the ram and the fat tail and the fat that covers the entrails, and the long lobe of the liver and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of ordination),
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also you shall take the fat of the ram, the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails, the fatty lobe attachedto the liver, the two kidneys and the fat on them, the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),
verses.textEnNlt: "Since this is the ram for the ordination of Aaron and his sons, take the fat of the ram, including the fat of the broad tail, the fat around the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat around them, along with the right thigh.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also take the fat from the ram and the fat tail, and the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of ordination),
verses.textEn: "Take from this ram the fat, the fat tail, the fat on the internal organs, the long lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh. (This is the ram for the ordination.)

verses.textZh: 你要从摆在耶和华面前载无酵饼的篮子里取一个圆饼、一个油饼和一个薄饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要从摆在耶和华面前载无酵饼的篮子里取一个圆饼、一个油饼和一个薄饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 再从耶和华面前装无酵饼的筐子中取一个饼，一个调油的饼和一个薄饼，
verses.textEnNiv: From the basket of bread made without yeast, which is before the Lord , take one round loaf, one thick loaf with olive oil mixed in, and one thin loaf.
verses.textEnEsv: and one loaf of bread and one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: one loaf of bread, one cake madewith oil, and one wafer from the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: Then take one round loaf of bread, one thin cake mixed with olive oil, and one wafer from the basket of bread without yeast that was placed in the Lord ’s presence.
verses.textEnNasb: and one loaf of bread, and one cake of bread mixed with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread which is set before the Lord;
verses.textEn: From the basket of bread made without yeast, which is before the Lord , take one round loaf, one thick loaf with olive oil mixed in, and one thin loaf.

verses.textZh: 你要把这一切都放在亚伦和他儿子的手上；你要在耶和华面前把他们摇动作摇祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这一切都放在亚伦和他儿子的手上；你要在耶和华面前把他们摇动作摇祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 都放在亚伦的手上和他儿子的手上，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
verses.textEnNiv: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and have them wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall put all these on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and wave them for a wave offering before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and you shall put all these in the hands of Aaron and in the hands of his sons, and you shall wave them as a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons to be lifted up as a special offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall put all these in the hands of Aaron and in the hands of his sons, and shall wave them as a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.textEn: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and have them wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.

verses.textZh: 你要从他们手中接过来，向着祭坛把这些东西烧在燔祭之上，在耶和华面前作馨香之气，这是献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要从他们手中接过来，向着祭坛把这些东西烧在燔祭之上，在耶和华面前作馨香之气，这是献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 要从他们手中接过来，烧在耶和华面前坛上的燔祭上，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar along with the burnt offering for a pleasing aroma to the Lord , a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall take them from their hands and burn them on the altar on top of the burnt offering, as a pleasing aroma before the Lord . It is a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall receive them back from their hands and burn them on the altar as a burnt offering, as a sweet aroma before the Lord. It is an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward take the various breads from their hands, and burn them on the altar along with the burnt offering. It is a pleasing aroma to the Lord , a special gift for him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall take them from their hands, and offer them up in smoke on the altar on the burnt offering for a soothing aroma before the Lord; it is an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar along with the burnt offering for a pleasing aroma to the Lord , a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你要取亚伦授圣职的时候，所献的公绵羊的胸，在耶和华面前把它摇动作摇祭，这就是你的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要取亚伦授圣职的时候，所献的公绵羊的胸，在耶和华面前把它摇动作摇祭，这就是你的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要取亚伦承接圣职所献公羊的胸，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，这就可以作你的分。
verses.textEnNiv: After you take the breast of the ram for Aaron’s ordination, wave it before the Lord as a wave offering, and it will be your share.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it for a wave offering before the Lord , and it shall be your portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then you shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration and wave it as a wave offering before the Lord; and it shall be your portion.
verses.textEnNlt: Then take the breast of Aaron’s ordination ram, and lift it up in the Lord ’s presence as a special offering to him. Then keep it as your own portion.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of ordination, and wave it as a wave offering before the Lord; and it shall be your portion.
verses.textEn: After you take the breast of the ram for Aaron’s ordination, wave it before the Lord as a wave offering, and it will be your share.

verses.textZh: 那作摇祭的胸和举祭的腿，你都要使它们成圣，就是亚伦和他儿子授圣职的时候，所献的公绵羊，被摇过被举过的部分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那作摇祭的胸和举祭的腿，你都要使它们成圣，就是亚伦和他儿子授圣职的时候，所献的公绵羊，被摇过被举过的部分。
verses.textZhCuv: 那摇祭的胸和举祭的腿，就是承接圣职所摇的、所举的，是归亚伦和他儿子的。这些你都要成为圣，
verses.textEnNiv: "Consecrate those parts of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons: the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall consecrate the breast of the wave offering that is waved and the thigh of the priests’ portion that is contributed from the ram of ordination, from what was Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the ram of the consecration you shall consecrate the breast of the wave offering which is waved, and the thigh of the heave offering which is raised, of that which is for Aaron and of that which is for his sons.
verses.textEnNlt: "Set aside the portions of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons. This includes the breast and the thigh that were lifted up before the Lord as a special offering.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall consecrate the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution which was waved and which was offered from the ram of ordination, from the one which was for Aaron and from the one which was for his sons.
verses.textEn: "Consecrate those parts of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons: the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented.

verses.textZh: 这要作为亚伦和他儿子们从以色列人所得的分，作为永远的定例，因为这是举祭。这举祭要从以色列人的平安祭中分别出来，归给耶和华作举祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这要作为亚伦和他儿子们从以色列人所得的分，作为永远的定例，因为这是举祭。这举祭要从以色列人的平安祭中分别出来，归给耶和华作举祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 作亚伦和他子孙从以色列人中永远所得的分，因为是举祭。这要从以色列人的平安祭中，作为献给耶和华的举祭。
verses.textEnNiv: This is always to be the perpetual share from the Israelites for Aaron and his sons. It is the contribution the Israelites are to make to the Lord from their fellowship offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as a perpetual due from the people of Israel, for it is a contribution. It shall be a contribution from the people of Israel from their peace offerings, their contribution to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be from the children of Israel for Aaron and his sons by a statute forever. For it is a heave offering; it shall be a heave offering from the children of Israel from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, thatis, their heave offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: In the future, whenever the people of Israel lift up a peace offering, a portion of it must be set aside for Aaron and his descendants. This is their permanent right, and it is a sacred offering from the Israelites to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the sons of Israel, for it is a contribution; and it shall be a contribution from the sons of Israel from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, their contribution to the Lord.
verses.textEn: This is always to be the perpetual share from the Israelites for Aaron and his sons. It is the contribution the Israelites are to make to the Lord from their fellowship offerings.

verses.textZh: "亚伦的圣衣要传给他的子孙，要穿著受膏，也要穿著受圣职。
verses.textZhCnvs: "亚伦的圣衣要传给他的子孙，要穿著受膏，也要穿著受圣职。
verses.textZhCuv: 「亚伦的圣衣要留给他的子孙，可以穿着受膏，又穿着承接圣职。
verses.textEnNiv: "Aaron’s sacred garments will belong to his descendants so that they can be anointed and ordained in them.
verses.textEnEsv: "The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him; they shall be anointed in them and ordained in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed in them and to be consecrated in them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Aaron’s sacred garments must be preserved for his descendants who succeed him, and they will wear them when they are anointed and ordained.
verses.textEnNasb: "The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, so that they may be anointed and ordained in them.
verses.textEn: "Aaron’s sacred garments will belong to his descendants so that they can be anointed and ordained in them.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的子孙中，凡是接替他作祭司的，每逢进入会幕在圣所里事奉的时候，都要穿圣衣七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的子孙中，凡是接替他作祭司的，每逢进入会幕在圣所里事奉的时候，都要穿圣衣七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的子孙接续他当祭司的，每逢进会幕在圣所供职的时候，要穿七天。
verses.textEnNiv: The son who succeeds him as priest and comes to the tent of meeting to minister in the Holy Place is to wear them seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: The son who succeeds him as priest, who comes into the tent of meeting to minister in the Holy Place, shall wear them seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: That son who becomes priest in his place shall put them on for seven days, when he enters the tabernacle of meeting to minister in the holy place.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendant who succeeds him as high priest will wear these clothes for seven days as he ministers in the Tabernacle and the Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days the one of his sons who is priest in his place shall put them on when he enters the tent of meeting to minister in the Holy Place.
verses.textEn: The son who succeeds him as priest and comes to the tent of meeting to minister in the Holy Place is to wear them seven days.

verses.textZh: "你要把授圣职的时候所献的公绵羊取来，在圣洁的地方烧牠的肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把授圣职的时候所献的公绵羊取来，在圣洁的地方烧牠的肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要将承接圣职所献公羊的肉煮在圣处。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the ram for the ordination and cook the meat in a sacred place.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall take the ram of the consecration and boil its flesh in the holy place.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take the ram used in the ordination ceremony, and boil its meat in a sacred place.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you shall take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
verses.textEn: "Take the ram for the ordination and cook the meat in a sacred place.

verses.textZh: 亚伦和他的儿子要在会幕的门口吃这公绵羊的肉和篮子里的饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦和他的儿子要在会幕的门口吃这公绵羊的肉和篮子里的饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦和他儿子要在会幕门口吃这羊的肉和筐内的饼。
verses.textEnNiv: At the entrance to the tent of meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket in the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Aaron and his sons will eat this meat, along with the bread in the basket, at the Tabernacle entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket, at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: At the entrance to the tent of meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.

verses.textZh: 他们要吃那些用来赎罪的东西，好使他们可以接受圣职，可以成圣；只是外人不可吃，因为这些东西是圣物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要吃那些用来赎罪的东西，好使他们可以接受圣职，可以成圣；只是外人不可吃，因为这些东西是圣物。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吃那些赎罪之物，好承接圣职，使他们成圣；只是外人不可吃，因为这是圣物。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to eat these offerings by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no one else may eat them, because they are sacred.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made at their ordination and consecration, but an outsider shall not eat of them, because they are holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall eat those things with which the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them; but an outsider shall not eat them, because they are holy.
verses.textEnNlt: They alone may eat the meat and bread used for their purification in the ordination ceremony. No one else may eat them, for these things are set apart and holy.
verses.textEnNasb: So they shall eat those things by which atonement was made at their ordination and consecration; but a layman shall not eat them, because they are holy.
verses.textEn: They are to eat these offerings by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no one else may eat them, because they are sacred.

verses.textZh: 授圣职的时候所献的肉和饼，如果有一点留到早晨，你要把留下的用火烧了，不可吃，因为这是圣物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 授圣职的时候所献的肉和饼，如果有一点留到早晨，你要把留下的用火烧了，不可吃，因为这是圣物。
verses.textZhCuv: 那承接圣职所献的肉或饼，若有一点留到早晨，就要用火烧了，不可吃这物，因为是圣物。
verses.textEnNiv: And if any of the meat of the ordination ram or any bread is left over till morning, burn it up. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.
verses.textEnEsv: And if any of the flesh for the ordination or of the bread remain until the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if any of the flesh of the consecration offerings, or of the bread, remains until the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.textEnNlt: If any of the ordination meat or bread remains until the morning, it must be burned. It may not be eaten, for it is holy.
verses.textEnNasb: And if any of the flesh of ordination or any of the bread remains until morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire; it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.textEn: And if any of the meat of the ordination ram or any bread is left over till morning, burn it up. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.

verses.textZh: "这样，你要照我吩咐你的，向亚伦和他的儿子行接受圣职的礼七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这样，你要照我吩咐你的，向亚伦和他的儿子行接受圣职的礼七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要这样照我一切所吩咐的，向亚伦和他儿子行承接圣职的礼七天。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do for Aaron and his sons everything I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus you shall do to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. Through seven days shall you ordain them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus you shall do to Aaron and his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. Seven days you shall consecrate them.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is how you will ordain Aaron and his sons to their offices, just as I have commanded you. The ordination ceremony will go on for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: "So you shall do for Aaron and for his sons, according to all that I have commanded you; you shall ordain them for seven days.
verses.textEn: "Do for Aaron and his sons everything I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.

verses.textZh: 你要每天献公牛一头作赎罪祭，用来赎罪；你为祭坛行赎罪祭的时候，你要洁净祭坛。而且你要用膏抹祭坛，使祭坛成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要每天献公牛一头作赎罪祭，用来赎罪；你为祭坛行赎罪祭的时候，你要洁净祭坛。而且你要用膏抹祭坛，使祭坛成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 每天要献公牛一只为赎罪祭。你洁净坛的时候，坛就洁净了；且要用膏抹坛，使坛成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Sacrifice a bull each day as a sin offering to make atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.
verses.textEnEsv: and every day you shall offer a bull as a sin offering for atonement. Also you shall purify the altar, when you make atonement for it, and shall anoint it to consecrate it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall offer a bull every day as a sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it, and you shall anoint it to sanctify it.
verses.textEnNlt: Each day you must sacrifice a young bull as a sin offering to purify them, making them right with the Lord . Afterward, cleanse the altar by purifying it ; make it holy by anointing it with oil.
verses.textEnNasb: Each day you shall offer a bull as a sin offering for atonement, and you shall purify the altar when you make atonement for it, and you shall anoint it to consecrate it.
verses.textEn: Sacrifice a bull each day as a sin offering to make atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.

verses.textZh: 你要为祭坛行赎罪祭七天，也要使它成圣，这样，祭坛就成为至圣；一切触着祭坛的东西，都要成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要为祭坛行赎罪祭七天，也要使它成圣，这样，祭坛就成为至圣；一切触着祭坛的东西，都要成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 要洁净坛七天，使坛成圣，坛就成为至圣。凡挨着坛的都成为圣。」
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will be most holy, and whatever touches it will be holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it, and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall become holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and sanctify it. And the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar must be holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Purify the altar, and consecrate it every day for seven days. After that, the altar will be absolutely holy, and whatever touches it will become holy.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it; then the altar shall be most holy, and whatever touches the altar shall be holy.
verses.textEn: For seven days make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will be most holy, and whatever touches it will be holy.

verses.textZh: "这就是你要献在祭坛的：每天两只一岁的羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这就是你要献在祭坛的：每天两只一岁的羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你每天所要献在坛上的就是两只一岁的羊羔；
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what you are to offer on the altar regularly each day: two lambs a year old.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now this is what you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day regularly.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now this is what you shall offer on the altar: two lambs of the first year, day by day continually.
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the sacrifices you are to offer regularly on the altar. Each day, offer two lambs that are a year old,
verses.textEnNasb: "Now this is what you shall offer on the altar: two one-year-old lambs each day, continuously.
verses.textEn: "This is what you are to offer on the altar regularly each day: two lambs a year old.

verses.textZh: 第一只羊你要在早晨献上；第二只在傍晚的时候献上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一只羊你要在早晨献上；第二只在傍晚的时候献上，
verses.textZhCuv: 早晨要献这一只，黄昏的时候要献那一只。
verses.textEnNiv: Offer one in the morning and the other at twilight.
verses.textEnEsv: One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight.
verses.textEnNkjv: One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight.
verses.textEnNlt: one in the morning and the other in the evening.
verses.textEnNasb: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight;
verses.textEn: Offer one in the morning and the other at twilight.

verses.textZh: 和这一只羊同献的，要用一公斤细面与一公升榨成的油混和，又要用一公升酒作奠祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和这一只羊同献的，要用一公斤细面与一公升榨成的油混和，又要用一公升酒作奠祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 和这一只羊羔同献的，要用细面伊法十分之一与捣成的油一欣四分之一调和，又用酒一欣四分之一作为奠祭。
verses.textEnNiv: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives, and a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And with the first lamb a tenth measure of fine flour mingled with a fourth of a hin of beaten oil, and a fourth of a hin of wine for a drink offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: With the one lamb shall be one-tenth ofanephah of flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil, and one-fourth of a hin of wine as a drink offering.
verses.textEnNlt: With one of them, offer two quarts of choice flour mixed with one quart of pure oil of pressed olives; also, offer one quart of wine as a liquid offering.
verses.textEnNasb: and there shall be a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a fourth of a hin of beaten oil, and a fourth of a hin of wine for a drink offering with one lamb.
verses.textEn: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives, and a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.

verses.textZh: 那另一只羊你要在傍晚的时候献上，照着早晨的素祭和它的奠祭一样办理，作馨香之气，作献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那另一只羊你要在傍晚的时候献上，照着早晨的素祭和它的奠祭一样办理，作馨香之气，作献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 那一只羊羔要在黄昏的时候献上，照着早晨的素祭和奠祭的礼办理，作为献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Sacrifice the other lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and its drink offering as in the morning—a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The other lamb you shall offer at twilight, and shall offer with it a grain offering and its drink offering, as in the morning, for a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the other lamb you shall offer at twilight; and you shall offer with it the grain offering and the drink offering, as in the morning, for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Offer the other lamb in the evening, along with the same offerings of flour and wine as in the morning. It will be a pleasing aroma, a special gift presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The other lamb you shall offer at twilight, and shall offer with it the same grain offering and the same drink offering as in the morning, for a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Sacrifice the other lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and its drink offering as in the morning—a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 这要作你们世世代代常献的燔祭，献在会幕的门口，耶和华的面前，我要在那里与你们相会，在那里和你们说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这要作你们世世代代常献的燔祭，献在会幕的门口，耶和华的面前，我要在那里与你们相会，在那里和你们说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 这要在耶和华面前、会幕门口，作你们世世代代常献的燔祭。我要在那里与你们相会，和你们说话。
verses.textEnNiv: "For the generations to come this burnt offering is to be made regularly at the entrance to the tent of meeting, before the Lord . There I will meet you and speak to you;
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be a regular burnt offering throughout your generations at the entrance of the tent of meeting before the Lord , where I will meet with you, to speak to you there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thisshallbe a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of meeting before the Lord, where I will meet you to speak with you.
verses.textEnNlt: "These burnt offerings are to be made each day from generation to generation. Offer them in the Lord ’s presence at the Tabernacle entrance; there I will meet with you and speak with you.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the doorway of the tent of meeting before the Lord, where I will meet with you, to speak to you there.
verses.textEn: "For the generations to come this burnt offering is to be made regularly at the entrance to the tent of meeting, before the Lord . There I will meet you and speak to you;

verses.textZh: 我要在那里与以色列人相会，会幕就会因我的荣耀被尊为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在那里与以色列人相会，会幕就会因我的荣耀被尊为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在那里与以色列人相会，会幕就要因我的荣耀成为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: there also I will meet with the Israelites, and the place will be consecrated by my glory.
verses.textEnEsv: There I will meet with the people of Israel, and it shall be sanctified by my glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and thetabernacle shall be sanctified by My glory.
verses.textEnNlt: I will meet the people of Israel there, in the place made holy by my glorious presence.
verses.textEnNasb: I will meet there with the sons of Israel, and it shall be consecrated by My glory.
verses.textEn: there also I will meet with the Israelites, and the place will be consecrated by my glory.

verses.textZh: 我要使会幕和祭坛成圣，也要使亚伦和他的儿子成圣，作祭司事奉我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使会幕和祭坛成圣，也要使亚伦和他的儿子成圣，作祭司事奉我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使会幕和坛成圣，也要使亚伦和他的儿子成圣，给我供祭司的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: "So I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar and will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.
verses.textEnEsv: I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar. Aaron also and his sons I will consecrate to serve me as priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will consecrate the tabernacle of meeting and the altar. I will also consecrate both Aaron and his sons to minister to Me as priests.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I will consecrate the Tabernacle and the altar, and I will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar; I will also consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve as priests to Me.
verses.textEn: "So I will consecrate the tent of meeting and the altar and will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.

verses.textZh: 我要住在以色列人中间，我也要作他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要住在以色列人中间，我也要作他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要住在以色列人中间，作他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.
verses.textEnEsv: I will dwell among the people of Israel and will be their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will dwell among the children of Israel and will be their God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will live among the people of Israel and be their God,
verses.textEnNasb: And I will dwell among the sons of Israel and will be their God.
verses.textEn: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.

verses.textZh: 他们必知道我是耶和华他们的神，就是从埃及地把他们领出来的，为要住在他们中间。我是耶和华他们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必知道我是耶和华他们的神，就是从埃及地把他们领出来的，为要住在他们中间。我是耶和华他们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必知道我是耶和华－他们的神，是将他们从埃及地领出来的，为要住在他们中间。我是耶和华－他们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: They will know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt that I might dwell among them. I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them. I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNlt: and they will know that I am the Lord their God. I am the one who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I could live among them. I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God who brought them out of the land of Egypt, so that I might dwell among them; I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEn: They will know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: "你要做一座烧香的坛，你要用皂荚木做这座坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要做一座烧香的坛，你要用皂荚木做这座坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用皂荚木做一座烧香的坛。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall make an altar on which to burn incense; you shall make it of acacia wood.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make an altar to burn incense on; you shall make it of acacia wood.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then make another altar of acacia wood for burning incense.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you shall make an altar as a place for burning incense; you shall make it of acacia wood.
verses.textEn: "Make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.

verses.textZh: 坛要四方的：长四十五公分，宽四十五公分，高九十公分。坛的四角要与坛接连在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 坛要四方的：长四十五公分，宽四十五公分，高九十公分。坛的四角要与坛接连在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 这坛要四方的，长一肘，宽一肘，高二肘；坛的四角要与坛接连一块。
verses.textEnNiv: It is to be square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high —its horns of one piece with it.
verses.textEnEsv: A cubit shall be its length, and a cubit its breadth. It shall be square, and two cubits shall be its height. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: A cubit shallbe its length and a cubit its width—it shall be square—and two cubits shallbe its height. Its horns shallbe of one piece with it.
verses.textEnNlt: Make it 18 inches square and 36 inches high, with horns at the corners carved from the same piece of wood as the altar itself.
verses.textEnNasb: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit; it shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits; its horns shall be of one piece with it.
verses.textEn: It is to be square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high —its horns of one piece with it.

verses.textZh: 你要用纯金把坛包裹，坛顶、坛的四边和坛的四角都要包裹，你要给坛的四围做金牙边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用纯金把坛包裹，坛顶、坛的四边和坛的四角都要包裹，你要给坛的四围做金牙边。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用精金把坛的上面与坛的四围，并坛的四角，包裹；又要在坛的四围镶上金牙边。
verses.textEnNiv: Overlay the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top and around its sides and its horns. And you shall make a molding of gold around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall overlay its top, its sides all around, and its horns with pure gold; and you shall make for it a molding of gold all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Overlay the top, sides, and horns of the altar with pure gold, and run a gold molding around the entire altar.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top and its sides all around, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding all around for it.
verses.textEn: Overlay the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

verses.textZh: 在坛的两旁金牙边以下你要做两个金环，两边都有，用来穿木杠的地方，以便抬坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在坛的两旁金牙边以下你要做两个金环，两边都有，用来穿木杠的地方，以便抬坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 要做两个金环安在牙子边以下，在坛的两旁，两根横撑上，作为穿杠的用处，以便抬坛。
verses.textEnNiv: Make two gold rings for the altar below the molding—two on each of the opposite sides—to hold the poles used to carry it.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make two golden rings for it. Under its molding on two opposite sides of it you shall make them, and they shall be holders for poles with which to carry it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Two gold rings you shall make for it, under the molding on both its sides. You shall place them on its two sides, and they will be holders for the poles with which to bear it.
verses.textEnNlt: Make two gold rings, and attach them on opposite sides of the altar below the gold molding to hold the carrying poles.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also make two gold rings for it under its molding; you shall make them on its two sides—on opposite sides—and they shall be holders for poles with which to carry it.
verses.textEn: Make two gold rings for the altar below the molding—two on each of the opposite sides—to hold the poles used to carry it.

verses.textZh: 你要用皂荚木做木杠，要用金把它们包裹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用皂荚木做木杠，要用金把它们包裹。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用皂荚木做杠，用金包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
verses.textEn: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

verses.textZh: 你要把坛放在法柜前面的幔幕前，面对着法柜上的施恩座，就是我与你相会的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把坛放在法柜前面的幔幕前，面对着法柜上的施恩座，就是我与你相会的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 要把坛放在法柜前的幔子外，对着法柜上的施恩座，就是我要与你相会的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Put the altar in front of the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law—before the atonement cover that is over the tablets of the covenant law—where I will meet with you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put it in front of the veil that is above the ark of the testimony, in front of the mercy seat that is above the testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall put it before the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Place the incense altar just outside the inner curtain that shields the Ark of the Covenant, in front of the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement—that covers the tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant. I will meet with you there.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall put this altar in front of the veil that is near the ark of the testimony, in front of the atoning cover that is over the ark of the testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.textEn: Put the altar in front of the curtain that shields the ark of the covenant law—before the atonement cover that is over the tablets of the covenant law—where I will meet with you.

verses.textZh: 亚伦要在坛上烧香料做的香，每天早晨整理灯的时候，要烧这香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦要在坛上烧香料做的香，每天早晨整理灯的时候，要烧这香。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦在坛上要烧馨香料做的香；每早晨他收拾灯的时候，要烧这香。
verses.textEnNiv: "Aaron must burn fragrant incense on the altar every morning when he tends the lamps.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron shall burn fragrant incense on it. Every morning when he dresses the lamps he shall burn it,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Aaron shall burn on it sweet incense every morning; when he tends the lamps, he shall burn incense on it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Every morning when Aaron maintains the lamps, he must burn fragrant incense on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Aaron shall burn fragrant incense on it; he shall burn it every morning when he trims the lamps.
verses.textEn: "Aaron must burn fragrant incense on the altar every morning when he tends the lamps.

verses.textZh: 傍晚，亚伦点灯的时候，也要烧这香，在耶和华面前作你们世世代代不断的香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 傍晚，亚伦点灯的时候，也要烧这香，在耶和华面前作你们世世代代不断的香。
verses.textZhCuv: 黄昏点灯的时候，他要在耶和华面前烧这香，作为世世代代常烧的香。
verses.textEnNiv: He must burn incense again when he lights the lamps at twilight so incense will burn regularly before the Lord for the generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: and when Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he shall burn it, a regular incense offering before the Lord throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Aaron lights the lamps at twilight, he shall burn incense on it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNlt: And each evening when he lights the lamps, he must again burn incense in the Lord ’s presence. This must be done from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: And when Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he shall burn incense. There shall be perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.
verses.textEn: He must burn incense again when he lights the lamps at twilight so incense will burn regularly before the Lord for the generations to come.

verses.textZh: 在这坛上，你们不可献上凡香、燔祭、素祭，也不可在这坛上浇奠祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这坛上，你们不可献上凡香、燔祭、素祭，也不可在这坛上浇奠祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这坛上不可奉上异样的香，不可献燔祭、素祭，也不可浇上奠祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not offer on this altar any other incense or any burnt offering or grain offering, and do not pour a drink offering on it.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not offer unauthorized incense on it, or a burnt offering, or a grain offering, and you shall not pour a drink offering on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not offer strange incense on it, or a burnt offering, or a grain offering; nor shall you pour a drink offering on it.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not offer any unholy incense on this altar, or any burnt offerings, grain offerings, or liquid offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not offer any strange incense on this altar, or burnt offering, or meal offering; and you shall not pour out a drink offering on it.
verses.textEn: Do not offer on this altar any other incense or any burnt offering or grain offering, and do not pour a drink offering on it.

verses.textZh: 亚伦每年一次要在坛的四角上行赎罪礼，每一次他都要用赎罪祭牲的血在坛上行赎罪礼；你们世世代代都要这样行，这坛要归耶和华为至圣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦每年一次要在坛的四角上行赎罪礼，每一次他都要用赎罪祭牲的血在坛上行赎罪礼；你们世世代代都要这样行，这坛要归耶和华为至圣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦一年一次要在坛的角上行赎罪之礼。他一年一次要用赎罪祭牲的血在坛上行赎罪之礼，作为世世代代的定例。这坛在耶和华面前为至圣。」
verses.textEnNiv: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns. This annual atonement must be made with the blood of the atoning sin offering for the generations to come. It is most holy to the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once a year. With the blood of the sin offering of atonement he shall make atonement for it once in the year throughout your generations. It is most holy to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Aaron shall make atonement upon its horns once a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonement; once a year he shall make atonement upon it throughout your generations. It is most holy to the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: "Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing its horns with blood from the offering made to purify the people from their sin. This will be a regular, annual event from generation to generation, for this is the Lord ’s most holy altar."
verses.textEnNasb: However, Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once a year; he shall make atonement on it with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once a year throughout your generations. It is most holy to the Lord."
verses.textEn: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns. This annual atonement must be made with the blood of the atoning sin offering for the generations to come. It is most holy to the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord also spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要照着以色列人被数点的数目登记人数；你数点的时候，他们各人要为自己的性命把赎价归给耶和华，免得你数点的时候，他们中间有灾病。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要照着以色列人被数点的数目登记人数；你数点的时候，他们各人要为自己的性命把赎价归给耶和华，免得你数点的时候，他们中间有灾病。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要按以色列人被数的，计算总数，你数的时候，他们各人要为自己的生命把赎价奉给耶和华，免得数的时候在他们中间有灾殃。
verses.textEnNiv: "When you take a census of the Israelites to count them, each one must pay the Lord a ransom for his life at the time he is counted. Then no plague will come on them when you number them.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you take the census of the people of Israel, then each shall give a ransom for his life to the Lord when you number them, that there be no plague among them when you number them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you take the census of the children of Israel for their number, then every man shall give a ransom for himself to the Lord, when you number them, that there may be no plague among them when you number them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Whenever you take a census of the people of Israel, each man who is counted must pay a ransom for himself to the Lord . Then no plague will strike the people as you count them.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you take a census of the sons of Israel to count them, then each one of them shall give a ransom for himself to the Lord, when you count them, so that there will be no plague among them when you count them.
verses.textEn: "When you take a census of the Israelites to count them, each one must pay the Lord a ransom for his life at the time he is counted. Then no plague will come on them when you number them.

verses.textZh: 以下就是他们当缴纳的；凡是属于那些被数点的人的，每人要照着圣所的标准献银子六克；这六克银子是归给耶和华的礼物。这重量是圣所用的标准重量 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下就是他们当缴纳的；凡是属于那些被数点的人的，每人要照着圣所的标准献银子六克；这六克银子是归给耶和华的礼物。这重量是圣所用的标准重量 。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡过去归那些被数之人的，每人要按圣所的平，拿银子半舍客勒；这半舍客勒是奉给耶和华的礼物（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
verses.textEnNiv: Each one who crosses over to those already counted is to give a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Each one who is numbered in the census shall give this: half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs), half a shekel as an offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: This is what everyone among those who are numbered shall give: half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (a shekel is twenty gerahs). The half-shekel shallbe an offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Each person who is counted must give a small piece of silver as a sacred offering to the Lord . (This payment is half a shekel, based on the sanctuary shekel, which equals twenty gerahs.)
verses.textEnNasb: This is what everyone who is counted shall give: half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs), half a shekel as a contribution to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Each one who crosses over to those already counted is to give a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 凡是属于那些被数点的人，自二十岁以上的，要把礼物献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是属于那些被数点的人，自二十岁以上的，要把礼物献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡过去归那些被数的人，从二十岁以外的，要将这礼物奉给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: All who cross over, those twenty years old or more, are to give an offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who is numbered in the census, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the Lord ’s offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone included among those who are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: All who have reached their twentieth birthday must give this sacred offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who is counted, from twenty years old and over, shall give the contribution to the Lord.
verses.textEn: All who cross over, those twenty years old or more, are to give an offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 富有的人不可多出，贫穷的也不可少出。各人要纳六克银子，作礼物献给耶和华，好为你们的性命作赎价。
verses.textZhCnvs: 富有的人不可多出，贫穷的也不可少出。各人要纳六克银子，作礼物献给耶和华，好为你们的性命作赎价。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们为赎生命将礼物奉给耶和华，富足的不可多出，贫穷的也不可少出，各人要出半舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: The rich are not to give more than a half shekel and the poor are not to give less when you make the offering to the Lord to atone for your lives.
verses.textEnEsv: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when you give the Lord ’s offering to make atonement for your lives.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rich shall not give more and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when you give an offering to the Lord, to make atonement for yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: When this offering is given to the Lord to purify your lives, making you right with him, the rich must not give more than the specified amount, and the poor must not give less.
verses.textEnNasb: The rich shall not pay more, and the poor shall not pay less, than the half shekel, when you give the contribution to the Lord to make atonement for yourselves.
verses.textEn: The rich are not to give more than a half shekel and the poor are not to give less when you make the offering to the Lord to atone for your lives.

verses.textZh: 你要从以色列人收取这赎银，指定作会幕事奉的使用，好使它在耶和华面前为以色列人作个记念，也赎回你们的性命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要从以色列人收取这赎银，指定作会幕事奉的使用，好使它在耶和华面前为以色列人作个记念，也赎回你们的性命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要从以色列人收这赎罪银，作为会幕的使用，可以在耶和华面前为以色列人作纪念，赎生命。」
verses.textEnNiv: Receive the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the tent of meeting. It will be a memorial for the Israelites before the Lord , making atonement for your lives."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall take the atonement money from the people of Israel and shall give it for the service of the tent of meeting, that it may bring the people of Israel to remembrance before the Lord , so as to make atonement for your lives."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of meeting, that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord, to make atonement for yourselves."
verses.textEnNlt: Receive this ransom money from the Israelites, and use it for the care of the Tabernacle. It will bring the Israelites to the Lord ’s attention, and it will purify your lives."
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall take the atonement money from the sons of Israel and give it for the service of the tent of meeting, so that it may be a memorial for the sons of Israel before the Lord, to make atonement for yourselves."
verses.textEn: Receive the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the tent of meeting. It will be a memorial for the Israelites before the Lord , making atonement for your lives."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要做一个铜盆和一个铜座，用来洗濯。你要把盆放在会幕和祭坛之间，并且要把水放在盆中。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要做一个铜盆和一个铜座，用来洗濯。你要把盆放在会幕和祭坛之间，并且要把水放在盆中。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用铜做洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要将盆放在会幕和坛的中间，在盆里盛水。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make a bronze basin, with its bronze stand, for washing. Place it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall also make a basin of bronze, with its stand of bronze, for washing. You shall put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it,
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall also make a laver of bronze, with its base also of bronze, for washing. You shall put it between the tabernacle of meeting and the altar. And you shall put water in it,
verses.textEnNlt: "Make a bronze washbasin with a bronze stand. Place it between the Tabernacle and the altar, and fill it with water.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also make a basin of bronze, with its base of bronze, for washing; and you shall put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.
verses.textEn: "Make a bronze basin, with its bronze stand, for washing. Place it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

verses.textZh: 亚伦和他的儿子要在盆里洗手洗脚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦和他的儿子要在盆里洗手洗脚。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦和他的儿子要在这盆里洗手洗脚。
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet with water from it.
verses.textEnEsv: with which Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: for Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in water from it.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron and his sons will wash their hands and feet there.
verses.textEnNasb: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it;
verses.textEn: Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet with water from it.

verses.textZh: 他们进会幕的时候，或是走近祭坛敬拜，给耶和华焚烧火祭的时候，都要用水洗濯，免得死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进会幕的时候，或是走近祭坛敬拜，给耶和华焚烧火祭的时候，都要用水洗濯，免得死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们进会幕，或是就近坛前供职给耶和华献火祭的时候，必用水洗濯，免得死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever they enter the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water so that they will not die. Also, when they approach the altar to minister by presenting a food offering to the Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: When they go into the tent of meeting, or when they come near the altar to minister, to burn a food offering to the Lord , they shall wash with water, so that they may not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they go into the tabernacle of meeting, or when they come near the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to the Lord, they shall wash with water, lest they die.
verses.textEnNlt: They must wash with water whenever they go into the Tabernacle to appear before the Lord and when they approach the altar to burn up their special gifts to the Lord —or they will die!
verses.textEnNasb: when they enter the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water, so that they do not die; or when they approach the altar to minister, by offering up in smoke a fire sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Whenever they enter the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water so that they will not die. Also, when they approach the altar to minister by presenting a food offering to the Lord ,

verses.textZh: 他们要洗手洗脚，免得死亡。这要作他们永远的定例，就是作亚伦和他的后裔世世代代永远的定例。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要洗手洗脚，免得死亡。这要作他们永远的定例，就是作亚伦和他的后裔世世代代永远的定例。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们洗手洗脚就免得死亡。这要作亚伦和他后裔世世代代永远的定例。」
verses.textEnNiv: they shall wash their hands and feet so that they will not die. This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come."
verses.textEnEsv: They shall wash their hands and their feet, so that they may not die. It shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his offspring throughout their generations."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, lest they die. And it shall be a statute forever to them—to him and his descendants throughout their generations."
verses.textEnNlt: They must always wash their hands and feet, or they will die. This is a permanent law for Aaron and his descendants, to be observed from generation to generation."
verses.textEnNasb: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, so that they do not die; and it shall be a permanent statute for them, for Aaron and his descendants throughout their generations."
verses.textEn: they shall wash their hands and feet so that they will not die. This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come."

verses.textZh: "你要取最上等的香料，就是流质的没药六公升，香肉桂是没药的一半，就是三公斤，香昌蒲三公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要取最上等的香料，就是流质的没药六公升，香肉桂是没药的一半，就是三公斤，香昌蒲三公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要取上品的香料，就是流质的没药五百舍客勒，香肉桂一半，就是二百五十舍客勒，菖蒲二百五十舍客勒，
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the following fine spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half as much (that is, 250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant calamus,
verses.textEnEsv: "Take the finest spices: of liquid myrrh 500 shekels, and of sweet-smelling cinnamon half as much, that is, 250, and 250 of aromatic cane,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also take for yourself quality spices—five hundred shekels of liquid myrrh, half as much sweet-smelling cinnamon (two hundred and fifty shekels), two hundred and fifty shekels of sweet-smelling cane,
verses.textEnNlt: "Collect choice spices—12-1/2 pounds of pure myrrh, 6-1/4 pounds of fragrant cinnamon, 6-1/4 pounds of fragrant calamus,
verses.textEnNasb: "Take also for yourself the finest of spices: of liquid myrrh five hundred shekels, and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, 250, and of fragrant cane 250,
verses.textEn: "Take the following fine spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half as much (that is, 250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant calamus,

verses.textZh: 肉桂皮六公斤，都要按着圣所的标准重量，又橄榄油四公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 肉桂皮六公斤，都要按着圣所的标准重量，又橄榄油四公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按着圣所的平，又取橄榄油一欣，
verses.textEnNiv: 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: and 500 of cassia, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, and a hin of olive oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: five hundred shekels of cassia, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, and a hin of olive oil.
verses.textEnNlt: and 12-1/2 pounds of cassia —as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel. Also get one gallon of olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: and of cassia 500, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive oil a hin.
verses.textEn: 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.

verses.textZh: 你要把这些材料制成圣膏油，就是照着香膏配制师的方法配制成的香膏，是要作为圣膏油的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这些材料制成圣膏油，就是照着香膏配制师的方法配制成的香膏，是要作为圣膏油的。
verses.textZhCuv: 按做香之法调和做成圣膏油。
verses.textEnNiv: Make these into a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer. It will be the sacred anointing oil.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall make of these a sacred anointing oil blended as by the perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make from these a holy anointing oil, an ointment compounded according to the art of the perfumer. It shall be a holy anointing oil.
verses.textEnNlt: Like a skilled incense maker, blend these ingredients to make a holy anointing oil.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make from these a holy anointing oil, a fragrant mixture of ointments, the work of a perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil.
verses.textEn: Make these into a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer. It will be the sacred anointing oil.

verses.textZh: 你要用这膏油抹会幕和法柜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用这膏油抹会幕和法柜，
verses.textZhCuv: 要用这膏油抹会幕和法柜，
verses.textEnNiv: Then use it to anoint the tent of meeting, the ark of the covenant law,
verses.textEnEsv: With it you shall anoint the tent of meeting and the ark of the testimony,
verses.textEnNkjv: With it you shall anoint the tabernacle of meeting and the ark of the Testimony;
verses.textEnNlt: Use this sacred oil to anoint the Tabernacle, the Ark of the Covenant,
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall anoint the tent of meeting with it, and the ark of the testimony,
verses.textEn: Then use it to anoint the tent of meeting, the ark of the covenant law,

verses.textZh: 桌子和桌子的所有器具，灯台和灯台的器具，以及香坛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 桌子和桌子的所有器具，灯台和灯台的器具，以及香坛，
verses.textZhCuv: 桌子与桌子的一切器具，灯台和灯台的器具，并香坛、
verses.textEnNiv: the table and all its articles, the lampstand and its accessories, the altar of incense,
verses.textEnEsv: and the table and all its utensils, and the lampstand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,
verses.textEnNkjv: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and its utensils, and the altar of incense;
verses.textEnNlt: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and all its accessories, the incense altar,
verses.textEnNasb: and the table and all its utensils, and the lampstand and its utensils, and the altar of incense,
verses.textEn: the table and all its articles, the lampstand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

verses.textZh: 燔祭坛和坛上的所有器具，盆和盆座；
verses.textZhCnvs: 燔祭坛和坛上的所有器具，盆和盆座；
verses.textZhCuv: 燔祭坛，和坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座。
verses.textEnNiv: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.
verses.textEnEsv: and the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils and the basin and its stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the laver and its base.
verses.textEnNlt: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the washbasin with its stand.
verses.textEnNasb: and the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin and its stand.
verses.textEn: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.

verses.textZh: 你要使它们成圣，使它们成为至圣；凡是触着它们的，都要成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要使它们成圣，使它们成为至圣；凡是触着它们的，都要成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 要使这些物成为圣，好成为至圣；凡挨着的都成为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: You shall consecrate them so they will be most holy, and whatever touches them will be holy.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall consecrate them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them will become holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall consecrate them, that they may be most holy; whatever touches them must be holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Consecrate them to make them absolutely holy. After this, whatever touches them will also become holy.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also consecrate them, so that they may be most holy; whatever touches them shall be holy.
verses.textEn: You shall consecrate them so they will be most holy, and whatever touches them will be holy.

verses.textZh: 你也要膏抹亚伦和他的儿子，好使他们成圣，作我的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要膏抹亚伦和他的儿子，好使他们成圣，作我的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 要膏亚伦和他的儿子，使他们成为圣，可以给我供祭司的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may serve me as priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister to Me as priests.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anoint Aaron and his sons also, consecrating them to serve me as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, so that they may serve as priests to Me.
verses.textEn: "Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

verses.textZh: 你要告诉以色列人说：‘你们世世代代要把这油归我为圣膏油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要告诉以色列人说：‘你们世世代代要把这油归我为圣膏油。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对以色列人说：『这油，我要世世代代以为圣膏油。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to the Israelites, ‘This is to be my sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall say to the people of Israel, ‘This shall be my holy anointing oil throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to Me throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNlt: And say to the people of Israel, ‘This holy anointing oil is reserved for me from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to Me throughout your generations.
verses.textEn: Say to the Israelites, ‘This is to be my sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.

verses.textZh: 不可倒在常人的身上，也不可照着这配制的分量制相似的膏油；这膏油是圣的，你们也要以它为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可倒在常人的身上，也不可照着这配制的分量制相似的膏油；这膏油是圣的，你们也要以它为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可倒在别人的身上，也不可按这调和之法做与此相似的。这膏油是圣的，你们也要以为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not pour it on anyone else’s body and do not make any other oil using the same formula. It is sacred, and you are to consider it sacred.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall not be poured on the body of an ordinary person, and you shall make no other like it in composition. It is holy, and it shall be holy to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh; nor shall you make anyother like it, according to its composition. It is holy, and it shall be holy to you.
verses.textEnNlt: It must never be used to anoint anyone else, and you must never make any blend like it for yourselves. It is holy, and you must treat it as holy.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall not be poured on anyone’s body, nor shall you make any like it in the same proportions; it is holy, and it shall be holy to you.
verses.textEn: Do not pour it on anyone else’s body and do not make any other oil using the same formula. It is sacred, and you are to consider it sacred.

verses.textZh: 无论谁配制相似的膏油，或把这膏油抹在外人的身上，这人就一定要从他的族人中被剪除。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论谁配制相似的膏油，或把这膏油抹在外人的身上，这人就一定要从他的族人中被剪除。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡调和与此相似的，或将这膏膏在别人身上的，这人要从民中剪除。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever makes perfume like it and puts it on anyone other than a priest must be cut off from their people.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever compounds any like it or whoever puts any of it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on an outsider, shall be cut off from his people.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who makes a blend like it or anoints someone other than a priest will be cut off from the community.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever mixes any like it or whoever puts any of it on a layman shall be cut off from his people.’ "
verses.textEn: Whoever makes perfume like it and puts it on anyone other than a priest must be cut off from their people.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要取芬芳的香料，就是苏合香、香锭、白松香；这芬芳的香料和纯净的乳香，各样都要分量相等。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要取芬芳的香料，就是苏合香、香锭、白松香；这芬芳的香料和纯净的乳香，各样都要分量相等。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你要取馨香的香料，就是拿他弗、施喜列、喜利比拿；这馨香的香料和净乳香各样要一般大的分量。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha and galbanum—and pure frankincense, all in equal amounts,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses, "Take sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum, sweet spices with pure frankincense (of each shall there be an equal part),
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses: "Take sweet spices, stacte and onycha and galbanum, and pure frankincense with these sweet spices; there shall be equal amounts of each.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Gather fragrant spices—resin droplets, mollusk shell, and galbanum—and mix these fragrant spices with pure frankincense, weighed out in equal amounts.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Take for yourself spices—stacte, onycha, and galbanum, spices and pure frankincense; there shall be an equal part of each.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha and galbanum—and pure frankincense, all in equal amounts,

verses.textZh: 你要照着香膏配制师的方法，用这些加上盐调和制成香，是清净圣洁的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要照着香膏配制师的方法，用这些加上盐调和制成香，是清净圣洁的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要用这些加上盐，按做香之法做成清净圣洁的香。
verses.textEnNiv: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer. It is to be salted and pure and sacred.
verses.textEnEsv: and make an incense blended as by the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make of these an incense, a compound according to the art of the perfumer, salted, pure, and holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Using the usual techniques of the incense maker, blend the spices together and sprinkle them with salt to produce a pure and holy incense.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make incense from it all, a skillful mixture, the work of a perfumer, salted, pure, and holy.
verses.textEn: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer. It is to be salted and pure and sacred.

verses.textZh: 你要取一部分香，把它研成碎末，放在会幕里法柜前，就是我要与你相会的地方。你们要以这香为至圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要取一部分香，把它研成碎末，放在会幕里法柜前，就是我要与你相会的地方。你们要以这香为至圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 这香要取点捣得极细，放在会幕内、法柜前，我要在那里与你相会。你们要以这香为至圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Grind some of it to powder and place it in front of the ark of the covenant law in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall beat some of it very small, and put part of it before the testimony in the tent of meeting where I shall meet with you. It shall be most holy for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall beat some of it very fine, and put some of it before the Testimony in the tabernacle of meeting where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Grind some of the mixture into a very fine powder and put it in front of the Ark of the Covenant, where I will meet with you in the Tabernacle. You must treat this incense as most holy.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall crush some of it very fine, and put part of it in front of the testimony in the tent of meeting where I will meet with you; it shall be most holy to you.
verses.textEn: Grind some of it to powder and place it in front of the ark of the covenant law in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.

verses.textZh: 你所制的香，你们不可按着它的分量为自己配制；你要以这香为圣归给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所制的香，你们不可按着它的分量为自己配制；你要以这香为圣归给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不可按这调和之法为自己做香；要以这香为圣，归耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not make any incense with this formula for yourselves; consider it holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the incense that you shall make according to its composition, you shall not make for yourselves. It shall be for you holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But asfor the incense which you shall make, you shall not make any for yourselves, according to its composition. It shall be to you holy for the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Never use this formula to make this incense for yourselves. It is reserved for the Lord , and you must treat it as holy.
verses.textEnNasb: And the incense which you shall make, you shall not make in the same proportions for yourselves; it shall be holy to you for the Lord.
verses.textEn: Do not make any incense with this formula for yourselves; consider it holy to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 无论谁制香和这香相似，为要闻香的味道的，这人就一定要从他的族人中被剪除。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论谁制香和这香相似，为要闻香的味道的，这人就一定要从他的族人中被剪除。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡做香和这香一样，为要闻香味的，这人要从民中剪除。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever makes incense like it to enjoy its fragrance must be cut off from their people."
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever makes any like it to use as perfume shall be cut off from his people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever makes any like it, to smell it, he shall be cut off from his people."
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who makes incense like this for personal use will be cut off from the community."
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever makes any like it, to use as perfume, shall be cut off from his people."
verses.textEn: Whoever makes incense like it to enjoy its fragrance must be cut off from their people."

verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.textZh: "看哪，犹大支派中户珥的孙子，乌利的儿子比撒列，我已经提名召他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪，犹大支派中户珥的孙子，乌利的儿子比撒列，我已经提名召他。
verses.textZhCuv: 「看哪，犹大支派中，户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列，我已经提他的名召他。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
verses.textEnEsv: "See, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: "See, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I have specifically chosen Bezalel son of Uri, grandson of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: "See, I have called by name Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEn: "See, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

verses.textZh: 我也用神的灵充满了他，使他有智慧，有聪明，有知识，有能力作各样的手工，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也用神的灵充满了他，使他有智慧，有聪明，有知识，有能力作各样的手工，
verses.textZhCuv: 我也以我的灵充满了他，使他有智慧，有聪明，有知识，能做各样的工，
verses.textEnNiv: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills—
verses.textEnEsv: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with ability and intelligence, with knowledge and all craftsmanship,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all mannerof workmanship,
verses.textEnNlt: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, giving him great wisdom, ability, and expertise in all kinds of crafts.
verses.textEnNasb: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of craftsmanship,
verses.textEn: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills—

verses.textZh: 可以设计巧工，可以用金、银、铜制造各物。

verses.textEnNasb: and in the cutting of stones for settings, and in the carving of wood, so that he may work in all kinds of craftsmanship.

verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, I have appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan, to help him. Also I have given ability to all the skilled workers to make everything I have commanded you:

verses.textEnNlt: "And I have personally appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, to be his assistant. Moreover, I have given special skill to all the gifted craftsmen so they can make all the things I have commanded you to make:

verses.textEn: Moreover, I have appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan, to help him. Also I have given ability to all the skilled workers to make everything I have commanded you:
