verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord then gave these instructions to Moses:
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列人说：你们务要守我的安息日，因为这是你我之间世世代代的记号，使你们知道我耶和华是把你们分别为圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列人说：你们务要守我的安息日，因为这是你我之间世世代代的记号，使你们知道我耶和华是把你们分别为圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要吩咐以色列人说：『你们务要守我的安息日；因为这是你我之间世世代代的证据，使你们知道我－耶和华是叫你们成为圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites, ‘You must observe my Sabbaths. This will be a sign between me and you for the generations to come, so you may know that I am the Lord , who makes you holy.
verses.textEnEsv: "You are to speak to the people of Israel and say, ‘Above all you shall keep my Sabbaths, for this is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I, the Lord , sanctify you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak also to the children of Israel, saying: ‘Surely My Sabbaths you shall keep, for it is a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell the people of Israel: ‘Be careful to keep my Sabbath day, for the Sabbath is a sign of the covenant between me and you from generation to generation. It is given so you may know that I am the Lord , who makes you holy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now as for you, speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘You must keep My Sabbaths; for this is a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, so that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites, ‘You must observe my Sabbaths. This will be a sign between me and you for the generations to come, so you may know that I am the Lord , who makes you holy.

verses.textZh: 所以你们应该守安息日，因为这是你们的圣日；凡是违反这日的，必要把他处死；凡是在这日工作的，那人必要从他的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们应该守安息日，因为这是你们的圣日；凡是违反这日的，必要把他处死；凡是在这日工作的，那人必要从他的族人中被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们要守安息日，以为圣日。凡干犯这日的，必要把他治死；凡在这日做工的，必从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Observe the Sabbath, because it is holy to you. Anyone who desecrates it is to be put to death; those who do any work on that day must be cut off from their people.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall keep the Sabbath, because it is holy for you. Everyone who profanes it shall be put to death. Whoever does any work on it, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall keep the Sabbath, therefore, for itis holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work on it, that person shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.textEnNlt: You must keep the Sabbath day, for it is a holy day for you. Anyone who desecrates it must be put to death; anyone who works on that day will be cut off from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore you are to keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it must be put to death; for whoever does any work on it, that person shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.textEn: " ‘Observe the Sabbath, because it is holy to you. Anyone who desecrates it is to be put to death; those who do any work on that day must be cut off from their people.

verses.textZh: 六日可以工作，但第七日是歇工的安息日，是归耶和华为圣的，凡是在这安息日工作的，必须把那人处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六日可以工作，但第七日是歇工的安息日，是归耶和华为圣的，凡是在这安息日工作的，必须把那人处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 六日要做工，但第七日是安息圣日，是向耶和华守为圣的。凡在安息日做工的，必要把他治死。』
verses.textEnNiv: For six days work is to be done, but the seventh day is a day of sabbath rest, holy to the Lord . Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Six days shall work be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the Lord . Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Work shall be done for six days, but the seventh is the Sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but the seventh day must be a Sabbath day of complete rest, a holy day dedicated to the Lord . Anyone who works on the Sabbath must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: For six days work may be done, but on the seventh day there is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the Lord; whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must be put to death.
verses.textEn: For six days work is to be done, but the seventh day is a day of sabbath rest, holy to the Lord . Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 所以，以色列人要守安息日，他们世世代代要遵行安息日的规例，作为永远的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，以色列人要守安息日，他们世世代代要遵行安息日的规例，作为永远的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日为永远的约。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites are to observe the Sabbath, celebrating it for the generations to come as a lasting covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the people of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, observing the Sabbath throughout their generations, as a covenant forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations as a perpetual covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel must keep the Sabbath day by observing it from generation to generation. This is a covenant obligation for all time.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to celebrate the Sabbath throughout their generations as a permanent covenant.’
verses.textEn: The Israelites are to observe the Sabbath, celebrating it for the generations to come as a lasting covenant.

verses.textZh: 这是我和以色列人中间永远的记号，因为六日之内耶和华创造了天地，但第七日就歇了工休息了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是我和以色列人中间永远的记号，因为六日之内耶和华创造了天地，但第七日就歇了工休息了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这是我和以色列人永远的证据；因为六日之内耶和华造天地，第七日便安息舒畅。」
verses.textEnNiv: It will be a sign between me and the Israelites forever, for in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: It is a sign forever between me and the people of Israel that in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: It is a sign between Me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: It is a permanent sign of my covenant with the people of Israel. For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, but on the seventh day he stopped working and was refreshed.’"
verses.textEnNasb: It is a sign between Me and the sons of Israel forever; for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, but on the seventh day He ceased from labor, and was refreshed."
verses.textEn: It will be a sign between me and the Israelites forever, for in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华在西奈山上与摩西说完了话，就把两块法版交给他，是神用指头写的石版。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在西奈山上与摩西说完了话，就把两块法版交给他，是神用指头写的石版。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在西奈山和摩西说完了话，就把两块法版交给他，是神用指头写的石版。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the covenant law, the tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he gave to Moses, when he had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had made an end of speaking with him on Mount Sinai, He gave Moses two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, written by the finger of God.
verses.textEnNasb: When He had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, He gave Moses the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written by the finger of God.
verses.textEn: When the Lord finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the covenant law, the tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.

verses.textZh: 人民见摩西迟迟不下山，就聚集到亚伦那里去，对他说："起来，为我们做神像可以走在我们前头领路，因为那摩西，就是把我们从埃及地领出来的那个人，我们不知道他遭遇了甚么事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民见摩西迟迟不下山，就聚集到亚伦那里去，对他说："起来，为我们做神像可以走在我们前头领路，因为那摩西，就是把我们从埃及地领出来的那个人，我们不知道他遭遇了甚么事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓见摩西迟延不下山，就大家聚集到亚伦那里，对他说：「起来！为我们做神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the people saw that Moses was so long in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, "Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don’t know what has happened to him."
verses.textEnEsv: When the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron and said to him, "Up, make us gods who shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered together to Aaron, and said to him, "Come, make us gods that shall go before us; for asfor this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him."
verses.textEnNlt: When the people saw how long it was taking Moses to come back down the mountain, they gathered around Aaron. "Come on," they said, "make us some gods who can lead us. We don’t know what happened to this fellow Moses, who brought us here from the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people assembled around Aaron and said to him, "Come, make us a god who will go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us up from the land of Egypt—we do not know what happened to him."
verses.textEn: When the people saw that Moses was so long in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, "Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don’t know what has happened to him."

verses.textZh: 亚伦对他们说："把你们妻子和儿女戴在耳上的金环摘下来，送来给我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦对他们说："把你们妻子和儿女戴在耳上的金环摘下来，送来给我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦对他们说：「你们去摘下你们妻子、儿女耳上的金环，拿来给我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron answered them, "Take off the gold earrings that your wives, your sons and your daughters are wearing, and bring them to me."
verses.textEnEsv: So Aaron said to them, "Take off the rings of gold that are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Aaron said to them, "Break off the golden earrings which are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me."
verses.textEnNlt: So Aaron said, "Take the gold rings from the ears of your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me."
verses.textEnNasb: Aaron said to them, "Tear off the gold rings which are in the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me."
verses.textEn: Aaron answered them, "Take off the gold earrings that your wives, your sons and your daughters are wearing, and bring them to me."

verses.textZh: 全体人民就把他们耳上的金耳环都摘下来，送来给亚伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体人民就把他们耳上的金耳环都摘下来，送来给亚伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓就都摘下他们耳上的金环，拿来给亚伦。
verses.textEnNiv: So all the people took off their earrings and brought them to Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the people took off the rings of gold that were in their ears and brought them to Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the people broke off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: All the people took the gold rings from their ears and brought them to Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the people tore off the gold rings which were in their ears and brought them to Aaron.
verses.textEn: So all the people took off their earrings and brought them to Aaron.

verses.textZh: 亚伦从他们手中接过来，用雕刻的工具雕刻，铸造了一个牛像；他们就说："以色列啊，这就是你们的神，就是把你从埃及地领出来的那位。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦从他们手中接过来，用雕刻的工具雕刻，铸造了一个牛像；他们就说："以色列啊，这就是你们的神，就是把你从埃及地领出来的那位。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦从他们手里接过来，铸了一只牛犊，用雕刻的器具做成。他们就说：「以色列啊，这是领你出埃及地的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: He took what they handed him and made it into an idol cast in the shape of a calf, fashioning it with a tool. Then they said, "These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: And he received the gold from their hand and fashioned it with a graving tool and made a golden calf. And they said, "These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he received thegold from their hand, and he fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made a molded calf. Then they said, "This is your god, O Israel, that brought you out of the land of Egypt!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Aaron took the gold, melted it down, and molded it into the shape of a calf. When the people saw it, they exclaimed, "O Israel, these are the gods who brought you out of the land of Egypt!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took the gold from their hands, and fashioned it with an engraving tool and made it into a cast metal calf; and they said, " This is your god, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt."
verses.textEn: He took what they handed him and made it into an idol cast in the shape of a calf, fashioning it with a tool. Then they said, "These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."

verses.textZh: 亚伦看见了，就在牛像面前筑了一座祭坛，并且宣告，说："明日是耶和华的节日。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦看见了，就在牛像面前筑了一座祭坛，并且宣告，说："明日是耶和华的节日。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦看见，就在牛犊面前筑坛，且宣告说：「明日要向耶和华守节。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of the calf and announced, "Tomorrow there will be a festival to the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it. And Aaron made a proclamation and said, "Tomorrow shall be a feast to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it. And Aaron made a proclamation and said, "Tomorrow is a feast to the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron saw how excited the people were, so he built an altar in front of the calf. Then he announced, "Tomorrow will be a festival to the Lord !"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of it; and Aaron made a proclamation and said, "Tomorrow shall be a feast to the Lord."
verses.textEn: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of the calf and announced, "Tomorrow there will be a festival to the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 次日清早，人民起来，就献上了燔祭，也带来了平安祭；然后他们坐下吃喝，起来玩乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次日清早，人民起来，就献上了燔祭，也带来了平安祭；然后他们坐下吃喝，起来玩乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日清早，百姓起来献燔祭和平安祭，就坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。
verses.textEnNiv: So the next day the people rose early and sacrificed burnt offerings and presented fellowship offerings. Afterward they sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.
verses.textEnEsv: And they rose up early the next day and offered burnt offerings and brought peace offerings. And the people sat down to eat and drink and rose up to play.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they rose early on the next day, offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
verses.textEnNlt: The people got up early the next morning to sacrifice burnt offerings and peace offerings. After this, they celebrated with feasting and drinking, and they indulged in pagan revelry.
verses.textEnNasb: So the next day they got up early and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and got up to engage in lewd behavior.
verses.textEn: So the next day the people rose early and sacrificed burnt offerings and presented fellowship offerings. Afterward they sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你下山去吧，因为你的人民，就是你从埃及地领出来的，已经败坏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你下山去吧，因为你的人民，就是你从埃及地领出来的，已经败坏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「下去吧，因为你的百姓，就是你从埃及地领出来的，已经败坏了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go down, because your people, whom you brought up out of Egypt, have become corrupt.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go down, for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go, get down! For your people whom you brought out of the land of Egypt have corrupted themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord told Moses, "Quick! Go down the mountain! Your people whom you brought from the land of Egypt have corrupted themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, "Go down at once, for your people, whom you brought up from the land of Egypt, have behaved corruptly.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go down, because your people, whom you brought up out of Egypt, have become corrupt.

verses.textZh: 他们很快就偏离了我吩咐他们的道路，为自己铸造了一个牛像，向它跪拜，向它献祭，说：‘以色列啊，这就是你的神，就是把你从埃及地领出来的那位。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们很快就偏离了我吩咐他们的道路，为自己铸造了一个牛像，向它跪拜，向它献祭，说：‘以色列啊，这就是你的神，就是把你从埃及地领出来的那位。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们快快偏离了我所吩咐的道，为自己铸了一只牛犊，向它下拜献祭，说：『以色列啊，这就是领你出埃及地的神。』」
verses.textEnNiv: They have been quick to turn away from what I commanded them and have made themselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. They have bowed down to it and sacrificed to it and have said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.’
verses.textEnEsv: They have turned aside quickly out of the way that I commanded them. They have made for themselves a golden calf and have worshiped it and sacrificed to it and said, ‘These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!’"
verses.textEnNkjv: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and worshiped it and sacrificed to it, and said, ‘This is your god, O Israel, that brought you out of the land of Egypt!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: How quickly they have turned away from the way I commanded them to live! They have melted down gold and made a calf, and they have bowed down and sacrificed to it. They are saying, ‘These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.’"
verses.textEnNasb: They have quickly turned aside from the way which I commanded them. They have made for themselves a cast metal calf, and have worshiped it and have sacrificed to it and said, ‘ This is your god, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt!’ "
verses.textEn: They have been quick to turn away from what I commanded them and have made themselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. They have bowed down to it and sacrificed to it and have said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："我看这人民，真是硬着颈项的人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："我看这人民，真是硬着颈项的人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「我看这百姓真是硬着颈项的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have seen these people," the Lord said to Moses, "and they are a stiff-necked people.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "I have seen this people, and behold, it is a stiff-necked people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "I have seen this people, and indeed it is a stiff-necked people!
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said, "I have seen how stubborn and rebellious these people are.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "I have seen this people, and behold, they are an obstinate people.
verses.textEn: "I have seen these people," the Lord said to Moses, "and they are a stiff-necked people.

verses.textZh: 现在，你且由得我，让我向他们发烈怒，把他们消灭；我要使你成为大国。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你且由得我，让我向他们发烈怒，把他们消灭；我要使你成为大国。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你且由着我，我要向他们发烈怒，将他们灭绝，使你的后裔成为大国。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now leave me alone so that my anger may burn against them and that I may destroy them. Then I will make you into a great nation."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them and I may consume them, in order that I may make a great nation of you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, let Me alone, that My wrath may burn hot against them and I may consume them. And I will make of you a great nation."
verses.textEnNlt: Now leave me alone so my fierce anger can blaze against them, and I will destroy them. Then I will make you, Moses, into a great nation."
verses.textEnNasb: So now leave Me alone, that My anger may burn against them and that I may destroy them; and I will make of you a great nation."
verses.textEn: Now leave me alone so that my anger may burn against them and that I may destroy them. Then I will make you into a great nation."

verses.textZh: 摩西就恳求耶和华他的神施恩，说："耶和华啊，你为甚么向你的人民发烈怒呢？这人民是你用大能和全能的手从埃及地领出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就恳求耶和华他的神施恩，说："耶和华啊，你为甚么向你的人民发烈怒呢？这人民是你用大能和全能的手从埃及地领出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西便恳求耶和华－他的神说：「耶和华啊，你为什么向你的百姓发烈怒呢？这百姓是你用大力和大能的手从埃及地领出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses sought the favor of the Lord his God. " Lord ," he said, "why should your anger burn against your people, whom you brought out of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses implored the Lord his God and said, "O Lord , why does your wrath burn hot against your people, whom you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses pleaded with the Lord his God, and said: "Lord, why does Your wrath burn hot against Your people whom You have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses tried to pacify the Lord his God. "O Lord !" he said. "Why are you so angry with your own people whom you brought from the land of Egypt with such great power and such a strong hand?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses pleaded with the Lord his God, and said, "Lord, why does Your anger burn against Your people whom You have brought out from the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
verses.textEn: But Moses sought the favor of the Lord his God. " Lord ," he said, "why should your anger burn against your people, whom you brought out of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?

verses.textZh: 为甚么让埃及人议论，说：‘把他们领出来是出于恶意的，要在山上杀死他们，在地上消灭他们’呢？求你回心转意，不发烈怒；求你改变初衷，不降祸给你的人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么让埃及人议论，说：‘把他们领出来是出于恶意的，要在山上杀死他们，在地上消灭他们’呢？求你回心转意，不发烈怒；求你改变初衷，不降祸给你的人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 为什么使埃及人议论说『他领他们出去，是要降祸与他们，把他们杀在山中，将他们从地上除灭』？求你转意，不发你的烈怒，后悔，不降祸与你的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: Why should the Egyptians say, ‘It was with evil intent that he brought them out, to kill them in the mountains and to wipe them off the face of the earth’? Turn from your fierce anger; relent and do not bring disaster on your people.
verses.textEnEsv: Why should the Egyptians say, ‘With evil intent did he bring them out, to kill them in the mountains and to consume them from the face of the earth’? Turn from your burning anger and relent from this disaster against your people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why should the Egyptians speak, and say, ‘He brought them out to harm them, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth’? Turn from Your fierce wrath, and relent from this harm to Your people.
verses.textEnNlt: Why let the Egyptians say, ‘Their God rescued them with the evil intention of slaughtering them in the mountains and wiping them from the face of the earth’? Turn away from your fierce anger. Change your mind about this terrible disaster you have threatened against your people!
verses.textEnNasb: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘With evil motives He brought them out, to kill them on the mountains and to destroy them from the face of the earth’? Turn from Your burning anger and relent of doing harm to Your people.
verses.textEn: Why should the Egyptians say, ‘It was with evil intent that he brought them out, to kill them in the mountains and to wipe them off the face of the earth’? Turn from your fierce anger; relent and do not bring disaster on your people.

verses.textZh: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各；你曾经指着自己向他们起誓，说：‘我必使你的后裔增多，好象天上的星一样；我必把我应许的这全地赐给你的后裔，他们必永远承受这地作产业。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各；你曾经指着自己向他们起誓，说：‘我必使你的后裔增多，好象天上的星一样；我必把我应许的这全地赐给你的后裔，他们必永远承受这地作产业。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列。你曾指着自己起誓说：『我必使你们的后裔像天上的星那样多，并且我所应许的这全地，必给你们的后裔，他们要永远承受为业。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Israel, to whom you swore by your own self: ‘I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and I will give your descendants all this land I promised them, and it will be their inheritance forever.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have promised I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Your servants, to whom You swore by Your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your descendants as the stars of heaven; and all this land that I have spoken of I give to your descendants, and they shall inherit it forever.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You bound yourself with an oath to them, saying, ‘I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars of heaven. And I will give them all of this land that I have promised to your descendants, and they will possess it forever.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Your servants to whom You swore by Yourself, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your descendants as the stars of the heavens, and all this land of which I have spoken I will give to your descendants, and they shall inherit it forever.’ "
verses.textEn: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Israel, to whom you swore by your own self: ‘I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and I will give your descendants all this land I promised them, and it will be their inheritance forever.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是，耶和华改变初衷，不把他所说的祸降在他的人民身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，耶和华改变初衷，不把他所说的祸降在他的人民身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶和华后悔，不把所说的祸降与他的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord relented and did not bring on his people the disaster he had threatened.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord relented from the disaster that he had spoken of bringing on his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord relented from the harm which He said He would do to His people.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord changed his mind about the terrible disaster he had threatened to bring on his people.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord relented of the harm which He said He would do to His people.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord relented and did not bring on his people the disaster he had threatened.

verses.textZh: 摩西转身，从山上下来，手里拿着两块法版；法版是两面写的，这面和那面都写着字。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西转身，从山上下来，手里拿着两块法版；法版是两面写的，这面和那面都写着字。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西转身下山，手里拿着两块法版。这版是两面写的，这面那面都有字，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the covenant law in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses turned and went down from the mountain with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand, tablets that were written on both sides; on the front and on the back they were written.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses turned and went down from the mountain, and the two tablets of the Testimony were in his hand. The tablets were written on both sides; on the one side and on the other they were written.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses turned and went down the mountain. He held in his hands the two stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses turned and went down from the mountain with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand, tablets which were written on both sides; they were written on one side and the other.
verses.textEn: Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the covenant law in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.

verses.textZh: 法版是神的工作，字是神写的，刻在法版上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法版是神的工作，字是神写的，刻在法版上。
verses.textZhCuv: 是神的工作，字是神写的，刻在版上。
verses.textEnNiv: The tablets were the work of God; the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
verses.textEnEsv: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God engraved on the tablets.
verses.textEnNlt: These tablets were God’s work; the words on them were written by God himself.
verses.textEnNasb: The tablets were God’s work, and the writing was God’s writing engraved on the tablets.
verses.textEn: The tablets were the work of God; the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

verses.textZh: 约书亚听见人民呼喊的声音的时候，就对摩西说："营里有战争的声音。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚听见人民呼喊的声音的时候，就对摩西说："营里有战争的声音。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚一听见百姓呼喊的声音，就对摩西说：「在营里有争战的声音。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Joshua heard the noise of the people shouting, he said to Moses, "There is the sound of war in the camp."
verses.textEnEsv: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, "There is a noise of war in the camp."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, "Thereis a noise of war in the camp."
verses.textEnNlt: When Joshua heard the boisterous noise of the people shouting below them, he exclaimed to Moses, "It sounds like war in the camp!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Joshua heard the sound of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, "There is a sound of war in the camp."
verses.textEn: When Joshua heard the noise of the people shouting, he said to Moses, "There is the sound of war in the camp."

verses.textZh: 摩西回答： "这不是战胜的呼声， 也不是战败的呼声； 我听见的是歌唱的声音。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西回答： "这不是战胜的呼声， 也不是战败的呼声； 我听见的是歌唱的声音。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「这不是人打胜仗的声音，也不是人打败仗的声音；我所听见的乃是人歌唱的声音。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses replied: "It is not the sound of victory, it is not the sound of defeat; it is the sound of singing that I hear."
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "It is not the sound of shouting for victory, or the sound of the cry of defeat, but the sound of singing that I hear."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said: "Itis not the noise of the shout of victory, Nor the noise of the cry of defeat, But the sound of singing I hear."
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses replied, "No, it’s not a shout of victory nor the wailing of defeat. I hear the sound of a celebration."
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "It is not the sound of the cry of victory, Nor is it the sound of the cry of defeat; But I hear the sound of singing."
verses.textEn: Moses replied: "It is not the sound of victory, it is not the sound of defeat; it is the sound of singing that I hear."

verses.textZh: 摩西走近营前的时候，看见了那牛犊，又看见了有人唱歌跳舞，他就发烈怒，把两块法版从他的手中摔掉，在山下把它们摔碎了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西走近营前的时候，看见了那牛犊，又看见了有人唱歌跳舞，他就发烈怒，把两块法版从他的手中摔掉，在山下把它们摔碎了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西挨近营前就看见牛犊，又看见人跳舞，便发烈怒，把两块版扔在山下摔碎了，
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, his anger burned and he threw the tablets out of his hands, breaking them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as he came near the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, Moses’ anger burned hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands and broke them at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, as soon as he came near the camp, that he saw the calf and the dancing. So Moses’ anger became hot, and he cast the tablets out of his hands and broke them at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: When they came near the camp, Moses saw the calf and the dancing, and he burned with anger. He threw the stone tablets to the ground, smashing them at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, as soon as Moses approached the camp, that he saw the calf and the people dancing; and Moses’ anger burned, and he threw the tablets from his hands and shattered them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
verses.textEn: When Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, his anger burned and he threw the tablets out of his hands, breaking them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.

verses.textZh: 又把他们所做的那牛犊拿过来，用火焚烧，磨到粉碎，撒在水面上，让以色列人喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把他们所做的那牛犊拿过来，用火焚烧，磨到粉碎，撒在水面上，让以色列人喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将他们所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。
verses.textEnNiv: And he took the calf the people had made and burned it in the fire; then he ground it to powder, scattered it on the water and made the Israelites drink it.
verses.textEnEsv: He took the calf that they had made and burned it with fire and ground it to powder and scattered it on the water and made the people of Israel drink it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took the calf which they had made, burned it in the fire, and ground it to powder; and he scattered it on the water and made the children of Israel drink it.
verses.textEnNlt: He took the calf they had made and burned it. Then he ground it into powder, threw it into the water, and forced the people to drink it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took the calf which they had made and completely burned it with fire, and ground it to powder, and scattered it over the surface of the water and made the sons of Israel drink it.
verses.textEn: And he took the calf the people had made and burned it in the fire; then he ground it to powder, scattered it on the water and made the Israelites drink it.

verses.textZh: 摩西对亚伦说："这人民向你作了甚么，你竟使他们陷在大罪里呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对亚伦说："这人民向你作了甚么，你竟使他们陷在大罪里呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对亚伦说：「这百姓向你做了什么？你竟使他们陷在大罪里！」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to Aaron, "What did these people do to you, that you led them into such great sin?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to Aaron, "What did this people do to you that you have brought such a great sin upon them?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to Aaron, "What did this people do to you that you have brought so great a sin upon them?"
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, he turned to Aaron and demanded, "What did these people do to you to make you bring such terrible sin upon them?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to Aaron, "What did this people do to you, that you have brought such a great sin upon them?"
verses.textEn: He said to Aaron, "What did these people do to you, that you led them into such great sin?"

verses.textZh: 亚伦回答："求我主不要发烈怒，你知道这人民倾向罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦回答："求我主不要发烈怒，你知道这人民倾向罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦说：「求我主不要发烈怒。这百姓专于作恶，是你知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not be angry, my lord," Aaron answered. "You know how prone these people are to evil.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron said, "Let not the anger of my lord burn hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Aaron said, "Do not let the anger of my lord become hot. You know the people, that they areset on evil.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t get so upset, my lord," Aaron replied. "You yourself know how evil these people are.
verses.textEnNasb: And Aaron said, "Do not let the anger of my lord burn; you know the people yourself, that they are prone to evil.
verses.textEn: "Do not be angry, my lord," Aaron answered. "You know how prone these people are to evil.

verses.textZh: 他们对我说：‘给我们做神像，可以在我们前面引路，因为那摩西，就是把我们从埃及地领出来的那个人，我们不知道他遭遇了甚么事。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对我说：‘给我们做神像，可以在我们前面引路，因为那摩西，就是把我们从埃及地领出来的那个人，我们不知道他遭遇了甚么事。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对我说：『你为我们做神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。』
verses.textEnNiv: They said to me, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don’t know what has happened to him.’
verses.textEnEsv: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods who shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods that shall go before us; asfor this Moses, the man who brought us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.’
verses.textEnNlt: They said to me, ‘Make us gods who will lead us. We don’t know what happened to this fellow Moses, who brought us here from the land of Egypt.’
verses.textEnNasb: For they said to me, ‘Make a god for us who will go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us up from the land of Egypt—we do not know what happened to him.’
verses.textEn: They said to me, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don’t know what has happened to him.’

verses.textZh: 我对他们说：‘凡是有金子的，都可以摘下来’，他们就给了我；我把它丢在火里，这牛犊就出来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对他们说：‘凡是有金子的，都可以摘下来’，他们就给了我；我把它丢在火里，这牛犊就出来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我对他们说：『凡有金环的可以摘下来』，他们就给了我。我把金环扔在火中，这牛犊便出来了。」
verses.textEnNiv: So I told them, ‘Whoever has any gold jewelry, take it off.’ Then they gave me the gold, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf!"

verses.textEnNkjv: And I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them break it off.’ So they gave it to me, and I cast it into the fire, and this calf came out."
verses.textEnNlt: So I told them, ‘Whoever has gold jewelry, take it off.’ When they brought it to me, I simply threw it into the fire—and out came this calf!"
verses.textEnNasb: So I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them tear it off.’ Then they gave it to me, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf."
verses.textEn: So I told them, ‘Whoever has any gold jewelry, take it off.’ Then they gave me the gold, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf!"

verses.textZh: 摩西看见人民放肆原来是亚伦纵容他们，使他们成为那些起来与他们为敌的人的笑柄，

verses.textZhCuv: 摩西见百姓放肆（亚伦纵容他们，使他们在仇敌中间被讥刺），
verses.textEnNiv: Moses saw that the people were running wild and that Aaron had let them get out of control and so become a laughingstock to their enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Moses saw that the people had broken loose (for Aaron had let them break loose, to the derision of their enemies),
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Moses saw that the people were unrestrained (for Aaron had not restrained them, to their shame among their enemies),
verses.textEnNlt: Moses saw that Aaron had let the people get completely out of control, much to the amusement of their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Moses saw that the people were out of control—for Aaron had let them get out of control to the point of being an object of ridicule among their enemies—
verses.textEn: Moses saw that the people were running wild and that Aaron had let them get out of control and so become a laughingstock to their enemies.

verses.textZh: 就站在营门中，说："凡是属耶和华的，都可以到我这里来。"于是，所有利未的子孙都到他那里聚集。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就站在营门中，说："凡是属耶和华的，都可以到我这里来。"于是，所有利未的子孙都到他那里聚集。
verses.textZhCuv: 就站在营门中，说：「凡属耶和华的，都要到我这里来！」于是利未的子孙都到他那里聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: So he stood at the entrance to the camp and said, "Whoever is for the Lord , come to me." And all the Levites rallied to him.
verses.textEnEsv: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, "Who is on the Lord ’s side? Come to me." And all the sons of Levi gathered around him.
verses.textEnNkjv: then Moses stood in the entrance of the camp, and said, "Whoever is on the Lord’s side—come to me!" And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.
verses.textEnNlt: So he stood at the entrance to the camp and shouted, "All of you who are on the Lord ’s side, come here and join me." And all the Levites gathered around him.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses then stood at the gate of the camp, and said, "Whoever is for the Lord, come to me!" And all the sons of Levi gathered together to him.
verses.textEn: So he stood at the entrance to the camp and said, "Whoever is for the Lord , come to me." And all the Levites rallied to him.

verses.textZh: 摩西对他们说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们各人要把自己的剑佩在大腿上，在营中往来行走，从这门到那门；你们各人要杀自己的兄弟、邻舍和亲人。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对他们说："耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们各人要把自己的剑佩在大腿上，在营中往来行走，从这门到那门；你们各人要杀自己的兄弟、邻舍和亲人。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的神这样说：『你们各人把刀跨在腰间，在营中往来，从这门到那门，各人杀他的弟兄与同伴并邻舍。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Each man strap a sword to his side. Go back and forth through the camp from one end to the other, each killing his brother and friend and neighbor.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel, ‘Put your sword on your side each of you, and go to and fro from gate to gate throughout the camp, and each of you kill his brother and his companion and his neighbor.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to them, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘Let every man put his sword on his side, and go in and out from entrance to entrance throughout the camp, and let every man kill his brother, every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Moses told them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Each of you, take your swords and go back and forth from one end of the camp to the other. Kill everyone—even your brothers, friends, and neighbors."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them, "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Every man of you put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate in the camp, and kill every man his brother, and every man his friend, and every man his neighbor.’ "
verses.textEn: Then he said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Each man strap a sword to his side. Go back and forth through the camp from one end to the other, each killing his brother and friend and neighbor.’ "

verses.textZh: 利未的子孙照着摩西的话作了；那一天，人民中被杀的约有三千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未的子孙照着摩西的话作了；那一天，人民中被杀的约有三千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未的子孙照摩西的话行了。那一天百姓中被杀的约有三千。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people died.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. And that day about three thousand men of the people fell.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. And about three thousand men of the people fell that day.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites obeyed Moses’ command, and about 3,000 people died that day.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Levi did as Moses instructed, and about three thousand men of the people fell that day.
verses.textEn: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people died.

verses.textZh: 摩西说："今天你们要奉献自己归耶和华为圣，因为各人牺牲了自己的儿子和兄弟，好使耶和华今天赐福给你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："今天你们要奉献自己归耶和华为圣，因为各人牺牲了自己的儿子和兄弟，好使耶和华今天赐福给你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「今天你们要自洁，归耶和华为圣，各人攻击他的儿子和弟兄，使耶和华赐福与你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said, "You have been set apart to the Lord today, for you were against your own sons and brothers, and he has blessed you this day."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said, "Today you have been ordained for the service of the Lord , each one at the cost of his son and of his brother, so that he might bestow a blessing upon you this day."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said, "Consecrate yourselves today to the Lord, that He may bestow on you a blessing this day, for every man has opposed his son and his brother."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses told the Levites, "Today you have ordained yourselves for the service of the Lord , for you obeyed him even though it meant killing your own sons and brothers. Today you have earned a blessing."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said, " Dedicate yourselves today to the Lord—for every man has been against his son and against his brother—in order that He may bestow a blessing upon you today."
verses.textEn: Then Moses said, "You have been set apart to the Lord today, for you were against your own sons and brothers, and he has blessed you this day."

verses.textZh: 第二天，摩西对人民说："你们犯了大罪，现在我要上耶和华那里去，或者我可以为你们赎罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，摩西对人民说："你们犯了大罪，现在我要上耶和华那里去，或者我可以为你们赎罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了第二天，摩西对百姓说：「你们犯了大罪。我如今要上耶和华那里去，或者可以为你们赎罪。」
verses.textEnNiv: The next day Moses said to the people, "You have committed a great sin. But now I will go up to the Lord ; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin."
verses.textEnEsv: The next day Moses said to the people, "You have sinned a great sin. And now I will go up to the Lord ; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass on the next day that Moses said to the people, "You have committed a great sin. So now I will go up to the Lord; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin."
verses.textEnNlt: The next day Moses said to the people, "You have committed a terrible sin, but I will go back up to the Lord on the mountain. Perhaps I will be able to obtain forgiveness for your sin."
verses.textEnNasb: And on the next day Moses said to the people, "You yourselves have committed a great sin; and now I am going up to the Lord; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin."
verses.textEn: The next day Moses said to the people, "You have committed a great sin. But now I will go up to the Lord ; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin."

verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西回到耶和华那里，说："唉，这人民犯了大罪，为自己做了金神像。

verses.textEn: So Moses went back to the Lord and said, "Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made themselves gods of gold.

verses.textZh: 现在，如果你肯赦免他们的罪，那就好了；如果不肯，求你从你所写的册上把我涂抹吧。"

verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："谁得罪了我，我就要从我的册上把谁涂抹。

verses.textZh: 现在你去吧，领这人民到我吩咐你的地方去。看哪，我的使者必在你前面引路；只是在我追讨的日子，我必追讨他们的罪。"

verses.textZh: 耶和华击杀人民是因为他们敬拜亚伦做的牛犊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华击杀人民是因为他们敬拜亚伦做的牛犊。

verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord sent a great plague upon the people because they had worshiped the calf Aaron had made.

verses.textEn: And the Lord struck the people with a plague because of what they did with the calf Aaron had made.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你和你从埃及地领出来的人民要离开这里，上我曾经起誓应许给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的地去，我曾应许：‘我要把这地赐给你的后裔。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你和你从埃及地领出来的人民要离开这里，上我曾经起誓应许给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的地去，我曾应许：‘我要把这地赐给你的后裔。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「我曾起誓应许亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各说：『要将迦南地赐给你的后裔。』现在你和你从埃及地所领出来的百姓，要从这里往那地去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of Egypt, and go up to the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses, "Depart; go up from here, you and the people whom you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give it.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Depart and go up from here, you and the people whom you have brought out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, ‘To your descendants I will give it.’
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses, "Get going, you and the people you brought up from the land of Egypt. Go up to the land I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I told them, ‘I will give this land to your descendants.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, "Depart, go up from here, you and the people whom you have brought up from the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, ‘To your descendants I will give it.’
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of Egypt, and go up to the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’

verses.textZh: 我要差派使者在你前面；我要把迦南人、亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人赶出去，

verses.textEn: I will send an angel before you and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

verses.textZh: 你们要上那流奶与蜜的地方去；我不与你们一同上去，因为你们是硬着颈项的人民，免得我在路上把你们消灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要上那流奶与蜜的地方去；我不与你们一同上去，因为你们是硬着颈项的人民，免得我在路上把你们消灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 领你到那流奶与蜜之地。我自己不同你们上去；因为你们是硬着颈项的百姓，恐怕我在路上把你们灭绝。」
verses.textEnNiv: Go up to the land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people and I might destroy you on the way."
verses.textEnEsv: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, lest I consume you on the way, for you are a stiff-necked people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Goup to a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up in your midst, lest I consume you on the way, for you are a stiff-necked people."
verses.textEnNlt: Go up to this land that flows with milk and honey. But I will not travel among you, for you are a stubborn and rebellious people. If I did, I would surely destroy you along the way."
verses.textEnNasb: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up in your midst, because you are an obstinate people, and I might destroy you on the way."
verses.textEn: Go up to the land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people and I might destroy you on the way."

verses.textZh: 人民一听见这凶信，就悲伤起来，也没有人穿戴装饰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民一听见这凶信，就悲伤起来，也没有人穿戴装饰。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓听见这凶信就悲哀，也没有人佩戴妆饰。
verses.textEnNiv: When the people heard these distressing words, they began to mourn and no one put on any ornaments.
verses.textEnEsv: When the people heard this disastrous word, they mourned, and no one put on his ornaments.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the people heard this bad news, they mourned, and no one put on his ornaments.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people heard these stern words, they went into mourning and stopped wearing their jewelry and fine clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: When the people heard this sad word, they went into mourning, and none of them put on his jewelry.
verses.textEn: When the people heard these distressing words, they began to mourn and no one put on any ornaments.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对以色列人说：‘你们是硬着颈项的民；我若是霎时间与你们同行，我会把你们消灭的；所以，现在你们要把你们身上的装饰脱下来，使我知道我要怎样处置你们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要对以色列人说：‘你们是硬着颈项的民；我若是霎时间与你们同行，我会把你们消灭的；所以，现在你们要把你们身上的装饰脱下来，使我知道我要怎样处置你们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你告诉以色列人说：『耶和华说：你们是硬着颈项的百姓，我若一霎时临到你们中间，必灭绝你们。现在你们要把身上的妆饰摘下来，使我可以知道怎样待你们。』」
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord had said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go with you even for a moment, I might destroy you. Now take off your ornaments and I will decide what to do with you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord had said to Moses, "Say to the people of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people; if for a single moment I should go up among you, I would consume you. So now take off your ornaments, that I may know what to do with you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord had said to Moses, "Say to the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. I could come up into your midst in one moment and consume you. Now therefore, take off your ornaments, that I may know what to do to you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord had told Moses to tell them, "You are a stubborn and rebellious people. If I were to travel with you for even a moment, I would destroy you. Remove your jewelry and fine clothes while I decide what to do with you."
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord had said to Moses, "Say to the sons of Israel, ‘You are an obstinate people; if I were to go up in your midst for just one moment, I would destroy you. So now, take off your jewelry that I may know what I shall do to you.’ "
verses.textEn: For the Lord had said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go with you even for a moment, I might destroy you. Now take off your ornaments and I will decide what to do with you.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是，以色列人离开何烈山以后，就把身上的装饰脱下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以色列人离开何烈山以后，就把身上的装饰脱下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人从住何烈山以后，就把身上的妆饰摘得干净。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Israelites stripped off their ornaments at Mount Horeb.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the people of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments, from Mount Horeb onward.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by Mount Horeb.
verses.textEnNlt: So from the time they left Mount Sinai, the Israelites wore no more jewelry or fine clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry, from Mount Horeb onward.
verses.textEn: So the Israelites stripped off their ornaments at Mount Horeb.

verses.textZh: 摩西一向把会幕支搭在营外，离营远些；摩西称它为会幕。凡是寻求耶和华的，就出到营外的会幕那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西一向把会幕支搭在营外，离营远些；摩西称它为会幕。凡是寻求耶和华的，就出到营外的会幕那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西素常将帐棚支搭在营外，离营却远，他称这帐棚为会幕。凡求问耶和华的，就到营外的会幕那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Moses used to take a tent and pitch it outside the camp some distance away, calling it the "tent of meeting." Anyone inquiring of the Lord would go to the tent of meeting outside the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far off from the camp, and he called it the tent of meeting. And everyone who sought the Lord would go out to the tent of meeting, which was outside the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moses took his tent and pitched it outside the camp, far from the camp, and called it the tabernacle of meeting. And it came to pass that everyone who sought the Lord went out to the tabernacle of meeting which was outside the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: It was Moses’ practice to take the Tent of Meeting and set it up some distance from the camp. Everyone who wanted to make a request of the Lord would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, a good distance from the camp, and he called it the tent of meeting. And everyone who sought the Lord would go out to the tent of meeting which was outside the camp.
verses.textEn: Now Moses used to take a tent and pitch it outside the camp some distance away, calling it the "tent of meeting." Anyone inquiring of the Lord would go to the tent of meeting outside the camp.

verses.textZh: 摩西出营到会幕去的时候，全体的人民都起来，各人站在自己帐幕的门口，望着摩西，直到他进了会幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西出营到会幕去的时候，全体的人民都起来，各人站在自己帐幕的门口，望着摩西，直到他进了会幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 当摩西出营到会幕去的时候，百姓就都起来，各人站在自己帐棚的门口，望着摩西，直等到他进了会幕。
verses.textEnNiv: And whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people rose and stood at the entrances to their tents, watching Moses until he entered the tent.
verses.textEnEsv: Whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would rise up, and each would stand at his tent door, and watch Moses until he had gone into the tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, whenever Moses went out to the tabernacle, that all the people rose, and each man stood at his tent door and watched Moses until he had gone into the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever Moses went out to the Tent of Meeting, all the people would get up and stand in the entrances of their own tents. They would all watch Moses until he disappeared inside.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, whenever Moses went out to the tent, that all the people would arise and stand, each at the entrance of his tent, and gaze after Moses until he entered the tent.
verses.textEn: And whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people rose and stood at the entrances to their tents, watching Moses until he entered the tent.

verses.textZh: 摩西进会幕的时候，就有云柱降下来，停在会幕门口上面；耶和华就与摩西谈话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西进会幕的时候，就有云柱降下来，停在会幕门口上面；耶和华就与摩西谈话。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西进会幕的时候，云柱降下来，立在会幕的门前，耶和华便与摩西说话。
verses.textEnNiv: As Moses went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and stay at the entrance, while the Lord spoke with Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: When Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would descend and stand at the entrance of the tent, and the Lord would speak with Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when Moses entered the tabernacle, that the pillar of cloud descended and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and theLord talked with Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: As he went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and hover at its entrance while the Lord spoke with Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Whenever Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would descend and stand at the entrance of the tent; and the Lord would speak with Moses.
verses.textEn: As Moses went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and stay at the entrance, while the Lord spoke with Moses.

verses.textZh: 全体的人民看见了云柱停在会幕门口上面，就都起来，各人在自己帐幕的门口下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体的人民看见了云柱停在会幕门口上面，就都起来，各人在自己帐幕的门口下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 众百姓看见云柱立在会幕门前，就都起来，各人在自己帐棚的门口下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they all stood and worshiped, each at the entrance to their tent.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, all the people would rise up and worship, each at his tent door.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the tabernacle door, and all the people rose and worshiped, each man in his tent door.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people saw the cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, they would stand and bow down in front of their own tents.
verses.textEnNasb: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, all the people would stand and worship, each at the entrance of his tent.
verses.textEn: Whenever the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they all stood and worshiped, each at the entrance to their tent.

verses.textZh: 耶和华与摩西面对面说话，好象人对朋友说话一样。然后，摩西回到营里去，只有他的侍从，一个少年人，就是嫩的儿子约书亚，不离开会幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华与摩西面对面说话，好象人对朋友说话一样。然后，摩西回到营里去，只有他的侍从，一个少年人，就是嫩的儿子约书亚，不离开会幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华与摩西面对面说话，好像人与朋友说话一般。摩西转到营里去，惟有他的帮手－一个少年人嫩的儿子约书亚不离开会幕。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord would speak to Moses face to face, as one speaks to a friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young aide Joshua son of Nun did not leave the tent.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the Lord used to speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. When Moses turned again into the camp, his assistant Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. And he would return to the camp, but his servant Joshua the son of Nun, a young man, did not depart from the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Inside the Tent of Meeting, the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, as one speaks to a friend. Afterward Moses would return to the camp, but the young man who assisted him, Joshua son of Nun, would remain behind in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord used to speak to Moses face to face, just as a man speaks to his friend. When Moses returned to the camp, his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tent.
verses.textEn: The Lord would speak to Moses face to face, as one speaks to a friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young aide Joshua son of Nun did not leave the tent.

verses.textZh: 摩西对耶和华说："看，你吩咐我说：‘把这百姓领上去’，可是你却没有让我知道你要差派谁与我同去；只是你曾经说过：‘我按着你的名字认识你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对耶和华说："看，你吩咐我说：‘把这百姓领上去’，可是你却没有让我知道你要差派谁与我同去；只是你曾经说过：‘我按着你的名字认识你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。’
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对耶和华说：「你吩咐我说：『将这百姓领上去』，却没有叫我知道你要打发谁与我同去，只说：『我按你的名认识你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。』
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to the Lord , "You have been telling me, ‘Lead these people,’ but you have not let me know whom you will send with me. You have said, ‘I know you by name and you have found favor with me.’
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said to the Lord , "See, you say to me, ‘Bring up this people,’ but you have not let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said to the Lord, "See, You say to me, ‘Bring up this people.’ But You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found grace in My sight.’
verses.textEnNlt: One day Moses said to the Lord , "You have been telling me, ‘Take these people up to the Promised Land.’ But you haven’t told me whom you will send with me. You have told me, ‘I know you by name, and I look favorably on you.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to the Lord, "See, You say to me, ‘Bring up this people!’ But You Yourself have not let me know whom You will send with me. Moreover, You have said, ‘I have known you by name, and you have also found favor in My sight.’
verses.textEn: Moses said to the Lord , "You have been telling me, ‘Lead these people,’ but you have not let me know whom you will send with me. You have said, ‘I know you by name and you have found favor with me.’

verses.textZh: 现在我若是在你眼前蒙恩，求你把你的道路指示我，使我可以认识你，可以在你眼前蒙恩；也求你想到这民族是你的人民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我若是在你眼前蒙恩，求你把你的道路指示我，使我可以认识你，可以在你眼前蒙恩；也求你想到这民族是你的人民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我如今若在你眼前蒙恩，求你将你的道指示我，使我可以认识你，好在你眼前蒙恩。求你想到这民是你的民。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you are pleased with me, teach me your ways so I may know you and continue to find favor with you. Remember that this nation is your people."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me now your ways, that I may know you in order to find favor in your sight. Consider too that this nation is your people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, I pray, if I have found grace in Your sight, show me now Your way, that I may know You and that I may find grace in Your sight. And consider that this nation is Your people."
verses.textEnNlt: If it is true that you look favorably on me, let me know your ways so I may understand you more fully and continue to enjoy your favor. And remember that this nation is your very own people."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, if I have found favor in Your sight in any way, please let me know Your ways so that I may know You, in order that I may find favor in Your sight. Consider too, that this nation is Your people."
verses.textEn: If you are pleased with me, teach me your ways so I may know you and continue to find favor with you. Remember that this nation is your people."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我必亲自与你同去，也必给你安息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我必亲自与你同去，也必给你安息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我必亲自和你同去，使你得安息。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord replied, "My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "My Presence will go withyou, and I will give you rest."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied, "I will personally go with you, Moses, and I will give you rest—everything will be fine for you."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "My presence shall go with you, and I will give you rest."
verses.textEn: The Lord replied, "My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest."

verses.textZh: 摩西对他说："你若是不亲自与我们同去，就不要把我们从这里领上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对他说："你若是不亲自与我们同去，就不要把我们从这里领上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「你若不亲自和我同去，就不要把我们从这里领上去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said to him, "If your Presence does not go with us, do not send us up from here.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "If your presence will not go with me, do not bring us up from here.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to Him, "If Your Presence does not go withus, do not bring us up from here.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said, "If you don’t personally go with us, don’t make us leave this place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to Him, "If Your presence does not go with us, do not lead us up from here.
verses.textEn: Then Moses said to him, "If your Presence does not go with us, do not send us up from here.

verses.textZh: 人在甚么事上可以知道我和你的人民在你眼前蒙恩呢？不是因为你与我们同去，使我和你的人民可以和地上所有的人有分别吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人在甚么事上可以知道我和你的人民在你眼前蒙恩呢？不是因为你与我们同去，使我和你的人民可以和地上所有的人有分别吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 人在何事上得以知道我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩呢？岂不是因你与我们同去、使我和你的百姓与地上的万民有分别吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me and with your people unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people from all the other people on the face of the earth?"
verses.textEnEsv: For how shall it be known that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Is it not in your going with us, so that we are distinct, I and your people, from every other people on the face of the earth?"
verses.textEnNkjv: For how then will it be known that Your people and I have found grace in Your sight, except You go with us? So we shall be separate, Your people and I, from all the people who are upon the face of the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: How will anyone know that you look favorably on me—on me and on your people—if you don’t go with us? For your presence among us sets your people and me apart from all other people on the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: For how then can it be known that I have found favor in Your sight, I and Your people? Is it not by Your going with us, so that we, I and Your people, may be distinguished from all the other people who are on the face of the earth?"
verses.textEn: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me and with your people unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people from all the other people on the face of the earth?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你所说的这件事我也要作，因为你在我眼前蒙恩，并且我按着你的名字认识了你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你所说的这件事我也要作，因为你在我眼前蒙恩，并且我按着你的名字认识了你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你这所求的我也要行；因为你在我眼前蒙了恩，并且我按你的名认识你。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said to Moses, "I will do the very thing you have asked, because I am pleased with you and I know you by name."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "This very thing that you have spoken I will do, for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to Moses, "I will also do this thing that you have spoken; for you have found grace in My sight, and I know you by name."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied to Moses, "I will indeed do what you have asked, for I look favorably on you, and I know you by name."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to Moses, "I will also do this thing of which you have spoken; for you have found favor in My sight and I have known you by name."
verses.textEn: And the Lord said to Moses, "I will do the very thing you have asked, because I am pleased with you and I know you by name."

verses.textZh: 摩西说："求你给我看看你的荣耀。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："求你给我看看你的荣耀。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「求你显出你的荣耀给我看。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said, "Now show me your glory."
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said, "Please show me your glory."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Please, show me Your glory."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses responded, "Then show me your glorious presence."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said, "Please, show me Your glory!"
verses.textEn: Then Moses said, "Now show me your glory."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我要使我的一切美善都在你面前经过，并且要把我的名字耶和华在你面前宣告出来；我要恩待谁，就恩待谁；我要怜悯谁，就怜悯谁。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我要使我的一切美善都在你面前经过，并且要把我的名字耶和华在你面前宣告出来；我要恩待谁，就恩待谁；我要怜悯谁，就怜悯谁。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我要显我一切的恩慈，在你面前经过，宣告我的名。我要恩待谁就恩待谁；要怜悯谁就怜悯谁」；
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said, "I will cause all my goodness to pass in front of you, and I will proclaim my name, the Lord , in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "I will make all my goodness pass before you and will proclaim before you my name ‘The Lord .’ And I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said, "I will make all My goodness pass before you, and I will proclaim the name of the Lord before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied, "I will make all my goodness pass before you, and I will call out my name, Yahweh, before you. For I will show mercy to anyone I choose, and I will show compassion to anyone I choose.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "I Myself will make all My goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the name of the Lord before you; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show compassion to whom I will show compassion."
verses.textEn: And the Lord said, "I will cause all my goodness to pass in front of you, and I will proclaim my name, the Lord , in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

verses.textZh: 他又说："你不能看我的脸，因为没有人看见了我还能活着。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又说："你不能看我的脸，因为没有人看见了我还能活着。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「你不能看见我的面，因为人见我的面不能存活。」
verses.textEnNiv: But," he said, "you cannot see my face, for no one may see me and live."
verses.textEnEsv: But," he said, "you cannot see my face, for man shall not see me and live."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said, "You cannot see My face; for no man shall see Me, and live."
verses.textEnNlt: But you may not look directly at my face, for no one may see me and live."
verses.textEnNasb: He further said, "You cannot see My face, for mankind shall not see Me and live!"
verses.textEn: But," he said, "you cannot see my face, for no one may see me and live."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："看哪，我这里有个地方，你要站在盘石上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："看哪，我这里有个地方，你要站在盘石上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「看哪，在我这里有地方，你要站在磐石上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said, "There is a place near me where you may stand on a rock.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "Behold, there is a place by me where you shall stand on the rock,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "Here is a place by Me, and you shall stand on the rock.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord continued, "Look, stand near me on this rock.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said, "Behold, there is a place by Me, and you shall stand there on the rock;
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said, "There is a place near me where you may stand on a rock.

verses.textZh: 我的荣耀经过的时候，我要把你放在盘石隙中，我要用我的手掌遮盖你，直到我过去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的荣耀经过的时候，我要把你放在盘石隙中，我要用我的手掌遮盖你，直到我过去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的荣耀经过的时候，我必将你放在磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，等我过去，
verses.textEnNiv: When my glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft in the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.
verses.textEnEsv: and while my glory passes by I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and I will cover you with my hand until I have passed by.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it shall be, while My glory passes by, that I will put you in the cleft of the rock, and will cover you with My hand while I pass by.
verses.textEnNlt: As my glorious presence passes by, I will hide you in the crevice of the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.
verses.textEnNasb: and it will come about, while My glory is passing by, that I will put you in the cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand until I have passed by.
verses.textEn: When my glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft in the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.

verses.textZh: 然后，我要收回我的手掌，你就会看见我的背后，却不能看见我的脸。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，我要收回我的手掌，你就会看见我的背后，却不能看见我的脸。"
verses.textZhCuv: 然后我要将我的手收回，你就得见我的背，却不得见我的面。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will remove my hand and you will see my back; but my face must not be seen."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I will take away my hand, and you shall see my back, but my face shall not be seen."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will take away My hand, and you shall see My back; but My face shall not be seen."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will remove my hand and let you see me from behind. But my face will not be seen."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will take My hand away and you shall see My back, but My face shall not be seen."
verses.textEn: Then I will remove my hand and you will see my back; but my face must not be seen."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要凿出两块石版，好象先前的一样，我要把先前写在你摔碎了的石版上的字写在这两块石版上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要凿出两块石版，好象先前的一样，我要把先前写在你摔碎了的石版上的字写在这两块石版上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你要凿出两块石版，和先前你摔碎的那版一样；其上的字我要写在这版上。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses, "Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Cut two tablets of stone like the first ones, and I will write on these tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told Moses, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones. I will write on them the same words that were on the tablets you smashed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Moses, "Cut out for yourself two stone tablets like the former ones, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the former tablets which you smashed.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

verses.textZh: 早晨之前，你要预备好了；到早晨的时候，你要上到西奈山来，在山顶上站在我面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 早晨之前，你要预备好了；到早晨的时候，你要上到西奈山来，在山顶上站在我面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 明日早晨，你要预备好了，上西奈山，在山顶上站在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Be ready in the morning, and then come up on Mount Sinai. Present yourself to me there on top of the mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: So be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself to Me there on the top of the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: Be ready in the morning to climb up Mount Sinai and present yourself to me on the top of the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: So be ready by morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to Me on the top of the mountain.
verses.textEn: Be ready in the morning, and then come up on Mount Sinai. Present yourself to me there on top of the mountain.

verses.textZh: 谁也不准同你一起上来，整个山都不准有人出现，也不准牛羊在这山前吃草。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁也不准同你一起上来，整个山都不准有人出现，也不准牛羊在这山前吃草。"
verses.textZhCuv: 谁也不可和你一同上去，遍山都不可有人，在山根也不可叫羊群牛群吃草。」
verses.textEnNiv: No one is to come with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain; not even the flocks and herds may graze in front of the mountain."
verses.textEnEsv: No one shall come up with you, and let no one be seen throughout all the mountain. Let no flocks or herds graze opposite that mountain."
verses.textEnNkjv: And no man shall come up with you, and let no man be seen throughout all the mountain; let neither flocks nor herds feed before that mountain."
verses.textEnNlt: No one else may come with you. In fact, no one is to appear anywhere on the mountain. Do not even let the flocks or herds graze near the mountain."
verses.textEnNasb: And no one is to come up with you, nor let anyone be seen anywhere on the mountain; even the flocks and the herds are not to graze in front of that mountain."
verses.textEn: No one is to come with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain; not even the flocks and herds may graze in front of the mountain."

verses.textZh: 摩西就凿了两块石版，好象先前的一样。他一早起来，照着耶和华吩咐他的，上到西奈山去，手里拿着两块石版。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就凿了两块石版，好象先前的一样。他一早起来，照着耶和华吩咐他的，上到西奈山去，手里拿着两块石版。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就凿出两块石版，和先前的一样。清晨起来，照耶和华所吩咐的上西奈山去，手里拿着两块石版。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones and went up Mount Sinai early in the morning, as the Lord had commanded him; and he carried the two stone tablets in his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses cut two tablets of stone like the first. And he rose early in the morning and went up on Mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand two tablets of stone.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he cut two tablets of stone like the first ones. Then Moses rose early in the morning and went up Mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him; and he took in his hand the two tablets of stone.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses chiseled out two tablets of stone like the first ones. Early in the morning he climbed Mount Sinai as the Lord had commanded him, and he carried the two stone tablets in his hands.
verses.textEnNasb: So he cut out two stone tablets like the former ones, and Moses got up early in the morning and went up to Mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and he took the two stone tablets in his hand.
verses.textEn: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones and went up Mount Sinai early in the morning, as the Lord had commanded him; and he carried the two stone tablets in his hands.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在云彩中降下来，与摩西一同站在那里，并且宣告耶和华的名字。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在云彩中降下来，与摩西一同站在那里，并且宣告耶和华的名字。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在云中降临，和摩西一同站在那里，宣告耶和华的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and stood there with him and proclaimed his name, the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord descended in the cloud and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord descended in the cloud and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord came down in a cloud and stood there with him; and he called out his own name, Yahweh.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord descended in the cloud and stood there with him as he called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and stood there with him and proclaimed his name, the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华在摩西面前经过，并且宣告说："耶和华，耶和华，是有怜悯有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并且有丰盛的慈爱和诚实，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在摩西面前经过，并且宣告说："耶和华，耶和华，是有怜悯有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并且有丰盛的慈爱和诚实，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在他面前宣告说：「耶和华，耶和华，是有怜悯有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实，
verses.textEnNiv: And he passed in front of Moses, proclaiming, "The Lord , the Lord , the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord passed before him and proclaimed, "The Lord , the Lord , a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord passed before him and proclaimed, "The Lord, the Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abounding in goodness and truth,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord passed in front of Moses, calling out, "Yahweh! The Lord ! The God of compassion and mercy! I am slow to anger and filled with unfailing love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord passed by in front of him and proclaimed, "The Lord, the Lord God, compassionate and merciful, slow to anger, and abounding in faithfulness and truth;
verses.textEn: And he passed in front of Moses, proclaiming, "The Lord , the Lord , the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness,

verses.textZh: 为千千万万人留下慈爱，赦免罪孽、过犯和罪恶。一定要清除罪，追讨罪孽自父及子至孙，直到三四代。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 为千千万万人留下慈爱，赦免罪孽、过犯和罪恶。一定要清除罪，追讨罪孽自父及子至孙，直到三四代。"
verses.textZhCuv: 为千万人存留慈爱，赦免罪孽、过犯，和罪恶，万不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。」
verses.textEnNiv: maintaining love to thousands, and forgiving wickedness, rebellion and sin. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children and their children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation."
verses.textEnEsv: keeping steadfast love for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, but who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and the children’s children, to the third and the fourth generation."
verses.textEnNkjv: keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, by no means clearing theguilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children and the children’s children to the third and the fourth generation."
verses.textEnNlt: I lavish unfailing love to a thousand generations. I forgive iniquity, rebellion, and sin. But I do not excuse the guilty. I lay the sins of the parents upon their children and grandchildren; the entire family is affected— even children in the third and fourth generations."
verses.textEnNasb: who keeps faithfulness for thousands, who forgives wrongdoing, violation of His Law, and sin; yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished, inflicting the punishment of fathers on the children and on the grandchildren to the third and fourth generations."
verses.textEn: maintaining love to thousands, and forgiving wickedness, rebellion and sin. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children and their children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation."

verses.textZh: 摩西急忙俯首在地敬拜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西急忙俯首在地敬拜，
