verses.textZhCuv: 摩西急忙伏地下拜，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses bowed to the ground at once and worshiped.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses quickly bowed his head toward the earth and worshiped.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses made haste and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses immediately threw himself to the ground and worshiped.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses hurried to bow low toward the ground and worship.
verses.textEn: Moses bowed to the ground at once and worshiped.

verses.textZh: 说："主啊，我若是在你眼前蒙恩，求我主与我们同行，因为这是硬着颈项的人民。又求你赦免我们的罪孽和我们的罪恶，把我们当作你的产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："主啊，我若是在你眼前蒙恩，求我主与我们同行，因为这是硬着颈项的人民。又求你赦免我们的罪孽和我们的罪恶，把我们当作你的产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「主啊，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在我们中间同行，因为这是硬着颈项的百姓。又求你赦免我们的罪孽和罪恶，以我们为你的产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Lord," he said, "if I have found favor in your eyes, then let the Lord go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our wickedness and our sin, and take us as your inheritance."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "If now I have found favor in your sight, O Lord, please let the Lord go in the midst of us, for it is a stiff-necked people, and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "If now I have found grace in Your sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray, go among us, even though we are a stiff-necked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us as Your inheritance."
verses.textEnNlt: And he said, "O Lord, if it is true that I have found favor with you, then please travel with us. Yes, this is a stubborn and rebellious people, but please forgive our iniquity and our sins. Claim us as your own special possession."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "If in any way I have found favor in Your sight, Lord, please may the Lord go along in our midst, even though the people are so obstinate, and pardon our wrongdoing and our sin, and take us as Your own possession."
verses.textEn: "Lord," he said, "if I have found favor in your eyes, then let the Lord go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our wickedness and our sin, and take us as your inheritance."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："看哪，我要立约，我要在你全体的人民面前作奇妙的事，是在全地万国中没有行过的。在你四周的万民都必看见耶和华的作为，因为我向你所行的是可畏惧的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："看哪，我要立约，我要在你全体的人民面前作奇妙的事，是在全地万国中没有行过的。在你四周的万民都必看见耶和华的作为，因为我向你所行的是可畏惧的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我要立约，要在百姓面前行奇妙的事，是在遍地万国中所未曾行的。在你四围的外邦人就要看见耶和华的作为，因我向你所行的是可畏惧的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said: "I am making a covenant with you. Before all your people I will do wonders never before done in any nation in all the world. The people you live among will see how awesome is the work that I, the Lord , will do for you.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Behold, I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been created in all the earth or in any nation. And all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the Lord , for it is an awesome thing that I will do with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said: "Behold, I make a covenant. Before all your people I will do marvels such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of the Lord. For it is an awesome thing that I will do with you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied, "Listen, I am making a covenant with you in the presence of all your people. I will perform miracles that have never been performed anywhere in all the earth or in any nation. And all the people around you will see the power of the Lord —the awesome power I will display for you.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, "Behold, I am going to make a covenant. Before all your people I will perform miracles which have not been produced in all the earth nor among any of the nations; and all the people among whom you live will see the working of the Lord, for it is a fearful thing that I am going to perform with you.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said: "I am making a covenant with you. Before all your people I will do wonders never before done in any nation in all the world. The people you live among will see how awesome is the work that I, the Lord , will do for you.

verses.textZh: 我今天吩咐你的，你务要遵守。看哪，我要把亚摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，从你面前赶逐出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我今天吩咐你的，你务要遵守。看哪，我要把亚摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，从你面前赶逐出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我今天所吩咐你的，你要谨守。我要从你面前撵出亚摩利人、迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人。
verses.textEnNiv: Obey what I command you today. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
verses.textEnEsv: "Observe what I command you this day. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Observe what I command you this day. Behold, I am driving out from before you the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNlt: But listen carefully to everything I command you today. Then I will go ahead of you and drive out the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
verses.textEnNasb: " Be sure to comply with what I am commanding you this day: behold, I am going to drive out the Amorite from you, and the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.textEn: Obey what I command you today. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

verses.textZh: 你要小心，不可与你所去的那地的居民立约，恐怕这事在你中间成为陷阱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要小心，不可与你所去的那地的居民立约，恐怕这事在你中间成为陷阱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要谨慎，不可与你所去那地的居民立约，恐怕成为你们中间的网罗；
verses.textEnNiv: Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land where you are going, or they will be a snare among you.
verses.textEnEsv: Take care, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which you go, lest it become a snare in your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take heed to yourself, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be a snare in your midst.
verses.textEnNlt: "Be very careful never to make a treaty with the people who live in the land where you are going. If you do, you will follow their evil ways and be trapped.
verses.textEnNasb: Be careful that you do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land into which you are going, or it will become a snare in your midst.
verses.textEn: Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land where you are going, or they will be a snare among you.

verses.textZh: 他们的祭坛你们却要拆毁，他们的柱像你们要打碎，他们的亚舍拉你们要砍下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的祭坛你们却要拆毁，他们的柱像你们要打碎，他们的亚舍拉你们要砍下。
verses.textZhCuv: 却要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，砍下他们的木偶。
verses.textEnNiv: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and cut down their Asherah poles.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall tear down their altars and break their pillars and cut down their Asherim
verses.textEnNkjv: But you shall destroy their altars, break their sacred pillars, and cut down their wooden images
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, you must break down their pagan altars, smash their sacred pillars, and cut down their Asherah poles.
verses.textEnNasb: But rather, you are to tear down their altars and smash their memorial stones, and cut down their Asherim
verses.textEn: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and cut down their Asherah poles.

verses.textZh: 你不可敬拜别的神，因为耶和华是忌邪的神，他名为忌邪者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可敬拜别的神，因为耶和华是忌邪的神，他名为忌邪者。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可敬拜别神；因为耶和华是忌邪的神，名为忌邪者。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not worship any other god, for the Lord , whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
verses.textEnEsv: (for you shall worship no other god, for the Lord , whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God),
verses.textEnNkjv: (for you shall worship no other god, for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God),
verses.textEnNlt: You must worship no other gods, for the Lord , whose very name is Jealous, is a God who is jealous about his relationship with you.
verses.textEnNasb: —for you shall not worship any other god, because the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God—
verses.textEn: Do not worship any other god, for the Lord , whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

verses.textZh: 恐怕你与那地的居民立约，他们随从自己的神行邪淫，给自己的神献祭的时候，有人叫你，你就吃他的祭物；
verses.textZhCnvs: 恐怕你与那地的居民立约，他们随从自己的神行邪淫，给自己的神献祭的时候，有人叫你，你就吃他的祭物；
verses.textZhCuv: 只怕你与那地的居民立约，百姓随从他们的神，就行邪淫，祭祀他们的神，有人叫你，你便吃他的祭物，
verses.textEnNiv: "Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land; for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you and you will eat their sacrifices.
verses.textEnEsv: lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and when they whore after their gods and sacrifice to their gods and you are invited, you eat of his sacrifice,
verses.textEnNkjv: lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they play the harlot with their gods and make sacrifice to their gods, and oneofthem invites you and you eat of his sacrifice,
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not make a treaty of any kind with the people living in the land. They lust after their gods, offering sacrifices to them. They will invite you to join them in their sacrificial meals, and you will go with them.
verses.textEnNasb: otherwise you might make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they would prostitute themselves with their gods and sacrifice to their gods, and someone might invite you to eat of his sacrifice,
verses.textEn: "Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land; for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you and you will eat their sacrifices.

verses.textZh: 又恐怕你给你的儿子娶他们的女儿为妻，他们的女儿随从自己的神行邪淫的时候，使你的儿子也随从她们的神行邪淫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又恐怕你给你的儿子娶他们的女儿为妻，他们的女儿随从自己的神行邪淫的时候，使你的儿子也随从她们的神行邪淫。
verses.textZhCuv: 又为你的儿子娶他们的女儿为妻，他们的女儿随从她们的神，就行邪淫，使你的儿子也随从她们的神行邪淫。
verses.textEnNiv: And when you choose some of their daughters as wives for your sons and those daughters prostitute themselves to their gods, they will lead your sons to do the same.
verses.textEnEsv: and you take of their daughters for your sons, and their daughters whore after their gods and make your sons whore after their gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you take of his daughters for your sons, and his daughters play the harlot with their gods and make your sons play the harlot with their gods.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will accept their daughters, who sacrifice to other gods, as wives for your sons. And they will seduce your sons to commit adultery against me by worshiping other gods.
verses.textEnNasb: and you might take some of his daughters for your sons, and his daughters might prostitute themselves with their gods and cause your sons also to prostitute themselves with their gods.
verses.textEn: And when you choose some of their daughters as wives for your sons and those daughters prostitute themselves to their gods, they will lead your sons to do the same.

verses.textZh: 你不可为自己铸造神像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可为自己铸造神像。
verses.textZhCuv: 「不可为自己铸造神像。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not make any idols.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not make for yourself any gods of cast metal.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall make no molded gods for yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: You must not make any gods of molten metal for yourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not make for yourself any gods cast in metal.
verses.textEn: "Do not make any idols.

verses.textZh: "你要守除酵节，要照着我吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的时期吃无酵饼七天，因为你是在亚笔月从埃及出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要守除酵节，要照着我吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的时期吃无酵饼七天，因为你是在亚笔月从埃及出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期吃无酵饼七天，因为你是这亚笔月内出了埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: "Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Aviv, for in that month you came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib, for in the month Abib you came out from Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Feast of Unleavened Bread you shall keep. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, in the appointed time of the month of Abib; for in the month of Abib you came out from Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days the bread you eat must be made without yeast, just as I commanded you. Celebrate this festival annually at the appointed time in early spring, in the month of Abib, for that is the anniversary of your departure from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days you are to eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Abib; for in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt.
verses.textEn: "Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Aviv, for in that month you came out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 凡是头胎的都是我的；你的牲畜中，无论是牛或羊，凡是公的和头生的，都是我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是头胎的都是我的；你的牲畜中，无论是牛或羊，凡是公的和头生的，都是我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡头生的都是我的；一切牲畜头生的，无论是牛是羊，公的都是我的。
verses.textEnNiv: "The first offspring of every womb belongs to me, including all the firstborn males of your livestock, whether from herd or flock.
verses.textEnEsv: All that open the womb are mine, all your male livestock, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: "All that open the womb are Mine, and every male firstborn among your livestock, whether ox or sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: "The firstborn of every animal belongs to me, including the firstborn males from your herds of cattle and your flocks of sheep and goats.
verses.textEnNasb: "The firstborn from every womb belongs to Me, and all your male livestock, the firstborn from cattle and sheep.
verses.textEn: "The first offspring of every womb belongs to me, including all the firstborn males of your livestock, whether from herd or flock.

verses.textZh: 头生的驴，你要用羊代赎，如果不代赎，就要打断牠的颈项。你所有头胎的儿子，你都要代赎出来。没有人可以空手见我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 头生的驴，你要用羊代赎，如果不代赎，就要打断牠的颈项。你所有头胎的儿子，你都要代赎出来。没有人可以空手见我。
verses.textZhCuv: 头生的驴要用羊羔代赎，若不代赎就要打折它的颈项。凡头生的儿子都要赎出来。谁也不可空手朝见我。
verses.textEnNiv: Redeem the firstborn donkey with a lamb, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem all your firstborn sons. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.
verses.textEnEsv: The firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb, or if you will not redeem it you shall break its neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. And none shall appear before me empty-handed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb. And if you will not redeem him, then you shall break his neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. "And none shall appear before Me empty-handed.
verses.textEnNlt: A firstborn donkey may be bought back from the Lord by presenting a lamb or young goat in its place. But if you do not buy it back, you must break its neck. However, you must buy back every firstborn son. "No one may appear before me without an offering.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall redeem with a lamb the firstborn from a donkey; and if you do not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. None are to appear before Me empty-handed.
verses.textEn: Redeem the firstborn donkey with a lamb, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem all your firstborn sons. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

verses.textZh: "你六日要工作，但第七天你要休息，在耕种和收割的时候，也要休息。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你六日要工作，但第七天你要休息，在耕种和收割的时候，也要休息。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你六日要做工，第七日要安息，虽在耕种收割的时候也要安息。
verses.textEnNiv: "Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even during the plowing season and harvest you must rest.
verses.textEnEsv: "Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest. In plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest; in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.
verses.textEnNlt: "You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but on the seventh day you must stop working, even during the seasons of plowing and harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall work six days, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even during plowing time and harvest you shall rest.
verses.textEn: "Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even during the plowing season and harvest you must rest.

verses.textZh: 在收割初熟麦子的时候，你要守七七节；在年底，你要过收藏节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在收割初熟麦子的时候，你要守七七节；在年底，你要过收藏节。
verses.textZhCuv: 在收割初熟麦子的时候要守七七节；又在年底要守收藏节。
verses.textEnNiv: "Celebrate the Festival of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Festival of Ingathering at the turn of the year.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall observe the Feast of Weeks, the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the year’s end.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall observe the Feast of Weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the year’s end.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must celebrate the Festival of Harvest with the first crop of the wheat harvest, and celebrate the Festival of the Final Harvest at the end of the harvest season.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks, that is, the first fruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.
verses.textEn: "Celebrate the Festival of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Festival of Ingathering at the turn of the year.

verses.textZh: 你所有的男子，都要一年三次去见主耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所有的男子，都要一年三次去见主耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们一切男丁要一年三次朝见主耶和华－以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Three times in the year shall all your males appear before the Lord God , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Three times in the year all your men shall appear before the Lord, the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Three times each year every man in Israel must appear before the Sovereign, the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 我要把列国从你面前赶出去，扩张你的境界；你一年三次上去面见耶和华你的神的时候，必没有人贪图你的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把列国从你面前赶出去，扩张你的境界；你一年三次上去面见耶和华你的神的时候，必没有人贪图你的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要从你面前赶出外邦人，扩张你的境界。你一年三次上去朝见耶和华－你神的时候，必没有人贪慕你的地土。
verses.textEnNiv: I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your territory, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times each year to appear before the Lord your God.
verses.textEnEsv: For I will cast out nations before you and enlarge your borders; no one shall covet your land, when you go up to appear before the Lord your God three times in the year.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will cast out the nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither will any man covet your land when you go up to appear before the Lord your God three times in the year.
verses.textEnNlt: I will drive out the other nations ahead of you and expand your territory, so no one will covet and conquer your land while you appear before the Lord your God three times each year.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will drive out nations from you and enlarge your borders, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times a year to appear before the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your territory, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times each year to appear before the Lord your God.

verses.textZh: "你不可把我祭物的血和有酵的饼一同献上，逾越节的祭物也不可留到早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你不可把我祭物的血和有酵的饼一同献上，逾越节的祭物也不可留到早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你不可将我祭物的血和有酵的饼一同献上。逾越节的祭物也不可留到早晨。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Festival remain until morning.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with anything leavened, or let the sacrifice of the Feast of the Passover remain until the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leaven, nor shall the sacrifice of the Feast of the Passover be left until morning.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not offer the blood of my sacrificial offerings together with any baked goods containing yeast. And none of the meat of the Passover sacrifice may be kept over until the next morning.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread, nor is the sacrifice of the Feast of the Passover to be left over until morning.
verses.textEn: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Festival remain until morning.

verses.textZh: 你要把你地里最早生产的初熟之物送到耶和华你的神的殿里。不可用羊羔母的奶去煮羊羔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把你地里最早生产的初熟之物送到耶和华你的神的殿里。不可用羊羔母的奶去煮羊羔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 地里首先初熟之物要送到耶和华－你神的殿。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the Lord your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk."
verses.textEnEsv: The best of the firstfruits of your ground you shall bring to the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk."
verses.textEnNkjv: "The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring to the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk."
verses.textEnNlt: "As you harvest your crops, bring the very best of the first harvest to the house of the Lord your God. "You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk."
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall bring the very first of the first fruits of your soil into the house of the Lord your God. "You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk."
verses.textEn: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the Lord your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要把这些话写上，因为我是按着这些话与你和以色列人立约的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要把这些话写上，因为我是按着这些话与你和以色列人立约的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「你要将这些话写上，因为我是按这话与你和以色列人立约。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Write these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write these words, for according to the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write down all these instructions, for they represent the terms of the covenant I am making with you and with Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."

verses.textZh: 摩西在那里与耶和华在一起共四十昼夜，不吃饭，也不喝水。他把这约的话写在两块版上，这就是十诫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西在那里与耶和华在一起共四十昼夜，不吃饭，也不喝水。他把这约的话写在两块版上，这就是十诫。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西在耶和华那里四十昼夜，也不吃饭也不喝水。耶和华将这约的话，就是十条诫，写在两块版上。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.
verses.textEnEsv: So he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights. He neither ate bread nor drank water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread nor drank water. And He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses remained there on the mountain with the Lord forty days and forty nights. In all that time he ate no bread and drank no water. And the Lord wrote the terms of the covenant—the Ten Commandments —on the stone tablets.
verses.textEnNasb: So he was there with the Lord for forty days and forty nights; he did not eat bread or drink water. And He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.
verses.textEn: Moses was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.

verses.textZh: 摩西从西奈山下来的时候，手里拿着两块法版；摩西从山上下来的时候，不知道自己的脸皮因为与耶和华谈过话而发光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西从西奈山下来的时候，手里拿着两块法版；摩西从山上下来的时候，不知道自己的脸皮因为与耶和华谈过话而发光。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西手里拿着两块法版下西奈山的时候，不知道自己的面皮因耶和华和他说话就发了光。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant law in his hands, he was not aware that his face was radiant because he had spoken with the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai, with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand as he came down from the mountain, Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because he had been talking with God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was so, when Moses came down from Mount Sinai (and the two tablets of the Testimony were in Moses’ hand when he came down from the mountain), that Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone while he talked with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses came down Mount Sinai carrying the two stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, he wasn’t aware that his face had become radiant because he had spoken to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when Moses was coming down from Mount Sinai (and the two tablets of the testimony were in Moses’ hand as he was coming down from the mountain), that Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because of his speaking with Him.
verses.textEn: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant law in his hands, he was not aware that his face was radiant because he had spoken with the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚伦和全体以色列人看见了摩西，见他脸上发光，就害怕接近他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦和全体以色列人看见了摩西，见他脸上发光，就害怕接近他。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦和以色列众人看见摩西的面皮发光就怕挨近他。
verses.textEnNiv: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, his face was radiant, and they were afraid to come near him.
verses.textEnEsv: Aaron and all the people of Israel saw Moses, and behold, the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid to come near him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid to come near him.
verses.textEnNlt: So when Aaron and the people of Israel saw the radiance of Moses’ face, they were afraid to come near him.
verses.textEnNasb: So when Aaron and all the sons of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid to approach him.
verses.textEn: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, his face was radiant, and they were afraid to come near him.

verses.textZh: 摩西叫他们过来，于是，亚伦和会众中所有的首领才回到摩西那里去，摩西就与他们谈话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西叫他们过来，于是，亚伦和会众中所有的首领才回到摩西那里去，摩西就与他们谈话。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西叫他们来；于是亚伦和会众的官长都到他那里去，摩西就与他们说话。
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses called to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and he spoke to them.
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him, and Moses talked with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses talked with them.
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses called out to them and asked Aaron and all the leaders of the community to come over, and he talked with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers in the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.
verses.textEn: But Moses called to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and he spoke to them.

verses.textZh: 以后，全体以色列人都近前来，摩西就把耶和华在西奈山上与他所说的一切话都吩咐他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后，全体以色列人都近前来，摩西就把耶和华在西奈山上与他所说的一切话都吩咐他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后以色列众人都近前来，他就把耶和华在西奈山与他所说的一切话都吩咐他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward all the Israelites came near him, and he gave them all the commands the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward all the people of Israel came near, and he commanded them all that the Lord had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them as commandments all that the Lord had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the people of Israel approached him, and Moses gave them all the instructions the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward all the sons of Israel came near, and he commanded them to do everything that the Lord had spoken to him on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEn: Afterward all the Israelites came near him, and he gave them all the commands the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.

verses.textZh: 摩西和他们说完了话，就用帕子蒙上自己的脸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和他们说完了话，就用帕子蒙上自己的脸。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西与他们说完了话就用帕子蒙上脸。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses finished speaking to them, he put a veil over his face.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses finished speaking with them, he covered his face with a veil.
verses.textEnNasb: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.
verses.textEn: When Moses finished speaking to them, he put a veil over his face.

verses.textZh: 每逢摩西进到耶和华面前与他谈话的时候，就把帕子揭去，直到他出来。他出来了，就把耶和华吩咐他的对以色列人说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢摩西进到耶和华面前与他谈话的时候，就把帕子揭去，直到他出来。他出来了，就把耶和华吩咐他的对以色列人说。
verses.textZhCuv: 但摩西进到耶和华面前与他说话就揭去帕子，及至出来的时候便将耶和华所吩咐的告诉以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: But whenever he entered the Lord ’s presence to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out. And when he came out and told the Israelites what he had been commanded,
verses.textEnEsv: Whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he would remove the veil, until he came out. And when he came out and told the people of Israel what he was commanded,
verses.textEnNkjv: But whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak with Him, he would take the veil off until he came out; and he would come out and speak to the children of Israel whatever he had been commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: But whenever he went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the Lord , he would remove the veil until he came out again. Then he would give the people whatever instructions the Lord had given him,
verses.textEnNasb: But whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak with Him, he would take off the veil until he came out; and whenever he came out and spoke to the sons of Israel what he had been commanded,
verses.textEn: But whenever he entered the Lord ’s presence to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out. And when he came out and told the Israelites what he had been commanded,

verses.textZh: 以色列人看见摩西的脸，见他的脸皮发光。摩西再用帕子蒙上自己的脸，直到他进去和耶和华说话为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人看见摩西的脸，见他的脸皮发光。摩西再用帕子蒙上自己的脸，直到他进去和耶和华说话为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人看见摩西的面皮发光。摩西又用帕子蒙上脸，等到他进去与耶和华说话就揭去帕子。
verses.textEnNiv: they saw that his face was radiant. Then Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: the people of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face was shining. And Moses would put the veil over his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whenever the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone, then Moses would put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: and the people of Israel would see the radiant glow of his face. So he would put the veil over his face until he returned to speak with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: the sons of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone. So Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with Him.
verses.textEn: they saw that his face was radiant. Then Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the Lord .

verses.textZh: 摩西召集了以色列全体会众，对他们说："这就是耶和华吩咐的话，要你们遵行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西召集了以色列全体会众，对他们说："这就是耶和华吩咐的话，要你们遵行。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西招聚以色列全会众，对他们说：「这是耶和华所吩咐的话，叫你们照着行：
verses.textEnNiv: Moses assembled the whole Israelite community and said to them, "These are the things the Lord has commanded you to do:
verses.textEnEsv: Moses assembled all the congregation of the people of Israel and said to them, "These are the things that the Lord has commanded you to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said to them, "These are the words which the Lord has commanded you to do:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses called together the whole community of Israel and told them, "These are the instructions the Lord has commanded you to follow.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses assembled all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and said to them, "These are the things that the Lord has commanded you to do:
verses.textEn: Moses assembled the whole Israelite community and said to them, "These are the things the Lord has commanded you to do:

verses.textZh: 六日要工作，但第七日是你们的圣日，要归耶和华为休息的安息日。凡是在这日工作的，必须把他处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六日要工作，但第七日是你们的圣日，要归耶和华为休息的安息日。凡是在这日工作的，必须把他处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 六日要做工，第七日乃为圣日，当向耶和华守为安息圣日。凡这日之内做工的，必把他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a day of sabbath rest to the Lord . Whoever does any work on it is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Six days work shall be done, but on the seventh day you shall have a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the Lord . Whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Work shall be done for six days, but the seventh day shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of rest to the Lord. Whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but the seventh day must be a Sabbath day of complete rest, a holy day dedicated to the Lord . Anyone who works on that day must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: "For six days work may be done, but on the seventh day you shall have a holy day, a Sabbath of complete rest to the Lord; whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
verses.textEn: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a day of sabbath rest to the Lord . Whoever does any work on it is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 在安息日，不可在你们任何的住处生火。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在安息日，不可在你们任何的住处生火。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当安息日，不可在你们一切的住处生火。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall kindle no fire in all your dwelling places on the Sabbath day."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall kindle no fire throughout your dwellings on the Sabbath day."
verses.textEnNlt: You must not even light a fire in any of your homes on the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not kindle a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day."
verses.textEn: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day."

verses.textZh: 摩西告诉以色列全体会众说："耶和华吩咐的是这样，他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西告诉以色列全体会众说："耶和华吩咐的是这样，他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对以色列全会众说：「耶和华所吩咐的是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to the whole Israelite community, "This is what the Lord has commanded:
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said to all the congregation of the people of Israel, "This is the thing that the Lord has commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, "This is the thing which the Lord commanded, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said to the whole community of Israel, "This is what the Lord has commanded:
verses.textEnNasb: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, "This is the thing which the Lord has commanded, saying,
verses.textEn: Moses said to the whole Israelite community, "This is what the Lord has commanded:

verses.textZh: ‘你们要从你们中间拿礼物来给耶和华，凡是甘心乐意的，都可以把耶和华的礼物带来，就是金、银、铜、
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你们要从你们中间拿礼物来给耶和华，凡是甘心乐意的，都可以把耶和华的礼物带来，就是金、银、铜、
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间要拿礼物献给耶和华，凡乐意献的可以拿耶和华的礼物来，就是金、银、铜，
verses.textEnNiv: From what you have, take an offering for the Lord . Everyone who is willing is to bring to the Lord an offering of gold, silver and bronze;
verses.textEnEsv: Take from among you a contribution to the Lord . Whoever is of a generous heart, let him bring the Lord ’s contribution: gold, silver, and bronze;
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Take from among you an offering to the Lord. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as an offering to the Lord: gold, silver, and bronze;
verses.textEnNlt: Take a sacred offering for the Lord . Let those with generous hearts present the following gifts to the Lord : gold, silver, and bronze;
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Take from among you a contribution to the Lord; whoever is of a willing heart is to bring it as the Lord’s contribution: gold, silver, and bronze,
verses.textEn: From what you have, take an offering for the Lord . Everyone who is willing is to bring to the Lord an offering of gold, silver and bronze;

verses.textZh: 蓝色紫色朱红色线、细麻、山羊毛、
verses.textZhCnvs: 蓝色紫色朱红色线、细麻、山羊毛、
verses.textZhCuv: 蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，
verses.textEnNiv: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;
verses.textEnEsv: blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen; goats’ hair,
verses.textEnNkjv: blue, purple, and scarlet thread, fine linen, and goats’ hair;
verses.textEnNlt: blue, purple, and scarlet thread; fine linen and goat hair for cloth;
verses.textEnNasb: and violet, purple, and scarlet material, fine linen, goats’ hair,
verses.textEn: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

verses.textZh: 染红的公羊皮、海狗皮、皂荚木、
verses.textZhCnvs: 染红的公羊皮、海狗皮、皂荚木、
verses.textZhCuv: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，
verses.textEnNiv: ram skins dyed red and another type of durable leather ; acacia wood;
verses.textEnEsv: tanned rams’ skins, and goatskins; acacia wood,
verses.textEnNkjv: ram skins dyed red, badger skins, and acacia wood;
verses.textEnNlt: tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather; acacia wood;
verses.textEnNasb: and rams’ skins dyed red, and fine leather, and acacia wood,
verses.textEn: ram skins dyed red and another type of durable leather ; acacia wood;

verses.textZh: 灯油，以及作膏油和芬芳的香的香料、
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯油，以及作膏油和芬芳的香的香料、
verses.textZhCuv: 点灯的油，并做膏油和香的香料，
verses.textEnNiv: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
verses.textEnEsv: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
verses.textEnNkjv: oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense;
verses.textEnNlt: olive oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and the fragrant incense;
verses.textEnNasb: and oil for lighting, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense,
verses.textEn: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

verses.textZh: 红玛瑙宝石，以及可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的宝石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 红玛瑙宝石，以及可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的宝石。
verses.textZhCuv: 红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。」
verses.textEnNiv: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
verses.textEnEsv: and onyx stones and stones for setting, for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
verses.textEnNkjv: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate.
verses.textEnNlt: onyx stones, and other gemstones to be set in the ephod and the priest’s chestpiece.
verses.textEnNasb: and onyx stones and setting stones for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
verses.textEn: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

verses.textZh: "‘你们中间凡是心里有智慧的都要来，做耶和华吩咐的一切，
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘你们中间凡是心里有智慧的都要来，做耶和华吩咐的一切，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们中间凡心里有智慧的都要来做耶和华一切所吩咐的：
verses.textEnNiv: "All who are skilled among you are to come and make everything the Lord has commanded:
verses.textEnEsv: "Let every skillful craftsman among you come and make all that the Lord has commanded:
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘All whoare gifted artisans among you shall come and make all that the Lord has commanded:
verses.textEnNlt: "Come, all of you who are gifted craftsmen. Construct everything that the Lord has commanded:
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Have every skillful person among you come and make all that the Lord has commanded:
verses.textEn: "All who are skilled among you are to come and make everything the Lord has commanded:

verses.textZh: 就是做帐幕、帐幕的棚罩、帐幕的盖、钩子、木板、横闩、柱子、帐幕的座、
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是做帐幕、帐幕的棚罩、帐幕的盖、钩子、木板、横闩、柱子、帐幕的座、
verses.textZhCuv: 就是帐幕和帐幕的罩棚，并帐幕的盖、钩子、板、闩、柱子、带卯的座，
verses.textEnNiv: the tabernacle with its tent and its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;
verses.textEnEsv: the tabernacle, its tent and its covering, its hooks and its frames, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
verses.textEnNkjv: the tabernacle, its tent, its covering, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.textEnNlt: the Tabernacle and its sacred tent, its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts, and bases;
verses.textEnNasb: the tabernacle, its tent and its covering, its hooks and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
verses.textEn: the tabernacle with its tent and its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

verses.textZh: 柜、柜杠、施恩座、遮盖至圣所的幔子、
verses.textZhCnvs: 柜、柜杠、施恩座、遮盖至圣所的幔子、
verses.textZhCuv: 柜和柜的杠，施恩座和遮掩柜的幔子，
verses.textEnNiv: the ark with its poles and the atonement cover and the curtain that shields it;
verses.textEnEsv: the ark with its poles, the mercy seat, and the veil of the screen;
verses.textEnNkjv: the ark and its poles, with the mercy seat, and the veil of the covering;
verses.textEnNlt: the Ark and its carrying poles; the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement; the inner curtain to shield the Ark;
verses.textEnNasb: the ark and its poles, the atoning cover, and the covering curtain;
verses.textEn: the ark with its poles and the atonement cover and the curtain that shields it;

verses.textZh: 桌子、桌子的杠、桌子的一切器具、陈设饼、
verses.textZhCnvs: 桌子、桌子的杠、桌子的一切器具、陈设饼、
verses.textZhCuv: 桌子和桌子的杠与桌子的一切器具，并陈设饼，
verses.textEnNiv: the table with its poles and all its articles and the bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnEsv: the table with its poles and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnNkjv: the table and its poles, all its utensils, and the showbread;
verses.textEnNlt: the table, its carrying poles, and all its utensils; the Bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnNasb: the table and its poles, and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
verses.textEn: the table with its poles and all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

verses.textZh: 灯台、灯台的器具、灯盏、灯油、
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯台、灯台的器具、灯盏、灯油、
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台和灯台的器具，灯盏并点灯的油，
verses.textEnNiv: the lampstand that is for light with its accessories, lamps and oil for the light;
verses.textEnEsv: the lampstand also for the light, with its utensils and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
verses.textEnNkjv: also the lampstand for the light, its utensils, its lamps, and the oil for the light;
verses.textEnNlt: for light, the lampstand, its accessories, the lamp cups, and the olive oil for lighting;
verses.textEnNasb: the lampstand also for the light and its utensils and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
verses.textEn: the lampstand that is for light with its accessories, lamps and oil for the light;

verses.textZh: 香坛、香坛的杠、膏油、芬芳的香、帐幕门口的门帘、
verses.textZhCnvs: 香坛、香坛的杠、膏油、芬芳的香、帐幕门口的门帘、
verses.textZhCuv: 香坛和坛的杠，膏油和馨香的香料，并帐幕门口的帘子，
verses.textEnNiv: the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense; the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle;
verses.textEnEsv: and the altar of incense, with its poles, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
verses.textEnNkjv: the incense altar, its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, and the screen for the door at the entrance of the tabernacle;
verses.textEnNlt: the incense altar and its carrying poles; the anointing oil and fragrant incense; the curtain for the entrance of the Tabernacle;
verses.textEnNasb: and the altar of incense and its poles, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the doorway at the entrance of the tabernacle;
verses.textEn: the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense; the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle;

verses.textZh: 燔祭坛、坛的铜网、坛杠、坛的一切器具、洗濯盆、盆座、
verses.textZhCnvs: 燔祭坛、坛的铜网、坛杠、坛的一切器具、洗濯盆、盆座、
verses.textZhCuv: 燔祭坛和坛的铜网，坛的杠并坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
verses.textEnNiv: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the bronze basin with its stand;
verses.textEnEsv: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils, the basin and its stand;
verses.textEnNkjv: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles, all its utensils, and the laver and its base;
verses.textEnNlt: the altar of burnt offering; the bronze grating of the altar and its carrying poles and utensils; the washbasin with its stand;
verses.textEnNasb: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils, the basin and its stand;
verses.textEn: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the bronze basin with its stand;

verses.textZh: 院子的帷子、帷子的柱子、帷子的座、院子的门帘、
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子的帷子、帷子的柱子、帷子的座、院子的门帘、
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的帷子和帷子的柱子，带卯的座和院子的门帘，
verses.textEnNiv: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;
verses.textEnEsv: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the court;
verses.textEnNkjv: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
verses.textEnNlt: the curtains for the walls of the courtyard; the posts and their bases; the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;
verses.textEnNasb: the hangings of the courtyard, its pillars and its bases, and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard;
verses.textEn: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;

verses.textZh: 帐幕的钉子、院子的钉子，以及这两处的绳子、
verses.textZhCnvs: 帐幕的钉子、院子的钉子，以及这两处的绳子、
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕的橛子并院子的橛子，和这两处的绳子，
verses.textEnNiv: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, and their ropes;
verses.textEnEsv: the pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the court, and their cords;
verses.textEnNkjv: the pegs of the tabernacle, the pegs of the court, and their cords;
verses.textEnNlt: the tent pegs of the Tabernacle and courtyard and their ropes;
verses.textEnNasb: the pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the courtyard and their ropes;
verses.textEn: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, and their ropes;

verses.textZh: 在圣所供职用的彩衣、祭司亚伦的圣衣和他儿子供祭司职用的衣服。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在圣所供职用的彩衣、祭司亚伦的圣衣和他儿子供祭司职用的衣服。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 精工做的礼服和祭司亚伦并他儿子在圣所用以供祭司职分的圣衣。」
verses.textEnNiv: the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary—both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests."
verses.textEnEsv: the finely worked garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, for their service as priests."
verses.textEnNkjv: the garments of ministry, for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to minister as priests.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: the beautifully stitched garments for the priests to wear while ministering in the Holy Place—the sacred garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments for his sons to wear as they minister as priests."
verses.textEnNasb: the woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests.’ "
verses.textEn: the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary—both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests."

verses.textZh: 以色列全体会众从摩西面前离去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列全体会众从摩西面前离去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列全会众从摩西面前退去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the whole Israelite community withdrew from Moses’ presence,
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the congregation of the people of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: So the whole community of Israel left Moses and returned to their tents.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the congregation of the sons of Israel departed from Moses’ presence.
verses.textEn: Then the whole Israelite community withdrew from Moses’ presence,

verses.textZh: 凡是心里受感、灵里乐意的，都来了；他们把耶和华的礼物都带来了，用作会幕的工程和会幕中的一切使用，又用来做圣衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是心里受感、灵里乐意的，都来了；他们把耶和华的礼物都带来了，用作会幕的工程和会幕中的一切使用，又用来做圣衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡心里受感和甘心乐意的都拿耶和华的礼物来，用以做会幕和其中一切的使用，又用以做圣衣。
verses.textEnNiv: and everyone who was willing and whose heart moved them came and brought an offering to the Lord for the work on the tent of meeting, for all its service, and for the sacred garments.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came, everyone whose heart stirred him, and everyone whose spirit moved him, and brought the Lord ’s contribution to be used for the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the holy garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then everyone came whose heart was stirred, and everyone whose spirit was willing, and they brought the Lord’s offering for the work of the tabernacle of meeting, for all its service, and for the holy garments.
verses.textEnNlt: All whose hearts were stirred and whose spirits were moved came and brought their sacred offerings to the Lord . They brought all the materials needed for the Tabernacle, for the performance of its rituals, and for the sacred garments.
verses.textEnNasb: And everyone whose heart stirred him and everyone whose spirit moved him came and brought the Lord’s contribution for the work of the tent of meeting and for all its service, and for the holy garments.
verses.textEn: and everyone who was willing and whose heart moved them came and brought an offering to the Lord for the work on the tent of meeting, for all its service, and for the sacred garments.

verses.textZh: 凡是甘心乐意的，不论男女，都来了，把金针、耳环、戒指、手钏和各样的金器都送来。他们各人都把金子作礼物呈献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是甘心乐意的，不论男女，都来了，把金针、耳环、戒指、手钏和各样的金器都送来。他们各人都把金子作礼物呈献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡心里乐意献礼物的，连男带女，各将金器，就是胸前针、耳环 、打印的戒指，和手钏带来献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: All who were willing, men and women alike, came and brought gold jewelry of all kinds: brooches, earrings, rings and ornaments. They all presented their gold as a wave offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So they came, both men and women. All who were of a willing heart brought brooches and earrings and signet rings and armlets, all sorts of gold objects, every man dedicating an offering of gold to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: They came, both men and women, as many as had a willing heart, and brought earrings and nose rings, rings and necklaces, all jewelry of gold, that is, every man who made an offering of gold to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Both men and women came, all whose hearts were willing. They brought to the Lord their offerings of gold—brooches, earrings, rings from their fingers, and necklaces. They presented gold objects of every kind as a special offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then all whose hearts moved them, both men and women, came and brought brooches and earrings and signet rings and bracelets, all articles of gold; so did everyone who presented an offering of gold to the Lord.
verses.textEn: All who were willing, men and women alike, came and brought gold jewelry of all kinds: brooches, earrings, rings and ornaments. They all presented their gold as a wave offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 凡是有蓝色紫色朱红色线、细麻、山羊毛、染红的公羊皮、海狗皮的，都送了来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是有蓝色紫色朱红色线、细麻、山羊毛、染红的公羊皮、海狗皮的，都送了来。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，染红的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都拿了来；
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone who had blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen, or goat hair, ram skins dyed red or the other durable leather brought them.
verses.textEnEsv: And every one who possessed blue or purple or scarlet yarns or fine linen or goats’ hair or tanned rams’ skins or goatskins brought them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And every man, with whom was found blue, purple, and scarlet thread, fine linen, and goats’ hair, red skins of rams, and badger skins, brought them.
verses.textEnNlt: All those who owned the following items willingly brought them: blue, purple, and scarlet thread; fine linen and goat hair for cloth; and tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who was in possession of violet, purple, or scarlet material or fine linen or goats’ hair, or rams’ skins dyed red or fine leather, brought them.
verses.textEn: Everyone who had blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen, or goat hair, ram skins dyed red or the other durable leather brought them.

verses.textZh: 凡是奉献银子和铜为礼物的，都带了来作耶和华的礼物；凡是有皂荚木可以用作工程上任何使用的，都带了来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是奉献银子和铜为礼物的，都带了来作耶和华的礼物；凡是有皂荚木可以用作工程上任何使用的，都带了来。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡献银子和铜给耶和华为礼物的都拿了来；凡有皂荚木可做什么使用的也拿了来。
verses.textEnNiv: Those presenting an offering of silver or bronze brought it as an offering to the Lord , and everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work brought it.
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who could make a contribution of silver or bronze brought it as the Lord ’s contribution. And every one who possessed acacia wood of any use in the work brought it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone who offered an offering of silver or bronze brought the Lord’s offering. And everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.textEnNlt: And all who had silver and bronze objects gave them as a sacred offering to the Lord . And those who had acacia wood brought it for use in the project.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who could make a contribution of silver and bronze brought the Lord’s contribution; and everyone who was in possession of acacia wood for any work of the service brought it.
verses.textEn: Those presenting an offering of silver or bronze brought it as an offering to the Lord , and everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work brought it.

verses.textZh: 凡是心中有智慧的妇女都亲手纺织，把所纺的蓝色紫色朱红色线都带了来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是心中有智慧的妇女都亲手纺织，把所纺的蓝色紫色朱红色线都带了来。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡心中有智慧的妇女亲手纺线，把所纺的蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和细麻都拿了来。
verses.textEnNiv: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun—blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen.
verses.textEnEsv: And every skillful woman spun with her hands, and they all brought what they had spun in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the women whowere gifted artisans spun yarn with their hands, and brought what they had spun, of blue, purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.textEnNlt: All the women who were skilled in sewing and spinning prepared blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine linen cloth.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the skilled women spun with their hands, and brought what they had spun, in violet, purple, and scarlet material, and in fine linen.
verses.textEn: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun—blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen.

verses.textZh: 凡是有心意又有智慧的妇女，都纺山羊毛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是有心意又有智慧的妇女，都纺山羊毛。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有智慧、心里受感的妇女就纺山羊毛。
verses.textEnNiv: And all the women who were willing and had the skill spun the goat hair.
verses.textEnEsv: All the women whose hearts stirred them to use their skill spun the goats’ hair.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the women whose hearts stirred with wisdom spun yarn of goats’ hair.
verses.textEnNlt: All the women who were willing used their skills to spin the goat hair into yarn.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the women whose heart stirred with a skill spun the goats’ hair.
verses.textEn: And all the women who were willing and had the skill spun the goat hair.

verses.textZh: 首领把红玛瑙宝石，以及可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的宝石都带了来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 首领把红玛瑙宝石，以及可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上的宝石都带了来；
verses.textZhCuv: 众官长把红玛瑙和别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得与胸牌上的，都拿了来；
verses.textEnNiv: The leaders brought onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
verses.textEnEsv: And the leaders brought onyx stones and stones to be set, for the ephod and for the breastpiece,
verses.textEnNkjv: The rulers brought onyx stones, and the stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate,
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders brought onyx stones and the special gemstones to be set in the ephod and the priest’s chestpiece.
verses.textEnNasb: The rulers, moreover, brought the onyx stones and the stones for setting for the ephod and for the breastpiece;
verses.textEn: The leaders brought onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

verses.textZh: 又带来了香料、点灯用的油、膏油、芬芳的香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又带来了香料、点灯用的油、膏油、芬芳的香。
verses.textZhCuv: 又拿香料做香，拿油点灯，做膏油。
verses.textEnNiv: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.
verses.textEnEsv: and spices and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
verses.textEnNkjv: and spices and oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.textEnNlt: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light, the anointing oil, and the fragrant incense.
verses.textEnNasb: and the spice and the oil for the light and for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
verses.textEn: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.

verses.textZh: 以色列人无论男女，凡是甘心乐意为作耶和华藉摩西吩咐的一切工程的，都把自愿奉献的礼物带了来献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人无论男女，凡是甘心乐意为作耶和华藉摩西吩咐的一切工程的，都把自愿奉献的礼物带了来献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人，无论男女，凡甘心乐意献礼物给耶和华的，都将礼物拿来，做耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的一切工。
verses.textEnNiv: All the Israelite men and women who were willing brought to the Lord freewill offerings for all the work the Lord through Moses had commanded them to do.
verses.textEnEsv: All the men and women, the people of Israel, whose heart moved them to bring anything for the work that the Lord had commanded by Moses to be done brought it as a freewill offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of Israel brought a freewill offering to the Lord, all the men and women whose hearts were willing to bring material for all kinds of work which the Lord, by the hand of Moses, had commanded to be done.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people of Israel—every man and woman who was eager to help in the work the Lord had given them through Moses—brought their gifts and gave them freely to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The Israelites, all the men and women, whose heart moved them to bring material for all the work, which the Lord had commanded through Moses to be done, brought a voluntary offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: All the Israelite men and women who were willing brought to the Lord freewill offerings for all the work the Lord through Moses had commanded them to do.

verses.textZh: 摩西对以色列人说："看哪，犹大支派中户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列，耶和华已经提名召他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对以色列人说："看哪，犹大支派中户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列，耶和华已经提名召他，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对以色列人说：「犹大支派中，户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列，耶和华已经提他的名召他，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said to the Israelites, "See, the Lord has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses said to the people of Israel, "See, the Lord has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to the children of Israel, "See, the Lord has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses told the people of Israel, "The Lord has specifically chosen Bezalel son of Uri, grandson of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to the sons of Israel, "See, the Lord has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEn: Then Moses said to the Israelites, "See, the Lord has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

verses.textZh: 又用神的灵充满他，使他有智慧，有聪明，有知识，有作一切巧工的技能。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用神的灵充满他，使他有智慧，有聪明，有知识，有作一切巧工的技能。
verses.textZhCuv: 又以神的灵充满了他，使他有智慧、聪明、知识，能做各样的工，
verses.textEnNiv: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills—
verses.textEnEsv: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, with intelligence, with knowledge, and with all craftsmanship,
verses.textEnNkjv: and He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom and understanding, in knowledge and all manner of workmanship,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has filled Bezalel with the Spirit of God, giving him great wisdom, ability, and expertise in all kinds of crafts.
verses.textEnNasb: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all craftsmanship;
verses.textEn: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills—

verses.textZh: 能巧设图案，用金、银、铜制造各物；
verses.textZhCnvs: 能巧设图案，用金、银、铜制造各物；
verses.textZhCuv: 能想出巧工，用金、银、铜制造各物，
verses.textEnNiv: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,
verses.textEnEsv: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold and silver and bronze,
verses.textEnNkjv: to design artistic works, to work in gold and silver and bronze,
verses.textEnNlt: He is a master craftsman, expert in working with gold, silver, and bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: to create designs for working in gold, in silver, and in bronze,
verses.textEn: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,

verses.textZh: 又能雕刻宝石，用来镶嵌；又能雕刻木头，用来制造各种巧工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又能雕刻宝石，用来镶嵌；又能雕刻木头，用来制造各种巧工。
verses.textZhCuv: 又能刻宝石，可以镶嵌，能雕刻木头，能做各样的巧工。
verses.textEnNiv: to cut and set stones, to work in wood and to engage in all kinds of artistic crafts.
verses.textEnEsv: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, for work in every skilled craft.
verses.textEnNkjv: in cutting jewels for setting, in carving wood, and to work in all manner of artistic workmanship.
verses.textEnNlt: He is skilled in engraving and mounting gemstones and in carving wood. He is a master at every craft.
verses.textEnNasb: and in the cutting of stones for settings and in the carving of wood, so as to perform in every inventive work.
verses.textEn: to cut and set stones, to work in wood and to engage in all kinds of artistic crafts.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又赐给他和但支派中亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯，心里有教导人的恩赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又赐给他和但支派中亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯，心里有教导人的恩赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又使他，和但支派中亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯，心里灵明，能教导人。
verses.textEnNiv: And he has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.
verses.textEnEsv: And he has inspired him to teach, both him and Oholiab the son of Ahisamach of the tribe of Dan.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And He has put in his heart the ability to teach, in him and Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach their skills to others.
verses.textEnNasb: He also has put in his heart to teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.textEn: And he has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又用智慧充满他们的心，使他们能作各种工作，雕刻的工，设图案的工，用蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻刺绣的工，以及编织的工。他们能作各种工程，也能巧设图案。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又用智慧充满他们的心，使他们能作各种工作，雕刻的工，设图案的工，用蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻刺绣的工，以及编织的工。他们能作各种工程，也能巧设图案。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使他们的心满有智慧，能做各样的工，无论是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和细麻、绣花的工，并机匠的工，他们都能做，也能想出奇巧的工。
verses.textEnNiv: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and weavers—all of them skilled workers and designers.
verses.textEnEsv: He has filled them with skill to do every sort of work done by an engraver or by a designer or by an embroiderer in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, or by a weaver—by any sort of workman or skilled designer.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has filled them with skill to do all manner of work of the engraver and the designer and the tapestry maker, in blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine linen, and of the weaver—those who do every work and those who design artistic works.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has given them special skills as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet thread on fine linen cloth, and weavers. They excel as craftsmen and as designers.
verses.textEnNasb: He has filled them with skill to perform every work of an engraver, of a designer, and of an embroiderer, in violet, purple, and in scarlet material, and in fine linen, and of a weaver, as performers of every work and makers of designs.
verses.textEn: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and weavers—all of them skilled workers and designers.

verses.textZh: 比撒列和亚何利亚伯，以及心里有智慧的，就是蒙耶和华赐予智慧与聪明，使他们知道怎样制造供圣所使用的一切工程的人，都照着耶和华吩咐的一切去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比撒列和亚何利亚伯，以及心里有智慧的，就是蒙耶和华赐予智慧与聪明，使他们知道怎样制造供圣所使用的一切工程的人，都照着耶和华吩咐的一切去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 「比撒列和亚何利亚伯，并一切心里有智慧的，就是蒙耶和华赐智慧聪明、叫他知道做圣所各样使用之工的，都要照耶和华所吩咐的做工。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Bezalel, Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord has given skill and ability to know how to carry out all the work of constructing the sanctuary are to do the work just as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnEsv: "Bezalel and Oholiab and every craftsman in whom the Lord has put skill and intelligence to know how to do any work in the construction of the sanctuary shall work in accordance with all that the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnNkjv: "And Bezalel and Aholiab, and every gifted artisan in whom the Lord has put wisdom and understanding, to know how to do all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, shall do according to all that the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord has gifted Bezalel, Oholiab, and the other skilled craftsmen with wisdom and ability to perform any task involved in building the sanctuary. Let them construct and furnish the Tabernacle, just as the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEnNasb: "Now Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skillful person in whom the Lord has put skill and understanding to know how to perform all the work in the construction of the sanctuary, shall perform in accordance with everything that the Lord has commanded."
verses.textEn: So Bezalel, Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord has given skill and ability to know how to carry out all the work of constructing the sanctuary are to do the work just as the Lord has commanded."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西把比撒列和亚何利亚伯，以及心里有智慧的，就是蒙耶和华赐他们心里有智慧的人，凡是心里受感要前来作这工的人，都召了来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西把比撒列和亚何利亚伯，以及心里有智慧的，就是蒙耶和华赐他们心里有智慧的人，凡是心里受感要前来作这工的人，都召了来。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡耶和华赐他心里有智慧、而且受感前来做这工的，摩西把他们和比撒列并亚何利亚伯一同召来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord had given ability and who was willing to come and do the work.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab and every craftsman in whose mind the Lord had put skill, everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to do the work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses called Bezalel and Aholiab, and every gifted artisan in whose heart the Lord had put wisdom, everyone whose heart was stirred, to come and do the work.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and all the others who were specially gifted by the Lord and were eager to get to work.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses called Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skillful person in whom the Lord had put skill, everyone whose heart stirred him, to come to the work to perform it.
verses.textEn: Then Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord had given ability and who was willing to come and do the work.

verses.textZh: 他们当着摩西面前，接收了以色列人为供圣所使用的工程带来的一切礼物。他们天天早晨还把自愿奉献的礼物带到摩西那里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们当着摩西面前，接收了以色列人为供圣所使用的工程带来的一切礼物。他们天天早晨还把自愿奉献的礼物带到摩西那里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人就从摩西收了以色列人为做圣所并圣所使用之工所拿来的礼物。百姓每早晨还把甘心献的礼物拿来。
verses.textEnNiv: They received from Moses all the offerings the Israelites had brought to carry out the work of constructing the sanctuary. And the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning.
verses.textEnEsv: And they received from Moses all the contribution that the people of Israel had brought for doing the work on the sanctuary. They still kept bringing him freewill offerings every morning,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of making the sanctuary. So they continued bringing to him freewill offerings every morning.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses gave them the materials donated by the people of Israel as sacred offerings for the completion of the sanctuary. But the people continued to bring additional gifts each morning.
verses.textEnNasb: They received from Moses every contribution which the sons of Israel had brought to perform the work in the construction of the sanctuary. And they still continued bringing to him voluntary offerings every morning.
verses.textEn: They received from Moses all the offerings the Israelites had brought to carry out the work of constructing the sanctuary. And the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning.

verses.textZh: 凡是作圣所一切工的智慧人，各人都放下自己所作的工，来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是作圣所一切工的智慧人，各人都放下自己所作的工，来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡做圣所一切工的智慧人各都离开他所做的工，
verses.textEnNiv: So all the skilled workers who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left what they were doing
verses.textEnEsv: so that all the craftsmen who were doing every sort of task on the sanctuary came, each from the task that he was doing,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the craftsmen who were doing all the work of the sanctuary came, each from the work he was doing,
verses.textEnNlt: Finally the craftsmen who were working on the sanctuary left their work.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the skillful people who were performing all the work of the sanctuary came, each from the work which they were performing,
verses.textEn: So all the skilled workers who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left what they were doing

verses.textZh: 他们告诉摩西："人民带来的太多，超过耶和华吩咐所作工程使用的需要。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们告诉摩西："人民带来的太多，超过耶和华吩咐所作工程使用的需要。"
verses.textZhCuv: 来对摩西说：「百姓为耶和华吩咐使用之工所拿来的，富富有余。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said to Moses, "The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the Lord commanded to be done."
verses.textEnEsv: and said to Moses, "The people bring much more than enough for doing the work that the Lord has commanded us to do."
verses.textEnNkjv: and they spoke to Moses, saying, "The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work which the Lord commanded us to do."
verses.textEnNlt: They went to Moses and reported, "The people have given more than enough materials to complete the job the Lord has commanded us to do!"
verses.textEnNasb: and they said to Moses, "The people are bringing much more than enough for the construction work which the Lord commanded us to perform."
verses.textEn: and said to Moses, "The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the Lord commanded to be done."

verses.textZh: 于是摩西下令，他们就在营中宣告，说："无论男女都不必再为圣所的工程奉献甚么礼物。"这样，人民才被拦阻，不送甚么礼物来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西下令，他们就在营中宣告，说："无论男女都不必再为圣所的工程奉献甚么礼物。"这样，人民才被拦阻，不送甚么礼物来。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西传命，他们就在全营中宣告说：「无论男女，不必再为圣所拿什么礼物来。」这样才拦住百姓不再拿礼物来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses gave an order and they sent this word throughout the camp: "No man or woman is to make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary." And so the people were restrained from bringing more,
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses gave command, and word was proclaimed throughout the camp, "Let no man or woman do anything more for the contribution for the sanctuary." So the people were restrained from bringing,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, "Let neither man nor woman do any more work for the offering of the sanctuary." And the people were restrained from bringing,
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses gave the command, and this message was sent throughout the camp: "Men and women, don’t prepare any more gifts for the sanctuary. We have enough!" So the people stopped bringing their sacred offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses issued a command, and circulated a proclamation throughout the camp, saying, "No man or woman is to perform work any longer for the contributions of the sanctuary." So the people were restrained from bringing any more.
verses.textEn: Then Moses gave an order and they sent this word throughout the camp: "No man or woman is to make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary." And so the people were restrained from bringing more,

verses.textZh: 因为所有的材料够作一切工程，而且有余。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为所有的材料够作一切工程，而且有余。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们所有的材料够做一切当做的物，而且有余。
verses.textEnNiv: because what they already had was more than enough to do all the work.
verses.textEnEsv: for the material they had was sufficient to do all the work, and more.
verses.textEnNkjv: for the material they had was sufficient for all the work to be done—indeed too much.
verses.textEnNlt: Their contributions were more than enough to complete the whole project.
verses.textEnNasb: For the material they had was sufficient and more than enough for all the work, to perform it.
verses.textEn: because what they already had was more than enough to do all the work.

verses.textZh: 在作这工程的人中，凡是心里有智慧的，用十幅幔子作帐幕；这些幔子是用捻的细麻、蓝色紫色朱红色线做的，并且用设计的巧工绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在作这工程的人中，凡是心里有智慧的，用十幅幔子作帐幕；这些幔子是用捻的细麻、蓝色紫色朱红色线做的，并且用设计的巧工绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们中间，凡心里有智慧做工的，用十幅幔子做帐幕。这幔子是比撒列用捻的细麻和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线制造的，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
verses.textEnNiv: All those who were skilled among the workers made the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim woven into them by expert hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the craftsmen among the workmen made the tabernacle with ten curtains. They were made of fine twined linen and blue and purple and scarlet yarns, with cherubim skillfully worked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the gifted artisans among them who worked on the tabernacle made ten curtains woven of fine linen, and of blue, purple, and scarlet thread; with artistic designs of cherubim they made them.
verses.textEnNlt: The skilled craftsmen made ten curtains of finely woven linen for the Tabernacle. Then Bezalel decorated the curtains with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: All the skillful people among those who were performing the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twisted linen and violet, purple, and scarlet material, with cherubim, the work of a skilled embroiderer, Bezalel made them.
verses.textEn: All those who were skilled among the workers made the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim woven into them by expert hands.

verses.textZh: 每一幅幔子长十二公尺，每一幅幔子宽两公尺，所有的幔子都是一样的尺寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每一幅幔子长十二公尺，每一幅幔子宽两公尺，所有的幔子都是一样的尺寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 每幅幔子长二十八肘，宽四肘，都是一样的尺寸。
verses.textEnNiv: All the curtains were the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains were the same size.
verses.textEnNkjv: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; the curtains were all the same size.
verses.textEnNlt: All ten curtains were exactly the same size—42 feet long and 6 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains had the same measurements.
verses.textEn: All the curtains were the same size—twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 他把五幅幔子一一相连；也使另外五幅幔子一一相连。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把五幅幔子一一相连；也使另外五幅幔子一一相连。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使这五幅幔子幅幅相连，又使那五幅幔子幅幅相连；
verses.textEnNiv: They joined five of the curtains together and did the same with the other five.
verses.textEnEsv: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he coupled five curtains to one another, and theother five curtains he coupled to one another.
verses.textEnNlt: Five of these curtains were joined together to make one long curtain, and the other five were joined to make a second long curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: He joined five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he joined to one another.
verses.textEn: They joined five of the curtains together and did the same with the other five.

verses.textZh: 在第一组相连的幔子末幅的边缘上，他做蓝色的钮扣；在另一组相连的幔子末幅的边缘上，他也照样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在第一组相连的幔子末幅的边缘上，他做蓝色的钮扣；在另一组相连的幔子末幅的边缘上，他也照样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上做蓝色的钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也照样做；
verses.textEnNiv: Then they made loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and the same was done with the end curtain in the other set.
verses.textEnEsv: He made loops of blue on the edge of the outermost curtain of the first set. Likewise he made them on the edge of the outermost curtain of the second set.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made loops of blue yarn on the edge of the curtain on the selvedge of one set; likewise he did on the outer edge of theother curtain of the second set.
verses.textEnNlt: He made fifty loops of blue yarn and put them along the edge of the last curtain in each set.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made loops of violet on the edge of the outermost curtain in the first set; he did likewise on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second set.
verses.textEn: Then they made loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and the same was done with the end curtain in the other set.

verses.textZh: 在这一幅幔子上，他做了五十个钮扣；在第二幅相连的幔子的边缘上，他也做了五十个钮扣，这些钮扣都彼此相对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一幅幔子上，他做了五十个钮扣；在第二幅相连的幔子的边缘上，他也做了五十个钮扣，这些钮扣都彼此相对。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这相连的幔子上做五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子上也做五十个钮扣，都是两两相对；
verses.textEnNiv: They also made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.
verses.textEnEsv: He made fifty loops on the one curtain, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was in the second set. The loops were opposite one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fifty loops he made on one curtain, and fifty loops he made on the edge of the curtain on the end of the second set; the loops held one curtain to another.
verses.textEnNlt: The fifty loops along the edge of one curtain matched the fifty loops along the edge of the other curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was in the second set; the loops were opposite each other.
verses.textEn: They also made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.

verses.textZh: 又做了五十个金钩，用钩子使幔子彼此相连。这样就成了一个帐幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又做了五十个金钩，用钩子使幔子彼此相连。这样就成了一个帐幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 又做五十个金钩，使幔子相连。这才成了一个帐幕。
