verses.textEnNiv: Then they made fifty gold clasps and used them to fasten the two sets of curtains together so that the tabernacle was a unit.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to the other with clasps. So the tabernacle was a single whole.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps, that it might be one tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he made fifty gold clasps and fastened the long curtains together with the clasps. In this way, the Tabernacle was made of one continuous piece.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made fifty clasps of gold, and joined the curtains to one another with the clasps, so that the tabernacle was a unit.
verses.textEn: Then they made fifty gold clasps and used them to fasten the two sets of curtains together so that the tabernacle was a unit.

verses.textZh: 他又用山羊毛做了幔子，作为帐幕上的罩棚，共做了十一幅幔子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又用山羊毛做了幔子，作为帐幕上的罩棚，共做了十一幅幔子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用山羊毛织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。
verses.textEnNiv: They made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.
verses.textEnEsv: He also made curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the tabernacle. He made eleven curtains.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle; he made eleven curtains.
verses.textEnNlt: He made eleven curtains of goat-hair cloth to serve as a tent covering for the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the tabernacle; he made eleven curtains in all.
verses.textEn: They made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven altogether.

verses.textZh: 每一幅幔子长十三公尺，宽两公尺，十一幅幔子都是一样的尺寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每一幅幔子长十三公尺，宽两公尺，十一幅幔子都是一样的尺寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 每幅幔子长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幔子都是一样的尺寸。
verses.textEnNiv: All eleven curtains were the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits. The eleven curtains were the same size.
verses.textEnNkjv: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; the eleven curtains were the same size.
verses.textEnNlt: These eleven curtains were all exactly the same size—45 feet long and 6 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the width of each curtain; the eleven curtains had the same measurements.
verses.textEn: All eleven curtains were the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 他把五幅幔子相连在一起，又把另外六幅幔子相连在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把五幅幔子相连在一起，又把另外六幅幔子相连在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 他把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅；
verses.textEnNiv: They joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another set.
verses.textEnEsv: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: He coupled five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: Bezalel joined five of these curtains together to make one long curtain, and the other six were joined to make a second long curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: He joined five curtains by themselves, and the other six curtains by themselves.
verses.textEn: They joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another set.

verses.textZh: 在第一组相连的幔子末幅的边缘上，做了五十个钮扣；在第二组相连的幔子末幅的边缘上，也做了五十个钮扣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在第一组相连的幔子末幅的边缘上，做了五十个钮扣；在第二组相连的幔子末幅的边缘上，也做了五十个钮扣。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上做五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也做五十个钮扣；
verses.textEnNiv: Then they made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the outermost curtain of the one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the other connecting curtain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in one set, and fifty loops he made on the edge of the curtain of the second set.
verses.textEnNlt: He made fifty loops for the edge of each large curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the first set, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second set.
verses.textEn: Then they made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.

verses.textZh: 又做了五十个铜钩，使罩棚相连，可以成为一个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又做了五十个铜钩，使罩棚相连，可以成为一个。
verses.textZhCuv: 又做五十个铜钩，使罩棚连成一个；
verses.textEnNiv: They made fifty bronze clasps to fasten the tent together as a unit.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together that it might be a single whole.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made fifty bronze clasps to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
verses.textEnNlt: He also made fifty bronze clasps to fasten the long curtains together. In this way, the tent covering was made of one continuous piece.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made fifty clasps of bronze to join the tent together so that it would be a unit.
verses.textEn: They made fifty bronze clasps to fasten the tent together as a unit.

verses.textZh: 用染红的公羊皮做了罩棚的盖，又用海狗皮做盖，放在罩棚的盖上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用染红的公羊皮做了罩棚的盖，又用海狗皮做盖，放在罩棚的盖上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 并用染红的公羊皮做罩棚的盖，再用海狗皮做一层罩棚上的顶盖。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of the other durable leather.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made for the tent a covering of tanned rams’ skins and goatskins.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he made a covering for the tent of ram skins dyed red, and a covering of badger skins above that.
verses.textEnNlt: He completed the tent covering with a layer of tanned ram skins and a layer of fine goatskin leather.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of fine leather above.
verses.textEn: Then they made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of the other durable leather.

verses.textZh: 他替帐幕用皂荚木做了竖板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他替帐幕用皂荚木做了竖板。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用皂荚木做帐幕的竖板。
verses.textEnNiv: They made upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he made the upright frames for the tabernacle of acacia wood.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the tabernacle he made boards of acacia wood, standing upright.
verses.textEnNlt: For the framework of the Tabernacle, Bezalel constructed frames of acacia wood.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
verses.textEn: They made upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 每块板长四公尺，宽六十六公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每块板长四公尺，宽六十六公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 每块长十肘，宽一肘半；
verses.textEnNiv: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,
verses.textEnEsv: Ten cubits was the length of a frame, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each frame.
verses.textEnNkjv: The length of each board was ten cubits, and the width of each board a cubit and a half.
verses.textEnNlt: Each frame was 15 feet high and 27 inches wide,
verses.textEnNasb: Ten cubits was the length of each board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
verses.textEn: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

verses.textZh: 每块板有两个榫头，彼此相连接；帐幕一切木板，他都这样做。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每块板有两个榫头，彼此相连接；帐幕一切木板，他都这样做。
verses.textZhCuv: 每块有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都是这样做。
verses.textEnNiv: with two projections set parallel to each other. They made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
verses.textEnEsv: Each frame had two tenons for fitting together. He did this for all the frames of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Each board had two tenons for binding one to another. Thus he made for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: with two pegs under each frame. All the frames were identical.
verses.textEnNasb: There were two tenons for each board, fitted to one another; he did this to all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: with two projections set parallel to each other. They made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

verses.textZh: 他为帐幕做板，给南边，就是向南的方向做了二十块板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为帐幕做板，给南边，就是向南的方向做了二十块板。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕的南面做板二十块。
verses.textEnNiv: They made twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle
verses.textEnEsv: The frames for the tabernacle he made thus: twenty frames for the south side.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side.
verses.textEnNlt: He made twenty of these frames to support the curtains on the south side of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: So he made the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side;
verses.textEn: They made twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle

verses.textZh: 在这二十块板底下，做了四十个银座；这块板底下的两个银座用来连接板的两个榫头，那块板底下的两个银座用来连接它的两个榫头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这二十块板底下，做了四十个银座；这块板底下的两个银座用来连接板的两个榫头，那块板底下的两个银座用来连接它的两个榫头。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这二十块板底下又做四十个带卯的银座：两卯接这块板上的两榫，两卯接那块板上的两榫。
verses.textEnNiv: and made forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made forty bases of silver under the twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons, and two bases under the next frame for its two tenons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Forty sockets of silver he made to go under the twenty boards: two sockets under each of the boards for its two tenons.
verses.textEnNlt: He also made forty silver bases—two bases under each frame, with the pegs fitting securely into the bases.
verses.textEnNasb: and he made forty bases of silver under the twenty boards; two bases under one board for its two tenons, and two bases under another board for its two tenons.
verses.textEn: and made forty silver bases to go under them—two bases for each frame, one under each projection.

verses.textZh: 他为帐幕的第二边，就是北面，也做了二十块板，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为帐幕的第二边，就是北面，也做了二十块板，
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕的第二面，就是北面，也做板二十块
verses.textEnNiv: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, they made twenty frames
verses.textEnEsv: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty frames
verses.textEnNkjv: And for the other side of the tabernacle, the north side, he made twenty boards
verses.textEnNlt: For the north side of the Tabernacle, he made another twenty frames,
verses.textEnNasb: Then for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards,
verses.textEn: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, they made twenty frames

verses.textZh: 和四十个银座；这一块板底下有两个银座，那一块板底下也有两个银座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和四十个银座；这一块板底下有两个银座，那一块板底下也有两个银座。
verses.textZhCuv: 和带卯的银座四十个：这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。
verses.textEnNiv: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.
verses.textEnEsv: and their forty bases of silver, two bases under one frame and two bases under the next frame.
verses.textEnNkjv: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under each of the boards.
verses.textEnNlt: with their forty silver bases, two bases under each frame.
verses.textEnNasb: and their forty bases of silver; two bases under one board, and two bases under another board.
verses.textEn: and forty silver bases—two under each frame.

verses.textZh: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，做了六块板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，做了六块板。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，做板六块。
verses.textEnNiv: They made six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnEsv: For the rear of the tabernacle westward he made six frames.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the west side of the tabernacle he made six boards.
verses.textEnNlt: He made six frames for the rear—the west side of the Tabernacle—
verses.textEnNasb: And for the back of the tabernacle, to the west, he made six boards.
verses.textEn: They made six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,

verses.textZh: 他替帐幕后面两个角上做了两块板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他替帐幕后面两个角上做了两块板。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕后面的拐角做板两块。
verses.textEnNiv: and two frames were made for the corners of the tabernacle at the far end.
verses.textEnEsv: He made two frames for corners of the tabernacle in the rear.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made two boards for the two back corners of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: along with two additional frames to reinforce the rear corners of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle at the back.
verses.textEn: and two frames were made for the corners of the tabernacle at the far end.

verses.textZh: 板的下截是双的，直到上面的第一个环才接合完整；他把两块板都这样做了，形成两个角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 板的下截是双的，直到上面的第一个环才接合完整；他把两块板都这样做了，形成两个角。
verses.textZhCuv: 板的下半截是双的，上半截是整的，直到第一个环子；在帐幕的两个拐角上都是这样做。
verses.textEnNiv: At these two corners the frames were double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both were made alike.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were separate beneath but joined at the top, at the first ring. He made two of them this way for the two corners.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were coupled at the bottom and coupled together at the top by one ring. Thus he made both of them for the two corners.
verses.textEnNlt: These corner frames were matched at the bottom and firmly attached at the top with a single ring, forming a single corner unit. Both of these corner units were made the same way.
verses.textEnNasb: They were double beneath, and together they were complete to its top, to the first ring; he did this with both of them for the two corners.
verses.textEn: At these two corners the frames were double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both were made alike.

verses.textZh: 所以共有八块板，十六个银座。每一块板底下都有两个银座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以共有八块板，十六个银座。每一块板底下都有两个银座。
verses.textZhCuv: 有八块板和十六个带卯的银座，每块板底下有两卯。
verses.textEnNiv: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
verses.textEnEsv: There were eight frames with their bases of silver: sixteen bases, under every frame two bases.
verses.textEnNkjv: So there were eight boards and their sockets—sixteen sockets of silver—two sockets under each of the boards.
verses.textEnNlt: So there were eight frames at the rear of the Tabernacle, set in sixteen silver bases—two bases under each frame.
verses.textEnNasb: There were eight boards with their bases of silver, sixteen bases, two bases under every board.
verses.textEn: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.

verses.textZh: 他又用皂荚木做了横闩，替帐幕这一边的板做了五个横闩，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又用皂荚木做了横闩，替帐幕这一边的板做了五个横闩，
verses.textZhCuv: 他用皂荚木做闩：为帐幕这面的板做五闩，
verses.textEnNiv: They also made crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnEsv: He made bars of acacia wood, five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards on one side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnNlt: Then he made crossbars of acacia wood to link the frames, five crossbars for the north side of the Tabernacle
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made bars of acacia wood, five for the boards of one side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEn: They also made crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

verses.textZh: 替帐幕第二边的板也做了五个横闩，替帐幕后面，就是西面的板也做了五个横闩，
verses.textZhCnvs: 替帐幕第二边的板也做了五个横闩，替帐幕后面，就是西面的板也做了五个横闩，
verses.textZhCuv: 为帐幕那面的板做五闩，又为帐幕后面的板做五闩，
verses.textEnNiv: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: and five bars for the frames of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the tabernacle at the rear westward.
verses.textEnNkjv: five bars for the boards on the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle on the far side westward.
verses.textEnNlt: and five for the south side. He also made five crossbars for the rear of the Tabernacle, which faced west.
verses.textEnNasb: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the back side to the west.
verses.textEn: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 他又做了中间的横闩，穿过板腰，从这一端穿到那一端。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又做了中间的横闩，穿过板腰，从这一端穿到那一端。
verses.textZhCuv: 使板腰间的中闩从这一头通到那一头。
verses.textEnNiv: They made the center crossbar so that it extended from end to end at the middle of the frames.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made the middle bar to run from end to end halfway up the frames.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made the middle bar to pass through the boards from one end to the other.
verses.textEnNlt: He made the middle crossbar to attach halfway up the frames; it ran all the way from one end of the Tabernacle to the other.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made the middle bar to pass through in the center of the boards from end to end.
verses.textEn: They made the center crossbar so that it extended from end to end at the middle of the frames.

verses.textZh: 他用金子把板包裹，也做了板上的金环，用作穿横闩的地方，并且也用金子把横闩包裹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用金子把板包裹，也做了板上的金环，用作穿横闩的地方，并且也用金子把横闩包裹。
verses.textZhCuv: 用金子将板包裹，又做板上的金环套闩；闩也用金子包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: They overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. They also overlaid the crossbars with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And he overlaid the frames with gold, and made their rings of gold for holders for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: He overlaid the boards with gold, made their rings of gold tobe holders for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: He overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. Then he overlaid the crossbars with gold as well.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as holders for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
verses.textEn: They overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. They also overlaid the crossbars with gold.

verses.textZh: 他用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做了一幅幔幕，用巧设的图案手工绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做了一幅幔幕，用巧设的图案手工绣上基路伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
verses.textEnNiv: They made the curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim woven into it by a skilled worker.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the veil of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen; with cherubim skillfully worked into it he made it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen; it was worked with an artistic design of cherubim.
verses.textEnNlt: For the inside of the Tabernacle, Bezalel made a special curtain of finely woven linen. He decorated it with blue, purple, and scarlet thread and with skillfully embroidered cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, he made the veil of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen; he made it with cherubim, the work of a skilled embroiderer.
verses.textEn: They made the curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim woven into it by a skilled worker.

verses.textZh: 他替幔幕做了四根皂荚木柱子，用金子包裹，柱钉是金的，又替柱子铸造四个银座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他替幔幕做了四根皂荚木柱子，用金子包裹，柱钉是金的，又替柱子铸造四个银座。
verses.textZhCuv: 为幔子做四根皂荚木柱子，用金包裹，柱子上有金钩，又为柱子铸了四个带卯的银座。
verses.textEnNiv: They made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold. They made gold hooks for them and cast their four silver bases.
verses.textEnEsv: And for it he made four pillars of acacia and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold, and he cast for them four bases of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made for it four pillars of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, with their hooks of gold; and he cast four sockets of silver for them.
verses.textEnNlt: For the curtain, he made four posts of acacia wood and four gold hooks. He overlaid the posts with gold and set them in four silver bases.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold, with their hooks of gold; and he cast four bases of silver for them.
verses.textEn: They made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold. They made gold hooks for them and cast their four silver bases.

verses.textZh: 又用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工做成帐幕的门帘；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工做成帐幕的门帘；
verses.textZhCuv: 拿蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘；
verses.textEnNiv: For the entrance to the tent they made a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer;
verses.textEnEsv: He also made a screen for the entrance of the tent, of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen, embroidered with needlework,
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made a screen for the tabernacle door, of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver,
verses.textEnNlt: Then he made another curtain for the entrance to the sacred tent. He made it of finely woven linen and embroidered it with exquisite designs using blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made a curtain for the doorway of the tent, of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen, the work of a weaver;
verses.textEn: For the entrance to the tent they made a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer;

verses.textZh: 又为门帘做了五根柱子和柱子上的钉子，用金子把柱顶和横杆包裹。但那五个座是铜的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又为门帘做了五根柱子和柱子上的钉子，用金子把柱顶和横杆包裹。但那五个座是铜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又为帘子做五根柱子和柱子上的钩子，用金子把柱顶和柱子上的杆子包裹。柱子有五个带卯的座，是铜的。
verses.textEnNiv: and they made five posts with hooks for them. They overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold and made their five bases of bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: and its five pillars with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals, and their fillets were of gold, but their five bases were of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: and its five pillars with their hooks. And he overlaid their capitals and their rings with gold, but their five sockets were bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: This curtain was hung on gold hooks attached to five posts. The posts with their decorated tops and hooks were overlaid with gold, and the five bases were cast from bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: and he made its five pillars with their hooks, and he overlaid their tops and their bands with gold; but their five bases were of bronze.
verses.textEn: and they made five posts with hooks for them. They overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold and made their five bases of bronze.

verses.textZh: 比撒列用皂荚木做了一个柜，长一百一十公分，宽六十六公分，高六十六公分，
verses.textZhCnvs: 比撒列用皂荚木做了一个柜，长一百一十公分，宽六十六公分，高六十六公分，
verses.textZhCuv: 比撒列用皂荚木做柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。
verses.textEnNiv: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
verses.textEnEsv: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Two cubits and a half was its length, a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood; two and a half cubits was its length, a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Bezalel made the Ark of acacia wood—a sacred chest 45 inches long, 27 inches wide, and 27 inches high.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood; its length was two and a half cubits, its width one and a half cubits, and its height one and a half cubits;
verses.textEn: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood—two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

verses.textZh: 用纯金把柜里外都包裹了，替柜的四周做了金牙边，
verses.textZhCnvs: 用纯金把柜里外都包裹了，替柜的四周做了金牙边，
verses.textZhCuv: 里外包上精金，四围镶上金牙边，
verses.textEnNiv: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold all around it.
verses.textEnNlt: He overlaid it inside and outside with pure gold, and he ran a molding of gold all around it.
verses.textEnNasb: and he overlaid it with pure gold inside and out, and made a gold molding for it all around.
verses.textEn: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.

verses.textZh: 又铸造了四个金环，安放在柜的四脚上，这一边两个环，那一边两个环。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又铸造了四个金环，安放在柜的四脚上，这一边两个环，那一边两个环。
verses.textZhCuv: 又铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上：这边两环，那边两环。
verses.textEnNiv: He cast four gold rings for it and fastened them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.
verses.textEnEsv: And he cast for it four rings of gold for its four feet, two rings on its one side and two rings on its other side.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold tobeset in its four corners: two rings on one side, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.textEnNlt: He cast four gold rings and attached them to its four feet, two rings on each side.
verses.textEnNasb: He cast four rings of gold for it on its four feet; two rings on one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.textEn: He cast four gold rings for it and fastened them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

verses.textZh: 又用皂荚木做了两根柜杠，包上黄金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用皂荚木做了两根柜杠，包上黄金。
verses.textZhCuv: 用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold
verses.textEnNkjv: He made poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he made poles from acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEn: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

verses.textZh: 把杠穿在柜旁的环内，可以抬柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把杠穿在柜旁的环内，可以抬柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 把杠穿在柜旁的环内，以便抬柜。
verses.textEnNiv: And he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.
verses.textEnEsv: and put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he put the poles into the rings at the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
verses.textEnNlt: He inserted the poles into the rings at the sides of the Ark to carry it.
verses.textEnNasb: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry it.
verses.textEn: And he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.

verses.textZh: 又用纯金做施恩座，长一百一十公分，宽六十六公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用纯金做施恩座，长一百一十公分，宽六十六公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 用精金做施恩座，长二肘半，宽一肘半。
verses.textEnNiv: He made the atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made a mercy seat of pure gold. Two cubits and a half was its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made the mercy seat of pure gold; two and a half cubits was its length and a cubit and a half its width.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he made the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement—from pure gold. It was 45 inches long and 27 inches wide.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made an atoning cover of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and one and a half cubits wide.
verses.textEn: He made the atonement cover of pure gold—two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

verses.textZh: 又用黄金做了两个基路伯，是从施恩座的两端用锤锤成的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用黄金做了两个基路伯，是从施恩座的两端用锤锤成的；
verses.textZhCuv: 用金子锤出两个基路伯来，安在施恩座的两头，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he made two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made two cherubim of gold. He made them of hammered work on the two ends of the mercy seat,
verses.textEnNkjv: He made two cherubim of beaten gold; he made them of one piece at the two ends of the mercy seat:
verses.textEnNlt: He made two cherubim from hammered gold and placed them on the two ends of the atonement cover.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made two cherubim of gold; he made them of hammered work at the two ends of the atoning cover:
verses.textEn: Then he made two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.

verses.textZh: 这端一个基路伯，那端一个基路伯；他在施恩座的两端做了两个基路伯，和施恩座连在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这端一个基路伯，那端一个基路伯；他在施恩座的两端做了两个基路伯，和施恩座连在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 这头做一个基路伯，那头做一个基路伯，二基路伯接连一块，在施恩座的两头。
verses.textEnNiv: He made one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; at the two ends he made them of one piece with the cover.
verses.textEnEsv: one cherub on the one end, and one cherub on the other end. Of one piece with the mercy seat he made the cherubim on its two ends.
verses.textEnNkjv: one cherub at one end on this side, and the other cherub at the other end on that side. He made the cherubim at the two ends ofonepiece with the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNlt: He molded the cherubim on each end of the atonement cover, making it all of one piece of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: one cherub at the one end and one cherub at the other end; he made the cherubim of one piece with the atoning cover at the two ends.
verses.textEn: He made one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; at the two ends he made them of one piece with the cover.

verses.textZh: 两个基路伯高展着翅膀，用它们的翅膀遮掩着施恩座，它们的脸彼此相对；基路伯的脸都对着施恩座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两个基路伯高展着翅膀，用它们的翅膀遮掩着施恩座，它们的脸彼此相对；基路伯的脸都对着施恩座。
verses.textZhCuv: 二基路伯高张翅膀，遮掩施恩座；基路伯是脸对脸，朝着施恩座。
verses.textEnNiv: The cherubim had their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the cover.
verses.textEnEsv: The cherubim spread out their wings above, overshadowing the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces one to another; toward the mercy seat were the faces of the cherubim.
verses.textEnNkjv: The cherubim spread out their wings above, and covered the mercy seat with their wings. They faced one another; the faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
verses.textEnNlt: The cherubim faced each other and looked down on the atonement cover. With their wings spread above it, they protected it.
verses.textEnNasb: And the cherubim had their wings spread upward, covering the atoning cover with their wings, with their faces toward each other; the faces of the cherubim were toward the atoning cover.
verses.textEn: The cherubim had their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the cover.

verses.textZh: 他又用皂荚木做了一张桌子，长八十八公分，宽四十四公分，高六十六公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又用皂荚木做了一张桌子，长八十八公分，宽四十四公分，高六十六公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用皂荚木做一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半，
verses.textEnNiv: They made the table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.
verses.textEnEsv: He also made the table of acacia wood. Two cubits was its length, a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made the table of acacia wood; two cubits was its length, a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Bezalel made the table of acacia wood, 36 inches long, 18 inches wide, and 27 inches high.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the table of acacia wood, two cubits long, a cubit wide, and one and a half cubits high.
verses.textEn: They made the table of acacia wood—two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.

verses.textZh: 用纯金把桌子包裹，替桌子的四周做了金牙边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用纯金把桌子包裹，替桌子的四周做了金牙边。
verses.textZhCuv: 又包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made a molding of gold around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made a molding of gold all around it.
verses.textEnNlt: He overlaid it with pure gold and ran a gold molding around the edge.
verses.textEnNasb: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding for it all around.
verses.textEn: Then they overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.

verses.textZh: 又替桌子的四周做了七十五公厘宽的框子；框子的四周又做了金牙边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又替桌子的四周做了七十五公厘宽的框子；框子的四周又做了金牙边。
verses.textZhCuv: 桌子的四围各做一掌宽的横梁，横梁上镶着金牙边，
verses.textEnNiv: They also made around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made a rim around it a handbreadth wide, and made a molding of gold around the rim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he made a frame of a handbreadth all around it, and made a molding of gold for the frame all around it.
verses.textEnNlt: He decorated it with a 3-inch border all around, and he ran a gold molding along the border.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made a rim for it of a hand width all around, and made a gold molding for its rim all around.
verses.textEn: They also made around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

verses.textZh: 又替桌子铸造四个金环，把环子安放在桌子四脚的四角上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又替桌子铸造四个金环，把环子安放在桌子四脚的四角上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又铸了四个金环，安在桌子四脚的四角上。
verses.textEnNiv: They cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners, where the four legs were.
verses.textEnEsv: He cast for it four rings of gold and fastened the rings to the four corners at its four legs.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that were at its four legs.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he cast four gold rings for the table and attached them at the four corners next to the four legs.
verses.textEnNasb: He also cast four gold rings for it and put the rings on the four corners that were on its four legs.
verses.textEn: They cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners, where the four legs were.

verses.textZh: 环子靠近框子，是穿杠的地方，可以抬桌子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 环子靠近框子，是穿杠的地方，可以抬桌子。
verses.textZhCuv: 安环子的地方是挨近横梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。
verses.textEnNiv: The rings were put close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.
verses.textEnEsv: Close to the frame were the rings, as holders for the poles to carry the table.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rings were close to the frame, as holders for the poles to bear the table.
verses.textEnNlt: The rings were attached near the border to hold the poles that were used to carry the table.
verses.textEnNasb: Close by the rim were the rings, the holders for the poles to carry the table.
verses.textEn: The rings were put close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.

verses.textZh: 又用皂荚木做了两根杠，用金子把杠包裹，可以抬桌子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用皂荚木做了两根杠，用金子把杠包裹，可以抬桌子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子；
verses.textEnNiv: The poles for carrying the table were made of acacia wood and were overlaid with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the poles of acacia wood to carry the table, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made the poles of acacia wood to bear the table, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: He made these poles from acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
verses.textEn: The poles for carrying the table were made of acacia wood and were overlaid with gold.

verses.textZh: 又用纯金做桌子的器皿，就是盘子、碟子、碗和奠酒用的杯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用纯金做桌子的器皿，就是盘子、碟子、碗和奠酒用的杯。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用精金做桌子上的器皿，就是盘子、调羹，并奠酒的瓶和爵。
verses.textEnNiv: And they made from pure gold the articles for the table—its plates and dishes and bowls and its pitchers for the pouring out of drink offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made the vessels of pure gold that were to be on the table, its plates and dishes for incense, and its bowls and flagons with which to pour drink offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made of pure gold the utensils which were on the table: its dishes, its cups, its bowls, and its pitchers for pouring.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he made special containers of pure gold for the table—bowls, ladles, jars, and pitchers—to be used in pouring out liquid offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made the utensils which were on the table, its dishes, its pans, its libation bowls, and its jars, with which to pour out drink offerings, of pure gold.
verses.textEn: And they made from pure gold the articles for the table—its plates and dishes and bowls and its pitchers for the pouring out of drink offerings.

verses.textZh: 他用纯金做了一个灯台，他用锤锤成灯台；灯台的座和干，跟杯、球、花，都是连在一起的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用纯金做了一个灯台，他用锤锤成灯台；灯台的座和干，跟杯、球、花，都是连在一起的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用精金做一个灯台；这灯台的座和干，与杯、球、花，都是接连一块锤出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: They made the lampstand of pure gold. They hammered out its base and shaft, and made its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms of one piece with them.
verses.textEnEsv: He also made the lampstand of pure gold. He made the lampstand of hammered work. Its base, its stem, its cups, its calyxes, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made the lampstand of pure gold; of hammered work he made the lampstand. Its shaft, its branches, its bowls, its ornamental knobs, and its flowers were of the same piece.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Bezalel made the lampstand of pure, hammered gold. He made the entire lampstand and its decorations of one piece—the base, center stem, lamp cups, buds, and petals.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the lampstand of pure gold. He made the lampstand of hammered work, its base and its shaft; its cups, its bulbs, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
verses.textEn: They made the lampstand of pure gold. They hammered out its base and shaft, and made its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms of one piece with them.

verses.textZh: 灯台的两边伸出六个枝子，这一边有三个灯台枝子，那一边也有三个灯台枝子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯台的两边伸出六个枝子，这一边有三个灯台枝子，那一边也有三个灯台枝子。
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台两旁杈出六个枝子：这旁三个，那旁三个。
verses.textEnNiv: Six branches extended from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
verses.textEnEsv: And there were six branches going out of its sides, three branches of the lampstand out of one side of it and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it;
verses.textEnNkjv: And six branches came out of its sides: three branches of the lampstand out of one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.
verses.textEnNlt: The lampstand had six branches going out from the center stem, three on each side.
verses.textEnNasb: There were six branches going out of its sides; three branches of the lampstand from the one side of it and three branches of the lampstand from the other side of it;
verses.textEn: Six branches extended from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.

verses.textZh: 在这一个枝子有三个杯，形状好象杏花，有球、有花；在那一个枝子上也有三个杯，形状好象杏花，有球、有花。从灯台那里伸出来的六个枝子都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一个枝子有三个杯，形状好象杏花，有球、有花；在那一个枝子上也有三个杯，形状好象杏花，有球、有花。从灯台那里伸出来的六个枝子都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 这旁每枝上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球有花；那旁每枝上也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球有花。从灯台杈出来的六个枝子都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms were on one branch, three on the next branch and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.
verses.textEnEsv: three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on one branch, and three cups made like almond blossoms, each with calyx and flower, on the other branch—so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.
verses.textEnNkjv: There were three bowls made like almond blossoms on one branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower, and three bowls made like almond blossoms on the other branch, with an ornamental knob and a flower—and so for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of the six branches had three lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.
verses.textEnNasb: three cups shaped like almond blossoms, a bulb and a flower on one branch, and three cups shaped like almond blossoms, a bulb and a flower on the other branch—so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.
verses.textEn: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms were on one branch, three on the next branch and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

verses.textZh: 灯台上有四个杯，形状好象杏花，有球、有花；
verses.textZhCnvs: 灯台上有四个杯，形状好象杏花，有球、有花；
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球有花。
verses.textEnNiv: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the lampstand itself were four cups made like almond blossoms, with their calyxes and flowers,
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the lampstand itself were four bowls made like almond blossoms, each with its ornamental knob and flower.
verses.textEnNlt: The center stem of the lampstand was crafted with four lamp cups shaped like almond blossoms, complete with buds and petals.
verses.textEnNasb: And on the lampstand there were four cups shaped like almond blossoms, its bulbs and its flowers;
verses.textEn: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.

verses.textZh: 从灯台伸出的每两个枝子以下都有一个球，灯台的六个枝子都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从灯台伸出的每两个枝子以下都有一个球，灯台的六个枝子都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 灯台每两个枝子以下有球，与枝子接连一块；灯台杈出的六个枝子都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: One bud was under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair—six branches in all.
verses.textEnEsv: and a calyx of one piece with it under each pair of the six branches going out of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewas a knob under the first two branches of the same, a knob under the second two branches of the same, and a knob under the third two branches of the same, according to the six branches extending from it.
verses.textEnNlt: There was an almond bud beneath each pair of branches where the six branches extended from the center stem, all made of one piece.
verses.textEnNasb: and a bulb was under the first pair of branches coming out of it, and a bulb under the second pair of branches coming out of it, and a bulb under the third pair of branches coming out of it, for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.
verses.textEn: One bud was under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair—six branches in all.

verses.textZh: 这些球和枝子都是连在一起的，全都是一块纯金锤成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些球和枝子都是连在一起的，全都是一块纯金锤成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 球和枝子是接连一块，都是一块精金锤出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: The buds and the branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
verses.textEnEsv: Their calyxes and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole of it was a single piece of hammered work of pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their knobs and their branches were of one piece; all of it was one hammered piece of pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: The almond buds and branches were all of one piece with the center stem, and they were hammered from pure gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Their bulbs and their branches were of one piece with it; the whole of it was a single hammered work of pure gold.
verses.textEn: The buds and the branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

verses.textZh: 又用纯金做灯台的七个灯盏、烛剪和蜡花盘碟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用纯金做灯台的七个灯盏、烛剪和蜡花盘碟。
verses.textZhCuv: 用精金做灯台的七个灯盏，并灯台的蜡剪和蜡花盘。
verses.textEnNiv: They made its seven lamps, as well as its wick trimmers and trays, of pure gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made its seven lamps and its tongs and its trays of pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made its seven lamps, its wick-trimmers, and its trays of pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: He also made seven lamps for the lampstand, lamp snuffers, and trays, all of pure gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made its seven lamps with its tongs and its trays of pure gold.
verses.textEn: They made its seven lamps, as well as its wick trimmers and trays, of pure gold.

verses.textZh: 他用了三十五公斤纯金做灯台和灯台的一切器具。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用了三十五公斤纯金做灯台和灯台的一切器具。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用精金一他连得做灯台和灯台的一切器具。
verses.textEnNiv: They made the lampstand and all its accessories from one talent of pure gold.
verses.textEnEsv: He made it and all its utensils out of a talent of pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of a talent of pure gold he made it, with all its utensils.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire lampstand, along with its accessories, was made from 75 pounds of pure gold.
verses.textEnNasb: He made it and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold.
verses.textEn: They made the lampstand and all its accessories from one talent of pure gold.

verses.textZh: 他用皂荚木做了一座香坛，长四十四公分，宽四十四公分，是正方形的，高八十八公分；坛的四角是与坛连在一起的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用皂荚木做了一座香坛，长四十四公分，宽四十四公分，是正方形的，高八十八公分；坛的四角是与坛连在一起的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用皂荚木做香坛，是四方的，长一肘，宽一肘，高二肘，坛的四角与坛接连一块；
verses.textEnNiv: They made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide and two cubits high —its horns of one piece with it.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. Its length was a cubit, and its breadth was a cubit. It was square, and two cubits was its height. Its horns were of one piece with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made the incense altar of acacia wood. Its length was a cubit and its width a cubit—itwas square—and two cubits was its height. Its horns were ofonepiece with it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Bezalel made the incense altar of acacia wood. It was 18 inches square and 36 inches high, with horns at the corners carved from the same piece of wood as the altar itself.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the altar of incense of acacia wood: a cubit long and a cubit wide, square, and two cubits high; its horns were of one piece with it.
verses.textEn: They made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide and two cubits high —its horns of one piece with it.

verses.textZh: 又用纯金把坛包裹，坛顶、坛的四边和坛的四角都包裹，又替坛做了金牙边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用纯金把坛包裹，坛顶、坛的四边和坛的四角都包裹，又替坛做了金牙边。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用精金把坛的上面与坛的四面并坛的四角包裹，又在坛的四围镶上金牙边。
verses.textEnNiv: They overlaid the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
verses.textEnEsv: He overlaid it with pure gold, its top and around its sides and its horns. And he made a molding of gold around it,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides all around, and its horns. He also made for it a molding of gold all around it.
verses.textEnNlt: He overlaid the top, sides, and horns of the altar with pure gold, and he ran a gold molding around the entire altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And he overlaid it with pure gold, its top and its sides all around, and its horns; and he made a gold molding for it all around.
verses.textEn: They overlaid the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

verses.textZh: 又替坛做了两个金环，安放在牙边以下，坛的两侧，就是坛的两旁，作穿杠的地方，用来抬坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又替坛做了两个金环，安放在牙边以下，坛的两侧，就是坛的两旁，作穿杠的地方，用来抬坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 做两个金环，安在牙子边以下，在坛的两旁、两根横撑上，作为穿杠的用处，以便抬坛。
verses.textEnNiv: They made two gold rings below the molding—two on each of the opposite sides—to hold the poles used to carry it.
verses.textEnEsv: and made two rings of gold on it under its molding, on two opposite sides of it, as holders for the poles with which to carry it.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made two rings of gold for it under its molding, by its two corners on both sides, as holders for the poles with which to bear it.
verses.textEnNlt: He made two gold rings and attached them on opposite sides of the altar below the gold molding to hold the carrying poles.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made two golden rings for it under its molding, on its two sides—on opposite sides—as holders for poles with which to carry it.
verses.textEn: They made two gold rings below the molding—two on each of the opposite sides—to hold the poles used to carry it.

verses.textZh: 用皂荚木做了两根杠，用金包裹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用皂荚木做了两根杠，用金包裹。
verses.textZhCuv: 用皂荚木做杠，用金包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: He made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.textEn: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

verses.textZh: 又按着制香料者的制法，制圣膏油以及芬芳的纯香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又按着制香料者的制法，制圣膏油以及芬芳的纯香。
verses.textZhCuv: 又按做香之法做圣膏油和馨香料的净香。
verses.textEnNiv: They also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense—the work of a perfumer.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the holy anointing oil also, and the pure fragrant incense, blended as by the perfumer.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the perfumer.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he made the sacred anointing oil and the fragrant incense, using the techniques of a skilled incense maker.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the holy anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense of spices, the work of a perfumer.
verses.textEn: They also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense—the work of a perfumer.

verses.textZh: 他用皂荚木做燔祭坛，长两公尺两公寸，宽两公尺两公寸，成正方形，高一公尺三公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用皂荚木做燔祭坛，长两公尺两公寸，宽两公尺两公寸，成正方形，高一公尺三公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用皂荚木做燔祭坛，是四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘，
verses.textEnNiv: They built the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood, three cubits high; it was square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. Five cubits was its length, and five cubits its breadth. It was square, and three cubits was its height.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood; five cubits was its length and five cubits its width—itwas square—and its height was three cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Bezalel used acacia wood to construct the square altar of burnt offering. It was 7-1/2 feet wide, 7-1/2 feet long, and 4-1/2 feet high.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide, square, and three cubits high.
verses.textEn: They built the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood, three cubits high; it was square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 在坛的四个拐角做了四只角，角是与坛连在一起的；又用铜把坛包裹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在坛的四个拐角做了四只角，角是与坛连在一起的；又用铜把坛包裹。
verses.textZhCuv: 在坛的四拐角上做四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: They made a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar were of one piece, and they overlaid the altar with bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: He made horns for it on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made its horns on its four corners; the horns were ofonepiece with it. And he overlaid it with bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: He made horns for each of its four corners so that the horns and altar were all one piece. He overlaid the altar with bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made its horns on its four corners, its horns being of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
verses.textEn: They made a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar were of one piece, and they overlaid the altar with bronze.

verses.textZh: 又做坛上的一切器具，就是盆、铲、盘、肉叉和火盆；坛上的一切器具都是用铜做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又做坛上的一切器具，就是盆、铲、盘、肉叉和火盆；坛上的一切器具都是用铜做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他做坛上的盆、铲子、盘子、肉锸子、火鼎；这一切器具都是用铜做的。
verses.textEnNiv: They made all its utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made all the utensils of the altar, the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its utensils of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made all the utensils for the altar: the pans, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the firepans; all its utensils he made of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he made all the altar utensils of bronze—the ash buckets, shovels, basins, meat forks, and firepans.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made all the utensils of the altar, the pails, the shovels, the basins, the meat-forks, and the firepans; he made all its utensils of bronze.
verses.textEn: They made all its utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.

verses.textZh: 又替坛做一个铜网，放在坛的围腰板以下，向下直到坛的半腰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又替坛做一个铜网，放在坛的围腰板以下，向下直到坛的半腰。
verses.textZhCuv: 又为坛做一个铜网，安在坛四面的围腰板以下，从下达到坛的半腰。
verses.textEnNiv: They made a grating for the altar, a bronze network, to be under its ledge, halfway up the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made for the altar a grating, a network of bronze, under its ledge, extending halfway down.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made a grate of bronze network for the altar, under its rim, midway from the bottom.
verses.textEnNlt: Next he made a bronze grating and installed it halfway down the side of the altar, under the ledge.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made for the altar a grating of bronze netting beneath, under its ledge, reaching halfway up.
verses.textEn: They made a grating for the altar, a bronze network, to be under its ledge, halfway up the altar.

verses.textZh: 又铸造四个环，放在铜网的四端之上，用作抬坛的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又铸造四个环，放在铜网的四端之上，用作抬坛的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 为铜网的四角铸四个环子，作为穿杠的用处。
verses.textEnNiv: They cast bronze rings to hold the poles for the four corners of the bronze grating.
verses.textEnEsv: He cast four rings on the four corners of the bronze grating as holders for the poles.
verses.textEnNkjv: He cast four rings for the four corners of the bronze grating, as holders for the poles.
verses.textEnNlt: He cast four rings and attached them to the corners of the bronze grating to hold the carrying poles.
verses.textEnNasb: He also cast four rings on the four ends of the bronze grating as holders for the poles.
verses.textEn: They cast bronze rings to hold the poles for the four corners of the bronze grating.

verses.textZh: 他用皂荚木做两根杠，用铜包裹，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用皂荚木做两根杠，用铜包裹，
verses.textZhCuv: 用皂荚木做杠，用铜包裹，
verses.textEnNiv: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: He made the poles from acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: He made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
verses.textEn: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.

verses.textZh: 把杠穿在坛两侧的环里，用来抬坛；坛是用木板做的，是空的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把杠穿在坛两侧的环里，用来抬坛；坛是用木板做的，是空的。
verses.textZhCuv: 把杠穿在坛两旁的环子内，用以抬坛，并用板做坛；坛是空的。
verses.textEnNiv: They inserted the poles into the rings so they would be on the sides of the altar for carrying it. They made it hollow, out of boards.
verses.textEnEsv: And he put the poles through the rings on the sides of the altar to carry it with them. He made it hollow, with boards.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to bear it. He made the altar hollow with boards.
verses.textEnNlt: He inserted the poles through the rings on the sides of the altar. The altar was hollow and was made from planks.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
verses.textEn: They inserted the poles into the rings so they would be on the sides of the altar for carrying it. They made it hollow, out of boards.

verses.textZh: 他用铜做洗濯盆，又用铜做盆座，是用那些在会幕门口服事的妇女的铜镜做成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用铜做洗濯盆，又用铜做盆座，是用那些在会幕门口服事的妇女的铜镜做成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用铜做洗濯盆和盆座，是用会幕门前伺候的妇人之镜子做的。
verses.textEnNiv: They made the bronze basin and its bronze stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the basin of bronze and its stand of bronze, from the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered in the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made the laver of bronze and its base of bronze, from the bronze mirrors of the serving women who assembled at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Bezalel made the bronze washbasin and its bronze stand from bronze mirrors donated by the women who served at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, he made the basin of bronze with its base of bronze, from the mirrors of the serving women who served at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: They made the bronze basin and its bronze stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 他又做院子；南面，就是向南的方向，用捻的细麻做院子的幔幕，共四十四公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又做院子；南面，就是向南的方向，用捻的细麻做院子的幔幕，共四十四公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 他做帐幕的院子。院子的南面用捻的细麻做帷子，宽一百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Next they made the courtyard. The south side was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely twisted linen,
verses.textEnEsv: And he made the court. For the south side the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, a hundred cubits;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he made the court on the south side; the hangings of the court wereof fine woven linen, one hundred cubits long.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Bezalel made the courtyard, which was enclosed with curtains made of finely woven linen. On the south side the curtains were 150 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the courtyard: for the south side the hangings of the courtyard were of fine twisted linen, a hundred cubits;
verses.textEn: Next they made the courtyard. The south side was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely twisted linen,

verses.textZh: 幔幕的柱子有二十根，柱座有二十个，是铜做的；柱钩和横柱闩是银做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 幔幕的柱子有二十根，柱座有二十个，是铜做的；柱钩和横柱闩是银做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个；柱子上的钩子和杆子都是用银子做的。
verses.textEnNiv: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
verses.textEnEsv: their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: There were twenty pillars for them, with twenty bronze sockets. The hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
verses.textEnNlt: They were held up by twenty posts set securely in twenty bronze bases. He hung the curtains with silver hooks and rings.
verses.textEnNasb: their twenty pillars, and their twenty bases, were made of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.
verses.textEn: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

verses.textZh: 北面，有幔幕四十四公尺，幔幕的柱子有二十根，柱座有二十个，是铜做的；柱钩和横柱闩是银做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 北面，有幔幕四十四公尺，幔幕的柱子有二十根，柱座有二十个，是铜做的；柱钩和横柱闩是银做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 北面也有帷子，宽一百肘。帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个；柱子上的钩子和杆子都是用银子做的。
verses.textEnNiv: The north side was also a hundred cubits long and had twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
verses.textEnEsv: And for the north side there were hangings of a hundred cubits; their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the north side thehangingswere one hundred cubits long, with twenty pillars and their twenty bronze sockets. The hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
verses.textEnNlt: He made a similar set of curtains for the north side—150 feet of curtains held up by twenty posts set securely in bronze bases. He hung the curtains with silver hooks and rings.
verses.textEnNasb: For the north side there were a hundred cubits; their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were of bronze, the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.
verses.textEn: The north side was also a hundred cubits long and had twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

verses.textZh: 西面，有幔幕二十二公尺，幔幕的柱子有十根，柱座有十个；柱钩和横柱闩是银做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西面，有幔幕二十二公尺，幔幕的柱子有十根，柱座有十个；柱钩和横柱闩是银做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的西面有帷子，宽五十肘。帷子的柱子十根，带卯的座十个；柱子的钩子和杆子都是用银子做的。
verses.textEnNiv: The west end was fifty cubits wide and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
verses.textEnEsv: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their ten pillars, and their ten bases; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the west side therewere hangings of fifty cubits, with ten pillars and their ten sockets. The hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver.
verses.textEnNlt: The curtains on the west end of the courtyard were 75 feet long, hung with silver hooks and rings and supported by ten posts set into ten bases.
verses.textEnNasb: For the west side there were hangings of fifty cubits with their ten pillars and their ten bases; the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.
verses.textEn: The west end was fifty cubits wide and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

verses.textZh: 东面，就是日出的方向，有幔幕二十二公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东面，就是日出的方向，有幔幕二十二公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的东面，宽五十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The east end, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: And for the front to the east, fifty cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the east side thehangingswere fifty cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: The east end, the front, was also 75 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: For the east side, fifty cubits.
verses.textEn: The east end, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 门口这一边有幔幕六公尺六公寸；幔幕的柱子有三根，柱座有三个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门口这一边有幔幕六公尺六公寸；幔幕的柱子有三根，柱座有三个。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子四面的帷子都是用捻的细麻做的。
verses.textEnNiv: Curtains fifteen cubits long were on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,
verses.textEnEsv: The hangings for one side of the gate were fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and three bases.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hangings of one side ofthegatewere fifteen cubits long, with their three pillars and their three sockets,
verses.textEnNlt: The courtyard entrance was on the east end, flanked by two curtains. The curtain on the right side was 22-1/2 feet long and was supported by three posts set into three bases.
verses.textEnNasb: The hangings for the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three bases,
verses.textEn: Curtains fifteen cubits long were on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

verses.textZh: 门口那一边也是这样。院子门口的两边各有幔幕六公尺六公寸；幔幕的柱子有三根，柱座有三个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门口那一边也是这样。院子门口的两边各有幔幕六公尺六公寸；幔幕的柱子有三根，柱座有三个。
verses.textZhCuv: 柱子带卯的座是铜的，柱子上的钩子和杆子是银的，柱顶是用银子包的。院子一切的柱子都是用银杆连络的。
verses.textEnNiv: and curtains fifteen cubits long were on the other side of the entrance to the courtyard, with three posts and three bases.
verses.textEnEsv: And so for the other side. On both sides of the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three bases.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the same for the other side of the court gate; on this side and that were hangings of fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three sockets.
verses.textEnNlt: The curtain on the left side was also 22-1/2 feet long and was supported by three posts set into three bases.
verses.textEnNasb: and so for the other side. On both sides of the gate of the courtyard were hangings of fifteen cubits, with their three pillars and their three bases.
verses.textEn: and curtains fifteen cubits long were on the other side of the entrance to the courtyard, with three posts and three bases.

verses.textZh: 院子周围的一切幔幕都是用捻的细麻做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子周围的一切幔幕都是用捻的细麻做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的门帘是以绣花的手工，用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和捻的细麻织的，宽二十肘，高五肘，与院子的帷子相配。
verses.textEnNiv: All the curtains around the courtyard were of finely twisted linen.
verses.textEnEsv: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the hangings of the court all around wereof fine woven linen.
verses.textEnNlt: All the curtains used in the courtyard were made of finely woven linen.
verses.textEnNasb: All the hangings of the courtyard all around were of fine twisted linen.
verses.textEn: All the curtains around the courtyard were of finely twisted linen.

verses.textZh: 柱座是铜做的，柱钩和横柱闩是银做的，柱顶是用银包裹的；院子的一切柱子都是用银横闩相连起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 柱座是铜做的，柱钩和横柱闩是银做的，柱顶是用银包裹的；院子的一切柱子都是用银横闩相连起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 帷子的柱子四根，带卯的铜座四个；柱子上的钩子和杆子是银的；柱顶是用银子包的。
verses.textEnNiv: The bases for the posts were bronze. The hooks and bands on the posts were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver; so all the posts of the courtyard had silver bands.
verses.textEnEsv: And the bases for the pillars were of bronze, but the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. The overlaying of their capitals was also of silver, and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sockets for the pillars were bronze, the hooks of the pillars and their bands were silver, and the overlay of their capitals was silver; and all the pillars of the court had bands of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: Each post had a bronze base, and all the hooks and rings were silver. The tops of the posts of the courtyard were overlaid with silver, and the rings to hold up the curtains were made of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: And the bases for the pillars were of bronze, the hooks of the pillars and their bands, of silver; and the overlaying of their tops, of silver, and all the pillars of the courtyard were furnished with silver bands.
verses.textEn: The bases for the posts were bronze. The hooks and bands on the posts were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver; so all the posts of the courtyard had silver bands.

verses.textZh: 院子的门帘，是用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻，以及刺绣的手工做成的；长九公尺，以宽度来说，两公尺高，与院子的幔幕相配。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子的门帘，是用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻，以及刺绣的手工做成的；长九公尺，以宽度来说，两公尺高，与院子的幔幕相配。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕一切的橛子和院子四围的橛子都是铜的。
verses.textEnNiv: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was made of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,
verses.textEnEsv: And the screen for the gate of the court was embroidered with needlework in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen. It was twenty cubits long and five cubits high in its breadth, corresponding to the hangings of the court.
verses.textEnNkjv: The screen for the gate of the court was woven of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine woven linen. The length was twenty cubits, and the height along its width was five cubits, corresponding to the hangings of the court.
verses.textEnNlt: He made the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard of finely woven linen, and he decorated it with beautiful embroidery in blue, purple, and scarlet thread. It was 30 feet long, and its height was 7-1/2 feet, just like the curtains of the courtyard walls.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the curtain of the gate of the courtyard was the work of the weaver, of violet, purple, and scarlet material and fine twisted linen. And the length was twenty cubits and the height was five cubits, corresponding to the hangings of the courtyard.
verses.textEn: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was made of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen—the work of an embroiderer. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,

verses.textZh: 幔幕的柱子有四根，柱座有四个，是铜做的；柱钩是银做的，柱顶和横柱闩是用银包裹的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 幔幕的柱子有四根，柱座有四个，是铜做的；柱钩是银做的，柱顶和横柱闩是用银包裹的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是法柜的帐幕中利未人所用物件的总数，是照摩西的吩咐，经祭司亚伦的儿子以他玛的手数点的。
verses.textEnNiv: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks and bands were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver.
verses.textEnEsv: And their pillars were four in number. Their four bases were of bronze, their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals and their fillets of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: And therewere four pillars with their four sockets of bronze; their hooks were silver, and the overlay of their capitals and their bands was silver.
verses.textEnNlt: It was supported by four posts, each set securely in its own bronze base. The tops of the posts were overlaid with silver, and the hooks and rings were also made of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: Their four pillars and their four bases were of bronze; their hooks were of silver, and the overlaying of their tops and their bands were of silver.
verses.textEn: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks and bands were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver.

verses.textZh: 帐幕的一切钉子和院子四周的一切钉子，都是铜做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 帐幕的一切钉子和院子四周的一切钉子，都是铜做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的都是犹大支派户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列做的。
verses.textEnNiv: All the tent pegs of the tabernacle and of the surrounding courtyard were bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the pegs for the tabernacle and for the court all around were of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the pegs of the tabernacle, and of the court all around, were bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: All the tent pegs used in the Tabernacle and courtyard were made of bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: All the pegs of the tabernacle and of the courtyard all around were of bronze.
verses.textEn: All the tent pegs of the tabernacle and of the surrounding courtyard were bronze.

verses.textZh: 这是帐幕 内利未人使用的物件的总数，是照着摩西的吩咐，经亚伦祭司的儿子以他玛的手计算的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是帐幕 内利未人使用的物件的总数，是照着摩西的吩咐，经亚伦祭司的儿子以他玛的手计算的。
verses.textZhCuv: 与他同工的有但支派中亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯；他是雕刻匠，又是巧匠，又能用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，和细麻绣花。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the amounts of the materials used for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the covenant law, which were recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the records of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the testimony, as they were recorded at the commandment of Moses, the responsibility of the Levites under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the inventory of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, which was counted according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: This is an inventory of the materials used in building the Tabernacle of the Covenant. The Levites compiled the figures, as Moses directed, and Ithamar son of Aaron the priest served as recorder.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the number of the things for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the testimony, as they were counted according to the command of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textEn: These are the amounts of the materials used for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the covenant law, which were recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

verses.textZh: 凡是耶和华吩咐摩西的，犹大支派户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列都做了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是耶和华吩咐摩西的，犹大支派户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列都做了。
verses.textZhCuv: 为圣所一切工作使用所献的金子，按圣所的平，有二十九他连得并七百三十舍客勒。

verses.textEnNkjv: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Bezalel son of Uri, grandson of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything that the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: (Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything the Lord commanded Moses;

verses.textZh: 与他同工的，有但支派亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯，是个雕刻匠、图案设计家，以及能用蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻刺绣的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 与他同工的，有但支派亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯，是个雕刻匠、图案设计家，以及能用蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻刺绣的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 会中被数的人所出的银子，按圣所的平，有一百他连得并一千七百七十五舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: with him was Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan—an engraver and designer, and an embroiderer in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen.)
verses.textEnEsv: and with him was Oholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver and designer and embroiderer in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And with him was Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver and designer, a weaver of blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine linen.
verses.textEnNlt: He was assisted by Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, a craftsman expert at engraving, designing, and embroidering with blue, purple, and scarlet thread on fine linen cloth.
verses.textEnNasb: With him was Oholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver and a skilled embroiderer, and a weaver in violet, in purple, and in scarlet material, and fine linen.
verses.textEn: with him was Oholiab son of Ahisamak, of the tribe of Dan—an engraver and designer, and an embroiderer in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen.)

verses.textZh: 用来建造圣所整个工程使用的一切黄金，就是献作礼物的金子，按照圣所的标准，共有一千公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用来建造圣所整个工程使用的一切黄金，就是献作礼物的金子，按照圣所的标准，共有一千公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡过去归那些被数之人的，从二十岁以外，有六十万零三千五百五十人。按圣所的平，每人出银半舍客勒，就是一比加。
verses.textEnNiv: The total amount of the gold from the wave offering used for all the work on the sanctuary was 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
verses.textEnEsv: All the gold that was used for the work, in all the construction of the sanctuary, the gold from the offering, was twenty-nine talents and 730 shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the gold that was used in all the work of the holy place, that is, the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred and thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: The people brought special offerings of gold totaling 2,193 pounds, as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel. This gold was used throughout the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: All the gold that was used for the work, in all the work of the sanctuary, which was the gold of the wave offering, was twenty-nine talents and 730 shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: The total amount of the gold from the wave offering used for all the work on the sanctuary was 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

verses.textZh: 会众中被数点的人所出的银子，按照圣所的标准，共有三千四百三十公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 会众中被数点的人所出的银子，按照圣所的标准，共有三千四百三十公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 用那一百他连得银子铸造圣所带卯的座和幔子柱子带卯的座；一百他连得共一百带卯的座，每带卯的座用一他连得。
verses.textEnNiv: The silver obtained from those of the community who were counted in the census was 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel—
verses.textEnEsv: The silver from those of the congregation who were recorded was a hundred talents and 1,775 shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the silver from those who were numbered of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.textEnNlt: The whole community of Israel gave 7,545 pounds of silver, as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel.
verses.textEnNasb: And the silver of those of the congregation who were counted was a hundred talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;
verses.textEn: The silver obtained from those of the community who were counted in the census was 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel—

verses.textZh: 凡是按着次序被数点的人，从二十岁以上的，有六十万三千五百五十人，按着圣所的标准，每人纳银六克。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是按着次序被数点的人，从二十岁以上的，有六十万三千五百五十人，按着圣所的标准，每人纳银六克。
verses.textZhCuv: 用那一千七百七十五舍客勒银子做柱子上的钩子，包裹柱顶并柱子上的杆子。
verses.textEnNiv: one beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone who had crossed over to those counted, twenty years old or more, a total of 603,550 men.
verses.textEnEsv: a beka a head (that is, half a shekel, by the shekel of the sanctuary), for everyone who was listed in the records, from twenty years old and upward, for 603,550 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: a bekah for each man (thatis, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary), for everyone included in the numbering from twenty years old and above, for six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty men.
verses.textEnNlt: This silver came from the tax collected from each man registered in the census. (The tax is one beka, which is half a shekel, based on the sanctuary shekel.) The tax was collected from 603,550 men who had reached their twentieth birthday.
verses.textEnNasb: a beka a head (that is, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary), assessed to each one who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for 603,550 men.
verses.textEn: one beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone who had crossed over to those counted, twenty years old or more, a total of 603,550 men.

verses.textZh: 他用这三千四百公斤银子铸造圣所的柱座，和幔子的柱座；一百个柱座用了三千四百公斤银子，三十四公斤银子做一个柱座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用这三千四百公斤银子铸造圣所的柱座，和幔子的柱座；一百个柱座用了三千四百公斤银子，三十四公斤银子做一个柱座。
verses.textZhCuv: 所献的铜有七十他连得并二千四百舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: The 100 talents of silver were used to cast the bases for the sanctuary and for the curtain—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent for each base.
verses.textEnEsv: The hundred talents of silver were for casting the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil; a hundred bases for the hundred talents, a talent a base.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil: one hundred sockets from the hundred talents, one talent for each socket.
verses.textEnNlt: The hundred bases for the frames of the sanctuary walls and for the posts supporting the inner curtain required 7,500 pounds of silver, about 75 pounds for each base.
verses.textEnNasb: The hundred talents of silver were used for casting the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil; a hundred bases for the hundred talents, a talent for a base.
verses.textEn: The 100 talents of silver were used to cast the bases for the sanctuary and for the curtain—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent for each base.

verses.textZh: 他用三十公斤银子做柱钩，包裹柱顶，以及为柱顶做横柱闩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用三十公斤银子做柱钩，包裹柱顶，以及为柱顶做横柱闩。
verses.textZhCuv: 用这铜做会幕门带卯的座和铜坛，并坛上的铜网和坛的一切器具，
verses.textEnNiv: They used the 1,775 shekels to make the hooks for the posts, to overlay the tops of the posts, and to make their bands.
verses.textEnEsv: And of the 1,775 shekels he made hooks for the pillars and overlaid their capitals and made fillets for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then from the one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made bands for them.
verses.textEnNlt: The remaining 45 pounds of silver was used to make the hooks and rings and to overlay the tops of the posts.
verses.textEnNasb: And of the 1,775 shekels, he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their tops and made bands for them.
verses.textEn: They used the 1,775 shekels to make the hooks for the posts, to overlay the tops of the posts, and to make their bands.

verses.textZh: 献作礼物的铜有二千四百二十五公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 献作礼物的铜有二千四百二十五公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 并院子四围带卯的座和院门带卯的座，与帐幕一切的橛子和院子四围所有的橛子。
verses.textEnNiv: The bronze from the wave offering was 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.
verses.textEnEsv: The bronze that was offered was seventy talents and 2,400 shekels;
verses.textEnNkjv: The offering of bronze was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
verses.textEnNlt: The people also brought as special offerings 5,310 pounds of bronze,
verses.textEnNasb: And the bronze of the wave offering was seventy talents and 2,400 shekels.
verses.textEn: The bronze from the wave offering was 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.

verses.textZh: 他用这些铜做会幕门口的柱座、铜坛和坛上的铜网，以及坛上的一切器具、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用这些铜做会幕门口的柱座、铜坛和坛上的铜网，以及坛上的一切器具、
verses.textZhCuv: 他用这些铜做会幕门口的柱座、铜坛和坛上的铜网，以及坛上的一切器具、
verses.textEnNiv: They used it to make the bases for the entrance to the tent of meeting, the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all its utensils,
verses.textEnEsv: with it he made the bases for the entrance of the tent of meeting, the bronze altar and the bronze grating for it and all the utensils of the altar,
