verses.textEnNkjv: And with it he made the sockets for the door of the tabernacle of meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, and all the utensils for the altar,
verses.textEnNlt: which was used for casting the bases for the posts at the entrance to the Tabernacle, and for the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all the altar utensils.
verses.textEnNasb: With it he made the bases to the doorway of the tent of meeting, and the bronze altar and its bronze grating, and all the utensils of the altar,
verses.textEn: They used it to make the bases for the entrance to the tent of meeting, the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all its utensils,

verses.textZh: 院子四周的柱座、院子门口的柱座、帐幕的一切钉子和院子四周的一切钉子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子四周的柱座、院子门口的柱座、帐幕的一切钉子和院子四周的一切钉子。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子四周的柱座、院子门口的柱座、帐幕的一切钉子和院子四周的一切钉子。
verses.textEnNiv: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and those for its entrance and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and those for the surrounding courtyard.
verses.textEnEsv: the bases around the court, and the bases of the gate of the court, all the pegs of the tabernacle, and all the pegs around the court.
verses.textEnNkjv: the sockets for the court all around, the bases for the court gate, all the pegs for the tabernacle, and all the pegs for the court all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Bronze was also used to make the bases for the posts that supported the curtains around the courtyard, the bases for the curtain at the entrance of the courtyard, and all the tent pegs for the Tabernacle and the courtyard.
verses.textEnNasb: and the bases of the courtyard all around and the bases of the gate of the courtyard, and all the pegs of the tabernacle and all the pegs of the courtyard all around.
verses.textEn: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and those for its entrance and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and those for the surrounding courtyard.

verses.textZh: 他们用蓝色紫色朱红色线做彩衣，在圣所供职时穿著；又照着耶和华吩咐摩西的，为亚伦做圣衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用蓝色紫色朱红色线做彩衣，在圣所供职时穿著；又照着耶和华吩咐摩西的，为亚伦做圣衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 比撒列用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线做精致的衣服，在圣所用以供职，又为亚伦做圣衣，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: From the blue, purple and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary. They also made sacred garments for Aaron, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: From the blue and purple and scarlet yarns they made finely woven garments, for ministering in the Holy Place. They made the holy garments for Aaron, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet thread they made garments of ministry, for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: The craftsmen made beautiful sacred garments of blue, purple, and scarlet cloth—clothing for Aaron to wear while ministering in the Holy Place, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Now from the violet, purple, and scarlet material they made finely woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, as well as the holy garments which were for Aaron, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: From the blue, purple and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary. They also made sacred garments for Aaron, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 又用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做以弗得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做以弗得。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做以弗得；
verses.textEnNiv: They made the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the ephod of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine woven linen.
verses.textEnNlt: Bezalel made the ephod of finely woven linen and embroidered it with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
verses.textEnNasb: He made the ephod of gold and of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen.
verses.textEn: They made the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

verses.textZh: 他们把金子锤成薄片，剪成细线，用巧工织在蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把金子锤成薄片，剪成细线，用巧工织在蓝色紫色朱红色线和细麻之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 把金子锤成薄片，剪出线来，与蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，用巧匠的手工一同绣上。
verses.textEnNiv: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut strands to be worked into the blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen—the work of skilled hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And they hammered out gold leaf, and he cut it into threads to work into the blue and purple and the scarlet yarns, and into the fine twined linen, in skilled design.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they beat the gold into thin sheets and cut itinto threads, to work it in with the blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and the fine linen, into artistic designs.
verses.textEnNlt: He made gold thread by hammering out thin sheets of gold and cutting it into fine strands. With great skill and care, he worked it into the fine linen with the blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they hammered out gold sheets and cut them into threads to be woven in with the violet, the purple, and the scarlet material, and the fine linen, the work of a skilled embroiderer.
verses.textEn: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut strands to be worked into the blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen—the work of skilled hands.

verses.textZh: 又为以弗得做相连的肩带，把以弗得的两端连接起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又为以弗得做相连的肩带，把以弗得的两端连接起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 又为以弗得做两条相连的肩带，接连在以弗得的两头。
verses.textEnNiv: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached to two of its corners, so it could be fastened.
verses.textEnEsv: They made for the ephod attaching shoulder pieces, joined to it at its two edges.
verses.textEnNkjv: They made shoulder straps for it to couple it together; it was coupled together at its two edges.
verses.textEnNlt: The ephod consisted of two pieces, front and back, joined at the shoulders with two shoulder-pieces.
verses.textEnNasb: They made attaching shoulder pieces for the ephod; it was attached at its two upper ends.
verses.textEn: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached to two of its corners, so it could be fastened.

verses.textZh: 上面的带子，做法好象以弗得一样，与以弗得连在一起，都用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做的，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 上面的带子，做法好象以弗得一样，与以弗得连在一起，都用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做的，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 其上巧工织的带子和以弗得一样的做法，用以束上，与以弗得接连一块，是用金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做的，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: Its skillfully woven waistband was like it—of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And the skillfully woven band on it was of one piece with it and made like it, of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the intricately woven band of his ephod that was on it was of the same workmanship, wovenof gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine woven linen, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: The decorative sash was made of the same materials: finely woven linen embroidered with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: And the skillfully woven band of its overlay which was on it was like its workmanship, of the same material: of gold and of violet, purple, and scarlet material, and fine twisted linen, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Its skillfully woven waistband was like it—of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 他们预备了两块红玛瑙宝石，镶嵌在金槽里，又用刻图章的方法刻上以色列众子的名字，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们预备了两块红玛瑙宝石，镶嵌在金槽里，又用刻图章的方法刻上以色列众子的名字，
verses.textZhCuv: 又琢出两块红玛瑙，镶在金槽上，仿佛刻图书，按着以色列儿子的名字雕刻；
verses.textEnNiv: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings and engraved them like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: They made the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold filigree, and engraved like the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they set onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold; they were engraved, as signets are engraved, with the names of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: They mounted the two onyx stones in settings of gold filigree. The stones were engraved with the names of the tribes of Israel, just as a seal is engraved.
verses.textEnNasb: They also made the onyx stones, set in gold filigree settings; they were engraved like the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings and engraved them like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.

verses.textZh: 把这两块宝石放在以弗得的两条肩带上，作以色列人的记念石，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把这两块宝石放在以弗得的两条肩带上，作以色列人的记念石，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人做纪念石，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And he set them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod to be stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: He put them on the shoulders of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: He fastened these stones on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod as a reminder that the priest represents the people of Israel. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: And he placed them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 他又用巧设的图案手工做胸牌，像做以弗得一样，用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又用巧设的图案手工做胸牌，像做以弗得一样，用金线、蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用巧匠的手工做胸牌，和以弗得一样的做法，用金线与蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做的。
verses.textEnNiv: They fashioned the breastpiece—the work of a skilled craftsman. They made it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the breastpiece, in skilled work, in the style of the ephod, of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made the breastplate, artistically woven like the workmanship of the ephod, of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet thread, and of fine woven linen.
verses.textEnNlt: Bezalel made the chestpiece with great skill and care. He made it to match the ephod, using finely woven linen embroidered with gold and with blue, purple, and scarlet thread.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made the breastpiece, the work of a skilled embroiderer, like the workmanship of the ephod: of gold and of violet, purple, and scarlet material and fine twisted linen.
verses.textEn: They fashioned the breastpiece—the work of a skilled craftsman. They made it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

verses.textZh: 胸牌是正方形的；他们把胸牌做成双层，长二十二公分，宽二十二公分，是双层的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 胸牌是正方形的；他们把胸牌做成双层，长二十二公分，宽二十二公分，是双层的。
verses.textZhCuv: 胸牌是四方的，叠为两层；这两层长一虎口，宽一虎口，
verses.textEnNiv: It was square—a span long and a span wide—and folded double.
verses.textEnEsv: It was square. They made the breastpiece doubled, a span its length and a span its breadth when doubled.
verses.textEnNkjv: They made the breastplate square by doubling it; a span was its length and a span its width when doubled.
verses.textEnNlt: He made the chestpiece of a single piece of cloth folded to form a pouch nine inches square.
verses.textEnNasb: It was square; they made the breastpiece folded double, a span long and a span wide when folded double.
verses.textEn: It was square—a span long and a span wide—and folded double.

verses.textZh: 又把四行宝石镶在上面，一行是红宝石、黄玉、翡翠，这是第一行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把四行宝石镶在上面，一行是红宝石、黄玉、翡翠，这是第一行。
verses.textZhCuv: 上面镶着宝石四行：第一行是红宝石、红璧玺、红玉；
verses.textEnNiv: Then they mounted four rows of precious stones on it. The first row was carnelian, chrysolite and beryl;
verses.textEnEsv: And they set in it four rows of stones. A row of sardius, topaz, and carbuncle was the first row;
verses.textEnNkjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: a row with a sardius, a topaz, and an emerald was the first row;
verses.textEnNlt: They mounted four rows of gemstones on it. The first row contained a red carnelian, a pale-green peridot, and an emerald.
verses.textEnNasb: And they mounted four rows of stones on it. The first row was a row of ruby, topaz, and emerald;
verses.textEn: Then they mounted four rows of precious stones on it. The first row was carnelian, chrysolite and beryl;

verses.textZh: 第二行是绿宝石、蓝宝石、金钢石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二行是绿宝石、蓝宝石、金钢石。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二行是绿宝石、蓝宝石、金钢石；
verses.textEnNiv: the second row was turquoise, lapis lazuli and emerald;
verses.textEnEsv: and the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond;
verses.textEnNkjv: the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
verses.textEnNlt: The second row contained a turquoise, a blue lapis lazuli, and a white moonstone.
verses.textEnNasb: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
verses.textEn: the second row was turquoise, lapis lazuli and emerald;

verses.textZh: 第三行是黄玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三行是黄玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三行是紫玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶；
verses.textEnNiv: the third row was jacinth, agate and amethyst;
verses.textEnEsv: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.textEnNkjv: the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.textEnNlt: The third row contained an orange jacinth, an agate, and a purple amethyst.
verses.textEnNasb: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.textEn: the third row was jacinth, agate and amethyst;

verses.textZh: 第四行是水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉；这些宝石都是镶在金槽里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第四行是水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉；这些宝石都是镶在金槽里。
verses.textZhCuv: 第四行是水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉。这都镶在金槽中。
verses.textEnNiv: the fourth row was topaz, onyx and jasper. They were mounted in gold filigree settings.
verses.textEnEsv: and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in settings of gold filigree.
verses.textEnNkjv: the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Theywere enclosed in settings of gold in their mountings.
verses.textEnNlt: The fourth row contained a blue-green beryl, an onyx, and a green jasper. All these stones were set in gold filigree.
verses.textEnNasb: and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. They were set in gold filigree settings when they were mounted.
verses.textEn: the fourth row was topaz, onyx and jasper. They were mounted in gold filigree settings.

verses.textZh: 这些宝石代表以色列众子的名字，共有十二块；用刻图章的方法，每块刻上一个名字，十二块代表十二个支派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些宝石代表以色列众子的名字，共有十二块；用刻图章的方法，每块刻上一个名字，十二块代表十二个支派。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些宝石都是按着以色列十二个儿子的名字，仿佛刻图书，刻十二个支派的名字。
verses.textEnNiv: There were twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
verses.textEnEsv: There were twelve stones with their names according to the names of the sons of Israel. They were like signets, each engraved with its name, for the twelve tribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewere twelve stones according to the names of the sons of Israel: according to their names, engravedlike a signet, each one with its own name according to the twelve tribes.
verses.textEnNlt: Each stone represented one of the twelve sons of Israel, and the name of that tribe was engraved on it like a seal.
verses.textEnNasb: The stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel; they were twelve, corresponding to their names, engraved with the engravings of a signet, each with its name for the twelve tribes.
verses.textEn: There were twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

verses.textZh: 又在胸牌上用纯金做链子，像拧绳子一般做成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在胸牌上用纯金做链子，像拧绳子一般做成。
verses.textZhCuv: 在胸牌上，用精金拧成如绳子的链子。
verses.textEnNiv: For the breastpiece they made braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.
verses.textEnEsv: And they made on the breastpiece twisted chains like cords, of pure gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they made chains for the breastplate at the ends, like braided cords of pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: To attach the chestpiece to the ephod, they made braided cords of pure gold thread.
verses.textEnNasb: And they made for the breastpiece chains like cords, work of twisted cords of pure gold.
verses.textEn: For the breastpiece they made braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

verses.textZh: 又做两个金槽和两个金环，把两个金环安放在胸牌的两端，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又做两个金槽和两个金环，把两个金环安放在胸牌的两端，
verses.textZhCuv: 又做两个金槽和两个金环，安在胸牌的两头。
verses.textEnNiv: They made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the rings to two of the corners of the breastpiece.
verses.textEnEsv: And they made two settings of gold filigree and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two edges of the breastpiece.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also made two settings of gold and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.textEnNlt: They also made two settings of gold filigree and two gold rings and attached them to the top corners of the chestpiece.
verses.textEnNasb: They made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.
verses.textEn: They made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the rings to two of the corners of the breastpiece.

verses.textZh: 把那两条金绳穿在胸牌两端的环子里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 把那两条金绳穿在胸牌两端的环子里；
verses.textZhCuv: 把那两条拧成的金链子穿过胸牌两头的环子，
verses.textEnNiv: They fastened the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
verses.textEnEsv: And they put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the edges of the breastpiece.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.textEnNlt: They tied the two gold cords to the rings on the chestpiece.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they put the two gold cords in the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.
verses.textEn: They fastened the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

verses.textZh: 又把金绳的另两端接在两槽上，再把它们连在以弗得前面的肩带上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把金绳的另两端接在两槽上，再把它们连在以弗得前面的肩带上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又把链子的那两头接在两槽上，安在以弗得前面肩带上。
verses.textEnNiv: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
verses.textEnEsv: They attached the two ends of the two cords to the two settings of filigree. Thus they attached it in front to the shoulder pieces of the ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: The two ends of the two braided chains they fastened in the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in the front.
verses.textEnNlt: They tied the other ends of the cords to the gold settings on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod.
verses.textEnNasb: And they put the other two ends of the two cords on the two filigree settings, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front of it.
verses.textEn: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

verses.textZh: 他又做两个金环，安放在胸牌的两端，在胸牌的两边，就是在以弗得里面的边上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又做两个金环，安放在胸牌的两端，在胸牌的两边，就是在以弗得里面的边上。
verses.textZhCuv: 做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头，在以弗得里面的边上，
verses.textEnNiv: They made two gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they made two rings of gold, and put them at the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inside edge next to the ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they made two rings of gold and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on the edge of it, which was on the inward side of the ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the inside edges of the chestpiece next to the ephod.
verses.textEnNasb: They made two gold rings and placed them on the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inner edge which was next to the ephod.
verses.textEn: They made two gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

verses.textZh: 他又做两个金环，安放在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，靠近相连的地方，在以巧工做成的以弗得的肩带上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又做两个金环，安放在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，靠近相连的地方，在以巧工做成的以弗得的肩带上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 又做两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，挨近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.
verses.textEnEsv: And they made two rings of gold, and attached them in front to the lower part of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, at its seam above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: They made two other gold rings and put them on the two shoulder straps, underneath the ephod toward its front, right at the seam above the intricately woven band of the ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the front of the ephod, below the shoulder-pieces, just above the knot where the decorative sash was fastened to the ephod.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, they made two gold rings and placed them on the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on the front of it, close to the place where it joined, above the woven band of the ephod.
verses.textEn: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

verses.textZh: 他们用蓝色细带子把胸牌系住，就是把胸牌的环子和以弗得的环子系在一起，使胸牌可以贴在以巧工织成的以弗得的带子上，免得胸牌从以弗得上脱落，这是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用蓝色细带子把胸牌系住，就是把胸牌的环子和以弗得的环子系在一起，使胸牌可以贴在以巧工织成的以弗得的带子上，免得胸牌从以弗得上脱落，这是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 用一条蓝细带子把胸牌的环子和以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不可与以弗得离缝，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: They tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband so that the breastpiece would not swing out from the ephod—as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And they bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, so that it should lie on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastpiece should not come loose from the ephod, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they bound the breastplate by means of its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord, so that it would be above the intricately woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate would not come loose from the ephod, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: They attached the bottom rings of the chestpiece to the rings on the ephod with blue cords. In this way, the chestpiece was held securely to the ephod above the decorative sash. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: And they bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a violet cord, so that it would be on the woven band of the ephod, and that the breastpiece would not come loose from the ephod, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: They tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband so that the breastpiece would not swing out from the ephod—as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 又做以弗得的外袍，是织成的，全件是蓝色的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又做以弗得的外袍，是织成的，全件是蓝色的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用织工做以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。
verses.textEnNiv: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth—the work of a weaver—
verses.textEnEsv: He also made the robe of the ephod woven all of blue,
verses.textEnNkjv: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
verses.textEnNlt: Bezalel made the robe that is worn with the ephod from a single piece of blue woven cloth,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of violet;
verses.textEn: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth—the work of a weaver—

verses.textZh: 在外袍的中间有一领口，如同战袍的领口，领口的周围有领边，免得领口破裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在外袍的中间有一领口，如同战袍的领口，领口的周围有领边，免得领口破裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 袍上留一领口，口的周围织出领边来，仿佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。
verses.textEnNiv: with an opening in the center of the robe like the opening of a collar, and a band around this opening, so that it would not tear.
verses.textEnEsv: and the opening of the robe in it was like the opening in a garment, with a binding around the opening, so that it might not tear.
verses.textEnNkjv: And therewas an opening in the middle of the robe, like the opening in a coat of mail, with a woven binding all around the opening, so that it would not tear.
verses.textEnNlt: with an opening for Aaron’s head in the middle of it. The opening was reinforced with a woven collar so it would not tear.
verses.textEnNasb: and the opening of the robe was at the top in the center, as the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding all around its opening, so that it would not be torn.
verses.textEn: with an opening in the center of the robe like the opening of a collar, and a band around this opening, so that it would not tear.

verses.textZh: 又在外袍的底边上，用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做石榴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在外袍的底边上，用蓝色紫色朱红色线和捻的细麻做石榴。
verses.textZhCuv: 在袍子底边上，用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做石榴，
verses.textEnNiv: They made pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen around the hem of the robe.
verses.textEnEsv: On the hem of the robe they made pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen.
verses.textEnNkjv: They made on the hem of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet, and of fine woven linen.
verses.textEnNlt: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and attached them to the hem of the robe.
verses.textEnNasb: And they made pomegranates of violet, purple, and scarlet material and twisted linen on the hem of the robe.
verses.textEn: They made pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen around the hem of the robe.

verses.textZh: 他又用纯金做铃铛，把金铃安放在石榴中间，就是安放在外袍周围底边上的石榴中间：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又用纯金做铃铛，把金铃安放在石榴中间，就是安放在外袍周围底边上的石榴中间：
verses.textZhCuv: 又用精金做铃铛，把铃铛钉在袍子周围底边上的石榴中间：
verses.textEnNiv: And they made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates.
verses.textEnEsv: They also made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates all around the hem of the robe, between the pomegranates—
verses.textEnNkjv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates on the hem of the robe all around between the pomegranates:
verses.textEnNlt: They also made bells of pure gold and placed them between the pomegranates along the hem of the robe,
verses.textEnNasb: They also made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates all around on the hem of the robe,
verses.textEn: And they made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates.

verses.textZh: 一个金铃，一个石榴，一个金铃，一个石榴，在外袍周围的底边上，在供职时穿用；都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一个金铃，一个石榴，一个金铃，一个石榴，在外袍周围的底边上，在供职时穿用；都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 一个铃铛一个石榴，一个铃铛一个石榴，在袍子周围底边上用以供职，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: The bells and pomegranates alternated around the hem of the robe to be worn for ministering, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate around the hem of the robe for ministering, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, all around the hem of the robe to minister in, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: with bells and pomegranates alternating all around the hem. This robe was to be worn whenever the priest ministered before the Lord , just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: alternating a bell and a pomegranate all around on the hem of the robe for the service, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: The bells and pomegranates alternated around the hem of the robe to be worn for ministering, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 他又用织成的细麻布替亚伦和他的儿子做内袍，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又用织成的细麻布替亚伦和他的儿子做内袍，
verses.textZhCuv: 他用织成的细麻布为亚伦和他的儿子做内袍，
verses.textEnNiv: For Aaron and his sons, they made tunics of fine linen—the work of a weaver—
verses.textEnEsv: They also made the coats, woven of fine linen, for Aaron and his sons,
verses.textEnNkjv: They made tunics, artistically woven of fine linen, for Aaron and his sons,
verses.textEnNlt: They made tunics for Aaron and his sons from fine linen cloth.
verses.textEnNasb: They also made the tunics of finely woven linen for Aaron and his sons,
verses.textEn: For Aaron and his sons, they made tunics of fine linen—the work of a weaver—

verses.textZh: 并且用细麻做礼冠，用细麻做头巾，用捻的细麻做细麻布裤子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且用细麻做礼冠，用细麻做头巾，用捻的细麻做细麻布裤子，
verses.textZhCuv: 并用细麻布做冠冕和华美的裹头巾，用捻的细麻布做裤子，
verses.textEnNiv: and the turban of fine linen, the linen caps and the undergarments of finely twisted linen.
verses.textEnEsv: and the turban of fine linen, and the caps of fine linen, and the linen undergarments of fine twined linen,
verses.textEnNkjv: a turban of fine linen, exquisite hats of fine linen, short trousers of fine woven linen,
verses.textEnNlt: The turban and the special head coverings were made of fine linen, and the undergarments were also made of finely woven linen.
verses.textEnNasb: and the turban of fine linen, and the decorated caps of fine linen, and the linen undergarments of fine twisted linen,
verses.textEn: and the turban of fine linen, the linen caps and the undergarments of finely twisted linen.

verses.textZh: 以及用捻的细麻和蓝色紫色朱红色线，用刺绣的手工做腰带；都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及用捻的细麻和蓝色紫色朱红色线，用刺绣的手工做腰带；都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻，以绣花的手工做腰带，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: The sash was made of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn—the work of an embroiderer—as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: and the sash of fine twined linen and of blue and purple and scarlet yarns, embroidered with needlework, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: and a sash of fine woven linen with blue, purple, and scarlet thread, made by a weaver, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: The sashes were made of finely woven linen and embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet thread, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: and the sash of fine twisted linen, and violet, purple, and scarlet material, the work of the weaver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: The sash was made of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn—the work of an embroiderer—as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 他们用纯金做圣冠上的牌子，又用刻图章的方法，在上面刻着"归耶和华为圣"的字样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用纯金做圣冠上的牌子，又用刻图章的方法，在上面刻着"归耶和华为圣"的字样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用精金做圣冠上的牌，在上面按刻图书之法，刻着「归耶和华为圣」。
verses.textEnNiv: They made the plate, the sacred emblem, out of pure gold and engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: Holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engraving of a signet, "Holy to the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription like the engraving of a signet: HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, they made the sacred medallion—the badge of holiness—of pure gold. They engraved it like a seal with these words: Holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and inscribed it like the engravings of a signet, "Holy to the Lord."
verses.textEn: They made the plate, the sacred emblem, out of pure gold and engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: Holy to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 又用一条蓝色细带子把牌子系住，系在礼冠的上面，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用一条蓝色细带子把牌子系住，系在礼冠的上面，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用一条蓝细带子将牌系在冠冕上，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they fastened a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And they tied to it a cord of blue to fasten it on the turban above, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they tied to it a blue cord, to fasten it above on the turban, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: They attached the medallion with a blue cord to Aaron’s turban, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they fastened a violet cord to it, to fasten it on the turban above, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Then they fastened a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 于是，帐幕，就是会幕的一切工程都完成了；凡是耶和华吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照著作了；这样，他们就作完了会幕的一切工程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，帐幕，就是会幕的一切工程都完成了；凡是耶和华吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照著作了；这样，他们就作完了会幕的一切工程。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕，就是会幕，一切的工就这样做完了。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照样做了。
verses.textEnNiv: So all the work on the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was finished, and the people of Israel did according to all that the Lord had commanded Moses; so they did.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was finished. And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord had commanded Moses; so they did.
verses.textEnNlt: And so at last the Tabernacle was finished. The Israelites had done everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was completed; and the sons of Israel did according to all that the Lord had commanded Moses; so they did.
verses.textEn: So all the work on the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 他们把帐幕、会幕和会幕的一切器具都带到摩西那里，就是钩子、木板、横闩、柱子、柱座、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把帐幕、会幕和会幕的一切器具都带到摩西那里，就是钩子、木板、横闩、柱子、柱座、
verses.textZhCuv: 他们送到摩西那里。帐幕和帐幕的一切器具，就是钩子、板、闩、柱子、带卯的座，
verses.textEnNiv: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;
verses.textEnEsv: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its utensils, its hooks, its frames, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its furnishings: its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.textEnNlt: And they brought the entire Tabernacle to Moses: the sacred tent with all its furnishings, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts, and bases;
verses.textEnNasb: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its furnishings: its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
verses.textEn: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

verses.textZh: 染红公山羊皮的盖、海狗皮的盖和遮盖至圣所的幔子、
verses.textZhCnvs: 染红公山羊皮的盖、海狗皮的盖和遮盖至圣所的幔子、
verses.textZhCuv: 染红公羊皮的盖、海狗皮的顶盖，和遮掩柜的幔子，
verses.textEnNiv: the covering of ram skins dyed red and the covering of another durable leather and the shielding curtain;
verses.textEnEsv: the covering of tanned rams’ skins and goatskins, and the veil of the screen;
verses.textEnNkjv: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of badger skins, and the veil of the covering;
verses.textEnNlt: the tent coverings of tanned ram skins and fine goatskin leather; the inner curtain to shield the Ark;
verses.textEnNasb: and the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of fine leather, and the covering curtain;
verses.textEn: the covering of ram skins dyed red and the covering of another durable leather and the shielding curtain;

verses.textZh: 法柜、柜杠和施恩座，
verses.textZhCnvs: 法柜、柜杠和施恩座，
verses.textZhCuv: 法柜和柜的杠并施恩座，
verses.textEnNiv: the ark of the covenant law with its poles and the atonement cover;
verses.textEnEsv: the ark of the testimony with its poles and the mercy seat;
verses.textEnNkjv: the ark of the Testimony with its poles, and the mercy seat;
verses.textEnNlt: the Ark of the Covenant and its carrying poles; the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement;
verses.textEnNasb: the ark of the testimony, its poles, and the atoning cover;
verses.textEn: the ark of the covenant law with its poles and the atonement cover;

verses.textZh: 桌子、桌子上的一切器具和陈设饼，
verses.textZhCnvs: 桌子、桌子上的一切器具和陈设饼，
verses.textZhCuv: 桌子和桌子的一切器具并陈设饼，
verses.textEnNiv: the table with all its articles and the bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnEsv: the table with all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnNkjv: the table, all its utensils, and the showbread;
verses.textEnNlt: the table and all its utensils; the Bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnNasb: the table, all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
verses.textEn: the table with all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

verses.textZh: 纯金的灯台与灯盏，就是摆列在灯台上的灯盏和灯台上的一切器具，以及点灯用的油；
verses.textZhCnvs: 纯金的灯台与灯盏，就是摆列在灯台上的灯盏和灯台上的一切器具，以及点灯用的油；
verses.textZhCuv: 精金的灯台和摆列的灯盏，与灯台的一切器具，并点灯的油，
verses.textEnNiv: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its accessories, and the olive oil for the light;
verses.textEnEsv: the lampstand of pure gold and its lamps with the lamps set and all its utensils, and the oil for the light;
verses.textEnNkjv: the pure gold lampstand with its lamps (the lamps set in order), all its utensils, and the oil for light;
verses.textEnNlt: the pure gold lampstand with its symmetrical lamp cups, all its accessories, and the olive oil for lighting;
verses.textEnNasb: the pure gold lampstand, with its arrangement of lamps and all its utensils, and the oil for the light;
verses.textEn: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its accessories, and the olive oil for the light;

verses.textZh: 金坛、膏油、芬芳的香和会幕的门帘；
verses.textZhCnvs: 金坛、膏油、芬芳的香和会幕的门帘；
verses.textZhCuv: 金坛、膏油、馨香的香料、会幕的门帘，
verses.textEnNiv: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
verses.textEnEsv: the golden altar, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the entrance of the tent;
verses.textEnNkjv: the gold altar, the anointing oil, and the sweet incense; the screen for the tabernacle door;
verses.textEnNlt: the gold altar; the anointing oil and fragrant incense; the curtain for the entrance of the sacred tent;
verses.textEnNasb: and the gold altar, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the doorway of the tent;
verses.textEn: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;

verses.textZh: 铜坛、坛上的铜网、坛杠、坛上的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座；
verses.textZhCnvs: 铜坛、坛上的铜网、坛杠、坛上的一切器具、洗濯盆和盆座；
verses.textZhCuv: 铜坛和坛上的铜网，坛的杠并坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
verses.textEnNiv: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;
verses.textEnEsv: the bronze altar, and its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin and its stand;
verses.textEnNkjv: the bronze altar, its grate of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils; the laver with its base;
verses.textEnNlt: the bronze altar; the bronze grating and its carrying poles and utensils; the washbasin with its stand;
verses.textEnNasb: the bronze altar and its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils, the basin and its stand;
verses.textEn: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;

verses.textZh: 院子的幔幕、柱子、柱座、院子的门帘、绳子、钉子和帐幕，以及会幕一切使用的器具；
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子的幔幕、柱子、柱座、院子的门帘、绳子、钉子和帐幕，以及会幕一切使用的器具；
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的帷子和柱子，并带卯的座，院子的门帘、绳子、橛子，并帐幕和会幕中一切使用的器具，
verses.textEnNiv: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard; the ropes and tent pegs for the courtyard; all the furnishings for the tabernacle, the tent of meeting;
verses.textEnEsv: the hangings of the court, its pillars, and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, and its pegs; and all the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
verses.textEnNkjv: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its sockets, the screen for the court gate, its cords, and its pegs; all the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
verses.textEnNlt: the curtains for the walls of the courtyard; the posts and their bases; the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard; the ropes and tent pegs; all the furnishings to be used in worship at the Tabernacle;
verses.textEnNasb: the hangings for the courtyard, its pillars and its bases, and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and its pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
verses.textEn: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard; the ropes and tent pegs for the courtyard; all the furnishings for the tabernacle, the tent of meeting;

verses.textZh: 在圣所供职用的彩衣、祭司亚伦的圣衣和他儿子供祭司职的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在圣所供职用的彩衣、祭司亚伦的圣衣和他儿子供祭司职的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 精工做的礼服，和祭司亚伦并他儿子在圣所用以供祭司职分的圣衣。
verses.textEnNiv: and the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when serving as priests.
verses.textEnEsv: the finely worked garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons for their service as priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the garments of ministry, to minister in the holy place: the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister as priests.
verses.textEnNlt: the beautifully stitched garments for the priests to wear while ministering in the Holy Place—the sacred garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments for his sons to wear as they minister as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: the woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests.
verses.textEn: and the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when serving as priests.

verses.textZh: 这一切工作，耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切工作，耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切工作都是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐摩西做的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites had done all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: According to all that the Lord had commanded Moses, so the people of Israel had done all the work.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to all that the Lord had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people of Israel followed all of the Lord ’s instructions to Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel did all the work according to everything that the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: The Israelites had done all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 摩西查看了一切工作，见他们所作的，完全是耶和华吩咐的，就给他们祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西查看了一切工作，见他们所作的，完全是耶和华吩咐的，就给他们祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华怎样吩咐的，他们就怎样做了。摩西看见一切的工都做成了，就给他们祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses inspected the work and saw that they had done it just as the Lord had commanded. So Moses blessed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it; as the Lord had commanded, so had they done it. Then Moses blessed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses looked over all the work, and indeed they had done it; as the Lord had commanded, just so they had done it. And Moses blessed them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses inspected all their work. When he found it had been done just as the Lord had commanded him, he blessed them.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses examined all the work, and behold, they had done it; just as the Lord had commanded, this they had done. So Moses blessed them.
verses.textEn: Moses inspected the work and saw that they had done it just as the Lord had commanded. So Moses blessed them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华告诉摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华告诉摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses:

verses.textZh: "正月初一日，你要把会幕的帐幕竖立起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: "正月初一日，你要把会幕的帐幕竖立起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 「正月初一日，你要立起帐幕，
verses.textEnNiv: "Set up the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, on the first day of the first month.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the first day of the first month you shall erect the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: "On the first day of the first month you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: "Set up the Tabernacle on the first day of the new year.
verses.textEnNasb: "On the first day of the first month you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: "Set up the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, on the first day of the first month.

verses.textZh: 把法柜安放在里面，用幔子把法柜遮盖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把法柜安放在里面，用幔子把法柜遮盖。
verses.textZhCuv: 把法柜安放在里面，用幔子将柜遮掩。
verses.textEnNiv: Place the ark of the covenant law in it and shield the ark with the curtain.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put in it the ark of the testimony, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall put in it the ark of the Testimony, and partition off the ark with the veil.
verses.textEnNlt: Place the Ark of the Covenant inside, and install the inner curtain to enclose the Ark within the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall place the ark of the testimony there, and you shall screen off the ark with the veil.
verses.textEn: Place the ark of the covenant law in it and shield the ark with the curtain.

verses.textZh: 把桌子搬进去，摆上陈设物；把灯台也搬进去，把灯台上的灯盏点着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把桌子搬进去，摆上陈设物；把灯台也搬进去，把灯台上的灯盏点着。
verses.textZhCuv: 把桌子搬进去，摆设上面的物。把灯台搬进去，点其上的灯。
verses.textEnNiv: Bring in the table and set out what belongs on it. Then bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall bring in the table and arrange it, and you shall bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall bring in the table and arrange the things that are to be set in order on it; and you shall bring in the lampstand and light its lamps.
verses.textEnNlt: Then bring in the table, and arrange the utensils on it. And bring in the lampstand, and set up the lamps.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall bring in the table and arrange what belongs on it; and you shall bring in the lampstand and mount its lamps.
verses.textEn: Bring in the table and set out what belongs on it. Then bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

verses.textZh: 把烧香用的金坛安放在法柜前，挂上帐幕的门帘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把烧香用的金坛安放在法柜前，挂上帐幕的门帘。
verses.textZhCuv: 把烧香的金坛安在法柜前，挂上帐幕的门帘。
verses.textEnNiv: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the covenant law and put the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall put the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony, and set up the screen for the door of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall also set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the Testimony, and put up the screen for the door of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: "Place the gold incense altar in front of the Ark of the Covenant. Then hang the curtain at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also set the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the testimony, and set up the curtain for the doorway to the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the covenant law and put the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 把燔祭坛安放在会幕的帐幕门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把燔祭坛安放在会幕的帐幕门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 把燔祭坛安在帐幕门前。
verses.textEnNiv: "Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting;
verses.textEnEsv: You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the Tabernacle entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall set the altar of burnt offering in front of the doorway of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: "Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting;

verses.textZh: 把洗濯盆安放在会幕和祭坛的中间，把水盛在盆里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把洗濯盆安放在会幕和祭坛的中间，把水盛在盆里。
verses.textZhCuv: 把洗濯盆安在会幕和坛的中间，在盆里盛水。
verses.textEnNiv: place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it.
verses.textEnEsv: and place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall set the laver between the tabernacle of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
verses.textEnNlt: Set the washbasin between the Tabernacle and the altar, and fill it with water.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall set the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
verses.textEn: place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it.

verses.textZh: 又在周围竖立院子的幔幕，把院子的门帘挂上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在周围竖立院子的幔幕，把院子的门帘挂上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在四围立院帷，把院子的门帘挂上。
verses.textEnNiv: Set up the courtyard around it and put the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set up the court all around, and hang up the screen for the gate of the court.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall set up the court all around, and hang up the screen at the court gate.
verses.textEnNlt: Then set up the courtyard around the outside of the tent, and hang the curtain for the courtyard entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also set up the courtyard all around and hang up the curtain for the gate of the courtyard.
verses.textEn: Set up the courtyard around it and put the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.

verses.textZh: 你要拿膏油来，抹帐幕和其中的一切器具，使帐幕和帐幕的一切器具成圣，就必成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要拿膏油来，抹帐幕和其中的一切器具，使帐幕和帐幕的一切器具成圣，就必成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 用膏油把帐幕和其中所有的都抹上，使帐幕和一切器具成圣，就都成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and consecrate it and all its furniture, so that it may become holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it; and you shall hallow it and all its utensils, and it shall be holy.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take the anointing oil and anoint the Tabernacle and all its furnishings to consecrate them and make them holy.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything that is in it, and consecrate it and all its furnishings; and it shall be holy.
verses.textEn: "Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.

verses.textZh: 又要抹燔祭坛和坛上的一切器具，使坛成圣，坛就必成为至圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要抹燔祭坛和坛上的一切器具，使坛成圣，坛就必成为至圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要抹燔祭坛和一切器具，使坛成圣，就都成为至圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Then anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it will be most holy.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall also anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar, so that the altar may become most holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall anoint the altar of the burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar. The altar shall be most holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and its utensils to consecrate them. Then the altar will become absolutely holy.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar, and the altar shall be most holy.
verses.textEn: Then anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it will be most holy.

verses.textZh: 要抹洗濯盆和盆座，使它成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要抹洗濯盆和盆座，使它成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 要抹洗濯盆和盆座，使盆成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall also anoint the basin and its stand, and consecrate it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall anoint the laver and its base, and consecrate it.
verses.textEnNlt: Next anoint the washbasin and its stand to consecrate them.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall anoint the basin and its stand, and consecrate it.
verses.textEn: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.

verses.textZh: 要把亚伦和他的众子带到会幕的门口来，用水给他们洗身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把亚伦和他的众子带到会幕的门口来，用水给他们洗身。
verses.textZhCuv: 要使亚伦和他儿子到会幕门口来，用水洗身。
verses.textEnNiv: "Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and shall wash them with water
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of meeting and wash them with water.
verses.textEnNlt: "Present Aaron and his sons at the entrance of the Tabernacle, and wash them with water.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doorway of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
verses.textEn: "Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

verses.textZh: 要把圣衣给亚伦穿上，又膏抹他，使他成圣，可以作我的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把圣衣给亚伦穿上，又膏抹他，使他成圣，可以作我的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 要给亚伦穿上圣衣，又膏他，使他成圣，可以给我供祭司的职分；
verses.textEnNiv: Then dress Aaron in the sacred garments, anoint him and consecrate him so he may serve me as priest.
verses.textEnEsv: and put on Aaron the holy garments. And you shall anoint him and consecrate him, that he may serve me as priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall put the holy garments on Aaron, and anoint him and consecrate him, that he may minister to Me as priest.
verses.textEnNlt: Dress Aaron with the sacred garments and anoint him, consecrating him to serve me as a priest.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall put the holy garments on Aaron and anoint him and consecrate him, so that he may serve as a priest to Me.
verses.textEn: Then dress Aaron in the sacred garments, anoint him and consecrate him so he may serve me as priest.

verses.textZh: 你要把亚伦的儿子带来，给他们穿上内袍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把亚伦的儿子带来，给他们穿上内袍。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要使他儿子来，给他们穿上内袍。
verses.textEnNiv: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall bring his sons also and put coats on them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall bring his sons and clothe them with tunics.
verses.textEnNlt: Then present his sons and dress them in their tunics.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also bring his sons and put tunics on them;
verses.textEn: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics.

verses.textZh: 要膏抹他们好象膏抹他们的父亲一样，使他们可以作祭司服事我；他们的膏抹使他们世世代代永远当祭司之职。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 要膏抹他们好象膏抹他们的父亲一样，使他们可以作祭司服事我；他们的膏抹使他们世世代代永远当祭司之职。"
verses.textZhCuv: 怎样膏他们的父亲，也要照样膏他们，使他们给我供祭司的职分。他们世世代代凡受膏的，就永远当祭司的职任。」
verses.textEnNiv: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will be to a priesthood that will continue throughout their generations."
verses.textEnEsv: and anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may serve me as priests. And their anointing shall admit them to a perpetual priesthood throughout their generations."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to Me as priests; for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations."
verses.textEnNlt: Anoint them as you did their father, so they may also serve me as priests. With their anointing, Aaron’s descendants are set apart for the priesthood forever, from generation to generation."
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall anoint them just as you have anointed their father, so that they may serve as priests to Me; and their anointing will qualify them for a permanent priesthood throughout their generations."
verses.textEn: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will be to a priesthood that will continue throughout their generations."

verses.textZh: 摩西就这样作了；凡是耶和华吩咐他的，他都作了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就这样作了；凡是耶和华吩咐他的，他都作了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西这样行，都是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses did everything just as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: This Moses did; according to all that the Lord commanded him, so he did.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Moses did; according to all that the Lord had commanded him, so he did.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses proceeded to do everything just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses did these things; according to all that the Lord had commanded him, so he did.
verses.textEn: Moses did everything just as the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 第二年正月初一日，帐幕就竖立起来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二年正月初一日，帐幕就竖立起来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二年正月初一日，帐幕就立起来。
verses.textEnNiv: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month in the second year.
verses.textEnEsv: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was erected.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the first month of the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was raised up.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the first month of the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was erected.
verses.textEn: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month in the second year.

verses.textZh: 摩西竖立起帐幕，安上柱座，放上木板，安上横闩，竖立柱子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西竖立起帐幕，安上柱座，放上木板，安上横闩，竖立柱子。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西立起帐幕，安上带卯的座，立上板，穿上闩，立起柱子。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he put the bases in place, erected the frames, inserted the crossbars and set up the posts.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses erected the tabernacle. He laid its bases, and set up its frames, and put in its poles, and raised up its pillars.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses raised up the tabernacle, fastened its sockets, set up its boards, put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses erected the Tabernacle by setting down its bases, inserting the frames, attaching the crossbars, and setting up the posts.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses erected the tabernacle and laid its bases, and set up its boards, and inserted its bars, and erected its pillars.
verses.textEn: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he put the bases in place, erected the frames, inserted the crossbars and set up the posts.

verses.textZh: 把罩棚铺在帐幕上面，又把罩棚的上盖放在上面；都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把罩棚铺在帐幕上面，又把罩棚的上盖放在上面；都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在帐幕以上搭罩棚，把罩棚的顶盖盖在其上，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent over it, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he spread out the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent on top of it, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he spread the coverings over the Tabernacle framework and put on the protective layers, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent on top of it, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, as the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 摩西拿了法版，放在柜里，把杠穿在柜的两旁，把施恩座安放在约柜上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西拿了法版，放在柜里，把杠穿在柜的两旁，把施恩座安放在约柜上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 又把法版放在柜里，把杠穿在柜的两旁，把施恩座安在柜上。
verses.textEnNiv: He took the tablets of the covenant law and placed them in the ark, attached the poles to the ark and put the atonement cover over it.
verses.textEnEsv: He took the testimony and put it into the ark, and put the poles on the ark and set the mercy seat above on the ark.
verses.textEnNkjv: He took the Testimony and put it into the ark, inserted the poles through the rings of the ark, and put the mercy seat on top of the ark.
verses.textEnNlt: He took the stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant and placed them inside the Ark. Then he attached the carrying poles to the Ark, and he set the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement—on top of it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took the testimony and put it into the ark, and attached the poles to the ark, and put the atoning cover on top of the ark.
verses.textEn: He took the tablets of the covenant law and placed them in the ark, attached the poles to the ark and put the atonement cover over it.

verses.textZh: 把约柜抬进帐幕里去，挂上遮盖至圣所的幔子，把法柜遮盖着，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把约柜抬进帐幕里去，挂上遮盖至圣所的幔子，把法柜遮盖着，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 把柜抬进帐幕，挂上遮掩柜的幔子，把法柜遮掩了，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the shielding curtain and shielded the ark of the covenant law, as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the testimony, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, hung up the veil of the covering, and partitioned off the ark of the Testimony, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he brought the Ark of the Covenant into the Tabernacle and hung the inner curtain to shield it from view, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: He then brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up a veil for the covering, and screened off the ark of the testimony, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the shielding curtain and shielded the ark of the covenant law, as the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 又把桌子安放在会幕里，放在帐幕的北面，幔子的外面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把桌子安放在会幕里，放在帐幕的北面，幔子的外面。
verses.textZhCuv: 又把桌子安在会幕内，在帐幕北边，在幔子外。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses placed the table in the tent of meeting on the north side of the tabernacle outside the curtain
verses.textEnEsv: He put the table in the tent of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil,
verses.textEnNkjv: He put the table in the tabernacle of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil;
verses.textEnNlt: Next Moses placed the table in the Tabernacle, along the north side of the Holy Place, just outside the inner curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: He also put the table in the tent of meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil.
verses.textEn: Moses placed the table in the tent of meeting on the north side of the tabernacle outside the curtain

verses.textZh: 在桌子上把陈设饼摆在耶和华面前，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在桌子上把陈设饼摆在耶和华面前，都是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在桌子上将饼陈设在耶和华面前，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
verses.textEnNiv: and set out the bread on it before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: and arranged the bread on it before the Lord , as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he set the bread in order upon it before the Lord, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: And he arranged the Bread of the Presence on the table before the Lord , just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he set the arrangement of bread in order on it before the Lord, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: and set out the bread on it before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 摩西把灯台设立在会幕里，在帐幕的南面，与桌子相对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把灯台设立在会幕里，在帐幕的南面，与桌子相对。
verses.textZhCuv: 又把灯台安在会幕内，在帐幕南边，与桌子相对，
verses.textEnNiv: He placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle
verses.textEnEsv: He put the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnNkjv: He put the lampstand in the tabernacle of meeting, across from the table, on the south side of the tabernacle;
verses.textEnNlt: He set the lampstand in the Tabernacle across from the table on the south side of the Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: He placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle

verses.textZh: 在耶和华面前把灯盏点着，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华面前把灯盏点着，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华面前点灯，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
verses.textEnNiv: and set up the lamps before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: and set up the lamps before the Lord , as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he lit the lamps before the Lord, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he lit the lamps in the Lord ’s presence, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he lighted the lamps before the Lord, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: and set up the lamps before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 把金坛安设在会幕里，幔子的前面；
verses.textZhCnvs: 把金坛安设在会幕里，幔子的前面；
verses.textZhCuv: 把金坛安在会幕内的幔子前，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses placed the gold altar in the tent of meeting in front of the curtain
verses.textEnEsv: He put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil,
verses.textEnNkjv: He put the gold altar in the tabernacle of meeting in front of the veil;
verses.textEnNlt: He also placed the gold incense altar in the Tabernacle, in the Holy Place in front of the inner curtain.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he placed the gold altar in the tent of meeting in front of the veil;
verses.textEn: Moses placed the gold altar in the tent of meeting in front of the curtain

verses.textZh: 在坛上焚烧芬芳的香，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在坛上焚烧芬芳的香，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在坛上烧了馨香料做的香，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
verses.textEnNiv: and burned fragrant incense on it, as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: and burned fragrant incense on it, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he burned sweet incense on it, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: On it he burned the fragrant incense, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: and burned fragrant incense on it, as the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 又挂上帐幕的门帘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又挂上帐幕的门帘。
verses.textZhCuv: 又挂上帐幕的门帘。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: He put in place the screen for the door of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: He hung up the screen at the door of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: He hung the curtain at the entrance of the Tabernacle,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he set up the curtain for the doorway of the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 把燔祭坛安放在会幕的帐幕门口，把燔祭和素祭献在坛上；是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把燔祭坛安放在会幕的帐幕门口，把燔祭和素祭献在坛上；是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在会幕的帐幕门前，安设燔祭坛，把燔祭和素祭献在其上，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
verses.textEnNiv: He set the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, and offered on it burnt offerings and grain offerings, as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he put the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: and he placed the altar of burnt offering near the Tabernacle entrance. On it he offered a burnt offering and a grain offering, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he set the altar of burnt offering in front of the doorway of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: He set the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, and offered on it burnt offerings and grain offerings, as the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 又把洗濯盆安放在会幕与祭坛之间，盆里盛水，作洗濯之用；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把洗濯盆安放在会幕与祭坛之间，盆里盛水，作洗濯之用；
verses.textZhCuv: 把洗濯盆安在会幕和坛的中间，盆中盛水，以便洗濯。
verses.textEnNiv: He placed the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing,
verses.textEnEsv: He set the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing,
verses.textEnNkjv: He set the laver between the tabernacle of meeting and the altar, and put water there for washing;
verses.textEnNlt: Next Moses placed the washbasin between the Tabernacle and the altar. He filled it with water so the priests could wash themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: He placed the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing.
verses.textEn: He placed the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing,

verses.textZh: 摩西、亚伦和亚伦的儿子，可以在这盆里洗手洗脚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西、亚伦和亚伦的儿子，可以在这盆里洗手洗脚。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西和亚伦并亚伦的儿子在这盆里洗手洗脚。
verses.textEnNiv: and Moses and Aaron and his sons used it to wash their hands and feet.
verses.textEnEsv: with which Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Moses, Aaron, and his sons would wash their hands and their feet withwater from it.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses and Aaron and Aaron’s sons used water from it to wash their hands and feet.
verses.textEnNasb: From it Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet.
verses.textEn: and Moses and Aaron and his sons used it to wash their hands and feet.

verses.textZh: 每逢他们走进会幕，或是走近祭坛的时候，就要先洗濯；是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢他们走进会幕，或是走近祭坛的时候，就要先洗濯；是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们进会幕或就近坛的时候，便都洗濯，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
verses.textEnNiv: They washed whenever they entered the tent of meeting or approached the altar, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: When they went into the tent of meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whenever they went into the tabernacle of meeting, and when they came near the altar, they washed, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever they approached the altar and entered the Tabernacle, they washed themselves, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: When they entered the tent of meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: They washed whenever they entered the tent of meeting or approached the altar, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 摩西在帐幕和祭坛的周围，竖立起院子的幔幕，又挂上院子的门帘。这样摩西就完成了工程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西在帐幕和祭坛的周围，竖立起院子的幔幕，又挂上院子的门帘。这样摩西就完成了工程。
verses.textZhCuv: 在帐幕和坛的四围立了院帷，把院子的门帘挂上。这样，摩西就完了工。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and altar and put up the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard. And so Moses finished the work.
verses.textEnEsv: And he erected the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he raised up the court all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung up the screen of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he hung the curtains forming the courtyard around the Tabernacle and the altar. And he set up the curtain at the entrance of the courtyard. So at last Moses finished the work.
verses.textEnNasb: And he erected the courtyard all around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung up the curtain for the gate of the courtyard. So Moses finished the work.
verses.textEn: Then Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and altar and put up the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard. And so Moses finished the work.

verses.textZh: 当时，有云彩遮盖会幕，耶和华的荣耀充满了帐幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，有云彩遮盖会幕，耶和华的荣耀充满了帐幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，云彩遮盖会幕，耶和华的荣光就充满了帐幕。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the cloud covered the tabernacle of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the cloud covered the Tabernacle, and the glory of the Lord filled the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 摩西不能进入会幕，因为云彩停在会幕上面，并且耶和华的荣耀充满着帐幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西不能进入会幕，因为云彩停在会幕上面，并且耶和华的荣耀充满着帐幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西不能进会幕；因为云彩停在其上，并且耶和华的荣光充满了帐幕。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses could not enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud settled on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses was not able to enter the tabernacle of meeting, because the cloud rested above it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses could no longer enter the Tabernacle because the cloud had settled down over it, and the glory of the Lord filled the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: Moses could not enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 在以色列人所有的旅程中是这样的：每逢云彩从帐幕收上去的时候，他们就起程；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以色列人所有的旅程中是这样的：每逢云彩从帐幕收上去的时候，他们就起程；
verses.textZhCuv: 每逢云彩从帐幕收上去，以色列人就起程前往；
verses.textEnNiv: In all the travels of the Israelites, whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, they would set out;
verses.textEnEsv: Throughout all their journeys, whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the people of Israel would set out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whenever the cloud was taken up from above the tabernacle, the children of Israel would go onward in all their journeys.
verses.textEnNlt: Now whenever the cloud lifted from the Tabernacle, the people of Israel would set out on their journey, following it.
verses.textEnNasb: Throughout their journeys, whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the sons of Israel would set out;
verses.textEn: In all the travels of the Israelites, whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, they would set out;

verses.textZh: 云彩若是不收上去，他们就不起程，直到云彩收上去的日子为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 云彩若是不收上去，他们就不起程，直到云彩收上去的日子为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 云彩若不收上去，他们就不起程，直等到云彩收上去。
verses.textEnNiv: but if the cloud did not lift, they did not set out—until the day it lifted.
verses.textEnEsv: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out till the day that it was taken up.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not journey till the day that it was taken up.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the cloud did not rise, they remained where they were until it lifted.
verses.textEnNasb: but if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out until the day when it was taken up.
verses.textEn: but if the cloud did not lift, they did not set out—until the day it lifted.

verses.textZh: 因为以色列人所有的旅程中，日间有耶和华的云彩在帐幕上，夜间云中有火，显在以色列全家的眼前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以色列人所有的旅程中，日间有耶和华的云彩在帐幕上，夜间云中有火，显在以色列全家的眼前。
verses.textZhCuv: 日间，耶和华的云彩是在帐幕以上；夜间，云中有火，在以色列全家的眼前。在他们所行的路上都是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: So the cloud of the Lord was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the Israelites during all their travels.
verses.textEnEsv: For the cloud of the Lord was on the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel throughout all their journeys.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the cloud of the Lordwas above the tabernacle by day, and fire was over it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.textEnNlt: The cloud of the Lord hovered over the Tabernacle during the day, and at night fire glowed inside the cloud so the whole family of Israel could see it. This continued throughout all their journeys.
verses.textEnNasb: For throughout their journeys, the cloud of the Lord was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel.
verses.textEn: So the cloud of the Lord was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the Israelites during all their travels.
